phrase.zh: 人間音緣─星雲大師佛教歌曲發表會詞庫
phrase.en: Lyrics for Sounds of the Human World: Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Buddhist Songs Competition

sentences.zh: 在今年的『人間音緣─星雲大師佛教歌曲發表會詞庫』中，共有五十首全新創作的歌曲被選入。
sentences.en: In this year's 'Lyrics for Sounds of the Human World: Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Buddhist Songs Competition', fifty newly composed songs have been selected.

sentences.zh: 音樂家們積極參與『人間音緣─星雲大師佛教歌曲發表會詞庫』，為佛教藝術貢獻了許多優美的歌曲。
sentences.en: Musicians actively participated in the 'Lyrics for Sounds of the Human World: Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Buddhist Songs Competition', contributing many beautiful songs to Buddhist art.

sentences.zh: 『人間音緣─星雲大師佛教歌曲發表會詞庫』旨在弘揚佛法，透過音樂的力量將佛教智慧傳遞給更多人。
sentences.en: The 'Lyrics for Sounds of the Human World: Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Buddhist Songs Competition' aims to propagate the Dharma, using the power of music to spread Buddhist wisdom to more people.

sentences.zh: 這次『人間音緣─星雲大師佛教歌曲發表會詞庫』的作品展現了現代佛教藝術與傳承的完美結合。
sentences.en: This year's 'Lyrics for Sounds of the Human World: Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Buddhist Songs Competition' showcases a perfect blend of contemporary Buddhist art and tradition.

phrase.en: Buddhist Songs From Sounds of the Human World Competition

sentences.zh: 「人間音緣」入圍歌曲發表會將在下個月舉行，吸引了許多來自世界各地的參賽者。
sentences.en: The Buddhist Songs From Sounds of the Human World Competition will be held next month, attracting many participants from around the globe.

sentences.zh: 在「人間音緣」入圍歌曲發表會上，參賽者們將展示他們的創作，表達佛教教義。
sentences.en: At the Buddhist Songs From Sounds of the Human World Competition, participants will showcase their compositions, expressing Buddhist teachings.

sentences.zh: 「人間音緣」入圍歌曲發表會是一個展示佛教音樂和創作才能的重要平台。
sentences.en: The Buddhist Songs From Sounds of the Human World Competition is an important platform for showcasing Buddhist music and creative talents.

sentences.zh: 我們期待在「人間音緣」入圍歌曲發表會上聽到更多動人的佛教音樂作品。
sentences.en: We look forward to hearing more touching Buddhist music entries at the Buddhist Songs From Sounds of the Human World Competition.

phrase.zh: 和平鐘聲到台灣祈求兩岸和平回向法會

sentences.zh: 在寺廟裡，我們舉行了「和平鐘聲到台灣祈求兩岸和平回向法會」，旨在祈求兩岸和平。
sentences.en: At the temple, we held the “Peace Bell for Taiwan” Dharma Service, with the aim of praying for peace between the two sides.

sentences.zh: 每年這個時候，信眾們都會參加「和平鐘聲到台灣祈求兩岸和平回向法會」，希望促進和解。
sentences.en: Every year at this time, devotees participate in the “Peace Bell for Taiwan” Dharma Service, hoping to promote reconciliation.

sentences.zh: 「和平鐘聲到台灣祈求兩岸和平回向法會」吸引了許多民眾前來，共同祈禱世界和平。
sentences.en: The “Peace Bell for Taiwan” Dharma Service attracted many people who came together to pray for world peace.

sentences.zh: 在「和平鐘聲到台灣祈求兩岸和平回向法會」上，大家一同誦經，表達對和平的深切期望。
sentences.en: At the “Peace Bell for Taiwan” Dharma Service, everyone chanted sutras together, expressing their deep hope for peace.

sentences.zh: 『回歸佛陀時代』弘法大會吸引了成千上萬的信徒前來參加。
sentences.en: The 'Return To Buddha's Time' Dharma Service attracted thousands of devotees to participate.

sentences.zh: 在『回歸佛陀時代』弘法大會上，眾多法師講解了佛陀教導的核心思想。
sentences.en: During the 'Return To Buddha's Time' Dharma Service, many Dharma masters elucidated the core teachings of the Buddha.

sentences.zh: 『回歸佛陀時代』弘法大會上有許多活動，包括冥想和禪修。
sentences.en: The 'Return To Buddha's Time' Dharma Service featured various activities, including meditation and Zen practice.

sentences.zh: 參加『回歸佛陀時代』弘法大會的信徒表示，這次活動讓他們感受到了深刻的靈性啟迪。
sentences.en: Devotees attending the 'Return To Buddha's Time' Dharma Service expressed that the event provided them with profound spiritual inspiration.

phrase.en: Sounds of the Ganges River Buddhist Concert

sentences.zh: 恆河之聲梵唄音樂會舉行在一個寧靜的寺廟裡，吸引了許多信眾前來參加。
sentences.en: The 'Sounds of the Ganges River' Buddhist Concert was held in a serene temple, attracting many devotees.

sentences.zh: 這場音樂會融合了不同傳統的梵唄樂曲，讓人感受到身心靈的淨化。
sentences.en: The concert combined chanting music from different traditions, providing a purification experience for mind, body, and spirit.

sentences.zh: 在恆河之聲梵唄音樂會上，參加者們被深沉的音樂感動，達到了心靈的平靜。
sentences.en: During the 'Sounds of the Ganges River' Buddhist Concert, participants were moved by the profound music, achieving inner peace.

sentences.zh: 恆河之聲梵唄音樂會的籌辦者希望這樣的活動能促進世界和平和宗教間的理解。
sentences.en: The organizers of the 'Sounds of the Ganges River' Buddhist Concert hope such events can promote world peace and inter-religious understanding.

phrase.en: “Compassion, Loving-kindness, Joy And Equanimity” Buddhist Concert

sentences.zh: 昨晚的慈悲喜捨梵唄音樂會吸引了數百名聽眾，大家都感受到了深刻的靜謐和安詳。
sentences.en: Last night's 'Compassion, Loving-kindness, Joy And Equanimity' Buddhist Concert attracted hundreds of attendees, and everyone felt a deep sense of tranquility and peace.

sentences.zh: 這場慈悲喜捨梵唄音樂會由多位著名的佛教音樂家共同演出，共同弘揚佛教的核心精神。
sentences.en: The 'Compassion, Loving-kindness, Joy And Equanimity' Buddhist Concert was performed by several renowned Buddhist musicians, promoting the core spirit of Buddhism together.

sentences.zh: 在慈悲喜捨梵唄音樂會的尾聲，大家共同誦念經文，希望散播愛與善念。
sentences.en: At the conclusion of the 'Compassion, Loving-kindness, Joy And Equanimity' Buddhist Concert, everyone chanted sutras together, hoping to spread love and goodwill.

sentences.zh: 慈悲喜捨梵唄音樂會上的音樂和誦經讓參加者感受到心靈的淨化和重生。
sentences.en: The music and chanting at the 'Compassion, Loving-kindness, Joy And Equanimity' Buddhist Concert allowed participants to feel a sense of spiritual purification and rebirth.

sentences.zh: 浩瀚星雲音樂劇將於下個月在大城市劇院首演，吸引了大量的關注。
sentences.en: The Stars and Clouds Musical will premiere at the Grand City Theater next month, attracting a lot of attention.

sentences.zh: 這部浩瀚星雲音樂劇融合了現代音樂與傳統文化，帶來全新的藝術體驗。
sentences.en: This Stars and Clouds Musical integrates modern music with traditional culture, offering a unique artistic experience.

sentences.zh: 觀眾們對浩瀚星雲音樂劇的舞台設計和特效贊不絕口。
sentences.en: The audience praised the stage design and special effects of the Stars and Clouds Musical.

sentences.zh: 導演透露，浩瀚星雲音樂劇的靈感來自古老的星空傳說。
sentences.en: The director revealed that the inspiration for the Stars and Clouds Musical came from ancient celestial myths.

phrase.en: In Praise of the Buddhas: Buddhist Chanting And Dance

sentences.zh: 每年廟會都會舉行禮讚十方佛梵音樂舞，吸引了許多信眾前來參觀。
sentences.en: Every year, the temple fair hosts 'In Praise of the Buddhas: Buddhist Chanting and Dance,' attracting many devotees.

sentences.zh: 在禮讚十方佛梵音樂舞的表演中，僧人們以動聽的梵音和優美的舞姿表達對佛陀的敬意。
sentences.en: During the 'In Praise of the Buddhas: Buddhist Chanting and Dance' performance, monks express their reverence for the Buddha through melodious chants and graceful dances.

sentences.zh: 這次禮讚十方佛梵音樂舞的演出，由一支國際知名的舞團特別呈現。
sentences.en: This rendition of 'In Praise of the Buddhas: Buddhist Chanting and Dance' was specially presented by an internationally renowned dance troupe.

sentences.zh: 參與禮讚十方佛梵音樂舞的活動，讓人感受到深邃的佛教文化和無上的心靈寧靜。
sentences.en: Participating in 'In Praise of the Buddhas: Buddhist Chanting and Dance' allows one to experience profound Buddhist culture and supreme inner peace.

phrase.zh: 莊嚴淨土·梵音樂舞·梵唄音樂會
phrase.en: Beautiful Pure Land - Buddhist Chanting And Dances

sentences.zh: 莊嚴淨土·梵音樂舞·梵唄音樂會是一場融合了古典與現代元素的表演，吸引了眾多觀眾。
sentences.en: The Beautiful Pure Land - Buddhist Chanting And Dances is a performance that blends classical and modern elements, attracting a large audience.

sentences.zh: 這次莊嚴淨土·梵音樂舞·梵唄音樂會的演出者都是來自不同國家的佛教藝術家，呈現了豐富多樣的文化。
sentences.en: Performers in this Beautiful Pure Land - Buddhist Chanting And Dances come from various countries, presenting a rich and diverse culture.

sentences.zh: 音樂會的莊嚴氛圍讓人感受到淨土的純淨與安寧，是心靈的一次洗滌。
sentences.en: The solemn atmosphere of the concert makes people feel the purity and tranquility of the Pure Land, serving as a cleansing for the soul.

sentences.zh: 莊嚴淨土·梵音樂舞·梵唄音樂會的每個環節都精心設計，從視覺到聽覺都給人以深刻的體驗。
sentences.en: Every part of the Beautiful Pure Land - Buddhist Chanting And Dances concert is meticulously designed, providing a profound experience from both visual and auditory perspectives.

phrase.zh: 覺有情─星雲大師墨跡巡迴展
phrase.en: To Enlighten Sentient Beings - Calligraphy Tour of Venerable Master

sentences.zh: 覺有情─星雲大師墨跡巡迴展在全國各地巡回，吸引了無數佛教信徒和書法愛好者前來參觀。
sentences.en: The 'To Enlighten Sentient Beings - Calligraphy Tour of Venerable Master' has been traveling nationwide, attracting numerous Buddhist devotees and calligraphy enthusiasts.

sentences.zh: 此次覺有情─星雲大師墨跡巡迴展展示了大師多年來創作的珍貴書法作品。
sentences.en: The 'To Enlighten Sentient Beings - Calligraphy Tour of Venerable Master' showcases the precious calligraphy works created by the Venerable Master over the years.

sentences.zh: 覺有情─星雲大師墨跡巡迴展所傳達的慈悲與智慧，讓觀眾深受感動。
sentences.en: The compassion and wisdom conveyed by the 'To Enlighten Sentient Beings - Calligraphy Tour of Venerable Master' deeply moved the audience.

sentences.zh: 許多人在參觀覺有情─星雲大師墨跡巡迴展後，表示得到了心靈的啟發與淨化。
sentences.en: Many people expressed that their souls were enlightened and purified after visiting the 'To Enlighten Sentient Beings - Calligraphy Tour of Venerable Master'.

sentences.zh: 今年夏天，世人將有機會觀看改編自佛教故事的釋迦牟尼佛傳音樂劇。
sentences.en: This summer, the world will have the opportunity to watch Siddhartha: The Musical, adapted from Buddhist stories.

sentences.zh: 釋迦牟尼佛傳音樂劇結合了現代舞蹈和傳統音樂，創造了一個獨特的視覺和聽覺盛宴。
sentences.en: Siddhartha: The Musical combines modern dance with traditional music to create a unique visual and auditory feast.

sentences.zh: 當我第一次看到釋迦牟尼佛傳音樂劇的海報時，我就對這部劇充滿了期待。
sentences.en: When I first saw the poster for Siddhartha: The Musical, I was filled with anticipation for the show.

sentences.zh: 許多觀眾都被釋迦牟尼佛傳音樂劇中深刻的佛法理念所感動。
sentences.en: Many audience members were moved by the profound Buddhist concepts presented in Siddhartha: The Musical.

sentences.zh: 每次我們到32養生蔬食館，都可以品嘗到新鮮、美味的素食料理。
sentences.en: Every time we visit the 32 Vegetarian Restaurant, we can enjoy fresh and delicious vegetarian dishes.

sentences.zh: 32養生蔬食館因其健康的菜單和舒適的環境，受到顧客們的高度評價。
sentences.en: The 32 Vegetarian Restaurant is highly rated by customers for its healthy menu and comfortable environment.

sentences.zh: 32養生蔬食館的廚師們用心準備每一道菜，確保顧客吃得健康又滿足。
sentences.en: The chefs at the 32 Vegetarian Restaurant carefully prepare each dish to ensure that customers eat healthily and feel satisfied.

sentences.zh: 我們計劃在週末去32養生蔬食館享用豐盛的晚餐，享受慢食的樂趣。
sentences.en: We plan to go to the 32 Vegetarian Restaurant for a sumptuous dinner this weekend to enjoy the pleasures of slow dining.

sentences.zh: 她參加了寺廟舉辦的49日精進念佛活動，以求內心的平靜和智慧。
sentences.en: She attended the 49-Day Amitabha Chanting Retreat organized by the temple, seeking inner peace and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 49日精進念佛是一種深度修行，可以幫助參加者淨化心靈和累積福報。
sentences.en: The 49-Day Amitabha Chanting Retreat is an intensive practice that helps participants purify their mind and accumulate merit.

sentences.zh: 每年，成千上萬的信眾參加49日精進念佛，祈求阿彌陀佛的加持。
sentences.en: Every year, thousands of devotees participate in the 49-Day Amitabha Chanting Retreat, praying for the blessings of Amitabha Buddha.

sentences.zh: 49日精進念佛需要堅持和決心，許多人因此而達到了前所未有的心靈淨化。
sentences.en: The 49-Day Amitabha Chanting Retreat requires perseverance and determination, and many achieve unprecedented spiritual purification as a result.

sentences.zh: 在人我之間要跳探戈，雙方都需要默契和協調。
sentences.en: In personal relationships, like tango, both parties need harmony and coordination.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們，人我之間要跳探戈，這樣才能保持良好的關係。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us that personal relationships are like tango, which helps maintain healthy relations.

sentences.zh: 老師告訴我們，人我之間要跳探戈，彼此的理解和包容至關重要。
sentences.en: The teacher told us that personal relationships are like tango, where mutual understanding and tolerance are crucial.

sentences.zh: 夫妻之間，人我之間要跳探戈，才能共同成長，度過難關。
sentences.en: Between spouses, personal relationships are like tango, allowing them to grow together and overcome challenges.

sentences.zh: 一九五三宜蘭合唱團在國際合唱比賽中贏得了金獎。
sentences.en: The 1953 Yilan Choir won the gold medal in the international choir competition.

sentences.zh: 一九五三宜蘭合唱團在當地社區舉辦了一場慈善音樂會，引來了大批觀眾。
sentences.en: The 1953 Yilan Choir held a charity concert in the local community, attracting a large audience.

sentences.zh: 這個合唱團的成員來自不同的年齡層和職業，展示了多樣性和包容性。
sentences.en: The members of the 1953 Yilan Choir come from different age groups and professions, showcasing diversity and inclusivity.

sentences.zh: 一九五三宜蘭合唱團定期在各地巡演，傳播音樂的美好和佛教的慈悲理念。
sentences.en: The 1953 Yilan Choir regularly tours different regions, spreading the beauty of music and the compassionate ideals of Buddhism.

phrase.zh: 一人一世界 一心一如來
phrase.en: Every mind is a world; Every heart is a buddha.

sentences.zh: 在佛教思想中，一人一世界 一心一如來意味著每個人的內心世界都同樣重要和獨特。
sentences.en: In Buddhist philosophy, 'Every mind is a world; Every heart is a buddha' means that each individual's inner world is equally important and unique.

sentences.zh: 老師告訴我們，一人一世界 一心一如來，教導我們要尊重他人的內在經驗。
sentences.en: The teacher told us, 'Every mind is a world; Every heart is a buddha,' teaching us to respect the inner experiences of others.

sentences.zh: 她經常冥想，體會一人一世界 一心一如來的真理，感受內心的平靜與和諧。
sentences.en: She often meditates, experiencing the truth of 'Every mind is a world; Every heart is a buddha,' feeling inner peace and harmony.

sentences.zh: 他認為一人一世界 一心一如來的概念幫助他更好地理解和包容這個多樣化的社會。
sentences.en: He believes that the concept of 'Every mind is a world; Every heart is a buddha' helps him better understand and embrace our diverse society.

phrase.zh: 一人入道 全家有福
phrase.en: When One Member Enters the Way; The Entire Family Will Benefit from It

sentences.zh: 一人入道 全家有福，這句話意味著當一個人修行佛法，全家都會因此受益。
sentences.en: The phrase 'When One Member Enters the Way; The Entire Family Will Benefit from It' means that when one person practices Buddhism, the entire family will be blessed.

sentences.zh: 在他的帶領下，全家人都開始了解佛法，顯然應證了一人入道 全家有福。
sentences.en: Under his guidance, the whole family started to learn about Buddhism, evidently proving the saying 'When One Member Enters the Way; The Entire Family Will Benefit from It'.

sentences.zh: 我們的老師經常說，一人入道 全家有福，鼓勵大家追求佛法修行。
sentences.en: Our teacher often says, 'When One Member Enters the Way; The Entire Family Will Benefit from It', encouraging everyone to pursue the practice of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 自從她開始修行佛法，他們家庭的氣氛變得更為和諧，真可謂一人入道 全家有福。
sentences.en: Since she started practicing Buddhism, the family atmosphere has become more harmonious, truly exemplifying 'When One Member Enters the Way; The Entire Family Will Benefit from It'.

sentences.zh: 他對待工作的態度始終如一，一以貫之地保持高效和專業。
sentences.en: His attitude towards work has always been consistent; he consistently maintains efficiency and professionalism.

sentences.zh: 學佛必須一以貫之，不能今天學這個，明天學那個。
sentences.en: Learning Buddhism requires consistency; one cannot study one thing today and another thing tomorrow.

sentences.zh: 教育孩子需要一以貫之的原則，這樣才能培養出有良好習慣的孩子。
sentences.en: Raising children requires consistent principles so that they can develop good habits.

sentences.zh: 他在困難面前依然一以貫之，從未放棄過他的信念。
sentences.en: In the face of difficulties, he remained consistent and never abandoned his beliefs.

phrase.en: when one buddha is born, the other two will pass away

sentences.zh: 按照古老的預言，一佛出世，二佛涅槃，這象徵著宇宙間的永恆變化。
sentences.en: According to ancient prophecy, when one Buddha is born, the other two will pass away, signifying the eternal changes in the universe.

sentences.zh: 這句話‘一佛出世，二佛涅槃’常用來描述盛世與衰亡的交替。
sentences.en: The phrase 'when one Buddha is born, the other two will pass away' is often used to describe the cyclical nature of prosperity and decline.

sentences.zh: 在佛教典籍中，一佛出世，二佛涅槃，被解釋為世界上的平衡法則。
sentences.en: In Buddhist scriptures, 'when one Buddha is born, the other two will pass away' is interpreted as the balancing principle of the world.

sentences.zh: 古代禪師常用‘一佛出世，二佛涅槃’來教導弟子把握當下，珍惜現世的修行。
sentences.en: Ancient Zen masters often used 'when one Buddha is born, the other two will pass away' to teach disciples to seize the moment and cherish their spiritual practice in the present.

phrase.en: The birth of one Buddha is made possible by thousands of other Buddhas

sentences.zh: 據說，一佛出世，千佛護持，這意味著每一位新的佛陀都得到了無數前行者的支持。
sentences.en: It is said that the birth of one Buddha is made possible by thousands of other Buddhas, meaning that each new Buddha is supported by countless predecessors.

sentences.zh: 我們應該記住，一佛出世，千佛護持，這樣才能感恩那些默默奉獻的修行者。
sentences.en: We should remember that the birth of one Buddha is made possible by thousands of other Buddhas, thereby showing gratitude to the numerous practitioners who contribute silently.

sentences.zh: 佛教中的一個重要概念是，一佛出世，千佛護持，這表明一個人的覺悟需要社群的共同努力。
sentences.en: A key concept in Buddhism is that the birth of one Buddha is made possible by thousands of other Buddhas, indicating that an individual's enlightenment requires the collective effort of the community.

sentences.zh: 老師經常提醒我們，一佛出世，千佛護持，這樣我們才能在修行的路上互相幫助。
sentences.en: The teacher often reminds us that the birth of one Buddha is made possible by thousands of other Buddhas, so that we can help each other on the path of practice.

zh: 一個真誠的微笑 給人無限的歡喜
一句適當的鼓勵 給人無窮的受用
一件慈悲的善行 給人無量的因緣
一則應機的故事 給人無盡的啟示
en: A sincere smile offers immeasurable joy.
A fitting encouragement offers endless support.
An act of compassion offers boundless possibilities.
A relevant story offers infinite inspirations.

sentences.zh: 一個真誠的微笑，給人無限的歡喜，就像陽光驅散寒冷的陰霾。
sentences.en: A sincere smile offers immeasurable joy, just like sunlight dispels the chilly gloom.

sentences.zh: 她的一個真誠的微笑，給了疲憊不堪的他無限的歡喜和安慰。
sentences.en: Her sincere smile offered him immeasurable joy and comfort amid his exhaustion.

sentences.zh: 一個真誠的微笑，自他人的心中散發出無限的歡喜，是人間最好的禮物。
sentences.en: A sincere smile emanating from someone's heart brings immeasurable joy, the finest gift of humanity.

sentences.zh: 他的真誠微笑像一盞明燈，給人無限的歡喜和希望。
sentences.en: His sincere smile is like a bright light, offering immeasurable joy and hope.

sentences.zh: 一句適當的鼓勵，給人無窮的受用，讓她重新燃起了勇氣和信心。
sentences.en: A fitting encouragement offers endless support, reigniting her courage and confidence.

sentences.zh: 他的適當鼓勵給她無窮的受用，使她不再畏懼挑戰。
sentences.en: His fitting encouragement offered her endless support, making her fearless in the face of challenges.

sentences.zh: 那一句適當的鼓勵，給人無窮的受用，成為她前行的力量。
sentences.en: That fitting encouragement offered endless support, becoming her driving force.

sentences.zh: 老師的一句適當的鼓勵，給他無窮的受用，使他擁有了更多自信。
sentences.en: The teacher's fitting encouragement offered endless support, giving him more confidence.

sentences.zh: 一件慈悲的善行，給人無量的因緣，種下了躲避風暴的種子。
sentences.en: An act of compassion offers boundless possibilities, planting seeds to weather the storms.

sentences.zh: 她一件慈悲的善行，給了他無量的因緣，改變了他的一生。
sentences.en: Her act of compassion offered him boundless possibilities, changing his life forever.

sentences.zh: 實踐慈悲的善行，給人無量的因緣，讓社會更加和諧。
sentences.en: Practicing acts of compassion offers boundless possibilities, bringing more harmony to society.

sentences.zh: 慈悲的善行就像春風，給人無量的因緣，散播在四方。
sentences.en: Acts of compassion are like a spring breeze, offering boundless possibilities and spreading everywhere.

sentences.zh: 一則應機的故事，給人無盡的啟示，讓人們在苦難中找到光明。
sentences.en: A relevant story offers infinite inspirations, helping people find light in their suffering.

sentences.zh: 他的應機故事，給聽眾無盡的啟示，使他們重新思考生活的意義。
sentences.en: His relevant story offered the audience infinite inspirations, making them rethink the meaning of life.

sentences.zh: 那則應機的故事，給人無盡的啟示，提醒人們永不放棄希望。
sentences.en: That relevant story offered infinite inspirations, reminding people never to lose hope.

sentences.zh: 老人講述的應機故事，給年輕一代無盡的啟示，指引他們走向美好的未來。
sentences.en: The elderly man's relevant story offered the younger generation infinite inspirations, guiding them towards a better future.

phrase.zh: 一個科學者研究佛經的報告
phrase.en: Reports of Buddhist Studies by a Scientist

sentences.zh: 在會議上，他展示了一個科學者研究佛經的報告，並引起了廣泛的討論。
sentences.en: At the conference, he presented reports of Buddhist studies by a scientist, sparking widespread discussion.

sentences.zh: 這本書收集了一個科學者研究佛經的報告，對佛教經典進行了全新的解讀。
sentences.en: This book compiles reports of Buddhist studies by a scientist, offering a fresh interpretation of Buddhist scriptures.

sentences.zh: 一個科學者研究佛經的報告揭示了科學與佛學之間的深層聯繫。
sentences.en: Reports of Buddhist studies by a scientist reveal deep connections between science and Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 學術期刊最近刊登了一篇文章，詳述了一個科學者研究佛經的報告。
sentences.en: A recent academic journal published an article detailing reports of Buddhist studies by a scientist.

phrase.en: All Is but a Creation of the Mind

sentences.zh: 佛教教義告訴我們，一切唯心造，我們的思想創造了我們的現實。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings tell us that all is but a creation of the mind, and our thoughts create our reality.

sentences.zh: 禪宗大師強調一切唯心造，提醒我們保持內心的清淨和智慧。
sentences.en: Zen masters emphasize that all is but a creation of the mind, reminding us to maintain inner purity and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 在面對困難時，我們應該記住一切唯心造，從而轉變我們的內心狀態。
sentences.en: When facing difficulties, we should remember that all is but a creation of the mind, and thus transform our inner state.

sentences.zh: 透過修行，我們可以體驗一切唯心造的真理，從迷惑中解脫出來。
sentences.en: Through practice, we can experience the truth that all is but a creation of the mind and liberate ourselves from delusion.

phrases.zh: 一切好事 從我本身做起
phrases.en: May all good causes begin from self.

phrases.zh: 一切好言 從我口中說出
phrases.en: May all good words spread from my speech.

phrases.zh: 一切善心 從我自己開發
phrases.en: May all good intentions begin from my heart.

phrases.zh: 一切善人 從我至誠禮敬
phrases.en: May all good people feel respect from me.

sentences.zh: 一切好事從我本身做起，這樣才能真正改變世界。
sentences.en: May all good causes begin from self, this is the only way to truly change the world.

sentences.zh: 她相信一切好事從我本身做起，因此每天都在努力改善自己。
sentences.en: She believes that all good causes begin from self, so she works on improving herself every day.

sentences.zh: 他常說，一切好事必須從我本身做起，這樣才能帶來積極的影響。
sentences.en: He often says that all good causes must begin from self so that we can make a positive impact.

sentences.zh: 一切好事從我本身做起，我們才能共同創造一個更好的社會。
sentences.en: May all good causes begin from self; only then can we together create a better society.

sentences.zh: 一切好言從我口中說出，讓周圍的人感受到真誠與溫暖。
sentences.en: May all good words spread from my speech, letting those around feel sincerity and warmth.

sentences.zh: 她的座右銘是一切好言從我口中說出，這讓她的朋友們都十分敬重她。
sentences.en: Her motto is that all good words spread from my speech, which earns her great respect from her friends.

sentences.zh: 一切好言從我口中說出，這是我每天努力實踐的原則。
sentences.en: May all good words spread from my speech, this is the principle I strive to live by every day.

sentences.zh: 他堅信，一切好言從我口中說出，可以讓這個世界變得更好。
sentences.en: He firmly believes that all good words spread from my speech can make the world a better place.

sentences.zh: 一切善心從我自己開發，這是修行的第一步。
sentences.en: May all good intentions begin from my heart, as this is the first step in cultivation.

sentences.zh: 在大多數情況下，一切善心從我自己開發比尋求外在的幫助更加有效。
sentences.en: In most cases, all good intentions beginning from my heart is more effective than seeking external help.

sentences.zh: 一切善心從我自己開發，這樣才是真正的修行。
sentences.en: May all good intentions begin from my heart; this is the true practice.

sentences.zh: 他經常提醒自己，一切善心從我自己開發，才能繼續前進。
sentences.en: He often reminds himself that all good intentions begin from my heart, so that he can keep moving forward.

sentences.zh: 一切善人從我至誠禮敬，只因尊重是最基本的美德。
sentences.en: May all good people feel respect from me, for respect is the most fundamental virtue.

sentences.zh: 她相信，一切善人從我至誠禮敬，這樣能帶來更多的和諧。
sentences.en: She believes that all good people feel respect from me, as this brings more harmony.

sentences.zh: 一切善人從我至誠禮敬，是我每天禱告的一部分。
sentences.en: May all good people feel respect from me, as it is part of my daily prayers.

sentences.zh: 他每天都反思，一切善人從我至誠禮敬，希望成為一個更好的人。
sentences.en: He reflects daily that all good people feel respect from me, aspiring to become a better person.

sentences.zh: 佛陀擁有無上的一切智，能夠洞察世間的諸法實相。
sentences.en: The Buddha possesses supreme wisdom of all, capable of perceiving the true nature of all phenomena in the world.

sentences.zh: 在修行的過程中，我們應該追求一切智，以達到究竟解脫。
sentences.en: In the course of practice, we should seek the wisdom of all to attain ultimate liberation.

sentences.zh: 一切智讓我們能夠不受煩惱阻礙，從而得到真正的內心平安。
sentences.en: The wisdom of all enables us to be free from the hindrances of afflictions, thereby attaining true inner peace.

sentences.zh: 只有通過正確的修習和思索，我們才有可能獲得一切智，達到菩薩的境界。
sentences.en: Only through correct practice and contemplation can we possibly gain the wisdom of all and reach the state of a bodhisattva.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒應當培養對一切有情的悲憫之心。
sentences.en: Buddhists should cultivate compassion for all living beings.

sentences.zh: 我們的修行目標是解脫一切有情的苦難。
sentences.en: Our goal in practice is to liberate all living beings from suffering.

sentences.zh: 在大悲咒中，我們祈願一切有情都能獲得平安與快樂。
sentences.en: In the Great Compassion Mantra, we pray for all living beings to attain peace and happiness.

sentences.zh: 菩薩以大慈大悲救度一切有情，無論貧富貴賤。
sentences.en: Bodhisattvas, with great compassion, save all living beings regardless of their status.

phrase.zh: 一切有為法，如夢幻泡影
phrase.en: all conditioned phenomena are like dreams, illusions, bubbles, and shadows

sentences.zh: 佛陀教導我們，一切有為法，如夢幻泡影，以提醒我們人生的無常與虛幻。
sentences.en: The Buddha taught us that all conditioned phenomena are like dreams, illusions, bubbles, and shadows to remind us of life's impermanence and illusory nature.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，僧侶們經常反思一切有為法，如夢幻泡影，來達到心靈的平靜。
sentences.en: During meditation, monks often reflect on the idea that all conditioned phenomena are like dreams, illusions, bubbles, and shadows to achieve inner peace.

sentences.zh: 她深知一切有為法，如夢幻泡影，所以她不再執著於物質的追求。
sentences.en: She understood deeply that all conditioned phenomena are like dreams, illusions, bubbles, and shadows, so she no longer clung to material pursuits.

sentences.zh: 學習一切有為法，如夢幻泡影的智慧，他逐漸放下了對未來的焦慮。
sentences.en: By learning the wisdom that all conditioned phenomena are like dreams, illusions, bubbles, and shadows, he gradually let go of his anxiety about the future.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，一切法皆是空的，沒有實體。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, all phenomena are considered empty, lacking inherent existence.

sentences.zh: 悟道之人能見一切法的真實相，了知無常與無我。
sentences.en: An enlightened person can see the true nature of all phenomena, understanding impermanence and non-self.

sentences.zh: 了解一切法的相互依存性有助於我們放下執著。
sentences.en: Understanding the interdependent nature of all phenomena helps us let go of attachments.

sentences.zh: 涅槃是超越一切法的狀態，是究竟的安樂。
sentences.en: Nirvana is a state beyond all phenomena, representing ultimate peace and happiness.

sentences.zh: 佛陀的慈悲心普及一切眾生，無論貧富貴賤。
sentences.en: The Buddha's compassion extends to all sentient beings, regardless of their wealth or status.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，修行者發願幫助和救度一切眾生。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, practitioners vow to help and save all sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 慈悲心是對一切眾生無條件的愛與關懷。
sentences.en: Compassion is the unconditional love and care for all sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 菩薩道是為了利益一切眾生而實行的修行方式。
sentences.en: The Bodhisattva path is a practice aimed at benefiting all sentient beings.

phrase.en: All sentient beings are capable of becoming buddhas

sentences.zh: 佛教教義強調一切眾生皆能成佛的可能性，這代表了無窮的希望與慈悲。
sentences.en: The teachings of Buddhism emphasize that all sentient beings are capable of becoming buddhas, which represents endless hope and compassion.

sentences.zh: 導師告訴我們，一切眾生皆能成佛，只要我們持續修行和積善。
sentences.en: The teacher told us that all sentient beings are capable of becoming buddhas, as long as we continue practicing and accumulating virtues.

sentences.zh: 這部經文闡述了一切眾生皆能成佛的理念，激勵信眾追求真理。
sentences.en: This scripture elucidates the concept that all sentient beings are capable of becoming buddhas, inspiring devotees to seek the truth.

sentences.zh: 一切眾生皆能成佛的信念讓我們更加包容和慈愛，對待每個生命都充滿敬重。
sentences.en: The belief that all sentient beings are capable of becoming buddhas makes us more inclusive and loving, treating every life with respect.

phrase.en: Everything is as it should be

sentences.zh: 在佛教的智慧中，我們學到一切都是當然的，無須執著於過去或未來。
sentences.en: In the wisdom of Buddhism, we learn that everything is as it should be, without clinging to the past or the future.

sentences.zh: 當我們明白一切都是當然的，此刻的每個經歷都成了一種恩典。
sentences.en: When we understand that everything is as it should be, every experience in the present moment becomes a grace.

sentences.zh: 在面對逆境時，應該記得一切都是當然的，這樣可以幫助我們保持內心的平靜。
sentences.en: When facing adversity, we should remember that everything is as it should be, which can help us maintain inner peace.

sentences.zh: 她學會了接受生活的變化，因為她知道一切都是當然的。
sentences.en: She learned to accept the changes in life because she knew that everything is as it should be.

sentences.zh: 佛經中常提到一剎那，指的是極短暫的時間。
sentences.en: The Buddhist scriptures often mention one ksana, referring to an extremely brief moment of time.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，一剎那的覺悟可能改變整個人生。
sentences.en: In meditation practice, one ksana of enlightenment can change one's entire life.

sentences.zh: 當下的這一剎那，充滿了無限的可能性。
sentences.en: This very ksana is filled with infinite possibilities.

sentences.zh: 我們在一剎那的決定中，往往會影響未來的走向。
sentences.en: Decisions made in one ksana often influence the course of the future.

sentences.zh: 在轉生的輪迴中，我們的行為和經歷可能會重複（Duplicate），直到我們學會該學的課題。
sentences.en: In the cycle of reincarnation, our actions and experiences may duplicate until we learn the lessons we need to.

sentences.zh: 禪修中，我們應避免思想的重複（Duplicate），努力保持心境的單純和專注。
sentences.en: In Zen meditation, we should avoid the duplication of thoughts, striving to maintain a state of simplicity and concentration.

sentences.zh: 佛僧們經常要抄寫經文，有時需要精確地重複（Duplicate）經書中的每一句話。
sentences.en: Monks often have to transcribe scriptures, sometimes requiring precise duplication of every sentence from the sacred texts.

sentences.zh: 祭祀儀式通常包含許多重複（Duplicate）的動作，象徵著一種神聖的傳承。
sentences.en: The rituals often include many duplicated actions, symbolizing a sacred tradition.

sentences.zh: 一曉一天明，每個黎明都意味著新的開始。
sentences.en: Every dawn breaks into a sunrise, symbolizing a new beginning.

sentences.zh: 一天一日行，每一天都是生命的一部分。
sentences.en: Every day is a part of life, contributing to the journey of existence.

sentences.zh: 一路一條道，每條路都通向一個目的。
sentences.en: Every road leads to a way, guiding us towards a destination.

sentences.zh: 一往一來去，每一次來臨都帶來一次離別。
sentences.en: Every arrival leads to departure, marking the cycle of coming and going.

sentences.zh: 一點一開始，每一點都是新的起點。
sentences.en: Every dot is a beginning, signifying a fresh start.

sentences.zh: 一筆一幅畫，每一筆都使畫作完整。
sentences.en: Every brush makes a painting whole, bringing it to life.

sentences.zh: 一手一片天，每隻手都能創造一片天地。
sentences.en: Every hand creates a world, capable of shaping realities.

sentences.zh: 一笑一歡喜，每一次微笑都帶來喜悅。
sentences.en: Every smile carries a delight, spreading happiness.

sentences.zh: 一生一條命，每個生命都代表著希望。
sentences.en: Every life represents a hope, embodying potential and dreams.

sentences.zh: 一人一顆心，每個人都有一顆心。
sentences.en: Every person has a heart, with its own emotions and desires.

sentences.zh: 一句一讚歎，每句話都能成為讚歎。
sentences.en: Every word can be a compliment, offering praise and appreciation.

sentences.zh: 一家一合相，每個家庭都有一種聯結。
sentences.en: Every family is a union, bonded by connection and love.

sentences.zh: 一默一聲雷，每個靜默都意味著響徹的聲音。
sentences.en: Every silence is a thunderous statement, speaking volumes.

sentences.zh: 一事一種理，每件事都包含一種道理。
sentences.en: Every incident embodies a theory, teaching us lessons.

sentences.zh: 一諾一千金，每個承諾都價值千金。
sentences.en: Every promise is worth a thousand gold, signifying trust.

sentences.zh: 一小一無限，每一小事都蘊含無限可能。
sentences.en: Every small matter holds infinite possibilities, unfolding potential.

sentences.zh: 一念一禪法，每一個念頭都包含禪修的智慧。
sentences.en: Every thought is Chan in practice, embracing mindfulness.

sentences.zh: 一空一切色，每份空性都蘊含萬象。
sentences.en: Every emptiness comprises all matters, encapsulating the universe.

sentences.zh: 一花一世界，每朵花都是一個世界。
sentences.en: Every flower is a world of its own, containing boundless beauty.

sentences.zh: 一葉一如來，每片葉子都是如來的顯現。
sentences.en: Every leaf is a manifestation of Buddha, symbolizing enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，一劫是指一個非常漫長的時間單位，超出了我們通常所能理解的時間範圍。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, one kalpa is a very long unit of time that surpasses our usual understanding of time.

sentences.zh: 據說，佛陀在過去的一劫中已經修行了多次，積累了無數的功德。
sentences.en: It is said that the Buddha practiced many times in past kalpas, accumulating countless merits.

sentences.zh: 一劫的概念幫助我們理解時間的無限性以及修行道路的漫長。
sentences.en: The concept of one kalpa helps us understand the infiniteness of time and the long path of spiritual practice.

sentences.zh: 某些經文中提到世界在經歷一劫後會經歷巨大的變遷。
sentences.en: Certain scriptures mention that the world undergoes significant changes after the duration of one kalpa.

sentences.zh: 修行者沿著佛塔繞行一匝，表達他們的虔誠與敬意。
sentences.en: The practitioners made a full circle around the stupa, expressing their devotion and respect.

sentences.zh: 他們在佛堂內一匝接著一匝地步行，祈求心靈的平靜。
sentences.en: They walked a full circle after another in the hall, praying for inner peace.

sentences.zh: 我看到香客們虔誠地環繞佛像一匝，並在每個感恩節點鞠躬。
sentences.en: I saw the devotees making a full circle around the Buddha statue, bowing at each point of thanksgiving.

sentences.zh: 在高僧的帶領下，僧侶們整齊地繞行寺院一匝，進行晨間修行。
sentences.en: Led by the master monk, the monks made a full circle around the temple in an orderly manner as part of their morning practice.

sentences.zh: 他的意見對這個計劃的支持是一半一半，他既看到了優點也看到了缺點。
sentences.en: His opinion on supporting the plan is half and half; he sees both the advantages and the disadvantages.

sentences.zh: 這杯咖啡裡加的奶和咖啡是一半一半，味道剛剛好。
sentences.en: The milk and coffee in this cup are half and half, making the flavor just right.

sentences.zh: 在選舉結果中，支持和反對的票數是一半一半。
sentences.en: In the election results, the votes for and against were half and half.

sentences.zh: 我們的任務完成了大約一半一半，但仍需要更多的努力來達成目標。
sentences.en: We have completed about half and half of our tasks, but more effort is still needed to reach our goal.

phrase.en: one is many, and many are one

sentences.zh: 禪宗教導我們，一即多，多即一，所有事物都是相互關聯的。
sentences.en: Zen teaching tells us that one is many, and many are one, indicating that all things are interconnected.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，一即多，多即一的概念有助於理解空性的深奧意義。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, the concept of one is many, and many are one helps to grasp the profound meaning of emptiness.

sentences.zh: 這個道理讓我們明白，每一個個體其實都包含了整個宇宙，一即多，多即一。
sentences.en: This principle helps us realize that each individual actually contains the entire universe, one is many, and many are one.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該體驗一即多，多即一，理解自我和他人之間沒有真正的界限。
sentences.en: Practitioners should experience that one is many, and many are one, understanding that there is no real boundary between self and others.

sentences.zh: 他用一句簡單的話表達了他的感受。
sentences.en: He expressed his feelings with a simple sentence.

sentences.zh: 佛經中的一句話可以給人無窮的啟發。
sentences.en: A single sentence from the sutras can provide endless inspiration.

sentences.zh: 老師提醒學生們，寫好一篇文章從一句好的開頭開始。
sentences.en: The teacher reminded the students that a good essay starts with a well-crafted sentence.

sentences.zh: 他花了很長時間才明白那一句真理的深意。
sentences.en: It took him a long time to understand the profound meaning of that one sentence of truth.

sentences.zh: 佛教中認為一合相是由多種因緣聚合而成，並非獨立存在。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, it is believed that a composite is formed by the coming together of various causes and conditions, and does not exist independently.

sentences.zh: 這個世界上的事物都是一合相，沒有一樣東西能夠單獨存在。
sentences.en: All things in this world are composites; nothing can exist by itself.

sentences.zh: 一合相的概念提醒我們認識到每一件事情的複雜性和多面性。
sentences.en: The concept of a composite reminds us to recognize the complexity and multifaceted nature of every situation.

sentences.zh: 當你明白了什麼是一合相，你會發現每件事物都是有機地互相依存的。
sentences.en: Once you understand what a composite is, you will see that everything organically depends on one another.

sentences.zh: 他一向遵循老師的教導，從不敢偏離一分一毫。
sentences.en: He has always followed the teacher's guidance, not daring to deviate even slightly.

sentences.zh: 這條溪流一向向東流，從未改變過方向。
sentences.en: This stream has always flowed in one direction to the east and has never changed its course.

sentences.zh: 她一向專注於修行，從未被外界的紛擾干擾過。
sentences.en: She has always focused on her practice in one direction, never being disturbed by the chaos outside.

sentences.zh: 這艘船一向沿著這條航道行駛，即使遇到風暴也不曾改道。
sentences.en: The ship has always sailed in one direction along this route, never changing course even in storms.

sentences.zh: 修行者努力達到心境的一味，所有的煩惱和分別心都消融於一味之中。
sentences.en: Practitioners strive to attain a state of one taste in their minds, where all troubles and dualistic thoughts dissolve into one taste.

sentences.zh: 在禪定中，當內心達到一味時，能夠感受到極度的平靜和滿足。
sentences.en: In meditation, when the mind reaches one taste, an extreme sense of peace and contentment can be felt.

sentences.zh: 佛教真理的終極體驗是證悟一味，體會到萬事萬物的本質無分別。
sentences.en: The ultimate experience of Buddhist truth is realizing one taste, where the essence of all things is understood as non-distinct.

sentences.zh: 一味的狀態代表著心靈和智慧的統一，超越所有的相對和分別。
sentences.en: The state of one taste represents the unification of mind and wisdom, transcending all relativities and distinctions.

sentences.zh: 修行一味禪的僧人們在悟道中體驗到內心深處的和平與喜悅。
sentences.en: Monks practicing the Chan of one taste experience inner peace and joy in their enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 一味禪教導我們無論外在環境如何變化，都應保持心性的平等。
sentences.en: The Chan of one taste teaches us to maintain the equality of mind regardless of external changes.

sentences.zh: 一味禪的修行能幫助我們不被世俗的困擾所左右，找到真正的自由。
sentences.en: Practicing the Chan of one taste can help us not be swayed by worldly troubles and find true freedom.

sentences.zh: 在一味禪的境界中，所有的分別念和執著都會消失殆盡。
sentences.en: In the state of the Chan of one taste, all discriminative thoughts and attachments are completely eradicated.

phrase.en: an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth

sentences.zh: 在古代，一報還一報的報復方式在法律中被接受。
sentences.en: In ancient times, the principle of 'an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth' was accepted in legal practices.

sentences.zh: 這部電影探討了復仇和一報還一報的主題。
sentences.en: This movie explores the themes of revenge and 'an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth.'

sentences.zh: 佛教提倡慈悲為懷，而不是一報還一報。
sentences.en: Buddhism advocates for compassion, rather than an 'eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth' approach.

sentences.zh: 現代社會中，我們應該超越一報還一報的思維，尋求和解與理解。
sentences.en: In modern society, we should transcend the 'an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth' mentality and seek reconciliation and understanding.

phrase.zh: 一塵不染清淨地 萬善同登般若門
phrase.en: Without even a speck of dust is this land of purity; Through which all virtues unite is this gate of prajna.

sentences.zh: 這座寺廟象徵著一塵不染清淨地，讓人們得以冥想和修行心靈的清淨。
sentences.en: This temple symbolizes a land of purity without even a speck of dust, allowing people to meditate and cultivate a pure mind.

sentences.zh: 大師指出，修習禪定的境界如一塵不染清淨地，無論外在環境如何變化，都保持內心的平靜與清淨。
sentences.en: The master pointed out that the state of practicing meditation is like a land of purity without even a speck of dust, maintaining inner peace and purity regardless of external changes.

sentences.zh: 般若智慧是通往萬善同登般若門的關鍵，所有美德在此融合，達到究竟的智慧。
sentences.en: Prajna wisdom is the key to the gate through which all virtues unite, achieving ultimate wisdom.

sentences.zh: 在一塵不染清淨地裡，萬善同登般若門，人們得以見證極樂和智慧的結合。
sentences.en: In a land of purity without even a speck of dust, through which all virtues unite in the gate of prajna, people witness the union of bliss and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 佛教中，一大劫是宇宙從形成到毀滅再到重生的整個周期。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, one great kalpa is the entire cycle of the universe forming, perishing, and being reborn.

sentences.zh: 據說一位菩薩需要經歷數不清的一大劫才能成佛。
sentences.en: It is said that a bodhisattva must go through countless great kalpas to attain Buddhahood.

sentences.zh: 在這無數次的一大劫中，我們的意識不斷在輪迴中轉生。
sentences.en: Through these countless great kalpas, our consciousness continuously reincarnates in the cycle of samsara.

sentences.zh: 佛陀教導弟子們如何在一大劫的漫長時間內修行達到涅槃。
sentences.en: The Buddha taught his disciples how to practice diligently to attain Nirvana through the long duration of one great kalpa.

phrase.en: when one child renounces, nine clans of kinsmen will ascend to heaven

sentences.zh: 佛教的教義中，一子出家，九族升天，這表達了出家人的功德能夠庇佑整個家族。
sentences.en: In Buddhist teachings, it is said that when one child renounces, nine clans of kinsmen will ascend to heaven, expressing that the virtue of a renunciant can protect the entire family.

sentences.zh: 全村人都在慶祝那位年輕人出家的儀式，記住一子出家，九族升天的話語。
sentences.en: The entire village celebrated the young man's ordination ceremony, remembering the saying that when one child renounces, nine clans of kinsmen will ascend to heaven.

sentences.zh: 在他的決定下，家人們感到欣慰，深信一子出家，九族升天的美好預示。
sentences.en: His family felt comforted by his decision, deeply believing in the auspicious saying that when one child renounces, nine clans of kinsmen will ascend to heaven.

sentences.zh: 僧人經常在講道中提到一子出家，九族升天，鼓勵更多人追求出家的生活。
sentences.en: Monks often mention the saying when one child renounces, nine clans of kinsmen will ascend to heaven during their sermons, encouraging more people to pursue a monastic life.

sentences.zh: 我們雖然沒有血緣關係，但因為共同的信仰，我們就像一家人一樣。
sentences.en: Although we are not blood-related, we are like the same family because of our shared beliefs.

sentences.zh: 這些僧人生活在同一寺廟裡，就像一家人一樣互相關心。
sentences.en: These monks live in the same temple, caring for one another like the same family.

sentences.zh: 在佛教徒眼中，所有眾生都是一家，因此應該彼此慈悲對待。
sentences.en: In the eyes of Buddhists, all sentient beings are the same family, hence they should treat each other with compassion.

sentences.zh: 在這個社區裡，大家彼此相互支持，就像一家人一樣。
sentences.en: In this community, everyone supports each other like the same family.

sentences.zh: 在佛經中記載，一宿覺是指某個人在一夜之間達到究極的覺悟。
sentences.en: In Buddhist scriptures, enlightenment in one night refers to someone attaining ultimate awakening overnight.

sentences.zh: 大師曾說，尋求一宿覺並不容易，需要多年的修行和內觀。
sentences.en: The master once said that seeking enlightenment in one night is not easy; it requires years of practice and introspection.

sentences.zh: 雖然一宿覺是眾人夢寐以求的境界，但很多人終其一生也無法達到。
sentences.en: Although enlightenment in one night is a state many aspire to, many people cannot achieve it in their lifetime.

sentences.zh: 他經過無數跋涉和苦修，終於在靜坐中達到了一宿覺的境界。
sentences.en: After countless journeys and severe practice, he finally reached the state of enlightenment in one night during meditation.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該堅持一師一道，避免迷失在五花八門的教法之中。
sentences.en: Practitioners should stick to one teacher and one path, avoiding getting lost in the myriad teachings.

sentences.zh: 在這一寺廟中，學徒們尊崇一師一道的原則，以保持修行的一致性。
sentences.en: In this temple, disciples respect the principle of one teacher and one path to maintain consistency in their practice.

sentences.zh: 若你能一師一道地修行，更容易達到心靈的平靜與覺悟。
sentences.en: If you practice with one teacher and one path, it is easier to achieve peace of mind and enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 古代的大德往往強調一師一道，認為這是獲得真實智慧的關鍵。
sentences.en: Ancient sages often emphasized one teacher and one path, believing it to be the key to attaining true wisdom.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，一彈指的時間極其短暫，但往往可以產生重大的變化。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, a snap of the finger is exceedingly brief, but it can often result in significant changes.

sentences.zh: 大師說，觀照自己的念頭，如同一彈指那樣迅捷。
sentences.en: The master said to observe one’s thoughts just as swiftly as a snap of the finger.

sentences.zh: 他在一彈指之間，領悟了真理，心靈頓時明朗。
sentences.en: In a snap of the finger, he realized the truth, and his mind became instantly clear.

sentences.zh: 時間流逝如同一彈指，我們應該珍惜每一個當下。
sentences.en: Time passes as quickly as a snap of the finger; we should cherish every moment.

sentences.zh: 佛經中說，一彈指頃的時間可能比我們想象的還要短。
sentences.en: The sutras say that a snap of the finger might be shorter than we can imagine.

sentences.zh: 在一彈指頃之間，宇宙的萬象都可以發生變化。
sentences.en: In a snap of the finger, the myriad phenomena of the universe can change.

sentences.zh: 他專注於自己的修行，仿佛能在一彈指頃內體悟真理。
sentences.en: He focuses on his practice as if he could grasp the truth in a snap of the finger.

sentences.zh: 生命的短暫就像一彈指頃，我們應當珍惜每一刻。
sentences.en: Life's brevity is like a snap of the finger; we should cherish every moment.

sentences.zh: 在佛教的宇宙觀中，整個無量世界可以濃縮在一微塵之中。
sentences.en: In the Buddhist cosmology, the infinite universe can be condensed into a particle of dust.

sentences.zh: 佛經中提到，修行者的心境應該如同一微塵般清淨無暇。
sentences.en: The Buddhist scriptures mention that the practitioner's mind should be as pure and unblemished as a particle of dust.

sentences.zh: 無論再微小的一微塵，也與宇宙萬物息息相關，互相影響。
sentences.en: Even the tiniest particle of dust is interconnected with everything in the universe, influencing each other.

sentences.zh: 一微塵之中蘊含著無限的智慧，只待有心人發現。
sentences.en: A particle of dust contains infinite wisdom, waiting to be discovered by those who seek it.

sentences.zh: 他一心只想完成這項冗長的工作。
sentences.en: He single-mindedly wanted to complete this tedious task.

sentences.zh: 學生們一心準備即將到來的考試。
sentences.en: The students are single-mindedly preparing for the upcoming exam.

sentences.zh: 她一心追求成為一名優秀的醫生。
sentences.en: She single-mindedly pursues her goal of becoming an excellent doctor.

sentences.zh: 工人們一心投入到新項目的建設中。
sentences.en: The workers are single-mindedly engaged in the construction of the new project.

phrase.zh: 一心一德 十全十美

sentences.zh: 他一心一德地追求真理，希望將佛法智慧傳遞給更多的人。
sentences.en: He single-heartedly pursued the truth, hoping to spread the wisdom of the Dharma to more people.

sentences.zh: 她的作品被認為是十全十美的範例，每一個細節都經過精心打磨。
sentences.en: Her work is considered perfect in every way, with every detail meticulously crafted.

sentences.zh: 這位僧人一心一德修行，終於達到了真正的內在平和。
sentences.en: The monk practiced single-heartedly and finally achieved true inner peace.

sentences.zh: 這座寺廟的建築設計十全十美，無論是外觀還是內部的裝飾都令人驚嘆。
sentences.en: The architecture of the temple is perfect in every way, stunning both in its exterior and interior decorations.

sentences.zh: 他一心一意地追求佛法，每天早上都進行冥想和經文誦讀。
sentences.en: He follows the path of Buddhism with single-mindedness, practicing meditation and reciting scriptures every morning.

sentences.zh: 她一心一意地工作，希望能夠為公司創造更大的價值。
sentences.en: She works with single-mindedness, hoping to create greater value for the company.

sentences.zh: 在大修行中，他一直保持一心一意的修持，沒有被外界的誘惑所動搖。
sentences.en: During his intense spiritual practice, he maintained his single-mindedness and was not swayed by external temptations.

sentences.zh: 對於他的夢想，他一心一意地投入，從未動搖過。
sentences.en: He is single-mindedly committed to his dream, never wavering in his dedication.

sentences.zh: 他在打坐時，能夠達到一心不亂的境界，內心十分平靜。
sentences.en: He is able to reach a state of undisturbed single-mindedness during meditation, with a profoundly calm mind.

sentences.zh: 修行者需要經過長期的修煉，才能達到一心不亂的狀態。
sentences.en: Practitioners need to undergo prolonged training to achieve a state of undisturbed single-mindedness.

sentences.zh: 在面對複雜的問題時，他仍然可以保持一心不亂，集中精力尋找解決方法。
sentences.en: When facing complex problems, he can still maintain a state of undisturbed single-mindedness, focusing his energy on finding solutions.

sentences.zh: 她一心不亂地工作，不受外界的干擾，效率極高。
sentences.en: She works in a state of undisturbed single-mindedness, unaffected by external disturbances, achieving high efficiency.

sentences.zh: 她一心不二地投身於這個慈善項目，投入了無數的時間和不懈的努力。
sentences.en: She single-heartedly dedicated herself to the charity project, putting in countless hours of hard work and unwavering commitment.

sentences.zh: 他一心不二地追求自己的目標，最終獲得了巨大的成功。
sentences.en: He single-heartedly pursued his goals and eventually achieved great success.

sentences.zh: 在修行道路上，一心不二是非常重要的態度，能幫助修行者克服各種困難。
sentences.en: On the path of spiritual practice, being single-heartedly committed is a crucial attitude that can help practitioners overcome various difficulties.

sentences.zh: 老師一心不二地教導學生，希望他們能夠掌握知識並成長。
sentences.en: The teacher single-heartedly taught her students, hoping that they would gain knowledge and grow.

phrase.zh: 一心二門: 1. 心真如門; 2. 心生滅門
phrase.en: One Mind Opens Two Doors: 1. The door of suchness; 2. The door of arising and ceasing

sentences.zh: 佛教認為宇宙和生命的一切玄妙皆在於一心二門，其中心真如門代表真實的本體。
sentences.en: Buddhism believes that the mysteries of the universe and life are encapsulated in the concept of 'One Mind Opens Two Doors', where the door of suchness represents the ultimate reality.

sentences.zh: 禪宗修行者通過冥想和心靈觀察進入心真如門，以體驗一切萬物的實相。
sentences.en: Zen practitioners enter the door of suchness through meditation and mindfulness to experience the true nature of all things.

sentences.zh: 心生滅門描述了我們的心識如何在無常中生起和滅亡，是理解煩惱根源的關鍵。
sentences.en: The door of arising and ceasing describes how our consciousness arises and ceases in impermanence, which is key to understanding the roots of afflictions.

sentences.zh: 修行者學會如何在心生滅門中找到平靜，理解一切現象的短暫和變化。
sentences.en: Practitioners learn to find peace in the door of arising and ceasing, understanding the impermanence and transience of all phenomena.

phrase.zh: 一心似月無圓缺 萬事如雲任去來
phrase.en: A mind like the perfect full moon; Coursing through the world's troubles like free clouds.

sentences.zh: 擁有一心似月無圓缺的心境，方能在面對生活的波折時保持平靜。
sentences.en: Only with a mind like the perfect full moon can one maintain calmness in the face of life's challenges.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該追求一心似月無圓缺，無論外界如何動盪，都不會動搖心中的寧靜。
sentences.en: Practitioners should strive for a mind like the perfect full moon, undisturbed by external turmoil.

sentences.zh: 悟道之人，心境如月無圓缺，萬事如雲任去來，不為世俗所動。
sentences.en: An enlightened person, with a mind like the perfect full moon, navigates through life's troubles like free clouds, untouched by worldly matters.

sentences.zh: 他對待困難時總是一心似月無圓缺，萬事如雲任去來，這種心態讓他變得非常從容。
sentences.en: He faces difficulties with a mind like the perfect full moon, flowing through challenges like free clouds, making him incredibly composed.

phrase.zh: 一心如月明千載 萬法似水淨十方
phrase.en: A heart like the timeless bright moon; Boundless dharmas like all-permeating purifying water.

sentences.zh: 修行人一心如月明千載，萬法似水淨十方，必能達到心靈的究竟安寧。
sentences.en: A practitioner with a heart like the timeless bright moon and boundless dharmas like all-permeating purifying water will achieve ultimate peace of mind.

sentences.zh: 若能一心如月明千載，萬法似水淨十方，智慧便能無量無邊地增長。
sentences.en: When one's heart is like the timeless bright moon and the dharmas are like all-permeating purifying water, wisdom will infinitely grow.

sentences.zh: 大師的教誨讓弟子們懂得一心如月明千載，萬法似水淨十方的重要性。
sentences.en: The master's teachings helped disciples understand the importance of having a heart like the timeless bright moon and boundless dharmas like all-permeating purifying water.

sentences.zh: 理解了佛法的真諦，弟子們努力做到一心如月明千載，萬法似水淨十方。
sentences.en: Understanding the true essence of the Dharma, the disciples strive to have a heart like the timeless bright moon and boundless dharmas like all-permeating purifying water.

phrase.zh: 一忍可當百勇 一靜可別百動 一勤可成百事 一善可消百惡
phrase.en: A moment of tolerance outplays a hundred warriors. A moment of calm outweighs a hundred movements. A moment of diligence solves a hundred problems. A moment of kindness eliminates a hundred unkind deeds.

sentences.zh: 在生活中，一忍可當百勇，寬容往往比爭執更能解決問題。
sentences.en: In life, a moment of tolerance outplays a hundred warriors; often, tolerance resolves conflicts better than arguments.

sentences.zh: 面對亂世，一靜可別百動，保持冷靜才能明辨是非。
sentences.en: In chaotic times, a moment of calm outweighs a hundred movements; staying calm helps discern right from wrong.

sentences.zh: 在學習上，一勤可成百事，只有勤奮才能取得成功。
sentences.en: In studies, a moment of diligence solves a hundred problems; only through diligence can one achieve success.

sentences.zh: 在人際交往中，一善可消百惡，一個善意的行動往往能化解很多矛盾。
sentences.en: In interpersonal relationships, a moment of kindness eliminates a hundred unkind deeds; a single act of kindness can often resolve many conflicts.

sentences.zh: 修行人應該時時注意自己的一念，不讓它偏離正道。
sentences.en: Practitioners should constantly be mindful of their one thought, ensuring it does not stray from the righteous path.

sentences.zh: 一念之轉，可能會改變一個人的整個人生軌跡。
sentences.en: A shift in one thought can change the entire trajectory of a person's life.

sentences.zh: 禪定中，修行者要把全部注意力集中於當下的一念。
sentences.en: In meditation, practitioners should focus all their attention on the present one thought.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們，每個人都是因為一念無明而輪迴生死。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us that everyone cycles through life and death due to one thought of ignorance.

phrase.en: Three Great Multiverses Are Contained Within a Moment of Thought

sentences.zh: 佛經中提到一念三千，這強調了心念的強大力量。
sentences.en: The Buddhist scriptures mention that 'three great multiverses are contained within a moment of thought,' highlighting the powerful potential of our mind.

sentences.zh: 在打坐時，我感受到了一念三千的重要性，覺察每個瞬間的心念。
sentences.en: During meditation, I felt the significance of the concept 'three great multiverses are contained within a moment of thought,' becoming aware of each passing thought.

sentences.zh: 老師向我們解釋了何謂一念三千，我們理解到每個念頭都具無限可能。
sentences.en: The teacher explained to us what 'three great multiverses are contained within a moment of thought' means, and we understood that each thought holds infinite possibilities.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該深刻體會一念三千，才能真正掌握自己的人生方向。
sentences.en: Practitioners should profoundly grasp the idea that 'three great multiverses are contained within a moment of thought' in order to truly control the direction of their lives.

phrase.en: All in a moment of thought

sentences.zh: 他的心情在一念之間就從沮喪轉變為希望。
sentences.en: His mood shifted from despair to hope all in a moment of thought.

sentences.zh: 決定未來走向的人生選擇，有時就發生在一念之間。
sentences.en: Life-altering decisions sometimes happen all in a moment of thought.

sentences.zh: 佛教相信，業力的變化可以在一念之間發生。
sentences.en: Buddhism believes that karmic changes can occur all in a moment of thought.

sentences.zh: 面對困境，他一念之間選擇了積極面對。
sentences.en: Facing adversity, he chose to confront it positively all in a moment of thought.

phrase.en: Each key opens up a lock

sentences.zh: 在佛教修行中，每個修行方法就像一把鑰匙，開一把鎖，幫助我們解開內心的結。
sentences.en: In Buddhist practice, each method of cultivation is like a key that opens up a lock, helping us to untangle the knots within our hearts.

sentences.zh: 每一種善行都是一把鑰匙，開一把鎖，使我們接近內心的平靜和智慧。
sentences.en: Each act of kindness is a key that opens up a lock, bringing us closer to inner peace and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 每個人都有自己的障礙和挑戰，而每一種修行方式就像一把鑰匙，開一把鎖，幫助他們克服困難。
sentences.en: Everyone has their own obstacles and challenges, and each method of practice is like a key that opens up a lock, aiding them in overcoming difficulties.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，每段經文或指導方針都是一把鑰匙，開一把鎖，啟發我們的智慧。
sentences.en: In meditation practice, each scripture or guideline is like a key that opens up a lock, enlightening our wisdom.

sentences.zh: 一指禪是少林寺的一種高深武學，訓練者需達到極高的悟道境界。
sentences.en: One-finger Chan is an advanced martial art from the Shaolin Temple, requiring practitioners to attain a high level of spiritual enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 老和尚展示了一指禪的威力，他輕輕一指便穿透了厚厚的磚牆。
sentences.en: The old monk demonstrated the power of one-finger Chan, effortlessly piercing through a thick brick wall with a single finger.

sentences.zh: 在禪修課程中，師父強調了一指禪中精神專注的重要性。
sentences.en: During the Zen meditation class, the master emphasized the importance of mental focus in one-finger Chan.

sentences.zh: 一指禪不僅僅是一種武術，更是一門修心養性的功法。
sentences.en: One-finger Chan is not merely a martial art, but also a practice for cultivating the mind and nurturing the spirit.

phrase.zh: 一方土地方方淨 念念心真念念真
phrase.en: A corner of land pure in all corners; A moment of thought truthful in every moment.

sentences.zh: 他們的禪修處所是一方土地方方淨，讓人感受到無比的寧靜和純淨。
sentences.en: Their meditation retreat is a corner of land pure in all corners, offering a sense of unparalleled tranquility and purity.

sentences.zh: 這裡的一方土地方方淨，使得每位來訪的人都能體驗到心靈上的清淨。
sentences.en: This place, a corner of land pure in all corners, allows every visitor to experience spiritual cleanliness.

sentences.zh: 在佛教的教義中，一方土地方方淨象徵著心靈的純潔和淨化。
sentences.en: In Buddhist teachings, a corner of land pure in all corners symbolizes the purity and purification of the mind.

sentences.zh: 她每天以念念心真念念真來修行，確保每一個念頭都是真實無偽的。
sentences.en: She practices daily with a moment of thought truthful in every moment, ensuring that each thought is genuine and unpretentious.

sentences.zh: 念念心真念念真能幫助修行者保持心境的真實和純淨。
sentences.en: A moment of thought truthful in every moment helps practitioners maintain authenticity and purity of mind.

sentences.zh: 在日常生活中，若能保持念念心真念念真，就能提升心靈的純淨度。
sentences.en: In daily life, maintaining a moment of thought truthful in every moment can enhance the purity of one's mind.

sentences.zh: 佛法中強調，念念心真念念真是達到涅槃的關鍵。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings emphasize that a moment of thought truthful in every moment is the key to achieving Nirvana.

phrase.en: A day without work means a day without food

sentences.zh: 禪師經常教導弟子們，一日不作，一日不食，以鼓勵他們勤勞工作。
sentences.en: The Zen master often taught his disciples that a day without work means a day without food, encouraging them to work diligently.

sentences.zh: 農夫深信一日不作，一日不食，因此他每天都勤奮耕作。
sentences.en: The farmer firmly believed that a day without work means a day without food, so he toiled in the fields every day.

sentences.zh: 在這個頗為艱難的時代，即使是年輕人也認同一日不作，一日不食的觀念。
sentences.en: Even the younger generation adhered to the idea that a day without work means a day without food in these challenging times.

sentences.zh: 老人的生活信條是，一日不作，一日不食，這句話激勵他直到晚年仍然保持勤奮。
sentences.en: The elder's life motto was that a day without work means a day without food, and it motivated him to stay industrious well into his old age.

phrase.zh: 一日之計在於晨 一生之計在於勤 一事之計在於明 一家之計在於和
phrase.en: Morning is the golden moment of the day. Diligence is the key to success in life. Clarity is the cause for a favorable outcome. Harmony is the foundation of a family.

sentences.zh: 一日之計在於晨，早起不僅使人有更多的時間安排一天的工作，也能提升生產力。
sentences.en: Morning is the golden moment of the day; rising early not only provides more time to organize one’s tasks but also boosts productivity.

sentences.zh: 他明白一生之計在於勤，因此無論遇到什麼困難，他都堅持不懈地工作。
sentences.en: He understands that diligence is the key to success in life, so no matter what hurdles he faces, he perseveres steadfastly.

sentences.zh: 在進行每一個重要決定時，都應該記住一事之計在於明，這樣才能達到理想的效果。
sentences.en: When making any important decision, one should remember that clarity is the cause for a favorable outcome to achieve the desired results.

sentences.zh: 一家之計在於和，家庭成員之間的和諧是幸福生活的基礎。
sentences.en: Harmony is the foundation of a family; the harmony among family members is the cornerstone of a happy life.

phrase.zh: 一日修來一日功 一日不修一日空 真正修行在日常 佛道本在生活中
phrase.en: Each day's worth of practice is each day's worth of merit, Each day's share of negligence is each day's share of vanity; True practice is found within everyday life, Because the Buddha is nowhere but in life itself.

sentences.zh: 一日修來一日功，每天堅持冥想，你將會看到內在的轉變。
sentences.en: Each day's worth of practice is each day's worth of merit; by meditating daily, you will notice an inner transformation.

sentences.zh: 一日不修一日空，如果今天沒有專注於修行，將會感到內心的空虛。
sentences.en: Each day's share of negligence is each day's share of vanity; if you neglect your practice today, you will feel the emptiness within.

sentences.zh: 真正修行在日常，我們應該在平凡的日子裡堅持修行，找到內在的安寧。
sentences.en: True practice is found within everyday life; we should persist in our practice on ordinary days, finding peace within.

sentences.zh: 佛道本在生活中，修行並不是脫離生活，而是在生活的每一刻中找到智慧和慈悲。
sentences.en: The Buddha is nowhere but in life itself; practicing is not about escaping life, but finding wisdom and compassion in every moment of it.

phrase.en: A Day's Buddhist Chanting - Millennium Dharma Music

sentences.zh: 每個月寺廟都會舉行一日梵唄，千禧法音的活動，吸引了眾多信徒參加。
sentences.en: Every month, the temple holds an event called 'A Day's Buddhist Chanting - Millennium Dharma Music,' attracting many devotees to participate.

sentences.zh: 一日梵唄，千禧法音的深遠意義在於讓人們沉澱心靈，體驗佛法的無窮智慧。
sentences.en: The profound significance of 'A Day's Buddhist Chanting - Millennium Dharma Music' lies in allowing people to calm their minds and experience the boundless wisdom of the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 在年度法會上，一日梵唄，千禧法音的節目成為了一個重要的亮點，受到了廣泛好評。
sentences.en: At the annual Dharma assembly, the 'A Day's Buddhist Chanting - Millennium Dharma Music' program became a significant highlight, receiving widespread praise.

sentences.zh: 參加一日梵唄，千禧法音的人們感受到了一種無法言說的寧靜和祥和。
sentences.en: Those who participated in 'A Day's Buddhist Chanting - Millennium Dharma Music' felt an indescribable sense of tranquility and peace.

sentences.zh: 歲月是流轉的，文化是千秋的。
sentences.en: Age is fleeting, but culture is timeless.

sentences.zh: 花開是時節的，青山是常在的。
sentences.en: Flowers are seasonal, but mountains are abiding.

sentences.zh: 勸導是有限的，守戒是不變的。
sentences.en: Counseling is limited, but discipline is sustainable.

sentences.zh: 感受是短暫的，相處是長遠的。
sentences.en: Feelings are momentary, but relationships are for life.

sentences.zh: 傷痛是當下的，歡喜是持久的。
sentences.en: Pain is transient, but joy is perpetual.

sentences.zh: 委屈是暫時的，真相是恆常的。
sentences.en: Misunderstanding is temporary, but Truth is eternal.

sentences.zh: 功名是一時的，生命是一世的。
sentences.en: Fame and gain are short-lived, but life is everlasting.

sentences.zh: 生死是瞬間的，願力是無窮的。
sentences.en: Birth and death are ephemeral, but vows are abiding.

sentences.zh: 妄念是剎那的，佛性是不滅的。
sentences.en: Delusion is swift, but Buddha-nature is imperishable.

sentences.zh: 因緣是變化的，悟道是永恆的。
sentences.en: Causes and conditions are changing, but enlightenment is forever.

phrase.zh: 一朝被蛇咬，十年怕井繩

sentences.zh: 經歷了那場失敗後，他對嘗試新事物變得一朝被蛇咬，十年怕井繩。
sentences.en: After that failure, he became once bitten, twice shy about trying new things.

sentences.zh: 由於早年的投資損失，他對任何金融決策都變得一朝被蛇咬，十年怕井繩。
sentences.en: Because of his early investment losses, he has become once bitten, twice shy about any financial decisions.

sentences.zh: 在那次旅途意外後，她對出遠門變得一朝被蛇咬，十年怕井繩。
sentences.en: After the travel mishap, she became once bitten, twice shy about taking long trips.

sentences.zh: 他的前任背叛了他，所以他現在在感情上變得一朝被蛇咬，十年怕井繩。
sentences.en: His ex betrayed him, so he is now once bitten, twice shy about relationships.

phrase.zh: 一朝風月 萬里晴空
phrase.en: A Moment's Moon and Wind Across an Everlasting Cloudless Sky

sentences.zh: 在這一朝風月萬里晴空的時刻，山間的景色顯得格外美麗。
sentences.en: In this moment's moon and wind across an everlasting cloudless sky, the mountain scenery appeared exceptionally beautiful.

sentences.zh: 他們在一朝風月萬里晴空下漫步，享受充滿和諧的自然環境。
sentences.en: They strolled under a moment's moon and wind across an everlasting cloudless sky, enjoying the harmonious natural environment.

sentences.zh: 這幅畫描繪了一朝風月萬里晴空，帶給人無限的寧靜與安祥。
sentences.en: This painting depicted a moment's moon and wind across an everlasting cloudless sky, bringing infinite peace and serenity.

sentences.zh: 一朝風月萬里晴空的景象讓人感受到天地間的純粹和寧靜。
sentences.en: The sight of a moment's moon and wind across an everlasting cloudless sky made one feel the purity and tranquility of the world.

sentences.zh: 人生如夢，不過是一期的短暫經歷。
sentences.en: Life is like a dream, merely one moment of time in its brief experience.

sentences.zh: 修行者常說，要珍惜每一期的機緣，不可錯過。
sentences.en: Practitioners often say that one should cherish every moment of time and not let any opportunity slip by.

sentences.zh: 在這一期的生命中，我希望能多行善事，造福他人。
sentences.en: In this one moment of time in life, I hope to do more good deeds and benefit others.

sentences.zh: 佛法教導我們，應對每一期的境遇保持平靜心態。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us to maintain a calm mindset in every moment of time.

phrase.en: The Same Water Is Perceived in Four Ways

sentences.zh: 佛教教義中提到一水四見，說明即使是同一杯水，不同的眾生會有不同的感受。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings mention that the same water is perceived in four ways, illustrating that even a single cup of water can be experienced differently by different beings.

sentences.zh: 所謂一水四見，眾生因為業力和見解的不同，對同一現象會產生不同的體驗。
sentences.en: The concept of 'The Same Water Is Perceived in Four Ways' suggests that beings, due to karmic differences and perspectives, will have varied experiences of the same phenomenon.

sentences.zh: 經典上說，一水四見，魚見水為家，人見水為飲，鬼見水為火，天見水為琉璃。
sentences.en: According to the scriptures, the same water is perceived in four ways: fish see water as their home, humans see it as drink, ghosts see it as fire, and celestial beings see it as crystal.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，我們學會了解一水四見的道理，理解每個人對事物的看法可能都不同。
sentences.en: In meditation practice, we learn to understand the principle that the same water is perceived in four ways, realizing that everyone may have a different view of the same thing.

sentences.zh: 這家餐廳的服務和食物都是一流的，讓人回味無窮。
sentences.en: The service and food at this restaurant are of the same flow, leaving everyone reminiscing.

sentences.zh: 他在國際象棋比賽中的表現堪稱一流，所有人都對他的戰略讚嘆不已。
sentences.en: His performance in the chess tournament was of the same flow, and everyone admired his strategy.

sentences.zh: 她的繪畫技巧真是一流，每一幅作品都充滿了生命力。
sentences.en: Her painting skills are of the same flow, with each piece brimming with vitality.

sentences.zh: 這家公司的產品一直以來都是市面上的一流選擇，深受消費者喜愛。
sentences.en: This company's products have always been of the same flow in the market, beloved by consumers.

sentences.zh: 一滴水可以折射出整個宇宙的光芒。
sentences.en: A water drop can reflect the light of the entire universe.

sentences.zh: 在禪修過程中，我們專注於一滴水，以此來冥想。
sentences.en: During meditation, we focus on a water drop to aid our contemplation.

sentences.zh: 瀑布的威力是由無數一滴水匯集而成的。
sentences.en: The power of the waterfall is formed by the gathering of countless water drops.

sentences.zh: 一滴水雖渺小，但若匯入海洋，便能與大海融為一體。
sentences.en: A water drop may be small, but when it merges into the ocean, it becomes one with the vast sea.

phrase.zh: 一燈照破心中暗 雙手能做慈悲人
phrase.en: One single light can dispel the mind's darkness; Your hands suffice to show the compassion in you.

sentences.zh: 在困境中，一燈照破心中暗，激勵著我們前行。
sentences.en: In times of hardship, one single light can dispel the mind's darkness, inspiring us to move forward.

sentences.zh: 她的一句話如同一燈照破心中暗，讓我重新找回了生活的方向。
sentences.en: Her words were like a single light that dispelled the darkness in my mind, helping me to find my way again.

sentences.zh: 雙手能做慈悲人，她每天都去志願服務，幫助那些需要幫助的人。
sentences.en: Your hands suffice to show the compassion in you; she volunteers every day, helping those in need.

sentences.zh: 他相信雙手能做慈悲人，因此經常參與社會公益活動。
sentences.en: He believes that your hands suffice to show the compassion in you, hence he often participates in social welfare activities.

phrase.en: The Dharma Realm of One Truth

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，一真法界是一個無二無別的究竟實相。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, the Dharma Realm of One Truth is the ultimate reality with no duality or distinction.

sentences.zh: 禪修可以幫助我們體驗一真法界的寂靜和清明。
sentences.en: Meditation can help us experience the serenity and clarity of the Dharma Realm of One Truth.

sentences.zh: 大師經常教導我們要尋找一真法界的智慧，解脫生死輪迴之苦。
sentences.en: The master often teaches us to seek the wisdom of the Dharma Realm of One Truth to liberate from the suffering of the cycle of birth and death.

sentences.zh: 通過修行，我們可以漸漸理解並融入一真法界的真諦。
sentences.en: Through practice, we can gradually understand and merge with the true essence of the Dharma Realm of One Truth.

phrase.zh: 一碗慈心粥，勝飲人參湯; 一杯清和茶,勝喝瓊玉漿; 一口菜根香,勝嚼酒肉飯; 一念思無邪,勝辦滿漢席
phrase.en: A bowl of compassion porridge is better than drinking precious ginseng soup, A cup of calming tea is better than drinking a fabulous elixir, A mouthful of humble fare is better than dining on meat and wine. One thought free of unwholesomeness is better than arranging a sumptuous feast.

sentences.zh: 一碗慈心粥，勝飲人參湯，這樣的理念提醒我們飲食不只是為了饗樂，更是修行的一部分。
sentences.en: A bowl of compassion porridge is better than drinking precious ginseng soup, reminding us that eating is not just for pleasure but also a part of our spiritual practice.

sentences.zh: 一杯清和茶, 勝喝瓊玉漿，這句話讓我們體會到簡單的生活亦能帶來無比的安寧。
sentences.en: A cup of calming tea is better than drinking a fabulous elixir, making us realize that a simple life can bring immense peace.

sentences.zh: 一口菜根香, 勝嚼酒肉飯，這表達了對樸素生活的推崇，示範了如何潔淨自己的味覺和心靈。
sentences.en: A mouthful of humble fare is better than dining on meat and wine, extolling the virtues of a simple, clean diet for both taste and soul.

sentences.zh: 一念思無邪, 勝辦滿漢席，提醒我們內心的清淨比任何外在的豪華盛宴更為重要。
sentences.en: One thought free of unwholesomeness is better than arranging a sumptuous feast, reminding us that inner purity is far more important than external opulence.

sentences.zh: 他只需一筆勾，便將錯誤的字刪掉了。
sentences.en: He just needed to cross out the incorrect word with one stroke.

sentences.zh: 老師在學生作業上用紅筆一筆勾掉錯誤答案。
sentences.en: The teacher crossed out the wrong answers on the student's homework with one stroke of the red pen.

sentences.zh: 會議上，他一筆勾掉了無用的建議，節省了時間。
sentences.en: During the meeting, he crossed out the unnecessary suggestions with one stroke, saving time.

sentences.zh: 當她決定重新開始時，她便一筆勾掉了過去的諸多挫折。
sentences.en: When she decided to start anew, she crossed out her many past setbacks with one stroke.

phrase.zh: 一粒米中藏世界 半邊鍋裏煮乾坤
phrase.en: An entire world is hidden inside a grain of rice; Endless wonders are stirred inside a wok.

sentences.zh: 他說一粒米中藏世界，讓我們從小事中看到生活的智慧。
sentences.en: He said an entire world is hidden inside a grain of rice, encouraging us to find life's wisdom in small things.

sentences.zh: 面對壓力，我們應該記住，一粒米中藏世界，一點小事也有其深意。
sentences.en: When facing stress, we should remember that an entire world is hidden inside a grain of rice, even the smallest things have their significance.

sentences.zh: 半邊鍋裏煮乾坤，這句話讓我想到料理中蘊藏的無限創意。
sentences.en: Endless wonders are stirred inside a wok, this phrase reminds me of the infinite creativity contained within cooking.

sentences.zh: 每次煮飯，我都會想起這句話：半邊鍋裏煮乾坤，因為它提醒我要珍惜日常的簡單幸福。
sentences.en: Every time I cook, I think of the phrase: endless wonders are stirred inside a wok, as it reminds me to cherish the simple happiness of daily life.

phrase.en: not attached to a single thread

sentences.zh: 在這一刻，他感到內心的平靜，一絲不掛，毫無牽掛。
sentences.en: In that moment, he felt a deep sense of inner peace, not attached to a single thread, free of any worries.

sentences.zh: 修行的最高境界是達到心靈一絲不掛的狀態，不被世俗的煩惱所束縛。
sentences.en: The highest state of spiritual practice is to achieve a mind not attached to a single thread, unbound by worldly troubles.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，他學會了讓心靈一絲不掛，專注於當下的每一個呼吸。
sentences.en: In meditation, he learned to let his mind be not attached to a single thread, focusing solely on each breath in the present moment.

sentences.zh: 真正的自在是在任何場合都能保持一絲不掛的心境，不為外物所動。
sentences.en: True freedom is maintaining a mind not attached to a single thread in any situation, unmoved by external circumstances.

phrase.zh: 一缽千家飯 孤僧萬里遊
phrase.en: From a thousand households I eat with an alms bowl; Ten thousand miles I travel as a lone monk.

sentences.zh: 一缽千家飯，孤僧萬里遊，這句話完美闡明了僧侶四海為家的精神。
sentences.en: From a thousand households I eat with an alms bowl; Ten thousand miles I travel as a lone monk, this phrase perfectly illustrates the monk's spirit of taking the world as their home.

sentences.zh: 他一直秉持著一缽千家飯，孤僧萬里遊的修行理念，雖然行腳遙遠，但心中自在。
sentences.en: He always upheld the practice of 'From a thousand households I eat with an alms bowl; Ten thousand miles I travel as a lone monk.' Although he traveled far, he felt at ease in his heart.

sentences.zh: 這位僧人遵循一缽千家飯，孤僧萬里遊的教義，無論走到哪裡都能得心應手。
sentences.en: This monk follows the teaching 'From a thousand households I eat with an alms bowl; Ten thousand miles I travel as a lone monk,' and he can handle any situation no matter where he goes.

sentences.zh: 一缽千家飯，孤僧萬里遊，這種生活方式展現了僧侶的獨立與堅毅。
sentences.en: From a thousand households I eat with an alms bowl; Ten thousand miles I travel as a lone monk, this way of life shows the monk's independence and resilience.

phrase.zh: 一花一世界 一葉一如來
phrase.en: One can find a world in a flower; One can see a buddha in a leaf.

sentences.zh: 通過禪修，他意識到一花一世界，一葉一如來的深刻意義。
sentences.en: Through meditation, he realized the profound meaning of 'One can find a world in a flower; One can see a buddha in a leaf.'

sentences.zh: 在這塊靜謐的花園中，她深深體會到一花一世界 一葉一如來的真諦。
sentences.en: In this serene garden, she deeply understood the truth of 'One can find a world in a flower; One can see a buddha in a leaf.'

sentences.zh: 老師常常用一花一世界 一葉一如來來啟發學生們觀察世界的方式。
sentences.en: The teacher often used 'One can find a world in a flower; One can see a buddha in a leaf' to inspire students to observe the world differently.

sentences.zh: 這句一花一世界 一葉一如來的智慧讓他在繁忙的生活中找到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: The wisdom of 'One can find a world in a flower; One can see a buddha in a leaf' helped him find inner peace amid his busy life.

phrase.zh: 一花一世界，一葉一如來
phrase.en: there is a world in a single flower; a buddha in a single leaf

sentences.zh: 在禪宗的教導中，一花一世界，一葉一如來，象徵著事事物物皆具無窮的奧妙。
sentences.en: In Zen teachings, there is a world in a single flower; a buddha in a single leaf, symbolizing that every object contains infinite mysteries.

sentences.zh: 當你靜心觀察，你會發現一花一世界，一葉一如來的真諦。
sentences.en: When you observe calmly, you will find the true meaning that there is a world in a single flower; a buddha in a single leaf.

sentences.zh: 這句話提醒我們，在日常生活的細節中也能體會到宇宙的真理，一花一世界，一葉一如來。
sentences.en: This phrase reminds us that we can understand the universe's truths even in the details of everyday life; there is a world in a single flower; a buddha in a single leaf.

sentences.zh: 佛陀的智慧告訴我們，一花一世界，一葉一如來，每一個存在都是獨特而有意義的。
sentences.en: The Buddha’s wisdom teaches us that there is a world in a single flower; a buddha in a single leaf, showing that every existence is unique and meaningful.

phrase.zh: 一花一木都有生命 一山一水都有生機 一人一事都有道理 一舉一動都有因果
phrase.en: Every flower and tree has its own life, Every mountain and river has its own vitality, Every person and matter has its own reasons, Every move and action has its own cause and effect.

sentences.zh: 我們應該尊重自然，因為一花一木都有生命。
sentences.en: We should respect nature because every flower and tree has its own life.

sentences.zh: 旅途中，我感受到了一山一水都有生機。
sentences.en: During the journey, I felt that every mountain and river has its own vitality.

sentences.zh: 與人相處時，我明白了一人一事都有道理。
sentences.en: When interacting with people, I came to understand that every person and matter has its own reasons.

sentences.zh: 我們應當謹慎行事，因為一舉一動都有因果。
sentences.en: We should act cautiously because every move and action has its own cause and effect.

phrase.zh: 一花一界 一人一佛
phrase.en: One Can See a World in a Flower; One Can See a Buddha in a Person

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，老師常提醒我們，一花一界，一人一佛，要通過觀照細微而見宏大。
sentences.en: During meditation, the teacher often reminds us that one can see a world in a flower, and one can see a Buddha in a person, to observe the minute and perceive the vast.

sentences.zh: 她深信一花一界，一人一佛的理念，能夠在平凡中感受到生命的深意。
sentences.en: She firmly believes in the concept that one can see a world in a flower and a Buddha in a person, finding profound meaning in the mundane.

sentences.zh: 這幅畫作表現了一花一界，一人一佛的思想，每一個小細節都充滿了生命的智慧。
sentences.en: This painting embodies the idea that one can see a world in a flower and a Buddha in a person, with every small detail filled with the wisdom of life.

sentences.zh: 他在旅行中體驗到，一花一界，一人一佛的真理，使他對萬物生發更深的敬意。
sentences.en: He experienced the truth that one can see a world in a flower and a Buddha in a person during his travels, deepening his respect for all beings.

phrase.zh: 一花一界 一葉一如
phrase.en: One Can See a World in a Flower; One Can See a Buddha in a Leaf

sentences.zh: 在禪修時，禪師告訴我們：一花一界，一葉一如，要用心去觀照身邊的每一寸自然。
sentences.en: During the meditation session, the Zen master told us: One can see a world in a flower; one can see a Buddha in a leaf. We need to mindfully observe every inch of nature around us.

sentences.zh: 這句話一花一界，一葉一如，讓我明白了每一個小細節都蘊含著宇宙的智慧。
sentences.en: The phrase 'one can see a world in a flower; one can see a Buddha in a leaf' made me realize that every small detail contains the wisdom of the universe.

sentences.zh: 在靜坐的時候，我經常想起一花一界，一葉一如的教誨，這使我更加平靜和專注。
sentences.en: While meditating, I often recall the teaching 'one can see a world in a flower; one can see a Buddha in a leaf,' which brings me greater peace and focus.

sentences.zh: 孩子們在公園裡嬉戲，老師用一花一界，一葉一如的理念告訴他們自然中的深奧智慧。
sentences.en: As the children played in the park, the teacher used the concept 'one can see a world in a flower; one can see a Buddha in a leaf' to teach them the profound wisdom found in nature.

sentences.zh: 佛經中的智慧可以在一言之中揭示出深奧的真理。
sentences.en: The wisdom in the Buddhist scriptures can reveal profound truths in one word.

sentences.zh: 老師的一言點醒了他的迷茫，使他重新找回了方向。
sentences.en: The teacher's one word awakened him from his confusion and helped him find his direction again.

sentences.zh: 在緊急情況下，他的一言避免了一場災難。
sentences.en: In an emergency situation, his one word averted a disaster.

sentences.zh: 一言既出，駟馬難追，這句古語提醒我們說話要謹慎。
sentences.en: The old saying 'a word once spoken cannot be retracted' reminds us to be cautious with our words.

phrase.en: a word spoken is an arrow let fly

sentences.zh: 古人常說：『一言既出，駟馬難追』，提醒我們說話要謹慎。
sentences.en: The ancients often said, 'a word spoken is an arrow let fly,' reminding us to speak carefully.

sentences.zh: 在這次會議上，經理引用了『一言既出，駟馬難追』，告訴我們承諾的重要性。
sentences.en: During the meeting, the manager quoted, 'a word spoken is an arrow let fly,' to emphasize the importance of keeping promises.

sentences.zh: 小明犯了一個錯誤，後來才明白『一言既出，駟馬難追』的道理。
sentences.en: Xiao Ming made a mistake and later realized the truth of the saying, 'a word spoken is an arrow let fly.'

sentences.zh: 老師告誡學生們要注意言行，因為『一言既出，駟馬難追』。
sentences.en: The teacher admonished the students to be mindful of their words and actions because 'a word spoken is an arrow let fly.'

sentences.zh: 他一路禪修，終於悟得了佛法的真諦。
sentences.en: He practiced Zen all along the way and finally comprehended the true essence of Buddhist teachings.

sentences.zh: 我們一路上談論佛教經典，加深了對經文的理解。
sentences.en: We discussed Buddhist scriptures all along the way, deepening our understanding of the texts.

sentences.zh: 一路的風景讓我感受到大自然的和諧與美麗。
sentences.en: The scenery all along the way made me feel the harmony and beauty of nature.

sentences.zh: 她一路支持他的修行，給予無限的鼓勵和愛。
sentences.en: She supported his spiritual practice all along the way, providing endless encouragement and love.

sentences.zh: 他一路福星，凡事順利，讓人不得不佩服他的運氣。
sentences.en: He is a star of fortune, and everything goes smoothly for him, making people marvel at his luck.

sentences.zh: 在公司的創業之路上，她似乎一路福星，遇到了許多貴人扶持。
sentences.en: On her entrepreneurial journey with the company, she seemed to be a star of fortune, encountering many benefactors along the way.

sentences.zh: 這位年輕的演員可說是一路福星，出道即紅，短短幾年就成為家喻戶曉的明星。
sentences.en: This young actor can be said to be a star of fortune, gaining fame right after debut and becoming a household name in just a few years.

sentences.zh: 他的人生充滿挑戰，但也一路福星，總是在關鍵時刻遇到貴人幫助。
sentences.en: His life is full of challenges, but he is also a star of fortune, always meeting helpful people at crucial moments.

sentences.zh: 學佛應該一門深入，避免貪多嚼不爛。
sentences.en: In studying Buddhism, one should delve deeply into one gate, avoiding the pitfall of trying to learn too much superficially.

sentences.zh: 選擇一門禪修方法並持之以恆，更容易達到心靈的平靜。
sentences.en: Choosing one gate of meditation practice and sticking to it makes achieving inner peace easier.

sentences.zh: 對於任何學問，深究一門往往比淺嘗百味來得更有成效。
sentences.en: In any field of study, mastering one gate is often more effective than sampling many.

sentences.zh: 專心於一門佛教經典，能夠更好地理解其深奧的智慧。
sentences.en: Focusing on one gate of Buddhist scripture allows for a better understanding of its profound wisdom.

sentences.zh: 眾弟子在佛祖面前齊誦經文，猶如一音。
sentences.en: All the disciples chanted the sutra in front of the Buddha, as if in one voice.

sentences.zh: 當他們分享心靈的智慧時，猶如在一音中和諧共鳴。
sentences.en: When they shared their spiritual wisdom, it resonated harmoniously as if in one voice.

sentences.zh: 這部佛經的宣講宛如一音，帶給人們深刻的心靈震撼。
sentences.en: The preaching of this Buddhist sutra was like one voice, bringing profound spiritual impact to the audience.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中心，參加者們同時冥想，形成了猶如一音的寧靜氛圍。
sentences.en: At the meditation center, participants meditated simultaneously, creating a tranquil atmosphere as if in one voice.

sentences.zh: 在古代，一食頃常用來衡量短暫的時間段。
sentences.en: In ancient times, the time of a meal was often used to measure a short period.

sentences.zh: 只需一食頃的時間，我們便可完成這簡單的修行。
sentences.en: In just the time of a meal, we can complete this simple practice.

sentences.zh: 師父教導我們要在一食頃內專注於冥想，不被外界干擾。
