sentences.en: This year, the Nanhua University Soccer Team recruited some new talents, expecting them to bring fresh energy.

sentences.zh: 博士人間佛教論壇今年邀請了眾多知名學者來分享他們的研究成果。
sentences.en: This year's Humanistic Buddhism Doctorate Forum invited numerous renowned scholars to share their research findings.

sentences.zh: 參加博士人間佛教論壇是一次難得的學習機會，可以深入了解現代佛教的發展。
sentences.en: Attending the Humanistic Buddhism Doctorate Forum is a rare learning opportunity to gain in-depth understanding of modern Buddhist developments.

sentences.zh: 在博士人間佛教論壇上，很多新興的研究議題被提出和討論。
sentences.en: At the Humanistic Buddhism Doctorate Forum, many emerging research topics were brought up and discussed.

sentences.zh: 博士人間佛教論壇旨在推廣人間佛教思想，促進學術交流和合作。
sentences.en: The Humanistic Buddhism Doctorate Forum aims to promote Humanistic Buddhism ideas and facilitate academic exchange and collaboration.

sentences.zh: 他在完成博士學位後，選擇留校進行博士後研究。
sentences.en: After completing his PhD, he chose to stay at the university for his post-doctorate research.

sentences.zh: 她的博士後生涯主要集中在癌症基因療法的研究上。
sentences.en: Her post-doctorate career primarily focused on research in cancer gene therapy.

sentences.zh: 博士後研究人員通常會在多個項目中同時工作，以拓展學術視野。
sentences.en: Post-doctorate researchers often work on multiple projects simultaneously to broaden their academic horizons.

sentences.zh: 他申請了多所名校的博士後機會，最終選擇了加州大學。
sentences.en: He applied for post-doctorate opportunities at several prestigious universities and ultimately chose the University of California.

sentences.zh: 印度五比丘塔位於印度北部，是佛教徒朝聖的重要地點。
sentences.en: Chaukhandi Mound, India, located in the northern part of the country, is an important pilgrimage site for Buddhists.

sentences.zh: 在印度五比丘塔，佛陀首次向他的五位弟子傳授了四聖諦。
sentences.en: At Chaukhandi Mound, India, the Buddha first taught the Four Noble Truths to his five disciples.

sentences.zh: 印度五比丘塔曾經是佛陀與五比丘共修的地方，現今成為聯合國教科文組織的世界遺產。
sentences.en: Chaukhandi Mound, India, was once the site where the Buddha practiced with the five monks, and it is now a UNESCO World Heritage site.

sentences.zh: 印度五比丘塔吸引了無數遊客和信徒，他們來此參拜並追尋佛陀的足跡。
sentences.en: Chaukhandi Mound, India, attracts countless tourists and devotees who come to pay homage and follow in the Buddha's footsteps.

phrase.en: Buddha Light Art and Living Private Limited, New Delhi

sentences.zh: 印度佛光文化公司致力於推廣佛教文化和藝術，在當地社區享有盛譽。
sentences.en: Buddha Light Art and Living Private Limited, New Delhi is dedicated to promoting Buddhist culture and art, and enjoys a high reputation in the local community.

sentences.zh: 印度佛光文化公司最近參加了一個國際佛教藝術展覽，展示了多種具有歷史價值的佛教文物。
sentences.en: Buddha Light Art and Living Private Limited, New Delhi recently participated in an international Buddhist art exhibition, showcasing various historically valuable Buddhist artifacts.

sentences.zh: 那間印度佛光文化公司出版的書籍涵蓋了廣泛的佛教主題，深受學者和信眾的喜愛。
sentences.en: The books published by Buddha Light Art and Living Private Limited, New Delhi cover a wide range of Buddhist topics and are well-received by scholars and devotees alike.

sentences.zh: 我朋友最近去過印度佛光文化公司參加了一個禪修工作坊，獲得了平靜和智慧。
sentences.en: My friend recently attended a meditation workshop at Buddha Light Art and Living Private Limited, New Delhi, and gained peace and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 每年都有無數信徒前往印度佛陀涅槃塔朝聖。
sentences.en: Every year, countless devotees make a pilgrimage to the Mahaparinirvana Stupa, India.

sentences.zh: 印度佛陀涅槃塔是釋迦牟尼佛涅槃後建造的重要紀念碑。
sentences.en: The Mahaparinirvana Stupa, India, is a significant monument built after the Buddha's parinirvana.

sentences.zh: 印度佛陀涅槃塔附近有許多重要的佛教遺跡，吸引了全球旅客。
sentences.en: Many important Buddhist relics are located near the Mahaparinirvana Stupa, India, attracting travelers worldwide.

sentences.zh: 導遊向我們詳細介紹了印度佛陀涅槃塔的歷史和其背後的深遠意義。
sentences.en: The tour guide gave us a detailed explanation of the history and profound significance of the Mahaparinirvana Stupa, India.

sentences.zh: 法師們即將啟程前往印度弘法之旅，為當地信眾傳遞佛法智慧。
sentences.en: The monks are about to embark on a Dharma Propagation Tour in India to impart Buddhist wisdom to the local devotees.

sentences.zh: 她參加了今年的印度弘法之旅，並感受到了佛法的深遠影響。
sentences.en: She participated in this year's Dharma Propagation Tour in India and felt the profound impact of Buddhist teachings.

sentences.zh: 印度弘法之旅不僅是學習的機會，還是與世界各地佛教徒交流的良好平台。
sentences.en: The Dharma Propagation Tour in India is not only a learning opportunity but also a great platform to exchange ideas with Buddhists from around the world.

sentences.zh: 印度弘法之旅的經歷讓許多人找到了內心的平靜與智慧的靈感。
sentences.en: The experience of the Dharma Propagation Tour in India has helped many find inner peace and inspiration for wisdom.

phrase.zh: 印度菩提伽耶國際三壇大戒

sentences.zh: 每年的印度菩提伽耶國際三壇大戒吸引了來自世界各地的僧侶參加。
sentences.en: The Bodhgaya International Full Ordination Ceremony held annually attracts monks from all around the world.

sentences.zh: 在印度菩提伽耶國際三壇大戒期間，參加者經歷了一系列嚴格且神聖的修行儀式。
sentences.en: During the Bodhgaya International Full Ordination Ceremony, participants undergo a series of rigorous and sacred practice rituals.

sentences.zh: 印度菩提伽耶國際三壇大戒是一個傳承千年的佛教儀式，具有深遠的歷史意義。
sentences.en: The Bodhgaya International Full Ordination Ceremony is an age-old Buddhist ritual with profound historical significance.

sentences.zh: 參加印度菩提伽耶國際三壇大戒的僧侶們表示，這是一生難得的修行機會。
sentences.en: Monks who participate in the Bodhgaya International Full Ordination Ceremony state that it is a rare and invaluable opportunity for spiritual cultivation.

sentences.zh: 印度菩提正覺大塔是釋迦牟尼佛悟道之地，每年吸引著眾多信徒前來朝拜。
sentences.en: The Bodhgaya temple in India is the place where Siddhartha Gautama attained enlightenment, attracting numerous devotees every year.

sentences.zh: 當地政府定期對印度菩提正覺大塔進行修繕，以確保這一聖地的完整與安全。
sentences.en: The local government regularly maintains and renovates the Bodhgaya temple in India to ensure the integrity and safety of this sacred site.

sentences.zh: 印度菩提正覺大塔周圍的樹木同樣具有重要的宗教意義，被尊稱為菩提樹。
sentences.en: The trees surrounding the Bodhgaya temple in India, known as the Bodhi trees, also hold significant religious importance.

sentences.zh: 印度菩提正覺大塔的建築風格融合了多種文化元素，成為全球佛教徒心目中的聖地。
sentences.en: The architectural style of the Bodhgaya temple in India incorporates various cultural elements, making it a revered site for Buddhists around the world.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，師父常說我們需要與自己的本心建立印心的聯繫。
sentences.en: In meditation, the master often said that we need to establish a heart-to-heart connection with our true self.

sentences.zh: 這種印心的交流讓師徒之間的關係更加深厚和真誠。
sentences.en: This heart-to-heart connection deepens and makes the relationship between teacher and disciple more sincere.

sentences.zh: 當朋友之間有了印心的溝通，他們之間的誤解也逐漸消除了。
sentences.en: When friends establish a heart-to-heart connection, misunderstandings between them gradually dissipate.

sentences.zh: 通過靜坐和反思，人們可以與宇宙建立深層次的印心聯繫。
sentences.en: Through meditation and reflection, individuals can establish a deep heart-to-heart connection with the universe.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，厚德是修行者應該培養的重要品質之一。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, great virtue is one of the essential qualities that practitioners should cultivate.

sentences.zh: 他的行為處處體現了厚德，讓人們對他充滿了敬仰之心。
sentences.en: His actions consistently reflected great virtue, garnering admiration from everyone around him.

sentences.zh: 厚德不僅讓一個人獲得內心的平靜，也能夠影響和感化他人。
sentences.en: Great virtue not only brings inner peace to an individual but also influences and inspires others.

sentences.zh: 當一個人具備厚德時，他的言行自然會散發出一種慈悲和智慧的光芒。
sentences.en: When a person possesses great virtue, his words and actions naturally radiate compassion and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 在他的言行中，總能感受到一種厚道的品質。
sentences.en: In his words and deeds, one can always sense a quality of honesty and kindness.

sentences.zh: 她因為厚道而得到朋友們的尊敬和信賴。
sentences.en: She gained the respect and trust of her friends because of her honesty and kindness.

sentences.zh: 厚道是佛教徒應該培養的重要品德之一。
sentences.en: Honesty and kindness is one of the important virtues that Buddhists should cultivate.

sentences.zh: 他以厚道的態度處理每一個問題，總是考慮別人的感受。
sentences.en: He approaches every issue with honesty and kindness, always considering others' feelings.

sentences.zh: 這部佛經的內容厚重，需要花大量時間仔細研讀。
sentences.en: The content of this Buddhist scripture is deep and heavy, requiring a lot of time to study carefully.

sentences.zh: 他的聲音厚重，充滿了智慧和慈悲。
sentences.en: His voice is deep and heavy, filled with wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 這棟寺廟的建築風格既厚重又莊嚴，給人一種寧靜的感覺。
sentences.en: The architectural style of this temple is both deep and heavy, providing a sense of serenity and solemnity.

sentences.zh: 典籍中記載的歷史事件厚重如山，讓人感到無限的敬畏。
sentences.en: The historical events recorded in the scriptures are deep and heavy like a mountain, inspiring infinite awe.

phrase.zh: 去除煩惱垢 增長菩提心
phrase.en: Cleanse the dirt of defilement; Nurture the Bodhi Mind.

sentences.zh: 每日打坐可以幫助我們去除煩惱垢，增長菩提心。
sentences.en: Daily meditation can help us cleanse the dirt of defilement and nurture the Bodhi Mind.

sentences.zh: 佛教修行的目的是為了去除煩惱垢，增長菩提心。
sentences.en: The purpose of Buddhist practice is to cleanse the dirt of defilement and nurture the Bodhi Mind.

sentences.zh: 老師教導我們如何通過禪修去除煩惱垢，並增長菩提心。
sentences.en: The teacher guides us on how to cleanse the dirt of defilement through meditation and nurture the Bodhi Mind.

sentences.zh: 只有真正去除煩惱垢，才能達到增長菩提心的境界。
sentences.en: Only by truly cleansing the dirt of defilement can one reach the state of nurturing the Bodhi Mind.

phrase.zh: 去除貪瞋痴 增長戒定慧
phrase.en: Eliminate greed, anger, and ignorance; Nurture discipline, concentration, and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義強調我們應該去除貪瞋痴，增長戒定慧，以達到內心的平和。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings emphasize that we should eliminate greed, anger, and ignorance; nurture discipline, concentration, and wisdom to achieve inner peace.

sentences.zh: 修行者透過冥想來去除貪瞋痴，增長戒定慧，使心靈更加純淨。
sentences.en: Practitioners use meditation to eliminate greed, anger, and ignorance; nurture discipline, concentration, and wisdom, purifying their minds.

sentences.zh: 在日常生活中，我們應該時時刻刻提醒自己去除貪瞋痴，增長戒定慧。
sentences.en: In everyday life, we should constantly remind ourselves to eliminate greed, anger, and ignorance; nurture discipline, concentration, and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 通過學習佛法，我們可以漸漸去除貪瞋痴，增長戒定慧，從而過上更加健康和諧的生活。
sentences.en: By studying the Dharma, we can gradually eliminate greed, anger, and ignorance; nurture discipline, concentration, and wisdom, leading to a healthier and more harmonious life.

sentences.zh: 很多僧侶會在修行過程中參學，從各地的師父那裡學習不同的佛法。
sentences.en: Many monks travel and learn during their practice, studying various teachings of the Dharma from masters in different regions.

sentences.zh: 他常常參學訪友，擴展自己的眼界和見識。
sentences.en: He often travels and learns by visiting friends, expanding his horizons and knowledge.

sentences.zh: 在佛教界，參學是一種重要的學習方式，通過旅行了解各地的佛教文化。
sentences.en: In the Buddhist world, travel and learn is an important method of study, allowing one to understand Buddhist cultures from various regions through travel.

sentences.zh: 每年夏天，很多學生會參加海外參學團，探索不同國家的寺院和佛教傳統。
sentences.en: Every summer, many students join overseas travel and learn groups, exploring temples and Buddhist traditions in different countries.

sentences.zh: 他常常在書中記錄下他的參學瑣憶，分享旅程中的點點滴滴。
sentences.en: He often recorded his recollections of the traveling days in his book, sharing the little details of his journeys.

sentences.zh: 這本書充滿了作者參學瑣憶，讀來讓人仿佛親身經歷那些歲月。
sentences.en: The book is filled with the author's recollections of the traveling days, making readers feel as if they are personally experiencing those times.

sentences.zh: 在安靜的夜晚，他會回想起過去的參學瑣憶，覺得自己充滿了智慧與成長。
sentences.en: On quiet nights, he would reminisce about his recollections of the traveling days, feeling enriched with wisdom and growth.

sentences.zh: 老法師的參學瑣憶中充滿了寶貴的教誨和令人深思的故事。
sentences.en: The elder monk's recollections of the traveling days were filled with valuable lessons and thought-provoking stories.

sentences.zh: 每天清晨，他都會坐在佛堂裡參禪，尋求內心的平靜。
sentences.en: Every morning, he sits in the temple for contemplation on Chan, seeking inner peace.

sentences.zh: 參禪是一種修行方式，通過靜坐來觀察自心，達到智慧的開啟。
sentences.en: Contemplation on Chan is a practice where one observes the mind through meditation, leading to the awakening of wisdom.

sentences.zh: 她參禪多年，終於明悟了生死的真諦。
sentences.en: After many years of contemplation on Chan, she finally comprehended the true essence of life and death.

sentences.zh: 參禪可以幫助我們脫離煩惱，進入寂靜的心靈狀態。
sentences.en: Contemplation on Chan can help us break free from worries and enter a state of serene mind.

sentences.zh: 他通過參究經典來深入理解佛法的智慧。
sentences.en: He engages in contemplative investigation of sutras to gain a deeper understanding of Buddha's wisdom.

sentences.zh: 參究是禪修的一種重要方法，幫助修行者內觀自身。
sentences.en: Contemplative investigation is an important method in Zen practice, aiding practitioners in self-reflection.

sentences.zh: 在參究之中，他常會靜坐冥想，尋找內心的答案。
sentences.en: During contemplative investigation, he often sits in meditation, seeking answers from within.

sentences.zh: 參究佛法需要耐心和定力，方能領悟其中的精髓。
sentences.en: Contemplative investigation of Buddhism requires patience and concentration to grasp its essence.

sentences.zh: 修行者通過參話頭來澄清內心的疑惑，達到智慧的開悟。
sentences.en: Practitioners inquire into the expressions to clear inner doubts and achieve enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 許多禪宗師父鼓勵弟子參話頭，以直指真心，排除妄念。
sentences.en: Many Zen masters encourage their disciples to inquire into the expressions to directly point to their true mind and eliminate delusions.

sentences.zh: 在禪堂中，眾僧人一起參話頭，共同追求心靈的解脫。
sentences.en: In the Zen hall, monks inquire into the expressions together, collectively pursuing spiritual liberation.

sentences.zh: 參話頭的方法包含反覆詢問像‘是什麼？’這樣的問題，以引發深度的省思。
sentences.en: The method of inquiring into the expressions involves repeatedly asking questions like 'What is it?' to provoke deep reflection.

phrase.en: contemplate the head phrase (of a gongan)

sentences.zh: 他每天打坐參話頭，希望能有所悟得。
sentences.en: He meditates daily to contemplate the head phrase (of a gongan), hoping to attain enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 參話頭是一種修行方式，需要持續的專注和反思。
sentences.en: Contemplating the head phrase (of a gongan) is a form of practice that requires sustained focus and reflection.

sentences.zh: 許多禪宗弟子通過參話頭來啟發自己的智慧。
sentences.en: Many Zen disciples contemplate the head phrase (of a gongan) to awaken their own wisdom.

sentences.zh: 老和尚指導弟子們如何正確地參話頭，以免陷入思維的陷阱。
sentences.en: The elder monk guided his disciples on how to properly contemplate the head phrase (of a gongan), so they wouldn't fall into the trap of intellectual analysis.

phrase.zh: 友有四品; 1. 有友如花 2. 有友如秤 3. 有友如山 4. 有友如地
phrase.en: Four Kinds of Friends: 1. Friendship like a flower; 2. Friendship like a balance-scale; 3. Friendship like a mountain; 4. Friendship like the ground

sentences.zh: 有友如花，初見時盛開如花，隨時間而變化，或凋謝或凋零。
sentences.en: Friendship like a flower blooms beautifully upon first meeting but changes or withers over time.

sentences.zh: 有友如秤，能公平衡量事物，給予中肯的建議和支持。
sentences.en: Friendship like a balance-scale can measure things fairly and provide honest advice and support.

sentences.zh: 有友如山，堅固穩重，在你需要時成為堅定的後盾。
sentences.en: Friendship like a mountain is solid and reliable, providing steadfast support when you need it.

sentences.zh: 有友如地，無私承載，默默地給予你穩定和養分。
sentences.en: Friendship like the ground selflessly supports and silently nourishes you, providing stability.

sentences.zh: 在皈依儀式上，很多在場的信徒都決定受五戒，作為他們修行的基礎。
sentences.en: During the ordination ceremony, many devotees present decided to take the Five Precepts as the foundation of their practice.

sentences.zh: 受五戒幫助他們在日常生活中培養道德規範和正念。
sentences.en: Taking the Five Precepts helps them cultivate moral discipline and mindfulness in their daily lives.

sentences.zh: 參加者受五戒後，感覺內心更加寧靜和平。
sentences.en: After taking the Five Precepts, the participants felt a greater sense of inner peace and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 他決定受五戒，以此來標誌自己生活的一個新的開始。
sentences.en: He decided to take the Five Precepts as a mark of a new beginning in his life.

sentences.zh: 他決定在今年的佛教儀式中受戒，立志成為一名虔誠的佛教徒。
sentences.en: He decided to take the precepts during this year's Buddhist ceremony, aspiring to become a devout Buddhist.

sentences.zh: 當你選擇受戒，你承諾遵守五戒，這是佛教徒基本的道德指導。
sentences.en: When you choose to take the precepts, you commit to observing the Five Precepts, which are the basic moral guidelines for Buddhists.

sentences.zh: 受戒是一個莊嚴的儀式，象徵著對佛法的尊崇和信仰的堅定。
sentences.en: Taking the precepts is a solemn ceremony that symbolizes reverence for the Dharma and steadfastness in faith.

sentences.zh: 在受戒的過程中，信徒會祈求三寶的庇佑並發誓遵守戒律。
sentences.en: During the process of taking the precepts, the devotee will seek the protection of the Triple Gem and vow to uphold the precepts.

sentences.zh: 他終身受持佛教戒律，時時刻刻警惕自己的言行。
sentences.en: He upheld the Buddhist precepts throughout his life, always mindful of his words and actions.

sentences.zh: 受持正法是每個佛教徒的責任和義務。
sentences.en: Upholding the Dharma is the responsibility and duty of every Buddhist.

sentences.zh: 在困難的時候，受持信仰能給予我們前進的力量。
sentences.en: In times of hardship, upholding one's faith can provide us with the strength to move forward.

sentences.zh: 她每天誦經，受持佛法，心中充滿了平靜與喜悅。
sentences.en: She recited scriptures and upheld the Dharma daily, filling her mind with peace and joy.

phrase.en: Buddhism in Every Step: The Five Precepts

sentences.zh: 在受持五戒的意義中，不殺生是第一條戒律，旨在保護所有生命的尊嚴。
sentences.en: In 'Buddhism in Every Step: The Five Precepts', the first precept, refraining from taking life, aims to protect the dignity of all living beings.

sentences.zh: 受持五戒的意義提醒我們，不偷盜有助於建立信任和社會和諧。
sentences.en: 'Buddhism in Every Step: The Five Precepts' reminds us that refraining from stealing helps build trust and social harmony.

sentences.zh: 受持五戒的意義強調，不妄語可以促進誠實和誠信。
sentences.en: The meaning of 'Buddhism in Every Step: The Five Precepts' emphasizes that refraining from false speech fosters honesty and integrity.

sentences.zh: 遵守受持五戒的意義，包括不飲酒，能夠保持心智清明和身心健康。
sentences.en: Adhering to the meaning of 'Buddhism in Every Step: The Five Precepts', including abstaining from intoxicants, helps maintain mental clarity and physical well-being.

phrase.zh: 受持戒法如瓔珞 可以莊嚴身心 堅定信仰如明燈 可以照破痴暗
phrase.en: Upholding precepts is like wearing an ornament that adorns both body and mind. Strengthened faith is like a shining light that dispels the darkness in the mind.

sentences.zh: 受持戒法如瓔珞，可以莊嚴身心，讓我們在修行中更加莊重。
sentences.en: Upholding precepts is like wearing an ornament that adorns both body and mind, allowing us to become more dignified in our practice.

sentences.zh: 堅定信仰如明燈，可以照破痴暗，幫助我們看清人生的方向。
sentences.en: Strengthened faith is like a shining light that dispels the darkness in the mind, helping us see the direction of life clearly.

sentences.zh: 當我們受持戒法時，心靈會變得如同佩戴著璀璨的瓔珞般美麗。
sentences.en: When we uphold precepts, our mind becomes beautiful as if adorned with resplendent ornaments.

sentences.zh: 信仰堅定的人，他們的智慧心燈將永遠閃耀，驅除任何無明的黑暗。
sentences.en: For those with strengthened faith, their lamp of wisdom will forever shine, dispelling any darkness of ignorance.

sentences.zh: 學習佛法可以讓人受用無窮，獲得內心的平靜與智慧。
sentences.en: Studying Buddhist teachings can provide endless benefits, gaining inner peace and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 禪修的實踐使許多人在日常生活中受用，提升了他們的專注力和情緒管理能力。
sentences.en: The practice of meditation has benefited many people in their daily lives, enhancing their focus and emotional management skills.

sentences.zh: 這本書中的教誨對他的精神成長非常受用，幫助他更加理智地面對困難。
sentences.en: The teachings in this book were very beneficial for his spiritual growth, helping him face difficulties with more rationality.

sentences.zh: 參加這次佛學講座，大家都覺得非常受用，獲得了許多啟發。
sentences.en: Attending the Buddhist lecture was very beneficial to everyone, gaining a lot of inspiration.

sentences.zh: 在這座古老的叢林裡，僧侶們每日都進行靜修和誦經。
sentences.en: In this ancient monastery, monks perform daily meditations and chant scriptures.

sentences.zh: 叢林中的生活簡樸，僧侶們專注於修行和學習佛法。
sentences.en: Life in the monastery is simple, with monks focusing on their practice and the study of Buddhist teachings.

sentences.zh: 許多信徒前來叢林求取平靜與智慧，希望能從中找到心靈的慰藉。
sentences.en: Many devotees visit the monastery seeking peace and wisdom, hoping to find solace for their souls.

sentences.zh: 這座叢林建立於千年前，是一個遠離塵囂的修行聖地。
sentences.en: This monastery was established a thousand years ago, serving as a retreat away from the turmoil of worldly life.

sentences.zh: 叢林大學是佛教叢林學修的地方，專注於培養僧伽的學識與道德。
sentences.en: FGS Tsung-Lin University is a place for monastic study and practice, focusing on the education and moral development of monks.

sentences.zh: 許多來自世界各地的佛教徒前來叢林大學學習佛法與修行。
sentences.en: Many Buddhists from around the world come to FGS Tsung-Lin University to study Dharma and practice.

sentences.zh: 叢林大學強調理論與實踐的結合，讓學生們能夠全方位地發展。
sentences.en: FGS Tsung-Lin University emphasizes the integration of theory and practice, allowing students to develop comprehensively.

sentences.zh: 叢林大學的豐富課程包括佛教經典研究、禪修課程以及生活技能培訓。
sentences.en: The diverse curriculum at FGS Tsung-Lin University includes Buddhist scripture studies, meditation courses, and life skills training.

sentences.zh: 叢林大學院是佛光山的教育機構，培育了多位優秀的出家人。
sentences.en: FGS Tsung-Lin University is an educational institution of Fo Guang Shan, nurturing many excellent monastics.

sentences.zh: 叢林大學院致力於推廣佛教教育，提供多種課程給大眾選擇。
sentences.en: FGS Tsung-Lin University is dedicated to promoting Buddhist education, offering various courses for the public to choose from.

sentences.zh: 許多學生從叢林大學院畢業後，繼續弘揚佛法，服務社會。
sentences.en: Many students, after graduating from FGS Tsung-Lin University, continue to spread the Dharma and serve society.

sentences.zh: 叢林大學院的課程涵蓋經典研讀、禪修實踐及社會服務。
sentences.en: The curriculum of FGS Tsung-Lin University includes classical studies, meditation practice, and social services.

sentences.zh: 他在叢林學院學習佛法，培養了深厚的信仰基礎。
sentences.en: He studied Dharma at Tsung Lin University, developing a profound foundation of faith.

sentences.zh: 叢林學院每年吸引許多國內外學者前來研究佛教經典。
sentences.en: Tsung Lin University attracts numerous scholars from both home and abroad each year to study Buddhist scriptures.

sentences.zh: 叢林學院的教師不僅擁有深厚的學術背景，還在實踐中體驗佛法。
sentences.en: The teachers at Tsung Lin University not only possess strong academic backgrounds but also experience Dharma in practice.

sentences.zh: 他畢業於叢林學院，如今成為一名尊敬的佛教導師。
sentences.en: He graduated from Tsung Lin University and has now become a respected Buddhist instructor.

sentences.zh: 參加叢林尋根之旅，你會親身體會到佛光山的傳統與文化。
sentences.en: Joining the Roots Discovery Tour to FGS, you will personally experience the traditions and culture of Fo Guang Shan.

sentences.zh: 在叢林尋根之旅中，參與者能夠深入了解佛光山的誕生歷史及其發展歷程。
sentences.en: During the Roots Discovery Tour to FGS, participants can gain in-depth knowledge about the birth and development of Fo Guang Shan.

sentences.zh: 叢林尋根之旅讓人有機會沉浸在佛教的修行環境中，感受內心的平靜。
sentences.en: The Roots Discovery Tour to FGS offers an opportunity to immerse oneself in the Buddhist monastic environment, experiencing inner peace.

sentences.zh: 通過叢林尋根之旅，來自世界各地的信徒可以一同探索佛光山的精神根源。
sentences.en: Through the Roots Discovery Tour to FGS, followers from around the world can explore the spiritual roots of Fo Guang Shan together.

phrase.zh: 口中吃的清和味 心裏常思佛土居
phrase.en: Taste the pure and harmonious flavors; Think constantly of the Buddha's abiding.

sentences.zh: 在靜寂的禪堂中，口中吃的清和味，心裏常思佛土居。
sentences.en: In the serene meditation hall, one tastes the pure and harmonious flavors and constantly thinks of the Buddha's abiding.

sentences.zh: 她在每天的用餐時，都口中吃的清和味，心裡常思佛土居，以保持心靈的純淨。
sentences.en: During her daily meals, she would taste the pure and harmonious flavors and constantly think of the Buddha's abiding to keep her mind pure.

sentences.zh: 禪師教導弟子們，應該口中吃的清和味，心裡常思佛土居，這樣才能達到內心的平和。
sentences.en: The Zen master taught his disciples to taste the pure and harmonious flavors and constantly think of the Buddha's abiding in order to achieve inner peace.

sentences.zh: 在精進修行的過程中，修行者應該謹記口中吃的清和味，心裡常思佛土居的原則。
sentences.en: During the rigorous practice, the practitioner should remember the principle of tasting the pure and harmonious flavors and constantly thinking of the Buddha's abiding.

sentences.zh: 他因為口業造下了許多不好的因果，現在常常感受到內心的煎熬。
sentences.en: He has created a lot of negative karma through his verbal actions, and now he often feels inner torment.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們要謹慎言語，避免口業紛爭以修行善業。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us to be mindful of our speech and avoid verbal karma to cultivate good deeds.

sentences.zh: 口業積重難返，要透過不斷的懺悔和修行來淨化心靈。
sentences.en: Verbal karma can be deeply ingrained, requiring constant repentance and practice to purify the mind.

sentences.zh: 他開始重視口業，努力改變自己的言語習慣，以期達到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: He began to pay attention to his verbal karma, striving to change his speech habits in hopes of achieving inner peace.

phrase.zh: 口說不如身行 生氣不如爭氣 妒他不如學他 認命不如拼命
phrase.en: It is better to act than talk. It is better to step up than get worked up. It is better to learn from others than be jealous. It is better to try than yield.

sentences.zh: 口說不如身行，與其空談不如真正去做。
sentences.en: It is better to act than talk; instead of idle talk, it's better to actually do something.

sentences.zh: 生氣不如爭氣，面對困難時更應該堅持不懈。
sentences.en: It is better to step up than get worked up; when facing difficulties, we should persevere.

sentences.zh: 妒他不如學他，嫉妒他的成功不如從中學習。
sentences.en: It is better to learn from others than be jealous; instead of envying someone's success, learn from it.

sentences.zh: 認命不如拼命，在遇到挫折時，應該勇敢奮鬥，而不是坐以待斃。
sentences.en: It is better to try than yield; in the face of setbacks, we should fight bravely rather than resign ourselves to fate.

sentences.zh: 他的話常常被認為只是口頭禪，並沒有真正的行動來支持。
sentences.en: His words are often considered as just lip service Chan, without any real actions to back them up.

sentences.zh: 在這個組織中，推動真正的改變比僅僅給出口頭禪來得重要。
sentences.en: In this organization, driving real change is more important than merely giving lip service Chan.

sentences.zh: 領導者需要的是堅實的行動，而不是口頭禪虛張聲勢。
sentences.en: Leaders need solid actions, not the lip service Chan bluff.

sentences.zh: 他們的承諾聽起來像是口頭禪，但社區希望看到更多的實際成果。
sentences.en: Their promises sound like lip service Chan, but the community hopes to see more tangible results.

phrase.zh: 古人不見今時月 今月曾經照古人
phrase.en: Those from times past were unable to see today's moon; Yet today's moon once shone on those from bygone times.

sentences.zh: 古人不見今時月，今月卻與我們共享同一片天空。
sentences.en: Those from times past were unable to see today's moon, but the moon today shares the same sky with us.

sentences.zh: 我們仰望同一輪明月，感受古人不見今時月的歲月流轉。
sentences.en: We gaze upon the same bright moon, feeling the passage of time that those from times past were unable to witness today's moon.

sentences.zh: 今月曾經照古人，如今又映在我們眼中，歷史在這光影中交融。
sentences.en: Today's moon once shone on those from bygone times, now it reflects in our eyes, merging history within this light.

sentences.zh: 皓月當空，古人不見今時月，卻曾經照耀過古人的夜晚。
sentences.en: Under the bright moonlight, those from times past were unable to see today's moon, yet it once illuminated the nights of bygone people.

phrase.zh: 古今多少事 都付笑談中
phrase.en: Laugh away all that has happened in the past and present.

sentences.zh: 歷史上的風風雨雨，古今多少事，終歸還是要都付笑談中。
sentences.en: The storms of history, all that has happened in the past and present, will eventually be laughed away.

sentences.zh: 在這艱難的時刻，他提醒自己古今多少事，都付笑談中來保持積極的心態。
sentences.en: In these difficult times, he reminded himself to laugh away all that has happened in the past and present to maintain a positive attitude.

sentences.zh: 回首過往，當初的困難如今已經成為了古今多少事，都付笑談中的一部分。
sentences.en: Looking back, the difficulties of those days have now become part of what we laugh away from the past and present.

sentences.zh: 無論生活中多少挫折，他總是能古今多少事，都付笑談中，展現出豁達的胸懷。
sentences.en: No matter how many setbacks in life, he could always laugh away all that has happened in the past and present, showing a magnanimous heart.

sentences.zh: 這本書懷揣著古今譚，深入探討了歷史與現在的關聯。
sentences.en: This book is filled with past and present talks, deeply exploring the connection between history and the present.

sentences.zh: 僧人在佛法講座中常常引用古今譚，以啟發聽眾的智慧。
sentences.en: Monks often cite past and present talks during Dharma lectures to inspire the audience's wisdom.

sentences.zh: 古今譚的故事教會我們如何在現代世界中保持內心的平靜和和諧。
sentences.en: Stories of past and present talks teach us how to maintain inner peace and harmony in the modern world.

sentences.zh: 通過古今譚，我們得以理解歷史事件對現代生活的影響。
sentences.en: Through past and present talks, we can understand the impact of historical events on modern life.

phrase.zh: 古佛堂前風掃地 高山頂上月為燈
phrase.en: The winds will sweep the floor of an ancient Buddha shrine; The moon will illuminate the peace of the most noble mountain.

sentences.zh: 每當夜深人靜，古佛堂前的風掃地，高山頂上的月為燈，營造出一片靜謐的氛圍。
sentences.en: Every deep night, the winds will sweep the floor of the ancient Buddha shrine, and the moon will illuminate the peace of the most noble mountain, creating a serene atmosphere.

sentences.zh: 在這片安靜的山谷中，古佛堂前的風掃地，高山頂上的月為燈，令人心生寧靜。
sentences.en: In this peaceful valley, the winds will sweep the floor of the ancient Buddha shrine, and the moon will illuminate the peace of the most noble mountain, bringing tranquility to one's heart.

sentences.zh: 無論晴雨，古佛堂前的風掃地，高山頂上的月為燈，這裡永遠都是修行者的靜修之地。
sentences.en: Regardless of rain or shine, the winds will sweep the floor of the ancient Buddha shrine, and the moon will illuminate the peace of the most noble mountain; this place remains forever a retreat for practitioners.

sentences.zh: 古佛堂前的風掃地，高山頂上的月為燈，是許多前來禮佛者的心靈依靠。
sentences.en: The winds will sweep the floor of the ancient Buddha shrine, and the moon will illuminate the peace of the most noble mountain, providing a spiritual haven for many who come to worship.

sentences.zh: 古德的智慧和教誨，至今仍是指引我們生活的明燈。
sentences.en: The wisdom and teachings of the ancient sages continue to guide our lives to this day.

sentences.zh: 學習古德的思想，有助於我們理解宇宙的真理和人性的本質。
sentences.en: Studying the thoughts of ancient sages helps us understand the truths of the universe and the nature of humanity.

sentences.zh: 在面對困難和迷惘時，我們可以從古德的教導中尋找到力量和方向。
sentences.en: In times of difficulty and confusion, we can find strength and direction from the teachings of the ancient sages.

sentences.zh: 古德所傳承的經典，不僅是文化遺產，也是智慧的源泉。
sentences.en: The classics passed down by ancient sages are not only cultural heritage but also a fountain of wisdom.

phrase.zh: 古聖賢修身做起 大英雄立功為先
phrase.en: Sages began by cultivating themselves; Great heroes began with honorable acts.

sentences.zh: 古聖賢修身做起，從提高自身品德開始，道德涵養成為人生的基石。
sentences.en: Sages began by cultivating themselves, starting with enhancing their own virtues; moral cultivation became the foundation of their lives.

sentences.zh: 大英雄立功為先，從小事做起，逐步建立起自己的功勳。
sentences.en: Great heroes began with honorable acts, starting with small deeds and gradually building up their achievements.

sentences.zh: 古聖賢修身做起，從自身修養入手，影響了後世無數人。
sentences.en: Sages began by cultivating themselves, starting from their own self-cultivation, influencing countless people in later generations.

sentences.zh: 大英雄立功為先，他們總是先考慮如何為國家和人民做出貢獻。
sentences.en: Great heroes began with honorable acts, always considering how to contribute to the country and the people first.

phrase.zh: 只要有悲心 世間無善惡 只要有慧心 人生無痴迷 只要肯發心 人間無難事 只要有願心 地球無遠近
phrase.en: In this world, there is no good or bad in the eyes of compassion. In life, there is no ignorance or delusion in the eyes of wisdom. In this world, nothing is impossible in the face of aspiration. In this universe, there is no close or afar in the eyes of great vows.

sentences.zh: 只要有悲心，世間無善惡，因為任何行為都可以被仁慈理解。
sentences.en: In this world, there is no good or bad in the eyes of compassion, for any action can be understood through kindness.

sentences.zh: 只要有慧心，人生無痴迷，因為智慧能讓一切變得清楚。
sentences.en: In life, there is no ignorance or delusion in the eyes of wisdom, for wisdom makes everything clear.

sentences.zh: 只要肯發心，人間無難事，任何障礙都能被堅定的心克服。
sentences.en: In this world, nothing is impossible in the face of aspiration, as any obstacle can be overcome with a determined heart.

sentences.zh: 只要有願心，地球無遠近，任何距離都因為我們的願望變得無關重要。
sentences.en: In this universe, there is no close or afar in the eyes of great vows, as distances become irrelevant in light of our aspirations.

phrase.zh: 只見江流千里外 不知身在五峰中
phrase.en: You see rivers flowing for thousands of miles; Never realizing you stand within the Five Peaks.

sentences.zh: 觀賞江流千里外的美景，我們常常忽略了自己身處五峰中的壯麗。
sentences.en: While admiring the rivers flowing for thousands of miles, we often overlook the grandeur of the Five Peaks around us.

sentences.zh: 他只見江流千里外，卻不知自己已然深入五峰的心靈之旅。
sentences.en: He sees rivers flowing for thousands of miles, but never realizes he has embarked on an inner journey within the Five Peaks.

sentences.zh: 在追求遠方的景象時，我們不知不覺身在五峰中，錯過了此刻的真實。
sentences.en: In chasing distant sceneries, we unwittingly find ourselves within the Five Peaks, missing the reality of the present.

sentences.zh: 她感受到江流千里外的廣闊，卻未曾意識到五峰中的靜謐之美。
sentences.en: She felt the vastness of rivers flowing for thousands of miles, yet never noticed the serene beauty within the Five Peaks.

sentences.zh: 佛寺中，叫香通常用於召集僧眾進行早晚課。
sentences.en: In Buddhist temples, the clapper signal is commonly used to gather monks for morning and evening prayers.

sentences.zh: 當你聽到叫香聲，表示靜坐時間開始了。
sentences.en: When you hear the clapper signal, it indicates the start of meditation time.

sentences.zh: 叫香是一種古老的傳統，持續了數百年。
sentences.en: The clapper signal is an ancient tradition that has persisted for centuries.

sentences.zh: 即使在現代科技發達的今天，許多佛寺仍然使用叫香來保持傳統。
sentences.en: Even in today's technologically advanced age, many Buddhist temples still use the clapper signal to maintain tradition.

sentences.zh: 寺廟的僧人每天都會舉行召請儀式，祈求諸佛菩薩的護佑。
sentences.en: Monks at the temple hold a summoning ceremony daily, praying for the protection of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.

sentences.zh: 在重要的法會上，主法和尚會進行召請，迎請天界的護法神來護持道場。
sentences.en: During important Dharma assemblies, the presiding monk conducts summoning to invite the celestial guardians to support the venue.

sentences.zh: 召請法是一種傳統的佛教儀軌，用來喚起諸佛菩薩的加持。
sentences.en: The summoning practice is a traditional Buddhist ritual used to invoke the blessings of the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.

sentences.zh: 在觀音法會期間，信眾們誠心誦經，並進行召請，希望觀音菩薩能夠救度眾生。
sentences.en: During the Guanyin Dharma Assembly, devotees sincerely recite sutras and conduct summoning, hoping that Bodhisattva Guanyin will save all sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 在這次會議中，他被任命為召集人，負責安排所有議程和討論。
sentences.en: He was appointed as the Executive Convener in this meeting, responsible for organizing all the agendas and discussions.

sentences.zh: 作為召集人，她需要協調不同部門的工作，確保項目順利進行。
sentences.en: As the Executive Convener, she needs to coordinate the work of different departments to ensure the project's smooth progress.

sentences.zh: 這位召集人有豐富的經驗，之前曾在多個國際會議中擔任重要角色。
sentences.en: The Executive Convener has extensive experience, having played important roles in several international conferences before.

sentences.zh: 他作為召集人展示出卓越的領導才能，成功地推動了改革進程。
sentences.en: As the Executive Convener, he demonstrated exceptional leadership skills and successfully advanced the reform process.

sentences.zh: 台中慈善寺位於台中市的市中心，吸引了許多信眾前來參拜。
sentences.en: Tzu Shan Temple is located in the center of Taichung City and attracts many devotees to come and worship.

sentences.zh: 每逢重要節日，台中慈善寺都會舉辦盛大的慶祝活動。
sentences.en: During major holidays, Tzu Shan Temple hosts grand celebrations.

sentences.zh: 這間歷史悠久的台中慈善寺，是當地居民心中的精神寄託。
sentences.en: This historic Tzu Shan Temple is a spiritual haven for the local residents.

sentences.zh: 台中慈善寺的建築風格莊嚴宏偉，充分體現了傳統的宗教文化。
sentences.en: The architecture of Tzu Shan Temple is grand and solemn, fully embodying traditional religious culture.

phrase.en: Tainan Tien Hui Child Care Centre

sentences.zh: 台南天惠托兒所是一個以仁愛和慈悲為基礎的幼兒教育機構。
sentences.en: Tainan Tien Hui Child Care Centre is a childcare institution founded on the principles of kindness and compassion.

sentences.zh: 許多父母選擇台南天惠托兒所，因為他們相信這裡的教育理念能夠提供孩子們一個良好的成長環境。
sentences.en: Many parents choose Tainan Tien Hui Child Care Centre because they believe its educational philosophy provides a nurturing environment for their children's growth.

sentences.zh: 台南天惠托兒所的老師們經常舉辦文化活動，讓孩子們能夠從小接觸傳統文化。
sentences.en: The teachers at Tainan Tien Hui Child Care Centre often organize cultural activities, allowing children to be exposed to traditional culture from an early age.

sentences.zh: 透過遊戲和互動，台南天惠托兒所的孩童在快樂中學習並成長。
sentences.en: Through games and interactive activities, children at Tainan Tien Hui Child Care Centre learn and grow joyfully.

sentences.zh: 台灣九二一大震發生於1999年，是台灣歷史上最嚴重的地震之一。
sentences.en: The September 21st Earthquake in Taiwan occurred in 1999 and is one of the most severe earthquakes in Taiwan's history.

sentences.zh: 台灣九二一大震造成大量的建築倒塌和人員傷亡，使全台灣進入緊急狀態。
sentences.en: The September 21st Earthquake in Taiwan caused massive building collapses and casualties, putting the entire island in a state of emergency.

sentences.zh: 在台灣九二一大震之後，許多國家伸出援手，幫助台灣重建家園。
sentences.en: Following the September 21st Earthquake in Taiwan, many countries extended a helping hand to assist Taiwan in rebuilding homes.

sentences.zh: 台灣九二一大震喚起了對地震災害防範的重要性，催生了許多防災措施的改進。
sentences.en: The September 21st Earthquake in Taiwan raised awareness about the importance of earthquake disaster prevention, leading to numerous improvements in disaster preparedness measures.

phrase.en: Taiwanese Institute of Buddhist Studies (est. in 1948 by Ven. Tzu Hang)

sentences.zh: 台灣佛學院是1948年由慈航菩薩創立的，至今培育了無數的佛教學者。
sentences.en: The Taiwanese Institute of Buddhist Studies was established in 1948 by Ven. Tzu Hang and has since nurtured countless Buddhist scholars.

sentences.zh: 許多來自各地的學僧前往台灣佛學院學習，以期深入了解佛教經典和修行方法。
sentences.en: Many monks from various regions travel to the Taiwanese Institute of Buddhist Studies in hopes of gaining a deeper understanding of Buddhist scriptures and practices.

sentences.zh: 台灣佛學院的教學質量和嚴謹的學術研究受到了國際佛教界的高度評價。
sentences.en: The quality of education and rigorous academic research at the Taiwanese Institute of Buddhist Studies has received high praise from the international Buddhist community.

sentences.zh: 作為台灣佛教教育的重要基地，台灣佛學院積極推動佛教文化的弘揚與普及。
sentences.en: As an important center for Buddhist education in Taiwan, the Taiwanese Institute of Buddhist Studies actively promotes the dissemination and popularization of Buddhist culture.

sentences.zh: 台灣佛教在近幾十年間迅速發展，吸引了許多信眾。
sentences.en: Buddhism in Taiwan has rapidly developed over the past decades, attracting many followers.

sentences.zh: 台灣佛教特色之一是結合了傳統與現代的元素。
sentences.en: One of the characteristics of Buddhism in Taiwan is the integration of traditional and modern elements.

sentences.zh: 台灣佛教寺廟如佛光山和中台禪寺，成為了世界知名的宗教場所。
sentences.en: Taiwanese Buddhist temples such as Fo Guang Shan and Chung Tai Chan Monastery have become world-renowned religious sites.

sentences.zh: 台灣佛教在國際間積極推動文化交流，促進了不同國家之間的理解與合作。
sentences.en: Buddhism in Taiwan actively promotes cultural exchanges internationally, fostering understanding and cooperation between different countries.

sentences.zh: 今年的台灣佛教講習會吸引了來自各地的僧俗二眾，共同交流佛法心得。
sentences.en: This year's Taiwan Buddhist Seminar attracted monks and laypeople from various regions to share and discuss their insights into the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 台灣佛教講習會期間，各種精彩的講座和課程豐富了參與者的視野和智慧。
sentences.en: During the Taiwan Buddhist Seminar, a variety of fascinating lectures and courses enriched the participants' perspectives and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 多位學者和高僧在台灣佛教講習會上發表了關於現代社會與佛教融合的演講。
sentences.en: Several scholars and senior monks delivered speeches on the integration of modern society and Buddhism at the Taiwan Buddhist Seminar.

sentences.zh: 她表示參加台灣佛教講習會讓她對人生有了更深刻的瞭解和更堅定的信仰。
sentences.en: She stated that participating in the Taiwan Buddhist Seminar gave her a deeper understanding of life and a more resolute faith.

phrase.zh: 台灣南北行腳托缽法會

sentences.zh: 每年的台灣南北行腳托缽法會都吸引了成千上萬的信眾一同參加。
sentences.en: The annual Anniversary Alms Procession Across Taiwan attracts thousands of devotees to participate.

sentences.zh: 在台灣南北行腳托缽法會期間，僧侶們會一邊行走一邊接受信眾的供養。
sentences.en: During the Anniversary Alms Procession Across Taiwan, monks walk while receiving alms from the faithful.

sentences.zh: 台灣南北行腳托缽法會是一個融合傳統文化與宗教信仰的重要活動。
sentences.en: The Anniversary Alms Procession Across Taiwan is an important event that blends traditional culture and religious beliefs.

sentences.zh: 這項活動旨在推廣慈悲和無私奉獻的精神，是一年中佛教界的一大盛事。
sentences.en: The event aims to promote the spirit of compassion and selfless devotion, making it a major occasion in the Buddhist community each year.

sentences.zh: 我今年參加了台灣寺院管理講習會，學到了很多實用的管理方法。
sentences.en: This year, I attended the National Buddhist Temple Management Seminar and learned many practical management techniques.

sentences.zh: 台灣寺院管理講習會是專為提升當地寺院管理水平而設計的年度活動。
sentences.en: The National Buddhist Temple Management Seminar is an annual event designed to improve the management standards of local temples.

sentences.zh: 來自全國各地的和尚和尼姑聚集在台灣寺院管理講習會，交換經驗和心得。
sentences.en: Monks and nuns from all over the country gathered at the National Buddhist Temple Management Seminar to exchange experiences and insights.

sentences.zh: 在參加台灣寺院管理講習會後，我們計劃採納一些新的管理策略來提升寺院的運作效率。
sentences.en: After attending the National Buddhist Temple Management Seminar, we plan to adopt some new management strategies to enhance the operational efficiency of our temple.

phrase.zh: 台灣情義 中國夢景

sentences.zh: 台灣情義是不可或缺的文化根基，而中國夢景則是未來的共同願景。
sentences.en: Taiwan sentiment is an indispensable cultural foundation, while China vision represents a shared future aspiration.

sentences.zh: 在這個特別的節日裡，讓我們一同懷念台灣情義並展望中國夢景。
sentences.en: On this special occasion, let's together reminisce about Taiwan sentiment and look forward to China vision.

sentences.zh: 台灣情義與中國夢景的結合，給予我們更多的信心與力量。
sentences.en: The combination of Taiwan sentiment and China vision gives us more confidence and strength.

sentences.zh: 面對全球化的挑戰，台灣情義與中國夢景能為我們的未來提供指引。
sentences.en: Facing the challenges of globalization, Taiwan sentiment and China vision can guide our future.

phrase.en: Relief Program - Love from Taiwan, Care for South Asia

sentences.zh: 這次的台灣愛心，關懷南亞活動，吸引了許多志願者參與，為當地提供了急需的支援。
sentences.en: This relief program - Love from Taiwan, Care for South Asia attracted many volunteers and provided much-needed support to the region.

sentences.zh: 台灣愛心，關懷南亞的行動，給那些受災民眾送去了溫暖和希望。
sentences.en: The relief program - Love from Taiwan, Care for South Asia brought warmth and hope to those affected by the disaster.

sentences.zh: 台灣愛心，關懷南亞項目向南亞地區捐贈了大量醫療物資，幫助他們度過難關。
sentences.en: The relief program - Love from Taiwan, Care for South Asia donated a substantial amount of medical supplies to help the South Asia region overcome their difficulties.

sentences.zh: 通過台灣愛心，關懷南亞這一舉措，台灣人民向南亞展現了無私的關愛與援助。
sentences.en: Through the relief program - Love from Taiwan, Care for South Asia, the people of Taiwan demonstrated their selfless care and assistance to South Asia.

sentences.zh: 台灣靈巖山寺是台灣著名的佛教聖地，吸引了許多信徒前來朝拜。
sentences.en: Ling Yen Shan Temple in Taiwan is a famous Buddhist pilgrimage site that attracts many devotees.

sentences.zh: 每年的佛誕節，台灣靈巖山寺都會舉辦盛大的慶祝活動。
sentences.en: Every year during Buddha's birthday, Ling Yen Shan Temple in Taiwan holds grand celebration events.

sentences.zh: 台灣靈巖山寺的庭院充滿了幽靜的氛圍，適合靜心修行。
sentences.en: The courtyard of Ling Yen Shan Temple in Taiwan is filled with a tranquil atmosphere, ideal for meditative practice.

sentences.zh: 訪客們可以在台灣靈巖山寺參加禪修課程，體驗深層的內在平靜。
sentences.en: Visitors can participate in meditation classes at Ling Yen Shan Temple in Taiwan to experience deep inner peace.

sentences.zh: 史傳類書籍在記錄偉大人物的成就和挫折上有很大的價值。
sentences.en: Biographies have significant value in documenting the achievements and struggles of great individuals.

sentences.zh: 許多讀者喜歡從史傳類書籍中尋找靈感，學習歷史人物的智慧和經驗。
sentences.en: Many readers like to seek inspiration from biographies, learning the wisdom and experiences of historical figures.

sentences.zh: 這本史傳類書籍讓我們深刻了解了一位歷史領袖的生活。
sentences.en: This biography gave us a profound understanding of the life of a historical leader.

sentences.zh: 史傳類文本能夠幫助我們理解歷史事件的細節和背後的人物故事。
sentences.en: Biographical texts help us understand the details of historical events and the stories of the people behind them.

sentences.zh: 寺廟的司庫負責管理捐款和其他財務事宜。
sentences.en: The temple's treasury is responsible for managing donations and other financial matters.

sentences.zh: 司庫每天都會記錄所有的財務交易，以確保財務透明。
sentences.en: The treasury records all financial transactions every day to ensure financial transparency.

sentences.zh: 在大型法會中，司庫的工作尤其繁忙，需要處理大量的捐贈。
sentences.en: During large Dharma assemblies, the work of the treasury is particularly busy, handling a significant amount of donations.

sentences.zh: 這座寺廟的司庫設有專門的人員來管理善款的使用和分配。
sentences.en: The treasury of this temple has dedicated personnel to manage the use and allocation of donations.

phrase.en: to live on offerings from the ten directions

sentences.zh: 出家人依靠吃十方，以示對眾生布施的感恩。
sentences.en: Monks and nuns live on offerings from the ten directions to show their gratitude for the donations of all sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 寺院的長者提醒年輕僧人，應當勤修精進，因為他們是吃十方的。
sentences.en: The elders in the temple reminded the young monks to practice diligently because they live on offerings from the ten directions.

sentences.zh: 在佛法中，吃十方提醒我們要常懷感恩之心，珍惜每一分施食。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, living on offerings from the ten directions reminds us to always be grateful and to cherish every bit of given food.

sentences.zh: 法師說，吃十方也是一種修行，能讓我們學會謙卑和知足。
sentences.en: The Dharma master said that living on offerings from the ten directions is also a form of practice that teaches us humility and contentment.

phrase.zh: 吃得苦中苦 方為人上人
phrase.en: Out of the worst of the worst pains

sentences.zh: 吃得苦中苦，方為人上人，他每天都是最後一個離開辦公室的人。
sentences.en: Out of the worst of the worst pains; he is always the last one to leave the office each day.

sentences.zh: 這位年輕的運動員深知吃得苦中苦，方為人上人，因此他在訓練中從不偷懶。
sentences.en: This young athlete understands that out of the worst of the worst pains comes success, so he never slacks off in training.

sentences.zh: 她的成績突飛猛進，證明了吃得苦中苦，方為人上人的道理。
sentences.en: Her remarkable academic progress proves that out of the worst of the worst pains comes excellence.

sentences.zh: 他堅信吃得苦中苦，方為人上人，為了完成這個項目，他熬了無數個通宵。
sentences.en: He firmly believes that out of the worst of the worst pains comes greatness; for this project, he has pulled countless all-nighters.

sentences.zh: 每天早晨，寺院的僧人們會在禪堂吃早齋，以開始他們的一天。
sentences.en: Every morning, the monks in the monastery have a vegetarian breakfast in the meditation hall to start their day.

sentences.zh: 這裡的吃早齋包括各種新鮮的水果、蔬菜和傳統的谷物食品。
sentences.en: The vegetarian breakfast here includes a variety of fresh fruits, vegetables, and traditional grain foods.

sentences.zh: 在佛教的傳統節日，信徒們會聚集在一起，引領清晨的儀式並吃早齋。
sentences.en: During traditional Buddhist festivals, devotees gather together, leading the morning ceremonies and having a vegetarian breakfast.

sentences.zh: 吃早齋不僅是一種飲食習慣，更是一種修行方式，幫助我們保持身心的清淨。
sentences.en: Having a vegetarian breakfast is not just a dietary habit but also a form of practice that helps us maintain purity of body and mind.

sentences.zh: 每當心情煩亂時，他會靜靜地坐下來吃茶，讓自己放鬆。
sentences.en: Whenever he feels troubled, he quietly sits down to drink tea and relax.

sentences.zh: 在禪修結束後，大家一起圍坐在桌旁吃茶，享受這片刻的平靜。
sentences.en: After the Zen meditation session, everyone gathers around the table to drink tea and enjoy the moment of tranquility.

sentences.zh: 老師會教導學生如何正確地吃茶，體驗其中的禪意。
sentences.en: The teacher instructs the students on how to properly drink tea, experiencing the Zen philosophy within.

sentences.zh: 這家古老的茶館提供了吃茶的悠閒環境，讓人們遠離喧囂。
sentences.en: The old teahouse provides a serene environment for drinking tea, allowing people to escape the hustle and bustle.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，吃齋被認為是一種清淨心身的修行方式。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, vegetarianism is considered a way to purify the mind and body.

sentences.zh: 許多寺院每天都提供豐富的齋飯，鼓勵信徒吃齋。
sentences.en: Many temples offer abundant vegetarian meals every day to encourage followers to practice vegetarianism.

sentences.zh: 她因為信仰選擇了吃齋，並感受到了內心平靜。
sentences.en: She chose vegetarianism because of her faith and felt a sense of inner peace.

sentences.zh: 現代社會越來越多的人因健康和環保原因開始吃齋。
sentences.en: In modern society, more and more people are adopting vegetarianism for health and environmental reasons.

phrase.zh: 各大專學校青年學佛營

sentences.zh: 各大專學校青年學佛營每年夏天都會舉辦，吸引許多年輕人參加。
sentences.en: Buddhist Youth Camps are held every summer across various universities, attracting many young participants.

sentences.zh: 通過參加各大專學校青年學佛營，學生們可以學到許多佛教知識。
sentences.en: By participating in the Buddhist Youth Camps, students can learn a lot about Buddhist teachings.

sentences.zh: 參加各大專學校青年學佛營的每個人都感到精神上得到了提升。
sentences.en: Everyone who attended the Buddhist Youth Camps felt spiritually uplifted.

sentences.zh: 這些各大專學校青年學佛營提供了冥想、佛法講座和討論等豐富的活動。
sentences.en: These Buddhist Youth Camps offer a variety of activities like meditation, Dharma talks, and discussions.

phrase.zh: 各宗教領袖為世界和平聯評座談
phrase.en: Forum on World Peace with the Religious Leaders

sentences.zh: 此次，各宗教領袖為世界和平聯評座談，吸引了來自世界各地的重要人士參與。
sentences.en: The Forum on World Peace with the Religious Leaders this time attracted important figures from around the world.

sentences.zh: 為期三天的各宗教領袖為世界和平聯評座談，討論了如何通過合作實現全球穩定。
sentences.en: The three-day Forum on World Peace with the Religious Leaders discussed how to achieve global stability through cooperation.

sentences.zh: 各宗教領袖為世界和平聯評座談上，與會者分享了他們對和平的願景與計劃。
sentences.en: At the Forum on World Peace with the Religious Leaders, participants shared their visions and plans for peace.

sentences.zh: 這次各宗教領袖為世界和平聯評座談，非常重要，因為它促進了跨宗教的理解和交流。
sentences.en: This Forum on World Peace with the Religious Leaders was very important as it promoted interfaith understanding and dialogue.

phrase.en: Fo Guang Shan Through the Eyes of the World

sentences.zh: 各界人士看佛光山，無不感嘆其莊嚴與宏大。
sentences.en: Fo Guang Shan through the eyes of the world, everyone is struck by its grandeur and solemnity.

sentences.zh: 從學者到遊客，各界人士看佛光山，都能感受到一種深厚的宗教氛圍。
sentences.en: From scholars to tourists, Fo Guang Shan through the eyes of the world, one can feel the profound religious atmosphere.

sentences.zh: 各界人士看佛光山，常能體驗到佛教文化的博大精深。
sentences.en: Fo Guang Shan through the eyes of the world allows one to experience the profound and intricate Buddhist culture.

sentences.zh: 各界人士看佛光山，都表示這裡是尋求內心平靜和啟迪的理想場所。
sentences.en: Fo Guang Shan through the eyes of the world, many express that it is an ideal place for seeking inner peace and enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 在佛教儀式中，信徒們會將雙手合十表示恭敬和虔誠。
sentences.en: During Buddhist rituals, devotees join their palms to show respect and devotion.

sentences.zh: 他在見到師父時，合十向師父行禮，表示敬意。
sentences.en: He joined his palms and bowed to the master as a sign of respect when he met him.

sentences.zh: 合十是一種古老的手勢，代表著祈禱和祝福。
sentences.en: Joined palms is an ancient gesture representing prayer and blessings.

sentences.zh: 禪修時，大家通常會合十來集中精神和心念。
sentences.en: During meditation, people often join their palms to focus their mind and intention.

phrase.en: to bring the ten fingers or two palms together

sentences.zh: 進入佛寺時，人們通常會合十，以表示對佛的恭敬。
sentences.en: Upon entering the temple, people usually bring their ten fingers or two palms together to show respect to the Buddha.

sentences.zh: 在禪修開始前，導師要求所有參加者合十，集中精神。
sentences.en: Before beginning the meditation session, the instructor asked all participants to bring their ten fingers or two palms together and focus their minds.

sentences.zh: 孩子在觀音像前合十，虔誠地祈禱家庭平安。
sentences.en: The child brought his ten fingers or two palms together in front of the statue of Guanyin, sincerely praying for family peace.

sentences.zh: 禮佛時，我們經常雙手合十，以表達內心的虔敬。
sentences.en: When worshipping Buddha, we often bring our two palms together to express our inner devotion.

sentences.zh: 他過著合十人生，時刻以慈悲之心對待他人。
sentences.en: He leads a life of joined palms, always treating others with compassion.

sentences.zh: 合十人生代表著和平與敬意的生活態度。
sentences.en: A life of joined palms represents an attitude of peace and respect.

sentences.zh: 修行者追求合十人生，以祈求內心的平靜與智慧。
sentences.en: Practitioners seek a life of joined palms to attain inner peace and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，合十人生意味著對一切眾生的無限關懷。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, a life of joined palms signifies boundless care for all sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 每年新年，我們都會舉辦一次合家歡，讓所有家人共聚一堂。
sentences.en: Every New Year, we hold a joyful family reunion, bringing all our family members together.

sentences.zh: 中秋節是我們家最重要的節日之一，也是一個合家歡的好機會。
sentences.en: The Mid-Autumn Festival is one of the most important holidays for our family and a great opportunity for a joyful family reunion.

sentences.zh: 這個周末我們計劃一次合家歡，大家可以一起享用豐盛的晚餐。
sentences.en: We are planning a joyful family reunion this weekend, where everyone can enjoy a sumptuous dinner together.

sentences.zh: 在祖父母的七十大壽時，我們全家人都參加了這個特別的合家歡。
sentences.en: For our grandparents' seventieth birthday, the entire family gathered for this special joyful family reunion.

phrases.zh: 合抱之木 生於幼苗
phrases.en: A giant tree comes from tiny sprouts.

phrases.zh: 穿石之水 始於涓滴
phrases.en: Water that wears through rock comes from a stream of droplets.

phrases.zh: 成功之基 奠於勤勞
phrases.en: Success comes from a foundation built by diligence.

phrases.zh: 悟道之緣 在於用心
phrases.en: Conditions for awakening come from commitment.

sentences.zh: 合抱之木 生於幼苗，只有悉心照料，才能長成參天大樹。
sentences.en: A giant tree comes from tiny sprouts, and only through careful nurturing can it grow into a towering tree.

sentences.zh: 偌大一棵合抱之木 生於幼苗，所以不要忽視每一個細小的進步。
sentences.en: A giant tree comes from tiny sprouts, so never overlook the significance of each small step forward.

sentences.zh: 他深信合抱之木 生於幼苗的道理，開始一步步建立自己的事業。
sentences.en: He firmly believes that a giant tree comes from tiny sprouts, and he began to build his business step by step.

sentences.zh: 成功就像合抱之木 生於幼苗，只要努力不懈，終會有所成就。
sentences.en: Success is like a giant tree that comes from tiny sprouts; with persistent effort, achievements will surely follow.

sentences.zh: 穿石之水 始於涓滴，即使是最小的努力也能帶來巨大的改變。
sentences.en: Water that wears through rock comes from a stream of droplets; even the smallest efforts can bring about significant change.

sentences.zh: 他姐姐常用穿石之水 始於涓滴的話來鼓勵他持之以恆。
sentences.en: His sister often uses the phrase 'water that wears through rock comes from a stream of droplets' to encourage him to persevere.

sentences.zh: 穿石之水 始於涓滴，這啟示我們每個小步都至關重要。
sentences.en: Water that wears through rock comes from a stream of droplets, reminding us that every small step is crucial.

sentences.zh: 她相信穿石之水 始於涓滴，每天都在為達到目標而持續努力。
sentences.en: She believes that water that wears through rock comes from a stream of droplets and continues to work towards her goals every day.

sentences.zh: 成功之基 奠於勤勞，只要不懈努力，就能攀登巔峰。
sentences.en: Success comes from a foundation built by diligence; with relentless effort, one can reach the pinnacle.

sentences.zh: 他的畢生信念是成功之基 奠於勤勞，一直以來，他兢兢業業，不曾懈怠。
sentences.en: His lifelong belief is that success comes from a foundation built by diligence; he has always been diligent and never wavered.

sentences.zh: 這位企業家的成功故事證明了成功之基 奠於勤勞。
sentences.en: The success story of this entrepreneur proves that success comes from a foundation built by diligence.

sentences.zh: 她深知成功之基 奠於勤勞，竭盡所能地工作以實現自己的夢想。
sentences.en: She knows that success comes from a foundation built by diligence and works tirelessly to achieve her dreams.

sentences.zh: 悟道之緣 在於用心，只有全神貫注，才能領悟人生的真諦。
sentences.en: Conditions for awakening come from commitment; only through wholehearted focus can one grasp the true essence of life.

sentences.zh: 老師常說悟道之緣 在於用心，勉勵我們每天靜心修行。
sentences.en: The teacher often says that conditions for awakening come from commitment, encouraging us to practice mindfully every day.

sentences.zh: 她在冥想中體會到悟道之緣 在於用心，每一次呼吸都變得更加深刻。
sentences.en: She realized during meditation that conditions for awakening come from commitment; every breath became more profound.

sentences.zh: 悟道之緣 在於用心，這讓他每天都更加專注於自己的內心世界。
sentences.en: Conditions for awakening come from commitment, which made him more focused on his inner world each day.

sentences.zh: 佛教信徒常在禮佛時合掌，以表敬意和虔誠。
sentences.en: Buddhist practitioners often join palms when paying homage to the Buddha, symbolizing respect and devotion.

sentences.zh: 在聖誕節的彌撒上，信徒們合掌祈禱，感恩上帝的恩典。
sentences.en: During the Christmas mass, parishioners join palms in prayer, expressing gratitude for God's grace.

sentences.zh: 在國際會議上，代表們合掌致意，象徵和平與友誼。
sentences.en: At the international conference, delegates joined palms as a gesture of peace and friendship.

sentences.zh: 合掌是一種全球通用的手勢，廣泛用於表達尊重、祈禱或感恩。
sentences.en: Joining palms is a universally recognized gesture, widely used to express respect, prayer, or gratitude.

sentences.zh: 他過著合掌人生，每天都在感恩和祈禱中度過。
sentences.en: He leads a life of joined palms, spending each day in gratitude and prayer.

sentences.zh: 合掌人生是一種以和諧和慈悲為基礎的生活方式。
sentences.en: A life of joined palms is a way of living founded on harmony and compassion.

sentences.zh: 選擇合掌人生，使我能夠與他人和自然保持靈性的聯繫。
sentences.en: Choosing a life of joined palms enables me to maintain a spiritual connection with others and nature.

sentences.zh: 他說，保持合掌人生讓他感受到無比的心靈平靜與祥和。
sentences.en: He said that maintaining a life of joined palms gives him immense inner peace and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 這是一個吉日，適合開始新的企業或推出新的產品。
sentences.en: This is an auspicious day, suitable for starting a new business or launching a new product.

sentences.zh: 在婚禮上，人們通常會選擇吉祥的日子，希望給新婚夫婦帶來幸福和繁榮。
sentences.en: At weddings, people typically choose an auspicious day, hoping to bring happiness and prosperity to the newlyweds.

sentences.zh: 傳統上，人們會在吉日舉行搬家儀式，以確保未來的生活幸福順遂。
sentences.en: Traditionally, people hold moving ceremonies on auspicious days to ensure a happy and smooth future life.

sentences.zh: 新年被認為是一個特別吉利的時期，許多人相信這段時間內做任何事情都會成功。
sentences.en: The New Year is considered a particularly auspicious time, with many believing that endeavors undertaken during this period will be successful.

phrase.zh: 吉星明月歸天上 白雲春風在眼前
phrase.en: Auspicious stars and the bright moon belong in the sky; White clouds and spring breezes are found before your eyes.

sentences.zh: 在寧靜的夜晚，仰望星空，總讓人不禁感嘆吉星明月歸天上，白雲春風在眼前的美景。
sentences.en: On a tranquil night, gazing at the starry sky always makes one marvel at the beauty where auspicious stars and the bright moon belong in the sky; white clouds and spring breezes are found before your eyes.

sentences.zh: 老人坐在庭院中，微笑著說：'吉星明月歸天上，白雲春風在眼前，這世間真是美好無比。'
sentences.en: The old man sat in the courtyard, smiling and saying: 'Auspicious stars and the bright moon belong in the sky; white clouds and spring breezes are found before your eyes. This world is truly beautiful.'

sentences.zh: 靜心閱讀佛經時，彷彿可以感受到吉星明月歸天上，白雲春風在眼前的平和心境。
sentences.en: When calmly reading the Buddhist scriptures, it feels as if one can sense the serene state where auspicious stars and the bright moon belong in the sky; white clouds and spring breezes are found before your eyes.

sentences.zh: 旅行途中，她感受到了大自然的奧秘和詩意，心中浮現出'吉星明月歸天上，白雲春風在眼前'的景象。
sentences.en: During her travels, she felt the mystery and poetry of nature, with the image of 'auspicious stars and the bright moon belong in the sky; white clouds and spring breezes are found before your eyes' coming to her mind.

phrase.zh: 吉星明月歸天上 白雲清風在眼前
phrase.en: Auspicious stars and the bright moon belong in the sky; White clouds and soothing breezes are found before your eyes.

sentences.zh: 當夜晚來臨，吉星明月歸天上，白雲清風在眼前，一切都顯得如此祥和美麗。
sentences.en: When night falls, auspicious stars and the bright moon belong in the sky; white clouds and soothing breezes are found before your eyes, creating a serene and beautiful scene.

sentences.zh: 在人生的旅途中，我們應該像吉星明月歸天上，白雲清風在眼前一樣，保持心靈的平靜與祥和。
sentences.en: On the journey of life, we should keep our minds as peaceful and serene as auspicious stars and the bright moon belonging in the sky, white clouds and soothing breezes found before our eyes.

sentences.zh: 這座古廟依山而建，廟前吉星明月歸天上，白雲清風在眼前，景色如詩如畫。
sentences.en: This ancient temple is built against the mountain, with auspicious stars and the bright moon belonging in the sky, white clouds and soothing breezes before your eyes, creating a picturesque view.

sentences.zh: 隨著夜幕的降臨，吉星明月歸天上，白雲清風在眼前，我不禁感受到大自然的寧靜與美好。
sentences.en: As night falls, auspicious stars and the bright moon belong in the sky; white clouds and soothing breezes are found before your eyes, making me feel the tranquility and beauty of nature.

phrase.zh: 吉星明月歸天上 白雲青松在眼前
phrase.en: Auspicious stars and the bright moon belong in the sky; White clouds and green pines are found before your eyes.

sentences.zh: 當你抬頭仰望，吉星明月歸天上，而當你低頭看，自有白雲青松在眼前。
sentences.en: When you look up, the auspicious stars and the bright moon belong in the sky; but when you look down, white clouds and green pines are found before your eyes.

sentences.zh: 在這靜謐的夜晚，吉星明月歸天上，而周圍的白雲青松在眼前，令人心生安詳。
sentences.en: In this tranquil night, auspicious stars and the bright moon belong in the sky, while white clouds and green pines are found before your eyes, bringing a sense of peace.

sentences.zh: 在這片美麗的山谷中，吉星明月歸天上，白雲青松在眼前，景色無比壯麗。
sentences.en: In this beautiful valley, auspicious stars and the bright moon belong in the sky; white clouds and green pines are found before your eyes, creating a magnificent view.

sentences.zh: 晚上露營時，我們看到吉星明月歸天上，四周則是白雲青松在眼前，感受到大自然的和諧。
sentences.en: While camping at night, we saw auspicious stars and the bright moon in the sky; white clouds and green pines were found before our eyes, feeling the harmony of nature.

sentences.zh: 新年伊始，我們祝願大家吉星高照，好運連連。
sentences.en: At the beginning of the new year, we wish everyone an auspicious star shining high above and good luck in abundance.

sentences.zh: 在他的婚禮上，長輩們都祝福他吉星高照，婚姻幸福。
sentences.en: At his wedding, the elders blessed him with an auspicious star shining high above and a happy marriage.

sentences.zh: 當我們搬進新家時，鄰居們贈送賀禮並祝我們一家吉星高照。
sentences.en: When we moved into our new home, the neighbors gave us gifts and wished our family with an auspicious star shining high above.

sentences.zh: 她堅信，只要保持正念，生活中就會有吉星高照。
sentences.en: She firmly believes that as long as one maintains positive mindfulness, there will be an auspicious star shining high above in life.

phrase.zh: 吉星高照 好運會到
phrase.en: Auspicious Star Shining High Above; Good Luck Is Coming Soon

sentences.zh: 每當新年來臨，我們都希望吉星高照，好運會到。
sentences.en: Every time the new year arrives, we hope that the auspicious star is shining high above and good luck is coming soon.

sentences.zh: 在這個充滿困難的時期，他仍然相信吉星高照，好運會到。
sentences.en: During this challenging time, he still believes that the auspicious star is shining high above and good luck is coming soon.

sentences.zh: 只要我們保持正念，吉星高照，好運會到。
sentences.en: As long as we maintain a positive mindset, the auspicious star will be shining high above and good luck will be coming soon.

sentences.zh: 她說吉星高照，好運會到，讓大家感到更加放心。
sentences.en: She said that the auspicious star is shining high above and good luck is coming soon, which made everyone feel more at ease.

phrase.zh: 吉星高照 福滿家園
phrase.en: Auspicious Star Shining High Above; May There Be Happiness in the Family

sentences.zh: 新年到了，我們祝願每個家庭都能吉星高照，福滿家園。
sentences.en: As the New Year arrives, we wish for every family to have an auspicious star shining high above, and happiness in the home.

sentences.zh: 在這個特別的節日裡，讓我們祈禱吉星高照，福滿家園。
sentences.en: During this special holiday, let us pray for an auspicious star shining high above and happiness in the family.

sentences.zh: 婚禮上，長輩們祝福新人吉星高照，福滿家園。
sentences.en: At the wedding, the elders blessed the newlyweds with an auspicious star shining high above, and happiness in their family.

sentences.zh: 爺爺每次過年都會說，希望來年吉星高照，福滿家園。
sentences.en: Every New Year, grandpa would say he hopes for an auspicious star shining high above and happiness in the family in the coming year.

phrase.zh: 吉星高照 萬事吉祥
phrase.en: Auspicious Star Shining High Above; May Everything Be Auspicious

sentences.zh: 新年伊始，祝你吉星高照，萬事吉祥。
sentences.en: As the new year begins, may the auspicious star shine high above, and may everything be auspicious for you.

sentences.zh: 在這個特別的節日里，我希望你家庭和睦，吉星高照，萬事吉祥。
sentences.en: On this special holiday, I wish for your family to be harmonious, with the auspicious star shining high above, and may everything be auspicious.

sentences.zh: 過生日的時候，朋友們祝我吉星高照，萬事吉祥。
sentences.en: On my birthday, my friends wished me an auspicious star shining high above and that everything may be auspicious.

sentences.zh: 搬進新家之際，希望你們吉星高照，萬事吉祥，福氣滿滿。
sentences.en: Moving into the new house, I hope the auspicious star shines high above and everything be auspicious, bringing you abundant blessings.

sentences.zh: 在新年的慶祝活動中，人們會相互祝福吉祥如意。
sentences.en: During the New Year celebrations, people wish each other auspicious blessings and good fortune.

sentences.zh: 這座寺廟以其吉祥的氛圍和美麗的建築而聞名。
sentences.en: This temple is renowned for its auspicious atmosphere and beautiful architecture.

sentences.zh: 他們選擇了一個吉祥的日子舉行婚禮，希望未來充滿幸福和美滿。
sentences.en: They chose an auspicious day for their wedding, hoping their future would be filled with happiness and harmony.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒經常祈求吉祥的加持，以保佑他們的日常生活和修行之路。
sentences.en: Buddhists often pray for auspicious blessings to protect their daily lives and spiritual practice.

sentences.zh: 這座寺廟建築在一片吉祥地上，自古以來就象徵著和平與繁榮。
sentences.en: This temple was built on an auspicious land, symbolizing peace and prosperity since ancient times.

sentences.zh: 聖人大師選擇了這片吉祥地來修行，希望能更接近悟道的境界。
sentences.en: The revered master chose this auspicious land for his practice, hoping to come closer to the state of enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 在人們的心目中，吉祥地是一個充滿祝福和靈性的地方，吸引了無數信徒前來朝拜。
sentences.en: In people's minds, the auspicious land is a place full of blessings and spirituality, attracting countless devotees for pilgrimage.

sentences.zh: 傳說這片吉祥地由佛祖親自加持，讓一切修行者都能在此獲得心靈的平靜。
sentences.en: It is said that this auspicious land was blessed by Buddha himself, allowing all practitioners to find inner peace here.

sentences.zh: 許多人每天早上誦念吉祥經，以期望帶來好運和平安。
sentences.en: Many people recite the Mangala Sutra every morning to bring good fortune and peace.

sentences.zh: 吉祥經是一部佛經，探討什麼是真正的吉祥與幸福。
sentences.en: The Mangala Sutra is a Buddhist scripture that explores what true auspiciousness and happiness are.

sentences.zh: 誦讀吉祥經的儀式在節日期間尤為盛大，吸引了大量信徒參加。
sentences.en: The recitation of the Mangala Sutra is especially grand during festivals, attracting a large number of devotees.

sentences.zh: 在佛教寺院中，僧侶往往會帶領信徒們共同誦念吉祥經，分享智慧和祝福。
sentences.en: In Buddhist temples, monks often lead the followers in reciting the Mangala Sutra, sharing wisdom and blessings.

sentences.zh: 寺院的庭園裡種滿了吉祥草，象徵著祥瑞和平。
sentences.en: The garden of the temple is filled with Auspicious Grass, symbolizing good fortune and peace.

sentences.zh: 信徒們在佛前敬奉吉祥草，祈求吉祥安康。
sentences.en: The devotees offer Auspicious Grass before the Buddha, praying for good luck and well-being.

sentences.zh: 在佛教儀式中，吉祥草常常被用來裝飾壇場，增添神聖氛圍。
sentences.en: In Buddhist ceremonies, Auspicious Grass is often used to decorate the altar, enhancing the sacred atmosphere.

sentences.zh: 傳說吉祥草具有驅邪辟災的神奇力量，因此深受信徒們的敬仰。
sentences.en: Legend has it that Auspicious Grass possesses the magical power to ward off evil and disasters, thus it is highly revered by followers.

phrase.en: Perfect the Seeds of Wisdom Together

sentences.zh: 我們應當同圓種智，努力在修行中互相幫助，共同提升智慧。
sentences.en: We should perfect the seeds of wisdom together, striving to assist each other in practice and collectively enhance our wisdom.

sentences.zh: 通過討論學習佛法，我們能夠同圓種智，共同邁向解脫之道。
sentences.en: By discussing and learning the Dharma, we can perfect the seeds of wisdom together, advancing collectively towards the path of liberation.

sentences.zh: 師父經常告誡我們，要同圓種智，互相扶持，才能在修行路上走得更遠。
sentences.en: The master often advises us to perfect the seeds of wisdom together, supporting one another to travel further on the path of practice.

sentences.zh: 在這個團體中，我們同圓種智，無論遇到什麼困難都能一同面對。
sentences.en: In this community, we perfect the seeds of wisdom together, facing any challenges we encounter as one.

sentences.zh: 他們夫妻二人同心同德，共同面對生活中的挑戰。
sentences.en: The husband and wife, with the same mind and same virtue, faced life's challenges together.

sentences.zh: 只有全體成員同心同德，這個團隊才能在比賽中取得勝利。
sentences.en: Only with everyone having the same mind and same virtue can the team achieve victory in the competition.

sentences.zh: 我們的社會需要大家同心同德，才能克服目前的困難。
sentences.en: Our society needs everyone to have the same mind and same virtue in order to overcome the current difficulties.

sentences.zh: 在這次疫情中，醫護人員和志願者同心同德，拯救了無數的生命。
sentences.en: During the pandemic, healthcare workers and volunteers, with the same mind and same virtue, saved countless lives.

sentences.zh: 修行者們以共同的心願與精進，期望同登法界，實現最終的覺悟。
sentences.en: Practitioners, with a shared aspiration and diligence, hope to reach the gateway to enlightenment and achieve ultimate awakening.

sentences.zh: 這本佛教經典詳細描述了如何通過智慧和慈悲，同登法界，達到清淨無染的境界。
sentences.en: This Buddhist scripture provides detailed instructions on how to reach the gateway to enlightenment through wisdom and compassion, achieving a state of purity and clarity.

sentences.zh: 在這個法會上，眾人祈願同登法界，以期心靈的解脫和安寧。
sentences.en: During the ceremony, everyone prayed to reach the gateway to enlightenment, seeking spiritual liberation and peace.

sentences.zh: 修禪者不分年齡和背景，只要心懷真誠，都能同登法界，體證真理。
sentences.en: Zen practitioners, regardless of age or background, can reach the gateway to enlightenment as long as they hold sincerity in their hearts and realize the truth.

sentences.zh: 大師期望人人都能同登法界，實現內心的真正解脫。
sentences.en: The master hopes that everyone can ascend with the Dharma Realm, achieving true liberation in their hearts.

sentences.zh: 在佛教修行中，同登法界意味著達到靈性的至高境界。
sentences.en: In Buddhist practice, to ascend with the Dharma Realm means reaching the highest level of spirituality.

sentences.zh: 修行者通過持續的打坐和誦經，希望有一天能夠同登法界。
sentences.en: Through continuous meditation and recitation of the sutras, practitioners hope to one day ascend with the Dharma Realm.

sentences.zh: 法會中，師父鼓勵在座信眾一起努力，共同同登法界。
sentences.en: During the Dharma assembly, the master encouraged the attendees to work together and collectively ascend with the Dharma Realm.

phrase.zh: 名位謙讓為先 生活儉樸為重 處眾服務為本 心胸寬廣為要
phrase.en: Humility comes before fame. Diligence and frugality are the core of life. Service is the basis of fellowship. Magnanimity is the key to a peaceful mind.

sentences.zh: 名位謙讓為先，在任何成就面前，我都謙虛待人，從不驕傲。
sentences.en: Humility comes before fame; I remain humble in the face of any achievement, never becoming arrogant.

sentences.zh: 生活儉樸為重，我每天都盡量簡單地生活，節省資源。
sentences.en: Diligence and frugality are the core of life; I strive to live simply every day, conserving resources.

sentences.zh: 處眾服務為本，在社區活動中，我總是優先考慮如何服務他人。
sentences.en: Service is the basis of fellowship; in community activities, I always prioritize how to serve others.

sentences.zh: 心胸寬廣為要，面對人生的困難，我保持樂觀和大度。
sentences.en: Magnanimity is the key to a peaceful mind; facing life's difficulties, I maintain optimism and magnanimity.

zh: 名利看不破 道德難增長
私情放不下 事功難建立
en: One cannot grow morally without seeing beyond fame and gain
One cannot be accomplished without transcending personal matters

sentences.zh: 如果名利看不破，道德難增長，你的修行便會停滯不前。
sentences.en: If one cannot see beyond fame and gain, moral growth will stagnate, halting one’s spiritual practice.

sentences.zh: 他多次強調，名利看不破，道德難增長，這是修行者應該謹記的教誨。
sentences.en: He repeatedly emphasized that one cannot grow morally without seeing beyond fame and gain; this is a teaching all practitioners should remember.

sentences.zh: 私情放不下，事功難建立，個人情感往往成為邁向成功的絆腳石。
sentences.en: One cannot be accomplished without transcending personal matters; personal emotions often become stumbling blocks on the path to success.

sentences.zh: 她明白私情放不下，事功難建立，於是決心克服內心的情感糾結，專注於事業目標。
sentences.en: She understood that one cannot be accomplished without transcending personal matters, so she resolved to overcome her emotional entanglements and focus on her career goals.

phrase.zh: 名士志四海 古人惜寸陰
phrase.en: The noble man sets his heart on the world; The ancient sages set their minds on time.

sentences.zh: 名士志四海，胸懷寬廣，願為天下百姓謀福利。
sentences.en: The noble man sets his heart on the world, harboring vast ambitions to work for the welfare of all people.

sentences.zh: 古人惜寸陰，珍惜每一個片刻，不浪費光陰。
sentences.en: The ancient sages set their minds on time, treasuring every moment and not wasting a single second.

sentences.zh: 名士志四海，在動亂時期挺身而出，為國家和人民盡忠報國。
sentences.en: The noble man sets his heart on the world, stepping forward in times of turmoil to serve his country and people wholeheartedly.

sentences.zh: 古人惜寸陰，以勤勉著稱，終成就驚人的事業。
sentences.en: The ancient sages set their minds on time, known for their diligence, eventually achieving remarkable feats.

phrase.zh: 名士志四海 浩氣養乾坤
phrase.en: The noble man sets his heart on the world; Nurturing the universe with awe-inspiring virtue.

sentences.zh: 名士志四海，浩氣養乾坤，他的胸懷寬廣，胸襟高尚。
sentences.en: The noble man sets his heart on the world; nurturing the universe with awe-inspiring virtue, he possesses a broad mind and high ideals.

sentences.zh: 古代名士志四海，浩氣養乾坤，以他們的德行和智慧引領時代。
sentences.en: Ancient noble men set their hearts on the world; nurturing the universe with awe-inspiring virtue, leading their times with their moral conduct and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 現代領袖也應該效仿名士志四海，浩氣養乾坤，為人類繁榮作出貢獻。
sentences.en: Modern leaders should emulate the noble man setting his heart on the world; nurturing the universe with awe-inspiring virtue, contributing to human prosperity.

sentences.zh: 他胸懷大志，名士志四海，浩氣養乾坤，願為世界和平貢獻一己之力。
sentences.en: He harbors great ambitions, setting his heart on the world as a noble man; nurturing the universe with awe-inspiring virtue, he wishes to contribute to world peace.

phrase.en: Fo Guang Shan's Wall of Plaques on One Hundred Artists and Masters

sentences.zh: 名家百人碑牆展示了來自各地的藝術家和大師的卓越作品。
sentences.en: Fo Guang Shan's Wall of Plaques on One Hundred Artists and Masters showcases excellent works from artists and masters around the world.

sentences.zh: 遊客們在名家百人碑牆前駐足，欣賞這些偉大名字的風采。
sentences.en: Visitors stop in front of Fo Guang Shan's Wall of Plaques on One Hundred Artists and Masters, admiring the brilliance of these great names.

sentences.zh: 名家百人碑牆是佛光山的一大特色，吸引了無數佛教徒和藝術愛好者前來參觀。
sentences.en: Fo Guang Shan's Wall of Plaques on One Hundred Artists and Masters is a major highlight, attracting numerous Buddhists and art enthusiasts.

sentences.zh: 每年，名家百人碑牆都會更新新的大師名字，以表彰他們的貢獻。
sentences.en: Every year, Fo Guang Shan's Wall of Plaques on One Hundred Artists and Masters is updated with new names of masters to honor their contributions.

phrase.en: Reflections on Buddhist Affinity Across 100 Years

sentences.zh: 在《名家看百年佛緣》一書中，眾多學者分享了他們對佛教歷史的深刻見解。
sentences.en: In the book 'Reflections on Buddhist Affinity Across 100 Years,' many scholars share their profound insights on the history of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 這場講座以《名家看百年佛緣》為題，吸引了許多對佛教有興趣的聽眾。
sentences.en: The lecture titled 'Reflections on Buddhist Affinity Across 100 Years' attracted many attendees interested in Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 《名家看百年佛緣》展示了佛教如何在過去一個世紀中影響和塑造全球文化。
sentences.en: 'Reflections on Buddhist Affinity Across 100 Years' showcases how Buddhism has influenced and shaped global culture over the past century.

sentences.zh: 每段《名家看百年佛緣》中提到的故事，都讓現代人更深入了解佛教的精髓與智慧。
sentences.en: Each story mentioned in 'Reflections on Buddhist Affinity Across 100 Years' helps modern people gain a deeper understanding of the essence and wisdom of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 他的努力與智慧終於讓他的公司名聲天曉，贏得了業界的高度評價。
sentences.en: His hard work and intelligence finally earned his company a rising dawn of success, winning high praise in the industry.

sentences.zh: 在經過多年的艱辛奮鬥後，她的事業名聲天曉，成為了眾人仰慕的典範。
sentences.en: After years of hard struggle, her career saw a rising dawn of success, becoming a model admired by many.

sentences.zh: 他的創新與堅持使這個非營利組織名聲天曉，得到了來自各方的支持與捐贈。
sentences.en: His innovation and perseverance brought a rising dawn of success to the non-profit organization, attracting support and donations from various quarters.

sentences.zh: 電影上映後取得巨大成功，導演和演員們的名聲天曉，成為了全國的焦點。
sentences.en: After the movie's release, it achieved tremendous success, and the director and actors experienced a rising dawn of success, becoming the focus of the entire nation.

sentences.zh: 大學在儀式上授予他名譽院長的稱號，以表彰他對學校做出的傑出貢獻。
sentences.en: The university awarded him the title of Honorary Dean during the ceremony to recognize his outstanding contributions to the school.

sentences.zh: 她被任命為名譽院長，這是對她多年教學和研究工作的高度讚譽。
sentences.en: She was appointed as the Honorary Dean, which was a high commendation for her years of teaching and research work.

sentences.zh: 雖然他是名譽院長，但他仍然積極參與大學的各種活動和計劃。
sentences.en: Although he is the Honorary Dean, he still actively participates in various university activities and programs.

sentences.zh: 名譽院長的職位讓她有更多機會在更高層面上影響教育政策。
sentences.en: The position of Honorary Dean gives her more opportunities to influence educational policies at a higher level.

sentences.zh: 在修行的道路上，無論遇到什麼困難，我們都應該堅信向前有路。
sentences.en: On the path of spiritual practice, no matter what difficulties we encounter, we should firmly believe that we must keep going.

sentences.zh: 老師告訴我們，只要我們努力，向前有路，必定能夠實現自己的夢想。
sentences.en: Our teacher told us that as long as we work hard and keep going, we will definitely be able to achieve our dreams.

sentences.zh: 當生活充滿挑戰時，記住佛陀的教導，向前有路，一切都會好起來的。
sentences.en: When life is full of challenges, remember the Buddha's teachings: keep going, and everything will get better.

sentences.zh: 即使前方的道路充滿了荊棘，只要我們不放棄，向前有路，終會到達目的地。
sentences.en: Even if the road ahead is full of thorns, as long as we do not give up and keep going, we will eventually reach our destination.

phrase.zh: 向受過現代教育的人介紹佛教

sentences.zh: 這本書特別適合向受過現代教育的人介紹佛教，它用現代語言解釋了古老的智慧。
sentences.en: This book is particularly suitable for the introduction to modern day intellectuals to Buddhism, as it explains ancient wisdom in modern language.

sentences.zh: 我們計劃舉辦一系列講座，向受過現代教育的人介紹佛教的基本概念。
sentences.en: We plan to host a series of lectures for an introduction to modern day intellectuals on the fundamental concepts of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 向受過現代教育的人系統地介紹佛教，能夠促進多元文化的理解與融合。
sentences.en: Systematically introducing Buddhism to modern day intellectuals can promote cultural diversity and integration.

sentences.zh: 為了向受過現代教育的人介紹佛教，我們準備了一些視頻和文章，旨在闡明佛教的核心思想。
sentences.en: We have prepared some videos and articles aimed at elucidating the core ideas of Buddhism for the introduction to modern day intellectuals.

sentences.zh: 佛教提倡我們向自己革命，改變心靈的習氣。
sentences.en: Buddhism encourages us to start a self-revolution, changing the habitual tendencies of the mind.

sentences.zh: 她決定向自己革命，徹底改掉拖延的壞習慣。
sentences.en: She decided to start a self-revolution, completely getting rid of her bad habit of procrastination.

sentences.zh: 每一次向自己革命，都是一次心靈的成長。
sentences.en: Every time you start a self-revolution, it is a growth of the mind.

sentences.zh: 他通過向自己革命，找到了真正的內心平靜。
sentences.en: Through starting a self-revolution, he found true inner peace.

sentences.zh: 他有著堅定的向道之心，無論面對多少困難，都不曾動搖。
sentences.en: He has a steadfast commitment to the path, never wavering no matter how many difficulties he faces.

sentences.zh: 在修行的過程中，向道之心是非常重要的，它會指引你走向覺悟的道路。
sentences.en: In the process of cultivation, a commitment to the path is very important, as it guides you towards the road to enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 那位修行多年的僧人一次次地展現了他對向道之心的不懈追求。
sentences.en: The monk, who has practiced for many years, has repeatedly demonstrated his relentless commitment to the path.

sentences.zh: 儘管生活充滿挑戰，他始終保持向道之心，勇敢面對種種考驗。
sentences.en: Despite the challenges of life, he maintains his commitment to the path, bravely facing various trials.

phrase.zh: 君來問道無餘說 雲在青天水在瓶
phrase.en: Not much to be said on your question about the Way; The clouds are up in the sky and water in the vase.

sentences.zh: 當你來問道時，我沒有更多的話要說，因為雲在青天水在瓶，這一切已經自有答案。
sentences.en: When you came asking about the Way, I had nothing more to say, as the clouds are up in the sky and the water in the vase, forming their own answers.

sentences.zh: 師父只是笑笑不語，然後應和道：君來問道無餘說，雲在青天水在瓶。
