sentences.en: Each year, thousands of devotees gather at the National Buddha's Birthday Bathing the Buddha Celebration to participate in the solemn ceremony.

sentences.zh: 長達一週的國定佛誕節浴佛大會包含了誦經、祈禱和浴佛等活動。
sentences.en: The week-long National Buddha's Birthday Bathing the Buddha Celebration includes activities such as chanting, prayers, and bathing the Buddha.

sentences.zh: 許多家長帶著孩子前來參加國定佛誕節浴佛大會，讓孩子們從小就接觸佛教文化。
sentences.en: Many parents bring their children to the National Buddha's Birthday Bathing the Buddha Celebration to expose them to Buddhist culture from a young age.

sentences.zh: 在國定佛誕節浴佛大會上，信徒們會用香花和清水浴佛，象徵著淨化身心。
sentences.en: At the National Buddha's Birthday Bathing the Buddha Celebration, devotees bathe the Buddha with fragrant flowers and clean water, symbolizing the purification of body and mind.

phrase.en: International Triple Platform Full Ordination Ceremony

sentences.zh: 國際三壇大戒戒會每年吸引千名來自各國的求戒者。
sentences.en: The International Triple Platform Full Ordination Ceremony attracts thousands of precept seekers from various countries every year.

sentences.zh: 參加國際三壇大戒戒會的僧人需要經過嚴格的戒律訓練。
sentences.en: Monks participating in the International Triple Platform Full Ordination Ceremony must undergo rigorous disciplinary training.

sentences.zh: 國際三壇大戒戒會是一個重要的佛教儀式，標誌著受戒者的正式出家。
sentences.en: The International Triple Platform Full Ordination Ceremony is a significant Buddhist ritual marking the formal ordination of precept seekers.

sentences.zh: 許多國際信徒特意來到這裡，見證國際三壇大戒戒會的莊嚴儀式。
sentences.en: Many international devotees come specifically to witness the solemn ceremonies of the International Triple Platform Full Ordination Ceremony.

sentences.zh: 每年的國際佛光日，全球佛光山寺廟都會舉行大型祈福法會。
sentences.en: On International Buddha's Light Day each year, Fo Guang Shan temples around the world hold large-scale blessing ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光日是佛教信徒們聚集在一起，弘揚佛法的重要節日。
sentences.en: International Buddha's Light Day is an important occasion for Buddhist followers to gather and promote the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 許多國家都有慶祝國際佛光日的活動，參與人數每年逐漸增加。
sentences.en: Many countries have events to celebrate International Buddha's Light Day, with the number of participants increasing each year.

sentences.zh: 在國際佛光日，信徒們會點亮佛燈，象徵心靈的光明與智慧。
sentences.en: On International Buddha's Light Day, devotees light Buddha lamps, symbolizing the illumination of the mind and wisdom.

phrase.zh: 國際佛光會世界總會會員代表大會

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會世界總會會員代表大會每兩年舉行一次，吸引了來自全球的佛教徒參與。
sentences.en: The BLIA General Conference is held every two years and attracts Buddhists from around the globe.

sentences.zh: 在最近的國際佛光會世界總會會員代表大會上，討論了全球佛教推廣的新策略。
sentences.en: At the recent BLIA General Conference, new strategies for the global promotion of Buddhism were discussed.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會世界總會會員代表大會是一個聯繫全球佛教徒的重要平台。
sentences.en: The BLIA General Conference is an important platform that connects Buddhists worldwide.

sentences.zh: 每位會員代表都期待參加國際佛光會世界總會會員代表大會，以了解最新的動態和倡議。
sentences.en: Each member representative looks forward to attending the BLIA General Conference to stay updated on the latest developments and initiatives.

phrase.zh: 國際佛光會世界總會理事會議
phrase.en: BLIA World Headquarters Board of Directors Meeting

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會世界總會理事會議每年定期舉行，以討論全球弘法事務。
sentences.en: The BLIA World Headquarters Board of Directors Meeting is held annually to discuss global Dharma propagation affairs.

sentences.zh: 在最新一次的國際佛光會世界總會理事會議上，各國代表提出了多項合作計畫。
sentences.en: At the latest BLIA World Headquarters Board of Directors Meeting, representatives from various countries proposed multiple collaborative projects.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會世界總會理事會議通過了新的佛教教育推廣方案，旨在提升全球的佛法認知。
sentences.en: The BLIA World Headquarters Board of Directors Meeting approved a new Buddhist education promotion plan aimed at enhancing global awareness of Dharma.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會世界總會理事會議強調了環保議題，並呼籲全球會員積極參與綠色生活的實踐。
sentences.en: The BLIA World Headquarters Board of Directors Meeting emphasized environmental issues and called on global members to actively engage in the practice of green living.

sentences.zh: 每年的國際佛光會日，來自世界各地的信徒聚集一起，進行隆重的慶祝儀式。
sentences.en: Every year on Buddha's Light Day, devotees from around the world gather to perform grand celebrations.

sentences.zh: 在國際佛光會日，我們特別安排了一系列的講座和工作坊，旨在弘揚佛教文化。
sentences.en: On Buddha's Light Day, we have scheduled a series of lectures and workshops aimed at promoting Buddhist culture.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會日是一個讓人們反思自我、宣揚和平的日子。
sentences.en: Buddha's Light Day is a time for people to reflect on themselves and advocate for peace.

sentences.zh: 今年的國際佛光會日，我們將啟動一個全球善行計劃，以回饋社會。
sentences.en: This year on Buddha's Light Day, we will launch a global goodwill initiative to give back to the community.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光青年會議每年吸引來自全球的年輕佛教徒參加，交流佛學知識和實踐經驗。
sentences.en: The BLIA Young Adult Conference annually attracts young Buddhists from around the world to exchange knowledge and experience in Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 在今年的國際佛光青年會議上，主題是“全球化背景下的佛教適應與發展”。
sentences.en: This year’s BLIA Young Adult Conference focused on the theme 'Adaptation and Development of Buddhism in the Context of Globalization.'

sentences.zh: 許多參加國際佛光青年會議的青年表示，這是一個極好的平台，可以建立新的友誼並深化他們的信仰。
sentences.en: Many young attendees of the BLIA Young Adult Conference expressed that it is an excellent platform to forge new friendships and deepen their faith.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光青年會議通過各種工作坊和討論會幫助青年人學習如何將佛法融入日常生活。
sentences.en: The BLIA Young Adult Conference helps young people learn how to integrate Buddhist teachings into their daily lives through various workshops and discussions.

phrase.zh: 國際佛教促進會大陸弘法探親團

sentences.zh: 國際佛教促進會大陸弘法探親團今年計劃前往多處寺廟進行弘法活動。
sentences.en: The Dharma Propagation and Homecoming Group of the International Buddhist Association plans to visit multiple temples for Dharma activities this year.

sentences.zh: 這次大陸弘法探親團的行程包括參觀歷史悠久的名剎以及聚會。
sentences.en: The itinerary of the Dharma Propagation and Homecoming Group includes visits to historical monasteries and gatherings.

sentences.zh: 國際佛教促進會的會員們非常期待參加大陸弘法探親團，親身體驗佛教文化。
sentences.en: Members of the International Buddhist Association eagerly look forward to joining the Dharma Propagation and Homecoming Group to experience Buddhist culture firsthand.

sentences.zh: 大陸弘法探親團的活動旨在加深海內外佛教徒之間的交流與友誼。
sentences.en: The activities of the Dharma Propagation and Homecoming Group aim to deepen the exchange and friendship among Buddhists worldwide.

sentences.zh: 今年的國際佛教僧伽會議將在日本舉行，來自世界各地的僧侶都會參加。
sentences.en: This year's International Monastic Conference will be held in Japan, with monks from around the world attending.

sentences.zh: 國際佛教僧伽會議旨在促進不同佛教傳統之間的交流與合作。
sentences.en: The International Monastic Conference aims to promote exchange and cooperation between different Buddhist traditions.

sentences.zh: 在國際佛教僧伽會議上，與會者討論了環境保護和慈善事業的重要性。
sentences.en: At the International Monastic Conference, attendees discussed the importance of environmental protection and charitable work.

sentences.zh: 國際佛教僧伽會議的舉辦有助於提升全球佛教社群的凝聚力和影響力。
sentences.en: The convening of the International Monastic Conference helps to enhance the cohesion and influence of the global Buddhist community.

sentences.zh: 今年的國際佛教僧伽研習會主題是世界和平與禪修。
sentences.en: This year's International Monastic Seminar focuses on world peace and meditation.

sentences.zh: 許多著名的高僧將參加即將到來的國際佛教僧伽研習會。
sentences.en: Many renowned monks will attend the upcoming International Monastic Seminar.

sentences.zh: 國際佛教僧伽研習會提供了一個交流佛教思想和實踐的平台。
sentences.en: The International Monastic Seminar provides a platform for exchanging Buddhist thoughts and practices.

sentences.zh: 學生們期待從國際佛教僧伽研習會中學習到更多的佛教智慧。
sentences.en: Students are looking forward to learning more Buddhist wisdom from the International Monastic Seminar.

sentences.zh: 來自世界各地的學者匯聚在國際佛教學術會議上，共同探討佛教理論的各個方面。
sentences.en: Scholars from around the world gathered at the International Buddhist Academic Conference to discuss various aspects of Buddhist theory.

sentences.zh: 國際佛教學術會議提供了寶貴的機會，使人們能夠分享最新的研究成果。
sentences.en: The International Buddhist Academic Conference provided a valuable opportunity for people to share the latest research findings.

sentences.zh: 今年的國際佛教學術會議主題是佛教與現代科技的融合。
sentences.en: The theme of this year's International Buddhist Academic Conference is the integration of Buddhism and modern technology.

sentences.zh: 國際佛教學術會議結束後，與會者們一致認為此次會議促進了不同文化間的學術交流。
sentences.en: After the conclusion of the International Buddhist Academic Conference, the attendees unanimously agreed that the conference promoted academic exchange between different cultures.

sentences.zh: 國際佛教會議每年吸引來自世界各地的學者和僧侶參加。
sentences.en: The International Buddhist Academic Conference annually attracts scholars and monks from around the world.

sentences.zh: 在那次國際佛教會議上，討論了佛教在現代社會中的角色。
sentences.en: At the International Buddhist Academic Conference, the role of Buddhism in modern society was discussed.

sentences.zh: 她在國際佛教會議上發表了一篇有關禪修的論文，受到廣泛好評。
sentences.en: She presented a paper on meditation at the International Buddhist Academic Conference, receiving widespread acclaim.

sentences.zh: 該國際佛教會議旨在促進全球佛教學術交流和思想碰撞。
sentences.en: The International Buddhist Academic Conference aims to promote global Buddhist academic exchange and intellectual engagement.

sentences.zh: 今年的國際佛教論壇將在日本舉行，預計將吸引上千名參與者。
sentences.en: This year's International Buddhist Forum will be held in Japan, and it is expected to attract thousands of participants.

sentences.zh: 在國際佛教論壇上，來自不同國家的僧人將分享他們的修行經驗和智慧。
sentences.en: At the International Buddhist Forum, monks from different countries will share their experiences and wisdom of cultivation.

sentences.zh: 我們的協會計劃派代表參加明年的國際佛教論壇，以促進跨文化交流。
sentences.en: Our association plans to send representatives to attend the International Buddhist Forum next year to promote cross-cultural exchange.

sentences.zh: 國際佛教論壇提供了一個平台，讓來自世界各地的佛教徒能夠交流和協作。
sentences.en: The International Buddhist Forum provides a platform for Buddhists from around the world to interact and collaborate.

sentences.zh: 當我參加國際佛教青年會議時，我結識了來自世界各地的同修。
sentences.en: When I attended the Buddha's Light International Youth Conference, I met Dharma friends from all around the world.

sentences.zh: 國際佛教青年會議的宗旨是培養年輕一代對佛法的了解與實踐。
sentences.en: The Buddha's Light International Youth Conference aims to cultivate an understanding and practice of Dharma among the younger generation.

sentences.zh: 每年的國際佛教青年會議都吸引了數百位來自各地的參加者。
sentences.en: Each year, the Buddha's Light International Youth Conference attracts hundreds of participants from various regions.

sentences.zh: 我在國際佛教青年會議上聽到了許多啟發人心的演講和研討會。
sentences.en: I heard many inspiring talks and participated in workshops at the Buddha's Light International Youth Conference.

sentences.zh: 每年，來自世界各地的高僧和學者聚集在國際僧伽研習會上，分享他們的智慧和經驗。
sentences.en: Each year, renowned monks and scholars from around the world gather at the International Monastic Seminar to share their wisdom and experiences.

sentences.zh: 國際僧伽研習會的議程包括許多討論佛教哲學、冥想技術和社區服務的講座。
sentences.en: The agenda of the International Monastic Seminar includes numerous lectures discussing Buddhist philosophy, meditation techniques, and community service.

sentences.zh: 參加國際僧伽研習會的僧侶們不僅交流思想，還共同修行增進彼此的修為。
sentences.en: Monks attending the International Monastic Seminar not only exchange ideas but also practice together to enhance their spiritual development.

sentences.zh: 這次國際僧伽研習會的主題是“現代世界中的佛教實踐”，吸引了許多年輕的佛教徒參加。
sentences.en: The theme of this year's International Monastic Seminar is 'Buddhist Practice in the Modern World,' attracting many young Buddhists to participate.

phrase.zh: 國際書展暨蔬食博覽會
phrase.en: International Book Fair and Vegetarian Expo

sentences.zh: 今年的國際書展暨蔬食博覽會將在市中心的展覽館舉行，吸引了全球各地的參展者。
sentences.en: This year's International Book Fair and Vegetarian Expo will be held at the downtown exhibition center, attracting participants from around the world.

sentences.zh: 作家和素食廚師將在國際書展暨蔬食博覽會上分享他們的最新作品和食譜。
sentences.en: Authors and vegetarian chefs will share their latest works and recipes at the International Book Fair and Vegetarian Expo.

sentences.zh: 國際書展暨蔬食博覽會是一個結合文化與健康生活方式的盛會，不容錯過。
sentences.en: The International Book Fair and Vegetarian Expo is a grand event that combines culture with a healthy lifestyle and should not be missed.

sentences.zh: 參加國際書展暨蔬食博覽會的觀眾將有機會參加多場講座和烹飪示範。
sentences.en: Attendees of the International Book Fair and Vegetarian Expo will have the opportunity to attend numerous lectures and cooking demonstrations.

sentences.zh: 今年的國際禪學會議將在京都舉行，來自世界各地的學者將齊聚一堂。
sentences.en: This year's International Conference on Chan Buddhism will be held in Kyoto, bringing together scholars from around the world.

sentences.zh: 在國際禪學會議上，他們討論了現代社會中禪修的應用和挑戰。
sentences.en: At the International Conference on Chan Buddhism, they discussed the applications and challenges of Chan practice in modern society.

sentences.zh: 國際禪學會議的開幕式中，有多位著名禪師和佛教學者發表演講。
sentences.en: During the opening ceremony of the International Conference on Chan Buddhism, several renowned Chan masters and Buddhist scholars gave speeches.

sentences.zh: 國際禪學會議的籌備工作需要數個月，這是一個規模宏大的學術活動。
sentences.en: The preparations for the International Conference on Chan Buddhism took several months, marking it as a significant academic event.

sentences.zh: 今年的國際素食博覽會將吸引來自全世界的參展商和訪客。
sentences.en: This year's International Vegetarian & Organic Food Festival will attract exhibitors and visitors from around the world.

sentences.zh: 在國際素食博覽會上，我們可以品嘗到各種美味的素食和有機食品。
sentences.en: At the International Vegetarian & Organic Food Festival, we can sample various delicious vegetarian and organic foods.

sentences.zh: 國際素食博覽會提供了自然健康飲食的最新趨勢和資訊。
sentences.en: The International Vegetarian & Organic Food Festival offers the latest trends and information on natural healthy eating.

sentences.zh: 許多知名的廚師和營養專家將會在國際素食博覽會上進行講座和示範。
sentences.en: Many renowned chefs and nutrition experts will give lectures and demonstrations at the International Vegetarian & Organic Food Festival.

phrase.en: International Triple Platform Full Ordination Ceremony

sentences.zh: 是一個希望成為僧侶的個人參加的國際萬緣三壇大戒的重要時刻。
sentences.en: It is a significant moment for individuals aspiring to become monks to participate in the International Triple Platform Full Ordination Ceremony.

sentences.zh: 每年，成千上萬的人來到寺廟參加國際萬緣三壇大戒。
sentences.en: Every year, thousands of people come to the temple to take part in the International Triple Platform Full Ordination Ceremony.

sentences.zh: 國際萬緣三壇大戒包括受持戒律、學習佛教經典和參加佛教儀式。
sentences.en: The International Triple Platform Full Ordination Ceremony includes taking vows, studying Buddhist scriptures, and participating in Buddhist rituals.

sentences.zh: 國際萬緣三壇大戒提供了一個深入了解佛教教義和實踐的機會。
sentences.en: The International Triple Platform Full Ordination Ceremony provides an opportunity to deeply understand Buddhist doctrines and practices.

sentences.zh: 佛教經典常常圍繞著智慧和慈悲的核心教義。
sentences.en: Buddhist scriptures often surround the core teachings of wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 他的生活似乎始終被各種問題所圍繞，但他依然保持平靜。
sentences.en: His life always seemed to be surrounded by various problems, yet he remained calm.

sentences.zh: 禪修的過程中，一切雜念都會被心靈的寧靜所圍繞。
sentences.en: During meditation, all distracting thoughts are surrounded by the peace of the mind.

sentences.zh: 在佛塔基座周圍，人們圍繞著遶塔禮拜，表達他們的虔誠。
sentences.en: Around the base of the pagoda, people surround it to perform circumambulation, expressing their devotion.

sentences.zh: 佛陀圓寂後，他的弟子們繼續弘揚他的教誨。
sentences.en: After the Buddha's perfect rest, his disciples continued to spread his teachings.

sentences.zh: 法師在圓寂之前留下了許多寶貴的佛法經典。
sentences.en: Before the master entered into perfect rest, he left behind many valuable Buddhist scriptures.

sentences.zh: 每年在法師圓寂紀念日，信徒們都會聚集一起緬懷他的功德。
sentences.en: Every year on the anniversary of the master's perfect rest, followers gather to commemorate his virtues.

sentences.zh: 他們認為圓寂是一種超越世間痛苦的解脫。
sentences.en: They believe that perfect rest is a liberation transcending worldly suffering.

sentences.zh: 他在佛法的修行中達到了圓滿的境界。
sentences.en: He has attained the state of perfection in his Buddhist practice.

sentences.zh: 這幅畫的每一筆都表現出藝術家的圓滿造詣。
sentences.en: Every stroke in this painting demonstrates the artist's perfection in skill.

sentences.zh: 圓滿的一生並不靠外在的成就，而在於內心的平和與滿足。
sentences.en: A perfect life is not based on external achievements but on inner peace and contentment.

sentences.zh: 通過不斷的修煉和反思，他最終取得了精神上的圓滿。
sentences.en: Through continuous practice and reflection, he eventually achieved spiritual perfection.

sentences.zh: 在圓滿七佛事法會期間，信徒們每天都會誦經祈福。
sentences.en: During the Final Seven-Day Period Chanting Service, devotees chant scriptures and offer prayers daily.

sentences.zh: 這次的圓滿七佛事法會為故人祈福，吸引了許多親友前來參加。
sentences.en: The Final Seven-Day Period Chanting Service for the deceased attracted many friends and relatives to participate.

sentences.zh: 圓滿七佛事法會結束後，大家感受到了一種深刻的平靜和慰藉。
sentences.en: After the Final Seven-Day Period Chanting Service ended, everyone felt a deep sense of peace and solace.

sentences.zh: 寺廟的住持在圓滿七佛事法會的最後一天進行了莊嚴的祝禱儀式。
sentences.en: The temple's abbot conducted a solemn blessing ceremony on the last day of the Final Seven-Day Period Chanting Service.

sentences.zh: 他透過修行達到了圓滿自在的境界，每一天都過得心靈充實。
sentences.en: Through practice, he reached a state of wholeness and freeness, living each day with a sense of fulfillment.

sentences.zh: 這部經文教導我們如何在日常生活中實現圓滿自在。
sentences.en: The scripture teaches us how to achieve wholeness and freeness in our daily lives.

sentences.zh: 當內心充滿平靜和愛，我們才能真正感受到圓滿自在。
sentences.en: When our hearts are filled with peace and love, we can truly experience wholeness and freeness.

sentences.zh: 禪修的目的是為了讓我們達到圓滿自在的狀態，脫離煩惱和束縛。
sentences.en: The purpose of meditation is to help us attain wholeness and freeness, freeing us from troubles and constraints.

sentences.zh: 經過多年的修行，他終於達到了圓滿菩提的境界。
sentences.en: After years of practice, he finally attained the state of Perfected Bodhi Wisdom.

sentences.zh: 圓滿菩提是每一位修行者的終極目標，是修行中最高的智慧。
sentences.en: Perfected Bodhi Wisdom is the ultimate goal for every practitioner, representing the highest wisdom in practice.

sentences.zh: 在佛陀的教導下，弟子們努力追求圓滿菩提，期望能夠解脫生死輪迴。
sentences.en: Under the teachings of the Buddha, disciples strive for Perfected Bodhi Wisdom, hoping to liberate themselves from the cycle of birth and death.

sentences.zh: 只有透過不斷的反思和修行，才能漸漸接近圓滿菩提的境界。
sentences.en: Only through continuous reflection and practice can one gradually approach the state of Perfected Bodhi Wisdom.

phrase.zh: 圓瑛法彙 (圓瑛法師全集)
phrase.en: Complete Collection of Venerable Yuan Ying

sentences.zh: 我最近購買了一套圓瑛法彙 (圓瑛法師全集)，希望能更深入地理解他的教義。
sentences.en: I recently purchased a set of the Complete Collection of Venerable Yuan Ying, hoping to deepen my understanding of his teachings.

sentences.zh: 這本圓瑛法彙 (圓瑛法師全集) 是學習佛法不可多得的寶典。
sentences.en: This Complete Collection of Venerable Yuan Ying is an invaluable resource for studying Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 圖書館新增加了圓瑛法彙 (圓瑛法師全集)，供讀者參考。
sentences.en: The library has recently added the Complete Collection of Venerable Yuan Ying for readers' reference.

sentences.zh: 他每晚都閱讀幾個小時的圓瑛法彙 (圓瑛法師全集)，以尋求心靈的啟示。
sentences.en: He reads the Complete Collection of Venerable Yuan Ying for several hours every night to seek spiritual enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 在佛教修行中，圓融意味著所有心念與行為都達到了一種完美的和諧。
sentences.en: In Buddhist practice, perfect harmony means that all thoughts and actions have achieved a state of perfect coherence.

sentences.zh: 大師的教導總是讓弟子們感受到圓融的智慧與慈悲。
sentences.en: The master's teachings always brought a sense of perfect harmony through wisdom and compassion to the disciples.

sentences.zh: 他的生活理念是達到內外圓融，不僅追求內心的平靜，還注重與他人的和諧共處。
sentences.en: His philosophy of life is to achieve perfect harmony both internally and externally, not only seeking inner peace but also harmonious relationships with others.

sentences.zh: 禪修的目標之一就是達到心靈和身體的圓融，實現完全的平衡。
sentences.en: One of the goals of meditation practice is to attain perfect harmony between mind and body, achieving complete balance.

sentences.zh: 佛陀達到了圓覺，從此解脫輪迴的苦海。
sentences.en: The Buddha attained perfect enlightenment, liberating himself from the sea of suffering in samsara.

sentences.zh: 圓覺的境界是每個修行者最終的目標。
sentences.en: The state of perfect enlightenment is the ultimate goal of every practitioner.

sentences.zh: 他相信通過不斷的修行和冥思，他也能達到圓覺。
sentences.en: He believes that through continuous practice and meditation, he too can achieve perfect enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 圓覺不是僅僅一種智力的體驗，而是徹底的覺醒。
sentences.en: Perfect enlightenment is not merely an intellectual experience, but a profound awakening.

sentences.zh: 《圓覺經》是大乘佛教的重要經典之一，詳細描述了圓滿覺悟的境界。
sentences.en: The Sutra of Complete Enlightenment is one of the important scriptures in Mahayana Buddhism, detailing the state of complete enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 許多學者和修行者通過研讀《圓覺經》來深化對佛法的理解。
sentences.en: Many scholars and practitioners deepen their understanding of the Dharma by studying the Sutra of Complete Enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 《圓覺經》中的教義強調了無我和空性的概念。
sentences.en: The teachings in the Sutra of Complete Enlightenment emphasize concepts of non-self and emptiness.

sentences.zh: 在禪修課程中，導師經常引用《圓覺經》來啟發學生的悟道之路。
sentences.en: In meditation courses, instructors often quote the Sutra of Complete Enlightenment to inspire students on their path to enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 佛教的智慧是圓通的，能夠解答許多生命中的疑問。
sentences.en: The wisdom of Buddhism is universally penetrating, capable of answering many of life's questions.

sentences.zh: 他在修行的過程中達到了心靈的圓通，能夠理解各種哲理。
sentences.en: During his practice, he achieved universally penetrating understanding of different philosophies.

sentences.zh: 圓通的見解讓他在人際關係中更具同理心和包容性。
sentences.en: His universally penetrating insights made him more empathetic and inclusive in his relationships.

sentences.zh: 佛經中提到的圓通智慧，幫助修行者更深刻地領悟宇宙的真理。
sentences.en: The universally penetrating wisdom mentioned in the Buddhist scriptures helps practitioners deeply understand the truths of the universe.

sentences.zh: 他時常以圖利他人的心態來處理業務，贏得了客戶的信賴。
sentences.en: He often handles business with the mindset to give others the advantage, earning the trust of his clients.

sentences.zh: 在團隊合作中，她總是不忘圖利他人，創造了和諧的工作環境。
sentences.en: During teamwork, she never forgets to give others the advantage, creating a harmonious work environment.

sentences.zh: 這位老和尚教導弟子們，要心懷慈悲，時時圖利他人。
sentences.en: The old monk taught his disciples to be compassionate and always give others the advantage.

sentences.zh: 他的領導風格是圖利他人，這使得團隊的士氣和合作精神達到了新的高度。
sentences.en: His leadership style is to give others the advantage, which has elevated the team's morale and spirit of cooperation to new heights.

phrase.zh: 在人間歡喜修行─維摩詰經

sentences.zh: 《在人間歡喜修行─維摩詰經》中講述了維摩詰大士如何在日常生活中修行。
sentences.en: In 'Joyful Realizations: Vimalakirti Sutra', it is described how the layman Vimalakirti practiced in everyday life.

sentences.zh: 這本書《在人間歡喜修行─維摩詰經》提供了許多智慧的指引，適合現代人修行。
sentences.en: The book 'Joyful Realizations: Vimalakirti Sutra' offers much wisdom and guidance suitable for modern practice.

sentences.zh: 我從《在人間歡喜修行─維摩詰經》中學到了如何在繁忙的生活中保持內心的寧靜。
sentences.en: I learned how to maintain inner peace in a busy life from 'Joyful Realizations: Vimalakirti Sutra'.

sentences.zh: 《在人間歡喜修行─維摩詰經》告訴我們，真實的修行不一定要遠離塵世。
sentences.en: 'Joyful Realizations: Vimalakirti Sutra' teaches us that true practice does not necessarily require distancing oneself from the secular world.

phrase.zh: 在人間自在修行─八識講話
phrase.en: Carefree Living: A Commentary on the Eight Consciousnesses

sentences.zh: 《在人間自在修行─八識講話》一書深入解釋了佛教中的八識理論。
sentences.en: The book 'Carefree Living: A Commentary on the Eight Consciousnesses' delves deeply into the Buddhist theory of the eight consciousnesses.

sentences.zh: 透過《在人間自在修行─八識講話》，讀者可以探索如何在日常生活中達到自在的修行。
sentences.en: Through 'Carefree Living: A Commentary on the Eight Consciousnesses,' readers can explore how to achieve carefree practice in daily life.

sentences.zh: 修行者可以從《在人間自在修行─八識講話》一書中學到把握每一個當下的智慧與方法。
sentences.en: Practitioners can learn the wisdom and methods of seizing each moment from the book 'Carefree Living: A Commentary on the Eight Consciousnesses.'

sentences.zh: 《在人間自在修行─八識講話》提供了如何在俗世中修行的實用指南。
sentences.en: The book 'Carefree Living: A Commentary on the Eight Consciousnesses' offers practical guidance on how to practice in the worldly life.

phrase.zh: 在家戒會暨啟建水陸法會

sentences.zh: 每年寺廟都會舉辦在家戒會暨啟建水陸法會，吸引了許多信徒參加。
sentences.en: Every year, the temple holds a Lay Buddhist Precepts Ceremony, attracting many devotees to participate.

sentences.zh: 在家戒會暨啟建水陸法會是提供信眾修行和發願的重要活動。
sentences.en: The Lay Buddhist Precepts Ceremony is an important event for practitioners to cultivate and make vows.

sentences.zh: 很多在家居士期待參加這次的在家戒會暨啟建水陸法會，以加強他們的信仰。
sentences.en: Many lay practitioners look forward to participating in the Lay Buddhist Precepts Ceremony to strengthen their faith.

sentences.zh: 在家戒會暨啟建水陸法會的儀式為信徒們提供了反思和上進的機會。
sentences.en: The rituals of the Lay Buddhist Precepts Ceremony provide an opportunity for believers to reflect and advance spiritually.

phrase.zh: 在欲而無欲 居塵不染塵
phrase.en: In the face of desire, remain desireless; In a house of dust, stay dust-free

sentences.zh: 修行者應該在欲而無欲，居塵不染塵，以保持心靈的清淨。
sentences.en: Practitioners should remain desireless in the face of desire, and stay dust-free in a house of dust, to maintain the purity of their mind.

sentences.zh: 菩薩在繁華的都市中也能在欲而無欲，居塵不染塵，令人欽佩。
sentences.en: Bodhisattvas can stay desireless in the face of desire and dust-free in a house of dust, even in bustling cities, which commands great admiration.

sentences.zh: 他在人生的起伏中，始終堅持在欲而無欲，居塵不染塵，展現了堅定的修行心態。
sentences.en: Throughout the ups and downs of life, he has consistently adhered to being desireless in the face of desire and staying dust-free in a house of dust, demonstrating a steadfast attitude in his practice.

sentences.zh: 我們應該學習在欲而無欲，居塵不染塵，這是達到內心平靜的重要途徑。
sentences.en: We should learn to remain desireless in the face of desire and stay dust-free in a house of dust, as this is a crucial path to achieving inner peace.

sentences.zh: 佛教認為地水火風四大元素構成了物質世界的基礎。
sentences.en: Buddhism believes that Earth, Water, Fire and Wind are the fundamental elements that make up the material world.

sentences.zh: 在禪定中，修行者觀察地水火風的變化，以理解無常的真理。
sentences.en: During meditation, practitioners observe the changes in Earth, Water, Fire and Wind to understand the truth of impermanence.

sentences.zh: 我們的身體也是由地水火風四大元素所組成的，而這些元素始終處於動態平衡中。
sentences.en: Our bodies are also composed of the four elements: Earth, Water, Fire and Wind, which are always in a dynamic balance.

sentences.zh: 古代的醫學理論認為健康依賴於地水火風的和諧運作。
sentences.en: Ancient medical theories held that health depends on the harmonious functioning of Earth, Water, Fire and Wind.

phrase.zh: 地無寒谷春常在 家有芳鄰德不孤
phrase.en: A land free of cold valleys that constantly bathes in Spring, A family with good neighbors is never without virtue.

sentences.zh: 這裡地無寒谷春常在，四季如春，正是一個宜居之地。
sentences.en: Here, a land free of cold valleys that constantly bathes in Spring, feels like an eternal spring, making it a perfect place to live.

sentences.zh: 家有芳鄰德不孤，我們與鄰居之間和睦共處，相互幫助。
sentences.en: A family with good neighbors is never without virtue; we live harmoniously with our neighbors and always help each other.

sentences.zh: 他們的村莊邊界地無寒谷春常在，每個人都享受著大自然的恩賜。
sentences.en: At the village's borders, a land free of cold valleys that constantly bathes in Spring, everyone enjoys the blessings of nature.

sentences.zh: 與好鄰居相處, 家有芳鄰德不孤，讓我們的生活充滿了溫暖和善意。
sentences.en: Living with good neighbors, a family with good neighbors is never without virtue, fills our lives with warmth and kindness.

phrase.en: I shall never attain buddhahood until hell is emptied

sentences.zh: 觀音菩薩立下誓言，地獄不空，誓不成佛，她的慈悲心感動了無數眾生。
sentences.en: Guanyin Bodhisattva vowed, 'I shall never attain buddhahood until hell is emptied,' and her compassion moved countless beings.

sentences.zh: 他的精神理念是，地獄不空，誓不成佛，這讓他堅持幫助每一個痛苦中的人。
sentences.en: His guiding principle, 'I shall never attain buddhahood until hell is emptied,' kept him steadfast in aiding every suffering person.

sentences.zh: 這句話深深印在他的心中，地獄不空，誓不成佛，這讓他保持初心，從未放棄救度眾生。
sentences.en: The phrase 'I shall never attain buddhahood until hell is emptied' was deeply engraved in his heart, ensuring he remained true to his intentions, never giving up on saving beings.

sentences.zh: 地獄不空，誓不成佛，不只是信徒的信念，更是一種無私大愛的體現。
sentences.en: 'I shall never attain buddhahood until hell is emptied' is not only a believer’s creed but also a manifestation of selfless great love.

sentences.zh: 地獄門被認為是通往無盡苦難和折磨的入口。
sentences.en: The gate of hell is considered the entrance to endless suffering and torment.

sentences.zh: 佛經中提到，地獄門象徵著無明和執著的終端。
sentences.en: In the Buddhist scriptures, the gate of hell symbolizes the end point of ignorance and attachment.

sentences.zh: 地獄門的可怕景象警示人們要謹慎行事，避免造作惡業。
sentences.en: The terrifying sight of the gate of hell warns people to act cautiously and avoid committing evil deeds.

sentences.zh: 許多寺廟的壁畫中，都描繪了地獄門的情景，教導信徒遠離罪惡。
sentences.en: Many temple murals depict scenes of the gate of hell, teaching devotees to stay away from sin.

sentences.zh: 身為一個地球人，我們應該關注全球環境問題，努力保護地球。
sentences.en: As a world citizen, we should be concerned about global environmental issues and strive to protect the Earth.

sentences.zh: 他認為自己是一個地球人，因此致力於促進國際理解和合作。
sentences.en: He considers himself a world citizen, thus he is dedicated to fostering international understanding and cooperation.

sentences.zh: 新一代應該培養地球人的意識，不僅關心自己的國家，也關心世界的未來。
sentences.en: The new generation should cultivate the consciousness of being world citizens, caring not only for their own country but also for the future of the world.

sentences.zh: 在全球化的時代，成為一個地球人意味著我們要尊重和理解不同的文化。
sentences.en: In the era of globalization, being a world citizen means we need to respect and understand different cultures.

sentences.zh: 地球高峰會議是世界上最大的環保會議，聚集了來自各國的領袖。
sentences.en: The Earth Summit is the world's largest environmental conference, gathering leaders from various countries.

sentences.zh: 在地球高峰會議上，討論的議題包括氣候變遷和可持續發展。
sentences.en: At the Earth Summit, the topics discussed include climate change and sustainable development.

sentences.zh: 地球高峰會議旨在促進全球合作以應對環境挑戰。
sentences.en: The Earth Summit aims to promote global cooperation to address environmental challenges.

sentences.zh: 地球高峰會議的一項主要成果是簽訂了多項國際環保協定。
sentences.en: One of the major outcomes of the Earth Summit was the signing of several international environmental agreements.

sentences.zh: 每年寺廟都會舉行地藏法會，吸引了成千上萬的信眾前來參加。
sentences.en: The temple holds a Ksitigarbha Dharma Service annually, attracting thousands of devotees to participate.

sentences.zh: 地藏法會期間，人們誦經祈福，並祈求地藏菩薩庇佑眾生。
sentences.en: During the Ksitigarbha Dharma Service, people recite scriptures and pray for the protection of all beings by Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva.

sentences.zh: 參與地藏法會能讓我們感受到地藏菩薩的慈悲和智慧，並激發我們修行的心志。
sentences.en: Participating in the Ksitigarbha Dharma Service allows us to feel the compassion and wisdom of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, inspiring our commitment to practice.

sentences.zh: 在地藏法會上，僧侶們會進行莊嚴的儀式來紀念和讚頌地藏菩薩。
sentences.en: During the Ksitigarbha Dharma Service, monks perform solemn ceremonies to commemorate and praise Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva.

sentences.zh: 地藏王菩薩在佛教中被尊稱為地獄不空，誓不成佛的大願王。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, Ksitigarbha is revered as the Bodhisattva who vowed not to attain Buddhahood until all hells are emptied.

sentences.zh: 許多人會在農曆七月向地藏王菩薩祈求保佑亡靈得以安息。
sentences.en: Many people pray to Ksitigarbha during the seventh lunar month for the repose of the deceased.

sentences.zh: 寺廟中常見地藏王菩薩手握錫杖，象徵他的普渡眾生的力量。
sentences.en: Ksitigarbha is often depicted in temples holding a staff, symbolizing his power to deliver sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 地藏王菩薩的教義強調慈悲和救贖，特別是對那些在困境中的人。
sentences.en: The teachings of Ksitigarbha emphasize compassion and salvation, especially for those in difficult situations.

phrase.en: The Original Vows of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra

sentences.zh: 在寺廟裡，我們誦讀了《地藏菩薩本願經》，這本經典教導我們孝順父母，修持善行。
sentences.en: In the temple, we recited 'The Original Vows of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra', which teaches us to honor our parents and practice good deeds.

sentences.zh: 《地藏菩薩本願經》強調了地藏菩薩的慈悲與願力，救度眾生出離苦海。
sentences.en: 'The Original Vows of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra' emphasizes Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's compassion and vows to save all beings from suffering.

sentences.zh: 老師在課堂上解釋《地藏菩薩本願經》的深遠意義，讓學生們更深入了解佛教的教義。
sentences.en: The teacher explained the profound meaning of 'The Original Vows of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra' in class, allowing students to gain a deeper understanding of Buddhist doctrines.

sentences.zh: 每年農曆七月，我們都會舉行地藏法會，誦讀《地藏菩薩本願經》以超度亡靈。
sentences.en: Every year in the seventh lunar month, we hold a Ksitigarbha Dharma Assembly, reciting 'The Original Vows of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra' to pray for the deceased.

sentences.zh: 均一國民中小學注重學生全方位發展，提供多元化的課程和活動。
sentences.en: Junyi Experimental High School focuses on the holistic development of students, offering a diverse range of courses and activities.

sentences.zh: 均一國民中小學的校訓是『務實創新，立德樹人』，鼓勵學生追求卓越。
sentences.en: The motto of Junyi Experimental High School is 'Innovative and Pragmatic, Virtue Cultivation,' encouraging students to strive for excellence.

sentences.zh: 均一國民中小學的教師團隊致力於提供優質教育，啟發學生的潛能。
sentences.en: The faculty at Junyi Experimental High School is committed to providing quality education and inspiring students' potential.

sentences.zh: 每年，均一國民中小學的學生都在各類學術和體育比賽中取得優異成績。
sentences.en: Each year, students from Junyi Experimental High School achieve outstanding results in various academic and athletic competitions.

phrase.en: Jun Tou Elementary and Junior High School

sentences.zh: 均頭國民中小學今年慶祝了建校五十週年，校友們齊聚一堂共襄盛舉。
sentences.en: Jun Tou Elementary and Junior High School celebrated its 50th anniversary this year, bringing alumni together to mark the occasion.

sentences.zh: 在均頭國民中小學，老師們致力於提供全面的教育，以培養學生的多元才能。
sentences.en: At Jun Tou Elementary and Junior High School, teachers are dedicated to providing a holistic education to nurture students' diverse talents.

sentences.zh: 均頭國民中小學的校園環境優美，充滿了書香氣息，為學生提供了良好的學習氛圍。
sentences.en: The campus of Jun Tou Elementary and Junior High School is beautiful and scholarly, providing a conducive learning environment for students.

sentences.zh: 均頭國民中小學每年舉辦各類校內外活動，激發學生的創造力和團隊精神。
sentences.en: Every year, Jun Tou Elementary and Junior High School organizes various activities both inside and outside the school to inspire students' creativity and teamwork.

sentences.zh: 在禪修時，我們使用舒適的坐具來保持姿勢和專注。
sentences.en: During meditation, we use a comfortable sitting mat to maintain posture and focus.

sentences.zh: 這塊坐具非常柔軟，適合長時間的靜坐。
sentences.en: This sitting mat is very soft, suitable for long periods of sitting.

sentences.zh: 廟裡的僧侶們每人都有自己的專屬坐具，用於日常修行。
sentences.en: Monks in the temple each have their own personal sitting mat for daily practice.

sentences.zh: 選擇合適的坐具對於新手來說尤為重要，能夠幫助他們更快進入冥想狀態。
sentences.en: Choosing the appropriate sitting mat is especially important for beginners, as it can help them get into a meditative state more quickly.

sentences.zh: 在禪修時，我們需要保持坐如鐘的姿勢，以便達到深層的靜定。
sentences.en: During meditation, we need to maintain a 'sit like a bell' posture to achieve deep concentration.

sentences.zh: 孩子在練習鋼琴時被告知要坐如鐘，這樣才能保持良好的演奏姿勢。
sentences.en: The child was told to 'sit like a bell' while practicing the piano to maintain good posture.

sentences.zh: 老師強調，坐如鐘不僅可以提升集中力，還能減少身體的疲勞。
sentences.en: The teacher emphasized that 'sitting like a bell' can not only improve focus but also reduce physical fatigue.

sentences.zh: 他的形體訓練中有一個部分就是學習如何坐如鐘，這對保持身體健康非常重要。
sentences.en: A part of his physical training involved learning how to 'sit like a bell,' which is crucial for maintaining good health.

phrase.en: to sever all [delusions] in sitting meditation

sentences.zh: 通過坐斷十方的修行，他體驗到了心靈的平靜和智慧的增長。
sentences.en: Through the practice of severing all delusions in sitting meditation, he experienced inner peace and growth in wisdom.

sentences.zh: 禪師教導弟子們如何在打坐中坐斷十方，從而達到心靈的解脫。
sentences.en: The Zen master instructed his disciples on how to sever all delusions in sitting meditation to achieve spiritual liberation.

sentences.zh: 每天早晨，她都花一個小時來坐斷十方，這已經成為她生活的一部分。
sentences.en: Every morning, she spends an hour severing all delusions in sitting meditation, which has become a part of her daily life.

sentences.zh: 通過坐斷十方，他逐漸克服了內心的混亂，找到了內心的寧靜。
sentences.en: By severing all delusions in sitting meditation, he gradually overcame his inner turmoil and found inner peace.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義中常常提到要放下執著，以達到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings often mention letting go of attachment to achieve inner peace.

sentences.zh: 對物質的過度執著會妨礙我們追求更高的精神境界。
sentences.en: Excessive attachment to material things can hinder our pursuit of higher spiritual realms.

sentences.zh: 心理學家認為，情感上的執著可能會導致無法自拔的痛苦。
sentences.en: Psychologists believe that emotional attachment may lead to inextricable suffering.

sentences.zh: 父母對孩子的成就太過執著，反而可能給孩子帶來極大的壓力。
sentences.en: Parents' excessive attachment to their children's achievements may instead bring immense pressure to the children.

phrase.en: attachment to the sense of self

sentences.zh: 在修行的路上，我們必須學會放下執著自我，才能突破內心的障礙。
sentences.en: On the path of practice, we must learn to let go of attachment to the sense of self in order to overcome the obstacles within our mind.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們，執著自我是煩惱和痛苦的根源。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us that attachment to the sense of self is the root of afflictions and suffering.

sentences.zh: 通過冥想和內省，我們可以減少對執著自我的依賴，從而達到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: Through meditation and introspection, we can reduce our reliance on attachment to the sense of self, thereby achieving inner peace.

sentences.zh: 不斷地拋棄執著自我的思想，將我們引導到涅槃的境界。
sentences.en: Continuously casting aside the thoughts of attachment to the sense of self guides us to the state of Nirvana.

sentences.zh: 公司執行長決定推行一系列新的企業政策來提升業績。
sentences.en: The company's director decided to implement a series of new corporate policies to boost performance.

sentences.zh: 這位執行長以其卓越的領導能力贏得了全體員工的尊敬。
sentences.en: The director has earned the respect of all employees for his outstanding leadership skills.

sentences.zh: 執行長召集了一個緊急會議來討論公司的危機管理計劃。
sentences.en: The director convened an emergency meeting to discuss the company's crisis management plan.

sentences.zh: 新任執行長的戰略計劃旨在確保公司未來的長期穩定發展。
sentences.en: The new director's strategic plan aims to ensure the company's long-term sustainable growth.

sentences.zh: 堂主每天都會為參與者安排禪修課程，確保他們能夠專心修行。
sentences.en: The director of the meditation hall arranges meditation sessions for the participants every day, ensuring they can focus on their practice.

sentences.zh: 這位堂主多年來一直致力於推廣佛教，並組織了許多禪修活動。
sentences.en: The director of the meditation hall has been committed to promoting Buddhism for many years and has organized numerous meditation activities.

sentences.zh: 堂主在冥想課結束後，通常會引導大家進行討論和反思。
sentences.en: After the meditation class ends, the director of the meditation hall usually leads a discussion and reflection session.

sentences.zh: 新來的堂主帶來了很多新想法，給禪堂帶來了新的氣象。
sentences.en: The new director of the meditation hall brought many fresh ideas, revitalizing the meditation hall with new energy.

sentences.zh: 堂頭和尚負責指導寺院內所有的修行活動。
sentences.en: The Head of the Cultivation Center is responsible for overseeing all the cultivation activities within the monastery.

sentences.zh: 這位堂頭和尚以其嚴格的修行標準而聞名。
sentences.en: The Head of the Cultivation Center is renowned for his strict standards of practice.

sentences.zh: 新來的僧人們需要接受堂頭和尚的教誨，學習寺院的規範。
sentences.en: Newly arrived monks must receive teachings from the Head of the Cultivation Center to learn the monastery's regulations.

sentences.zh: 在重要的佛教節日，堂頭和尚會主導重要的儀式和祈禱。
sentences.en: On significant Buddhist festivals, the Head of the Cultivation Center leads important ceremonies and prayers.

sentences.zh: 每當有人幫助了我們，我們應該心存感激，努力報恩。
sentences.en: Whenever someone helps us, we should be grateful and strive to repay others' kindness.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們通過善行和慈悲來報恩，從而積累福報。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us to repay others' kindness through good deeds and compassion, thereby accumulating merit.

sentences.zh: 他選擇回到家鄉服務，為了報恩父母的養育之恩。
sentences.en: He chose to return to his hometown to serve the community, as a way of repaying his parents' kindness in raising him.

sentences.zh: 感恩與報恩是人生必須的美德，它讓我們懂得珍惜和回饋。
sentences.en: Gratitude and repaying others' kindness are essential virtues in life, teaching us to appreciate and give back.

sentences.zh: 報恩愛國是每一個公民的責任，無論在什麼情況下都應該為國家貢獻自己的力量。
sentences.en: Loving and repaying your country is the responsibility of every citizen, and one should contribute their strength to the nation in all circumstances.

sentences.zh: 古人教導我們要報恩愛國，這是我們應該謹記的道德準則。
sentences.en: The ancients taught us to love and repay our country; this is a moral principle we should always remember.

sentences.zh: 他在海外求學多年，但始終不忘自己的根，他抱著報恩愛國的心情回到了祖國。
sentences.en: He studied abroad for many years, but never forgot his roots. He returned to his homeland with a heart full of love and repayment for his country.

sentences.zh: 在危難時期，每個人都應該團結一致，用行動來表達報恩愛國的精神。
sentences.en: In times of crisis, everyone should come together and show the spirit of loving and repaying the country through their actions.

sentences.zh: 每年寺廟都會舉辦報恩法會，讓人們感懷父母的養育之恩。
sentences.en: Every year, the temple holds a Repaying Gratitude Dharma Service to remind people of the nurturing grace of their parents.

sentences.zh: 在報恩法會上，信徒們誠心祈禱，感謝祖先的庇佑。
sentences.en: During the Repaying Gratitude Dharma Service, devotees sincerely pray, expressing gratitude for their ancestors' blessings.

sentences.zh: 這次報恩法會蒞臨的法師教導我們如何在日常生活中實踐感恩。
sentences.en: The monk who attended this Repaying Gratitude Dharma Service taught us how to practice gratitude in our daily lives.

sentences.zh: 參加報恩法會使我更加珍惜生命中所有的恩賜，心懷感恩。
sentences.en: Attending the Repaying Gratitude Dharma Service has made me cherish all the blessings in my life and hold a heart full of gratitude.

sentences.zh: 這樣的行為最終會帶來負面的報應。
sentences.en: Such actions will eventually bring about negative karmic retribution.

sentences.zh: 許多人相信善惡到頭終有報應。
sentences.en: Many people believe that good and evil deeds will eventually face karmic retribution.

sentences.zh: 他經歷的種種困難被認為是過去行為的報應。
sentences.en: The various difficulties he experienced are believed to be the karmic retribution for his past actions.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義中強調報應的概念，提醒人們要行善避惡。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings emphasize the concept of karmic retribution, reminding people to do good deeds and avoid evil.

sentences.zh: 他總是找機會報施恩，回饋那些曾經幫助過他的人。
sentences.en: He always looks for opportunities to repay kindness to those who have helped him.

sentences.zh: 學會報施恩是人生中重要的一課，它使我們更加感恩和謙卑。
sentences.en: Learning to repay kindness is an important life lesson that makes us more grateful and humble.

sentences.zh: 報施恩並不需要豪華的回報，有時一句真誠的感謝就能傳遞心意。
sentences.en: Repaying kindness does not require extravagant gestures; sometimes a heartfelt thank you conveys the message.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，報施恩被視為積累福德的一種重要方式。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, repaying kindness is seen as an important way to accumulate merit.

sentences.zh: 佛教強調通過修行可以減少內心的塵勞。
sentences.en: Buddhism emphasizes that through practice, one can reduce inner afflictions.

sentences.zh: 塵勞如影隨形，唯一解脫之道是通過智慧和慈悲。
sentences.en: Afflictions cling like shadows; the only path to liberation is through wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 他在定中觀察到，所有的塵勞都是心的幻覺。
sentences.en: In deep meditation, he observed that all afflictions are mere illusions of the mind.

sentences.zh: 生活中的塵勞雖然不可避免，但可以通過修行來淡化。
sentences.en: Though life's afflictions are unavoidable, they can be lessened through spiritual practice.

phrase.en: when dusts are cleared light will shine

sentences.zh: 在修行的過程中，我們需要逐漸去除內心的雜念，塵盡光生。
sentences.en: In the process of spiritual practice, we need to gradually remove inner distractions; when dusts are cleared, light will shine.

sentences.zh: 他的行善舉動讓人們看見了他心靈的純淨，正應了那句話：塵盡光生。
sentences.en: His acts of kindness revealed the purity of his heart, truly embodying the saying: when dusts are cleared, light will shine.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們要去貪欲心，唯有如此，塵盡光生，才能見到真實的智慧。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us to rid ourselves of greed; only then, when dusts are cleared, light will shine and true wisdom can be seen.

sentences.zh: 春天來臨，大地上的積雪融化，塵盡光生，一片新的光輝霽色。
sentences.en: With the arrival of spring, the snow on the ground melts; when dusts are cleared, light will shine, revealing a new radiant scenery.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義強調放捨塵緣，追求內心的平靜與解脫。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings emphasize letting go of worldly affinity to seek inner peace and liberation.

sentences.zh: 他想要出家修行，拋棄一切塵緣束縛。
sentences.en: He wishes to become a monk and abandon all worldly affinities.

sentences.zh: 塵緣牽絆住了她，使她難以完全投入修行。
sentences.en: Worldly affinities held her back, making it difficult for her to fully engage in spiritual practice.

sentences.zh: 在這喧囂的世界中，保持初心，不被塵緣所繫，實屬不易。
sentences.en: In this noisy world, it is challenging to maintain a pure heart and not be bound by worldly affinities.

sentences.zh: 修行所需的增上緣包括良好的師父和正法的指引。
sentences.en: The positive conditions required for practice include a good teacher and guidance in the correct Dharma.

sentences.zh: 創造增上緣能幫助我們在生活中更加順利，進一步增進智慧。
sentences.en: Creating positive conditions can help us navigate life more smoothly and further enhance our wisdom.

sentences.zh: 無論是善因還是惡因，都會形成我們未來的增上緣。
sentences.en: Whether they are good or bad causes, they will form the positive conditions for our future.

sentences.zh: 良好的國土和正見都是成佛的重要增上緣。
sentences.en: A good land and right views are important positive conditions for attaining Buddhahood.

sentences.zh: 禪定的修習可以成為開悟的增上緣，幫助修行者更加深入地理解佛法。
sentences.en: The practice of meditation can be a contributory factor to enlightenment, aiding practitioners in a deeper understanding of the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 善知識的指導常常被視為增上緣，因為它能夠引領修行者走上正確的道路。
sentences.en: The guidance of a good teacher is often seen as a contributory factor because it can lead practitioners on the right path.

sentences.zh: 環境的和平與安寧可以成為精神修行的增上緣，提供一個適合靜心和反思的場所。
sentences.en: A peaceful and tranquil environment can be a contributory factor for spiritual practice, providing a suitable place for meditation and reflection.

sentences.zh: 冥想音樂在某些情況下是增上緣，有助於修行者進入深度放鬆和專注的狀態。
sentences.en: Meditation music can be a contributory factor in some instances, helping practitioners enter a state of deep relaxation and focus.

sentences.zh: 修持善行可以增福慧，讓我們的生活更加圓滿豐盛。
sentences.en: Practicing good deeds can increase merit and wisdom, making our lives more complete and fulfilling.

sentences.zh: 菩薩行是為了增福慧，從而救度更多的眾生。
sentences.en: The actions of a Bodhisattva aim to increase merit and wisdom in order to save more sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 透過禪修和參禪，我們能夠增福慧，達到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: Through meditation and Zen practice, we can increase merit and wisdom, achieving inner peace.

sentences.zh: 師父常勉勵弟子們應該勤修戒定慧，以增福慧，靈性更上一層樓。
sentences.en: The master often encourages disciples to diligently practice discipline, concentration, and wisdom to increase merit and wisdom, thereby elevating their spirituality.

sentences.zh: 通過每天的修行，他的智慧與慈悲心逐日增長。
sentences.en: Through daily practice, his wisdom and compassion continue to increase day by day.

sentences.zh: 每一次誦經都能讓我們的信心增長。
sentences.en: Each time we recite the sutras, our faith grows.

sentences.zh: 這些經書的流通有助於佛教的廣泛增長。
sentences.en: The distribution of these scriptures helps the widespread growth of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 當我們心中充滿善念，內在的平和與幸福也會隨之增長。
sentences.en: When our minds are filled with good thoughts, inner peace and happiness will also increase.

sentences.zh: 壽山佛學院是一所著名的佛教學府，培養了許多優秀的僧人和學者。
sentences.en: Shou Shan Buddhist College is a renowned Buddhist institution, having nurtured many excellent monks and scholars.

sentences.zh: 每年都有很多信徒和學者前來壽山佛學院參加各種佛學活動。
sentences.en: Every year, many believers and scholars come to Shou Shan Buddhist College to participate in various Buddhist activities.

sentences.zh: 壽山佛學院的教授們致力於研究和傳播佛教教義及文化。
sentences.en: The professors at Shou Shan Buddhist College are dedicated to researching and disseminating Buddhist doctrines and culture.

sentences.zh: 壽山佛學院提供了廣泛的課程，涵蓋經典佛教文本、禪修實踐和現代佛教研究。
sentences.en: Shou Shan Buddhist College offers a wide range of courses, covering classic Buddhist texts, meditation practices, and modern Buddhist studies.

phrase.en: Shou Shan Buddhist Chanting and Pilgrimage Group

sentences.zh: 壽山念佛朝山團每年都會組織一次朝聖之旅，吸引了許多信徒參與。
sentences.en: The Shou Shan Buddhist Chanting and Pilgrimage Group organizes an annual pilgrimage, attracting numerous devotees.

sentences.zh: 參加壽山念佛朝山團讓我感受到了心靈的平靜和充實。
sentences.en: Joining the Shou Shan Buddhist Chanting and Pilgrimage Group brought me a sense of peace and fulfillment.

sentences.zh: 壽山念佛朝山團的成員們在靈鷲山上一起誦經，祈願世界和平。
sentences.en: Members of the Shou Shan Buddhist Chanting and Pilgrimage Group chanted scriptures together on Vulture Peak, praying for world peace.

sentences.zh: 這次壽山念佛朝山團的活動讓我更深入了解了佛法的智慧和慈悲。
sentences.en: This event with the Shou Shan Buddhist Chanting and Pilgrimage Group enabled me to gain a deeper understanding of the wisdom and compassion in Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 這位外參僧在寺廟留宿了一晚，並與住持討論了佛法。
sentences.en: The visiting monastic stayed at the temple for one night and discussed Buddhist teachings with the abbot.

sentences.zh: 外參往往會帶來不同的修行方法與心得，豐富寺院內的修行資源。
sentences.en: Visiting monastics often bring different cultivation methods and insights, enriching the resources of the monastery.

sentences.zh: 我們很高興接待一位外參，並期待與他一起修行與學習。
sentences.en: We are delighted to welcome a visiting monastic and look forward to practicing and learning together.

sentences.zh: 在外參期間，他分享了自己在其他寺院的修行經歷，令大家受益匪淺。
sentences.en: During his visit, he shared his experiences cultivating in other monasteries, greatly benefiting everyone.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義認為，外緣對於個人修行有著重要的影響。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings hold that external conditions have a significant impact on individual practice.

sentences.zh: 即使外緣如何艱難，我們也要保持內心的平靜。
sentences.en: No matter how difficult the external conditions, we must maintain inner peace.

sentences.zh: 他的成功並不僅僅依賴於內部努力，外緣的助力也不可忽視。
sentences.en: His success does not solely rely on internal efforts; the support of external conditions cannot be overlooked.

sentences.zh: 老師告訴我們改變命運不僅要依靠內心的修持，外緣的改變也同等重要。
sentences.en: Our teacher told us that changing destiny requires not only internal cultivation but also equally significant changes in external conditions.

sentences.zh: 在佛教經典中，外道常被用來形容那些不遵循正法的異教徒。
sentences.en: In Buddhist scriptures, heretics are often described as those who do not follow the true path.

sentences.zh: 對於那些堅持外道思想的人，釋迦牟尼佛以慈悲心予以開導。
sentences.en: For those who adhered to heretical thoughts, Shakyamuni Buddha guided them with compassion.

sentences.zh: 傳統佛教社群對外道的看法各有不同，有些則更為包容。
sentences.en: Traditional Buddhist communities have varying views on heretics, with some being more inclusive.

sentences.zh: 他們被視為外道，因為他們的教義違背了佛教的核心教義。
sentences.en: They are considered heretics because their doctrines contradict the core teachings of Buddhism.

phrase.zh: 多一分禮貌 少一分衝動 多一分公義 少一分特權 多一分服務 少一分自私 多一分慈悲 少一分瞋恚
phrase.en: Be a little more polite and a little less impulsive. Be a little more just and a little less privileged. Be a little more of service and a little less selfish. Be a little more compassionate and a little less angry.

sentences.zh: 多一分禮貌，少一分衝動，我們的互動將更加和諧。
sentences.en: Be a little more polite and a little less impulsive; our interactions will be more harmonious.

sentences.zh: 在處理問題時，多一分公義，少一分特權，社會就會變得更加公平。
sentences.en: When addressing issues, be a little more just and a little less privileged; the society will become fairer.

sentences.zh: 多一分服務，少一分自私，我們才能共同創造更好的未來。
sentences.en: Be a little more of service and a little less selfish; only then can we create a better future together.

sentences.zh: 在面對困難時，多一分慈悲，少一分瞋恚，心靈才能平靜。
sentences.en: When facing difficulties, be a little more compassionate and a little less angry; only then can the mind find peace.

sentences.zh: 多寶佛是一位在《法華經》中提到的佛陀，他的名字意為『無數珍寶』。
sentences.en: Prabhutaratna Buddha is a Buddha mentioned in the Lotus Sutra, whose name means 'abundance of treasures'.

sentences.zh: 在佛教故事中，多寶佛出現以見證釋迦牟尼佛宣講《法華經》的真實性。
sentences.en: In Buddhist stories, Prabhutaratna Buddha appears to affirm the authenticity of Shakyamuni Buddha's teaching of the Lotus Sutra.

sentences.zh: 多寶佛與釋迦牟尼佛並坐於一座大寶塔中，象徵著佛法的無量寶藏。
sentences.en: Prabhutaratna Buddha sits alongside Shakyamuni Buddha in a large jeweled stupa, symbolizing the infinite treasures of the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 多寶佛的出現被解釋為對佛教法門和經文的極大贊頌，象徵宇宙之間的無界聯繫。
sentences.en: The appearance of Prabhutaratna Buddha is interpreted as a great praise for the Buddhist teachings and scriptures, symbolizing the boundless connections within the universe.

phrase.zh: 多讀好書使自己芳香 多說好話令別人歡喜 多做好事讓社會祥和 多發好心增人間美麗
phrase.en: Keep reading good books to keep a fragrant mind. Keep speaking good words to bring joy to others. Keep doing good deeds to maintain harmony in society. Keep thinking good thoughts to add beauty to the world.

sentences.zh: 多讀好書使自己芳香，這不僅擴展了我的知識，還讓我的內心愈加豐富。
sentences.en: Keep reading good books to keep a fragrant mind; this not only expands my knowledge but also enriches my heart.

sentences.zh: 她經常多說好話令別人歡喜，她溫暖的言語如春風般撫慰人心。
sentences.en: She often keeps speaking good words to bring joy to others; her warm words comfort people like a gentle spring breeze.

sentences.zh: 多做好事讓社會祥和，我們應該每天努力幫助他人，為社會增添正能量。
sentences.en: Keep doing good deeds to maintain harmony in society, and we should strive to help others every day to add positive energy to the community.

sentences.zh: 多發好心增人間美麗，我們的善念可以像陽光一樣，照亮別人的生活。
sentences.en: Keep thinking good thoughts to add beauty to the world; our kind thoughts can shine like the sun and brighten others' lives.

sentences.zh: 在寂靜的夜晚，僧人們吟唱著夜來偈，祈求世界和平。
sentences.en: In the stillness of the night, the monks chant the Midnight Gatha, praying for world peace.

sentences.zh: 夜來偈的旋律悠揚，使人感到心靈的安寧。
sentences.en: The melody of the Midnight Gatha is soothing, bringing a sense of tranquility to the soul.

sentences.zh: 每當夜晚降臨，寺院裡總會響起夜來偈的歌聲。
sentences.en: Every nightfall, the temple resonates with the song of the Midnight Gatha.

phrase.zh: 夢中明明有六趣 覺後空空無大千
phrase.en: Though in my dream the Six Realms were so distinctly real; Upon awakening, the universe is naught but emptiness.

sentences.zh: 夢中明明有六趣，覺後空空無大千，這句話反映了佛教對一切現象皆為空的觀點。
sentences.en: Though in my dream the Six Realms were so distinctly real; Upon awakening, the universe is naught but emptiness. This phrase reflects the Buddhist view that all phenomena are empty.

sentences.zh: 在打坐時，我體驗到了‘夢中明明有六趣 覺後空空無大千’的真諦，一切皆是虛幻。
sentences.en: During meditation, I realized the truth of ‘Though in my dream the Six Realms were so distinctly real; Upon awakening, the universe is naught but emptiness', understanding that everything is an illusion.

sentences.zh: 這首詩中的‘夢中明明有六趣 覺後空空無大千’提醒我們不要執著於世間的假象，追求內心的清淨。
sentences.en: The verse ‘Though in my dream the Six Realms were so distinctly real; Upon awakening, the universe is naught but emptiness’ reminds us not to cling to worldly illusions and to seek inner purity.

sentences.zh: 學會接受‘夢中明明有六趣 覺後空空無大千’的觀念，可以幫助我們減少煩惱和執著，達到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: Learning to accept the concept ‘Though in my dream the Six Realms were so distinctly real; Upon awakening, the universe is naught but emptiness’ can help us reduce worries and attachments, achieving inner peace.

sentences.zh: 佛教經典中常說現實世界如夢幻泡影，一切都空無所有。
sentences.en: Buddhist scriptures often say that the real world is like a dream, illusion, bubble and shadow, with everything being void and empty.

sentences.zh: 他終於明白了他所追求的名利如夢幻泡影，毫無真實意義。
sentences.en: He finally understood that the fame and wealth he was pursuing were like a dream, illusion, bubble and shadow, having no real significance.

sentences.zh: 禪師告訴弟子們，要看破一切如夢幻泡影，才可達至解脫。
sentences.en: The Zen master told his disciples that only by seeing through everything as a dream, illusion, bubble and shadow can one attain liberation.

sentences.zh: 人生百年如夢幻泡影，應該更珍惜每一刻的當下。
sentences.en: A hundred years of human life are like a dream, illusion, bubble and shadow, so we should cherish every moment of the present.

sentences.zh: 《大丈夫論》是一本探討如何成為道德高尚、心智堅定的偉大人物的著作。
sentences.en: The 'Treatise on the Great Man' is a work that explores how to become a morally upright and mentally steadfast great man.

sentences.zh: 在佛教經典中，《大丈夫論》被視為重要的指導文獻。
sentences.en: In Buddhist scriptures, the 'Treatise on the Great Man' is considered an important guiding document.

sentences.zh: 學者們經常引用《大丈夫論》中的教誨來指導他們的生活和研究。
sentences.en: Scholars often cite teachings from the 'Treatise on the Great Man' to guide their lives and studies.

sentences.zh: 透過閱讀《大丈夫論》，我們可以學習如何在困難中保持冷靜和堅強。
sentences.en: By reading the 'Treatise on the Great Man,' we can learn how to remain calm and strong in the face of adversity.

phrase.zh: 大乘理趣六波羅蜜多經
phrase.en: Sutra on the Mahayana Practice of the Six Perfections

sentences.zh: 大乘理趣六波羅蜜多經中提到，修行者應該如何在日常生活中實踐六度。
sentences.en: The Sutra on the Mahayana Practice of the Six Perfections mentions how practitioners should implement the Six Perfections in their daily lives.

sentences.zh: 他經常閱讀大乘理趣六波羅蜜多經，以增進自己的智慧和慈悲心。
sentences.en: He often reads the Sutra on the Mahayana Practice of the Six Perfections to enhance his wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 大乘理趣六波羅蜜多經詳細解釋了布施、持戒、忍辱、精進、禪定和智慧的意義。
sentences.en: The Sutra on the Mahayana Practice of the Six Perfections elaborates on the meanings of generosity, morality, patience, diligence, meditation, and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 佛學研究者認為，大乘理趣六波羅蜜多經是理解大乘佛教修行的重要文本。
sentences.en: Scholars of Buddhism believe that the Sutra on the Mahayana Practice of the Six Perfections is an essential text for understanding Mahayana Buddhist practices.

sentences.zh: 釋迦牟尼佛以大人大忍面對一切困難，終於成就了無上的智慧。
sentences.en: Shakyamuni Buddha faced all difficulties with tremendous benevolence and patience, ultimately attaining supreme wisdom.

sentences.zh: 在面對挑戰時，我們需要大人大忍，才能保持內心的平靜與和諧。
sentences.en: When facing challenges, we need tremendous benevolence and patience to maintain inner peace and harmony.

sentences.zh: 她以大人大忍的態度對待每個人，無論對方如何苛刻，她始終保持慈悲和耐心。
sentences.en: She treated everyone with tremendous benevolence and patience, maintaining her compassion and calmness no matter how harsh others were.

sentences.zh: 在冥想中，我們學習大人大忍，這讓我們能夠更加深入地理解自我和宇宙。
sentences.en: In meditation, we learn tremendous benevolence and patience, which allows us to gain a deeper understanding of ourselves and the universe.

sentences.zh: 在大佛城裡，信徒們能夠找到心靈的平靜和安詳。
sentences.en: In the Great Buddha Land, devotees can find peace and tranquility for their souls.

sentences.zh: 大佛城的建設象徵了無數佛教弟子對如來的無限敬仰。
sentences.en: The construction of the Great Buddha Land symbolizes the infinite reverence Buddhists have for the Tathagata.

sentences.zh: 每年的佛誕節，大佛城都會舉行盛大的慶典和法會。
sentences.en: Every year during the Buddha’s birthday, the Great Buddha Land hosts grand celebrations and Dharma assemblies.

sentences.zh: 許多尋求靈性成長的人們來到大佛城，希望能在這裡找到真正的智慧和啟迪。
sentences.en: Many seekers of spiritual growth visit the Great Buddha Land, hoping to find true wisdom and enlightenment here.

sentences.zh: 大佛平台是許多朝聖者的重要目的地，讓他們在此膜拜和冥想。
sentences.en: The Big Buddha Terrace is a significant destination for many pilgrims, allowing them to worship and meditate.

sentences.zh: 從大佛平台可以俯瞰整個山谷，景色壯麗迷人。
sentences.en: From the Big Buddha Terrace, one can overlook the entire valley, with its magnificent and captivating scenery.

sentences.zh: 大佛平台上的巨型佛像吸引了世界各地的遊客前來參觀。
sentences.en: The enormous Buddha statue on the Big Buddha Terrace attracts tourists from all around the world.

sentences.zh: 每年都有無數的信徒前來大佛平台，參加年度的宗教慶典。
sentences.en: Every year, countless devotees visit the Big Buddha Terrace to attend the annual religious festival.

sentences.zh: 每年都有成千上萬的遊客來到這裡參觀這座壯觀的大佛紀念碑。
sentences.en: Every year, thousands of visitors come here to see the magnificent Great Buddha Memorial Plaque.

sentences.zh: 這座大佛紀念碑是為紀念佛陀的偉大功績而建造的。
sentences.en: The Great Buddha Memorial Plaque was erected to commemorate the great deeds of the Buddha.

sentences.zh: 大佛紀念碑的設計融合了傳統與現代元素，象徵著佛法的永恆。
sentences.en: The design of the Great Buddha Memorial Plaque incorporates traditional and modern elements, symbolizing the timelessness of the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 在清晨的陽光下，大佛紀念碑顯得格外莊嚴和神聖。
sentences.en: In the early morning sunlight, the Great Buddha Memorial Plaque appears particularly solemn and sacred.

sentences.zh: 他在處理這個紛爭時，展現了大公無私的精神，完全不偏不倚。
sentences.en: He demonstrated impartiality and unselfishness in handling the dispute, showing no bias whatsoever.

sentences.zh: 她以大公無私的態度為社區服務，每個人都深受她的影響。
sentences.en: She serves the community with a spirit of impartiality and unselfishness, impacting everyone deeply.

sentences.zh: 在領導這個計劃的過程中，他以大公無私的精神對待每一個成員。
sentences.en: During the leadership of this project, he treated every member with impartiality and unselfishness.

sentences.zh: 他的行為展示了大公無私的高尚品德，使大家更加尊敬他。
sentences.en: His actions showcased the noble virtue of impartiality and unselfishness, earning him greater respect from everyone.

phrase.zh: 大千世界古 不二法門深
phrase.en: Ancient is the great world of the universe; Profound is the Gate of Non-Duality.

sentences.zh: 大千世界古，不同的文明起源與消亡，世事滄桑。
sentences.en: Ancient is the great world of the universe; different civilizations rise and fall, and the vicissitudes of life unfold.

sentences.zh: 不二法門深，佛教徒需以智慧探究其中的真理。
sentences.en: Profound is the Gate of Non-Duality; Buddhists must use wisdom to delve into its truths.

sentences.zh: 大千世界古，自然界的奧秘無窮無盡，等待我們去發現。
sentences.en: Ancient is the great world of the universe; the mysteries of nature are endless, waiting for us to discover.

sentences.zh: 不二法門深，悟到它就能超越生死輪迴，達到涅槃之境。
sentences.en: Profound is the Gate of Non-Duality; realizing it allows one to transcend the cycle of birth and death, reaching the state of Nirvana.

sentences.zh: 大和尚在禪修中給予弟子們很多啟示。
sentences.en: The master provided many insights to his disciples during the meditation session.

sentences.zh: 這座寺廟的大和尚以其智慧和慈悲廣為人知。
sentences.en: The master of this temple is widely known for his wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 大和尚每天黎明前起床，開始一天的修行。
sentences.en: The master wakes up before dawn every day to begin his practice.

sentences.zh: 在法會上，大和尚回答了信眾們的許多疑問。
sentences.en: During the Dharma assembly, the master answered many questions from the followers.

phrase.en: Xuanzang of the Great Tang Dynasty

sentences.zh: 大唐玄奘是中國歷史上著名的佛教僧侶，他不遠萬里前往印度取經。
sentences.en: Xuanzang of the Great Tang Dynasty was a famous Buddhist monk in Chinese history who traveled to India to obtain sacred texts.

sentences.zh: 大唐玄奘編著的《大唐西域記》為我們提供了寶貴的歷史和地理資料。
sentences.en: Xuanzang of the Great Tang Dynasty authored the 'Great Tang Records on the Western Regions', providing valuable historical and geographical information.

sentences.zh: 大唐玄奘在印度學習了多年的佛教經典，回國後進行了大規模的翻譯工作。
sentences.en: Xuanzang of the Great Tang Dynasty studied Buddhist scriptures in India for many years and undertook extensive translation work upon his return to China.

sentences.zh: 大唐玄奘的旅程對促進中印文化交流起到了重要的作用。
sentences.en: The journey of Xuanzang of the Great Tang Dynasty played a crucial role in promoting cultural exchange between China and India.

phrase.en: Buddhist Pilgrim Monks of Tang Dynasty

sentences.zh: 《大唐西域求法高僧傳》記錄了高僧們在西域求法的壯舉。
sentences.en: The 'Buddhist Pilgrim Monks of Tang Dynasty' documents the heroic efforts of monks seeking sacred teachings in the Western Regions.

sentences.zh: 在《大唐西域求法高僧傳》中，玄奘法師的行跡尤為感人。
sentences.en: In the 'Buddhist Pilgrim Monks of Tang Dynasty', the journey of Master Xuanzang is particularly touching.

sentences.zh: 許多學者研究《大唐西域求法高僧傳》來了解唐代的佛教交流。
sentences.en: Many scholars study the 'Buddhist Pilgrim Monks of Tang Dynasty' to understand the Buddhist interactions during the Tang Dynasty.

sentences.zh: 《大唐西域求法高僧傳》對於研究古代絲綢之路上的文化交流具有重要價值。
sentences.en: The 'Buddhist Pilgrim Monks of Tang Dynasty' holds significant value for the study of cultural exchanges along the ancient Silk Road.

sentences.zh: 《大唐西域記》記載了玄奘法師在西行取經路上的所見所聞。
sentences.en: "Great Journey to the West" records the sights and experiences of the monk Xuanzang during his pilgrimage to obtain sacred texts.

sentences.zh: 《大唐西域記》是研究古代印度和中亞地區歷史文化的重要文獻。
sentences.en: "Great Journey to the West" is an essential document for studying the history and culture of ancient India and Central Asia.

sentences.zh: 在《大唐西域記》中，玄奘描述了他途經的許多佛教聖地。
sentences.en: In the "Great Journey to the West," Xuanzang describes many Buddhist sacred sites he passed through.

sentences.zh: 《大唐西域記》的內容對於理解漢唐時期的中西交流具有重要意義。
sentences.en: The content of the "Great Journey to the West" is crucial for understanding the cultural exchanges between the East and West during the Han and Tang dynasties.

sentences.zh: 佛陀是大圓滿覺者，他以無邊智慧和慈悲利益眾生。
sentences.en: The Buddha is the Perfectly Awakened One, benefiting sentient beings with boundless wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 大圓滿覺的境界是不受任何煩惱所困擾，內心完全清淨。
sentences.en: The state of the Perfectly Awakened One is free from all afflictions, with a completely pure mind.

sentences.zh: 在追求大圓滿覺的道路上，修行者須經歷多次的磨練和考驗。
sentences.en: On the path to becoming a Perfectly Awakened One, practitioners must endure numerous trials and tests.

sentences.zh: 大圓滿覺者不僅自己證得解脫，還會引領他人邁向覺悟的彼岸。
sentences.en: The Perfectly Awakened One not only attains liberation for themselves but also guides others toward the shore of enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 在修行的最高境界，修行者會達到大圓鏡智的狀態，領悟一切真理。
sentences.en: At the highest level of practice, the practitioner will attain the state of Great Perfect Mirror Wisdom, understanding all truths.

sentences.zh: 大圓鏡智能讓我們明辨是非，不受外界干擾，保持清明的心境。
sentences.en: Great Perfect Mirror Wisdom enables us to discern right from wrong, remain undisturbed by external influences, and maintain a clear mind.

sentences.zh: 佛陀通過大圓鏡智看到了眾生的心，慈悲指引他們走向解脫之路。
sentences.en: Through Great Perfect Mirror Wisdom, the Buddha saw into the hearts of beings and compassionately guided them towards the path of liberation.

sentences.zh: 修習禪定和智慧可以幫助我們開啟內在的大圓鏡智，獲得真正的安寧與智慧。
sentences.en: Practicing meditation and wisdom can help us unlock our inner Great Perfect Mirror Wisdom, attaining true peace and insight.

phrase.zh: 大地何許熱 慈悲自清涼
phrase.en: However much the Earth may burn; Compassion keeps everything cool.

sentences.zh: 在煩惱重重的生活中，大地何許熱，慈悲自清涼，只有慈悲之心才能帶來內心的平靜。
sentences.en: In a life filled with troubles, however much the Earth may burn, compassion keeps everything cool; only a compassionate heart can bring inner peace.

sentences.zh: 即使世界充滿了衝突和痛苦，大地何許熱，慈悲自清涼，唯有慈悲能平息一切。
sentences.en: Even in a world fraught with conflicts and suffering, however much the Earth may burn, compassion keeps everything cool; only compassion can calm everything down.

sentences.zh: 在𡝓聲不斷的環境中，大地何許熱，慈悲自清涼，慈悲的力量可以帶來和平與寧靜。
sentences.en: In an environment filled with noise, however much the Earth may burn, compassion keeps everything cool; the power of compassion can bring peace and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 面對他人的暴躁和怨恨，大地何許熱，慈悲自清涼，慈悲之心能使人和解。
sentences.en: Faced with others' anger and resentment, however much the Earth may burn, compassion keeps everything cool; a compassionate heart can bring about reconciliation.

sentences.zh: 春天來臨，處處可以感受到大地生機的恢復。
sentences.en: With the arrival of spring, one can feel the restoration of Earth's vitality everywhere.

sentences.zh: 綠色植物是大地生機的象徵，令人感受到無限的活力。
sentences.en: Green plants are a symbol of Earth's vitality, giving a sense of boundless energy.

sentences.zh: 這片荒野正在逐漸恢復大地生機，成為野生動物繁衍的樂園。
sentences.en: This wilderness is slowly regaining Earth's vitality, becoming a haven for wildlife to flourish.

sentences.zh: 通過保護自然環境，我們能夠恢復大地生機，讓未來的世代享受同樣的美景。
sentences.en: By protecting the natural environment, we can restore Earth's vitality and allow future generations to enjoy the same beauty.

sentences.zh: 佛教經典中常常提到，大地眾生，皆有佛性。
sentences.en: Buddhist scriptures often mention that all living beings possess buddha-nature.

sentences.zh: 上師提醒我們，大地眾生，皆有佛性，我們應該以慈悲心對待一切生靈。
sentences.en: The master reminds us that all living beings possess buddha-nature, and we should treat all creatures with compassion.

sentences.zh: 這句話告訴我們，無論是人還是動物，大地眾生，皆有佛性，應當彼此尊重。
sentences.en: This phrase tells us that whether human or animal, all living beings possess buddha-nature and should be respected.

sentences.zh: 理解大地眾生，皆有佛性，能幫助我們超越偏見，看到每個人內心的純淨與善良。
sentences.en: Understanding that all living beings possess buddha-nature can help us transcend prejudice and see the purity and goodness in everyone.

phrase.zh: 大地眾生，皆有如來智慧德相
phrase.en: All sentient beings possess the wisdom and virtues of the Buddha

sentences.zh: 佛陀教導我們，大地眾生，皆有如來智慧德相，即使是最卑微的生命也不例外。
sentences.en: The Buddha taught us that all sentient beings possess the wisdom and virtues of the Buddha, even the humblest forms of life.

sentences.zh: 這本經書反覆強調，大地眾生，皆有如來智慧德相，應當相互尊重和平等待人。
sentences.en: This scripture repeatedly emphasizes that all sentient beings possess the wisdom and virtues of the Buddha and should treat each other with respect and equality.

sentences.zh: 相信大地眾生，皆有如來智慧德相，是我們修持佛法的根本之一。
sentences.en: Believing that all sentient beings possess the wisdom and virtues of the Buddha is one of the fundamentals of our Buddhist practice.

sentences.zh: 通過冥想和修行，我們可以體驗並認識到，大地眾生，皆有如來智慧德相。
sentences.en: Through meditation and practice, we can experience and recognize that all sentient beings possess the wisdom and virtues of the Buddha.

sentences.zh: 觀世音菩薩被尊稱為大士，象徵著大慈大悲的精神。
sentences.en: Avalokitesvara is revered as a Mahasattva, symbolizing the spirit of great compassion.

sentences.zh: 每個大士都是發願度眾生的菩薩，他們的行為啟示著我們追隨佛法的道路。
sentences.en: Every Mahasattva is a Bodhisattva who vows to help all sentient beings, inspiring us to follow the path of the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 這位大士的言行舉止令所有弟子感到無比敬仰和尊重。
sentences.en: The Mahasattva's words and actions earn the profound admiration and respect of all disciples.

sentences.zh: 大士的慈悲心和智慧是修行者永遠學習的典範。
sentences.en: The compassion and wisdom of a Mahasattva are timeless exemplars for all practitioners.

phrase.zh: 大夢夢中原是夢 此山山外更無山
phrase.en: Dreaming inside the great dream, all is but a dream; Mountain outside the mountains, there are no other mountains.

sentences.zh: 禪師告訴他的弟子，大夢夢中原是夢 此山山外更無山，讓他們理解世間皆虛幻。
sentences.en: The Zen master told his disciples, 'Dreaming inside the great dream, all is but a dream; Mountain outside the mountains, there are no other mountains,' to help them understand the illusory nature of the world.

sentences.zh: 在修行中，他逐漸體驗到大夢夢中原是夢，此山山外更無山的境界，心靈逐漸平靜。
sentences.en: Through his practice, he gradually experienced the state of 'Dreaming inside the great dream, all is but a dream; Mountain outside the mountains, there are no other mountains,' and his mind became increasingly serene.

sentences.zh: 這句話“大夢夢中原是夢 此山山外更無山”經常被用來提醒人們勿執著於世俗的事物。
sentences.en: The phrase 'Dreaming inside the great dream, all is but a dream; Mountain outside the mountains, there are no other mountains' is often used to remind people not to cling to worldly matters.

sentences.zh: 他總是在夜深人靜時思考自己的修行，大夢夢中原是夢 此山山外更無山的意義。
sentences.en: He would often contemplate his practice in the stillness of the night, pondering the meaning of 'Dreaming inside the great dream, all is but a dream; Mountain outside the mountains, there are no other mountains.'

sentences.zh: 他被授予大學委員的職位，這讓他倍感榮幸。
sentences.en: He was honored to be appointed as a University Board Member.

sentences.zh: 作為大學委員，她積極參與學術規劃和校園發展討論。
sentences.en: As a University Board Member, she actively participated in academic planning and campus development discussions.

sentences.zh: 大學委員們討論了新研究中心的建立計劃。
sentences.en: The University Board Members discussed the plan for establishing a new research center.

sentences.zh: 大學委員的決定對學校的未來發展至關重要。
sentences.en: The decisions made by the University Board Members are crucial to the future development of the school.

sentences.zh: 今年的大學校長論壇將在東京舉行，多所知名高校的校長們將會參與。
sentences.en: This year's University Presidents Forum will be held in Tokyo, with presidents from several prestigious universities participating.

sentences.zh: 大學校長論壇旨在促進全球高等教育機構之間的合作與交流。
sentences.en: The University Presidents Forum aims to promote cooperation and exchange among higher education institutions worldwide.

sentences.zh: 在大學校長論壇上，各校長們討論了提高教育質量和學生幸福感的各種策略。
sentences.en: At the University Presidents Forum, the presidents discussed various strategies for improving educational quality and student well-being.

sentences.zh: 大學校長論壇提供了一個平台，讓各國校長們能夠分享他們的成功經驗和挑戰。
sentences.en: The University Presidents Forum provided a platform for university presidents from different countries to share their success stories and challenges.

sentences.zh: 每一天，僧侶們都在大寮準備大家的膳食，這裡的氣氛總是那麼寧靜和平。
sentences.en: Every day, the monks prepare meals for everyone in the monastery kitchen, and the atmosphere here is always so serene and peaceful.

sentences.zh: 大寮的工作不僅是烹飪，還包含了所有飲食相關的修持，是修行的一部分。
sentences.en: The work in the monastery kitchen is not just about cooking; it includes all diet-related practices and is considered part of the spiritual practice.

sentences.zh: 在大寮裏，僧侶和信徒們共同合作，體現了團結和互助的精神。
sentences.en: In the monastery kitchen, monks and devotees work together, embodying the spirit of unity and mutual support.

sentences.zh: 每當新的食材送達大寮，僧侶們都會以感恩的心收納，心中心存禮讚。
sentences.en: Whenever new ingredients arrive at the monastery kitchen, the monks receive them with gratitude, holding reverence in their hearts.

sentences.zh: 每年暑假，許多年輕人報名參加大專青年禪學營，學習禪修與佛法。
sentences.en: Every summer, many young people sign up for the Buddhist Youth Meditation Camp to learn meditation and Buddhist teachings.

sentences.zh: 在大專青年禪學營中，參加者有機會體驗真實的禪修生活，並且聆聽專業導師的講座。
sentences.en: At the Buddhist Youth Meditation Camp, participants get the chance to experience authentic meditation life and listen to lectures from expert instructors.

sentences.zh: 大專青年禪學營的活動設計豐富多樣，包括靜坐、禪步行和法談等，讓青年學生深入接觸禪修的智慧。
sentences.en: The activities at the Buddhist Youth Meditation Camp are rich and varied, including sitting meditation, walking meditation, and Dharma talks, allowing young students to deeply engage with the wisdom of meditation.

sentences.zh: 通過參加大專青年禪學營，許多年輕人找到了內心的平靜與智慧，並結識了一群志同道合的朋友。
sentences.en: By participating in the Buddhist Youth Meditation Camp, many young people have found inner peace and wisdom, and have met a group of like-minded friends.

sentences.zh: 大導師以其深厚的佛法修養和慈悲心，受到眾弟子的尊敬和愛戴。
sentences.en: The great teacher is respected and loved by all disciples for his profound understanding of Dharma and compassionate heart.

sentences.zh: 當大導師進入講堂時，所有人都感受到一股平靜與祥和的氛圍。
sentences.en: When the great teacher entered the hall, everyone felt a sense of peace and harmony.

sentences.zh: 在他的指導下，許多人成為了修行有成的佛教徒，並且繼續弘揚佛法。
sentences.en: Under his guidance, many have become accomplished practitioners and continued to propagate Dharma.

sentences.zh: 大導師的智慧猶如燈塔，引導迷失在塵世的人們找到心靈的平靜。
sentences.en: The great teacher's wisdom is like a lighthouse, guiding those lost in the world to find inner peace.

sentences.zh: 在佛教經典中，大小乘的教義各有不同，但都指向最終的解脫。
sentences.en: In Buddhist scriptures, the teachings of the Greater or Lesser Vehicles vary, but both ultimately aim towards liberation.

sentences.zh: 在學習佛法的過程中，弟子們會接觸到大小乘的不同修行方法。
sentences.en: During the study of the Dharma, disciples will encounter various practices from the Greater and Lesser Vehicles.

sentences.zh: 有人認為，大小乘之分其實是對不同根器眾生的教導方式。
sentences.en: Some believe that the distinction between the Greater and Lesser Vehicles is simply a way to teach beings of different capacities.

sentences.zh: 無論是選擇大小乘中的哪一個，最終目標都是達到涅槃的境界。
sentences.en: Regardless of whether one chooses the Greater or Lesser Vehicles, the ultimate goal is to reach the state of Nirvana.

sentences.zh: 真正的智者大巧若拙，他們並不急於表現自己的智慧。
sentences.en: The true sage, the wise appears slow-witted, does not rush to showcase their wisdom.

sentences.zh: 大巧若拙的人往往會給周圍的人留下深刻的印象，因為他們善於在適當的時機發言。
sentences.en: The wise who appear slow-witted often leave a deep impression on those around them, as they are adept at speaking at the right moment.

sentences.zh: 在儒家的思想中，大巧若拙是一種高尚的品德，意味著表面謙虛而內心充實。
sentences.en: In Confucian thought, the wise appears slow-witted is a noble virtue, implying a modest exterior and a rich interior.

sentences.zh: 大巧若拙的表現方式教會我們要謙遜，才不會陷入自負之中。
sentences.en: The way the wise appears slow-witted teaches us to be humble and not fall into arrogance.

sentences.zh: 這位大師在佛教界具有崇高的威望，指引了無數信徒走上修行之路。
sentences.en: This Venerable Master holds high esteem in the Buddhist community, guiding countless followers on the path of cultivation.

sentences.zh: 大師的開示深入淺出，幫助許多人領悟佛法的真諦。
sentences.en: The Venerable Master's teachings are profound yet accessible, helping many to grasp the true essence of the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 每當大師講經時，法堂內總是座無虛席，聽眾無不感到受益匪淺。
sentences.en: Whenever the Venerable Master delivers a sermon, the Dharma hall is always packed, and the audience feels deeply benefited.

sentences.zh: 這位大師以慈悲和智慧著稱，是無數佛教徒心目中的楷模。
sentences.en: This Venerable Master is renowned for his compassion and wisdom, and serves as a role model for countless Buddhists.

phrase.en: The Complete Works of Venerable Master Hsing Yun

sentences.zh: 我最近在閱讀大師全集，從中受到了許多啟發。
sentences.en: I've been reading The Complete Works of Venerable Master Hsing Yun recently, and it has provided me with a lot of inspiration.

sentences.zh: 大師全集收錄了星雲大師一生的著作，是瞭解他的思想的重要資料。
sentences.en: The Complete Works of Venerable Master Hsing Yun contains all of his lifetime writings, making it essential for understanding his philosophy.

sentences.zh: 圖書館新增了一套大師全集，吸引了很多佛教研究者前來閱讀。
sentences.en: The library has added a new set of The Complete Works of Venerable Master Hsing Yun, attracting many Buddhist scholars to read.

sentences.zh: 他花了數年時間整理和編寫這套大師全集，以保存星雲大師的智慧。
sentences.en: He spent several years compiling and editing The Complete Works of Venerable Master Hsing Yun to preserve the wisdom of the Venerable Master.

sentences.zh: 大師館是這座寺廟的重要建築，舉辦各種重要的佛教儀式。
sentences.en: The Main Hall is a significant structure in this temple, hosting various important Buddhist ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 參拜者們每天早上都會前往大師館進行祈禱和冥想。
sentences.en: Worshippers visit the Main Hall every morning to pray and meditate.

sentences.zh: 大師館的建築風格非常古樸，能夠感受到歷史的沉重。
sentences.en: The architectural style of the Main Hall is very ancient, evoking a sense of historical gravity.

sentences.zh: 在佛教節日的時候，大師館會擠滿前來祈願的信徒。
sentences.en: During Buddhist festivals, the Main Hall is crowded with believers coming to make wishes.

sentences.zh: 每年寺廟都會舉行大悲懺法會，希望信眾透過虔誠的祈禱獲得平安與福報。
sentences.en: Every year, the temple holds the Great Compassion Repentance Service, hoping that devotees can gain peace and blessings through sincere prayers.

sentences.zh: 大悲懺法會是一個重要的佛教儀式，許多人會來參加以懺悔過去的罪業。
sentences.en: The Great Compassion Repentance Service is an important Buddhist ritual, where many people come to repent for their past sins.

sentences.zh: 在大悲懺法會期間，信徒們會共同唱誦《大悲咒》，以達到心靈的淨化。
sentences.en: During the Great Compassion Repentance Service, devotees collectively recite the Great Compassion Mantra to achieve spiritual purification.

sentences.zh: 參與大悲懺法會可以讓人感受到內心的平靜與祥和，並增強對生活的信心。
sentences.en: Participating in the Great Compassion Repentance Service can bring a sense of inner peace and tranquility, and enhance confidence in life.

sentences.zh: 每年，數以千計的信徒前來大悲殿祈求菩薩的庇佑。
sentences.en: Every year, thousands of devotees visit the Great Compassion Shrine to seek the Bodhisattva's blessings.

sentences.zh: 大悲殿內的觀音像高大威嚴，令人感到無比的敬畏。
sentences.en: The statue of Guanyin inside the Great Compassion Shrine is towering and majestic, inspiring great awe.

sentences.zh: 在大悲殿靜坐冥想，能讓人感受到內心的平靜與祥和。
sentences.en: Meditating quietly in the Great Compassion Shrine allows one to feel inner peace and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 大悲殿以其慈悲為懷的精神，吸引了無數善信前來供奉香火。
sentences.en: The Great Compassion Shrine, with its spirit of boundless compassion, attracts numerous devotees to offer incense.

sentences.zh: 觀世音菩薩以大慈大悲救度眾生，使無數人得到心靈的安慰和指引。
