sentences.en: The Zen master often says, 'When the heart is good, everything is good,' which is a truth of introspection.

sentences.zh: 無論外面的環境多麼複雜，只要心好一切好，我們就能找到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: No matter how complex the external environment is, when the heart is good, everything is good, and we can find inner peace.

sentences.zh: 她相信心好一切好，堅持每天練習冥想來保持心境平和。
sentences.en: She believes that when the heart is good, everything is good, and she insists on practicing meditation daily to maintain a calm mind.

sentences.zh: 在面對挑戰時，他總是提醒自己，心好一切好，以此來克服困難。
sentences.en: When facing challenges, he always reminds himself that when the heart is good, everything is good, using it to overcome difficulties.

phrase.en: When the Heart Is Good, One Is Beautiful

sentences.zh: 佛教教義中提到，心好人美才是真正的美。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings often mention that when the heart is good, one is truly beautiful.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該記住心好人美的道理，用慈悲心待人。
sentences.en: Practitioners should remember that when the heart is good, one is beautiful, and treat others with compassion.

sentences.zh: 正如古話所說，心好人美，內在的善良比外表的裝飾更加重要。
sentences.en: As the ancient saying goes, when the heart is good, one is beautiful; inner kindness is more important than outer decorations.

sentences.zh: 她通過冥想和善行來改善自己，確信心好人美的真理。
sentences.en: She improves herself through meditation and good deeds, believing in the truth that when the heart is good, one is beautiful.

phrase.zh: 心好人間善 氣和天地美
phrase.en: Kindness makes the world a better place; Harmony makes the universe beautiful.

sentences.zh: 他每天都懷著一顆心好人間善的心，積極幫助他人。
sentences.en: He embraces the principle that kindness makes the world a better place and actively helps others every day.

sentences.zh: 當每個人都心好人間善，世界將會變得更加美好。
sentences.en: When everyone embodies the value that kindness makes the world a better place, the world will become even more wonderful.

sentences.zh: 正因為氣和天地美，這個地方才有如此和諧的氛圍。
sentences.en: Because harmony makes the universe beautiful, this place has such a harmonious atmosphere.

sentences.zh: 她相信氣和天地美，因此她盡力維持周圍環境的平和。
sentences.en: She believes that harmony makes the universe beautiful, so she does her best to maintain peace in her surroundings.

phrase.zh: 心好命好 平安到老
phrase.en: A Good Mind Leads a Good Life; Peace Shall Accompany Till Old Age

sentences.zh: 她常說，心好命好 平安到老，因此她每天都保持樂觀的心態。
sentences.en: She often says, 'A Good Mind Leads a Good Life; Peace Shall Accompany Till Old Age,' so she maintains a positive outlook every day.

sentences.zh: 只要心存善念，心好命好 平安到老，就能面對生活中的一切挑戰。
sentences.en: As long as you harbor good thoughts, 'A Good Mind Leads a Good Life; Peace Shall Accompany Till Old Age,' you can face all life's challenges.

sentences.zh: 這句話，心好命好 平安到老，成為他生活中的座右銘，指引他走過每一個困難的時刻。
sentences.en: This phrase, 'A Good Mind Leads a Good Life; Peace Shall Accompany Till Old Age,' became his life motto, guiding him through each difficult moment.

sentences.zh: 心好命好 平安到老，是她經常念誦的詞句，提醒自己要保持善良與鎮定。
sentences.en: 'A Good Mind Leads a Good Life; Peace Shall Accompany Till Old Age' is a phrase she often recites to remind herself to stay kind and calm.

sentences.zh: 只要你心好，命運自然會越來越好，心好命更好。
sentences.en: As long as you are kind-hearted, your destiny will naturally get better and better. Kindness makes life even better.

sentences.zh: 他總是說心好命更好，這句話給了他在人生困境中前行的力量。
sentences.en: He always says 'Kindness makes life even better,' and this phrase gives him the strength to move forward in life's difficulties.

sentences.zh: 心好命更好，這是一個佛教徒常掛在嘴邊的信念，提醒他們要保持善良。
sentences.en: 'Kindness makes life even better' is a belief often held by Buddhists, reminding them to stay kind.

sentences.zh: 她深信心好命更好，因此在生活中總是力行善事。
sentences.en: She firmly believes that kindness makes life even better, so she always practices good deeds in her life.

phrase.en: A Good Heart Attracts Good Fortune

sentences.zh: 古人常說，心好福來，善良的人總是能夠吸引幸福和吉祥。
sentences.en: The ancients often said, a good heart attracts good fortune, kind people always tend to draw happiness and blessings.

sentences.zh: 心好福來這句話提醒我們，內心的善良和誠意能帶來意想不到的好運。
sentences.en: The phrase 'a good heart attracts good fortune' reminds us that inner kindness and sincerity can bring unexpected good luck.

sentences.zh: 他經常幫助別人，相信心好福來，所以生活中充滿了美好的事物。
sentences.en: He often helps others, believing that a good heart attracts good fortune, so his life is filled with beautiful things.

sentences.zh: 心好福來，這是一種心靈的力量，讓幸福的能量不斷聚集。
sentences.en: A good heart attracts good fortune, it is a kind of spiritual power that allows happiness to continuously gather.

phrase.en: When the Heart Is Good, One Is at Perfect Ease

sentences.zh: 當他冥想時，他感受到心好自在，超脫了所有的煩惱。
sentences.en: When he meditated, he felt when the heart is good, one is at perfect ease, transcending all worries.

sentences.zh: 在困境中，她總是保持心好自在的態度，這讓她能夠平靜地面對挑戰。
sentences.en: In times of adversity, she always maintains an attitude of when the heart is good, one is at perfect ease, enabling her to face challenges calmly.

sentences.zh: 心好自在並不只是一種理論，而是可以實踐在日常生活中的智慧。
sentences.en: When the heart is good, one is at perfect ease is not just a theory but wisdom that can be practiced in daily life.

sentences.zh: 通過修行，他逐漸體會到心好自在的重要性，生活變得更加和諧而美好。
sentences.en: Through practice, he gradually realized the importance of when the heart is good, one is at perfect ease, making his life more harmonious and fulfilling.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒應努力培養心如光華，無論遇到什麼困難都能保持純淨和光明。
sentences.en: Buddhists should strive to cultivate a heart like light, maintaining purity and radiance regardless of any difficulties encountered.

sentences.zh: 他的心如光華，散發出無限的慈悲和智慧，影響著周圍的每一個人。
sentences.en: His heart is like light, emanating infinite compassion and wisdom, influencing everyone around him.

sentences.zh: 修行之道在於使心如光華，照亮自我和他人的生命旅程。
sentences.en: The path of cultivation lies in having a heart like light, illuminating the life journeys of oneself and others.

sentences.zh: 老師教導學生們要以心如光華去面對生活中的挑戰，從容而堅定地前行。
sentences.en: The teacher instructed the students to face life's challenges with a heart like light, proceeding calmly and steadfastly.

phrase.en: A Mind as Great as the Universe

sentences.zh: 修行者應該培養心如大千的胸懷，包容一切眾生。
sentences.en: Practitioners should cultivate a mind as great as the universe, embracing all sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 在面對困難時，保持心如大千的態度，可以幫助我們找到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: When facing difficulties, maintaining a mind as great as the universe can help us find inner peace.

sentences.zh: 從事藝術創作時，心如大千的視野能激發無窮的靈感。
sentences.en: When engaging in artistic creation, a mind as great as the universe can inspire boundless creativity.

sentences.zh: 心如大千，使他在處理複雜的社會關係時能夠游刃有餘。
sentences.en: A mind as great as the universe enables him to navigate complex social relationships with ease.

phrase.en: The Mind Is Like the Earth

sentences.zh: 在修行的過程中，我們應該培養心如大地的包容力，接受各種經驗和情感。
sentences.en: In the process of practice, we should cultivate the mind to be like the earth, embracing all experiences and emotions.

sentences.zh: 佛陀教導我們，心如大地，無論好壞皆能接納，且不為之動搖。
sentences.en: The Buddha taught us that the mind is like the earth, able to accept both good and bad without being disturbed.

sentences.zh: 瑜伽師常說，擁有心如大地的平靜，才能找到內心真正的安寧。
sentences.en: Yoga instructors often say that having a mind like the earth is essential to finding true inner peace.

sentences.zh: 當你面對困難時，記得讓心如大地，堅韌且無所畏懼。
sentences.en: When facing difficulties, remember to keep your mind like the earth, resilient and fearless.

phrases.zh: 心如大海無邊際
phrases.en: Let the mind be like the vast boundless ocean

phrases.zh: 廣植淨蓮養身心
phrases.en: Nurture yourself like extensively planted pure lotuses

sentences.zh: 修行者的心如大海無邊際，能包容世間一切苦痛。
sentences.en: The practitioner's mind is like the vast boundless ocean, capable of embracing all the sufferings of the world.

sentences.zh: 無論遇到多大的困難，我們都應該讓心如大海無邊際，處變不驚。
sentences.en: No matter what difficulties we encounter, we should let our mind be like the vast boundless ocean, remaining calm amidst changes.

sentences.zh: 當我們放下執著，心便能如大海無邊際，寬廣無際。
sentences.en: When we let go of attachments, our mind can be like the vast boundless ocean, broad and infinite.

sentences.zh: 禪修能讓你的心如大海無邊際，平靜而廣大。
sentences.en: Meditation can make your mind as vast and boundless as the ocean, serene and expansive.

sentences.zh: 廣植淨蓮養身心，就像在心田中種滿清淨的蓮花。
sentences.en: Nurturing yourself like extensively planted pure lotuses is like filling the field of your mind with pure lotuses.

sentences.zh: 每天練習正念，廣植淨蓮養身心，能使內心更加平靜。
sentences.en: Practicing mindfulness every day, nurturing yourself like extensively planted pure lotuses, can bring more peace to the heart.

sentences.zh: 通過修行廣植淨蓮養身心，我們能夠發現內心的純淨與平和。
sentences.en: Through practice and nurturing yourself like extensively planted pure lotuses, we can discover inner purity and peace.

sentences.zh: 廣植淨蓮養身心，如同保持心靈的花園，遠離煩惱。
sentences.en: Nurturing yourself like extensively planted pure lotuses is like maintaining a garden of the mind, away from troubles.

phrase.en: the mind is like a general who takes command

sentences.zh: 在修行中，心如將軍能行令，必須控制自己的慾望和雜念。
sentences.en: In practice, the mind is like a general who takes command and must control one's desires and distractions.

sentences.zh: 心如將軍能行令，我們要訓練自己的意志力和專注力。
sentences.en: The mind is like a general who takes command; we need to train our willpower and concentration.

sentences.zh: 在面對困難時，心如將軍能行令，可以領導我們走出迷霧。
sentences.en: When facing difficulties, the mind is like a general who takes command, leading us out of the fog.

sentences.zh: 冥想的過程中，心如將軍能行令，讓我們能夠更深入地自我探索。
sentences.en: During meditation, the mind is like a general who takes command, allowing us to delve deeper into self-exploration.

phrase.en: A Mind Bright as the Moon

sentences.zh: 在禪定中，他感受到心如明月，清明而祥和。
sentences.en: In meditation, he felt his mind bright as the moon, serene and clear.

sentences.zh: 老師的教誨讓學生們心如明月，智慧和慈悲並存。
sentences.en: The teacher's guidance made the students’ minds bright as the moon, possessing both wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 當煩惱消散時，修行者的心如明月，照亮內心的每一個角落。
sentences.en: When the troubles dissipate, the practitioner's mind is bright as the moon, illuminating every corner of the heart.

sentences.zh: 他的文章就像心如明月般的寫照，充滿了啓迪性的思想和真誠的情感。
sentences.en: His articles are a reflection of a mind bright as the moon, full of enlightening thoughts and genuine emotions.

phrase.zh: 心如明月連天地 性似虛空徹底清
phrase.en: A heart as radiant as the moon that links Heaven and Earth; A nature as crystal-clear as the vast emptiness.

sentences.zh: 修行者的心如明月連天地，能夠包容萬物，廣大無邊。
sentences.en: The practitioner's heart is as radiant as the moon that links Heaven and Earth, capable of embracing all things with infinite vastness.

sentences.zh: 當你達到性似虛空徹底清的境界，便能超越一切世俗的干擾。
sentences.en: When you attain a nature as crystal-clear as the vast emptiness, you can transcend all worldly disturbances.

sentences.zh: 禪修的目標是讓心如明月連天地，達到無我無他的大慈悲心。
sentences.en: The goal of Zen meditation is to make one's heart as radiant as the moon that links Heaven and Earth, achieving a great compassion that transcends self and others.

sentences.zh: 他的性格就像性似虛空徹底清一樣，無論什麼事情也不能動搖他內心的平靜。
sentences.en: His disposition is like a nature as crystal-clear as the vast emptiness, nothing can disturb the tranquility of his inner self.

phrase.zh: 心如明月連天淨 性似虛空徹底清
phrase.en: A heart as radiant as the moon that spans the clear sky; A nature as crystal-clear as the vast emptiness.

sentences.zh: 禪修讓他的心如明月連天淨，每次打坐都能感受到內心的寧靜。
sentences.en: Meditation made his heart as radiant as the moon that spans the clear sky; each session brought him a sense of inner peace.

sentences.zh: 當她面對困難時，她的性似虛空徹底清，不被煩惱所困。
sentences.en: When facing difficulties, her nature was as crystal-clear as the vast emptiness, untouched by troubles.

sentences.zh: 他的心如明月連天淨，使他在人群中顯得特別安詳。
sentences.en: His heart was as radiant as the moon that spans the clear sky, making him appear particularly serene among people.

sentences.zh: 修行多年，他的性似虛空徹底清，用平和的心態應對所有挑戰。
sentences.en: After years of practice, his nature became as crystal-clear as the vast emptiness, allowing him to face all challenges with a calm mindset.

phrase.en: A Mind Clear as a Mirror

sentences.zh: 修行者的心如明鏡，清晰地反映出世間的一切現象。
sentences.en: The practitioner's mind is clear as a mirror, reflecting all phenomena in the world with clarity.

sentences.zh: 在深沉的冥想中，他的心如明鏡，了無塵垢。
sentences.en: In deep meditation, his mind was clear as a mirror, free from any dust.

sentences.zh: 唯有心如明鏡，才能正確地看待人生的起伏波折。
sentences.en: Only with a mind clear as a mirror can one correctly perceive the ups and downs of life.

sentences.zh: 師父教導我們要心如明鏡，才能洞悉一切的真相。
sentences.en: The master taught us that only a mind clear as a mirror can discern the truth of all things.

phrase.en: A Mind as Pure as Flowers

sentences.zh: 他的心如淨華，待人處事皆以真誠和善意相待。
sentences.en: His mind is as pure as flowers, treating others with sincerity and kindness in all interactions.

sentences.zh: 修行佛法多年，她的心境已達到心如淨華的境界。
sentences.en: After practicing Buddhism for many years, her state of mind has reached a level as pure as flowers.

sentences.zh: 在這喧囂的都市裡，他努力保持心如淨華，不被外界的誘惑所動搖。
sentences.en: In this bustling city, he strives to maintain a mind as pure as flowers, not swayed by external temptations.

sentences.zh: 老師教導我們要心如淨華，保持內心的純淨與善良。
sentences.en: The teacher taught us to have a mind as pure as flowers, keeping our hearts pure and kind.

phrase.en: A Mind Pure as a Lotus

sentences.zh: 修行者追求心如淨蓮，以擺脫煩惱和世俗的束縛。
sentences.en: Practitioners strive for a mind pure as a lotus, seeking to transcend worldly troubles and attachments.

sentences.zh: 他的心如淨蓮，無論身處何種困境，總能保持內心的平靜與清明。
sentences.en: His mind is pure as a lotus; no matter what hardships he faces, he always maintains inner peace and clarity.

sentences.zh: 入禪定時，心如淨蓮，所有的雜念都隨之消散。
sentences.en: During meditation, the mind becomes pure as a lotus, and all distracting thoughts dissipate.

sentences.zh: 佛陀教導我們應該修心，使其心如淨蓮，不被世俗污染。
sentences.en: Buddha teaches us to cultivate our minds to be as pure as a lotus, untainted by worldly impurities.

phrase.zh: 心如淨蓮 月明千里
phrase.en: A Mind Pure as a Lotus; A Clear Moon Shining Far and Wide

sentences.zh: 修行能讓我們的心如淨蓮，不受外界的污濁所染。
sentences.en: Cultivation can make our mind pure as a lotus, untainted by external impurities.

sentences.zh: 他的心境猶如月明千里，讓人感到無比的清澈與祥和平靜。
sentences.en: His state of mind was like a clear moon shining far and wide, exuding an unparalleled sense of clarity and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義強調心如淨蓮，才能看透世間的真實。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings emphasize that only with a mind pure as a lotus can one see the true nature of the world.

sentences.zh: 在靜夜中冥想，使我們的心能夠如月明千里般清晰透徹。
sentences.en: Meditating in the quiet night allows our mind to become as clear as a moon shining far and wide.

phrase.en: The Mind Is Complete Like the Full Moon

sentences.zh: 修行人應該追求心如滿月的境界，清明而圓滿。
sentences.en: Practitioners should strive for a mind that is complete like the full moon, both clear and perfect.

sentences.zh: 心如滿月，無瑕無缺，照亮了我們內心的每一個角落。
sentences.en: The mind, complete like the full moon, is without flaw or defect, illuminating every corner of our inner self.

sentences.zh: 當你感受到心如滿月的平靜，所有的煩惱便會自然消散。
sentences.en: When you experience the tranquility of a mind complete like the full moon, all worries naturally dissipate.

sentences.zh: 透過冥想，他終於達到了心如滿月的境界，內心充滿了和諧與安寧。
sentences.en: Through meditation, he finally reached the state where his mind is complete like the full moon, filled with harmony and peace.

phrase.en: the mind is like a restless monkey

sentences.zh: 修行者經常感到心如猿猴難安住，須透過禪修來穩定心念。
sentences.en: Practitioners often feel that the mind is like a restless monkey and must stabilize their thoughts through meditation.

sentences.zh: 當面對壓力時，我們可能會發現心如猿猴難安住，但正念可以幫助我們找到平靜。
sentences.en: When facing stress, we may find that the mind is like a restless monkey, but mindfulness can help us find calm.

sentences.zh: 佛陀曾說，心如猿猴難安住，但通過持續的修行，我們可以逐漸掌控自己的心境。
sentences.en: The Buddha once said that the mind is like a restless monkey, but through continuous practice, we can gradually gain control over our mental state.

sentences.zh: 老師教導學生心如猿猴難安住，只有通過專注和冥想才能達到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: The teacher taught the students that the mind is like a restless monkey and only through focus and meditation can inner peace be achieved.

phrase.en: A Mind Like the Autumn Moon

sentences.zh: 修行得道的人，心如秋月，清明而恬靜，無所掛礙。
sentences.en: A person who has attained spiritual practice has a mind like the autumn moon, clear and tranquil, unburdened by worries.

sentences.zh: 冥想時，試著讓自己的心如秋月，平和而光明。
sentences.en: During meditation, try to make your mind like the autumn moon, peaceful and luminous.

sentences.zh: 她遇事不驚，心如秋月，總能保持冷靜和理智。
sentences.en: She remains calm and composed in the face of challenges, with a mind like the autumn moon, always able to maintain her cool and reason.

sentences.zh: 在寧靜的夜晚，觀察皓月當空，可以讓我們的心如秋月，放鬆和安定。
sentences.en: On a tranquil night, observing the bright moon in the sky can help make our mind like the autumn moon, relaxed and serene.

phrase.zh: 心如秋月 光照十方
phrase.en: A Mind Like the Autumn Moon; Light Shining in All Directions

sentences.zh: 他的內心如秋月般寧靜無波，光照十方，散發出智慧和慈悲。
sentences.en: His mind is like the calm autumn moon, shining light in all directions, emanating wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 當煩惱來襲時，保持心如秋月，讓光照十方，才能看見真正的解脫之道。
sentences.en: When troubles arise, maintaining a mind like the autumn moon and letting light shine in all directions allows one to see the true path to liberation.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該追求心如秋月，光照十方的境界，才能夠利益自己和他人。
sentences.en: Practitioners should aim for a mind like the autumn moon, shining light in all directions, in order to benefit both themselves and others.

sentences.zh: 老師的教誨如心如秋月，光照十方，讓我們在黑暗中找到方向。
sentences.en: The teacher's guidance is like the autumn moon, shining light in all directions, helping us find our way in the dark.

phrase.zh: 心如秋月明 意似春風暖
phrase.en: A heart cool like the autumn moon; A mind warm like the spring breeze.

sentences.zh: 他的修行讓他達到了心如秋月明，意似春風暖的境界。
sentences.en: His practice has led him to attain a state where his heart is cool like the autumn moon and his mind is warm like the spring breeze.

sentences.zh: 在喧鬧的世界中，她依然保持著心如秋月明，意似春風暖的平靜。
sentences.en: Amidst the bustling world, she maintains a heart cool like the autumn moon and a mind warm like the spring breeze.

sentences.zh: 即使在困難的時刻，他也能做到心如秋月明，意似春風暖，讓人感到安心。
sentences.en: Even in difficult times, he manages to keep a heart cool like the autumn moon and a mind warm like the spring breeze, bringing comfort to others.

sentences.zh: 她的性格如詩般美麗，心如秋月明，意似春風暖，令人陶醉。
sentences.en: Her character is as beautiful as poetry, with a heart cool like the autumn moon and a mind warm like the spring breeze, mesmerizing those around her.

phrase.zh: 心如蓮花不著水 性似日月不住空
phrase.en: Let the mind be a lotus that emerges dry from water; Let your nature be the sun and moon that course freely in the sky.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該保持心如蓮花不著水，不被外界的雜亂所影響。
sentences.en: A practitioner should maintain the mind like a lotus that emerges dry from water, unaffected by the chaos of the external world.

sentences.zh: 在面對挑戰時，我們應該讓性似日月不住空，自由自在地應對變化。
sentences.en: When facing challenges, we should let our nature be like the sun and moon that course freely in the sky, adapting with ease.

sentences.zh: 禪修的目的是讓心如蓮花不著水，清淨而無垢。
sentences.en: The purpose of meditation is to let the mind be like a lotus that emerges dry from water, pure and unstained.

sentences.zh: 追求內在平靜時，要讓性似日月不住空，自然流暢。
sentences.en: In the pursuit of inner peace, let your nature be like the sun and moon that course freely in the sky, flowing naturally.

sentences.zh: 在繁忙的現代生活中，很多人都會問自己這個問題：心安否？
sentences.en: In the busy modern life, many people often ask themselves this question: Is your mind at peace?

sentences.zh: 冥想能幫助你找到心靈的平靜，讓你可以問自己心安否。
sentences.en: Meditation can help you find inner peace, allowing you to ask yourself if your mind is at peace.

sentences.zh: 當面對困難的時候，保持心安是很重要的。
sentences.en: When facing difficulties, keeping your mind at peace is very important.

sentences.zh: 老師告訴學生，在每日的打坐中尋找心安，問問自己心安否。
sentences.en: The teacher advised the students to seek peace of mind in their daily meditation, asking themselves if their mind is at peace.

phrase.en: A Peaceful Mind and Unfaltering Nature

sentences.zh: 在繁忙的城市生活中，即使面臨各種挑戰，他仍能保持心安性定。
sentences.en: In the busy city life, even when facing various challenges, he can still maintain a peaceful mind and unfaltering nature.

sentences.zh: 通過長期的禪修，我們終於體會到心安性定的境界。
sentences.en: Through long-term meditation, we finally experienced the realm of a peaceful mind and unfaltering nature.

sentences.zh: 她在接收壞消息時能夠保持心安性定，這讓所有人都感到驚訝。
sentences.en: Her ability to maintain a peaceful mind and unfaltering nature while receiving bad news surprised everyone.

sentences.zh: 心安性定的生活方式使他遠離了焦慮和壓力，變得更加健康。
sentences.en: A lifestyle of a peaceful mind and unfaltering nature has kept him away from anxiety and stress, making him healthier.

phrase.zh: 心安茅屋穩 性定菜根香 世事靜方見 人情淡始長
phrase.en: A peaceful mind stays in an unshakable hut. A steady nature tastes delicacy in vegetable roots. A calm observer detects the unseen in this world. A bland relationship is the one to last long.

sentences.zh: 心安茅屋穩，財富未必帶來真正的安全感。
sentences.en: A peaceful mind stays in an unshakable hut; wealth does not necessarily bring true security.

sentences.zh: 性定菜根香，當我們內心安定時，簡單的食物也會變得美味。
sentences.en: A steady nature tastes delicacy in vegetable roots; when our mind is calm, even simple food tastes delicious.

sentences.zh: 世事靜方見，在安靜中我們才能真正看清這個世界。
sentences.en: A calm observer detects the unseen in this world; only in silence can we truly see the world clearly.

sentences.zh: 人情淡始長，平淡的人際關係才是最長久的。
sentences.en: A bland relationship is the one to last long; it is the plain and simple relationships that endure the longest.

sentences.zh: 無論外界如何喧囂，心安茅屋穩，內心的和平才是真正的穩定。
sentences.en: Regardless of external noise, a peaceful mind stays in an unshakable hut; inner peace is true stability.

sentences.zh: 性定菜根香，這句話教導我們素樸生活的美好。
sentences.en: A steady nature tastes delicacy in vegetable roots; this phrase teaches us the beauty of a simple life.

sentences.zh: 世事靜方見，在繁忙的生活中，靜心觀察才能把握真相。
sentences.en: A calm observer detects the unseen in this world; in a busy life, only by calming down can we grasp the truth.

sentences.zh: 人情淡始長，不被利害牽絆的友誼才能夠長久。
sentences.en: A bland relationship is the one to last long; friendships not bound by self-interest can endure.

phrase.zh: 心安茅屋穩 性定菜根香
phrase.en: A mind at ease finds safe abode in a thatched hut; A peaceful nature finds fragrant taste in a vegetable root.

sentences.zh: 在簡樸的生活中，心安茅屋穩，即使茅屋簡陋，也能感到心靈的平靜。
sentences.en: In a simple life, a mind at ease finds a safe abode in a thatched hut, even if the hut is humble, one can still feel a sense of peace.

sentences.zh: 即便是吃最普通的蔬菜，性定菜根香，也能品味到平和心境帶來的甘美。
sentences.en: Even when eating the most ordinary vegetables, a peaceful nature finds the fragrant taste in a vegetable root, savoring the sweetness brought by a calm mind.

sentences.zh: 修行者在簡單的居住環境中，心安茅屋穩，能夠更加專注於內心的修煉。
sentences.en: For practitioners living in simple dwellings, a mind at ease finds a safe abode in a thatched hut, allowing them to focus more on their inner cultivation.

sentences.zh: 追求心靈的平靜，心安茅屋穩，性定菜根香，使人能夠享受到生活中最單純的美好。
sentences.en: In the pursuit of inner peace, a mind at ease finds a safe abode in a thatched hut; a peaceful nature finds the fragrant taste in a vegetable root, enabling one to enjoy the simplest joys of life.

sentences.zh: 他們倆之間有一種心心相印的情誼，即使不說話也能互相理解。
sentences.en: They share a heart-to-heart connection, understanding each other even without words.

sentences.zh: 師徒之間的心心相印，使得學習佛法變得更加深刻和有意義。
sentences.en: The heart-to-heart connection between the master and disciple makes the learning of the Dharma more profound and meaningful.

sentences.zh: 夫妻之間的心心相印，是婚姻幸福的基石。
sentences.en: A heart-to-heart connection between spouses is the cornerstone of a happy marriage.

sentences.zh: 經過多年修行，他們終於達到了心心相印的境界，無需言語便能感知對方的心意。
sentences.en: After years of practice, they finally achieved a heart-to-heart connection, sensing each other's intentions without the need for words.

sentences.zh: 年輕修行者的心志開展，使他在道路上邁出了堅實的一步。
sentences.en: The soaring aspirations of the young practitioner helped him take a firm step on the spiritual path.

sentences.zh: 在老師的啟發下，學生們的心志開展，立志成為未來的領袖。
sentences.en: Inspired by their teacher, the students' soaring aspirations led them to aim to become future leaders.

sentences.zh: 老太太願望成真，看到兒孫們的心志開展，內心充滿了幸福和安慰。
sentences.en: The old lady's wish came true as she saw her children and grandchildren's soaring aspirations, filling her heart with happiness and comfort.

sentences.zh: 他的心志開展，不僅為自己奠基了成功的未來，也激勵了身邊的朋友和家人。
sentences.en: His soaring aspirations not only laid the foundation for his own successful future but also inspired his friends and family.

sentences.zh: 修行者要時刻觀照自己的心念，避免落入妄想之中。
sentences.en: Practitioners must constantly observe their thoughts to avoid falling into delusions.

sentences.zh: 我們的言行源自於心念，因此保持正念是非常重要的。
sentences.en: Our words and actions stem from our thoughts, so it is very important to maintain right mindfulness.

sentences.zh: 心念善良的人，通常會吸引更積極和幸福的經歷。
sentences.en: People with kind thoughts tend to attract more positive and happy experiences.

sentences.zh: 冥想可以幫助我們平靜心念，進一步提高內心的安寧。
sentences.en: Meditation can help calm our thoughts and further enhance inner peace.

sentences.zh: 修行佛法可以讓人心意和樂，遠離煩惱。
sentences.en: Practicing Buddhism can bring a peaceful and happy mind, free from worries.

sentences.zh: 他的心意和樂, 面對各種困難都能保持平靜。
sentences.en: With a peaceful and happy mind, he can stay calm in the face of various challenges.

sentences.zh: 每當他想起那段時光，心意和樂，倍感幸福。
sentences.en: Whenever he recalls that time, his mind becomes peaceful and happy, and he feels a profound sense of happiness.

sentences.zh: 借由禪修，能夠讓我們達到心意和樂的境界。
sentences.en: Through meditation, we can achieve a state of a peaceful and happy mind.

sentences.zh: 禪修可以幫助我們靜下心來，觀察自己的心意識。
sentences.en: Meditation can help us calm down and observe our mind, thought, and perception.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義強調淨化心意識以達到真正的平靜。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings emphasize purifying the mind, thought, and perception to achieve true tranquility.

sentences.zh: 掌握心意識的變化有助於我們更好地理解自己和周圍的世界。
sentences.en: Understanding the changes in our mind, thought, and perception can help us better understand ourselves and the world around us.

sentences.zh: 修行過程中，我們要時刻反省和調整自己的心意識。
sentences.en: During the practice, we must constantly reflect on and adjust our mind, thought, and perception.

sentences.zh: 修習佛法的人應當心懷仁慈，以慈悲為懷，普渡眾生。
sentences.en: Those who practice Buddhism should be kind and compassionate, holding compassion in their hearts to help all beings.

sentences.zh: 即使面對困難和挑戰，我們也要心懷仁慈，不失本心。
sentences.en: Even when facing difficulties and challenges, we must be kind and compassionate, never losing our true nature.

sentences.zh: 她總是心懷仁慈，無論誰需要幫助，她都會毫不猶豫地伸出援手。
sentences.en: She always remains kind and compassionate, never hesitating to offer help to those in need.

sentences.zh: 他心懷仁慈地對待每一個人，這使得他成為社區中受人尊敬的榜樣。
sentences.en: He treats everyone with kindness and compassion, making him a respected role model in the community.

sentences.zh: 佛法教導我們要心懷大千，包容所有眾生的苦難。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us to embrace the whole world, encompassing the suffering of all beings.

sentences.zh: 他心懷大千，關心整個地球環境的保護問題。
sentences.en: He embraces the whole world, showing concern for the protection of the entire planet’s environment.

sentences.zh: 在心懷大千的心境下，我們能更加理解他人的行為和動機。
sentences.en: With a mindset that embraces the whole world, we can better understand others’ actions and motivations.

sentences.zh: 她以心懷大千的態度對待每一個人，展現了無限的愛與包容。
sentences.en: She treats everyone with an attitude that embraces the whole world, showing infinite love and acceptance.

phrase.en: A Mind That Embraces the World

sentences.zh: 佛教徒應該心懷天下，以慈悲和智慧來對待每一個眾生。
sentences.en: Buddhists should embrace a mind that embraces the world, treating each being with compassion and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 他心懷天下，致力於推動世界和平與人類福祉。
sentences.en: He has a mind that embraces the world, dedicated to promoting global peace and human welfare.

sentences.zh: 在面對困難時，我們應該心懷天下，不只關注自己的利益。
sentences.en: When facing difficulties, we should have a mind that embraces the world and not focus only on our own interests.

sentences.zh: 她的領導風格是心懷天下，經常考慮到公司和員工的長遠發展。
sentences.en: Her leadership style is one that embraces the world, often considering the long-term growth of both the company and its employees.

phrase.zh: 心懷度眾慈悲願，身似法海不繫舟，問我一生何所求，平安幸福照五洲。
phrase.en: With mind as vast and boundless as emptiness, A body like an unbound boat that sails the ocean of Dharma. What merit and virtue have I accomplished in this lifetime? Peace and happiness shines upon the five continents.

sentences.zh: 他心懷度眾慈悲願，身似法海不繫舟，無論身在何處，總是盡力幫助他人。
sentences.en: He holds the vow of compassion to help beings, with a body like an unbound boat sailing the Dharma ocean, always striving to assist others no matter where he is.

sentences.zh: 她常常默念：心懷度眾慈悲願，身似法海不繫舟，以這樣的心態面對生活中的困難。
sentences.en: She often recites to herself, 'With mind as vast and boundless as emptiness, a body like an unbound boat that sails the ocean of Dharma,' facing life's challenges with this mindset.

sentences.zh: 問我一生何所求，平安幸福照五洲，這是我所追求的最高理想。
sentences.en: What merit and virtue have I accomplished in this lifetime? Peace and happiness shines upon the five continents; this is my highest aspiration.

sentences.zh: 他的一生，都在實現這一句話：心懷度眾慈悲願，身似法海不繫舟，問我一生何所求，平安幸福照五洲。
sentences.en: His entire life is dedicated to fulfilling this phrase: 'With mind as vast and boundless as emptiness, a body like an unbound boat that sails the ocean of Dharma. What merit and virtue have I accomplished in this lifetime? Peace and happiness shines upon the five continents.'

phrase.zh: 心懷度眾慈悲願，身似法海不繫舟，問我平生何功德，佛光普照五大洲
phrase.en: A heart with compassionate vows to save sentient beings My body is that of the Dharma ocean that binds no boats Ask me what have I achieved in this lifetime? May the Buddha’s Light shine over the five continents.

sentences.zh: 他心懷度眾慈悲願，希望能夠拯救每一個困苦的靈魂。
sentences.en: He carries a heart with compassionate vows to save sentient beings, hoping to rescue every suffering soul.

sentences.zh: 此僧人身似法海不繫舟，無論身處何地，皆心無掛礙。
sentences.en: This monk's body is like the Dharma ocean that binds no boats; no matter where he is, his mind remains unbound.

sentences.zh: 問我平生何功德，我只是心懷度眾的願望，默默行善。
sentences.en: Ask me what have I achieved in this lifetime? I only carry the vow to save others and silently perform good deeds.

sentences.zh: 願佛光普照五大洲，將和平與慈悲帶給每一個角落。
sentences.en: May the Buddha's Light shine over the five continents, bringing peace and compassion to every corner.

phrase.zh: 心懷法界 志在十方
phrase.en: A Mind That Embraces the Dharma Realm; Aspiration to Soar into the Entire World

sentences.zh: 他心懷法界，志在十方，願意為普度眾生而奉獻自己的一切。
sentences.en: He possesses a mind that embraces the Dharma realm and has an aspiration to soar into the entire world, willing to devote everything for the salvation of all beings.

sentences.zh: 心懷法界，志在十方，她在日常生活中處處以佛法為指引。
sentences.en: With a mind that embraces the Dharma realm and an aspiration to soar into the entire world, she guides her daily life with the principles of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 老師經常教導我們要心懷法界，志在十方，這樣才能成就無上道業。
sentences.en: The teacher often advises us to have a mind that embraces the Dharma realm and an aspiration to soar into the entire world, for this is the way to achieve supreme spiritual attainment.

sentences.zh: 心懷法界，志在十方，他在國際佛教會議上發表了精彩的演講。
sentences.en: With a mind that embraces the Dharma realm and an aspiration to soar into the entire world, he delivered an inspiring speech at the international Buddhist conference.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義指出，每個人的心有寶藏，只要你願意探索。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings state that the mind has treasures, provided you are willing to explore.

sentences.zh: 冥想可以幫助我們發現內心深處的寶藏，因為心有寶藏。
sentences.en: Meditation can help us discover the deep treasures within, as the mind has treasures.

sentences.zh: 這本書鼓勵讀者相信自己的心有寶藏，並從中尋找智慧與力量。
sentences.en: This book encourages readers to believe that the mind has treasures, and to seek wisdom and strength from it.

sentences.zh: 老師教導學生，心有寶藏，應該從內在而不是外在尋找真正的幸福。
sentences.en: The teacher instructed the students that the mind has treasures, and they should seek true happiness from within rather than from external sources.

sentences.zh: 在團隊合作中，每個人都應該心有尺寸，尊重彼此的職責和界限。
sentences.en: In team collaboration, everyone should always know their place and respect each other's roles and boundaries.

sentences.zh: 即使取得了許多成就，他依然謙虛自持，心有尺寸。
sentences.en: Despite achieving numerous accomplishments, he remains humble, always knowing his place.

sentences.zh: 為人處事，心有尺寸，有助於維持人際關係的和諧。
sentences.en: In dealing with people, always knowing your place helps maintain harmonious relationships.

sentences.zh: 她深諳心有尺寸的重要，因此在各方面都表現得十分得體。
sentences.en: She deeply understands the importance of always knowing your place, thus she conducts herself appropriately in all aspects.

sentences.zh: 無論在哪種情況下，我們都應該心有方圓，不為外界所動。
sentences.en: In any situation, we should remain clear on our principles and not be swayed by external influences.

sentences.zh: 大師教導我們要心有方圓，保持內心的和平與堅定。
sentences.en: The master taught us to remain clear on our principles, maintaining inner peace and firmness.

sentences.zh: 在面對誘惑時，他始終心有方圓，不被迷惑。
sentences.en: When facing temptations, he always remained clear on his principles and wasn't misled.

sentences.zh: 心有方圓的人，不會因眼前的利益而放棄長遠的信念。
sentences.en: A person who remains clear on their principles won't abandon long-term beliefs for immediate benefits.

sentences.zh: 修養心性，心正人安，才能在喧囂的世俗生活中找到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: Cultivating one's character, a righteous mind brings peace, enables one to find inner calm amidst the clamor of secular life.

sentences.zh: 在面對困難時，心正人安的原則可以幫助我們做出正確的決定。
sentences.en: When facing challenges, the principle that a righteous mind brings peace can help us make the right decisions.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們，心正人安，這種心境會引導我們過上更加和諧的生活。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us that a righteous mind brings peace, and this mindset leads us to live a more harmonious life.

sentences.zh: 即使在複雜的情況下，保持心正人安的精神是通向真正快樂的道路。
sentences.en: Even in complicated situations, maintaining the spirit that a righteous mind brings peace is the path to true happiness.

phrase.zh: 心正人間善，氣和天地寬
phrase.en: Righteousness makes the world virtuous; Harmony makes the universe boundless.

sentences.zh: 心正人間善，氣和天地寬，這句話鼓勵我們保持正念與和諧。
sentences.en: Righteousness makes the world virtuous; Harmony makes the universe boundless, this saying encourages us to maintain right mindfulness and harmony.

sentences.zh: 只要我們做到心正人間善，氣和天地寬，社會就會更加和諧。
sentences.en: As long as we uphold righteousness and harmony, the society will become more harmonious.

sentences.zh: 心正人間善，氣和天地寬，這是修行者應遵循的基本原則。
sentences.en: Righteousness makes the world virtuous; Harmony makes the universe boundless, this is the fundamental principle that practitioners should follow.

sentences.zh: 老師常常提醒我們，心正人間善，氣和天地寬，以鼓勵我們做個好人。
sentences.en: The teacher often reminds us, righteousness makes the world virtuous; harmony makes the universe boundless, to encourage us to be good people.

phrase.zh: 心正人間善 氣和天地美
phrase.en: Righteousness makes the world virtuous; Harmony makes the universe beautiful.

sentences.zh: 佛經講述心正人間善，讓世人明白正直之心的重要性。
sentences.en: The Buddhist scriptures talk about righteousness making the world virtuous, highlighting the importance of having an upright heart.

sentences.zh: 修行者應當堅守心正人間善，這樣方能造福眾生。
sentences.en: Practitioners should uphold righteousness to make the world virtuous, thereby benefiting all beings.

sentences.zh: 氣和天地美是指內心和諧能使外在環境也變得美好。
sentences.en: Harmony making the universe beautiful means that inner harmony can create a beautiful external environment.

sentences.zh: 當我們的心態和諧時，我們也能共創氣和天地美的世界。
sentences.en: When our mindset is harmonious, we can co-create a universe where harmony makes everything beautiful.

phrase.zh: 心正則本立 本立則道生 道生則心淨 心淨則自然
phrase.en: An upright character establishes one's principle. An established principle nurtures the Way. A nurtured Way purifies the mind. A purified mind brings perfect ease.

sentences.zh: 心正則本立，這意味著我們的品德端正，才是立身處世的根本。
sentences.en: An upright character establishes one's principle, meaning that our moral integrity is the foundation for how we conduct ourselves in life.

sentences.zh: 本立則道生，當我們的原則確立之後，自然而然就會生出智慧之道。
sentences.en: An established principle nurtures the Way; once our principles are solidified, wisdom naturally arises.

sentences.zh: 道生則心淨，有了智慧之道，我們的心靈才會變得清淨透明。
sentences.en: A nurtured Way purifies the mind; with a foundation of wisdom, our minds become clear and pure.

sentences.zh: 心淨則自然，當心靈清淨無染，我們就可以與自然界和諧共處，徹底解脫。
sentences.en: A purified mind brings perfect ease; when the mind is purified and uncontaminated, we can live harmoniously with nature and find ultimate liberation.

phrase.zh: 心正山河壯 人和萬事興
phrase.en: Righteousness begets a prosperous kingdom; Interpersonal harmony begets all success.

sentences.zh: 在治理國家中，心正山河壯，人和萬事興，領導者應該以身作則，務實處事。
sentences.en: In governing a nation, righteousness begets a prosperous kingdom, and interpersonal harmony begets all success. Leaders should lead by example and approach matters pragmatically.

sentences.zh: 企業文化強調心正山河壯，人和萬事興，從而創造了一個高效和諧的工作環境。
sentences.en: Corporate culture emphasizes that righteousness begets a prosperous kingdom and interpersonal harmony begets all success, thus creating an efficient and harmonious work environment.

sentences.zh: 我們社區的繁榮有賴於心正山河壯，人和萬事興，每一位居民都應該為和睦共處努力。
sentences.en: The prosperity of our community depends on righteousness begetting a prosperous kingdom and interpersonal harmony begetting all success. Every resident should strive for peaceful coexistence.

sentences.zh: 家庭幸福的秘訣在於心正山河壯，人和萬事興，夫妻之間的互敬互愛尤為重要。
sentences.en: The secret to a happy family lies in righteousness begetting a prosperous kingdom and interpersonal harmony begetting all success, with mutual respect and love between spouses being particularly important.

phrase.zh: 心正山河壯 家和萬事興
phrase.en: Righteousness begets a prosperous kingdom; Family harmony begets all success.

sentences.zh: 心正山河壯，領導若能保持正直，國家自然繁榮強盛。
sentences.en: Righteousness begets a prosperous kingdom; if leaders maintain integrity, the nation naturally prospers.

sentences.zh: 家和萬事興，家庭成員彼此理解和支持，所有事情都會順利進行。
sentences.en: Family harmony begets all success; when family members understand and support each other, everything progresses smoothly.

sentences.zh: 無論是國家還是家庭，心正與家和都是成功的基石。
sentences.en: Whether it is a nation or a family, righteousness and harmony are the cornerstones of success.

sentences.zh: 這句諺語告訴我們，心正山河壯，家和萬事興，所以我們要努力保持正直和家庭和睦。
sentences.en: This proverb teaches us that righteousness begets a prosperous kingdom, and family harmony begets all success; hence, we should strive to maintain integrity and family unity.

sentences.zh: 修行者在冥想中，心海宛如無限的宇宙，寬廣而深沉。
sentences.en: In meditation, the practitioner's heart's ocean seems like an infinite universe, vast and profound.

sentences.zh: 佛法教導我們要安住於自己的心海，尋找內心的平靜。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us to dwell in our heart’s ocean, seeking inner peace.

sentences.zh: 她的關懷和愛如心海般廣大無邊，包容了所有人的痛苦和歡樂。
sentences.en: Her care and love are as boundless as the heart's ocean, embracing everyone's pain and joy.

sentences.zh: 他在夢中看見心海中的蓮花冉冉升起，散發出無盡的光明。
sentences.en: He saw in his dream a lotus rising from the heart's ocean, emanating limitless light.

phrase.en: A Ferry of Compassion in the Mind's Ocean

sentences.zh: 在困境中，她的心海慈舟引導著我們走向和平與溫暖的港灣。
sentences.en: In times of adversity, her ferry of compassion in the mind's ocean guided us to a harbor of peace and warmth.

sentences.zh: 我們需要心海慈舟的引領，才能穿越內心的波濤，達到內在的安寧。
sentences.en: We need the guidance of a ferry of compassion in the mind's ocean to navigate through our inner turbulence and achieve inner tranquility.

sentences.zh: 當你在煩惱與憂愁中，記得乘坐心海慈舟，它會帶你找到解脫之路。
sentences.en: When you are troubled and worried, remember to board the ferry of compassion in the mind's ocean; it will lead you to the path of liberation.

sentences.zh: 這本書就像是一本心海慈舟的指南，幫助讀者豁然開朗，找到心靈的歸宿。
sentences.en: This book serves as a guide to a ferry of compassion in the mind's ocean, helping readers gain clarity and find a home for their souls.

phrase.en: A Ferry of Compassion in the Mind's Ocean

sentences.zh: 老師的教誨如同心海慈航，指引我們走向智慧的彼岸。
sentences.en: The teacher's teachings are like a ferry of compassion in the mind's ocean, guiding us to the shore of wisdom.

sentences.zh: 他的一番話猶如心海慈航，讓我從迷茫中找到希望。
sentences.en: His words were like a ferry of compassion in the mind's ocean, helping me find hope amidst confusion.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，我感受到內心的寧靜，恰似心海慈航，帶來無限的安詳。
sentences.en: During meditation, I felt an inner peace, akin to a ferry of compassion in the mind's ocean, bringing boundless tranquility.

sentences.zh: 佛法如心海慈航，渡過生命的無明苦海。
sentences.en: The Dharma is like a ferry of compassion in the mind's ocean, crossing the sea of life's ignorance and suffering.

phrase.en: A Heart Like the Ocean and Bright Moon

sentences.zh: 他的心海明月般寬廣，容納了所有人的痛苦與歡樂。
sentences.en: His heart is like the ocean and bright moon, capable of embracing everyone's pain and joy.

sentences.zh: 她心海明月，沉靜而明淨，使身邊的人感到平和與舒適。
sentences.en: She has a heart like the ocean and bright moon, calm and clear, making those around her feel peaceful and comfortable.

sentences.zh: 禪師的智慧如同心海明月，照亮了我們的修行之路。
sentences.en: The Zen master's wisdom is like a heart like the ocean and bright moon, illuminating our path of practice.

sentences.zh: 在繁忙的都市生活中，他一直保持著心海明月般的心境。
sentences.en: In the hustle and bustle of city life, he always maintains a heart like the ocean and bright moon.

sentences.zh: 修行佛法能使心淨，遠離貪嗔癡。
sentences.en: Practicing Buddhism can lead to a pure mind, free from greed, anger, and ignorance.

sentences.zh: 唯有心淨，人才能真正感受到內心的平靜和安寧。
sentences.en: Only with a pure mind can one truly experience inner peace and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 打坐有助於清理心淨，提升身心健康。
sentences.en: Meditation helps to purify the mind and enhance physical and mental health.

sentences.zh: 老師常常教導我們，心淨如水，才能照見本來面目。
sentences.en: The teacher often instructs us that a pure mind, like clear water, can reflect true nature.

phrase.en: A Pure Mind Makes Everything Just as Pure

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們，心淨一切淨，唯有如此才能真正解脫。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us that a pure mind makes everything just as pure, and only in this way can we achieve true liberation.

sentences.zh: 當我們內心充滿智慧與慈悲，心淨一切淨的境界自然展現。
sentences.en: When our hearts are filled with wisdom and compassion, the state of 'a pure mind makes everything just as pure' naturally manifests.

sentences.zh: 禪宗強調心淨一切淨，認為外境的清淨源於內心的清淨。
sentences.en: Zen Buddhism emphasizes that 'a pure mind makes everything just as pure,' believing that external purity stems from internal purity.

sentences.zh: 無論環境如何變遷，保持一顆純淨的心，心淨一切淨的力量會幫助我們應對一切挑戰。
sentences.en: No matter how the environment changes, maintaining a pure mind helps us cope with all challenges, embracing the power of 'a pure mind makes everything just as pure.'

phrase.zh: 心淨國土淨 人成即佛成
phrase.en: A pure mind sees the world just as pure; An attained character is no different from buddhahood.

sentences.zh: 當我們心淨國土淨，人成即佛成，便能看到這世界如同淨土一般。
sentences.en: When we hold a pure mind, seeing the world just as pure, and attain character akin to buddhahood, we see this world as a pure land.

sentences.zh: 心淨國土淨，人成即佛成，這是我們應該追求的人生目標。
sentences.en: A pure mind sees the world just as pure; an attained character is no different from buddhahood—this should be our life's pursuit.

sentences.zh: 聽著佛法，我漸漸明瞭心淨國土淨，人成即佛成的重要意義。
sentences.en: Listening to the teachings of Buddha, I gradually understood the profound significance of a pure mind sees the world just as pure; an attained character is no different from buddhahood.

sentences.zh: 每日禪修有助於我們達到心淨國土淨，人成即佛成的境界。
sentences.en: Daily meditation helps us reach a state where a pure mind sees the world just as pure; an attained character is no different from buddhahood.

phrase.zh: 心淨土淨 人成佛成
phrase.en: A Pure Mind Makes Everything Just as Pure; Buddhahood Is Attained When Human Characters Are Perfected

sentences.zh: 佛教教義中常說「心淨土淨 人成佛成」，意指個人內心的純淨能帶來外在環境的清淨。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings often state 'A Pure Mind Makes Everything Just as Pure; Buddhahood Is Attained When Human Characters Are Perfected,' meaning that a pure mind can bring about a pure external environment.

sentences.zh: 若能實踐「心淨土淨 人成佛成」，我們在日常生活中的苦惱和煩惱就會減少。
sentences.en: If we can practice 'A Pure Mind Makes Everything Just as Pure; Buddhahood Is Attained When Human Characters Are Perfected,' our daily worries and troubles will diminish.

sentences.zh: 禪修可以幫助我們達到「心淨土淨 人成佛成」的境界，帶來內心的真正和平。
sentences.en: Meditation can help us reach the state of 'A Pure Mind Makes Everything Just as Pure; Buddhahood Is Attained When Human Characters Are Perfected,' bringing true peace of mind.

sentences.zh: 通過修行和自我內省，我們可以實現「心淨土淨 人成佛成」，從而獲得精神上的覺悟。
sentences.en: Through practice and self-reflection, we can achieve the state of 'A Pure Mind Makes Everything Just as Pure; Buddhahood Is Attained When Human Characters Are Perfected,' attaining spiritual enlightenment.

phrase.zh: 心清水見月 意淨天無雲
phrase.en: Clear is the heart that sees the moon; Pure is the mind beneath a cloudless sky.

sentences.zh: 在寧靜的夜晚，心清水見月，他感受到內心的深深平靜與滿足。
sentences.en: On a tranquil night, clear is the heart that sees the moon, he felt a deep sense of inner peace and contentment.

sentences.zh: 禪定之時，意淨天無雲，他體驗到了一種無比淨化的感覺。
sentences.en: During meditation, pure is the mind beneath a cloudless sky, he experienced an incomparable sense of purification.

sentences.zh: 當你心清水見月，任何煩惱都變得微不足道。
sentences.en: When clear is the heart that sees the moon, any troubles become insignificant.

sentences.zh: 師父教導我們，心清水見月，意淨天無雲，方能見到本來面目。
sentences.en: The master taught us that clear is the heart that sees the moon; pure is the mind beneath a cloudless sky, only then can we see our true nature.

phrase.zh: 心游禪海 清涼自在
phrase.en: Traverse the Ocean of Chan; Remain Calm and Cool

sentences.zh: 禪修者心游禪海，清涼自在，尋找內在的平靜。
sentences.en: The meditator traverses the Ocean of Chan, remaining calm and cool, seeking inner peace.

sentences.zh: 在繁忙的城市，能夠心游禪海，清涼自在，是一種珍貴的能力。
sentences.en: In a busy city, being able to traverse the Ocean of Chan and remain calm and cool is a precious ability.

sentences.zh: 當面對挑戰時，她總是能夠心游禪海，清涼自在，不為外物所擾。
sentences.en: When facing challenges, she always manages to traverse the Ocean of Chan and remain calm and cool, undisturbed by external factors.

sentences.zh: 通過修行，他學會了如何心游禪海，清涼自在，以應對生活中的壓力。
sentences.en: Through practice, he learned how to traverse the Ocean of Chan and remain calm and cool, to cope with the stresses of life.

phrase.zh: 心游綠水青山外 人在黃花翠竹間
phrase.en: In mind I roam amidst the mountains and rivers; In person I am among the bamboos and flowers.

sentences.zh: 他經常冥想，心游綠水青山外，身心仿佛置身於大自然的懷抱之中。
sentences.en: He often meditates, and in his mind he roams amidst the mountains and rivers, feeling as if he is embraced by nature.

sentences.zh: 即便身處城市的喧囂，他的心靈也能夠飛越到心游綠水青山外的靜謐之地。
sentences.en: Even amidst the city's hustle and bustle, his spirit can soar to a tranquil place where in mind he roams amidst the mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 在這竹林深處的小屋裡，她感到心游綠水青山外，仿佛遠離了塵世的煩惱。
sentences.en: In the small house deep in the bamboo forest, she feels in mind she roams amidst the mountains and rivers, as if far from the world's troubles.

sentences.zh: 當他靜坐於庭院中黃花翠竹間，他的心游綠水青山外，享受一刻的安寧。
sentences.en: When he sits quietly in the courtyard among the bamboos and flowers, his mind roams amidst the mountains and rivers, enjoying a moment of peace.

sentences.zh: 禪修能讓我們的心變得如心源活水般，隨時清淨而流動。
sentences.en: Meditation can make our minds like open mind, everflowing water, always pure and fluid.

sentences.zh: 保持心源活水，意味著你要持續地保持開放和接受的態度。
sentences.en: To maintain an open mind, everflowing water means to continuously keep an open and receptive attitude.

sentences.zh: 大師用心源活水來形容應對生活變化時應有的平和心態。
sentences.en: The master used the phrase open mind, everflowing water to describe the peaceful mindset one should have when dealing with life's changes.

sentences.zh: 在追求智慧的路上，我們需要像心源活水般永不枯竭的好奇心和開放性。
sentences.en: On the path to wisdom, we need an unending curiosity and openness like an open mind, everflowing water.

phrase.zh: 心源無風雨 浩氣養乾坤
phrase.en: At the heart's source lies neither wind nor rain; With awe-inspiring virtue the world is nurtured.

sentences.zh: 當你達到心源無風雨的境界，就能在即使最艱難的環境中保持平靜。
sentences.en: When you reach the state where 'at the heart's source lies neither wind nor rain,' you can remain calm even in the harshest environments.

sentences.zh: 浩氣養乾坤，意即靠著強大的德行可以成就偉大的事業。
sentences.en: 'With awe-inspiring virtue the world is nurtured' means that great deeds can be accomplished through strong moral character.

sentences.zh: 在修行中，心源無風雨是一種至高無上的境界，只有內心無障才能抵達。
sentences.en: In spiritual practice, 'at the heart's source lies neither wind nor rain' is an ultimate state, achievable only when the mind is free of obstructions.

sentences.zh: 他的人生哲學是心源無風雨，並用浩氣養乾坤來指引自己行事。
sentences.en: His philosophy of life is 'at the heart's source lies neither wind nor rain,' and he guides his actions by 'with awe-inspiring virtue the world is nurtured.'

sentences.zh: 修行者應該努力達到心無罣礙的境界，以免受到外界干擾。
sentences.en: Practitioners should strive to reach the state of an untroubled mind to avoid external disturbances.

sentences.zh: 心無罣礙，方能看清事物的本質，做出明智的決定。
sentences.en: With an untroubled mind, one can see the true nature of things and make wise decisions.

sentences.zh: 在面對困難時，保持心無罣礙的心態能幫助我們找到解決之道。
sentences.en: Facing difficulties with an untroubled mind can help us find solutions.

sentences.zh: 每天進行冥想能讓我們培養心無罣礙的穩定心態。
sentences.en: Daily meditation helps us cultivate a stable, untroubled mind.

sentences.zh: 在迷茫的時候，禪修可以點亮我們的心燈，照亮前行的道路。
sentences.en: During times of confusion, meditation can light up our lamp of the mind, illuminating the path ahead.

sentences.zh: 他的話語如同心燈，給予在絕望中的人們希望和勇氣。
sentences.en: His words were like a lamp of the mind, giving hope and courage to those in despair.

sentences.zh: 每一次的內觀都是在清理塵埃，讓心燈更為明亮照人。
sentences.en: Each session of introspection cleans the dust, making the lamp of the mind shine brighter.

sentences.zh: 智者的教導就如同心燈，照亮我們心中的黑暗，指引我們走向智慧。
sentences.en: The teachings of the wise are like a lamp of the mind, illuminating the darkness within us and guiding us towards wisdom.

phrase.en: Light of the Mind Is Illuminating

sentences.zh: 當他深入禪修時，他感覺到心燈亮了，內心充滿了平靜和明悟。
sentences.en: As he delved deeper into meditation, he felt the light of the mind is illuminating, filling his heart with peace and clarity.

sentences.zh: 老師的教誨如同一道光芒，讓我們心燈亮了，頓悟人生的真諦。
sentences.en: The teacher's guidance was like a ray of light that illuminated our minds, making the light of the mind is illuminating, helping us to suddenly understand the true meaning of life.

sentences.zh: 在一片混亂中，她終於找到了安寧，感受到心燈亮了。
sentences.en: Amidst the chaos, she finally found peace, feeling that the light of the mind is illuminating.

sentences.zh: 當我們放下執著，心燈亮了，我們的生活變得更加明朗。
sentences.en: When we let go of our attachments, the light of the mind is illuminating, and our lives become clearer.

phrase.en: the mind is like a wild monkey and galloping horse

sentences.zh: 靜心修行能夠幫助我們平息心猿意馬的狀態，提高內在的平靜。
sentences.en: Meditative practice can help us calm the state where the mind is like a wild monkey and galloping horse, enhancing inner tranquility.

sentences.zh: 在這個快節奏的社會中，我們的心猿意馬難以集中精神。
sentences.en: In this fast-paced society, our minds are like a wild monkey and galloping horse, making it difficult to concentrate.

sentences.zh: 他的靜坐技巧已經到了爐火純青的程度，能夠輕鬆控制住心猿意馬。
sentences.en: His meditation skills have reached a masterful level, allowing him to easily control the state where the mind is like a wild monkey and galloping horse.

sentences.zh: 當壓力增加時，我們更需要方法來控制心猿意馬，保持理智和冷靜。
sentences.en: As stress levels increase, we need methods to control the mind that is like a wild monkey and galloping horse in order to stay rational and calm.

sentences.zh: 他心甘情願地接受了這項艱苦的任務，毫無怨言。
sentences.en: He was perfectly willing to take on the arduous task without any complaints.

sentences.zh: 心甘情願地幫助別人，是他一生的信念。
sentences.en: He is perfectly willing to help others, which is a belief he holds dear throughout his life.

sentences.zh: 她心甘情願地捐出她的積蓄，支持這個正義的事業。
sentences.en: She was perfectly willing to donate her savings to support the righteous cause.

sentences.zh: 即使面對困難，他依然心甘情願地履行自己的承諾。
sentences.en: Even in the face of difficulties, he remained perfectly willing to fulfill his promises.

sentences.zh: 儘管困難重重，他仍心甘情願地承擔起重任。
sentences.en: Despite the numerous challenges, he was perfectly willing to take on the heavy responsibilities.

sentences.zh: 她心甘情願地捐出所有積蓄，幫助那些需要幫助的人。
sentences.en: She was perfectly willing to donate all her savings to help those in need.

sentences.zh: 他心甘情願地跟隨老師學習佛法，無論多辛苦也從不抱怨。
sentences.en: He was perfectly willing to follow his teacher to learn Buddhism and never complained no matter how hard it was.

sentences.zh: 心甘情願地去解決問題，才能真正找到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: Only by being perfectly willing to solve the problems can one truly find inner peace.

sentences.zh: 縱使前路艱險，我們仍會永往直前，不曾退縮。
sentences.en: Even though the road ahead is perilous, we will forge bravely ahead and never retreat.

sentences.zh: 在面對未知的挑戰時，他總是鼓勵大家永往直前。
sentences.en: When facing unknown challenges, he always encourages everyone to forge bravely ahead.

sentences.zh: 成佛之道需要無怨無悔地永往直前，跨越一切困難。
sentences.en: The path to Buddhahood requires forging bravely ahead without regrets, overcoming all obstacles.

sentences.zh: 只要心中有信仰，就能在逆境中永往直前，迎接未來。
sentences.en: As long as there is faith in the heart, one can forge bravely ahead in adversity and embrace the future.

phrase.en: all dharmas arise from the mind

sentences.zh: 佛教教義中，心生萬法意味著所有現象的根源皆在於心。
sentences.en: In Buddhist teachings, 'all dharmas arise from the mind' means that the origin of all phenomena lies in the mind.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該明白心生萬法的道理，從而內觀自省，了悟心的真實本性。
sentences.en: Practitioners should understand the principle that 'all dharmas arise from the mind', thereby engaging in introspection to realize the true nature of the mind.

sentences.zh: 心生萬法的觀念強調了內心的力量，提醒我們應該善護己心。
sentences.en: The concept of 'all dharmas arise from the mind' emphasizes the power of the inner mind, reminding us to guard our thoughts carefully.

sentences.zh: 許多大師都講解過心生萬法的深奧智慧，指出心靈的轉變能夠改變外界的現象。
sentences.en: Many masters have explained the profound wisdom of 'all dharmas arise from the mind', stating that a transformation of the mind can change external phenomena.

phrase.zh: 心田(地)不長無明草 覺苑長開智慧花
phrase.en: The mind's ground does not grow weeds of ignorance; The court of enlightenment blooms flowers of wisdom.

sentences.zh: 她每天修行，心田不長無明草，覺苑長開智慧花。
sentences.en: She practices daily, so the mind's ground does not grow weeds of ignorance, and the court of enlightenment blooms flowers of wisdom.

sentences.zh: 禪修能幫助我們清理內心，使心田不長無明草，讓覺苑長開智慧花。
sentences.en: Meditation helps us cleanse our inner being, making sure the mind's ground does not grow weeds of ignorance and the court of enlightenment blooms flowers of wisdom.

sentences.zh: 學習佛法的過程中，我們要使心田不長無明草，讓覺苑長開智慧花。
sentences.en: During the process of learning Buddhism, we must ensure that the mind's ground does not grow weeds of ignorance so that the court of enlightenment blooms flowers of wisdom.

sentences.zh: 他堅持不懈地追求真理，使心田不長無明草，最終他的覺苑長開智慧花。
sentences.en: By persistently pursuing truth, he ensures that the mind's ground does not grow weeds of ignorance and ultimately, the court of enlightenment blooms flowers of wisdom.

sentences.zh: 鬧時練心安靜自在：在繁忙的環境中，她保持一顆安靜自在的心。
sentences.en: Train the mind in moments of clamor, remain calm and at ease: Amidst the bustling environment, she keeps a calm and at-ease mind.

sentences.zh: 獨時慎心不可妄為：獨處時，他謹慎地思考，從不妄為。
sentences.en: Caution the mind in moments of solitude, refrain from thoughtless actions: When alone, he cautiously contemplates, never acting thoughtlessly.

sentences.zh: 亂時定心集中精神：在混亂中，他集中精神，不受外界干擾。
sentences.en: Concentrate the mind in moments of chaos, stay in focus: In chaos, he focuses his mind, undisturbed by external factors.

sentences.zh: 怒時忍心沒有差錯：發怒時，她能忍住，不犯任何錯誤。
sentences.en: Withhold the mind in moments of anger, do not take any wrong steps: In moments of anger, she can withhold, making no mistakes.

sentences.zh: 傷時療心恢復健康：受傷之時，他透過療心迅速恢復健康。
sentences.en: Recuperate the mind in moments of hurt, regain good health: When hurt, he recuperates his mind, swiftly regaining health.

sentences.zh: 勞時專心工作易成：工作時，他專心致志，易達成目標。
sentences.en: Commit the mind in moments of hard work, goals will be accomplished: During work, he commits his mind, easily achieving goals.

sentences.zh: 苦時轉心化苦為樂：面對苦難，她能轉心，將苦痛轉化為快樂。
sentences.en: Transform the mind in moments of pain, turn it into joy: Facing hardships, she can transform her mind, turning pain into joy.

sentences.zh: 錯時改心必能成功：犯錯時，他改正心態，最終取得成功。
sentences.en: Amend the mind in moments of fault, success is within reach: Upon making a mistake, he amends his mindset, ultimately achieving success.

sentences.zh: 迷時悟心回歸正道：迷茫時，他通過覺悟重新回到正道。
sentences.en: Awaken the mind in moments of ignorance, return to the righteous path: In times of confusion, he awakens and returns to the righteous path.

sentences.zh: 妄時真心迷途知返：在妄念紛飛時，她保持真心，終於迷途知返。
sentences.en: Keep the mind genuine in moments of confusion, don't stay astray: Amidst delusional thoughts, she keeps her mind genuine, eventually finding her way back.

sentences.zh: 靜時養心禪修增上：安靜時，他透過禪修提升和養獨心。
sentences.en: Nurture the mind in moments of quietude, improve your meditative skills: In quiet moments, he nurtures and improves his meditative skills.

sentences.zh: 坐時觀心能知得失：坐下時，她觀察心態，清楚了解得失。
sentences.en: Contemplate the mind in moments of meditation, remain aware of your gains and losses: While sitting, she contemplates her mind, clearly understanding both gains and losses.

sentences.zh: 立時守心思前想後：立足時，他小心守護心神，仔細思前想後。
sentences.en: Guard the mind in moments of success, be cautious with every step: While standing, he guards his mind carefully, thinking things through.

sentences.zh: 行時小心安全第一：行路時，她小心謹慎，確保安全第一。
sentences.en: Alert the mind in moments of motion, safety comes first: Walking, she is cautious, ensuring safety above all.

sentences.zh: 言時留心說話謹慎：說話時，他留心措辭，謹慎發言。
sentences.en: Admonish the mind in moments of speaking, be careful with your words: When speaking, he pays attention to his words, careful with his speech.

sentences.zh: 學時省心容易成就：學習時，她心無旁騖，容易成就。
sentences.en: Reflect on the mind in moments of learning, achievements are within reach: During learning, she keeps her mind focused, making achievements reachable.

sentences.zh: 動時穩心不會冒失：動作時，他穩住心神，不會魯莽行事。
sentences.en: Steady the mind in moments of action, don't do anything abrupt: While acting, he steadies his mind, avoiding rash actions.

sentences.zh: 做時用心易達目標：工作時，她專心致志，目標易達。
sentences.en: Attend to the mind in moments of work, goals are possible: While working, she attends to her mind, making goals achievable.

sentences.zh: 富時捨心推己及人：富有時，他持有捨心，關愛他人。
sentences.en: Let go of the mind in moments of wealth, put yourself in others' shoes: In wealth, he practices letting go, caring for others.

sentences.zh: 睡時放心身心安然：睡眠時，她放心入睡，身心安然。
sentences.en: Rest the mind in moments of sleep, gain mental and physical peace: During sleep, she rests her mind, gaining mental and physical peace.

phrase.zh: 心真性美 花香月圓
phrase.en: Genuine Heart, Beautiful Nature; Fragrant Flowers, Perfect Moon

sentences.zh: 禪修能夠幫助我們達到心真性美，享受花香月圓的境界。
sentences.en: Zen meditation helps us achieve a genuine heart and beautiful nature, allowing us to enjoy the realm of fragrant flowers and perfect moon.

sentences.zh: 在人生的每一個階段，我們都應該努力保持心真性美，追求心靈的花香月圓。
sentences.en: At every stage of life, we should strive to maintain a genuine heart and beautiful nature, aiming for the spiritual state of fragrant flowers and perfect moon.

sentences.zh: 他的一生都在尋找心真性美，終於在一個花香月圓的夜晚找到了內心的平靜。
sentences.en: His whole life was spent searching for a genuine heart and beautiful nature, and he finally found inner peace on a night with fragrant flowers and a perfect moon.

sentences.zh: 當你達到心真性美的境界，周圍的一切都會像花香月圓一樣美好。
sentences.en: When you reach a state of genuine heart and beautiful nature, everything around you will be as beautiful as fragrant flowers and a perfect moon.

phrase.zh: 心空天地寬 意靜風浪平
phrase.en: Within an empty mind is a boundless Heaven and Earth; Across a serene mind are calm winds and waves.

sentences.zh: 當心靈放空時，天地之間變得寬廣無邊，正如心空天地寬。
sentences.en: When the mind is emptied, Heaven and Earth become boundless, just like within an empty mind is a boundless Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 在意靜風浪平的狀態下，再大的困難也能挨過。
sentences.en: In a state where across a serene mind are calm winds and waves, even the greatest difficulties can be overcome.

sentences.zh: 修行之道在於心空天地寬，意靜風浪平，才能達到真正的平和。
sentences.en: The path of cultivation lies in having an empty mind with a boundless Heaven and Earth, and a serene mind with calm winds and waves, achieving true peace.

sentences.zh: 她每天打坐冥想，體會到心空天地寬，意靜風浪平的深意。
sentences.en: She meditates daily and realizes the profound meaning of within an empty mind is a boundless Heaven and Earth, and across a serene mind are calm winds and waves.

phrase.en: An Empty Mind Embraces Myriad Existences

sentences.zh: 在深度冥想中，修行者能夠到達心空萬有的境界，感受到宇宙萬物皆為一體。
sentences.en: In deep meditation, practitioners can reach a state where an empty mind embraces myriad existences, feeling a unity with the entire universe.

sentences.zh: 禪師經常教導弟子們，只有心空萬有，才能真正理解佛法的真諦。
sentences.en: Zen masters often teach their disciples that only by having an empty mind that embraces myriad existences can they truly understand the essence of Buddha's teachings.

sentences.zh: 通過心空萬有的理念，我們可以學會接受生活中的變化，而不被情緒所左右。
sentences.en: By adopting the concept of an empty mind embracing myriad existences, we can learn to accept changes in life without being swayed by emotions.

sentences.zh: 佛經中多次提到心空萬有，強調放下執著的重要性。
sentences.en: Buddhist scriptures often mention an empty mind embracing myriad existences, stressing the importance of letting go of attachments.

sentences.zh: 在打坐的過程中，僧侶們反覆默誦心經以提升內心的平靜。
sentences.en: During meditation, the monks repeatedly chant the Heart Sutra to enhance their inner peace.

sentences.zh: 《心經》短小精悍，但卻是佛教經典中的核心經文之一。
sentences.en: The Heart Sutra is concise yet one of the core scriptures in Buddhist teachings.

sentences.zh: 她每天早晨都會閱讀心經，以祈求智慧和安寧。
sentences.en: She reads the Heart Sutra every morning to seek wisdom and peace.

sentences.zh: 《心經》中談到空性，這是佛教哲學的一個重要概念。
sentences.en: The Heart Sutra discusses the concept of emptiness, which is a crucial idea in Buddhist philosophy.

phrase.en: A Heart as Beautiful as the Flowers

sentences.zh: 他的心美如華，待人處事總是體貼入微。
sentences.en: His heart is as beautiful as the flowers, always considerate and attentive towards others.

sentences.zh: 她心美如華，流露出的善良打動了每個人的心。
sentences.en: Her heart is as beautiful as the flowers, and her kindness touches everyone's heart.

sentences.zh: 僧人說，修行要有一顆心美如華的心，才能感受到真正的慈悲。
sentences.en: The monk said that to cultivate, one must have a heart as beautiful as the flowers to truly experience compassion.

sentences.zh: 在他的書信中，流露出一顆心美如華的心，充滿了祥和與愛意。
sentences.en: His letters reveal a heart as beautiful as the flowers, filled with peace and love.

phrase.zh: 心美如華 人正似松
phrase.en: A Heart as Beautiful as the Flower; A Character as Upright as the Pine

sentences.zh: 他的心美如華，人正似松，總是在困難時刻幫助他人。
sentences.en: His heart is as beautiful as the flower, and his character as upright as the pine; he always helps others in times of need.

sentences.zh: 老師常常教導我們，做人要心美如華，人正似松，方能贏得他人的尊重。
sentences.en: Our teacher often teaches us that one should have a heart as beautiful as the flower and a character as upright as the pine to earn the respect of others.

sentences.zh: 在這個快節奏的社會中，他仍然保持著心美如華，人正似松的品德，讓人敬佩。
sentences.en: In this fast-paced society, he still upholds the virtues of having a heart as beautiful as the flower and a character as upright as the pine, earning people's admiration.

sentences.zh: 希望我們每個人都能做到心美如華，人正似松，對社會有所貢獻。
sentences.en: I hope each of us can achieve a heart as beautiful as the flower and a character as upright as the pine, contributing positively to society.

phrase.en: The Mind Can Change the Circumstance

sentences.zh: 佛教教義中提到，心能轉境，只要心態改變，外在環境也會跟著改變。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings mention that the mind can change the circumstance; if the mentality changes, the external environment will also change.

sentences.zh: 透過冥想和內省，我們可以體驗到心能轉境的力量。
sentences.en: Through meditation and introspection, we can experience the power of how the mind can change the circumstance.

sentences.zh: 許多信徒相信，心能轉境的觀念可以幫助他們克服生活中的困難和挑戰。
sentences.en: Many believers trust that the concept of the mind can change the circumstance can help them overcome life's difficulties and challenges.

sentences.zh: 當我們理解心能轉境，我們會更有力量去面對逆境，並找到解決辦法。
sentences.en: When we understand that the mind can change the circumstance, we gain more strength to face adversity and find solutions.

sentences.zh: 當她聽到好消息時，心花綻放，臉上露出了燦爛的笑容。
sentences.en: When she heard the good news, the flower of her mind blossomed, and a radiant smile appeared on her face.

sentences.zh: 通過冥想和修行，他感受到了內心的平靜與心花綻放。
sentences.en: Through meditation and practice, he experienced inner peace and the flower of his mind blossomed.

sentences.zh: 孩子們在歡樂的氣氛中，心花綻放，享受著無憂無慮的童年時光。
sentences.en: In the joyful atmosphere, the children’s minds blossomed like flowers, enjoying their carefree childhood.

sentences.zh: 她與老朋友重逢，心花綻放，談笑風生，仿佛從未分開過。
sentences.en: Reuniting with an old friend, the flower of her mind blossomed as they chatted and laughed as if they had never been apart.

sentences.zh: 當他在禪修中達到頓悟的時刻，他感受到內心的心花開。
sentences.en: When he reached a moment of enlightenment during meditation, he felt the blossoming of the mind.

sentences.zh: 每次聽到師父的開示，我都感受到心花開的喜悅。
sentences.en: Every time I listen to the master's teachings, I feel the joy of the blossoming of the mind.

sentences.zh: 在靜坐中，他深刻體悟到心花開的瞬間，這種經歷難以言喻。
sentences.en: During his silent sitting, he profoundly experienced the moment of the blossoming of the mind, which was indescribable.

sentences.zh: 她決定每天早晨冥想，希望能夠達到心花開的境界。
sentences.en: She decided to meditate every morning, hoping to reach the state of the blossoming of the mind.

sentences.zh: 當她深入禪修時，感覺心花開放，內心充滿了無盡的喜悅和寧靜。
sentences.en: As she delved deeper into meditation, she felt the flower of her mind blossoming, filling her with boundless joy and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 在煩惱解除之後，他覺得心花開放，視野變得更加清晰。
sentences.en: After releasing his worries, he felt the flower of his mind blossoming and his vision becoming clearer.

sentences.zh: 透過日常的修行，心花開放，讓他體會到生命的真諦。
sentences.en: Through daily practice, the flower of his mind blossomed, allowing him to grasp the true essence of life.

sentences.zh: 她說每當她感受深深的慈悲時，她會覺得心花開放，充滿溫暖的能量。
sentences.en: She said that whenever she felt deep compassion, she sensed the flower of her mind blossoming, filling her with a warm energy.

sentences.zh: 通過修行佛法，他最終達到了心解脫，感受到了前所未有的平靜。
sentences.en: Through the practice of Buddhism, he finally achieved liberation of mind, experiencing an unprecedented sense of peace.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，許多人尋求心解脫，擺脫世俗的煩惱和執著。
sentences.en: Many people seek the liberation of mind through meditation, aiming to rid themselves of worldly troubles and attachments.

sentences.zh: 書中描述了如何通過禪定達到心解脫，從而解脫生死輪回。
sentences.en: The book describes how to attain liberation of mind through meditation, thus freeing oneself from the cycle of birth and death.

sentences.zh: 心靈的進化需要長久的修行，最終才能達到心解脫的境界。
sentences.en: The evolution of the mind requires prolonged practice, eventually reaching the state of liberation of mind.

sentences.zh: 他的心量極大，總是能包容別人的錯誤。
sentences.en: His magnanimity is immense, always able to forgive others' mistakes.

sentences.zh: 在困難時刻，她以心量面對挑戰，並激勵身邊的人。
sentences.en: During difficult times, she faced challenges with magnanimity and inspired those around her.

sentences.zh: 佛教提倡高尚的心量，以克服內心的煩惱與怨恨。
sentences.en: Buddhism promotes magnanimity to overcome inner turmoil and resentment.

sentences.zh: 他的心量體現在日常生活的每一個方面，總是願意幫助需要的人。
sentences.en: His magnanimity is evident in everyday life, always willing to help those in need.

phrase.en: All Queries Resolved and Knots Untangled

sentences.zh: 經過師父的教誨，他心開意解，對人生的困惑頓時豁然開朗。
sentences.en: After the master's teachings, all his queries were resolved and knots untangled, bringing clarity to his life's dilemmas.

sentences.zh: 聽了這場佛法講座，他內心的疑惑心開意解，如同重見天日。
sentences.en: After listening to the Dharma talk, all his queries were resolved and knots untangled, as if he had seen the light again.

sentences.zh: 在禪坐中，他的心靈逐漸平靜，所有的問題心開意解。
sentences.en: During the meditation, his mind calmed down gradually, with all queries resolved and knots untangled.

sentences.zh: 通過修行和學習，他的心靈變得寧靜，疑團也隨之心開意解。
sentences.en: Through practice and study, his mind became tranquil, with all queries resolved and knots untangled.

phrase.en: the mind changes with the circumstances

sentences.zh: 禪修的目的是學習如何不讓心隨境轉，而是保持內心的平靜和平衡。
sentences.en: The aim of meditation is to learn how not to let the mind change with the circumstances, but to maintain inner peace and balance.

sentences.zh: 當面對困難時，他發現自己的心隨境轉，很容易被外界的變動影響到。
sentences.en: When facing difficulties, he found that his mind changes with the circumstances, easily influenced by external changes.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義教導我們不要讓心隨境轉，而是要找到內在的力量和智慧。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings instruct us not to let the mind change with the circumstances but to find inner strength and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 她在這次挑戰中學會了如何讓心不隨境轉，增強了自己的定力。
sentences.en: During this challenge, she learned how to prevent her mind from changing with the circumstances, strengthening her resolve.

sentences.zh: 在城市的喧囂中，這個心靈加油站提供了安靜的冥想空間。
sentences.en: In the midst of the city's hustle and bustle, this spiritual service center offers a peaceful meditation space.

sentences.zh: 每當感到迷茫時，我都會去心靈加油站尋找心靈的指引。
sentences.en: Whenever I feel lost, I go to the spiritual service center for guidance.

sentences.zh: 這個心靈加油站定期舉辦講座和工作坊，幫助人們尋求內心的平靜。
sentences.en: The spiritual service center regularly holds seminars and workshops to help people seek inner peace.

sentences.zh: 心靈加油站的志工們熱情地為每一個來訪者提供支持和鼓勵。
sentences.en: The volunteers at the spiritual service center warmly offer support and encouragement to every visitor.

phrase.zh: 心靜風浪平 性空天地寬
phrase.en: A serene mind sees no raging waves; An empty nature lives in a big world.

sentences.zh: 在修行佛法的過程中，心靜風浪平，無論外界如何動盪，內心都能保持平靜。
sentences.en: In the practice of Buddhism, a serene mind sees no raging waves; no matter how turbulent the outside world is, the inner self remains calm.

sentences.zh: 當一個人理解性空天地寬的道理，便能夠超越世俗的束縛，獲得真正的自由。
sentences.en: When one understands that an empty nature lives in a big world, one can transcend worldly constraints and attain true freedom.

sentences.zh: 禪修可以幫助我們達到心靜風浪平的境界，即使面對挑戰也不動搖。
sentences.en: Meditation can help us achieve a state where a serene mind sees no raging waves, remaining steadfast even in the face of challenges.

sentences.zh: 性空天地寬的觀念讓我們明白，內心的空靈與廣闊是無限的，無需為小事煩惱。
sentences.en: The concept that an empty nature lives in a big world teaches us that the spaciousness and emptiness within are limitless, and there is no need to worry about trivial matters.

sentences.zh: 修行者因善行而散發出心香，令人感到舒適和愉悅。
sentences.en: The practitioner emanates a fragrant mind due to their good deeds, making others feel comfortable and joyful.

sentences.zh: 當我們保持清淨的心靈，心香自然會隨之而來。
sentences.en: When we maintain a pure mind, a fragrant mind naturally follows.

sentences.zh: 心香不僅能讓自己愉悅，也能影響他人，使周圍環境更加和諧。
sentences.en: A fragrant mind not only brings joy to oneself, but also influences others, creating a more harmonious environment.

sentences.zh: 禪修可以幫助我們培養心香，使我們的生活更加充實和快樂。
sentences.en: Meditation can help us cultivate a fragrant mind, making our lives more fulfilling and happy.

phrase.en: A Fragrant Mind with Joined Palms

sentences.zh: 在佛前，信徒們心香合十，表達他們的無限敬意。
sentences.en: Before the Buddha statue, the devotees stood with a fragrant mind and joined palms, expressing their utmost reverence.

sentences.zh: 當她心香合十祈禱時，一種無法言喻的平靜瀰漫在她的心中。
sentences.en: When she prayed with a fragrant mind and joined palms, an indescribable peace permeated her heart.

sentences.zh: 他心香合十，默默地祝福所有生靈，希望他們都能找到真正的幸福。
sentences.en: He stood with a fragrant mind and joined palms, silently blessing all beings with the hope that they find true happiness.

sentences.zh: 禪修之後，他心香合十，感謝佛祖賜予的智慧和寧靜。
sentences.en: After meditation, he displayed a fragrant mind with joined palms, thanking the Buddha for the wisdom and tranquility bestowed upon him.

sentences.zh: 在修行的道路上，忍耐就是力量，讓我們能夠克服各種挑戰。
sentences.en: On the path of spiritual practice, endurance is power, allowing us to overcome various challenges.

sentences.zh: 他在困境中保持了冷靜，深信忍耐就是力量，終於迎來了轉機。
sentences.en: He remained calm in adversity, firmly believing that endurance is power, and finally saw a turning point.

sentences.zh: 面對痛苦與挫折時，她總是記得忍耐就是力量，從而堅持了下去。
sentences.en: When facing pain and setbacks, she always remembered that endurance is power, which helped her persist.

sentences.zh: 在工作壓力下，他依然能夠微笑面對，因為他相信忍耐就是力量。
sentences.en: Despite the pressure at work, he still managed to smile because he believed that endurance is power.

sentences.zh: 他在面對挑釁時表現出極大的忍辱，沒有讓情緒左右自己的行為。
sentences.en: He showed great patience in the face of provocation, not letting his emotions dictate his actions.

sentences.zh: 修習忍辱可以幫助我們在困難時期保持內心的平靜和安穩。
sentences.en: Practicing patience can help us maintain inner peace and stability during challenging times.

sentences.zh: 在修行中，忍辱是重要的德行之一，能讓我們更深入地理解和應對苦難。
sentences.en: In spiritual practice, patience is one of the important virtues that allows us to understand and cope with suffering more deeply.

sentences.zh: 忍辱不是忍氣吞聲，而是以智慧和慈悲心面對不公和困境。
sentences.en: Patience is not about enduring in silence, but about facing injustice and difficulties with wisdom and compassion.

phrase.en: A Will as Great as the Entire World

sentences.zh: 他立下志在天下的宏願，希望能夠改變整個社會。
sentences.en: He made a vow with a will as great as the entire world, hoping to transform the whole society.

sentences.zh: 志在天下的精神激勵著無數人勇敢追夢。
sentences.en: The spirit of a will as great as the entire world has inspired countless people to bravely pursue their dreams.

sentences.zh: 在他的自傳中，他詳述了那段志在天下的歲月。
sentences.en: In his autobiography, he detailed those years with a will as great as the entire world.

sentences.zh: 她說出自己的志在天下，讓聽眾感受到她的無限抱負。
sentences.en: She expressed her will as great as the entire world, making the audience feel her boundless ambition.

sentences.zh: 這位年輕人志在高遠，希望能夠改變世界。
sentences.en: This young man aims far and high, hoping to change the world.

sentences.zh: 她的夢想志在高遠，決心要成為一名國際知名的科學家。
sentences.en: Her dream aims far and high; she is determined to become an internationally renowned scientist.

sentences.zh: 儘管遇到諸多困難，他依然志在高遠，不曾放棄。
sentences.en: Despite facing numerous difficulties, he still aims far and high, never giving up.

sentences.zh: 學生們被鼓勵志在高遠，不僅要取得學術成就，還要對社會有所貢獻。
sentences.en: Students are encouraged to aim far and high, not only to achieve academic success but also to contribute to society.

phrase.zh: 志學有恒 成功在望
phrase.en: Aspire with Persistence; Success Is within Reach

sentences.zh: 只要我們志學有恒，成功在望，任何困難都不能阻止我們。
sentences.en: As long as we aspire with persistence, success is within reach, and no obstacle can stop us.

sentences.zh: 他的態度是志學有恒，成功在望，因此他在每個任務中都全心全意。
sentences.en: His attitude is to aspire with persistence; success is within reach, which is why he is fully committed to every task.

sentences.zh: 即使遇到挫折，他也不放棄，因為他相信志學有恒，成功在望。
sentences.en: Even when facing setbacks, he does not give up because he believes in aspiring with persistence; success is within reach.

sentences.zh: 她每天都在改進自己的技術，志學有恒，成功在望。
sentences.en: She improves her skills every day, aspiring with persistence; success is within reach.

phrase.en: Keeping busy is the best nourishment

sentences.zh: 在現代社會中，忙碌真的成為了許多人精神上的營養。
sentences.en: In modern society, keeping busy has truly become a source of mental nourishment for many people.

sentences.zh: 他總說『忙，就是營養』，認為通過忙碌可以保持心理的健康。
sentences.en: He always says, 'Keeping busy is the best nourishment,' believing that staying busy maintains mental health.

sentences.zh: 對於他來說，忙碌的生活方式讓他感到充實和滿足。
sentences.en: For him, a busy lifestyle makes him feel fulfilled and satisfied.

sentences.zh: 她深知『忙，就是營養』的道理，因此每天都安排很多活動。
sentences.en: She understands the principle that 'keeping busy is the best nourishment,' so she fills her days with a lot of activities.

sentences.zh: 在他的觀點中，忙是營養，能夠讓他保持精力充沛和積極向上。
sentences.en: In his perspective, being busy nourishes you, keeping him energized and positive.

sentences.zh: 她相信忙是營養，因為忙碌能夠充實她的生活，使她感到有價值。
sentences.en: She believes that being busy nourishes you because it enriches her life and makes her feel valuable.

sentences.zh: 工作壓力再大，他依然認為忙是營養，這讓他在職場上獲得更多的成就感。
sentences.en: Despite the work pressure, he still believes that being busy nourishes you and gives him a greater sense of accomplishment in his career.

sentences.zh: 在現代社會中，許多人認為忙是營養，他們通過不斷的努力來追求幸福和成功。
sentences.en: In modern society, many people believe that being busy nourishes you, and they strive for happiness and success through continuous effort.

sentences.zh: 儒家思想常常強調忠孝仁愛，即忠於國家，孝敬父母，仁愛他人。
sentences.en: Confucian thought often emphasizes loyalty, filial devotion, and benevolence, that is, being loyal to the country, respectful to parents, and loving towards others.

sentences.zh: 古代的君子以忠孝仁愛為立身之本，遵循道德規範。
sentences.en: In ancient times, a gentleman considered loyalty, filial devotion, and benevolence as the foundation of his character, adhering to moral principles.

sentences.zh: 他的一生都在實踐忠孝仁愛的價值觀，不僅照顧家人，還幫助社區中的每一個人。
sentences.en: Throughout his life, he practiced the values of loyalty, filial devotion, and benevolence, not only taking care of his family but also helping everyone in the community.

sentences.zh: 在家庭教育中，父母常教導孩子要有忠孝仁愛，這是做人的基本道理。
sentences.en: In family education, parents often teach their children about the importance of loyalty, filial devotion, and benevolence, emphasizing these as fundamental principles of being a person.

phrase.zh: 忠孝仁愛 信義和平
phrase.en: Loyalty, Filial Devotion, Benevolence; Righteousness and Peace

sentences.zh: 在他的教誨中，忠孝仁愛 信義和平是最重要的美德。
sentences.en: In his teachings, Loyalty, Filial Devotion, Benevolence; Righteousness and Peace are the most important virtues.

sentences.zh: 古代的社會崇尚忠孝仁愛 信義和平，這些價值觀深深影響了後世。
sentences.en: Ancient societies esteemed values of Loyalty, Filial Devotion, Benevolence; Righteousness and Peace, profoundly influencing future generations.

sentences.zh: 家長們常常教導孩子要遵守忠孝仁愛 信義和平，以成為一個有德行的人。
sentences.en: Parents often teach their children to uphold Loyalty, Filial Devotion, Benevolence; Righteousness and Peace to become virtuous individuals.

sentences.zh: 這本書深刻闡述了忠孝仁愛 信義和平在現代生活中的應用。
sentences.en: This book deeply explores the application of Loyalty, Filial Devotion, Benevolence; Righteousness and Peace in modern life.

phrase.zh: 忠孝信義無古今 仁山智水有真心
phrase.en: Loyal, dutiful, honest, and righteous minds transcend past and future; Majestic benevolence and everflowing wisdom reveal a true heart.

sentences.zh: 忠孝信義無古今，他不因時間的轉變而改變初心。
sentences.en: Loyal, dutiful, honest, and righteous minds transcend past and future; he remained steadfast despite the passage of time.

sentences.zh: 仁山智水有真心，如同這座山川般，無論時光如何變遷，真心始終不變。
sentences.en: Majestic benevolence and everflowing wisdom reveal a true heart; just like this landscape, the true heart remains the same over time.

sentences.zh: 她以忠孝信義對待所有的人，無分古今，皆保持真誠。
sentences.en: She treats everyone with loyalty, dutifulness, honesty, and righteousness, transcending past and future, always maintaining sincerity.

sentences.zh: 他的智慧如流水般源源不絕，正如仁山智水有真心，顯示他內在的仁愛與真誠。
sentences.en: His wisdom flows endlessly, much like majestic benevolence and everflowing wisdom, revealing his inner benevolence and sincerity.

phrase.zh: 忠孝信義無古今 仁山智水有真情
