sentences.zh: 禪修時，我們常常觀想日出大地曉、花開萬里香的景象，以安靜心神。
sentences.en: During meditation, we often visualize the scene of when the sun rises and illuminates the world; Flowers bloom with permeating fragrances to calm the mind.

sentences.zh: 詩人以‘日出大地曉，花開萬里香’來形容春天的到來，充滿了希望與生機。
sentences.en: The poet uses ‘when the sun rises and illuminates the world; Flowers bloom with permeating fragrances’ to describe the arrival of spring, full of hope and vitality.

phrase.zh: 日出大地曉 風和四季春
phrase.en: When the sun rises and illuminates the world; Soothing winds send spring across all four seasons.

sentences.zh: 當日出大地曉，風和四季春，我們可以感受到自然的祥和與美麗。
sentences.en: When the sun rises and illuminates the world; Soothing winds send spring across all four seasons, we can feel the harmony and beauty of nature.

sentences.zh: 日出大地曉，風和四季春，這正是世間最美的景色。
sentences.en: When the sun rises and illuminates the world; Soothing winds send spring across all four seasons, this is truly the most beautiful scenery in the world.

sentences.zh: 在日出大地曉、風和四季春的時刻，心靈得到寧靜和滿足。
sentences.en: In the moment when the sun rises and illuminates the world, and soothing winds send spring across all four seasons, the mind attains peace and fulfillment.

sentences.zh: 每當日出大地曉，風和四季春，我們便知曉新的希望和開始。
sentences.en: Whenever the sun rises and illuminates the world, and soothing winds send spring across all four seasons, we know new hope and beginnings are at hand.

phrase.zh: 日日是好日 處處是好處
phrase.en: Every day is a good day; Every place is a good place.

sentences.zh: 只要心境平和，日日是好日，處處是好處。
sentences.en: As long as your mind is at peace, every day is a good day, and every place is a good place.

sentences.zh: 她相信日日是好日，處處是好處，無論遇到什麼困難都能從容面對。
sentences.en: She believes that every day is a good day and every place is a good place, calmly facing any difficulties that come her way.

sentences.zh: 即使在最黑暗的時刻，他也堅信日日是好日，處處是好處，心中充滿希望。
sentences.en: Even in the darkest moments, he firmly believes that every day is a good day, and every place is a good place, with hope in his heart.

sentences.zh: 我們應該學會感恩，這樣日日是好日，處處是好處。
sentences.en: We should learn to be grateful, so that every day becomes a good day and every place becomes a good place.

phrase.zh: 日日是好時 處處是好地
phrase.en: Every day is a good day; Every place is a good place.

sentences.zh: 修行者通達人生，認為日日是好時，處處是好地。
sentences.en: Practitioners who understand life view every day as a good day, and every place as a good place.

sentences.zh: 無論遇到何種境遇，他總是抱持著日日是好時，處處是好地的心態。
sentences.en: No matter what circumstances he encounters, he always maintains the mindset that every day is a good day, and every place is a good place.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，師父教導我們要以日日是好時，處處是好地的心境面對一切。
sentences.en: In meditation practice, the master taught us to face everything with the mindset that every day is a good day, and every place is a good place.

sentences.zh: 這句禪語強調了心境的重要，不管身處何地，皆可體會日日是好時，處處是好地的美好。
sentences.en: This Zen saying emphasizes the importance of one’s mindset, suggesting that no matter where you are, you can always experience the beauty of every day being a good day and every place being a good place.

phrase.zh: 日日皆如意 歲歲都平安
phrase.en: May every day be a good day; Each year be a peaceful year.

sentences.zh: 願你日日皆如意，歲歲都平安，這是我們對彼此最真摯的祝願。
sentences.en: May every day be a good day, and each year be a peaceful year. This is our most sincere wish for each other.

sentences.zh: 在新的一年里，祝大家日日皆如意，歲歲都平安。
sentences.en: In the new year, I wish everyone every day be a good day, and each year be a peaceful year.

sentences.zh: 無論風雨或晴天，我都希望你能日日皆如意，歲歲都平安。
sentences.en: Whether through rain or shine, I hope that may every day be a good day and each year be a peaceful year for you.

sentences.zh: 她深信，只要心存善念，便能實現日日皆如意，歲歲都平安的生活。
sentences.en: She firmly believes that as long as there is goodwill in one's heart, one can achieve a life where every day is a good day and each year is a peaceful year.

sentences.zh: 佛教經典中常用日月光來比喻智慧的光明，照亮眾生的心靈。
sentences.en: In Buddhist scriptures, the sun, moon, and light are often used as metaphors for the brilliance of wisdom, illuminating the hearts of beings.

sentences.zh: 在那座古老的寺廟中，日月光透過彩色玻璃窗灑在地板上，營造出一片神聖的氛圍。
sentences.en: In the ancient temple, the sun, moon, and light streamed through the stained glass windows, creating a sacred atmosphere.

sentences.zh: 日月光不僅是自然現象，更是佛陀智慧的象徵，提醒我們要追求內在的光明。
sentences.en: The sun, moon, and light are not just natural phenomena but also symbols of Buddha's wisdom, reminding us to seek inner brightness.

sentences.zh: 無論日月光如何變幻，我們都應該穩定心念，尋找內心的平靜。
sentences.en: Regardless of how the sun, moon, and light change, we should stabilize our minds and seek inner peace.

phrase.zh: 日月放光明 山河增天色
phrase.en: When the sun and moon shine on the world; Rivers and mountains add color to the sky.

sentences.zh: 清晨的日月放光明，山河增天色，讓大地充滿無限生機。
sentences.en: In the morning, when the sun and moon shine on the world, rivers and mountains add color to the sky, filling the earth with infinite vitality.

sentences.zh: 他們在山頂靜靜地觀賞著日月放光明、山河增天色的美景，感受到宇宙的浩瀚。
sentences.en: They quietly watched from the mountain top as the sun and moon shone on the world and rivers and mountains added color to the sky, feeling the vastness of the universe.

sentences.zh: 日月放光明，山河增天色的景象讓人聯想到自然界的壯麗和諧。
sentences.en: When the sun and moon shine on the world, and rivers and mountains add color to the sky, it reminds people of the magnificence and harmony of nature.

sentences.zh: 古詩中常用日月放光明，山河增天色的意象來表達對自然界的讚美。
sentences.en: In ancient poetry, the imagery of the sun and moon shining on the world, and rivers and mountains adding color to the sky, is often used to express admiration for nature.

sentences.zh: 日月星辰運行自有其規律，不會因人的意願而改變。
sentences.en: The sun, moon, and stars follow their own patterns and will not change according to human will.

sentences.zh: 佛教經典中，日月星象常被用來比喻人生的無常。
sentences.en: In Buddhist scriptures, the sun, moon, and star phenomena are often used as metaphors for the impermanence of life.

sentences.zh: 修行之人應如日月星一般，光明清淨，照亮他人心靈。
sentences.en: Practitioners should be like the sun, moon, and star, bright and pure, illuminating the hearts of others.

sentences.zh: 在寧靜的夜空下，觀察日月星辰可以幫助我們悟出宇宙的奧秘。
sentences.en: Observing the sun, moon, and stars under a tranquil night sky can help us gain insight into the mysteries of the universe.

sentences.zh: 日本佛教大藏經是佛教經典的完整集合，其中包括經、律、耶三藏。
sentences.en: The Japanese Buddhist Tripitaka is a complete collection of Buddhist scriptures, including the Sutra, Vinaya, and Abhidharma Pitaka.

sentences.zh: 學者們常常利用日本佛教大藏經進行佛教研究和學術分析。
sentences.en: Scholars often use the Japanese Buddhist Tripitaka for Buddhist research and academic analysis.

sentences.zh: 日本佛教大藏經的翻譯工作繁瑣但至關重要，因為它可以促進佛教在世界範圍內的傳播。
sentences.en: The translation work of the Japanese Buddhist Tripitaka is tedious but crucial, as it facilitates the spread of Buddhism worldwide.

sentences.zh: 在日常修行中，日本佛教徒經常誦讀日本佛教大藏經以求得心靈上的平靜和智慧。
sentences.en: In their daily practice, Japanese Buddhists often recite texts from the Japanese Buddhist Tripitaka to attain inner peace and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 日本奈良藥師寺是日本古老且著名的佛教寺廟。
sentences.en: Yakushi Temple in Nara, Japan is an ancient and famous Buddhist temple.

sentences.zh: 每年有成千上萬的遊客和信徒參訪日本奈良藥師寺。
sentences.en: Each year, thousands of tourists and devotees visit the Yakushi Temple in Nara, Japan.

sentences.zh: 日本奈良藥師寺以其優美的建築和豐富的歷史文化吸引了眾多人。
sentences.en: Yakushi Temple in Nara, Japan attracts many people with its beautiful architecture and rich cultural history.

sentences.zh: 在日本奈良藥師寺裡，人們可以感受到深厚的佛教傳統和精神力量。
sentences.en: In Yakushi Temple in Nara, Japan, one can feel the profound Buddhist traditions and spiritual strength.

sentences.zh: 日本法隆寺是日本歷史最悠久的佛教寺廟之一，建於公元607年。
sentences.en: Horyu Temple in Japan is one of Japan's oldest Buddhist temples, built in 607 AD.

sentences.zh: 日本法隆寺被聯合國教科文組織列為世界文化遺產。
sentences.en: Horyu Temple in Japan has been designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

sentences.zh: 法隆寺內保存了許多寶貴的歷史文物和佛教藝術品。
sentences.en: Horyu Temple in Japan houses many valuable historical artifacts and Buddhist artworks.

sentences.zh: 每年都有大量的信徒和遊客參觀日本法隆寺，欣賞其獨特的建築風格。
sentences.en: Every year, many worshippers and tourists visit Horyu Temple in Japan to admire its unique architectural style.

sentences.zh: 日蓮正宗創價學會致力於推廣人間革命和世界和平。
sentences.en: The Soka Gakkai Society is dedicated to promoting human revolution and world peace.

sentences.zh: 他的信仰源自於日蓮正宗創價學會的教義，這讓他在生活中找到了方向。
sentences.en: His faith is rooted in the teachings of the Soka Gakkai Society, which has given him direction in life.

sentences.zh: 日蓮正宗創價學會的成員經常參加各種社區服務活動，以實踐利他主義。
sentences.en: Members of the Soka Gakkai Society often participate in various community service activities to practice altruism.

sentences.zh: 通過加入日蓮正宗創價學會，她發現了一個充滿支持和信仰的社群。
sentences.en: By joining the Soka Gakkai Society, she found a community full of support and faith.

phrase.en: It is too late to ever say, 'If only I had known.'

sentences.zh: 她經常感嘆，早知今日，悔不當初，當年應該更加珍惜父母在世的時光。
sentences.en: She often laments, it is too late to ever say, 'If only I had known,' she should have cherished the time with her parents more when they were still alive.

sentences.zh: 早知今日，悔不當初，他後悔沒有早些開始學習投資理財。
sentences.en: It is too late to ever say, 'If only I had known,' he regrets not starting to learn about investment and finance earlier.

sentences.zh: 在經歷失敗後，他終於明白了早知今日，悔不當初的道理。
sentences.en: After experiencing failure, he finally understood the meaning of, 'It is too late to ever say, 'If only I had known.''

sentences.zh: 早知今日，悔不當初，她不應該輕易放棄那段感情。
sentences.en: It is too late to ever say, 'If only I had known,' she should not have easily given up on that relationship.

sentences.zh: 佛陀教導我們要明因識果，了解一切事物的因果關係。
sentences.en: The Buddha taught us to understand causes and recognize effects, comprehending the causal relationship of all things.

sentences.zh: 他努力明因識果，尋找問題的根本原因，以找到解決之道。
sentences.en: He strives to understand causes and recognize effects, seeking the root of the problem to find a solution.

sentences.zh: 明因識果的智慧能幫助我們減少煩惱，過上更平和的生活。
sentences.en: The wisdom to understand causes and recognize effects can help us reduce troubles and lead a more peaceful life.

sentences.zh: 在修行的過程中，明因識果是一個關鍵的概念，幫助修行者增進智慧。
sentences.en: In the process of practice, understanding causes and recognizing effects is a key concept that helps practitioners enhance their wisdom.

phrase.zh: 明因識果知緣起 了生脫死證菩提
phrase.en: Be aware of the cause, recognize the effects, and understand the conditions; Transcend birth, be liberated from death, and attain Bodhi wisdom.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒通過明因識果知緣起，了解世間的一切因果關係。
sentences.en: Buddhists seek to be aware of the cause, recognize the effects, and understand the conditions to comprehend the causal relationships in the world.

sentences.zh: 修行者應努力了生脫死證菩提，以達至究竟的解脫和智慧。
sentences.en: Practitioners should strive to transcend birth, be liberated from death, and attain Bodhi wisdom to achieve ultimate liberation and enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 通過冥想和智慧，可以明因識果知緣起，從而超越生死的輪迴。
sentences.en: Through meditation and wisdom, one can be aware of the cause, recognize the effects, and understand the conditions, thereby transcending the cycle of birth and death.

sentences.zh: 導師教導我們如何了生脫死證菩提，使我們能夠解脫煩惱，獲得永恆的智慧。
sentences.en: The teacher guides us on how to transcend birth, be liberated from death, and attain Bodhi wisdom, helping us to overcome suffering and attain eternal wisdom.

sentences.zh: 相信明天更好，我們要活在希望中，不要被今日的困難擊倒。
sentences.en: Believe that tomorrow is a better day; we must live with hope and not be overwhelmed by today's difficulties.

sentences.zh: 每當我感到沮喪時，我總是告訴自己明天更好，這給了我繼續前進的力量。
sentences.en: Whenever I feel down, I always tell myself that tomorrow is a better day, and this gives me the strength to keep moving forward.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們要以平和的心態面對一切，因為明天更好。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us to face everything with a peaceful mind, because tomorrow is a better day.

sentences.zh: 在黑暗的時候，記住明天更好，它能給你帶來光明和希望。
sentences.en: In times of darkness, remember that tomorrow is a better day; it can bring you light and hope.

phrase.en: Tomorrow Will Be a Better Day

sentences.zh: 儘管今天面臨許多挑戰，我們堅信明天會更好。
sentences.en: Despite facing many challenges today, we firmly believe that tomorrow will be a better day.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們要有希望，因為明天會更好。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us to have hope, for tomorrow will be a better day.

sentences.zh: 每當生活艱難時，我總是提醒自己，明天會更好。
sentences.en: Whenever life gets tough, I always remind myself that tomorrow will be a better day.

sentences.zh: 老師鼓勵學生們不要放棄，因為明天會更好。
sentences.en: The teacher encouraged the students not to give up, because tomorrow will be a better day.

sentences.zh: 修行佛法可以幫助我們達到明心的境界，看清真正的自我。
sentences.en: Practicing Buddhism can help us attain a clear mind, seeing our true selves.

sentences.zh: 在繁忙的日常生活中，保持明心有助於我們應對壓力和挑戰。
sentences.en: Maintaining a clear mind in our busy daily lives helps us cope with stress and challenges.

sentences.zh: 通過靜坐冥想，我們可以逐漸體驗到明心的平靜和安詳。
sentences.en: Through seated meditation, we can gradually experience the tranquility and serenity of a clear mind.

sentences.zh: 明心在佛教的修行中是一個重要的目標，它讓我們能夠更加智慧和慈悲地生活。
sentences.en: Having a clear mind is an important goal in Buddhist practice, enabling us to live more wisely and compassionately.

phrase.en: A Clear Mind Awakens to the Way

sentences.zh: 經過多年的修行，他終於明心悟道，找到了內心的平靜。
sentences.en: After many years of practice, he finally cleared his mind and awakened to the Way, finding inner peace.

sentences.zh: 在禪坐中，我們可以逐漸達到明心悟道的境界，洞察生命的真相。
sentences.en: Through meditation, we can gradually reach a state where a clear mind awakens to the Way, gaining insight into the truth of life.

sentences.zh: 佛祖的教誨讓眾生有機會明心悟道，擺脫苦海。
sentences.en: The Buddha's teachings give beings the opportunity to clear their minds and awaken to the Way, freeing themselves from the sea of suffering.

sentences.zh: 只有放下執念，才能真正達到明心悟道的境界。
sentences.en: Only by letting go of attachments can one truly reach a state where a clear mind awakens to the Way.

phrase.zh: 明心能見道 入世不求名
phrase.en: An awakened mind that sees the Way; A this-worldly life that does not seek fame.

sentences.zh: 他通過禪修達到了明心能見道的境界，內心平靜且充滿智慧。
sentences.en: Through meditation, he reached a state of an awakened mind that sees the Way, finding inner peace and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 明心能見道的人常常能看透世間一切苦難和虛幻。
sentences.en: A person with an awakened mind that sees the Way can often see through the suffering and illusions of the world.

sentences.zh: 她選擇了入世不求名的生活方式，專注於幫助他人，而不是追求個人榮譽。
sentences.en: She chose a this-worldly life that does not seek fame, focusing on helping others rather than pursuing personal glory.

sentences.zh: 即使在世俗中，他依然保持入世不求名的精神，不讓名利干擾他的心靈。
sentences.en: Even in the secular world, he maintains a this-worldly life that does not seek fame, not letting fame and fortune disturb his mind.

phrase.en: to realize the mind and see one's true nature

sentences.zh: 通過禪修，他逐漸明心見性，感受到內心的平靜與喜悅。
sentences.en: Through meditation, he gradually realized the mind and saw his true nature, experiencing inner peace and joy.

sentences.zh: 那些經歷了深刻覺悟的人往往能夠明心見性，超越世俗的煩惱。
sentences.en: Those who have undergone profound enlightenment often realize the mind and see their true nature, transcending worldly troubles.

sentences.zh: 老師告訴我們，明心見性是通向解脫的重要一步。
sentences.en: The teacher told us that to realize the mind and see one's true nature is an important step towards liberation.

sentences.zh: 經過多年的修行，她終於明心見性，理解了生命的真正意義。
sentences.en: After years of practice, she finally realized the mind and saw her true nature, understanding the true meaning of life.

phrase.zh: 明月一池水 清風萬卷書
phrase.en: In a pond see the bright moon; In the cool breeze scroll through the books.

sentences.zh: 在寧靜的夜晚，明月一池水，清風萬卷書，心靈得到了極大的安慰。
sentences.en: On a tranquil night, seeing the bright moon in a pond and scrolling through books in the cool breeze deeply comforted the soul.

sentences.zh: 在禪修之中，體會到明月一池水，清風萬卷書的平靜和智慧。
sentences.en: During meditation, one can experience the tranquility and wisdom in seeing the bright moon in a pond and scrolling through books in the cool breeze.

sentences.zh: 讀書的時候，窗外明月一池水，清風拂面，讓人心情舒暢。
sentences.en: While reading, the bright moon reflected in a pond outside and the cool breeze on my face made me feel blissful.

sentences.zh: 在鄉村度假時，夜晚伴隨著明月一池水，清風萬卷書，你會感受到什麼叫做真正的放鬆。
sentences.en: During a countryside vacation, the evenings with the bright moon in a pond and scrolling through books in the cool breeze let you experience what true relaxation means.

phrase.zh: 明月一池水 青山萬卷書
phrase.en: In a pond see the bright moon; Within the greenery scroll through the books.

sentences.zh: 明月一池水，照映出池中的波光粼粼，如詩如畫。
sentences.en: In a pond see the bright moon, reflecting its shimmering light in the water, creating a poetic and picturesque scene.

sentences.zh: 青山環抱，萬卷古書彷彿在自然的壯麗中沉靜閱讀。
sentences.en: Within the greenery, scroll through the books as if reading in the serene embrace of nature’s grandeur.

sentences.zh: 禪師常說，明月一池水，青山萬卷書，教人從自然中汲取智慧。
sentences.en: The Zen master often says, 'In a pond see the bright moon; Within the greenery scroll through the books,' teaching people to draw wisdom from nature.

sentences.zh: 這個地方幽靜怡人，令人想起了“明月一池水，青山萬卷書”的意境。
sentences.en: This tranquil place reminds one of the saying, 'In a pond see the bright moon; Within the greenery scroll through the books.'

phrase.zh: 明月心中照 慈雲足下生
phrase.en: Inside the heart shines the bright moon; Beneath the feet arise clouds of compassion.

sentences.zh: 修行者在靜坐中體會到明月心中照，慈雲足下生的境界。
sentences.en: The practitioner experienced the state where inside the heart shines the bright moon, and beneath the feet arise clouds of compassion during meditation.

sentences.zh: 他的善行讓人感受到明月心中照，慈雲足下生的真諦。
sentences.en: His kind deeds made people feel the true essence of inside the heart shines the bright moon; beneath the feet arise clouds of compassion.

sentences.zh: 在這片祥和的禪林中，仿佛能感受到明月心中照，慈雲足下生。
sentences.en: In this peaceful Zen forest, it feels as if inside the heart shines the bright moon; beneath the feet arise clouds of compassion.

sentences.zh: 老師常常提醒我們要保持心靈的純淨，就如明月心中照，慈雲足下生一般。
sentences.en: The teacher often reminds us to maintain purity of mind, just like inside the heart shines the bright moon; beneath the feet arise clouds of compassion.

phrase.zh: 明月松間照 清泉石上流
phrase.en: Inbetween the pines shines the bright moon, Over rocks and boulders flows the pure stream.

sentences.zh: 在這個寧靜的夜晚，明月松間照，清泉石上流，讓人感受到自然的祥和與寧靜。
sentences.en: On this tranquil night, inbetween the pines shines the bright moon, over rocks and boulders flows the pure stream, invoking a sense of peace and serenity in nature.

sentences.zh: 古詩中常有描寫明月松間照，清泉石上流的意境，表達對自然景觀的讚美。
sentences.en: Classical poetry often describes the imagery of inbetween the pines shines the bright moon, over rocks and boulders flows the pure stream, praising the beauty of natural landscapes.

sentences.zh: 在山林中漫步時，你會發現明月松間照，清泉石上流的景象，彷彿置身於一幅畫中。
sentences.en: While strolling in the mountains, you may come across the scene where inbetween the pines shines the bright moon, over rocks and boulders flows the pure stream, as if you are part of a painting.

sentences.zh: 夜晚的山谷中，明月松間照，清泉石上流，這幅美景讓人流連忘返。
sentences.en: In the valley at night, inbetween the pines shines the bright moon, over rocks and boulders flows the pure stream, creating a picturesque sight that leaves people deeply enchanted.

sentences.zh: 在這明月清風的夜晚，禪房裡的僧人們正靜心打坐。
sentences.en: On this night of bright moon and cool breeze, the monks in the meditation hall are sitting in quiet contemplation.

sentences.zh: 明月清風相伴，我在花園裡讀經書，心靈頓感清涼。
sentences.en: Accompanied by the bright moon and cool breeze, I read the scriptures in the garden, my mind feeling instantly refreshed.

sentences.zh: 這幅畫描繪了明月清風之景，給人一種無比寧靜的感覺。
sentences.en: This painting depicts the scene of the bright moon and cool breeze, imparting a sense of profound tranquility.

sentences.zh: 在這樣的明月清風下散步，讓我的心境更加平和。
sentences.en: Walking under such a bright moon and cool breeze makes my mind more serene.

phrase.zh: 明月當空 吉星高照
phrase.en: A Bright Moon Shines Up High; Auspicious Stars Shine High Above

sentences.zh: 在這個寧靜的夜晚，明月當空吉星高照，讓人感到無限祥和。
sentences.en: On this serene night, a bright moon shines up high and auspicious stars shine high above, bringing a sense of boundless peace.

sentences.zh: 農曆新年之夜，明月當空吉星高照，象徵著來年的萬事如意。
sentences.en: On the night of the Lunar New Year, a bright moon shines up high and auspicious stars shine high above, symbolizing good fortune for the coming year.

sentences.zh: 當困難時期終於過去，我們仰望天空，明月當空吉星高照，感受到希望的光芒。
sentences.en: When the difficult times finally passed, we looked up at the sky where a bright moon shone up high and auspicious stars shone high above, feeling the glow of hope.

sentences.zh: 今晚的登山旅途，在明月當空吉星高照的光芒下，格外浪漫和神秘。
sentences.en: Tonight's hiking journey, under the bright moon shining up high and the auspicious stars shining high above, felt particularly romantic and mysterious.

phrase.en: A Chan Mind Like the Bright Moon

sentences.zh: 在靜謐的夜晚，他盤膝而坐，心中有著明月禪心，感受著內在的平靜與清明。
sentences.en: In the quiet night, he sat cross-legged, harboring a Chan mind like the bright moon, feeling inner peace and clarity.

sentences.zh: 禪修能讓人達到如明月禪心般的純淨心境，無垢無染。
sentences.en: Meditation can lead one to attain a mind like the bright moon, pure and uncontaminated.

sentences.zh: 她的微笑如明月禪心般安詳，讓人感到無比的舒適和安穩。
sentences.en: Her smile was as serene as a Chan mind like the bright moon, making people feel incredibly comfortable and secure.

sentences.zh: 他常常在庭院中仰望明月，希冀能修得一顆明月禪心，超越世俗雜染。
sentences.en: He often gazed at the bright moon in the courtyard, hoping to cultivate a Chan mind like the bright moon, transcending worldly defilements.

phrase.zh: 明月青松不見老 茅舍白雲任去來
phrase.en: Traces of age invisible in the bright moon and verdant pines; The freedom of clouds to come and go over the thatched hut.

sentences.zh: 明月青松不見老，穿越歲月依舊清新寧靜。
sentences.en: Traces of age invisible in the bright moon and verdant pines, remaining fresh and tranquil through the ages.

sentences.zh: 茅舍白雲任去來，隨心而行，無拘無束。
sentences.en: The freedom of clouds to come and go over the thatched hut, moving freely and unrestrained.

sentences.zh: 在這個寧靜的夜晚，明月青松不見老，抬頭即見。
sentences.en: On this tranquil night, traces of age invisible in the bright moon and verdant pines, seen upon looking up.

sentences.zh: 生活在茅舍中，白雲任去來，這便是無為而安的境界。
sentences.en: Living in a thatched hut, with the freedom of clouds to come and go, epitomizes the state of effortless peace.

phrase.zh: 明末四大師; 1. 憨山大師 2. 紫柏大師 3. 蓮池大師 4. 蕅益大師
phrase.en: Four Masters of the Ming Dynasty: 1. Master Hanshan; 2. Master Zibo; 3. Master Lianchi; 4. Master Ouyi

sentences.zh: 明末四大師之一，憨山大師，以其深厚的禪修和學術著作著稱。
sentences.en: Hanshan, one of the Four Masters of the Ming Dynasty, was renowned for his profound meditation practices and scholarly writings.

sentences.zh: 紫柏大師在明末四大師中，以其弘揚禪宗和推動佛教改革而聞名。
sentences.en: Master Zibo, among the Four Masters of the Ming Dynasty, is famed for his efforts in promoting Chan Buddhism and advocating for Buddhist reforms.

sentences.zh: 蓮池大師是明末四大師之一，他的淨土思想深受後世推崇。
sentences.en: Master Lianchi, one of the Four Masters of the Ming Dynasty, is highly esteemed for his Pure Land teachings.

sentences.zh: 明末四大師中的蕅益大師，以其多產的著作和教化眾生的力量而著稱。
sentences.en: Master Ouyi, one of the Four Masters of the Ming Dynasty, is distinguished by his prolific writings and his ability to teach and transform sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 在黑暗中，佛教教義如同一盞明燈，指引著我們前行的路。
sentences.en: In the darkness, Buddhist teachings are like a bright lamp, guiding our path forward.

sentences.zh: 學習經典猶如點燃智慧的明燈，照亮心靈的每一個角落。
sentences.en: Studying the scriptures is like lighting a bright lamp of wisdom, illuminating every corner of the mind.

sentences.zh: 他如同一盞明燈，在我們遇到困難時給予了寶貴的指引。
sentences.en: He was like a bright lamp, providing invaluable guidance when we faced difficulties.

sentences.zh: 禪定中的清明智慧就像一盞明燈，驅散了心中的疑惑和迷茫。
sentences.en: The clear wisdom in meditation is like a bright lamp, dispelling the doubts and confusion in the mind.

phrase.zh: 明燈常作伴 益書可為朋
phrase.en: Bright lights are my companions; Good books are my friends.

sentences.zh: 在安靜的夜晚，明燈常作伴，益書可為朋，我享受著這片刻的寧靜。
sentences.en: In the quiet night, bright lights are my companions, and good books are my friends; I savor these moments of serenity.

sentences.zh: 每當我感到迷茫時，明燈常作伴，益書可為朋，給我指引方向。
sentences.en: Whenever I feel lost, bright lights are my companions, and good books are my friends, guiding me on my path.

sentences.zh: 即使在黑暗的日子裡，明燈常作伴，益書可為朋，給予我力量和智慧。
sentences.en: Even in the darkest days, bright lights are my companions, and good books are my friends, giving me strength and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 學習的過程中，明燈常作伴，益書可為朋，讓我不斷進步。
sentences.en: In the process of learning, bright lights are my companions, and good books are my friends, helping me make continuous progress.

sentences.zh: 通過學習佛經，他漸漸明理，開始用慈悲心對待他人。
sentences.en: Through studying the Buddhist scriptures, he gradually gained an understanding and began treating others with compassion.

sentences.zh: 在困難面前，明理的人能夠保持冷靜，找到解決問題的方法。
sentences.en: In the face of difficulties, a person with understanding can stay calm and find ways to resolve issues.

sentences.zh: 老師的解釋讓學生們更好地明理，加深了對佛教教義的理解。
sentences.en: The teacher's explanation helped the students to better understand and deepen their comprehension of Buddhist teachings.

sentences.zh: 明理之人懂得包容與寬恕，不會輕易因小事動怒。
sentences.en: A person with understanding knows how to be tolerant and forgiving, and does not get easily angered by trivial matters.

sentences.zh: 通過修行，他逐漸對人生的真諦有了更深的明白。
sentences.en: Through practice, he gradually gained a deeper understanding of the true meaning of life.

sentences.zh: 老師的講解讓我對這個概念有了更多的明白。
sentences.en: The teacher's explanation gave me a better understanding of this concept.

sentences.zh: 在這條修行路上，我們需要互相扶持，互相明白。
sentences.en: On this path of practice, we need to support each other and share a mutual understanding.

sentences.zh: 小明非但不生氣，反而表現出很大的理解和明白。
sentences.en: Xiao Ming showed great understanding and patience instead of getting angry.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中獲得明禪是每個修行者的目標，這可以幫助他們看清內心的本質。
sentences.en: Gaining Clarity of Chan in meditation is a goal for every practitioner, as it helps them see the true nature of their mind.

sentences.zh: 他的指導使我達到了明禪的境界，從而解決了許多心靈上的困惑。
sentences.en: His guidance led me to a state of Clarity of Chan, resolving many of my mental confusions.

sentences.zh: 明禪讓我們能夠在日常生活中保持平靜並應對各種挑戰。
sentences.en: Clarity of Chan enables us to stay calm and face various challenges in daily life.

sentences.zh: 通過不斷的禪修，我終於體驗到了真正的明禪，內心充滿了祥和和平靜。
sentences.en: Through continuous meditation, I finally experienced true Clarity of Chan, my mind filled with peace and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 他在修行中達到了明行足，成為了一位受人尊敬的明師。
sentences.en: He has attained perfection in wisdom and action in his practice, becoming a revered teacher.

sentences.zh: 佛陀被尊稱為明行足的偉大導師，因為他具有無上的智慧和行為。
sentences.en: The Buddha is revered as a great teacher perfected in wisdom and action due to his supreme wisdom and conduct.

sentences.zh: 一個修行者若能達到明行足的境界，便能真正開悟並幫助他人。
sentences.en: If a practitioner can attain the state of being perfected in wisdom and action, they can truly achieve enlightenment and help others.

sentences.zh: 明行足是一個修行者一生追求的目標，代表著智慧與行動的完美結合。
sentences.en: Being perfected in wisdom and action is a goal that practitioners strive for throughout their lives, representing the perfect union of wisdom and action.

sentences.zh: 古代的明鏡台用來比喻心靈的清澈和明朗。
sentences.en: The bright standing mirror in ancient times was used as a metaphor for the clarity and brightness of the mind.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，明鏡台象徵智慧和潔淨的心境。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, the bright standing mirror symbolizes wisdom and a pure state of mind.

sentences.zh: 當你坐在明鏡台前，應當反思自身的內在世界是否如鏡般清明。
sentences.en: When you sit before the bright standing mirror, you should reflect on whether your inner world is as clear as the mirror.

sentences.zh: 她在禪房中設置了一個明鏡台，以日常提醒自己保持心靈的清淨。
sentences.en: She placed a bright standing mirror in her meditation room as a daily reminder to keep her mind pure.

sentences.zh: 大乘佛教中，淨土法門被稱為易行道，因為它相對簡單且容易實行。
sentences.en: In Mahayana Buddhism, the Pure Land practice is referred to as the easy path because it is relatively simple and easy to practice.

sentences.zh: 他選擇了易行道，希望能夠更快地達到心靈的安寧。
sentences.en: He chose the easy path, hoping to achieve inner peace more swiftly.

sentences.zh: 易行道強調信仰和祈禱，以達成超越輪迴的解脫。
sentences.en: The easy path emphasizes faith and prayer for attaining liberation from the cycle of rebirth.

sentences.zh: 修行者常選擇易行道，因為他們相信這條路能更快成就菩提。
sentences.en: Practitioners often choose the easy path because they believe it facilitates quicker attainment of enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 在這寧靜的夜晚，山間小溪在星光雲水的映照下，顯得格外迷人。
sentences.en: On this tranquil night, the mountain stream under the starry light and flowing cloud looked particularly enchanting.

sentences.zh: 大師在湖邊靜坐，感受著星光雲水的無限美好，心境達到了前所未有的平靜。
sentences.en: The master meditated by the lake, experiencing the infinite beauty of the starry light and flowing cloud, achieving an unprecedented level of tranquility in his mind.

sentences.zh: 每當煩惱纏身，我便喜歡在庭院中漫步，讓星光雲水洗滌心靈。
sentences.en: Whenever I am troubled, I enjoy walking in the courtyard, letting the starry light and flowing cloud cleanse my soul.

sentences.zh: 這幅畫呈現出星光雲水的和諧之美，令人深感自然的奧妙和寧靜。
sentences.en: This painting presents the harmonious beauty of starry light and flowing cloud, evoking a profound sense of nature's mystery and serenity.

phrase.zh: 星河界裏星河轉 日月樓中日月長
phrase.en: The Milky Way orbits within the universe of the Milky Way; The Sun and Moon expand within the world of the Sun and Moon.

sentences.zh: 在星河界裏，星河轉動自如，就像我們正在經歷的人生一樣，不停變化。
sentences.en: In the Milky Way's universe, the Milky Way orbits freely, much like the ever-changing journey of our lives.

sentences.zh: 當你仰望星河界，看到那無數星河轉動，你會不禁感嘆宇宙的浩瀚。
sentences.en: When you gaze up at the universe of the Milky Way and see countless stars orbiting, you can't help but marvel at the vastness of the cosmos.

sentences.zh: 日月樓中的日月長，象徵著光明與黑暗的不斷交替。
sentences.en: The Sun and Moon expanding within the world of the Sun and Moon symbolizes the perpetual alternation of light and darkness.

sentences.zh: 在日月樓中，日月長久地照耀著大地，帶來四季循環的變化。
sentences.en: Within the world of the Sun and Moon, they shine eternally, bringing forth the cyclic changes of the seasons.

phrase.zh: 星辰影裏那伽定 雲水光中照大千
phrase.en: Naga Concentration within the shadows of the stars; The multiverse lit by clouds, water, and light.

sentences.zh: 在深夜的冥想中，他感受到了星辰影裏那伽定的平靜與安詳。
sentences.en: During the deep night meditation, he felt the tranquility and serenity of Naga Concentration within the shadows of the stars.

sentences.zh: 雲水光中照大千，讓他明白了宇宙之間的無限可能。
sentences.en: The multiverse lit by clouds, water, and light made him understand the infinite possibilities within the universe.

sentences.zh: 她在繁忙的都市生活中尋找到了猶如星辰影裏那伽定般的內心平靜。
sentences.en: Amidst the bustling city life, she found an inner calm akin to Naga Concentration within the shadows of the stars.

sentences.zh: 這幅畫捕捉了雲水光中照大千的美麗，展示了大自然的輝煌。
sentences.en: This painting captured the beauty of the multiverse lit by clouds, water, and light, showcasing the splendor of nature.

phrase.zh: 星辰影裏那伽定 雲水光中自在身
phrase.en: Naga Concentration within the shadows of the stars; A body of perfect ease amidst the clouds, water, and light.

sentences.zh: 星辰影裏那伽定，讓人感受到無限的安寧和神秘。
sentences.en: Naga Concentration within the shadows of the stars brings a sense of infinite peace and mystery.

sentences.zh: 在夜晚靜謐的星辰影裏，修行者能夠進入那伽定的深層境界。
sentences.en: In the tranquil shadows of the stars at night, a practitioner can enter the deep state of Naga Concentration.

sentences.zh: 雲水光中自在身，使人心靈安定，如臨仙境。
sentences.en: A body of perfect ease amidst the clouds, water, and light settles the mind, as if stepping into a fairyland.

sentences.zh: 在晨曦的雲水光景中，他感受到自在身的無拘無束。
sentences.en: In the dawn’s clouds, water, and light, he felt the boundless ease of the perfect body.

phrase.zh: 星雲之道—領悟人間佛教
phrase.en: The Way of Hsing Yun: Realization of Humanistic Buddhism

sentences.zh: 星雲之道—領悟人間佛教，教導我們如何在日常生活中實踐佛教哲學。
sentences.en: The Way of Hsing Yun: Realization of Humanistic Buddhism teaches us how to practice Buddhist philosophy in our daily lives.

sentences.zh: 通過閱讀《星雲之道—領悟人間佛教》，我學會了更加慈悲和智慧地面對生活中的挑戰。
sentences.en: By reading The Way of Hsing Yun: Realization of Humanistic Buddhism, I have learned to face life's challenges with more compassion and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 星雲大師的著作《星雲之道—領悟人間佛教》，對現代人理解佛教有很大的幫助。
sentences.en: Master Hsing Yun's work, The Way of Hsing Yun: Realization of Humanistic Buddhism, greatly aids modern individuals in understanding Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 《星雲之道—領悟人間佛教》不僅是一本書，更是一種生活方式的指南。
sentences.en: The Way of Hsing Yun: Realization of Humanistic Buddhism is not just a book; it is a guide to a way of living.

phrase.zh: 星雲人文世界論壇創辦會
phrase.en: Hsing Yun Humanistic World Literary Forum

sentences.zh: 星雲人文世界論壇創辦會旨在促進全球人文思想的交流與發展。
sentences.en: The Hsing Yun Humanistic World Literary Forum aims to promote the exchange and development of humanistic ideas globally.

sentences.zh: 每年，來自世界各地的學者和作家齊聚星雲人文世界論壇創辦會，分享他們的研究和見解。
sentences.en: Each year, scholars and writers from around the world gather at the Hsing Yun Humanistic World Literary Forum to share their research and insights.

sentences.zh: 星雲人文世界論壇創辦會的活動涵蓋多個領域，包括文學、哲學、宗教和文化研究。
sentences.en: The activities of the Hsing Yun Humanistic World Literary Forum cover multiple fields, including literature, philosophy, religion, and cultural studies.

sentences.zh: 星雲大師於2001年創立了星雲人文世界論壇創辦會，以推動人文精神的全球化。
sentences.en: Master Hsing Yun founded the Hsing Yun Humanistic World Literary Forum in 2001 to promote the globalization of humanistic spirit.

sentences.zh: 星雲八十，不僅僅是個人的歷程，更是佛教文化傳承的一部分。
sentences.en: 80 Years of Star and Cloud is not just an individual's journey, but also a part of the heritage of Buddhist culture.

sentences.zh: 這本書，星雲八十，詳細記述了星雲大師八十年的修行與弘法經歷。
sentences.en: This book, '80 Years of Star and Cloud', details Venerable Master Hsing Yun’s 80 years of practice and propagation of the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 他在星雲八十的自序中反思了自己這一生的得失與收穫。
sentences.en: In the preface of '80 Years of Star and Cloud', he reflected on the gains and losses throughout his life.

sentences.zh: 通過星雲八十，我們可以更深入地了解他對佛教哲學的理解與貢獻。
sentences.en: Through '80 Years of Star and Cloud', we can gain deeper insights into his understanding and contributions to Buddhist philosophy.

phrase.zh: 星雲大師一筆字書法世界巡迴展
phrase.en: Venerable Master Hsing Yun's One-Stroke Calligraphy Worldwide Exhibition

sentences.zh: 星雲大師一筆字書法世界巡迴展吸引了來自世界各地的書法愛好者。
sentences.en: Venerable Master Hsing Yun's One-Stroke Calligraphy Worldwide Exhibition attracted calligraphy enthusiasts from all over the world.

sentences.zh: 在星雲大師一筆字書法世界巡迴展中，可以欣賞到大師精湛的書法藝術。
sentences.en: At Venerable Master Hsing Yun's One-Stroke Calligraphy Worldwide Exhibition, one can admire the master’s exquisite calligraphy art.

sentences.zh: 許多人為了星雲大師一筆字書法世界巡迴展特地遠道而來。
sentences.en: Many people traveled from afar specifically for Venerable Master Hsing Yun's One-Stroke Calligraphy Worldwide Exhibition.

sentences.zh: 星雲大師一筆字書法世界巡迴展展示了他對書法藝術的深厚修養。
sentences.en: Venerable Master Hsing Yun's One-Stroke Calligraphy Worldwide Exhibition showcased his profound mastery of the art of calligraphy.

phrase.zh: 星雲大師人間佛教思想研究
phrase.en: A Study of Venerable Master Hsing Yun’s Thoughts on Humanistic Buddhism

sentences.zh: 《星雲大師人間佛教思想研究》這本書詳細解析了他的學說對現代社會的影響。
sentences.en: The book 'A Study of Venerable Master Hsing Yun’s Thoughts on Humanistic Buddhism' provides a detailed analysis of his teachings' impact on modern society.

sentences.zh: 學者們在討論會上分享了《星雲大師人間佛教思想研究》的重要發現。
sentences.en: Scholars shared significant findings from 'A Study of Venerable Master Hsing Yun’s Thoughts on Humanistic Buddhism' at the symposium.

sentences.zh: 為深入理解人間佛教，許多學生參考了《星雲大師人間佛教思想研究》的內容。
sentences.en: To gain a deeper understanding of Humanistic Buddhism, many students referred to 'A Study of Venerable Master Hsing Yun’s Thoughts on Humanistic Buddhism'.

sentences.zh: 《星雲大師人間佛教思想研究》提供了豐富的資料，有助於推動宗教和諧。
sentences.en: 'A Study of Venerable Master Hsing Yun’s Thoughts on Humanistic Buddhism' provides extensive resources that help promote religious harmony.

phrase.zh: 星雲大師人間佛教理論實踐研究會
phrase.en: Academic Conference on the Theory and Practice of Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Humanistic Buddhism

sentences.zh: 星雲大師人間佛教理論實踐研究會每年吸引來自世界各地的學者參與。
sentences.en: The Academic Conference on the Theory and Practice of Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Humanistic Buddhism attracts scholars from around the world every year.

sentences.zh: 在星雲大師人間佛教理論實踐研究會上，專家們討論了許多最新的研究成果。
sentences.en: Experts discussed many of the latest research findings at the Academic Conference on the Theory and Practice of Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Humanistic Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 這次星雲大師人間佛教理論實踐研究會的主題是如何將佛教理念融入現代生活。
sentences.en: The theme of this year's Academic Conference on the Theory and Practice of Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Humanistic Buddhism is how to integrate Buddhist ideals into modern life.

sentences.zh: 學生們在星雲大師人間佛教理論實踐研究會上展示了他們的研究報告。
sentences.en: Students presented their research reports at the Academic Conference on the Theory and Practice of Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Humanistic Buddhism.

phrase.zh: 星雲大師佛學講座─人間佛教的戒定慧學
phrase.en: Venerable Master's Buddhist Lecture Series on Discipline, Mental Cultivation, and Wisdom of Humanistic Buddhism

sentences.zh: 星雲大師佛學講座─人間佛教的戒定慧學，幫助我們理解日常生活中的智慧應如何實踐。
sentences.en: The Venerable Master's Buddhist Lecture Series on Discipline, Mental Cultivation, and Wisdom of Humanistic Buddhism helps us understand how to practice wisdom in daily life.

sentences.zh: 參加星雲大師佛學講座─人間佛教的戒定慧學，讓我深刻體會到戒律的重要性。
sentences.en: Attending the Venerable Master's Buddhist Lecture Series on Discipline, Mental Cultivation, and Wisdom of Humanistic Buddhism gave me a profound understanding of the importance of precepts.

sentences.zh: 星雲大師佛學講座─人間佛教的戒定慧學，強調在現實生活中培養心靈定力的重要性。
sentences.en: The Venerable Master's Buddhist Lecture Series on Discipline, Mental Cultivation, and Wisdom of Humanistic Buddhism emphasizes the importance of cultivating mental stability in real life.

sentences.zh: 透過星雲大師佛學講座─人間佛教的戒定慧學，我們學習如何在生活中運用智慧解決問題。
sentences.en: Through the Venerable Master's Buddhist Lecture Series on Discipline, Mental Cultivation, and Wisdom of Humanistic Buddhism, we learn how to apply wisdom to solve problems in life.

phrase.zh: 星雲大師佛教歌曲發表會徵曲比賽
phrase.en: Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Buddhist Songs Composition Contest

sentences.zh: 星雲大師佛教歌曲發表會徵曲比賽吸引了來自世界各地的音樂愛好者。
sentences.en: Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Buddhist Songs Composition Contest attracted music enthusiasts from all around the world.

sentences.zh: 參加星雲大師佛教歌曲發表會徵曲比賽，是我人生中的一大挑戰。
sentences.en: Participating in Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Buddhist Songs Composition Contest was a significant challenge in my life.

sentences.zh: 她在星雲大師佛教歌曲發表會徵曲比賽中獲得了第一名，成為大家矚目的焦點。
sentences.en: She won first place in Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Buddhist Songs Composition Contest, becoming the focal point of everyone's attention.

sentences.zh: 這次的星雲大師佛教歌曲發表會徵曲比賽，共收到五百多首參賽作品。
sentences.en: This year's Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Buddhist Songs Composition Contest received over five hundred entries.

phrase.zh: 星雲大師來台弘法五十年雲水三千巡迴展
phrase.en: Cloud and Water: Venerable Master Hsing Yun's 50 Years of Dharma Propagation in Taiwan Exhibition Tour

sentences.zh: 星雲大師來台弘法五十年雲水三千巡迴展吸引了成千上萬的信徒和訪客前來參觀。
sentences.en: The 'Cloud and Water: Venerable Master Hsing Yun's 50 Years of Dharma Propagation in Taiwan Exhibition Tour' attracted thousands of devotees and visitors.

sentences.zh: 這次巡迴展展示了星雲大師五十年來在台灣弘法的歷程與成就。
sentences.en: The exhibition tour showcased Venerable Master Hsing Yun's fifty years of Dharma propagation in Taiwan and his achievements.

sentences.zh: 雲水三千巡迴展是一個讓人們更了解星雲大師貢獻的絕佳機會。
sentences.en: The 'Cloud and Water Exhibition Tour' provides an excellent opportunity for people to gain a deeper understanding of Venerable Master Hsing Yun's contributions.

sentences.zh: 許多參觀者表示，通過這次展覽他們對佛教有了更深刻的理解與感悟。
sentences.en: Many visitors expressed that the exhibition gave them a deeper understanding and appreciation of Buddhism.

phrase.en: The Complete Works of Venerable Master Hsing Yun

sentences.zh: 星雲大師全集是研究現代佛教思想的重要資料。
sentences.en: The Complete Works of Venerable Master Hsing Yun is an important resource for studying contemporary Buddhist thought.

sentences.zh: 我在圖書館裡找到了一整套星雲大師全集，真是受益匪淺。
sentences.en: I found a complete set of The Complete Works of Venerable Master Hsing Yun in the library, and it has been immensely beneficial.

sentences.zh: 閱讀星雲大師全集讓我能更深入理解佛法的核心教義。
sentences.en: Reading The Complete Works of Venerable Master Hsing Yun has allowed me to gain deeper insights into the core teachings of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 許多佛教學者都推薦學習星雲大師全集，因為它包含了豐富的智慧和洞見。
sentences.en: Many Buddhist scholars recommend studying The Complete Works of Venerable Master Hsing Yun because it is rich in wisdom and insights.

phrase.zh: 星雲大師對佛教的十大貢獻
phrase.en: Venerable Master Hsing Yun’s Ten Major Contributions to Buddhism

sentences.zh: 星雲大師對佛教的十大貢獻，包括推廣人間佛教和創建佛光山。
sentences.en: Venerable Master Hsing Yun’s ten major contributions to Buddhism include promoting Humanistic Buddhism and founding Fo Guang Shan.

sentences.zh: 許多人讚揚星雲大師對佛教的十大貢獻，尤其是在教育和慈善領域的努力。
sentences.en: Many people praise Venerable Master Hsing Yun’s ten major contributions to Buddhism, especially his efforts in education and charity.

sentences.zh: 了解星雲大師對佛教的十大貢獻能夠幫助我們更全面地理解現代佛教的發展。
sentences.en: Understanding Venerable Master Hsing Yun’s ten major contributions to Buddhism can help us gain a more comprehensive understanding of the development of modern Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 星雲大師對佛教的十大貢獻不僅影響了亞洲，還在全球範圍內產生了深遠的影響。
sentences.en: Venerable Master Hsing Yun’s ten major contributions to Buddhism have not only impacted Asia but have also had a profound influence globally.

phrase.en: Chronicle of Venerable Master Hsing Yun’s Life

sentences.zh: 《星雲大師年譜》詳細記載了他一生的光輝事跡。
sentences.en: The 'Chronicle of Venerable Master Hsing Yun’s Life' details the illustrious events of his life.

sentences.zh: 星雲大師年譜中提到，他在1950年代創立佛光山。
sentences.en: The Chronicle of Venerable Master Hsing Yun’s Life mentions that he founded Fo Guang Shan in the 1950s.

sentences.zh: 閱讀《星雲大師年譜》可以讓人們更深入了解他的思想和貢獻。
sentences.en: Reading the 'Chronicle of Venerable Master Hsing Yun’s Life' can give people deeper insights into his thoughts and contributions.

sentences.zh: 星雲大師年譜是一部非常重要且具有歷史意義的作品。
sentences.en: The 'Chronicle of Venerable Master Hsing Yun’s Life' is a remarkably important and historically significant work.

phrase.en: Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Lecture Series

sentences.zh: 星雲大師演講集提供了寶貴的智慧，讓人們對佛教有更深的理解。
sentences.en: Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Lecture Series offers invaluable wisdom, providing a deeper understanding of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 我經常閱讀星雲大師演講集，以提升我的靈修和心靈成長。
sentences.en: I often read Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Lecture Series to enhance my spiritual practice and personal growth.

sentences.zh: 星雲大師演講集翻譯成多種語言，讓世界各地的人都能受益。
sentences.en: Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Lecture Series has been translated into multiple languages, benefiting people around the world.

sentences.zh: 透過星雲大師演講集，我學會了如何在日常生活中實踐佛教教義。
sentences.en: Through Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Lecture Series, I have learned how to apply Buddhist teachings in daily life.

phrase.en: Buddhism in Every Step: The Life of Master Hsing Yun

sentences.zh: 星雲大師的一生展示了佛教在現代社會中的實踐與應用。
sentences.en: Buddhism in Every Step: The Life of Master Hsing Yun showcases the practice and application of Buddhism in modern society.

sentences.zh: 讀星雲大師的一生，你會了解到佛教如何影響了許多人的心靈和生活。
sentences.en: Reading Buddhism in Every Step: The Life of Master Hsing Yun will reveal how Buddhism has influenced many people's minds and lives.

sentences.zh: 星雲大師的一生不僅是一部傳記，還是一部佛教智慧的啟示錄。
sentences.en: Buddhism in Every Step: The Life of Master Hsing Yun is not just a biography but also a revelation of Buddhist wisdom.

sentences.zh: 在星雲大師的一生中，我們可以看到一個人如何通過佛教的修持實現心靈的平靜與智慧。
sentences.en: In Buddhism in Every Step: The Life of Master Hsing Yun, we can see how a person achieved inner peace and wisdom through the practice of Buddhism.

phrase.zh: 星雲大師禪淨密唱頌講座
phrase.en: Venerable Master Hsing Yun Chan, Pure Land, and Tantric Singing Dharma Talk

sentences.zh: 昨天，我有幸參加了星雲大師禪淨密唱頌講座，受益匪淺。
sentences.en: Yesterday, I was fortunate to attend the Venerable Master Hsing Yun Chan, Pure Land, and Tantric Singing Dharma Talk, and it was truly enlightening.

sentences.zh: 星雲大師在這場禪淨密唱頌講座中，深刻地解釋了三種修行法門的奧義。
sentences.en: In the Venerable Master Hsing Yun Chan, Pure Land, and Tantric Singing Dharma Talk, the Master profoundly explained the essence of the three spiritual practices.

sentences.zh: 朋友們，千萬別錯過即將舉行的星雲大師禪淨密唱頌講座，這是一個非常難得的機會。
sentences.en: Friends, don't miss the upcoming Venerable Master Hsing Yun Chan, Pure Land, and Tantric Singing Dharma Talk; it is a rare opportunity.

sentences.zh: 這次星雲大師的禪淨密唱頌講座使我對佛法有了更深入的理解和體驗。
sentences.en: The Venerable Master Hsing Yun Chan, Pure Land, and Tantric Singing Dharma Talk provided me with a deeper understanding and experience of the Dharma.

phrase.zh: 星雲大師詩偈徵曲活動
phrase.en: Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Poems and Verses Music Composition

sentences.zh: 星雲大師詩偈徵曲活動吸引了來自世界各地的音樂愛好者參加。
sentences.en: Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Poems and Verses Music Composition attracted music enthusiasts from all over the world.

sentences.zh: 這次星雲大師詩偈徵曲活動旨在通過音樂弘揚佛教精神。
sentences.en: The aim of Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Poems and Verses Music Composition is to promote Buddhist spirit through music.

sentences.zh: 參賽者在星雲大師詩偈徵曲活動中創作了許多動人的樂曲。
sentences.en: Participants composed many touching pieces during Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Poems and Verses Music Composition.

sentences.zh: 星雲大師詩偈徵曲活動的獲獎作品將在佛光山音樂會上演出。
sentences.en: The winning compositions from Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Poems and Verses Music Composition will be performed at a Fo Guang Shan concert.

sentences.zh: 星雲大師談讀書講座是一場提升心靈修養的盛會。
sentences.en: The Venerable Master's Lecture on Reading is a grand event that enhances spiritual cultivation.

sentences.zh: 在星雲大師談讀書講座中，他強調了閱讀的重要性和力量。
sentences.en: In the Venerable Master's Lecture on Reading, he emphasized the importance and power of reading.

sentences.zh: 參加星雲大師談讀書講座的學生們表示受益匪淺，充滿啟發。
sentences.en: Students who attended the Venerable Master's Lecture on Reading expressed that they were deeply benefited and inspired.

sentences.zh: 星雲大師談讀書講座吸引了來自各地的佛教徒和讀書愛好者。
sentences.en: The Venerable Master's Lecture on Reading attracted Buddhists and reading enthusiasts from various regions.

sentences.zh: 他在書中描述了宇宙的壯麗景象，包括星雲天地的奇觀。
sentences.en: In his book, he described the magnificent scenes of the universe, including the wonders of star, cloud, heaven, and earth.

sentences.zh: 這幅畫將星雲天地的美麗呈現得淋漓盡致，令人讚嘆。
sentences.en: This painting beautifully captures the splendor of star, cloud, heaven, and earth, leaving everyone in awe.

sentences.zh: 修行者常在冥想中體驗星雲天地的無限廣闊，感受天地的智慧。
sentences.en: Practitioners often experience the vast expanses of star, cloud, heaven, and earth during meditation, feeling the wisdom of the cosmos.

sentences.zh: 詩人用優美的詞句描繪了星雲天地的奇妙景色，讓讀者彷彿親臨其境。
sentences.en: The poet used elegant words to depict the marvelous scenery of star, cloud, heaven, and earth, making readers feel as though they were there.

sentences.zh: 星雲大師在他的學說與實踐中強調「人間佛教」的重要性，呼籲大家要關心當下社會。
sentences.en: In Hsing Yun’s teachings and actualization, Master Hsing Yun emphasizes the importance of 'Humanistic Buddhism' and calls on everyone to care for contemporary society.

sentences.zh: 很多人跟隨星雲大師的學說與實踐，發現自己的人生變得更加充實和有意義。
sentences.en: Many people follow Hsing Yun’s teachings and actualization, finding that their lives become more fulfilling and meaningful.

sentences.zh: 星雲大師的學說與實踐不僅在亞洲有深遠的影響，在全世界也得到眾多信眾的認同。
sentences.en: Hsing Yun’s teachings and actualization not only have a profound impact in Asia but are also recognized and embraced by followers around the world.

sentences.zh: 將星雲的學說與實踐融入日常生活，可以幫助我們建立更加和諧的人際關係和更積極的生活態度。
sentences.en: Incorporating Hsing Yun’s teachings and actualization into daily life can help us build more harmonious relationships and adopt a more positive attitude towards life.

sentences.zh: 我從星雲日記中學到了許多關於生活的智慧。
sentences.en: I have learned much about the wisdom of life from Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Diaries.

sentences.zh: 星雲日記記錄了大師的心路歷程和智慧。
sentences.en: Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Diaries document his mental journey and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 每晚閱讀星雲日記已經成為我的一個習慣。
sentences.en: Reading Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Diaries every night has become a habit of mine.

sentences.zh: 在星雲日記裡，我找到了解決煩惱的辦法。
sentences.en: In Venerable Master Hsing Yun's Diaries, I found ways to resolve my troubles.

sentences.zh: 在佛教界，星雲智慧被視為重要的指導原則，幫助無數信眾找到人生方向。
sentences.en: In the Buddhist community, Hsing Yun's Wisdom is regarded as an important guiding principle, helping countless followers find direction in life.

sentences.zh: 星雲智慧不僅限於宗教，還延伸到現代生活中的諸多領域。
sentences.en: Hsing Yun's Wisdom is not confined to religion but extends to many aspects of modern life.

sentences.zh: 透過學習星雲智慧，人們能夠更好地應對日常生活中的挑戰。
sentences.en: By learning Hsing Yun's Wisdom, people can better cope with the challenges of daily life.

sentences.zh: 許多學生在星雲大師的講座中獲得了深刻的啟發和星雲智慧。
sentences.en: Many students have gained profound inspiration and Hsing Yun's Wisdom from Master Hsing Yun's lectures.

phrase.en: Humanistic Buddhism in the Hsing Yun Model

sentences.zh: 星雲模式的人間佛教強調在現實生活中實踐佛法，以慈悲和智慧來造福社會。
sentences.en: Humanistic Buddhism in the Hsing Yun Model emphasizes the practice of Dharma in daily life, using compassion and wisdom to benefit society.

sentences.zh: 許多學者認為星雲模式的人間佛教為現代社會提供了一種實用的宗教路徑。
sentences.en: Many scholars believe that Humanistic Buddhism in the Hsing Yun Model provides a pragmatic religious path for modern society.

sentences.zh: 星雲法師通過星雲模式的人間佛教希望促進世界和平與和諧。
sentences.en: Master Hsing Yun hopes to promote world peace and harmony through Humanistic Buddhism in the Hsing Yun Model.

sentences.zh: 在全球化的背景下，星雲模式的人間佛教逐漸走向國際，並獲得廣泛認可。
sentences.en: Against the backdrop of globalization, Humanistic Buddhism in the Hsing Yun Model is increasingly gaining international recognition.

sentences.zh: 星雲法語啟發了無數尋求內心平靜的人。
sentences.en: Hsing Yun’s Dharma Words have inspired countless individuals seeking inner peace.

sentences.zh: 在他的書籍中，星雲法語帶來了深刻的人生智慧。
sentences.en: In his books, Hsing Yun’s Dharma Words offer profound life wisdom.

sentences.zh: 許多佛教徒每天閱讀星雲法語以啟迪自己。
sentences.en: Many Buddhists read Hsing Yun’s Dharma Words daily for inspiration.

sentences.zh: 通過星雲法語，他傳播了慈悲和和諧的信息。
sentences.en: Through Hsing Yun’s Dharma Words, he spread the message of compassion and harmony.

sentences.zh: 星雲大師的《星雲法語：生活的鑰匙》為我們現代生活提供了寶貴的智慧。
sentences.en: Master Hsing Yun's 'Keys to Living Well' offers us invaluable wisdom for modern life.

sentences.zh: 要過上充實幸福的生活，理解並實踐生活的鑰匙是不可或缺的。
sentences.en: To live a fulfilling and happy life, understanding and practicing the keys to living well is indispensable.

sentences.zh: 在星雲法師的演講中，他經常分享有關生活的鑰匙，幫助人們應對日常挑戰。
sentences.en: In Master Hsing Yun's talks, he often shares about the keys to living well, helping people deal with daily challenges.

sentences.zh: 這本書探索了多個生活的鑰匙，包括慈悲、智慧和忍耐，旨在引導讀者找到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: This book explores various keys to living well, including compassion, wisdom, and patience, aiming to guide the reader to find inner peace.

sentences.zh: 修道者的心應該清淨無染，能夠專注於內在的修行。
sentences.en: The mind of a practitioner should be pure and untainted, capable of focusing on inner cultivation.

sentences.zh: 在面對挫折時，修道者的心仍然保持平靜和堅定。
sentences.en: When facing setbacks, the mind of a practitioner remains calm and steadfast.

sentences.zh: 修道者的心不被外物所迷惑，時刻保持覺知和自律。
sentences.en: The mind of a practitioner is not swayed by external distractions, always maintaining awareness and discipline.

sentences.zh: 修道者的心如大海般廣闊，能夠包容一切眾生的痛苦。
sentences.en: The mind of a practitioner is as vast as the ocean, capable of embracing the suffering of all sentient beings.

phrase.zh: 星雲法語 生活中的覺醒

sentences.zh: 《星雲法語 生活中的覺醒》這本書中分享了許多能讓我們在日常生活中找到心靈平靜的方法。
sentences.en: The book 'The Awakening Life' by Hsing Yun shares numerous ways to find inner peace in our daily lives.

sentences.zh: 通過閱讀《星雲法語 生活中的覺醒》，我學會了如何在困難時期保持心靈的覺醒和平靜。
sentences.en: By reading 'The Awakening Life' by Hsing Yun, I learned how to maintain spiritual awakening and calmness during difficult times.

sentences.zh: 《星雲法語 生活中的覺醒》提供了許多實用的建議，幫助我們在忙碌的生活中找到靜心的片刻。
sentences.en: 'The Awakening Life' by Hsing Yun offers many practical suggestions to help us find moments of tranquility in our busy lives.

sentences.zh: 星雲大師在《星雲法語 生活中的覺醒》中強調了正念和慈悲在日常生活中的重要性。
sentences.en: Master Hsing Yun emphasizes the importance of mindfulness and compassion in daily life in his book 'The Awakening Life'.

phrase.zh: 星雲法語 自在的人生

sentences.zh: 星雲法語 自在的人生，教導我們如何在忙碌中尋找內心的平靜。
sentences.en: The Carefree Life, as taught by Venerable Master Hsing Yun, instructs us on how to find inner peace amidst our busy lives.

sentences.zh: 透過閱讀星雲法語 自在的人生，我們可以學習放下執著，獲得真實的自由。
sentences.en: By reading The Carefree Life, we can learn to let go of attachments and achieve true freedom.

sentences.zh: 星雲法語 自在的人生是一部充滿智慧的著作，適合尋求心靈解脫的人。
sentences.en: The Carefree Life is a wisdom-filled work, perfect for those seeking spiritual liberation.

sentences.zh: 星雲大師在星雲法語 自在的人生中，闡述了如何在現代社會中保持淡定和從容。
sentences.en: In The Carefree Life, Venerable Master Hsing Yun explains how to remain calm and composed in modern society.

phrase.zh: 星雲真善美新聞傳播獎
phrase.en: Hsing Yun Award for Contribution to Truth, Beautiful, and Good News

sentences.zh: 今年的星雲真善美新聞傳播獎頒發給了一位年輕的調查記者。
sentences.en: This year's Hsing Yun Award for Contribution to Truth, Beautiful, and Good News was presented to a young investigative journalist.

sentences.zh: 星雲真善美新聞傳播獎旨在表彰那些在新聞報導中傳遞真善美的優秀媒體工作者。
sentences.en: The Hsing Yun Award for Contribution to Truth, Beautiful, and Good News aims to honor outstanding media professionals who convey truth, beauty, and goodness in their reporting.

sentences.zh: 得獎者表示，星雲真善美新聞傳播獎激勵他們繼續追求真相和正義。
sentences.en: The awardees expressed that the Hsing Yun Award for Contribution to Truth, Beautiful, and Good News motivates them to continue pursuing truth and justice.

sentences.zh: 星雲真善美新聞傳播獎是對那些致力於社會福祉的新聞從業者的最大肯定。
sentences.en: The Hsing Yun Award for Contribution to Truth, Beautiful, and Good News is the highest recognition for journalists dedicated to social welfare.

sentences.zh: 星雲大師的星雲禪畫融合了禪理和藝術，啟迪無數追隨者。
sentences.en: Master Hsing Yun's Chan Talk blends Zen principles with art, inspiring countless followers.

sentences.zh: 通過星雲禪畫，我們可以感受到禪的智慧和大師的深思。
sentences.en: Through Hsing Yun's Chan Talk, we can sense the wisdom of Zen and the master's profound thoughts.

sentences.zh: 每一幅星雲禪畫都是大師內心世界的體現，充滿了深厚的靈性力量。
sentences.en: Every piece of Hsing Yun's Chan Talk is a reflection of the master's inner world, filled with deep spiritual power.

sentences.zh: 觀賞星雲禪畫，不僅是一種藝術享受，更是一種心靈的修行。
sentences.en: Appreciating Hsing Yun's Chan Talk is not just an artistic pleasure but also a spiritual practice.

sentences.zh: 他每天閱讀星雲禪話，從中學習佛教的智慧。
sentences.en: He reads Hsing Yun's Chan Stories daily to learn the wisdom of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 星雲禪話以簡單的故事闡述深奧的禪理，非常適合初學者。
sentences.en: Hsing Yun's Chan Stories explain profound Chan principles through simple stories, making it very suitable for beginners.

sentences.zh: 在星雲禪話中，他找到了解決生活問題的新方法。
sentences.en: In Hsing Yun's Chan Stories, he found new ways to solve life's problems.

sentences.zh: 星雲禪話的啟發性對話幫助讀者更深入地理解禪修。
sentences.en: The insightful dialogues in Hsing Yun's Chan Stories help readers gain a deeper understanding of Zen practice.

phrase.en: Cloud and Water: An Interpretation of Chan Poems

sentences.zh: 星雲說偈乃是佛教禪宗詩偈的詮釋，讓人們從詩歌中體會佛法的智慧。
sentences.en: Cloud and Water: An Interpretation of Chan Poems is an exposition of Zen Buddhist verses, allowing people to experience the wisdom of Buddhism through poetry.

sentences.zh: 在《星雲說偈》中，作者通過解讀古代詩偈呈現出豐富的精神內涵。
sentences.en: In 'Cloud and Water: An Interpretation of Chan Poems', the author presents a rich spiritual heritage through the interpretation of ancient Zen verses.

sentences.zh: 禪宗大師常以簡短的詩偈來表達深奧的教義，《星雲說偈》正是如此。
sentences.en: Zen masters often use short poems to express profound teachings, and 'Cloud and Water: An Interpretation of Chan Poems' does exactly that.

sentences.zh: 閱讀《星雲說偈》，能夠讓人深刻領悟到禪宗的真諦。
sentences.en: Reading 'Cloud and Water: An Interpretation of Chan Poems' can offer deep insights into the true essence of Zen Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 《星雲說喻》這本書裡有許多發人深省的小故事，令人十分感動。
sentences.en: The book 'Hsing Yun's Parables' contains many thought-provoking short stories that deeply move the reader.

sentences.zh: 老師經常引用《星雲說喻》中的故事來教授我們做人處事的道理。
sentences.en: The teacher often refers to stories from 'Hsing Yun's Parables' to teach us lessons in life and conduct.

sentences.zh: 通過閱讀《星雲說喻》，我對佛教智慧有了更深刻的理解。
sentences.en: Through reading 'Hsing Yun's Parables,' I gained a deeper understanding of Buddhist wisdom.

sentences.zh: 這些《星雲說喻》中的故事不僅適合成人閱讀，也非常適合孩子。
sentences.en: The stories in 'Hsing Yun's Parables' are suitable not only for adults but also for children.

phrase.zh: 春來春去春不老 福臨福地福無疆
phrase.en: Spring comes and goes, but never ages; Blessings come and go, but never end.

sentences.zh: 春天來了，又到了希望與再生的季節，真應了那句「春來春去春不老」。
sentences.en: Spring has arrived, marking the season of hope and renewal, truly embodying the phrase 'Spring comes and goes, but never ages.'

sentences.zh: 福臨福地，這裡是一處讓人心靈平靜的地方，真有「福臨福地福無疆」的感覺。
sentences.en: Blessings come and go, but never end; this place brings peace to the soul, truly giving a sense of 'Blessings come and go, but never end.'

sentences.zh: 在這座古老的禪院，時間彷彿靜止，體現出「春來春去春不老 福臨福地福無疆」的意境。
sentences.en: In this ancient Zen temple, time seems to stand still, capturing the essence of 'Spring comes and goes, but never ages; Blessings come and go, but never end.'

sentences.zh: 長者常說：「春來春去春不老，保持一顆年輕的心，幸福就會如影隨形。」
sentences.en: The elders often say, 'Spring comes and goes, but never ages; keep a young heart, and happiness will follow you everywhere.'

sentences.zh: 每當春來福到，村子裡的人們都會一起慶祝，迎接新的希望與豐收。
sentences.en: Whenever spring heralds prosperity, the villagers gather to celebrate and welcome new hopes and a bountiful harvest.

sentences.zh: 老人家總是說，春來福到，大家要心存感恩，共享這一份祥瑞。
sentences.en: The elders often say that when spring heralds prosperity, we should all be grateful and share in this auspicious time.

sentences.zh: 在中國的傳統文化中，春來福到標誌著一年新氣象的開始，象徵著繁榮和幸福。
sentences.en: In traditional Chinese culture, spring heralding prosperity marks the beginning of a new year, symbolizing wealth and happiness.

sentences.zh: 每年的春節，大家都相信春來福到，因此紛紛張貼春聯，祈求來年好運連連。
sentences.en: Every Chinese New Year, people believe that spring heralds prosperity, so they put up spring couplets to pray for continuous good luck in the coming year.

phrase.zh: 春光回大地 和氣到人間
phrase.en: The light of spring returns to the Earth, The joy of harmony returns to the world.

sentences.zh: 春光回大地，萬物復蘇，整個世界充滿了新生的氣息。
sentences.en: The light of spring returns to the Earth, revitalizing all things and filling the world with a sense of new life.

sentences.zh: 和氣到人間，家家戶戶都洋溢著歡聲笑語與和睦。
sentences.en: The joy of harmony returns to the world, filling every household with laughter and peace.

sentences.zh: 每當春光回大地，農夫們開始忙碌於耕作，準備迎接豐收的季節。
sentences.en: When the light of spring returns to the Earth, farmers become busy with their plowing, preparing for the bountiful harvest season.

sentences.zh: 和氣到人間，鄰里之間更顯得和睦友愛，互相幫助。
sentences.en: The joy of harmony returns to the world, fostering a spirit of friendship and mutual assistance among neighbors.

phrase.zh: 春到千山秀 花開萬里香
phrase.en: Picturesque mountain scenery brought by spring; A world filled with fragrance by blossoming flowers.

sentences.zh: 春到千山秀，花開萬里香，這是一年中最美的季節，讓人心曠神怡。
sentences.en: Picturesque mountain scenery brought by spring; A world filled with fragrance by blossoming flowers. This is the most beautiful season of the year, filling people's hearts with serenity.

sentences.zh: 當春天來臨，春到千山秀，花開萬里香，這片土地仿佛一片仙境。
sentences.en: When spring arrives, picturesque mountain scenery brought by spring; a world filled with fragrance by blossoming flowers, transforms the land into a fairyland.

sentences.zh: 我們在春天的清晨出發，迎著春到千山秀，花開萬里香的美景，走上了這段登山之旅。
sentences.en: We set off on a spring morning, embracing the picturesque mountain scenery brought by spring and a world filled with fragrance by blossoming flowers, starting our hiking journey.

sentences.zh: 這幅畫描繪了春到千山秀，花開萬里香的景象，使人彷彿置身於現實之外。
sentences.en: This painting depicts the picturesque mountain scenery brought by spring and a world filled with fragrance by blossoming flowers, making one feel as if they are in a world beyond reality.

phrase.zh: 春到千山秀 風和四季春
phrase.en: Picturesque mountain scenery brought by spring; The years filled with spring by the soothing breezes.

sentences.zh: 春到千山秀，萬物復甦，大自然展示出無邊的生機與美麗。
sentences.en: Picturesque mountain scenery brought by spring reveals endless vitality and beauty of nature.

sentences.zh: 當春風拂過每一座山峰，千山萬壑都被點綴得如詩如畫。
sentences.en: As the spring breeze caresses every peak, the mountains and valleys are adorned, turning them into picturesque scenery.

sentences.zh: 每年春天，當春到千山秀的景象出現，人們總是忍不住前往山野感受那一片生機勃勃。
sentences.en: Every spring, when the picturesque mountain scenery appears, people can't help but venture into the wilderness to experience the vibrancy.

sentences.zh: 風和四季春，四季皆如春一般和煦與美好，帶給人們無盡的希望。
sentences.en: The years filled with spring by the soothing breezes bring warmth and beauty to all seasons, offering endless hope to people.

phrase.zh: 春暖百花香 人勤萬物豐
phrase.en: In the warmth of spring, every flower is fragrant; With diligent hands, all harvests are bountiful.

sentences.zh: 春暖百花香，人勤萬物豐，是農人最喜愛的季節。
sentences.en: In the warmth of spring, every flower is fragrant; with diligent hands, all harvests are bountiful—this is the season most loved by farmers.

sentences.zh: 老師常用春暖百花香，人勤萬物豐來激勵學生努力學習。
sentences.en: The teacher often uses 'In the warmth of spring, every flower is fragrant; with diligent hands, all harvests are bountiful' to encourage students to study hard.

sentences.zh: 這句春暖百花香，人勤萬物豐的名言，體現了自然與辛勤相輔相成。
sentences.en: This saying, 'In the warmth of spring, every flower is fragrant; with diligent hands, all harvests are bountiful,' embodies the harmony between nature and hard work.

sentences.zh: 每逢春天，我們都會感受到春暖百花香，人勤萬物豐的美好景象。
sentences.en: Every spring, we can feel the beauty of 'In the warmth of spring, every flower is fragrant; with diligent hands, all harvests are bountiful.'

phrase.zh: 春暖百花香 家和萬事興
phrase.en: In the warmth of spring, every flower is fragrant; In families of harmony, everything is prosperous.

sentences.zh: 春暖百花香 家和萬事興，這句話體現了春天的美好與家庭和諧的重要性。
sentences.en: In the warmth of spring, every flower is fragrant; In families of harmony, everything is prosperous. This phrase reflects the beauty of spring and the importance of family harmony.

sentences.zh: 在公園裡，春暖百花香，孩子們在悠閒地散步遊玩。
sentences.en: In the park, in the warmth of spring, every flower is fragrant, and the children are leisurely walking and playing.

sentences.zh: 父母總是教導我們，家和萬事興，所以我們應該互愛互助。
sentences.en: Our parents always teach us that in families of harmony, everything is prosperous, so we should love and support each other.

sentences.zh: 當你走進這片花園，你會感受到春暖百花香的美景。
sentences.en: When you walk into this garden, you will experience the beauty of the warmth of spring, where every flower is fragrant.

phrase.zh: 春色無高下 華枝自短長
phrase.en: Neither good or bad are shown by colors of spring; When to grow short or long is known by floral branches.

sentences.zh: 悟道之人明白，春色無高下，華枝自短長，一切皆有其時機和自然的法則。
sentences.en: An enlightened person understands that neither good or bad are shown by colors of spring; When to grow short or long is known by floral branches, everything has its own timing and natural laws.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，我們應該體悟春色無高下，華枝自短長，不需執著於外在的表象。
sentences.en: In meditation, we should realize that neither good or bad are shown by colors of spring; When to grow short or long is known by floral branches, and not cling to external appearances.

sentences.zh: 這首詩教導我們要接受人生的多樣性，春色無高下，華枝自短長，每個人都有自己的獨特之處。
sentences.en: This poem teaches us to embrace the diversity of life; Neither good or bad are shown by colors of spring; When to grow short or long is known by floral branches, and everyone has their own uniqueness.

sentences.zh: 面對挑戰時，記得春色無高下，華枝自短長，我們應該相信自己的能力和智慧。
sentences.en: When facing challenges, remember that neither good or bad are shown by colors of spring; When to grow short or long is known by floral branches, and we should trust our own abilities and wisdom.

phrase.zh: 春蠶至死絲方盡 蜡炬成灰淚始乾
phrase.en: Silkworms keep spinning till death comes in spring; Candle tears do not dry till every bit is burnt to ash.

sentences.zh: 她的奉獻精神就如春蠶至死絲方盡，蜡炬成灰淚始乾。
sentences.en: Her spirit of dedication is like silkworms that keep spinning till death comes in spring; candle tears that do not dry till every bit is burnt to ash.

sentences.zh: 老師的默默付出令人感動，真是春蠶至死絲方盡，蜡炬成灰淚始乾。
sentences.en: The silent dedication of our teacher is truly moving; she embodies the spirit of silkworms keeping spinning till death comes in spring, and candles not drying their tears till every bit is burnt to ash.

sentences.zh: 他的事業心猶如春蠶至死絲方盡，蜡炬成灰淚始乾，無怨無悔地付出全部心力。
sentences.en: His devotion to his career is akin to silkworms that keep spinning till death comes in spring; candle tears that do not dry till every bit is burnt to ash, dedicating all his effort without regrets.

sentences.zh: 醫護人員的奉獻，如同春蠶至死絲方盡，蜡炬成灰淚始乾，令人無比敬佩。
sentences.en: The dedication of healthcare workers is like silkworms that keep spinning till death comes in spring; candle tears that do not dry till every bit is burnt to ash, earning immense admiration.

sentences.zh: 老師如春風化雨般滋潤著學生的心靈，讓他們茁壯成長。
sentences.en: The teacher nourishes the students' minds like spring breeze and rain, allowing them to grow and thrive.

sentences.zh: 這本書如同春風化雨，開啟了讀者的心智。
sentences.en: This book acts like spring breeze and rain, opening the readers' minds.

sentences.zh: 他的話宛如春風化雨，舒緩了我們的心情。
sentences.en: His words were like spring breeze and rain, soothing our spirits.

sentences.zh: 她的關懷如春風化雨，溫暖了每個人的心。
sentences.en: Her care was like spring breeze and rain, warming everyone's hearts.

phrase.zh: 春風吹大地 佛法滿人間
phrase.en: Soothing spring breezes caress the Earth; The wisdom of Dharma permeate the world.

sentences.zh: 在這春風吹大地的時節，佛法滿人間，人人都感受到一種平和與安詳。
sentences.en: In this season when soothing spring breezes caress the Earth, the wisdom of Dharma permeates the world, and everyone feels a sense of peace and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 當春風吹大地，佛法滿人間的時候，我們需要更加精進學習佛法，才能得到真正的智慧。
sentences.en: When soothing spring breezes caress the Earth and the wisdom of Dharma permeates the world, we need to diligently study the Dharma to attain true wisdom.

sentences.zh: 春風吹大地，佛法滿人間，我們的心靈也隨之變得更加純淨與開闊。
sentences.en: Soothing spring breezes caress the Earth and the wisdom of Dharma permeates the world, our minds also become purer and more expansive.

sentences.zh: 在這個春風吹大地，佛法滿人間的日子裡，我們應該懷著感恩之心，珍惜當下。
sentences.en: In these days when soothing spring breezes caress the Earth and the wisdom of Dharma permeates the world, we should hold gratitude in our hearts and cherish the present moment.

phrase.zh: 春風吹大地 和氣到人間
phrase.en: Soothing spring breezes caress the Earth; The joy of harmony permeate the world.

sentences.zh: 春風吹大地，和氣到人間，萬物復蘇，生機勃勃。
sentences.en: Soothing spring breezes caress the Earth; The joy of harmony permeates the world, bringing all things back to life with vibrant energy.

sentences.zh: 每當春風吹大地，和氣到人間，一切煩惱似乎都煙消雲散。
sentences.en: Every time the soothing spring breezes caress the Earth and the joy of harmony permeates the world, all troubles seem to dissipate.

sentences.zh: 寺廟裏的僧人用禪誦迎接春風吹大地，和氣到人間的安寧祥和。
sentences.en: The monks in the temple welcome the soothing spring breezes that caress the Earth and the joy of harmony that permeates the world with their chants.

sentences.zh: 春風吹大地，和氣到人間，整個村莊充滿了和平與歡樂。
sentences.en: Soothing spring breezes caress the Earth; The joy of harmony permeates the world, filling the entire village with peace and joy.

phrase.zh: 春風吹大地 福報滿人間
phrase.en: Soothing spring breezes caress the Earth; A fortune of blessings permeate the world.

sentences.zh: 在春風吹大地的季節，我們感受到福報滿人間的美好。
sentences.en: In the season when soothing spring breezes caress the Earth, we feel the beauty of blessings permeating the world.

sentences.zh: 春風吹大地，福報滿人間，我們以慈悲心走進每一天。
sentences.en: Soothing spring breezes caress the Earth; A fortune of blessings permeate the world, as we step into each day with compassion.

sentences.zh: 春風吹大地，萬物復蘇，福報滿人間，祥和安詳。
sentences.en: Soothing spring breezes caress the Earth, bringing everything back to life, and a fortune of blessings permeates the world, creating peace and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 在佛法的指引下，春風吹大地，福報滿人間，心靈也得到了淨化。
sentences.en: Under the guidance of Buddhist teachings, as soothing spring breezes caress the Earth, a fortune of blessings permeates the world, purifying our minds as well.

phrase.zh: 春風會讓生命成長 夏日會讓生命成熟 秋涼會讓生命考驗 冬陽會讓生命溫暖
phrase.en: Spring breeze will help life grow, Summer day will help life mature, Autumn cool will keep life strong, Winter sun will keep life warm.

sentences.zh: 春風會讓生命成長，如同希望的種子在和煦的風中紮根發芽。
sentences.en: Spring breeze will help life grow, just like seeds of hope taking root and sprouting in the gentle wind.

sentences.zh: 夏日會讓生命成熟，經歷了風雨，萬物終能結出豐碩的果實。
sentences.en: Summer day will help life mature, after enduring storms, everything ultimately can bear abundant fruit.

sentences.zh: 秋涼會讓生命考驗，只有經過寒冷的考驗，生命才能更堅強。
sentences.en: Autumn cool will keep life strong, only through the test of cold can life become stronger.

sentences.zh: 冬陽會讓生命溫暖，寒冬裡的一絲陽光總能帶來無限的希望和溫暖。
sentences.en: Winter sun will keep life warm, a ray of sunshine in the cold winter can always bring infinite hope and warmth.

sentences.zh: 他們終於意識到過去的錯誤，決定昨非今是，重新開始。
sentences.en: They finally realized their past mistakes and decided to correct yesterday's mistakes and start anew.

sentences.zh: 我們必須面對現實，昨非今是，改正過去的錯誤。
sentences.en: We must face reality, correct yesterday’s mistakes, and rectify our past errors.

sentences.zh: 經過深思熟慮，他選擇昨非今是，並採取行動彌補過去的過失。
sentences.en: After much contemplation, he chose to correct yesterday's mistakes and took steps to make amends for past wrongdoings.

sentences.zh: 昨非今是的心態讓她在生活中取得了巨大的進步和改變。
sentences.en: Having a mindset to correct yesterday's mistakes has brought her significant progress and change in her life.

phrase.en: Life shortens at the end of each day

sentences.zh: 是日已過，命亦隨減，我們應該好好珍惜當下的每一刻。
sentences.en: Life shortens at the end of each day, so we should cherish every moment we have.

sentences.zh: 禪師常說，是日已過，命亦隨減，告訴我們要時時反省自身行為。
sentences.en: The Zen master often reminds us that life shortens at the end of each day, urging us to constantly reflect on our actions.

sentences.zh: 每當夜幕降臨，我總會想起那句諺語：是日已過，命亦隨減，激勵自己勇敢地追逐夢想。
sentences.en: Whenever night falls, I remember the saying: 'Life shortens at the end of each day,' which motivates me to bravely pursue my dreams.

sentences.zh: 佛經中提到，是日已過，命亦隨減，提醒人們生命的無常和珍貴。
sentences.en: Buddhist scriptures mention that life shortens at the end of each day, reminding people of the impermanence and preciousness of life.

phrase.zh: 是法平等 無有高下
phrase.en: Dharma Is Equal, Without High or Low

sentences.zh: 佛陀教導我們，是法平等，無有高下，不應該以世俗身份來衡量人的價值。
sentences.en: The Buddha taught us that Dharma is equal, without high or low, and we should not measure a person's worth by worldly status.

sentences.zh: 在不同的宗教經典中，都有類似的觀念：是法平等，無有高下，人人皆應平等對待。
sentences.en: In various religious scriptures, there are similar concepts: Dharma is equal, without high or low, and everyone should be treated equally.

sentences.zh: 修行者應記住，是法平等，無有高下，以平等心看待所有眾生。
sentences.en: Practitioners should remember that Dharma is equal, without high or low, and view all beings with an equal mind.

sentences.zh: 無論是貧富貴賤，是法平等，無有高下，這是佛陀慈悲心的體現。
sentences.en: Regardless of wealth or status, Dharma is equal, without high or low; this reflects the Buddha's compassion.

sentences.zh: 每年的佛誕節慶典都在時教廣場舉行，吸引了成千上萬的信徒前來參加。
sentences.en: The annual Buddha's Birthday celebration is held at Dharma Square, attracting tens of thousands of devotees.

sentences.zh: 時教廣場以其壯麗的佛像和氛圍聞名，是學修佛法的理想地點。
sentences.en: Dharma Square is renowned for its magnificent Buddha statues and serene ambiance, making it an ideal place for studying and practicing Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 在時教廣場，每天都有法師進行公開講法，吸引了眾多追求智慧的聽眾。
sentences.en: At Dharma Square, monks hold public Dharma talks daily, attracting many listeners seeking wisdom.

sentences.zh: 我第一次參加佛教儀式就是在時教廣場，那裡的氣氛真讓人心靈寧靜。
sentences.en: My first participation in a Buddhist ceremony was at Dharma Square, where the atmosphere truly brought peace to my soul.

sentences.zh: 昨天寺廟舉行了晉山儀式，吸引了來自四面八方的信徒。
sentences.en: Yesterday, the temple held an inauguration ceremony, attracting devotees from all directions.

sentences.zh: 晉山大典是一個非常神聖的儀式，見證了新的主持正式接任。
sentences.en: The inauguration ceremony is a very sacred ritual, witnessing the formal assumption of the new abbot.

sentences.zh: 在晉山儀式上，僧人們誦經祈福，希望新主持能夠帶領寺廟走向更光明的未來。
sentences.en: During the inauguration ceremony, monks chanted prayers, hoping the new abbot would lead the temple toward a brighter future.

sentences.zh: 晉山儀式結束後，信徒們紛紛排隊上香，表達對新主持的祝福和支持。
sentences.en: After the inauguration ceremony, devotees queued up to offer incense, expressing their blessings and support for the new abbot.

sentences.zh: 寺廟的新住持即將在晉山典禮上揭幕。
sentences.en: The new abbot of the temple is set to be unveiled at the inauguration ceremony.

sentences.zh: 晉山典禮是一個非常重要的宗教儀式，標誌著新住持的正式就任。
sentences.en: The inauguration ceremony is a very important religious ritual, marking the official appointment of the new abbot.

sentences.zh: 許多信徒從各地趕來參加晉山典禮，見證這個神聖的時刻。
sentences.en: Many devotees traveled from various places to attend the inauguration ceremony and witness this sacred moment.

sentences.zh: 在晉山典禮結束後，僧侶們舉行了一場莊嚴的祈福儀式。
sentences.en: After the inauguration ceremony, the monks held a solemn blessing ritual.

sentences.zh: 每天清晨，寺院的晨鐘聲響徹雲霄，喚醒熟睡中的人們。
sentences.en: Every morning, the sound of the Morning Bell at the monastery echoes through the sky, awakening those who are asleep.

sentences.zh: 當晨鐘敲響，我們開始新一天的修行。
sentences.en: When the Morning Bell rings, we begin our day's practice.

sentences.zh: 聽到晨鐘的聲音，我感受到一種內心的寧靜和平和。
sentences.en: Hearing the sound of the Morning Bell, I feel a sense of inner peace and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 國家城鎮中的古老寺廟，每天依然保留着敲晨鐘的傳統。
sentences.en: In the old temple in the country's town, the tradition of ringing the Morning Bell is still maintained every day.

sentences.zh: 寺廟裡每天都會敲響晨鐘暮鼓，提醒僧侶們開始與結束一天的修行。
sentences.en: The temple rings the morning bells and evening drums every day to remind the monks to start and end their daily practice.

sentences.zh: 在這片幽靜的山谷中，晨鐘暮鼓的聲音顯得特別悠揚，令人心神寧靜。
sentences.en: In this tranquil valley, the sound of morning bells and evening drums is particularly soothing, bringing peace to the mind.

sentences.zh: 每當聽到晨鐘暮鼓的聲音，他就會想起在寺廟裡修行的那段日子。
sentences.en: Whenever he hears the morning bells and evening drums, he is reminded of the days he spent practicing in the temple.

sentences.zh: 晨鐘暮鼓的儀式象徵著對佛法的尊敬和對精神修養的專注。
sentences.en: The ritual of morning bells and evening drums symbolizes respect for the Dharma and a focus on spiritual cultivation.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義強調慈悲和智慧，這些價值觀普世共享。
sentences.en: The teachings of Buddhism emphasize compassion and wisdom, values shared all over the world.

sentences.zh: 佛經中的智慧被翻譯成多種語言，普世皆可學習和受益。
sentences.en: The wisdom in Buddhist scriptures has been translated into many languages, allowing people all over the world to learn and benefit from it.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒們普世舉辦祈福儀式，為世界和平祈禱。
sentences.en: Buddhists hold blessing ceremonies all over the world, praying for global peace.

sentences.zh: 普世的佛教僧伽致力於推廣和平與慈愛的理念。
sentences.en: Buddhist sanghas all over the world are dedicated to promoting ideals of peace and loving-kindness.

sentences.zh: 這項活動旨在推動普世和樂，讓世界各地的人們都能感受到幸福與和平。
sentences.en: This event aims to promote universal joy and harmony, allowing people around the world to experience happiness and peace.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義中的普世和樂強調所有生物的互相尊重與慈悲為懷。
sentences.en: The Buddhist teaching of universal joy and harmony emphasizes mutual respect and compassion for all beings.

sentences.zh: 她的願景是創造一個充滿普世和樂的社會，無論性別、種族和文化都能和諧共存。
sentences.en: Her vision is to create a society filled with universal joy and harmony, where gender, race, and culture coexist harmoniously.

sentences.zh: 在這個祝福儀式上，人們祈求普世和樂，希望所有眾生都能繁榮幸福。
sentences.en: During this blessing ceremony, people pray for universal joy and harmony, wishing for the prosperity and happiness of all beings.

sentences.zh: 普同塔是一個象徵所有生命相互連結的重要建築。
sentences.en: The Universal Unity Pagoda is an important structure symbolizing the interconnectedness of all life.

sentences.zh: 在普同塔的影子下，人們感受到強烈的和平與和諧。
sentences.en: Under the shadow of the Universal Unity Pagoda, people experience a profound sense of peace and harmony.

sentences.zh: 每年都有數千名信徒來到普同塔祈求世界和平。
sentences.en: Every year, thousands of devotees visit the Universal Unity Pagoda to pray for world peace.

sentences.zh: 普同塔的設計融合了多種文化元素，象徵著世界的多元和諧。
sentences.en: The design of the Universal Unity Pagoda incorporates elements from multiple cultures, symbolizing the world's diversity and harmony.

sentences.zh: 修行期間，僧人們每天都參加普坡，維持寺廟的潔淨和秩序。
sentences.en: During the training period, the monks participate in monastery-wide chorework every day, maintaining the cleanliness and order of the temple.

sentences.zh: 普坡是僧人日常生活的重要部分，讓他們學會謙遜和奉獻。
sentences.en: Monastery-wide chorework is an important part of the monks' daily life, teaching them humility and dedication.

sentences.zh: 即使是高僧也要參加普坡，以示平等和對工作的尊重。
sentences.en: Even senior monks participate in monastery-wide chorework to demonstrate equality and respect for the labor.

sentences.zh: 在普坡期間，僧人們互相合作，共同完成寺廟中的多項任務。
sentences.en: During monastery-wide chorework, the monks collaborate with each other to complete various tasks within the temple.

sentences.zh: 佛教信仰中的一個重要概念是普度眾生，讓所有眾生都能解脫苦海。
sentences.en: A key concept in Buddhism is universal salvation, aiming to liberate all beings from the sea of suffering.

sentences.zh: 寺廟僧人每天誦經，祈願普度世間的所有生靈，使他們獲得內心的平安。
sentences.en: Monks in the temple chant sutras daily, praying for the universal salvation of all creatures in the world, helping them attain inner peace.

sentences.zh: 慈悲為懷的菩薩們願意普度眾生，不分貴賤，一視同仁。
sentences.en: Compassionate bodhisattvas are willing to bring about universal salvation for all beings, regardless of their status, treating everyone equally.

sentences.zh: 這位大師畢生致力於普度世人，希望透過他的教誨讓更多的人走上解脫之路。
sentences.en: The master devoted his entire life to universal salvation, hoping to guide more people onto the path of liberation through his teachings.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們要有普慈廣仁的心，對待所有生命都應該心存慈悲。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us to have a heart of universal kindness and broad benevolence, treating all living beings with compassion.

sentences.zh: 他的行為體現了普慈廣仁的精神，無論貧富貴賤，他都一視同仁。
sentences.en: His actions embodied the spirit of universal kindness and broad benevolence, treating everyone equally regardless of wealth or status.

sentences.zh: 在這個動盪的時代，人們更需要以普慈廣仁的態度來化解矛盾和紛爭。
sentences.en: In these turbulent times, people need to adopt an attitude of universal kindness and broad benevolence to resolve conflicts and disputes.

sentences.zh: 老師以普慈廣仁的態度對待每一個學生，讓他們感受到了溫暖和關懷。
sentences.en: The teacher treated every student with universal kindness and broad benevolence, making them feel warmth and care.

sentences.zh: 普濟寺位於風景如畫的山腳下，每年吸引成千上萬的遊客。
sentences.en: Pu Ji Temple is situated at the scenic foothills, attracting thousands of visitors every year.

sentences.zh: 普濟寺的僧人們每天都舉行晨課和誦經儀式，為善信們祈福。
sentences.en: The monks at Pu Ji Temple hold morning prayers and chanting ceremonies daily, blessing the devotees.
