sentences.en: The newly ordained monks are learning the conducts and ways of a monastic, striving to adapt to the monastery's rules and lifestyle.

sentences.zh: 為僧之道不僅是形式上的修行，更是心靈上的修養與淨化。
sentences.en: The conducts and ways of a monastic are not just about external practices but also about internal cultivation and purification.

sentences.zh: 他深知為僧之道的艱辛，堅持每天戒律嚴守，禪修打坐。
sentences.en: He deeply understands the hardships of the conducts and ways of a monastic, consistently adhering to the precepts and practicing meditation daily.

phrase.en: Good Deeds Bring the Greatest Happiness

sentences.zh: 他深信為善最樂，因此他經常參加各種志工活動。
sentences.en: He firmly believes that good deeds bring the greatest happiness, so he often participates in various volunteer activities.

sentences.zh: 我們學校鼓勵學生們實踐為善最樂的理念，積極回饋社會。
sentences.en: Our school encourages students to practice the belief that good deeds bring the greatest happiness and actively give back to the community.

sentences.zh: 在困難的時期，他依然秉持著為善最樂的信條，幫助有需要的人。
sentences.en: Even in difficult times, he adheres to the principle that good deeds bring the greatest happiness and helps those in need.

sentences.zh: 她每天都會做一件好事，因為她相信為善最樂能讓生活更有意義。
sentences.en: She does a good deed every day because she believes good deeds bring the greatest happiness and make life more meaningful.

phrase.zh: 為大事也 何惜生命 為信仰也 何吝捨俗 為學法也 何懼委屈 為承諾也 何必反悔
phrase.en: Tis for the Greater Cause, why should even my life be spared? Tis for the Faith, why hesitate on relinquishing the mundane life? Tis for the Dharma, why fear being wronged? Tis for the promise, why regret anything?

sentences.zh: 為大事也，何惜生命？她甘願犧牲自己的安危，為了家族的利益奮鬥。
sentences.en: Tis for the Greater Cause, why should even my life be spared? She was willing to risk her safety to fight for her family's well-being.

sentences.zh: 為信仰也，何吝捨俗？他毅然決定放棄舒適的生活、投身於宗教修行。
sentences.en: Tis for the Faith, why hesitate on relinquishing the mundane life? He resolutely decided to leave his comfortable life and devote himself to religious practice.

sentences.zh: 為學法也，何懼委屈？她在修行的路上遇到了很多困難，但從未害怕過。
sentences.en: Tis for the Dharma, why fear being wronged? She encountered many difficulties on her path of practice but was never afraid.

sentences.zh: 為承諾也，何必反悔？他對朋友許下的承諾，即使面臨再大挑戰也不會反悔。
sentences.en: Tis for the promise, why regret anything? He would not regret a promise made to a friend, no matter how great the challenge.

phrase.zh: 為學要通識 人際要通情 個性要通達 求道要通理
phrase.en: Make sure the knowledge you attain is broad. Make sure the relationships you have are reasonable. Make sure the character in you is open. Make sure the path you seek is well understood.

sentences.zh: 在學習過程中，為學要通識，才能夠舉一反三，觸類旁通。
sentences.en: In the learning process, make sure the knowledge you attain is broad, so that you can draw inferences from one fact and apply them to different contexts.

sentences.zh: 與人相處時，人際要通情，才能建立真正的聯繫和理解。
sentences.en: When interacting with others, make sure the relationships you have are reasonable, so that you can establish genuine connections and understanding.

sentences.zh: 在面對人生挑戰時，個性要通達，才能保持心境平和，應對自如。
sentences.en: When facing life's challenges, make sure the character in you is open, so that you can maintain a peaceful state of mind and handle situations adeptly.

sentences.zh: 走在修行之道上，求道要通理，才能真正明白道理，行穩致遠。
sentences.en: On the path of spiritual practice, make sure the path you seek is well understood, so that you can truly grasp the principles and proceed steadily and far.

phrase.zh: 為東南亞印尼、印度地區大地震祈願文
phrase.en: A Prayer for the Earthquake and Tsunami Victims of Indonesia, India, and other South Asian Countries

sentences.zh: 我們齊聚一堂，為東南亞印尼、印度地區大地震祈願文，共同為受災群眾祈福。
sentences.en: We gathered to collectively offer a prayer for the earthquake and tsunami victims of Indonesia, India, and other South Asian countries, sending our blessings to those affected.

sentences.zh: 這篇為東南亞印尼、印度地區大地震祈願文表達了全世界對災民深切的哀痛與關懷。
sentences.en: This prayer for the earthquake and tsunami victims of Indonesia, India, and other South Asian countries expressed the world's deep sorrow and concern for the victims.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒們唸誦經文，為東南亞印尼、印度地區大地震祈願文，希望他們能夠早日重建家園。
sentences.en: Buddhists recited scriptures as a prayer for the earthquake and tsunami victims of Indonesia, India, and other South Asian countries, hoping for their swift recovery and rebuilding of their homes.

sentences.zh: 每個人都在默默祈禱，為東南亞印尼、印度地區大地震祈願文祈求平安和力量。
sentences.en: Each person silently prayed, offering a prayer for the earthquake and tsunami victims of Indonesia, India, and other South Asian countries, seeking peace and strength.

phrase.zh: 為生命留下歷史 為社會留下慈悲 為自己留下信仰 為人間留下貢獻
phrase.en: Make history in life, Give compassion to society, Keep faith for oneself, Leave benefactions to the world.

sentences.zh: 他以絕對的信念和堅持為生命留下歷史，成為人們心中的傳奇。
sentences.en: He made history in life with unwavering belief and perseverance, becoming a legend in people's hearts.

sentences.zh: 她總是盡力為社會留下慈悲，即便在最困難的時刻也不忘關愛他人。
sentences.en: She always strives to give compassion to society, even in the most challenging times, she never forgets to care for others.

sentences.zh: 修行者在每日禮佛與靜坐中，為自己留下信仰，加強內心的平靜與智慧。
sentences.en: A practitioner keeps faith for oneself through daily worship and meditation, strengthening inner peace and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 志願者們投入無私的奉獻，為人間留下貢獻，讓無數生命因此受益。
sentences.en: Volunteers offer selfless service, leaving benefactions to the world, benefiting countless lives.

phrase.zh: 為籌建佛光大學老歌義唱
phrase.en: Fo Guang University Fundraising Charity Concert

sentences.zh: 我們將舉辦一場為籌建佛光大學老歌義唱的活動，期待大家踴躍參加。
sentences.en: We will host a Fo Guang University Fundraising Charity Concert, and we hope for enthusiastic participation from everyone.

sentences.zh: 這場為籌建佛光大學老歌義唱活動將由多位著名歌手共同演出。
sentences.en: Several famous singers will jointly perform at the Fo Guang University Fundraising Charity Concert.

sentences.zh: 所有為籌建佛光大學老歌義唱活動的門票收入將全數捐出。
sentences.en: All proceeds from the Fo Guang University Fundraising Charity Concert will be donated.

sentences.zh: 志願者們辛勤準備貢獻他們的時間和精力，為籌建佛光大學老歌義唱活動加油。
sentences.en: Volunteers have worked hard, dedicating their time and effort to support the Fo Guang University Fundraising Charity Concert.

phrase.zh: 為美國卡翠納颶風紐奧爾良市水災祈願文
phrase.en: A Prayer for the Victims of the Katrina Disaster in New Orleans and the Gulf Coast

sentences.zh: 我們在此奉上為美國卡翠納颶風紐奧爾良市水災祈願文，願一切受災者早日恢復安寧。
sentences.en: We offer this prayer for the victims of the Katrina disaster in New Orleans and the Gulf Coast, hoping for their swift recovery and peace.

sentences.zh: 在佛教寺廟內，信徒們誠心地誦念為美國卡翠納颶風紐奧爾良市水災祈願文，為受難者祈福。
sentences.en: In the Buddhist temple, devotees earnestly recite a prayer for the victims of the Katrina disaster in New Orleans and the Gulf Coast, wishing for blessings upon the afflicted.

sentences.zh: 許多國際的善心人士共同響應，透過誦唸為美國卡翠納颶風紐奧爾良市水災祈願文，表達他們的支持和慰問。
sentences.en: Many compassionate people from around the world have joined together, chanting the prayer for the victims of the Katrina disaster in New Orleans and the Gulf Coast, expressing their support and condolences.

sentences.zh: 這本祈願文集中特別收錄了一篇為美國卡翠納颶風紐奧爾良市水災祈願文，旨在為受難者祈求安康。
sentences.en: This prayer anthology includes a special prayer for the victims of the Katrina disaster in New Orleans and the Gulf Coast, aimed at seeking well-being for those affected.

phrase.en: A Prayer for Our Natural Environment

sentences.zh: 每年在地球日，寺院舉行為自然生態祈願文的儀式，希望喚起人們愛護環境的意識。
sentences.en: Every year on Earth Day, the temple holds a prayer for our natural environment ceremony, hoping to raise awareness about environmental preservation.

sentences.zh: 和尚們跪在大自然中，誦讀為自然生態祈願文，祈求世界平靜與生態系統的和諧。
sentences.en: The monks knelt in the midst of nature, reciting a prayer for our natural environment, praying for world peace and ecosystem harmony.

sentences.zh: 這篇為自然生態祈願文，希望能重新喚醒人類對地球母親的愛與尊重。
sentences.en: This prayer for our natural environment seeks to rekindle humanity's love and respect for Mother Earth.

sentences.zh: 社區居民一起誦讀為自然生態祈願文，並承諾進一步保護和修復受損的自然區域。
sentences.en: Community residents gathered to recite a prayer for our natural environment and vowed to take further steps to protect and restore damaged natural areas.

phrase.zh: 煙雲皆般若 花石盡真如
phrase.en: Within twilight is Prajna hidden; Found in nature is True Thusness.

sentences.zh: 煙雲皆般若，花石盡真如，這句話意在告訴我們乾坤中的一切都是智慧的顯現。
sentences.en: Within twilight is Prajna hidden; found in nature is True Thusness, this phrase aims to tell us that all things in the universe are manifestations of wisdom.

sentences.zh: 在修行中，我們應學會觀察煙雲皆般若，花石盡真如，引導自己心靈的覺醒。
sentences.en: In practice, we should learn to observe that within twilight is Prajna hidden; found in nature is True Thusness, guiding ourselves towards spiritual awakening.

sentences.zh: 當你深刻體會到煙雲皆般若，花石盡真如，你會發現生命中每一刻都是值得珍惜的。
sentences.en: When you deeply realize that within twilight is Prajna hidden; found in nature is True Thusness, you will find that every moment in life is worth cherishing.

sentences.zh: 智慧無處不在，煙雲皆般若，花石盡真如，只要我們用心去感受。
sentences.en: Wisdom is omnipresent; within twilight is Prajna hidden; found in nature is True Thusness, as long as we sincerely perceive it.

sentences.zh: 在寺廟的早晨儀式中，僧侶們會焚香祈禱，讓香煙直達天際。
sentences.en: During the morning ritual at the temple, monks burn incense and pray, allowing the smoke to reach the heavens.

sentences.zh: 焚香是佛教徒日常修行的一部分，藉此表達他們對佛法的敬意。
sentences.en: Burning incense is part of a Buddhist's daily practice, expressing their reverence for the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 每逢重要的節日，信徒們會在家中焚香，祈求平安與幸福。
sentences.en: On important holidays, devotees burn incense at home to pray for peace and happiness.

sentences.zh: 焚香的香氣充滿了整個房間，帶來一種祥和與寧靜的氛圍。
sentences.en: The scent of burning incense filled the entire room, creating an atmosphere of peace and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 佛陀被尊為無上士，以其無可匹敵的智慧和慈悲。
sentences.en: The Buddha is revered as the unsurpassed one, for his unparalleled wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 這位無上士的教誨啟迪了無數走在菩提道上的修行者。
sentences.en: The teachings of the unsurpassed one have enlightened countless practitioners on the path to enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 他勤修佛法，希望有朝一日能成為無上士。
sentences.en: He diligently practices the Dharma, hoping one day to become an unsurpassed one.

sentences.zh: 無上士的境界是無人能及的，超越了世間的一切煩惱和限界。
sentences.en: The state of the unsurpassed one is unattainable by others, transcending all worldly troubles and limitations.

sentences.zh: 佛陀成就了無上菩提，成為了全知全覺的偉大覺者。
sentences.en: The Buddha attained Supreme Bodhi, becoming the great enlightened one who is omniscient.

sentences.zh: 修行之人以無上菩提為最終目標，追求真正的智慧和解脫。
sentences.en: Practitioners aim for Supreme Bodhi as their ultimate goal, seeking true wisdom and liberation.

sentences.zh: 無上菩提的實現需要無量劫的修行和堅定的誓願。
sentences.en: The attainment of Supreme Bodhi requires countless eons of practice and unwavering vows.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，無上菩提代表了最高的智慧和完全的覺悟。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, Supreme Bodhi represents the highest wisdom and complete enlightenment.

phrase.zh: 無人無我觀自在 非空非有見如來
phrase.en: No others, no self, a state of perfect ease; No emptiness, no existence, a realization of the Buddha.

sentences.zh: 在深度冥想中，他達到了無人無我觀自在的境界，心中充滿了平靜與安寧。
sentences.en: In deep meditation, he achieved a state of perfect ease with no others and no self, filling his heart with peace and serenity.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該努力達到無人無我觀自在的心境，超越世俗的分別心。
sentences.en: Practitioners should strive to attain a state of perfect ease without others and self, transcending worldly distinctions.

sentences.zh: 他了解到非空非有見如來的真諦，體驗到了佛性的真正意義。
sentences.en: He came to understand the true meaning of no emptiness, no existence, realizing the essence of the Buddha.

sentences.zh: 在這一刻，他超越了二元對立，看到了非空非有見如來的究竟實相。
sentences.en: In that moment, he transcended dualistic oppositions, witnessing the ultimate reality of no emptiness and no existence, realizing the Buddha.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義中的無住，強調不執著於任何形式或概念。
sentences.en: The Buddhist doctrine of non-abiding emphasizes not clinging to any form or concept.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該理解並實踐無住，以達到心靈的解脫。
sentences.en: Practitioners should understand and practice non-abiding to achieve spiritual liberation.

sentences.zh: 他常常提醒自己要無住於狀態或情緒，保持心靈的清明。
sentences.en: He often reminds himself to be non-abiding with states or emotions, maintaining clarity of mind.

sentences.zh: 無住並不意味著冷漠，而是對一切現象保持一種超然的態度。
sentences.en: Non-abiding does not mean indifference but maintaining a detached attitude towards all phenomena.

sentences.zh: 修行者應當培養無住生心，不執著於任何形式的妄念。
sentences.en: A practitioner should cultivate a non-abiding mind, not clinging to any forms of delusions.

sentences.zh: 在面對困難時，保持無住生心能夠讓我們更加平靜和自如。
sentences.en: When facing difficulties, maintaining a non-abiding mind allows us to remain calm and at ease.

sentences.zh: 無住生心是參禪修行中一個重要的概念，強調了不執於境相。
sentences.en: Non-abiding mind is an important concept in Zen practice, emphasizing non-attachment to phenomena.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒追求無住生心，以便在日常生活中達到心境的清明與自由。
sentences.en: Buddhists strive for a non-abiding mind to achieve clarity and freedom in their daily lives.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該抱有無分別心，對待所有眾生一視同仁。
sentences.en: A practitioner should hold a non-discriminative heart and treat all sentient beings equally.

sentences.zh: 無分別的愛是佛教慈悲的核心，超越了種族、宗教和國界。
sentences.en: Non-discriminative love is at the core of Buddhist compassion, transcending race, religion, and national boundaries.

sentences.zh: 佛陀教導我們要在無分別中尋求真理，放下所有的偏見。
sentences.en: The Buddha teaches us to seek truth in a non-discriminative manner, letting go of all prejudices.

sentences.zh: 無分別的智慧能夠讓我們看清萬物的本質，從而獲得真正的解脫。
sentences.en: Non-discriminative wisdom allows us to see the true nature of all things, thereby attaining genuine liberation.

sentences.zh: 修行者要達到無分別智，需要長期的禪修和自省。
sentences.en: To attain undiscriminating wisdom, a practitioner needs long-term meditation and self-reflection.

sentences.zh: 無分別智讓人能夠超越對立、看到一切事物的本質。
sentences.en: Undiscriminating wisdom allows one to transcend dualities and see the true nature of all things.

sentences.zh: 菩薩通過無分別智來利益眾生，不分貴賤，不分親仇。
sentences.en: A bodhisattva uses undiscriminating wisdom to benefit all beings, without distinguishing between high and low, friend and foe.

sentences.zh: 無分別智是一種超越知識的智慧，直接觀照真理。
sentences.en: Undiscriminating wisdom is a form of transcendental insight that directly perceives the truth.

sentences.zh: 佛陀的智慧無垢，能夠透徹地看到一切事物的真相。
sentences.en: The Buddha's wisdom is without impurity, able to see the true nature of all things clearly.

sentences.zh: 修行者通過禪定可以達到心靈的無垢狀態。
sentences.en: Practitioners can achieve a state of no impurity in their minds through meditation.

sentences.zh: 在佛教教義中，無垢的心是一種完美的境界，沒有任何煩惱和污染。
sentences.en: In Buddhist teachings, a mind of no impurity is a perfect state, free from any troubles and contamination.

sentences.zh: 那些修行到達無垢的人，通常被稱為阿羅漢或菩薩。
sentences.en: Those who attain a state of no impurity in their practice are often referred to as Arhats or Bodhisattvas.

phrase.zh: 無大無小無內外 有您有我有眾生
phrase.en: There is no biggest, no smallest, and no inside or outside; There is you, I, and sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 在真理的境界裡，無大無小無內外，有您有我有眾生，所有眾生平等無差別。
sentences.en: In the realm of truth, there is no biggest, no smallest, and no inside or outside; there is you, I, and sentient beings, all beings are equal without distinction.

sentences.zh: 通過修行，我們可以體驗到無大無小無內外的真相，並認識到有您有我有眾生，每個生命都值得尊重。
sentences.en: Through practice, we can realize the truth of no biggest, no smallest, and no inside or outside, and recognize that there is you, I, and sentient beings, every life deserves respect.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們要對待一切存在無大無小無內外，並認識到有您有我有眾生的全球共生理念。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us to treat all existence without seeing big, small, inside, or outside distinctions, and to understand the interconnectedness of you, I, and sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 當我們放下分別心，就能體驗到無大無小無內外的境界，並感受到有您有我有眾生的和諧共處。
sentences.en: When we let go of distinctions, we can experience the state of no biggest, no smallest, and no inside or outside, and feel the harmonious coexistence of you, I, and sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 在佛教修行中，無學位指的是菩薩達到最高智慧的階段，不再需要進一步學習。
sentences.en: In Buddhist practice, the stage of no more learning refers to the highest level of wisdom attained by a Bodhisattva, where no further learning is required.

sentences.zh: 達到無學位並不意味著停止修行，而是表示已經掌握了所有必要的教義。
sentences.en: Reaching the stage of no more learning does not mean ceasing practice, but indicates that all necessary teachings have been mastered.

sentences.zh: 在佛陀的教導中，無學位是一個非常高的境界，是修行者追求的最終目標。
sentences.en: In the Buddha's teachings, the stage of no more learning is a very high state, the ultimate goal pursued by practitioners.

sentences.zh: 這位高僧經過多年的修行，終於達到了無學位的境界，獲得了徹底的解脫。
sentences.en: After many years of practice, this venerable monk finally reached the stage of no more learning, attaining complete liberation.

sentences.zh: 佛陀證悟的智慧被稱為無師智，這種智慧不依賴於外在的教導。
sentences.en: The wisdom attained by the Buddha is known as untaught wisdom, which does not rely on external teachings.

sentences.zh: 無師智是指那種內在自然而生的覺悟，不需要任何人的指導。
sentences.en: Untaught wisdom refers to the innate enlightenment that arises naturally from within, without the guidance of anyone.

sentences.zh: 在深度禪修中，有時會體驗到無師智，這是一種自我頓悟的狀態。
sentences.en: During deep meditation, one might occasionally experience untaught wisdom, a state of self-realization.

sentences.zh: 古代聖賢常因其無師智被人稱頌，他們的智慧似乎來自於宇宙的真理。
sentences.en: Ancient sages were often praised for their untaught wisdom; their insights seemed to come from the truths of the universe.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義強調世間萬物皆無常，教導人們要以平常心面對變遷。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings emphasize that all things in the world are impermanent, encouraging people to face changes with equanimity.

sentences.zh: 人生無常，我們應該珍惜當下的每一刻。
sentences.en: Life is impermanent; we should cherish every moment of the present.

sentences.zh: 透過理解無常的道理，人們可以減少痛苦和執著。
sentences.en: By understanding the principle of impermanence, people can reduce suffering and attachment.

sentences.zh: 佛祖告誡弟子要常思無常，因為這樣能幫助他們達到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: The Buddha advised his disciples to constantly reflect on impermanence, as it helps them achieve inner peace.

sentences.zh: 在這個無常迅速的世界，我們更應珍惜當下。
sentences.en: In this world where impermanence strikes fast, we should cherish the present moment even more.

sentences.zh: 無常迅速正如人生，總是在你不預料的時候發生。
sentences.en: Impermanence strikes fast just like life; it always happens when you least expect it.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義中強調無常迅速，提醒人們生命的短暫和變幻。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings emphasize that impermanence strikes fast, reminding people of the brevity and changeability of life.

sentences.zh: 面對無常迅速的現實，人們應該練習心靈的平靜和安定。
sentences.en: Facing the reality that impermanence strikes fast, people should practice mental calmness and stability.

sentences.zh: 菩薩行者在修行中體悟無得的智慧，超越了所有執著與障礙。
sentences.en: A Bodhisattva practitioner realizes the wisdom of non-attainment during practice, transcending all attachments and obstacles.

sentences.zh: 佛陀教導我們要修行無得，不計較結果，只在意當下的付出。
sentences.en: Buddha taught us to practice non-attainment, not to mind the results, but to focus on the effort in the present moment.

sentences.zh: 無得的境界意味著已放下所有執著，達到了真正的自由。
sentences.en: The state of non-attainment means having let go of all attachments, achieving true freedom.

sentences.zh: 在禪修過程中，練習無得能幫助我們平靜心靈，尋找內在的明晰。
sentences.en: During meditation practice, applying non-attainment can help us calm the mind and find inner clarity.

sentences.zh: 修習禪定可以幫助我們達到無心的境界，超越世俗的煩惱。
sentences.en: Practicing meditation can help us achieve the state of No-Mind, transcending worldly troubles.

sentences.zh: 他在面對困難的時候，總能保持無心的態度，不受外界干擾。
sentences.en: When facing difficulties, he always maintains a No-Mind attitude, undisturbed by external influences.

sentences.zh: 無心的修行並不是冷漠，而是一種更高層次的覺悟和理解。
sentences.en: The practice of No-Mind is not about indifference, but rather a higher level of awareness and understanding.

sentences.zh: 在日常生活中，我們可以通過無心的態度來減少內心的焦慮和壓力。
sentences.en: In daily life, we can reduce inner anxiety and stress by adopting a No-Mind attitude.

sentences.zh: 佛教的修行者追求無念，並通過冥想達到這種狀態。
sentences.en: Buddhist practitioners seek to be free from thought and achieve this state through meditation.

sentences.zh: 在深度冥想中，我們可以達到無念的境界，感受到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: In deep meditation, we can reach a state free from thought and feel inner peace.

sentences.zh: 無念並不是完全無思，而是沒有執著於任何特定的念頭或感受。
sentences.en: Being free from thought is not about having no thoughts at all, but rather about not clinging to any specific thoughts or feelings.

sentences.zh: 他練習無念多年，逐漸能夠在日常生活中保持心靈的平靜。
sentences.en: He practiced being free from thought for many years and gradually managed to maintain mental tranquility in daily life.

sentences.zh: 他無怨無悔地選擇了這條路，即使艱辛也從不後悔。
sentences.en: He chose this path with no regret or resentment, never looking back despite the hardships.

sentences.zh: 她對自己的決定無怨無悔，認為這是人生中最重要的一步。
sentences.en: She feels no regret or resentment about her decision, believing it to be the most important step in her life.

sentences.zh: 我們應該學會無怨無悔地接受生活中的挑戰，這樣才能成長。
sentences.en: We should learn to accept the challenges of life with no regret or resentment, for this is how we grow.

sentences.zh: 他無怨無悔地照顧生病的母親，無論多麼勞累也不曾怨言。
sentences.en: He cared for his sick mother with no regret or resentment, never complaining no matter how tired he was.

sentences.zh: 他決定辭去工作，追求自己的夢想，對此他無悔。
sentences.en: He decided to quit his job and pursue his dreams, and he had no regrets about it.

sentences.zh: 這一生，我走過許多曲折的道路，但我無悔於所選擇的方向。
sentences.en: In this life, I have walked many winding paths, but I have no regrets about the direction I chose.

sentences.zh: 她回顧過去十年的努力，感到無悔，因為每一步都充滿了意義。
sentences.en: Reflecting on the past ten years of hard work, she felt no regrets, as every step was full of purpose.

sentences.zh: 儘管遭遇許多失敗，他始終堅持初心，無怨無悔。
sentences.en: Despite facing many failures, he always stayed true to his original intention, with no complaints and no regrets.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們要對一切眾生慈悲，即便是無情的石頭與花草，我們也應當心懷敬意。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us to have compassion for all beings, including insentient stones and plants, and to treat them with respect.

sentences.zh: 無情的暴風雨摧毀了村莊，人們不得不重新建造家園。
sentences.en: The insentient storm destroyed the village, forcing the inhabitants to rebuild their homes.

sentences.zh: 他的話語如同無情的利劍，刺痛了她的心靈。
sentences.en: His words were like an insentient dagger, piercing her heart deeply.

sentences.zh: 山川河流雖然無情，但它們的存在對我們的生命依然重要。
sentences.en: Mountains and rivers may be insentient, but their existence remains crucial to our lives.

sentences.zh: 他總是誠實待人，無愧於心。
sentences.en: He always treats people honestly, with a clear conscience.

sentences.zh: 即使面臨重重壓力，她仍然保持內心的無愧。
sentences.en: Even under intense pressure, she maintains her clear conscience.

sentences.zh: 遵從內心的信念，他做每件事都無愧於天地。
sentences.en: Following his inner beliefs, he does everything with a clear conscience before heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 每天反省自己，他確保自己的一舉一動無愧於心。
sentences.en: By reflecting on himself every day, he ensures that all his actions are performed with a clear conscience.

sentences.zh: 修行者通過冥想達到了無憂的境界，身心得到了極大的安寧。
sentences.en: The practitioner reached a state of being without sorrow through meditation, attaining great peace of mind and body.

sentences.zh: 這座古老的寺廟在一個無憂的環境中，使人感到心靈的淨化。
sentences.en: The ancient temple, situated in an environment without sorrow, provided a sense of spiritual purification.

sentences.zh: 小村莊民風純樸，居民們過著簡單且無憂的生活。
sentences.en: The small village had a simple and honest way of life, with residents living in a state without sorrow.

sentences.zh: 通過修持佛法，他逐漸從世俗的痛苦中解脫，達到了無憂的心境。
sentences.en: Through the practice of Buddhist teachings, he gradually liberated himself from worldly sufferings and attained a state of mind without sorrow.

sentences.zh: 他經常被稱為無憂人，因為他總是面帶微笑，生活中好像沒有什麼能困擾他。
sentences.en: He is often called the carefree one because he always has a smile on his face, and nothing in life seems to trouble him.

sentences.zh: 成為無憂人並不容易，需要我們放下執著和慾望，才能獲得內心的平靜。
sentences.en: Becoming a carefree one is not easy; it requires us to let go of attachments and desires to achieve inner peace.

sentences.zh: 她欣賞那位無憂人的生活態度，相信簡單的生活可以帶來最大的快樂。
sentences.en: She admires the carefree one's way of living, believing that a simple life brings the greatest joy.

sentences.zh: 無憂人的心境來自於長期的修行和對生活本質的深刻理解。
sentences.en: The state of being a carefree one comes from long-term practice and a profound understanding of the nature of life.

phrase.zh: 無懼念頭起 只怕覺照遲
phrase.en: Fear not thoughts that arise; Only the delay of realization and awareness.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該無懼念頭起，因為真正的問題在於覺照遲。
sentences.en: A practitioner should fear not thoughts that arise, as the real issue lies in the delay of realization and awareness.

sentences.zh: 當困擾的念頭出現時，我們需要無懼念頭起，只怕覺照遲。
sentences.en: When disturbing thoughts arise, we need to fear not thoughts that arise; only the delay of realization and awareness.

sentences.zh: 無論何時，面對煩惱應該無懼念頭起，重點在於避免覺照遲。
sentences.en: At any time, when facing troubles, one should fear not thoughts that arise; the key is to avoid the delay of realization and awareness.

sentences.zh: 禪修過程中重要的是無懼念頭起，而應該重視避免覺照遲。
sentences.en: During meditation, it's important to fear not thoughts that arise and rather focus on avoiding the delay of realization and awareness.

phrase.zh: 無我無人無世界 有事有理有眾生
phrase.en: There is no self, no people, no world; There is matter, reason, and sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 佛法教導我們無我無人無世界，有事有理有眾生，這是理解空性的關鍵。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us that there is no self, no people, no world; there is matter, reason, and sentient beings, which is key to understanding emptiness.

sentences.zh: 修行者需要體悟無我無人無世界，有事有理有眾生的道理，以達到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: Practitioners need to realize that there is no self, no people, no world; there is matter, reason, and sentient beings in order to attain inner peace.

sentences.zh: 透過禪修，我們可以逐漸體會無我無人無世界的境界，並且了解到有事有理有眾生的實相。
sentences.en: Through meditation, we can gradually experience a state where there is no self, no people, no world, and understand the reality that there is matter, reason, and sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 無我無人無世界的觀念幫助我們更深刻地理解有事有理有眾生的內涵，從而解脫輪迴。
sentences.en: The concept that there is no self, no people, no world helps us deeply understand that there is matter, reason, and sentient beings, thereby liberating us from the cycle of rebirth.

phrase.zh: 無我相，無人相，無眾生相，無壽者相
phrase.en: no notion of a self, no notion of others, no notion of sentient beings, no notion of longevity

sentences.zh: 修行者應該時刻保持無我相，無人相，無眾生相，無壽者相，以獲得真正的解脫。
sentences.en: Practitioners should constantly maintain no notion of a self, no notion of others, no notion of sentient beings, no notion of longevity to attain true liberation.

sentences.zh: 佛陀教導我們摒棄無我相，無人相，無眾生相，無壽者相，才能超越一切束縛。
sentences.en: The Buddha taught us to discard the notions of a self, others, sentient beings, and longevity to transcend all attachments.

sentences.zh: 在心境平和的狀態下，修行者可以更容易地理解無我相，無人相，無眾生相，無壽者相的真意。
sentences.en: In a state of mental tranquility, practitioners can more easily grasp the true meaning of no notion of a self, no notion of others, no notion of sentient beings, and no notion of longevity.

sentences.zh: 無我相，無人相，無眾生相，無壽者相是空性智慧的重要表現，是通向覺悟的關鍵。
sentences.en: The principles of no notion of a self, no notion of others, no notion of sentient beings, and no notion of longevity are crucial expressions of the wisdom of emptiness, key to achieving enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 在般若波羅蜜多心經中，指出真正的智慧來自於無所得的境界。
sentences.en: In the Heart Sutra, it is stated that true wisdom arises from the state of nothing to be attained.

sentences.zh: 修行者如果能夠理解無所得的真諦，便能免除內心的執著與煩惱。
sentences.en: If a practitioner can comprehend the true essence of nothing to be attained, they can be free from internal attachments and troubles.

sentences.zh: 無所得並不是什麼都沒有，而是一種解脫的狀態，超越了世俗的追求。
sentences.en: Nothing to be attained does not mean having nothing, but rather a liberated state that transcends worldly pursuits.

sentences.zh: 佛教的智慧教我們在無所得中找到心靈的平靜與自由。
sentences.en: Buddhist wisdom teaches us to find inner peace and freedom in the concept of nothing to be attained.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們，無明是造成輪迴的根源之一。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us that ignorance is one of the roots of the cycle of rebirth.

sentences.zh: 透過修行和智慧，我們可以消除內心的無明。
sentences.en: Through practice and wisdom, we can diminish the ignorance within our minds.

sentences.zh: 無明使人陷入痛苦和迷惑，而佛法能帶來真正的覺醒和解脫。
sentences.en: Ignorance traps people in suffering and confusion, while the Dharma brings true awakening and liberation.

sentences.zh: 老師經常提醒我們，不要讓無明遮蔽了我們的清明心。
sentences.en: Our teacher often reminds us not to let ignorance obscure our clear mind.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義中認為，無明火是煩惱的根源。
sentences.en: In Buddhist teachings, the fire of ignorance is considered the root of afflictions.

sentences.zh: 修行的目的是熄滅心中的無明火，達到智慧的境地。
sentences.en: The purpose of practice is to extinguish the fire of ignorance in the heart and attain a state of wisdom.

sentences.zh: 他因無明火而煩惱重重，無法看到事情的真相。
sentences.en: He is deeply troubled by the fire of ignorance, unable to see the truth of matters.

sentences.zh: 禪修能幫助我們控制無明火，使心靈平靜。
sentences.en: Meditation can help us control the fire of ignorance and bring peace to our minds.

sentences.zh: 達到無求的境界是一種心靈上的自由，能讓人擺脫執著。
sentences.en: Achieving a state of no desires is a form of spiritual freedom, allowing one to let go of attachment.

sentences.zh: 真正的快樂來自於內心的無求，而非外界的物質享受。
sentences.en: True happiness comes from an inner state of no desires, rather than material pleasures from the outside world.

sentences.zh: 修行無求之道，需要長期的自我反省和心靈鍛鍊。
sentences.en: Practicing the path of no desires requires long-term self-reflection and spiritual training.

sentences.zh: 無求的生活方式容易促進心靈的平靜和滿足。
sentences.en: A lifestyle of no desires tends to promote inner peace and contentment.

phrase.en: A Desireless Mind Is Also a Noble Mind

sentences.zh: 他一個無求品高的人，總是表現出極大的仁慈和智慧。
sentences.en: He is a person of a desireless mind, always demonstrating immense compassion and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 修行到了無求品高的境界，就能夠保持心靈的平靜與純潔。
sentences.en: When one reaches the state where 'a desireless mind is also a noble mind,' they can maintain peace and purity of the soul.

sentences.zh: 在現代社會中，無求品高的精神更顯得彌足珍貴。
sentences.en: In modern society, the spirit of 'a desireless mind is also a noble mind' is even more precious.

sentences.zh: 無求品高的心態能夠幫助我們看淡物質追求，追求內在的成長與幸福。
sentences.en: A desireless mind helps us to look beyond material pursuits and seek inner growth and happiness.

sentences.zh: 在他的深層禪修中，他體會到了無法可得的境界。
sentences.en: In his deep meditation, he realized the state of no-dharma.

sentences.zh: 無法可以理解為脫離所有概念和形象的徹底解脫。
sentences.en: No-dharma can be understood as the ultimate liberation from all concepts and forms.

sentences.zh: 大師教導我們要學會在日常生活中體會無法的智慧。
sentences.en: The master teaches us to imbibe the wisdom of no-dharma in our daily lives.

sentences.zh: 若能悟到無法的境界，我們便能真正解脫煩惱和痛苦。
sentences.en: If we can realize the state of no-dharma, we can truly liberate ourselves from suffering and distress.

sentences.zh: 佛教經典強調，他的心境達到了無漏的境地，沒有任何煩惱障礙。
sentences.en: Buddhist scriptures emphasize that his state of mind has reached an untainted level, free from any afflictions.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該努力達成無漏智慧，才能獲得真正的解脫和安樂。
sentences.en: Practitioners should strive to attain untainted wisdom in order to achieve true liberation and peace.

sentences.zh: 無漏的心態是修行中極其重要的目標，使人能夠超越世俗的束縛。
sentences.en: An untainted mindset is an extremely important goal in practice, enabling one to transcend worldly constraints.

sentences.zh: 大師的慈悲和智慧無漏，讓弟子們深受啟發，引領他們走上了修行之道。
sentences.en: The master's compassion and wisdom are untainted, deeply inspiring the disciples and leading them on the path of practice.

sentences.zh: 修行者通過禪定和智慧的結合，可以達到無漏智的境界。
sentences.en: By combining meditation and wisdom, practitioners can reach the state of untainted wisdom.

sentences.zh: 無漏智是佛陀所獲得的最高智慧，無一絲煩惱的污染。
sentences.en: Untainted wisdom is the highest wisdom attained by the Buddha, free from any trace of defilements.

sentences.zh: 獲得無漏智需要長期的修行和對佛法的深刻理解。
sentences.en: Attaining untainted wisdom requires long-term practice and a deep understanding of the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 只有通過無漏智，我們才能真正解脫生死輪迴。
sentences.en: Only through untainted wisdom can we truly liberate ourselves from the cycle of birth and death.

sentences.zh: 道家的哲學常提到無為，強調順應自然的法則。
sentences.en: Taoist philosophy often mentions Non-Doing, emphasizing alignment with the laws of nature.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，無為是一種高級的精神境界，意味著無需刻意為之。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, Non-Doing is a high spiritual state, meaning there is no need for deliberate action.

sentences.zh: 他經常冥想以達到無為的狀態，讓心靈平靜無波。
sentences.en: He often meditates to achieve a state of Non-Doing, allowing his mind to be calm and undisturbed.

sentences.zh: 無為不代表什麼都不做，而是在做事時保持心境平和。
sentences.en: Non-Doing doesn't mean doing nothing; it means maintaining a peaceful mind while acting.

sentences.zh: 他住在遠離喧囂的無為舍中，尋求內心的平靜。
sentences.en: He resides in the Abode of Non-Doing, far from the hustle and bustle, seeking inner peace.

sentences.zh: 無為舍象徵著佛教徒追求無為而治的最高境界。
sentences.en: The Abode of Non-Doing symbolizes the highest state of non-action pursued by Buddhists.

sentences.zh: 在無為舍中，修行者放下自我，全心投入禪修。
sentences.en: In the Abode of Non-Doing, practitioners let go of the self and fully engage in meditation.

sentences.zh: 許多人到無為舍朝聖，尋求智慧和解脫。
sentences.en: Many people make pilgrimages to the Abode of Non-Doing, seeking wisdom and liberation.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義提倡無為舍，追求內心和平與解脫。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings advocate for the house of nirvana, seeking inner peace and liberation.

sentences.zh: 他希望能夠達到無為舍的境界，不再受到煩惱的束縛。
sentences.en: He hopes to reach the state of the house of nirvana, no longer being bound by troubles.

sentences.zh: 在禪修的過程中，她感受到了無為舍的祥和與安詳。
sentences.en: During meditation, she felt the serenity and tranquility of the house of nirvana.

sentences.zh: 無為舍並非一個具體的地方，而是一種心靈的解脫與自在。
sentences.en: The house of nirvana is not a physical place, but a state of mental liberation and ease.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義中所指的無生，是說一切現象沒有實體的生起。
sentences.en: In Buddhist teachings, 'No-Birth' refers to the concept that all phenomena do not arise with an inherent existence.

sentences.zh: 無生法忍是一種智慧的境界，表示對生死的超越。
sentences.en: The patience in the no-birth dharma represents a state of wisdom that transcends life and death.

sentences.zh: 了解無生的道理，可以幫助我們解脫煩惱，獲得內心的平靜。
sentences.en: Understanding the principle of no-birth can help us liberate from troubles and attain inner peace.

sentences.zh: 修行者需體悟無生的真理，這樣才能達到涅槃的境界。
sentences.en: Practitioners must realize the truth of no-birth to reach the state of Nirvana.

sentences.zh: 修煉無生忍可以幫助人們在面對困難時保持心靈的平靜。
sentences.en: Cultivating non-arising tolerance can help people maintain inner peace when facing difficulties.

sentences.zh: 他在鍛鍊無生忍的過程中學會了如何對抗煩惱和煩擾。
sentences.en: In the process of practicing non-arising tolerance, he learned how to combat worries and disturbances.

sentences.zh: 無生忍是菩薩修行中非常重要的一部分，讓他們能夠無畏地幫助眾生。
sentences.en: Non-arising tolerance is a crucial part of a bodhisattva's practice, allowing them to fearlessly help all beings.

sentences.zh: 掌握無生忍需要長時間的修行和內在反思。
sentences.en: Mastering non-arising tolerance requires long-term practice and inner reflection.

sentences.zh: 修行者通過長期的靜坐冥想，最終達到了無生智的境界。
sentences.en: Through prolonged meditation, the practitioner eventually achieved the state of Non-Arising Wisdom.

sentences.zh: 無生智使他在面對困難時保持心境平和，不為煩惱所動。
sentences.en: Non-Arising Wisdom allowed him to maintain a serene state of mind when facing difficulties, unaffected by worries.

sentences.zh: 大師教導弟子們，無生智是一種超越生死的智慧。
sentences.en: The master taught his disciples that Non-Arising Wisdom is a form of wisdom that transcends life and death.

sentences.zh: 在經典中，佛陀多次提到無生智的重要性，並鼓勵眾生追求此境界。
sentences.en: In the scriptures, the Buddha often mentioned the importance of Non-Arising Wisdom and encouraged beings to strive for this state.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該努力培養無生法忍，以達到最高的智慧境界。
sentences.en: Practitioners should strive to develop Tolerance of Non-Arising Dharmas to attain the highest wisdom.

sentences.zh: 在面對苦難時，他以無生法忍來保持心靈的平靜不被動搖。
sentences.en: In facing suffering, he maintains his inner peace through the Tolerance of Non-Arising Dharmas.

sentences.zh: 大乘佛教強調，無生法忍是菩薩修行的一個重要階段。
sentences.en: Mahayana Buddhism emphasizes that the Tolerance of Non-Arising Dharmas is an essential stage in a Bodhisattva's practice.

sentences.zh: 陳老師在講課中詳細解釋了無生法忍的理念和修行方法。
sentences.en: Teacher Chen explained the concept and practice methods of the Tolerance of Non-Arising Dharmas in detail during his lecture.

sentences.zh: 這些鑰匙已經過時了，現在它們只是無用與無明的物件。
sentences.en: These keys are outdated, and now they are objects without use and without clarity.

sentences.zh: 在沒有正確引導的情況下，知識可能會變得無用與無明。
sentences.en: Without proper guidance, knowledge can become without use and without clarity.

sentences.zh: 一個沒有目標的人生就如同無用與無明的漂泊。
sentences.en: A life without a goal is like drifting without use and without clarity.

sentences.zh: 無用與無明的行為往往導致混亂和困惑。
sentences.en: Actions without use and without clarity often lead to confusion and chaos.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義鼓勵我們以無畏的態度面對人生的挑戰。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings encourage us to face life's challenges with a fearless attitude.

sentences.zh: 他的無畏精神激勵了周圍的每一個人，特別是在困難時期。
sentences.en: His fearless spirit inspired everyone around him, especially during difficult times.

sentences.zh: 她無畏地穿越黑暗的森林，心中只有對家人的牽掛。
sentences.en: She walked through the dark forest fearlessly, with only thoughts of her family in mind.

sentences.zh: 菩薩以無畏的智慧度化有情眾生，無懼艱險。
sentences.en: Bodhisattvas use their fearless wisdom to guide sentient beings, undeterred by difficulties.

sentences.zh: 菩薩經常無畏施，幫助眾生擺脫恐懼和困難。
sentences.en: Bodhisattvas often bestow fearlessness, helping sentient beings overcome fear and difficulties.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，無畏施是四種重要的布施之一，代表解除他人的恐懼。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, bestowing fearlessness is one of the four essential types of giving, symbolizing the removal of others' fears.

sentences.zh: 他用自己的言行無畏施，使身邊的人感到安全和安心。
sentences.en: He bestows fearlessness through his words and actions, making those around him feel safe and secure.

sentences.zh: 無畏施不只是物質上的幫助，更是精神上的支持和鼓勵。
sentences.en: Bestowing fearlessness is not just material aid but also spiritual support and encouragement.

sentences.zh: 無言是最高明的開示，真正的智慧往往需要無聲的傳達。
sentences.en: The wisest teaching is usually taught without words, as true wisdom often requires a silent conveyance.

sentences.zh: 無諍是最強大的力量，能夠與人和睦相處才是最大的力量。
sentences.en: The strongest power is to be without dispute; being able to get along harmoniously with others is the greatest power.

sentences.zh: 無欲是最富有的境界，不被物質所困才能體驗到真正的富足。
sentences.en: The greatest wealth is to be without desires; only by being unbound by material possessions can one experience true abundance.

sentences.zh: 無我是最高雅的情操，捨棄我的執著可以達到最高的境界。
sentences.en: The highest grace is to be without self; relinquishing attachment to 'self' allows one to attain the highest state.

sentences.zh: 無怨是最慈悲的涵養，寬恕他人是培養慈悲心之根本。
sentences.en: The highest compassion is to be without resentment; forgiving others is fundamental to cultivating a compassionate heart.

sentences.zh: 無私是最高尚的人性，助人為樂而不求回報是人性中最光輝的一面。
sentences.en: The noblest character is to be without selfishness; finding joy in helping others without expecting anything in return is the most radiant aspect of human nature.

sentences.zh: 無求是最有德的風範，不求回報才能展現真正的德行。
sentences.en: The greatest virtue is to be without want; true virtue is shown by expecting nothing in return.

sentences.zh: 無聲是最安詳的領域，寂靜才能體現內心的平和與安詳。
sentences.en: The most peaceful place to be is one without sound; tranquility best reflects inner peace and serenity.

sentences.zh: 無畏是最勇敢的氣魄，無所畏懼才能迎接真正的挑戰。
sentences.en: The greatest bravery is to be without unease; true courage comes from facing challenges without fear.

sentences.zh: 無喧是最平和的談吐，能夠心平氣和地與人交流是最珍貴的。
sentences.en: The most peaceful speech is one without quarrel; being able to communicate calmly is most valuable.

sentences.zh: 無憂是最安然的生活，無牽掛的生活是最愉悅的。
sentences.en: The most peaceful way of life is to live without worries; a life without cares is the most joyous.

sentences.zh: 真理是無常的，所有現象都是變化不定的。
sentences.en: The greatest Truth: all phenomena are impermanent; everything is subject to change.

sentences.zh: 無念是最清淨的意識，遠離妄念才能保持內心的純淨。
sentences.en: The purest mind is one without thoughts; staying away from delusive thoughts keeps the mind pure.

sentences.zh: 無住是最擴大的胸懷，不執著於一處才能擁有開闊的心胸。
sentences.en: The biggest heart is one without abiding; not clinging to one place allows for an open-hearted existence.

sentences.zh: 無相是最美好的空有，無形無相才是最高的存在。
sentences.en: The greatest way of existence is to be without form; formlessness is the highest existence.

sentences.zh: 無遮是最平等的布施，真正的施捨不分彼此、不加選擇。
sentences.en: The most equal form of giving is done without selection; true charity knows no discrimination or choice.

sentences.zh: 無礙是最豁達的態度，心無掛礙才能達到完全的開朗。
sentences.en: The most generous mind is one without hindrance; a carefree mind leads to utmost openness.

sentences.zh: 無為是最自然的樂章，自然之音來自於無為。
sentences.en: The most natural sound is created by non-action; the natural melody arises from effortless being.

sentences.zh: 無憾是最可貴的人生，無所遺憾的生活是最值得珍惜的。
sentences.en: The greatest prize in life is to live without regrets; a life without regrets is most precious.

sentences.zh: 無漏是最究竟的解脫，達到無漏才是最終的解脫。
sentences.en: The ultimate form of liberation: to be without imperfection; attaining this state is the highest form of liberation.

sentences.zh: 無怖是最自在的環境。
sentences.en: The most comfortable environment is one without fear.

sentences.zh: 無夢是最舒適的睡眠。
sentences.en: The best night of sleep is one without dreams.

sentences.zh: 無妨是最有量的修養。
sentences.en: The most substantial cultivation is one without harm.

sentences.zh: 無價是最珍貴的專長。
sentences.en: The most valuable skill is one offered without a price.

sentences.zh: 無障是最順利的前途。
sentences.en: The most promising future is one without hindrance.

sentences.zh: 無病是最幸福的生涯。
sentences.en: The greatest happiness in life is to be without sickness.

sentences.zh: 無牽是最安心的思想。
sentences.en: The most comforting thoughts are ones without concerns.

sentences.zh: 無惱是最灑脫的自覺。
sentences.en: The best self-awareness is to be without afflictions.

sentences.zh: 無苦是最希望的需要。
sentences.en: The greatest hope for all is to be without suffering.

sentences.zh: 無災是最平安的旅程。
sentences.en: The safest trip is one traveled without calamity.

sentences.zh: 無禍是最安全的家園。
sentences.en: The safest home is a place without disasters.

sentences.zh: 無染是最正派的行為。
sentences.en: The most righteous conduct is carried out without defilement.

sentences.zh: 無垢是最純潔的心靈。
sentences.en: The most innocent heart is one without impurity.

sentences.zh: 無議是最一致的共識。
sentences.en: The best consensus is one reached without debate.

sentences.zh: 無瑕是最美麗的藝術。
sentences.en: The most beautiful art is one without flaws.

sentences.zh: 無盡是最長遠的符號。
sentences.en: The most expansive symbol is one without an end.

sentences.zh: 無量是最難算的數字。
sentences.en: The hardest number to calculate is one without a limit.

sentences.zh: 無邊是最寬闊的空間。
sentences.en: The broadest space is one without a boundary.

sentences.zh: 無學是最完整的研究。
sentences.en: The most thorough research is one done without more to learn.

sentences.zh: 無門是最難入的世界。
sentences.en: The world that is hardest to enter is one without a gate.

sentences.zh: 佛教中的無盡慈悲是一種無條件的愛與關懷。
sentences.en: The endless compassion in Buddhism is a form of unconditional love and care.

sentences.zh: 他的修行之路似乎無盡，總有新的境界等待他去探索。
sentences.en: His path of practice seems endless, with new realms always awaiting exploration.

sentences.zh: 宇宙的奧秘是無盡的，科學家們仍在不斷地探索和發現。
sentences.en: The mysteries of the universe are endless, scientists are constantly exploring and discovering.

sentences.zh: 她的耐心可謂無盡，不管遇到多大的困難，她都能保持冷靜。
sentences.en: Her patience is seemingly endless; no matter the difficulty she faces, she remains calm.

sentences.zh: 佛經中，阿彌陀佛被形容為無盡燈，照亮無數眾生的心靈。
sentences.en: In Buddhist scriptures, Amitabha Buddha is described as an Endless Light, illuminating the hearts of countless sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 她的善行如無盡燈一般，溫暖了所有接觸到她的人。
sentences.en: Her acts of kindness are like an Endless Light, warming everyone who comes into contact with her.

sentences.zh: 無盡燈象徵著佛法的智慧，永遠照耀前方的道路。
sentences.en: The Endless Light symbolizes the wisdom of Dharma, eternally illuminating the path ahead.

sentences.zh: 在冥想時，我們可以視自己的內心如同無盡燈，照亮內在的每一個角落。
sentences.en: During meditation, we can envision our inner self as an Endless Light, illuminating every corner within.

sentences.zh: 無盡華藏，象徵著佛教中無盡的智慧和慈悲。
sentences.en: The Infinite Lotus Store symbolizes the endless wisdom and compassion in Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 佛經中描述的無盡華藏是一個充滿知識和 enlightenment 的境界。
sentences.en: The Infinite Lotus Store described in the Buddhist scriptures is a realm filled with knowledge and enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 修行者通過禪修可以體驗到無盡華藏的寧靜與深邃。
sentences.en: Practitioners can experience the tranquility and profundity of the Infinite Lotus Store through meditation.

sentences.zh: 無盡華藏中的每一朵蓮花都代表著佛法的不同面向。
sentences.en: Each lotus in the Infinite Lotus Store represents different aspects of the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 佛法如無盡藏，給予我們無限的智慧和慈悲。
sentences.en: Buddha's teachings are like a boundless treasure, providing us with infinite wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 眾生都有內在的力量，這就像一個無盡藏等待被發掘。
sentences.en: All sentient beings possess inner strength, akin to a boundless treasure waiting to be discovered.

sentences.zh: 禪修的過程讓我們探索內心的無盡藏，點燃心中的和平與喜樂。
sentences.en: The process of meditation allows us to explore the boundless treasure within, igniting inner peace and joy.

sentences.zh: 法師常說，無論外界如何變化，我們的心中都有無盡藏，提供無限的支持。
sentences.en: The Dharma master often says that no matter how the external world changes, we all have a boundless treasure within, offering endless support.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義中，無相即是指一切現象皆無實相，不能以固定形態捉摸。
sentences.en: In Buddhist teachings, 'Formless' refers to the notion that all phenomena lack a fixed reality and cannot be grasped in a settled form.

sentences.zh: 禪修時，我們要體悟無相的境界，超越對形象的執著。
sentences.en: During meditation, we must realize the state of Formless, transcending attachment to appearances.

sentences.zh: 無相並非無物，而是超越了執著的實相。
sentences.en: Formless does not mean non-existent; it transcends the clinging to substantial forms.

sentences.zh: 無相的智慧讓人們能看穿表象，瞭解真實的本質。
sentences.en: The wisdom of Formless allows people to see beyond appearances and understand the true nature of reality.

sentences.zh: 他們因為無緣而最終分開，各自在不同的城市生活。
sentences.en: They eventually separated due to a lack of connection, living in different cities.

sentences.zh: 這裡的人們對這個理念似乎無緣，無法理解其中的深意。
sentences.en: The people here seem to have a lack of connection with this concept and cannot grasp its deeper meaning.

sentences.zh: 因為無緣，我們錯失了這次難得的合作機會。
sentences.en: Due to a lack of connection, we missed out on this rare collaboration opportunity.

sentences.zh: 在這個陌生的城市，他感到與周圍的一切都無緣。
sentences.en: In this unfamiliar city, he felt a lack of connection with everything around him.

sentences.zh: 在寺廟的清晨，無聲息的歌唱伴隨著鐘鼓和木魚的節奏。
sentences.en: In the temple's early morning, the silent chant is accompanied by the rhythm of bells, gongs, and wooden fish.

sentences.zh: 無聲息的歌唱帶來內心的平靜，讓人感受到深沉的靈修力量。
sentences.en: The silent chant brings inner peace, allowing one to feel the deep spiritual power.

sentences.zh: 儘管是無聲息的歌唱，它卻能喚起靈魂深處最純淨的共鳴。
sentences.en: Even as a silent chant, it can evoke the purest resonance from the depths of the soul.

sentences.zh: 禪師常說，無聲息的歌唱才是與宇宙法音和諧共鳴的最高境界。
sentences.en: The Zen master often says that the silent chant is the highest state of harmony with the cosmic sound.

sentences.zh: 在道教思想中，無行是指順應自然，不強求控制。
sentences.en: In Taoist philosophy, non-action refers to aligning with nature and not forcing control.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該理解無行的深意，避免被世俗欲望所牽制。
sentences.en: Practitioners should understand the deep meaning of non-action and avoid being swayed by worldly desires.

sentences.zh: 他選擇無行的方式處理衝突，結果問題自然而然地解決了。
sentences.en: He chose a non-action approach to address the conflict, and the issue naturally resolved itself.

sentences.zh: 無行並不是指懶散，而是指一種智慧的生活方式，與宇宙的自然法則和諧共存。
sentences.en: Non-action does not mean laziness; rather, it signifies a wise way of living harmoniously with the natural laws of the universe.

sentences.zh: 在和解的氣氛中，他們達到了無諍的共識。
sentences.en: In an atmosphere of reconciliation, they reached a consensus with no disputes.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒追求的是一個無諍的世界，人人和平相處。
sentences.en: Buddhists strive for a world with no disputes, where everyone lives in peace.

sentences.zh: 經過多次聆聽法師開示，他終於可以心無掛礙，心境無諍。
sentences.en: After listening to the master's teachings multiple times, he finally achieved a state of mind with no disputes.

sentences.zh: 無諍乃是修行的一部分，能夠使心靈安寧。
sentences.en: No disputes is a part of practice, enabling the mind to attain serenity.

sentences.zh: 《無道三十》這本書詳細介紹了怎樣避免三十種不正當的方式來獲取成功。
sentences.en: The book 'Avoid 30 Improper Ways to Succeed' details how to avoid thirty improper methods to achieve success.

sentences.zh: 他根據《無道三十》的教導，引導自己走上了正當而光明的事業道路。
sentences.en: He guided himself onto a righteous and bright career path by following the teachings of 'Avoid 30 Improper Ways to Succeed'.

sentences.zh: 遵循《無道三十》的原則，她避免了職場上的陷阱，獲得了穩步的進步。
sentences.en: By adhering to the principles of 'Avoid 30 Improper Ways to Succeed', she avoided pitfalls in the workplace and achieved steady progress.

sentences.zh: 《無道三十》的理念幫助他在複雜的商業環境中保持了道德和誠信。
sentences.en: The principles of 'Avoid 30 Improper Ways to Succeed' helped him maintain ethics and integrity in the complex business environment.

sentences.zh: 每年的無遮會是當地最重要的佛教儀式之一，吸引了成千上萬的信徒來參加。
sentences.en: The annual Universal Offering is one of the most significant Buddhist ceremonies in the region, attracting thousands of devotees to participate.

sentences.zh: 在無遮會上，所有的信徒都奉獻心意，無論貧富都可以參與。
sentences.en: During the Universal Offering, all devotees make offerings of their intent and spirit, allowing everyone to participate regardless of their wealth.

sentences.zh: 無遮會強調平等和慈悲，是佛教信仰的重要表現。
sentences.en: The Universal Offering emphasizes equality and compassion, and is an important expression of Buddhist faith.

sentences.zh: 舉行無遮會的目的在於教導大眾布施的美德和共修的精神。
sentences.en: The purpose of holding the Universal Offering is to teach the virtues of generosity and the spirit of communal practice.

sentences.zh: 佛法的智慧是無量的，沒有任何界限。
sentences.en: The wisdom of the Dharma is immeasurable, with no limits.

sentences.zh: 他的慈悲心是無量的，對所有眾生都充滿了愛心。
sentences.en: His compassion is immeasurable, filled with love for all sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 萬物的生機是無量的，無窮無盡。
sentences.en: The vitality of all things is immeasurable, endless and boundless.

sentences.zh: 那些經文中描述的功德是無量無邊的，無法用言語形容。
sentences.en: The merits described in those scriptures are immeasurable, beyond words.

sentences.zh: 阿彌陀佛象徵著無量光，代表著無邊無際的智慧與慈悲。
sentences.en: Amitabha Buddha symbolizes Infinite Light, representing boundless wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 在冥想中，修行者觀想自己被無量光所包圍，感受無限的平靜與安寧。
sentences.en: During meditation, practitioners visualize themselves surrounded by Infinite Light, feeling boundless tranquility and peace.

sentences.zh: 無量光的概念提醒我們，佛法的智慧和慈悲是無窮無盡的。
sentences.en: The concept of Infinite Light reminds us that the wisdom and compassion of the Dharma are endless.

sentences.zh: 他常常誦念『無量光佛』的名號，祈求得到無限的智慧與祝福。
sentences.en: He often recites the name 'Buddha of Infinite Light,' praying for boundless wisdom and blessings.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，阿彌陀佛象徵著無量壽，代表無窮盡的生命和智慧。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, Amitabha Buddha symbolizes infinite life, representing endless life and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 修行者通過念誦佛號可以祈求無量壽，以期來世能再續前緣。
sentences.en: Practitioners recite the Buddha's name to pray for infinite life, hoping to continue their karma in the next life.

sentences.zh: 《無量壽經》是大乘佛教的重要經典之一，講述了阿彌陀佛的願力和淨土世界。
sentences.en: The Infinite Life Sutra is one of the important scriptures of Mahayana Buddhism, describing Amitabha Buddha's vows and the Pure Land.

sentences.zh: 在禪修過程中，我們體會到心靈的寧靜，仿佛接近了無量壽的境界。
sentences.en: During meditation, we experience the tranquility of the mind, as if approaching a state of infinite life.

sentences.zh: 在淨土宗中，信徒們常常向無量壽佛祈願，期望得以往生極樂世界。
sentences.en: In the Pure Land School, believers often pray to Amitayus Buddha, hoping to be reborn in the Western Pure Land.

sentences.zh: 無量壽佛代表了無限的生命和智慧，象徵著終極的覺悟與慈悲。
sentences.en: Amitayus Buddha represents infinite life and wisdom, symbolizing ultimate enlightenment and compassion.

sentences.zh: 很多佛教徒每天唸誦無量壽佛的名號，專心持念以求心靈的安寧。
sentences.en: Many Buddhists recite the name of Amitayus Buddha daily, focusing their chants to seek inner peace.

sentences.zh: 無量壽佛的雕像常見於寺廟，中國古今造型各異，但皆莊嚴慈祥。
sentences.en: Statues of Amitayus Buddha are commonly seen in temples, with varying designs across ancient and modern China, all exuding solemnity and compassion.

sentences.zh: 無量壽經是淨土宗的重要經典之一，詳細描述了極樂世界的景象。
sentences.en: The Larger Sutra on Amitayus is one of the key scriptures in Pure Land Buddhism, detailing the imagery of the Western Pure Land.

sentences.zh: 修行無量壽經可以幫助信徒更好地理解阿彌陀佛的本願。
sentences.en: Practicing the Larger Sutra on Amitayus can help devotees better understand the vows of Amitabha Buddha.

sentences.zh: 許多佛教徒每天誦讀無量壽經，以祈求在往生時能夠前往極樂世界。
sentences.en: Many Buddhists recite the Larger Sutra on Amitayus daily to pray for rebirth in the Pure Land at the time of death.

sentences.zh: 這位師父為新信徒講解無量壽經，讓他們更深入了解其教義。
sentences.en: The master explained the Larger Sutra on Amitayus to the new believers, allowing them to gain deeper insights into its teachings.

sentences.zh: 在佛教的修行中，無門代表著內心無限寬廣，無任何束縛。
sentences.en: In Buddhist practice, the concept of a Non-Existing Gate signifies an infinitely wide mind with no constraints.

sentences.zh: 禪師說，悟道就如同穿過無門，沒有任何具體的門檻可跨越。
sentences.en: The Zen master said that enlightenment is like passing through a Non-Existing Gate; there is no specific threshold to cross.

sentences.zh: 這本《無門關》是禪學經典，探討如何在無門中尋找真理。
sentences.en: This 'Gateless Gate' is a Zen classic that explores how to find truth within the Non-Existing Gate.

sentences.zh: 無門的智慧在於打破所有有形的障礙和限制，直接通達本心。
sentences.en: The wisdom of the Non-Existing Gate lies in breaking all tangible barriers and limitations, directly reaching one's true nature.

sentences.zh: 《無門關》是禪宗的重要公案集，對修行者有著深遠的影響。
sentences.en: "The Gateless Barrier" is a significant collection of koans in Zen Buddhism, having a profound impact on practitioners.

sentences.zh: 他反覆參究《無門關》中的公案，希望能夠領悟其中的深意。
sentences.en: He repeatedly studied the koans in "The Gateless Barrier," hoping to comprehend their profound meaning.

sentences.zh: 無門關的第一則公案是「趙州狗子」，常被用來啟發初學者的領悟。
sentences.en: The first koan in the Gateless Barrier is 'Zhaozhou's Dog,' often used to inspire beginners' understanding.

sentences.zh: 修行者必須超越無門關，達到真實的解脫和智慧。
sentences.en: Practitioners must transcend the Gateless Barrier to achieve true liberation and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，心與心之間無間，彼此真正的聯接與互通。
sentences.en: In meditation, there is no distance between hearts, truly connecting and communicating with each other.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們心中無間，超越虛假的分離感。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us that within our hearts there is no distance, transcending the false sense of separation.

sentences.zh: 師徒之間的信任與理解，讓他們感覺心靈無間。
sentences.en: The trust and understanding between the master and the disciple make them feel there is no distance between their souls.

sentences.zh: 在修行的道路上，人人本來就是同體大悲，彼此無間。
sentences.en: On the path of practice, everyone is inherently united in great compassion, with no distance between each other.

sentences.zh: 焦山佛學院坐落於中國江蘇省，是一所著名的佛教學府。
sentences.en: Jiaoshan Buddhist College is located in Jiangsu Province, China, and is a renowned Buddhist institution.

sentences.zh: 許多僧侶從全國各地來到焦山佛學院學習佛法。
sentences.en: Many monks come from all over the country to study Buddhism at Jiaoshan Buddhist College.

sentences.zh: 焦山佛學院的課程涵蓋了經典佛教教義和現代哲學。
sentences.en: The curriculum at Jiaoshan Buddhist College covers classical Buddhist teachings and modern philosophy.

sentences.zh: 每年，焦山佛學院都會舉辦多次佛教研討會，吸引來自全球的學者和信徒。
sentences.en: Every year, Jiaoshan Buddhist College hosts several Buddhist seminars that attract scholars and devotees from around the world.

sentences.zh: 在沙漠中的土地上，種下了許多焦芽敗種的植物，最終無一生長。
sentences.en: In the desert soil, many barren seeds were planted, but none ultimately grew.

sentences.zh: 這片土地多數都是焦芽敗種，因此很難有農作物能夠豐收。
sentences.en: Most of this land contains barren seeds, so it is difficult for crops to flourish.

sentences.zh: 由於長期缺乏水分，這些種子變成了焦芽敗種，無法萌發。
sentences.en: Due to a long-term lack of moisture, these seeds have turned into barren seeds and cannot sprout.

sentences.zh: 如果不改善土壤營養，它們最終都會成為焦芽敗種，毫無生機。
sentences.en: If the soil nutrients are not improved, they will ultimately become barren seeds, devoid of any vitality.

sentences.zh: 焰口超薦法會是一種特別的儀式，旨在超度亡靈並減輕他們的痛苦。
sentences.en: The Yogacara Offering Service is a special ceremony aimed at liberating the spirits of the deceased and alleviating their suffering.

sentences.zh: 在焰口超薦法會上，僧人們會誦讀經文並進行多種修法。
sentences.en: During the Yogacara Offering Service, monks recite sutras and perform various rituals.

sentences.zh: 家屬們參加焰口超薦法會，以表達對逝者的追思和祝福。
sentences.en: Families participate in the Yogacara Offering Service to express their remembrance and blessings for the deceased.

sentences.zh: 焰口超薦法會通常在寺廟舉行，吸引了許多信徒前來參加。
sentences.en: The Yogacara Offering Service is usually held at temples, attracting many devotees to attend.

phrase.zh: 照見五蘊皆空 能度一切苦厄
phrase.en: Upon seeing that the Five Skandhas are empty; One can thus overcome all ills and suffering.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒們相信，只要能夠照見五蘊皆空，就能度一切苦厄，達到真正的解脫。
sentences.en: Buddhists believe that upon seeing that the Five Skandhas are empty, one can thus overcome all ills and suffering, achieving true liberation.

sentences.zh: 在修行中，悟到照見五蘊皆空的方法，可以幫助我們從痛苦和困境中解脫。
sentences.en: In practice, realizing the method of seeing that the Five Skandhas are empty can help us liberate from pain and hardship.

sentences.zh: 通過深刻的冥想，我們可以照見五蘊皆空，從而能度一切苦厄。
sentences.en: Through profound meditation, we can see that the Five Skandhas are empty, and thus overcome all ills and suffering.

sentences.zh: 法師解釋道，照見五蘊皆空是通向內在和平的關鍵，能度一切苦厄。
sentences.en: The master explained that seeing the Five Skandhas as empty is the key to inner peace, helping to overcome all ills and suffering.

sentences.zh: 在修行的過程中，我們必須學會如何面對和清除內心的煩惱。
sentences.en: In the process of cultivation, we must learn how to confront and eliminate inner defilements.

sentences.zh: 煩惱是導致人們陷入痛苦和迷惑的主要原因。
sentences.en: Defilements are the main reasons why people fall into suffering and confusion.

sentences.zh: 佛教修行的目的是為了滅除煩惱，達到內心的安寧和解脫。
sentences.en: The goal of Buddhist practice is to eradicate defilements and attain inner peace and liberation.

sentences.zh: 若不斷淨化內心，煩惱將無法再生，而智慧將逐漸增長。
sentences.en: By continuously purifying the mind, defilements will cease to arise, and wisdom will gradually increase.

sentences.zh: 在農曆新年期間，許多人會到寺廟燒頭香，希望為新的一年祈求好運。
sentences.en: During the Lunar New Year, many people go to the temple to burn the first incense, hoping to pray for good luck in the coming year.

sentences.zh: 每年的正月初一，寺廟都會擠滿前來燒頭香的信徒，場面十分熱鬧。
sentences.en: On the first day of the lunar month every year, temples are crowded with devotees coming to burn the first incense, creating a lively atmosphere.

sentences.zh: 燒頭香是很多信徒心中最重要的儀式，象徵著新年的開始和美好的祝福。
sentences.en: Burning the first incense is one of the most significant rituals for many devotees, symbolizing the beginning of a new year and bestowing good wishes.

sentences.zh: 李先生每年都會帶全家一起去寺廟燒頭香，這已成為他們家中不可或缺的傳統。
sentences.en: Mr. Li takes his entire family to the temple to burn the first incense each year, a tradition that has become indispensable in their household.

sentences.zh: 每逢初一十五，佛寺裡香火不斷，信眾們虔誠地燒香祈福。
sentences.en: On the first and fifteenth of each month, the temple is filled with incense smoke as devotees burn incense devoutly wishing for blessings.

sentences.zh: 她在家中的佛堂燒香，祈求家庭幸福安康。
sentences.en: She burns incense in the family's prayer room, praying for happiness and health for her household.

sentences.zh: 祭祖時，人們會在祖先牌位前燒香，以表達對先人的尊敬。
sentences.en: During ancestor worship, people burn incense in front of ancestral tablets to show respect for their forebears.

sentences.zh: 在法會上，僧侶們和信眾一起燒香，共同祈禱世界和平。
sentences.en: At the religious ceremony, monks and devotees burn incense together, praying for world peace.

sentences.zh: 寺廟裡的大殿內放置了一個精美的香爐，供信徒們焚香祈福。
sentences.en: A beautiful incense burner is placed inside the main hall of the temple for devotees to burn incense and pray.

sentences.zh: 這個銅製的香爐年久失修，但依然散發著古老的氣息。
sentences.en: This bronze incense burner is in disrepair but still exudes an ancient aura.

sentences.zh: 上香的時候，應該先將香火點燃，然後插入香爐中。
sentences.en: When offering incense, you should first light the incense sticks and then place them into the incense burner.

sentences.zh: 她每天清晨都會在爐前焚上一炷香，祈求家人平安健康。
sentences.en: Every morning, she burns a stick of incense in the incense burner, praying for the health and safety of her family.

sentences.zh: 在佛殿中，信徒們在誦念爐香讚時，香火繚繞，充滿了莊嚴的氣氛。
sentences.en: In the Buddha hall, as devotees recited the Praise of the Incense Censer, the incense smoke spiraled upwards, filling the space with a solemn atmosphere.

sentences.zh: 每逢重要法會，住持都會領眾共同唱誦爐香讚，以示對佛的恭敬。
sentences.en: During significant ceremonies, the abbot leads the congregation in singing the Praise of the Incense Censer to show reverence for the Buddha.

sentences.zh: 爐香讚的旋律悠揚，令人心靈得到安寧和舒緩。
sentences.en: The melodious tune of the Praise of the Incense Censer brings peace and calm to the soul.

sentences.zh: 這部經典中的爐香讚部分展示了佛教儀式的神聖美。
sentences.en: The section of Praise of the Incense Censer in this scripture showcases the sacred beauty of Buddhist rituals.

phrase.zh: 父慈子孝全家福 兄友弟恭滿堂春
phrase.en: A compassionate father and dutiful sons realize a family, Loving and respectful brothers are the spring of the family.

sentences.zh: 有一句古語說得好：父慈子孝全家福，兄友弟恭滿堂春，這是真正幸福的家庭典範。
sentences.en: An old saying goes: 'A compassionate father and dutiful sons realize a family, Loving and respectful brothers are the spring of the family,' representing an ideal happy family.

sentences.zh: 在傳統的家庭觀念中，父慈子孝全家福，兄友弟恭滿堂春是最值得追求的。
sentences.en: In traditional family values, 'A compassionate father and dutiful sons realize a family, Loving and respectful brothers are the spring of the family' is the most worthwhile pursuit.

sentences.zh: 那個家庭正完美詮釋了父慈子孝全家福，兄友弟恭滿堂春的含義。
sentences.en: That family perfectly embodies the meaning of 'A compassionate father and dutiful sons realize a family, Loving and respectful brothers are the spring of the family.'

sentences.zh: 村裡的人們都知道，這一家一直恪守父慈子孝全家福，兄友弟恭滿堂春的道德規範。
sentences.en: The villagers know that this family has always adhered to the moral norm of 'A compassionate father and dutiful sons realize a family, Loving and respectful brothers are the spring of the family.'

phrase.zh: 物無義不可取 事非見不可說 人無善不可交 念非正不可動
phrase.en: Do not take what is wrongful. Do not speak of what you have not witnessed. Do not become acquainted with the unkind. Do not think of what is unwholesome.

sentences.zh: 物無義不可取，他時時提醒自己保持誠信，絕不拿不屬於自己的東西。
sentences.en: Do not take what is wrongful; he constantly reminded himself to maintain integrity and never take what did not belong to him.

sentences.zh: 事非見不可說，她一向謹慎，從不輕易談論自己未親眼所見的事情。
sentences.en: Do not speak of what you have not witnessed; she was always cautious and never spoke lightly of things she had not seen personally.

sentences.zh: 人無善不可交，他選擇與善良的人交朋友，而避開那些心地不好的人。
sentences.en: Do not become acquainted with the unkind; he chose to befriend kind-hearted people and avoid those with a malicious heart.

sentences.zh: 念非正不可動，他每天打坐，努力保持自己的心念純正，遠離邪惡的想法。
sentences.en: Do not think of what is unwholesome; he meditated daily, striving to keep his thoughts pure and steer clear of evil ideas.

sentences.zh: 公司新聘了一位特助來協助總經理處理日常事務。
sentences.en: The company hired a new executive assistant to help the general manager handle daily affairs.

sentences.zh: 這位特助非常熟練，能夠迅速有效地完成各項任務。
sentences.en: This executive assistant is highly skilled and can complete various tasks quickly and efficiently.

sentences.zh: 特助的職責包括安排會議、整理文件和其他管理工作。
sentences.en: The executive assistant’s responsibilities include scheduling meetings, organizing documents, and other administrative tasks.

sentences.zh: 作為特助，她不僅需要具備專業知識，還要擁有出色的溝通能力。
sentences.en: As an executive assistant, she needs to have not only professional knowledge but also excellent communication skills.

sentences.zh: 他為了家庭幸福，犧牲了自己的事業。
sentences.en: He sacrificed his career for the happiness of his family.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒視廢除自私的念頭為一種偉大的犧牲。
sentences.en: Buddhists view the eradication of selfish thoughts as a great sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 默默的犧牲往往不要任何回報。
sentences.en: Silent sacrifices often seek no recompense.

sentences.zh: 她為了照顧生病的親人，不得不犧牲自己的時間和自由。
sentences.en: She had to sacrifice her own time and freedom to take care of her sick relative.

sentences.zh: 佛教僧侶必須嚴格遵守戒律，任何犯戒行為都被視為非常嚴重。
sentences.en: Buddhist monks must strictly adhere to the precepts, and any violation of precepts is considered very serious.

sentences.zh: 他因為犯戒而被要求離開寺院，以示所有人遵守規範的重要性。
sentences.en: He was asked to leave the monastery due to his violation of precepts, as a demonstration of the importance of adhering to the rules.

sentences.zh: 犯戒不僅影響個人的修行，還可能對整個團體造成負面影響。
sentences.en: Violation of precepts not only affects one's own practice but can also have negative implications for the entire community.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，犯戒被認為會障礙修行的進步，並增長業力。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, violation of precepts is believed to hinder progress in practice and increase one's karma.

phrase.zh: 猶如蓮花不著水 亦如日月住虛空
phrase.en: Like a lotus that stays dry in water; Like the sun and moon that abide in the void.

sentences.zh: 修行者應猶如蓮花不著水，亦如日月住虛空，內心不受外界塵垢所染。
sentences.en: A practitioner should be like a lotus that stays dry in water, like the sun and moon that abide in the void, remaining internally unstained by external impurities.

sentences.zh: 這位僧侶的生活猶如蓮花不著水，亦如日月住虛空，無論身處何地，他的心境始終清淨。
sentences.en: The life of this monk is like a lotus that stays dry in water, like the sun and moon that abide in the void, maintaining purity of mind no matter where he is.

sentences.zh: 她的心靈境界猶如蓮花不著水，亦如日月住虛空，能從容面對世間的一切困難。
sentences.en: Her mental state is like a lotus that stays dry in water, like the sun and moon that abide in the void, enabling her to calmly face all difficulties in the world.

sentences.zh: 蓮花象徵著純潔和超然，就像日月住虛空，超脫世間的一切煩惱。
sentences.en: The lotus symbolizes purity and transcendence, just like the sun and moon that abide in the void, detached from all worldly troubles.

phrase.en: like apes and monkeys trying to catch the moon in the water

sentences.zh: 他的想法就像是猿猴捉月一樣，完全是不切實際的。
sentences.en: His idea is like apes and monkeys trying to catch the moon in the water, completely unrealistic.

sentences.zh: 在追求完美的過程中，有時候我們可能會變成猿猴捉月一般，徒勞無功。
sentences.en: In the pursuit of perfection, sometimes we might end up like apes and monkeys trying to catch the moon in the water, achieving nothing.

sentences.zh: 這些無謂的爭論，就像猿猴捉月一樣，沒有任何意義。
sentences.en: These pointless arguments are like apes and monkeys trying to catch the moon in the water, meaningless.

sentences.zh: 為了名利而喪失內心的平靜，真是猿猴捉月，白費力氣。
sentences.en: Losing inner peace for the sake of fame and fortune is like apes and monkeys trying to catch the moon in the water, a futile effort.

sentences.zh: 佛陀的教法如獅吼般，震撼每個聽者的心靈。
sentences.en: The teachings of the Buddha are like a lion's roar, shaking the hearts of all who hear them.

sentences.zh: 他的禪修領悟達到了獅吼般的境界，令人無法忽視。
sentences.en: His meditation insight reached the level of a lion's roar, making it impossible to ignore.

sentences.zh: 僧人在大殿中大聲誦經，猶如獅吼，震撼四方。
sentences.en: The monk chanted in the hall loudly, like a lion's roar, reverberating in all directions.

sentences.zh: 在困難面前，他展現出獅吼般的勇氣，無所畏懼。
sentences.en: In the face of adversity, he demonstrated a lion's roar-like courage, fearless and undeterred.

sentences.zh: 佛陀的教法猶如獅子吼，震撼人心，無人能及。
sentences.en: The Buddha's teachings are like a lion's roar, shaking the hearts of people with an unparalleled impact.

sentences.zh: 在該經典中，描述了佛陀如獅子吼般的說法，令眾生醒悟。
sentences.en: In that sutra, it is described how the Buddha's words were like a lion's roar, awakening sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 當他演講時，聲音如同獅子吼，充滿了力量和決心。
sentences.en: When he gave his speech, his voice was like a lion's roar, filled with power and determination.

sentences.zh: 他的講道聲如獅子吼，讓聽眾心神振奮，頓悟真理。
sentences.en: His sermon resonated like a lion's roar, inspiring the audience and leading them to sudden insight.

sentences.zh: 佛陀的教義就像獅子吼，能夠震撼凡夫的心靈。
sentences.en: The teachings of the Buddha are like a lion's roar, capable of shaking the minds of ordinary beings.

sentences.zh: 禪宗的大德們常以獅子吼來形容他們明心見性的悟道經驗。
sentences.en: Chan masters often use the term 'lion's roar' to describe their enlightenment experience of clearly seeing their own nature.

sentences.zh: 僧人誦經的聲音宛如獅子吼，震撼人心並驅散了眾人的煩惱。
sentences.en: The monk's chanting sounded like a lion's roar, shaking hearts and dispelling people's worries.

sentences.zh: 當他的修行達到高峰時，他發出了如獅子吼般的真言，驚醒了在場的所有弟子。
sentences.en: When his practice reached its peak, he uttered a mantra like a lion's roar, awakening all the disciples present.

sentences.zh: 在寺廟裡，信徒們每天都會進行獻供儀式，以表達他們的虔誠。
sentences.en: In the temple, devotees perform offering rituals daily to show their devotion.

sentences.zh: 她在佛壇前獻供，祈求家人的平安和幸福。
sentences.en: She made an offering at the Buddha altar, praying for the peace and happiness of her family.

sentences.zh: 這次佛事活動包括了誦經、布施、獻供等多個環節。
sentences.en: This Buddhist event included multiple segments such as chanting, almsgiving, and making offerings.

sentences.zh: 修行者通過獻供來深化他們對佛法的理解和實踐。
sentences.en: Practitioners deepen their understanding and practice of Dharma through making offerings.

sentences.zh: 在寺廟的法會上，信徒們虔誠地進行獻燈儀式，希望藉此淨化心靈。
sentences.en: During the temple ceremony, devotees participated in the light offering ritual with sincere hopes of purifying their minds.

sentences.zh: 獻燈是一種古老的佛教傳統，象徵著驅散無明和帶來智慧。
sentences.en: Light offering is an ancient Buddhist tradition that symbolizes dispelling ignorance and bringing wisdom.

sentences.zh: 她每天傍晚都會在佛堂進行獻燈，以祈求家人平安和順。
sentences.en: She performs a light offering every evening in the Buddhist hall to pray for her family's peace and harmony.

sentences.zh: 在佛前獻燈，不僅僅是一種儀式，更是一種心境的修持，提醒我們要持續追求內心的光明。
sentences.en: Offering light before the Buddha is not just a ritual, but a practice of one's mindset, reminding us to continually seek inner illumination.

phrase.zh: 獻給旅行者365日-中華文化與佛教寶典
phrase.en: 365 Days for Travelers: Wisdom from Chinese Literary and Buddhist Classics

sentences.zh: 《獻給旅行者365日-中華文化與佛教寶典》是一本融合了中國傳統文化智慧和佛教教義的書籍。
sentences.en: 365 Days for Travelers: Wisdom from Chinese Literary and Buddhist Classics is a book that integrates the wisdom of traditional Chinese culture and Buddhist teachings.

sentences.zh: 這本書《獻給旅行者365日-中華文化與佛教寶典》為讀者提供了每日的靈感和冥想材料。
sentences.en: This book, 365 Days for Travelers: Wisdom from Chinese Literary and Buddhist Classics, offers daily inspiration and meditation materials for readers.

sentences.zh: 《獻給旅行者365日-中華文化與佛教寶典》幫助旅行者在旅途中保持內心的平靜和智慧。
sentences.en: 365 Days for Travelers: Wisdom from Chinese Literary and Buddhist Classics helps travelers maintain inner peace and wisdom throughout their journeys.

sentences.zh: 她每天早上都會讀一段《獻給旅行者365日-中華文化與佛教寶典》，開始一天的心靈之旅。
sentences.en: She starts each day with a passage from 365 Days for Travelers: Wisdom from Chinese Literary and Buddhist Classics, beginning her day with a journey of the spirit.

sentences.zh: 每年春季，許多信眾都會到寺廟進行獻花儀式，表達對佛陀的崇敬。
sentences.en: Every spring, many devotees go to the temple to perform the flower offering ceremony to show their reverence for the Buddha.

sentences.zh: 獻花是佛教徒日常修行的一部分，象徵著對三寶的供養與尊敬。
sentences.en: Flower offering is part of the daily practice for Buddhists, symbolizing offerings and respect to the Triple Gem.

sentences.zh: 在佛誕節時，大家會特別準備精美的花卉，進行莊嚴的獻花儀式。
sentences.en: During the Buddha's Birthday festival, people specially prepare beautiful flowers for the solemn flower offering ceremony.

sentences.zh: 在儀式中，有一位年輕的信徒細心地將每一朵花獻上，充滿了虔誠與喜悅。
sentences.en: During the ceremony, a young devotee carefully offers each flower with sincere devotion and joy.

sentences.zh: 玄奘三藏院位於寺廟的中心，是朝聖者的重要景點。
sentences.en: Xuanzang Tripitaka Hall is located at the center of the temple and is an important spot for pilgrims.

sentences.zh: 在玄奘三藏院內，人們可以瞻仰歷史上著名的佛教經典手稿。
sentences.en: In Xuanzang Tripitaka Hall, people can admire famous historical manuscripts of Buddhist scriptures.

sentences.zh: 每年都有成千上萬的遊客來參觀玄奘三藏院，感受其神聖的氛圍。
sentences.en: Every year, thousands of visitors come to Xuanzang Tripitaka Hall to experience its sacred atmosphere.

sentences.zh: 玄奘三藏院的建築風格獨特，融合了多種文化元素。
sentences.en: The architectural style of Xuanzang Tripitaka Hall is unique, incorporating various cultural elements.

sentences.zh: 我們走進寺廟的玄關，感受到一股莊嚴肅穆的氣氛。
sentences.en: We walked into the entrance of the temple and felt a sense of solemnity and reverence.

sentences.zh: 玄關裝飾簡約大方，給人一種寧靜的感覺。
sentences.en: The entrance is decorated in a simple and elegant manner, giving a sense of tranquility.

sentences.zh: 在房子的玄關處放置一尊佛像，以迎接來訪的賓客。
sentences.en: A Buddha statue is placed at the entrance of the house to welcome visiting guests.

sentences.zh: 這座寺廟的玄關設計融合了傳統和現代的元素，十分獨特。
sentences.en: The entrance of this temple combines traditional and modern elements, making it very unique.

sentences.zh: 玉佛樓是這座寺院中最具代表性的建築之一。
sentences.en: The Jade Buddha Building is one of the most iconic structures in this temple.

sentences.zh: 每年都有成千上萬的信徒來到玉佛樓參拜。
sentences.en: Every year, thousands of devotees visit the Jade Buddha Building to pay their respects.

sentences.zh: 玉佛樓內供奉著一尊精美的玉佛，吸引了無數遊客。
sentences.en: Inside the Jade Buddha Building, there is a beautifully crafted jade Buddha that attracts countless tourists.

sentences.zh: 在佛誕節，玉佛樓內會舉行盛大的慶祝活動。
sentences.en: During Buddha's birthday, grand celebrations are held inside the Jade Buddha Building.

sentences.zh: 玉佛殿中的玉佛雕像栩栩如生，是寺廟中的重要珍寶。
sentences.en: The jade statue in the Jade Buddha Shrine is lifelike and is a significant treasure of the temple.

sentences.zh: 每年都有成千上萬的信徒前來玉佛殿參拜，祈求平安和幸福。
sentences.en: Every year, thousands of devotees visit the Jade Buddha Shrine to pray for peace and happiness.

sentences.zh: 玉佛殿建築精美，融合了傳統與現代的設計風格。
sentences.en: The Jade Buddha Shrine boasts exquisite architecture, blending traditional and modern design elements.

sentences.zh: 在玉佛殿裡，遊客可以靜心參禪，尋求內心的寧靜。
sentences.en: In the Jade Buddha Shrine, visitors can meditate peacefully, seeking inner tranquility.

sentences.zh: 玉山佛學院提供廣泛的佛學課程，吸引許多學生前來修習。
sentences.en: Yushan Buddhist College offers a wide range of Buddhist studies courses, attracting many students to learn.

sentences.zh: 在玉山佛學院學習的過程中，學生們深入了解了佛教的核心教義。
sentences.en: During their studies at Yushan Buddhist College, students gained a deep understanding of the core teachings of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 玉山佛學院的教職員都是經驗豐富的佛教學者，他們致力於推廣佛教教育。
sentences.en: The faculty at Yushan Buddhist College are experienced Buddhist scholars committed to promoting Buddhist education.

sentences.zh: 很多畢業於玉山佛學院的學生在世界各地弘揚佛法，取得了巨大成就。
sentences.en: Many students who graduated from Yushan Buddhist College have gone on to spread the Dharma worldwide, achieving great accomplishments.

sentences.zh: 玉琳國師一生致力於弘揚佛法，影響深遠。
sentences.en: National Master Yu Lin dedicated his life to propagating the Dharma, leaving a profound impact.

sentences.zh: 在玉琳國師的指導下，許多後學弟子受益匪淺。
sentences.en: Under the guidance of National Master Yu Lin, numerous disciples greatly benefited.

sentences.zh: 玉琳國師的智慧和慈悲心受到人們的廣泛尊敬。
sentences.en: National Master Yu Lin's wisdom and compassion are widely respected.

sentences.zh: 每年的紀念活動都充滿了對玉琳國師的感激和敬仰。
sentences.en: Annual commemorative events are filled with gratitude and reverence for National Master Yu Lin.

phrase.en: Sutra on the Teachings to Sudatta's Daughter-in-law

sentences.zh: 《玉耶女經》是佛教經典中的一部重要著作，旨在教導女性如何修行。
sentences.en: The 'Sutra on the Teachings to Sudatta's Daughter-in-law' is an important Buddhist scripture aimed at guiding women in their spiritual practice.

sentences.zh: 許多修行者認為《玉耶女經》中的教義對現代社會仍具有深遠的意義。
sentences.en: Many practitioners believe that the teachings in the 'Sutra on the Teachings to Sudatta's Daughter-in-law' still hold profound significance for modern society.

sentences.zh: 《玉耶女經》中的故事和智慧啟發了無數追求解脫的信眾。
sentences.en: The stories and wisdom within the 'Sutra on the Teachings to Sudatta's Daughter-in-law' have inspired countless devotees in their pursuit of liberation.

sentences.zh: 僧人們經常引用《玉耶女經》中的教義來指導一般信徒的日常生活。
sentences.en: Monks often cite teachings from the 'Sutra on the Teachings to Sudatta's Daughter-in-law' to guide laypeople in their daily lives.

phrase.en: karmic retribution in the present life

sentences.zh: 他經常做好事，相信現世報最終會帶來好運。
sentences.en: He often does good deeds, believing that karmic retribution in the present life will eventually bring him good fortune.

sentences.zh: 她因為傷害了很多人，終於在現世報中得到了教訓。
sentences.en: She received a lesson through karmic retribution in the present life for having hurt many people.

sentences.zh: 現世報讓我們看到，善惡有報，這樣的信念在佛教中很重要。
sentences.en: Karmic retribution in the present life shows us that good and evil are repaid, a belief that is important in Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 他相信經歷過的苦難是現世報的結果，所以下定決心要改過自新。
sentences.en: He believes that the sufferings he has gone through are the result of karmic retribution in the present life, so he has resolved to reform himself.

phrase.en: A Dictionary of People in Contemporary Buddhism

sentences.zh: 現代佛教人物辭典是一部重要的工具書，介紹了當代佛教界的主要人物及其貢獻。
sentences.en: A Dictionary of People in Contemporary Buddhism is an important reference book that introduces key figures in the modern Buddhist world and their contributions.

sentences.zh: 他正在編寫一部現代佛教人物辭典，以記錄那些在全球佛教發展中起到關鍵作用的人物。
sentences.en: He is compiling a Dictionary of People in Contemporary Buddhism to document those who have played pivotal roles in the global development of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 現代佛教人物辭典提供了豐富的資訊，對於理解當代佛教的演變非常有幫助。
sentences.en: A Dictionary of People in Contemporary Buddhism provides rich information and is very helpful in understanding the evolution of contemporary Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 研究者們經常使用現代佛教人物辭典來尋找有關當代佛教領袖的詳細資料。
sentences.en: Researchers frequently use A Dictionary of People in Contemporary Buddhism to find detailed information about modern Buddhist leaders.

sentences.zh: 這座古老的寺廟正在進行現代化改造，以吸引更多的遊客。
sentences.en: The ancient temple is undergoing modernization to attract more tourists.

sentences.zh: 城市的現代化帶來了許多便利，但也帶來了一些挑戰。
sentences.en: The modernization of the city has brought many conveniences but also some challenges.

sentences.zh: 教育體系需要現代化，以應對未來社會的需求。
sentences.en: The education system needs to modernize to meet the demands of future society.

sentences.zh: 現代化的技術正在改變我們的生活方式，讓我們更加高效。
sentences.en: Modernize technologies are transforming our way of life, making us more efficient.

sentences.zh: 佛教認為一切現象皆是緣起性空。
sentences.en: Buddhism believes that all phenomena are conditioned and empty in nature.

sentences.zh: 這種現象在科學界引起了廣泛的討論。
sentences.en: This phenomenon has caused widespread discussion in the scientific community.

sentences.zh: 他們觀察到這些奇特的自然現象，並開始進行深入研究。
sentences.en: They observed these peculiar natural phenomena and began conducting in-depth research.

sentences.zh: 無論是心理現象還是物理現象，都有其背後的因果關係。
sentences.en: Whether it is a psychological phenomenon or a physical phenomenon, there is a cause-and-effect relationship behind it.

sentences.zh: 佛陀在此土現身，以教化眾生。
sentences.en: The Buddha manifests himself in this world to teach and transform sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 菩薩經常現身於苦難之中，救助受困的人們。
sentences.en: Bodhisattvas often manifest in times of suffering to assist those in distress.

sentences.zh: 他的智慧和慈悲在每一個行動中現身，令眾人欽佩不已。
sentences.en: His wisdom and compassion manifest in every action, earning the admiration of all.
