sentences.zh: 布施他人是提升福德的一種重要途徑。
sentences.en: Donating to others is an important way to enhance one's fortune and virtue.

phrase.en: Let Merit and Blessings Be the Family Legacy

sentences.zh: 祖父一再告誡我們，福德傳家才是真正的富貴。
sentences.en: Grandfather repeatedly admonished us that letting merit and blessings be the family legacy is the true wealth.

sentences.zh: 他們一家人信仰佛法，深信福德傳家，可以造福子孫。
sentences.en: The family follows Buddhism and firmly believes that letting merit and blessings be the family legacy can bring prosperity to future generations.

sentences.zh: 福德傳家是一種慈悲和智慧的傳承，不僅僅是物質的積累。
sentences.en: Letting merit and blessings be the family legacy is a transmission of compassion and wisdom, not merely an accumulation of material wealth.

sentences.zh: 父母教導我們要積極行善，把福德傳家，這是我們家族的一貫信念。
sentences.en: Our parents taught us to actively do good deeds and let merit and blessings be the family legacy; this has been a consistent belief in our family.

phrase.en: Blessing, Virtue, and the Right Causes and Conditions

sentences.zh: 他能成就這一切，靠的就是福德因緣。
sentences.en: He was able to achieve all of this through blessing, virtue, and the right causes and conditions.

sentences.zh: 只要福德因緣具足，任何困難都能迎刃而解。
sentences.en: As long as there are blessings, virtues, and the right causes and conditions, any difficulty can be overcome.

sentences.zh: 要實現心願，必須積累福德因緣。
sentences.en: To fulfill one's wishes, one must accumulate blessing, virtue, and the right causes and conditions.

sentences.zh: 他的成功歸結於他多年來的福德因緣。
sentences.en: His success can be attributed to the blessing, virtue, and the right causes and conditions he accumulated over the years.

sentences.zh: 祝願你和你的家人福德安康，幸福美滿。
sentences.en: May you and your family have blessing, virtue, safety, and health, and a happy life.

sentences.zh: 修行佛法能使我們獲得福德安康，以至於身心安穩。
sentences.en: Practicing the Dharma can lead us to attain blessing, virtue, safety, and health, resulting in peace and stability of mind and body.

sentences.zh: 每當新年到來，人們總是相互祝福福德安康，事事順心。
sentences.en: At the arrival of the New Year, people always wish each other blessing, virtue, safety, and health, and a smooth life.

sentences.zh: 多行善事，不但可以增長福德，還能為自己和他人帶來安康。
sentences.en: Doing good deeds not only increases virtue but also brings safety and health to oneself and others.

sentences.zh: 修行佛法的目的在於增長福慧，讓我們在世間行善積德。
sentences.en: The goal of practicing Buddhism is to increase merit and wisdom, allowing us to do good and accumulate virtue in the world.

sentences.zh: 他的福慧雙全，不僅擁有豐富的知識，還用心行善助人。
sentences.en: He is endowed with both merit and wisdom, not only possessing extensive knowledge but also sincerely helping others.

sentences.zh: 福慧互相輝映，具備福慧的人會更容易度過人生的困難。
sentences.en: Merit and wisdom illuminate each other; individuals who possess both will find it easier to overcome life's challenges.

sentences.zh: 在修行的過程中，我們應該同時追求福慧，以達到身心的圓滿。
sentences.en: In the process of spiritual practice, we should pursue both merit and wisdom to achieve physical and mental perfection.

phrase.en: Dual Cultivation of Wisdom and Fortune

sentences.zh: 在他的生活中，福慧同修是他每天修行的目標。
sentences.en: In his life, the dual cultivation of wisdom and fortune is the goal of his daily practice.

sentences.zh: 她通過福慧同修的方法，達到了身心和諧的境界。
sentences.en: She reached a state of physical and mental harmony through the method of dual cultivation of wisdom and fortune.

sentences.zh: 這座寺廟提倡福慧同修，吸引了很多信徒來打坐和修行。
sentences.en: This temple advocates dual cultivation of wisdom and fortune, attracting many disciples to meditate and practice.

sentences.zh: 福慧同修不僅是佛教徒的修行原則，也是現代人追求圓滿生活的一種方式。
sentences.en: The dual cultivation of wisdom and fortune is not only a principle of Buddhist practice but also a way for modern people to seek a fulfilling life.

sentences.zh: 通過修行和學習佛法，我們可以實現福慧增上，走向解脫之路。
sentences.en: Through practice and studying the Dharma, we can gain in merit and wisdom, progressing on the path to liberation.

sentences.zh: 供養僧眾是福慧增上的一種善行，能夠為我們帶來無量的福報和知識。
sentences.en: Offering support to the monastic community is a good deed that leads to gain in merit and wisdom, bringing us boundless blessings and knowledge.

sentences.zh: 每天的禪修和誦經有助於我們福慧增上，提升內心的平靜和智慧。
sentences.en: Daily meditation and chanting help us gain in merit and wisdom, enhancing our inner peace and insight.

sentences.zh: 父母教導我們行善積德，讓我們從小就學會如何在日常生活中實現福慧增上。
sentences.en: Parents teach us to perform good deeds and accumulate virtues, helping us to learn from a young age how to gain in merit and wisdom in everyday life.

phrase.en: Fu Hui Home for Spiritual Cultivation

sentences.zh: 福慧家園是佛教信徒進行精神修養的理想場所。
sentences.en: Fu Hui Home for Spiritual Cultivation is an ideal place for Buddhists to pursue spiritual cultivation.

sentences.zh: 在福慧家園，學員可以參加各種冥想和法會活動。
sentences.en: At Fu Hui Home for Spiritual Cultivation, participants can join various meditation and Dharma assemblies.

sentences.zh: 許多人都表示在福慧家園度過的時光令人難忘，並深感內心的平靜。
sentences.en: Many people have said that their time spent at Fu Hui Home for Spiritual Cultivation was unforgettable and deeply calming.

sentences.zh: 福慧家園還提供各種佛學課程，幫助學員增進智慧與福報。
sentences.en: Fu Hui Home for Spiritual Cultivation also offers various Buddhist courses to help participants enhance wisdom and merit.

phrase.en: Fu Hui Home for Spiritual Cultivation Service

sentences.zh: 福慧家園共修會提供了一個讓修行者共同學習和提升的好環境。
sentences.en: Fu Hui Home for Spiritual Cultivation Service provides an excellent environment for practitioners to learn and improve together.

sentences.zh: 在福慧家園共修會，我們每週都有佛法講座和打坐活動。
sentences.en: At Fu Hui Home for Spiritual Cultivation Service, we have weekly Dharma talks and meditation sessions.

sentences.zh: 參與福慧家園共修會有助於我們建立更深的靈性連結和社群支持。
sentences.en: Participating in Fu Hui Home for Spiritual Cultivation Service helps us to build deeper spiritual connections and community support.

sentences.zh: 他加入了福慧家園共修會，發現自己的心靈變得更加平靜和充實。
sentences.en: He joined Fu Hui Home for Spiritual Cultivation Service and found his mind becoming more peaceful and fulfilled.

sentences.zh: 他被視為公司的福星，總是能帶來好的業績和運氣。
sentences.en: He is considered the company's prosperous star, always bringing good performance and luck.

sentences.zh: 那棟老房子的主人被鄰居稱為福星，因為他總是樂於助人。
sentences.en: The owner of that old house is called a prosperous star by the neighbors because he is always willing to help.

sentences.zh: 在亞洲文化中，被譽為福星的人通常具有正面的影響力和眾多的福報。
sentences.en: In Asian culture, someone regarded as a prosperous star typically has a positive influence and abundant good karma.

sentences.zh: 他的到來被不少人認為是這個社區的福星，使得這裡變得更加繁榮安定。
sentences.en: His arrival is seen by many as a prosperous star for the community, making it more prosperous and stable.

phrase.en: A Prosperous Star Shining High Above

sentences.zh: 祝你在新的一年裡福星高照，萬事如意。
sentences.en: May a prosperous star shine high above you in the new year, and may everything go your way.

sentences.zh: 他感覺自己福星高照，因為在困難時總能逢凶化吉。
sentences.en: He felt a prosperous star shining high above him because he always turned misfortune into a blessing during difficult times.

sentences.zh: 這是福星高照的好時機，可以展開新的冒險和挑戰。
sentences.en: This is a time when a prosperous star is shining high above, making it a great moment to embark on new adventures and challenges.

sentences.zh: 婚禮當天，福星高照，天氣晴朗，所有的籌備都按計劃進行。
sentences.en: On the wedding day, a prosperous star was shining high above; the weather was perfect, and all preparations went according to plan.

sentences.zh: 修行佛法可以增加我們的福智，讓生活更加圓滿。
sentences.en: Practicing Buddhism can increase our fortune and wisdom, making life more fulfilling.

sentences.zh: 他追求的不僅僅是世俗的成就，更是內在的福智。
sentences.en: He seeks not just worldly achievements but also inner fortune and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 福智兼備的人，往往能在逆境中保持冷靜和積極的心態。
sentences.en: Individuals endowed with both fortune and wisdom often remain calm and optimistic in adversity.

sentences.zh: 佛陀教導我們如何通過智慧的修煉來獲得真正的福智。
sentences.en: The Buddha teaches us how to attain true fortune and wisdom through the cultivation of intellect.

phrase.en: Fortune and Wisdom in the Heart

sentences.zh: 修習佛法的過程中，我們要追求福智印心，才能真正理解人生的真諦。
sentences.en: In the process of practicing Buddhism, we must strive for fortune and wisdom in the heart to truly understand the essence of life.

sentences.zh: 禪修能夠幫助我們達到福智印心的狀態，使心靈得到深層次的平靜與智慧。
sentences.en: Meditation can help us achieve a state of fortune and wisdom in the heart, allowing the mind to attain deep tranquility and insight.

sentences.zh: 這位高僧以福智印心的見解，開啟了許多信徒的心靈之門，使他們得到新的啟悟。
sentences.en: The monk, with his view of fortune and wisdom in the heart, opened the spiritual doors for many followers, giving them new enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 我們在日常生活中應該時刻反省，保持福智印心，以便面對各種挑戰。
sentences.en: We should constantly reflect and maintain fortune and wisdom in the heart in our daily lives to better face various challenges.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒修行的最終目標是達到福智圓滿的境界。
sentences.en: The ultimate goal of Buddhist practice is to achieve the perfection of fortune and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 通過不斷的修行和禪定，他終於達到了福智圓滿的狀態。
sentences.en: Through continuous practice and meditation, he finally attained the state of perfection of fortune and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 這位高僧的教誨使眾弟子朝向福智圓滿的道路前進。
sentences.en: The teachings of this venerable monk guided his disciples toward the path of perfection of fortune and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 福智圓滿不僅僅是個人的成就，也是造福眾生的重要目標。
sentences.en: The perfection of fortune and wisdom is not just a personal accomplishment but also an important goal for benefiting all sentient beings.

phrase.en: An Ocean of Fortune and Wisdom

sentences.zh: 修持佛法能使我們獲得福智如海的境界，無量無邊。
sentences.en: Practicing Buddhism can enable us to attain a state of an ocean of fortune and wisdom, boundless and infinite.

sentences.zh: 大師的教導猶如福智如海，令弟子們受益無窮。
sentences.en: The master's teachings are like an ocean of fortune and wisdom, providing endless benefits to his disciples.

sentences.zh: 通過學習佛經，我們可以逐漸深入福智如海，體驗智慧和慈悲的無限。
sentences.en: Through studying the Buddhist scriptures, we can gradually delve into an ocean of fortune and wisdom, experiencing infinite wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 他的修行成就令人敬仰，真是一位擁有福智如海的偉大行者。
sentences.en: His accomplishments in practice are admirable; he truly is a great practitioner with an ocean of fortune and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 佛教經典中提到，通過修行可以積累如福智海般的無盡功德和智慧。
sentences.en: Buddhist scriptures mention that through practice, one can accumulate an inexhaustible ocean of merit and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 導師強調我們應該努力提升自我，才能在未來達到福智海的境界。
sentences.en: The teacher emphasized that we should strive for self-improvement to reach the state of the ocean of merit and wisdom in the future.

sentences.zh: 他的智慧廣如福智海，讓人敬佩不已。
sentences.en: His wisdom is as vast as the ocean of merit and wisdom, earning him great respect.

sentences.zh: 修持菩薩道的人最終會達到福智海的圓滿境界。
sentences.en: Those who practice the Bodhisattva path will eventually reach the perfect state of the ocean of merit and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 他修持佛法多年，終於達到了福智無量的境界。
sentences.en: After many years of practicing Buddhism, he finally attained a state of boundless fortune and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 願眾生皆能得到福智無量，走向光明的未來。
sentences.en: May all beings attain boundless fortune and wisdom, leading them towards a bright future.

sentences.zh: 福智無量是每個修行者所追求的最終目標。
sentences.en: Boundless fortune and wisdom is the ultimate goal pursued by every practitioner.

sentences.zh: 他手捧經書，默默祈求福智無量，惠及世人。
sentences.en: He held the scripture in his hands, silently praying for boundless fortune and wisdom to benefit all people.

phrase.en: Perfection of Both Fortune and Wisdom

sentences.zh: 修行者通過禪修和慈善工作達到了福智雙圓，成為眾人的榜樣。
sentences.en: The practitioner attained the perfection of both fortune and wisdom through meditation and charitable work, becoming a model for all.

sentences.zh: 福智雙圓是佛教中追求的理想狀態，意味著內外兼修。
sentences.en: Perfection of both fortune and wisdom is an ideal state pursued in Buddhism, signifying both internal and external cultivation.

sentences.zh: 在他的倡導下，很多人開始關注福智雙圓的重要性，並努力實現它。
sentences.en: Under his advocacy, many people began to recognize the importance of the perfection of both fortune and wisdom and strive to achieve it.

sentences.zh: 這位大師以其福智雙圓和無私奉獻，贏得了整個社區的尊敬。
sentences.en: The master, with his perfection of both fortune and wisdom and selfless dedication, earned the respect of the entire community.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義中，福海象徵無限的功德和福報。
sentences.en: In Buddhist teachings, the Ocean of Prosperity symbolizes boundless merits and blessings.

sentences.zh: 他心中充滿善行，就像擁有一片無邊無際的福海。
sentences.en: His heart is filled with virtuous deeds, as if he possesses an endless Ocean of Prosperity.

sentences.zh: 禪修可以幫助我們探尋心靈深處的福海，找到內在的平靜。
sentences.en: Meditation can help us explore the Ocean of Prosperity within our minds, finding inner peace.

sentences.zh: 老師教導大家要行善積德，從而共同創造一個充滿福海的社會。
sentences.en: The teacher advises everyone to do good deeds and accumulate merits, thus creating a society filled with an Ocean of Prosperity.

phrase.en: A World Filled with Good Fortune

sentences.zh: 佛教徒期盼通過修行和善行創造一個福滿人間的世界。
sentences.en: Buddhists hope to create a world filled with good fortune through practice and good deeds.

sentences.zh: 這座和平塔的建立象徵著福滿人間的願望。
sentences.en: The construction of the Peace Pagoda symbolizes the wish for a world filled with good fortune.

sentences.zh: 在這個節日，我們祈求來年的日子福滿人間。
sentences.en: During this festival, we pray for the coming year to be filled with good fortune.

sentences.zh: 他的善行影響了許多人，使福滿人間的理想成為現實。
sentences.en: His good deeds influenced many people, making the ideal of a world filled with good fortune a reality.

phrase.zh: 福滿吉祥地 春臨和敬家
phrase.en: A place of auspice filled with blessings; A family of harmony greeted by spring.

sentences.zh: 每當春天來臨，我們的家就成為福滿吉祥地，彷彿一切美好的事物都在這裡匯聚。
sentences.en: Every time spring arrives, our home transforms into a place of auspice filled with blessings, as if all good things converge here.

sentences.zh: 辛勤努力帶來了豐收，我們的農田成為福滿吉祥地，四處洋溢著喜悅。
sentences.en: Hard work brought about a bountiful harvest, turning our fields into a place of auspice filled with blessings, brimming with joy everywhere.

sentences.zh: 這是一個和敬的家庭，春臨和敬家，充滿了愛和關懷。
sentences.en: This is a family of harmony, a family of harmony greeted by spring, filled with love and care.

sentences.zh: 我們的生活充滿了福滿吉祥地的美好，正如春臨和敬家的祥和氛圍。
sentences.en: Our life is imbued with the beauty of a place of auspice filled with blessings, just like the harmonious atmosphere of a family of harmony greeted by spring.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，布施僧侶和建設寺廟被認為是在福田中播種，好事會在未來回報。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, donating to monks and constructing temples are considered sowing seeds in the field of merit, with good deeds being rewarded in the future.

sentences.zh: 每當她參與社會公益活動，她都覺得自己正在耕耘自己的福田。
sentences.en: Whenever she participates in community service activities, she feels she is cultivating her field of merit.

sentences.zh: 通過幫助貧困的人們，他希望能夠擴展自己的福田，積累更多的福報。
sentences.en: By helping those in need, he hopes to expand his field of merit and accumulate more karmic rewards.

sentences.zh: 成為一名護法者是一種增加自己福田的方式，因為這樣能夠除垢修善。
sentences.en: Becoming a Dharma protector is a way to increase one's field of merit, as it helps to eliminate defilements and cultivate goodness.

sentences.zh: 僧團的福田庫積累了很多善行資源，供信眾供養。
sentences.en: The monastery's Field of Merits Bank has accumulated many resources of good deeds for devotees to offer.

sentences.zh: 捐贈寺廟財物，能夠增添自己的福田庫功德。
sentences.en: Donating belongings to the temple can add to one's Field of Merits Bank.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該時常檢視自己的福田庫，看看是否有需要改進的地方。
sentences.en: Practitioners should regularly examine their Field of Merits Bank to see if there are areas that need improvement.

sentences.zh: 在放生活動中，我們积累了不少福報，為福田庫增添了更多的善因。
sentences.en: During the life release activity, we accumulated a lot of merits, adding more good causes to the Field of Merits Bank.

sentences.zh: 僧人穿著福田衣，象徵著他們在修行中的淨化和對世間的利益。
sentences.en: Monks wear the Field of Merit Robe, symbolizing their purification in practice and their benefit to the world.

sentences.zh: 在法會上，信眾可以親手縫製福田衣，表達他們對僧人的敬意和感恩。
sentences.en: During the Dharma assembly, devotees can sew the Field of Merit Robe by hand, expressing their respect and gratitude towards the monks.

sentences.zh: 福田衣的設計包含了精美的圖案，這些圖案都傳遞著深遠的佛教意涵。
sentences.en: The design of the Field of Merit Robe includes intricate patterns, each conveying profound Buddhist meanings.

sentences.zh: 每當僧人接受新的福田衣，他們都會進行祈福儀式，祈求修行順利。
sentences.en: Whenever monks receive a new Field of Merit Robe, they perform a blessing ceremony, praying for smooth progress in their practice.

phrase.en: A Mountain of Merit of Wisdom

sentences.zh: 他的善行讓他積累了福緣如山，成為家鄉人敬仰的榜樣。
sentences.en: His virtuous deeds accumulated a mountain of merit of wisdom, making him a revered example in his hometown.

sentences.zh: 菩薩的福緣如山，利益眾生無數，廣大無邊。
sentences.en: The Bodhisattva's mountain of merit of wisdom benefits countless sentient beings, vast and boundless.

sentences.zh: 修行者在長期的修行中積累了福緣如山，終於達到了覺悟的境界。
sentences.en: Through long-term practice, the practitioner accumulated a mountain of merit of wisdom, finally reaching a state of enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 老師常教導我們行善積德，使我們未來的福緣如山。
sentences.en: Our teacher often guides us to do good deeds and accumulate virtue, ensuring that we will have a mountain of merit of wisdom in the future.

sentences.zh: 他每天早晨都會在花園裡打坐，一心追求內心的禪境。
sentences.en: Every morning, he sits in meditation in the garden, single-heartedly seeking the state of Chan.

sentences.zh: 禪修是一種深層次的靈修方法，有助於減輕壓力和提高集中力。
sentences.en: Chan meditation is a profound spiritual practice that helps relieve stress and improve concentration.

sentences.zh: 在佛教修行中，禪被認為是通向覺悟的重要途徑。
sentences.en: In Buddhist practice, Chan is considered an important path to enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 參加禪修退修會讓她的心靈變得更加平靜和安定。
sentences.en: Participating in a Chan meditation retreat has made her mind calmer and more stable.

phrase.en: Chan, Pure Land, and Tantric Ceremony

sentences.zh: 禪，淨，密這三種修持方法，各有其獨特的修行方式和目標。
sentences.en: Chan, Pure Land, and Tantric Ceremony are three distinct methods of practice, each with its unique approaches and goals.

sentences.zh: 在這座寺廟中，你可以找到禪，淨，密三大法門的修行資料。
sentences.en: In this temple, you can find resources on the practices of Chan, Pure Land, and Tantric Ceremony.

sentences.zh: 禪，淨，密三門修行的結合，可以互補不足，達到更全面的修行效果。
sentences.en: The combination of Chan, Pure Land, and Tantric practices can complement each other, achieving a more comprehensive effect in spiritual cultivation.

sentences.zh: 無論是禪宗的默坐，淨土宗的念佛，還是密教的儀式，都有助於提升靈性修為。
sentences.en: Whether it is the silent meditation of the Chan school, the recitation of Buddha's name in Pure Land practices, or the rituals of Tantric ceremonies, all can help enhance spiritual cultivation.

sentences.zh: 禪似明白廓然悟道。
sentences.en: Chan is a sudden realization.

sentences.zh: 禪似點破畫龍點睛。
sentences.en: Chan is to add the finishing touch.

sentences.zh: 禪似回家摸到門鎖。
sentences.en: Chan is like finding the lock that opens up your home.

sentences.zh: 禪似無門走進虛空。
sentences.en: Chan is to enter the void through the gateless gate.

sentences.zh: 禪似玄關重重疊疊。
sentences.en: Chan is to pass through entrance after entrance.

sentences.zh: 禪似無我去除執著。
sentences.en: Chan is non-self and non-attached.

sentences.zh: 禪似虛空包容萬有。
sentences.en: Chan is the void that embraces everything.

sentences.zh: 禪似滿足一切現成。
sentences.en: Chan is contentment with one’s blessings.

sentences.zh: 禪似問道解決疑情。
sentences.en: Chan is queries resolved.

sentences.zh: 禪似偵探找尋機密。
sentences.en: Chan is a detective that investigates mysteries.

sentences.zh: 禪似幽默哈哈一笑。
sentences.en: Chan is humor and laughter.

sentences.zh: 禪似思維無限參問。
sentences.en: Chan is unconfined thinking.

sentences.zh: 禪似無言不可說破。
sentences.en: Chan is wordless and unspeakable.

sentences.zh: 禪似覺悟一切明白。
sentences.en: Chan is enlightenment to everything.

sentences.zh: 禪似當下直下承當。
sentences.en: Chan is to take matters into your own hands here and now.

sentences.zh: 禪似示意能悟就好。
sentences.en: Chan is to focus solely on attainment.

sentences.zh: 禪似接心心心相印。
sentences.en: Chan is heart-to-heart connection.

sentences.zh: 禪似傳承衣缽為證。
sentences.en: Chan is an inheritance of legacy.

sentences.zh: 禪似道體直指人心。
sentences.en: Chan is the essence of the Way that points directly at the heart.

sentences.zh: 禪似境界看到目標。
sentences.en: Chan is a state of attainment that sees the goal.

sentences.zh: 禪似圓圈就那麼樣。
sentences.en: Chan is as simple as a circle.

sentences.zh: 禪似慧目通身是眼。
sentences.en: Chan is like having eyes all over the body.

sentences.zh: 禪似法界都在心中。
sentences.en: Chan is the dharma realm that exists within the mind.

sentences.zh: 禪似無限沒有邊緣。
sentences.en: Chan is limitless and boundless.

sentences.zh: 禪似無著寸絲不掛。
sentences.en: Chan is without a single thread of attachment.

sentences.zh: 禪似無念不落有無。
sentences.en: Chan is a mind thoughtless of existence or emptiness.

sentences.zh: 禪似無住無住生心。
sentences.en: Chan is to allow the non-abiding mind to arise without abiding.

sentences.zh: 禪似萬法回歸一如。
sentences.en: Chan is everything returned to their one origin.

sentences.zh: 禪似一心通達萬法。
sentences.en: Chan is one mind that connects with myriad dharmas.

sentences.zh: 禪似平常生活是道。
sentences.en: Chan is to live the Way like ordinary life.

sentences.zh: 禪似問號難以回答。
sentences.en: Chan is an unanswerable question mark.

sentences.zh: 禪似無知無所不知。
sentences.en: Chan is the unknown that knows all.

sentences.zh: 禪似般若要您放光。
sentences.en: Chan is prajna that makes you shine.

sentences.zh: 禪似通路直達佛道。
sentences.en: Chan is the Way that leads directly to buddhahood.

sentences.zh: 禪似藥草可治百病。
sentences.en: Chan is a herb that cures all illnesses.

sentences.zh: 禪似印章與佛印心。
sentences.en: Chan is a seal that authenticates your buddha-mind.

sentences.zh: 禪似開關一開就知。
sentences.en: Chan is like a switch that tells you what has clicked.

sentences.zh: 禪似工具自傘自度。
sentences.en: Chan is a tool that helps one cross over.

sentences.zh: 禪似翠竹代佛現身。
sentences.en: Chan is green bamboo that represents Buddha’s manifestation.

sentences.zh: 禪似時空無量無邊。
sentences.en: Chan is boundless time and infinite space.

sentences.zh: 每天早晨，他都會花一小時進行禪修，以清除心靈的雜念。
sentences.en: Every morning, he spends an hour on meditation to clear his mind of distractions.

sentences.zh: 通過禪修，她找到了內在的平靜與安寧。
sentences.en: Through meditation, she found inner peace and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 禪修不僅能夠改善人的精神健康，還有助於提升專注力。
sentences.en: Meditation not only improves mental health but also helps enhance concentration.

sentences.zh: 在壓力大的時候，幾分鐘的禪修可以有效地舒緩情緒。
sentences.en: During times of stress, a few minutes of meditation can effectively soothe emotions.

sentences.zh: 在寧靜的寺廟裡，我感受到濃厚的禪味，每一口茶都有一種特殊的精神韻味。
sentences.en: In the tranquil temple, I felt a strong taste of Chan; every sip of tea had a special spiritual flavor.

sentences.zh: 這幅畫展現了藝術家對禪味的深刻理解，畫中的每一筆似乎都在傳遞靜謐與平和。
sentences.en: This painting showcases the artist's deep understanding of the taste of Chan; every stroke seems to convey tranquility and peace.

sentences.zh: 禪宗講求在日常生活中體驗禪味，從簡單的呼吸間尋找內心的安寧。
sentences.en: Chan Buddhism emphasizes experiencing the taste of Chan in daily life, finding inner peace in simple breaths.

sentences.zh: 經過多年的修行，他終於領悟到禪味的真諦，並將這種感悟融入他的工作和生活中。
sentences.en: After years of practice, he finally grasped the true essence of the taste of Chan and integrated this understanding into his work and life.

sentences.zh: 這位禪和子每天都在修行冥想，示範了堅定的精神力量。
sentences.en: This Chan Monk practices meditation daily, demonstrating steadfast mental strength.

sentences.zh: 我們拜訪寺院時，遇到了一位禪和子，他向我們解釋了禪修的基本原則。
sentences.en: When we visited the temple, we met a Chan Monk who explained to us the basic principles of Zen practice.

sentences.zh: 禪和子的智慧言語總是能為迷茫的人指引方向。
sentences.en: The wise words of the Chan Monk always guide those who are lost.

sentences.zh: 在這本書中，作者講述了一名著名禪和子的生平故事。
sentences.en: In this book, the author narrates the life story of a famous Chan Monk.

sentences.zh: 每天早上，他都會進行三十分鐘的禪坐以保持精神上的平衡。
sentences.en: Every morning, he practices thirty minutes of sitting meditation to maintain his mental balance.

sentences.zh: 在這個禪修會上，參與者們專心禪坐，尋求內心的平靜。
sentences.en: During the retreat, participants engaged in sitting meditation, seeking inner peace.

sentences.zh: 老師教我們正確的禪坐姿勢，以幫助我們更好地集中注意力。
sentences.en: The teacher instructed us on the correct sitting meditation posture to help us focus better.

sentences.zh: 禪坐不僅可以減壓，還能提升自我覺察能力。
sentences.en: Sitting meditation not only reduces stress but also enhances self-awareness.

sentences.zh: 每天清晨，他都會到禪堂靜坐，開始一天的修行。
sentences.en: Every morning, he would go to the meditation hall to sit in silence and begin his daily practice.

sentences.zh: 禪堂內的氣氛非常寧靜，讓人感受到內心的平和。
sentences.en: The atmosphere in the meditation hall was very tranquil, giving a sense of inner peace.

sentences.zh: 這座禪堂建於百年前，見證了無數修行者的靈性旅程。
sentences.en: This meditation hall was built a century ago and has witnessed countless spiritual journeys of practitioners.

sentences.zh: 在禪堂裡打坐一小時，能夠讓我重新找回失去已久的安寧感。
sentences.en: Sitting in the meditation hall for an hour helps me regain a long-lost sense of calm.

phrase.zh: 禪宗與人間佛教學術研討會
phrase.en: Academic Conference on Humanistic Buddhism and Chan School

sentences.zh: 今年的禪宗與人間佛教學術研討會吸引了眾多國內外的學者。
sentences.en: This year's Academic Conference on Humanistic Buddhism and Chan School attracted numerous scholars from home and abroad.

sentences.zh: 禪宗與人間佛教學術研討會將探討現代世界中的靈性修行和社會應用。
sentences.en: The Academic Conference on Humanistic Buddhism and Chan School will explore spiritual practice and social application in the modern world.

sentences.zh: 多位知名學者在禪宗與人間佛教學術研討會上發表了自己的最新研究成果。
sentences.en: Several renowned scholars presented their latest research findings at the Academic Conference on Humanistic Buddhism and Chan School.

sentences.zh: 我期待參加這次禪宗與人間佛教學術研討會，學習最新的佛教理論和實踐。
sentences.en: I look forward to attending the Academic Conference on Humanistic Buddhism and Chan School to learn about the latest Buddhist theories and practices.

sentences.zh: 修行者通過禪定來達到心靈的平靜與覺醒。
sentences.en: Practitioners achieve mental peace and awakening through meditative concentration.

sentences.zh: 每天早晨的禪定成為他生活中不可缺少的一部分。
sentences.en: Daily morning meditative concentration has become an indispensable part of his life.

sentences.zh: 禪定可以幫助人們減少壓力，增強心理韌性。
sentences.en: Meditative concentration can help people reduce stress and enhance psychological resilience.

sentences.zh: 通過長時間的禪定，他在人生的道路上找到了方向。
sentences.en: Through prolonged meditative concentration, he found direction in his life's path.

sentences.zh: 修行佛法的核心是通過禪定與智慧來達到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: The core of practicing Buddhism is to achieve inner peace through meditation and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 他每天早晨花一個小時進行禪定以培養他的智慧。
sentences.en: He spends an hour every morning in meditation to cultivate his wisdom.

sentences.zh: 只有結合禪定與智慧，我們才能看清生活的真實本質。
sentences.en: Only by combining meditation and wisdom can we see the true nature of life.

sentences.zh: 老師強調了禪定與智慧對於解決困惑和煩惱的重要性。
sentences.en: The teacher emphasized the importance of meditation and wisdom in resolving confusion and troubles.

sentences.zh: 大雄禪師在山中修行多年，深得弟子的敬仰。
sentences.en: Master Dahong has been practicing in the mountains for years, earning the deep respect of his disciples.

sentences.zh: 這位禪師的教導被記錄在經典中，成為後世修行者的重要參考。
sentences.en: The teachings of this Chan master have been recorded in classical texts, becoming an important reference for future practitioners.

sentences.zh: 每年，各地的修行者都會前來拜訪這位著名的禪師，尋求他的指導。
sentences.en: Every year, practitioners from all over visit this renowned Chan master to seek his guidance.

sentences.zh: 這位禪師以其智慧和慈悲心著稱，並以此引導弟子走向覺悟之路。
sentences.en: This Chan master is known for his wisdom and compassion, guiding his disciples on the path to enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 他的禪心讓他在困境中仍能保持淡定和平。
sentences.en: His Chan mind allowed him to remain calm and peaceful even in difficult situations.

sentences.zh: 修持禪心使你能看到事物的真諦，不被表象所迷惑。
sentences.en: Cultivating a Chan mind enables you to see the true nature of things, free from the illusions of appearances.

sentences.zh: 修行多年，他終於領悟到何為真正的禪心。
sentences.en: After years of practice, he finally understood what a true Chan mind is.

sentences.zh: 以禪心面對一切，讓生活中的每一刻都充滿靈性和智慧。
sentences.en: Facing everything with a Chan mind allows every moment of life to be filled with spirituality and wisdom.

phrase.en: The Chan Mind, the Buddha Way

sentences.zh: 修行者應該時時保持禪心佛道，才能在日常生活中體驗到真正的幸福。
sentences.en: Practitioners should always maintain the Chan Mind, the Buddha Way, to experience true happiness in daily life.

sentences.zh: 禪心佛道的修行讓他對周遭的困苦境遇有了全新的理解與接受。
sentences.en: Cultivating the Chan Mind, the Buddha Way has given him a fresh understanding and acceptance of the hardships around him.

sentences.zh: 她透過禪心佛道的修練，達到了內心的平靜與安寧。
sentences.en: Through practicing the Chan Mind, the Buddha Way, she attained inner peace and serenity.

sentences.zh: 禪心佛道是我們通向解脫與覺悟的必經之路。
sentences.en: The Chan Mind, the Buddha Way is the essential path to liberation and enlightenment.

phrase.zh: 禪心朗照千江月 真性情懷萬里天
phrase.en: The Chan mind shines like the moon in a thousand rivers, True nature and sentiment are as vast as the boundless sky.

sentences.zh: 禪心朗照千江月，讓人心靜如水，遠離煩惱。
sentences.en: The Chan mind shines like the moon in a thousand rivers, bringing tranquility and distancing one from worries.

sentences.zh: 真性情懷萬里天，展示了人性的廣闊與包容。
sentences.en: True nature and sentiment are as vast as the boundless sky, demonstrating the expansiveness and inclusiveness of human nature.

sentences.zh: 當我們修行禪心時，能感受到郎月普照，萬景心安。
sentences.en: When we practice the Chan mind, we can feel the moon's universal glow, bringing peace to all scenes.

sentences.zh: 只有抱持真性情，才能與天地融為一體，達到心靈的廣闊無垠。
sentences.en: Only by embracing true nature and sentiment can one merge with the universe, achieving boundless expansiveness of the mind.

sentences.zh: 他通過每日打坐體會到了無上的禪悅，心靈獲得了前所未有的安寧。
sentences.en: Through daily meditation, he experienced the ultimate joy of Chan, bringing unprecedented peace to his mind.

sentences.zh: 禪悅是一種內在的喜悅，不受外界環境的影響。
sentences.en: The joy of Chan is an inner bliss unaffected by external circumstances.

sentences.zh: 當你達到禪悅的境界，所有的煩惱和憂慮都會消散如煙。
sentences.en: When you reach the state of the joy of Chan, all worries and troubles dissipate like smoke.

sentences.zh: 禪悅充滿了他的心，使他在面對挑戰時依然從容不迫。
sentences.en: The joy of Chan filled his heart, allowing him to remain unperturbed in the face of challenges.

sentences.zh: 在這寧靜的清晨，他感受到了禪悅，心靈得到了前所未有的平靜。
sentences.en: In the quiet morning, he felt the joy of meditation, and his mind experienced an unprecedented calm.

sentences.zh: 每日的禪修讓她體會到了真正的禪悅，她的生活因此變得更加豐富。
sentences.en: Her daily meditation practice allowed her to experience the true joy of meditation, making her life richer.

sentences.zh: 禪悅是佛法修行的一部分，它能幫助我們釋放壓力並找到內心的和平。
sentences.en: The joy of meditation is a part of Buddhist practice, helping us release stress and find inner peace.

sentences.zh: 透過禪悅，他學會了如何在困難時刻保持平靜和專注。
sentences.en: Through the joy of meditation, he learned how to stay calm and focused during difficult times.

phrase.zh: 禪悅法喜 禪心佛道
phrase.en: Joy of Chan and Dharma; Mind of Chan and Buddha

sentences.zh: 在安靜的禪房裡，她感受到禪悅法喜，心中充滿了平靜和喜樂。
sentences.en: In the quiet meditation hall, she felt the Joy of Chan and Dharma, and her heart was filled with peace and happiness.

sentences.zh: 禪心佛道是他一生追求的目標，每天早晨他都進行靜坐修行。
sentences.en: The Mind of Chan and Buddha was his lifelong pursuit, and every morning he engaged in meditation practice.

sentences.zh: 他說，只要能體會到禪悅法喜，就能找到內心的真正安定。
sentences.en: He said that by experiencing the Joy of Chan and Dharma, one can find true inner peace.

sentences.zh: 老師教導學生們要把禪心佛道融入日常生活，才能真正理解佛法的精髓。
sentences.en: The teacher instructed the students to integrate the Mind of Chan and Buddha into their daily lives to truly understand the essence of the Dharma.

phrase.zh: 禪是一朵花 禪是一輪月 禪是一生情 禪是一顆心
phrase.en: Chan is a flower. Chan is a full moon. Chan is a lifetime's sentiment. Chan is a full heart.

sentences.zh: 禪是一朵花，綻放在人們心靈的田地中。
sentences.en: Chan is a flower, blooming in the fields of people's hearts.

sentences.zh: 禪是一輪月，照亮我們黑夜中的內心世界。
sentences.en: Chan is a full moon, illuminating our inner worlds during the dark nights.

sentences.zh: 禪是一生情，無論境遇如何都能保持平靜和快樂。
sentences.en: Chan is a lifetime's sentiment, maintaining peace and happiness regardless of circumstances.

sentences.zh: 禪是一顆心，讓我們感受到生命的本質與和諧。
sentences.en: Chan is a full heart, allowing us to feel the essence and harmony of life.

sentences.zh: 禪是生活中的一朵花，它與日常生活緊密結合，能讓我們在繁忙中找到平靜。
sentences.en: Chan, a flower in life, is closely integrated with daily life, allowing us to find peace amid the busyness.

sentences.zh: 每當我感到困惑或疲倦時，禪是生活中的一朵花，提醒我回歸當下。
sentences.en: Whenever I feel confused or tired, Chan, a flower in life, reminds me to return to the present moment.

sentences.zh: 禪是生活中的一朵花，為心靈提供了清新的芬芳，帶來內心的安寧。
sentences.en: Chan, a flower in life, offers a fresh fragrance for the soul, bringing inner peace.

sentences.zh: 在忙碌的生活中，禪是生活中的一朵花，讓我們學會停下來欣賞瞬間的美好。
sentences.en: In the midst of a busy life, Chan, a flower in life, teaches us to pause and appreciate the beauty of the moment.

phrase.en: Precious Teachings of the Chan Masters

sentences.zh: 《禪林寶訓》是一本包含諸多禪宗大師智慧的珍貴典籍，對修行者有極大的指導作用。
sentences.en: The 'Precious Teachings of the Chan Masters' is a treasured text filled with the wisdom of numerous Chan masters, providing immense guidance to practitioners.

sentences.zh: 許多修行者每天誦讀《禪林寶訓》，希望從中汲取智慧和靈感。
sentences.en: Many practitioners recite the 'Precious Teachings of the Chan Masters' daily in the hopes of drawing wisdom and inspiration from it.

sentences.zh: 《禪林寶訓》中的教誨深刻，令所有讀者都能從中獲得啟發。
sentences.en: The teachings within the 'Precious Teachings of the Chan Masters' are profound, allowing all readers to gain insight.

sentences.zh: 老師常常引用《禪林寶訓》來指導學生們在生活中的種種挑戰。
sentences.en: The teacher often quotes the 'Precious Teachings of the Chan Masters' to guide students through various challenges in life.

phrase.zh: 禪河隨浪靜 定水逐波清
phrase.en: Beneath the moving currents the calming river of Chan; Behind rolling waves the clear water of concentration.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，我們學會了如何在禪河隨浪靜中尋找內心的平靜。
sentences.en: In meditation, we learn how to find inner peace beneath the moving currents of the calming river of Chan.

sentences.zh: 無論生活多麼動蕩，定水逐波清的原則教我們保持冷靜。
sentences.en: No matter how turbulent life gets, the principle of finding clear water behind rolling waves teaches us to stay calm.

sentences.zh: 禪河隨浪靜是禪修者的重要修行，幫助他們面對內心的動蕩。
sentences.en: Beneath the moving currents the calming river of Chan is a significant practice for meditators to face inner unrest.

sentences.zh: 我們可以在定水逐波清中發現真理，無需被外界的干擾所左右。
sentences.en: We can discover truth behind rolling waves in the clear water of concentration, without being swayed by external disturbances.

phrase.zh: 禪海隨浪靜 定水逐波清
phrase.en: Beneath the moving currents the calming river of Chan; Behind rolling waves the water of concentration clears.

sentences.zh: 禪海隨浪靜，正如在生活風暴中也能保持內心的平靜。
sentences.en: Beneath the moving currents the calming river of Chan, just as one can maintain inner peace amidst the storms of life.

sentences.zh: 定水逐波清，意指透過專注和冥想來清除心中的雜念。
sentences.en: Behind rolling waves the water of concentration clears, signifying the clearing of mind through focus and meditation.

sentences.zh: 在修行的路上，我們要學會禪海隨浪靜，定水逐波清。
sentences.en: On the path of practice, we must learn to be like the calming river of Chan amidst currents and the clear water of concentration behind waves.

sentences.zh: 能夠達到禪海隨浪靜，定水逐波清的境界，是佛教修行的高峰。
sentences.en: Reaching the state of beneath the moving currents the calming river of Chan; behind rolling waves the water of concentration clearing, is the pinnacle of Buddhist practice.

phrase.en: Combined Practice of Chan and Pureland

sentences.zh: 禪淨共修是一種結合禪宗和淨土宗方法的修行方式。
sentences.en: Combined Practice of Chan and Pureland is a cultivation method that integrates the approaches of Chan Buddhism and Pure Land Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 通過禪淨共修，修行者可以同時體驗到內心的靜定和淨土的祥和。
sentences.en: Through the Combined Practice of Chan and Pureland, practitioners can experience both inner tranquility and the harmony of the Pure Land.

sentences.zh: 很多寺廟定期舉行禪淨共修活動，吸引了許多信眾參加。
sentences.en: Many temples regularly hold Combined Practice of Chan and Pureland sessions, drawing numerous devotees to participate.

sentences.zh: 大師強調，通過禪淨共修可以更全面地培養智慧與慈悲心。
sentences.en: The master emphasized that by engaging in Combined Practice of Chan and Pureland, one can cultivate wisdom and compassion more comprehensively.

phrase.en: Chan, Pure Land, and Tantric Singing and Dharma Lecture

sentences.zh: 我們參加了一場禪淨密三修唱頌講座，從中學到了很多寶貴的知識。
sentences.en: We attended a Chan, Pure Land, and Tantric Singing and Dharma Lecture, and learned a lot of valuable knowledge.

sentences.zh: 禪淨密三修唱頌講座融合了多種修行方法，是一個很好的增進智慧的機會。
sentences.en: The Chan, Pure Land, and Tantric Singing and Dharma Lecture integrates various practice methods, offering a great opportunity to enhance wisdom.

sentences.zh: 這次禪淨密三修唱頌講座吸引了來自各地的佛教徒，一同探討修行的深奧境界。
sentences.en: This Chan, Pure Land, and Tantric Singing and Dharma Lecture attracted Buddhists from various regions, coming together to explore the profound realms of practice.

sentences.zh: 透過參加禪淨密三修唱頌講座，我們感受到了前所未有的心靈平靜和專注。
sentences.en: Through attending the Chan, Pure Land, and Tantric Singing and Dharma Lecture, we experienced an unprecedented sense of inner peace and concentration.

phrase.zh: 禪淨密三修獻燈祈福法會
phrase.en: Chan, Pure Land, and Esoteric Dharma Function and Light Offering Ceremony

sentences.zh: 上週寺廟舉辦了禪淨密三修獻燈祈福法會，吸引了許多信眾前來參加。
sentences.en: Last week, the temple held a Chan, Pure Land, and Esoteric Dharma Function and Light Offering Ceremony, attracting many devotees.

sentences.zh: 在禪淨密三修獻燈祈福法會上，信眾們共同為世界和平和眾生幸福祈福。
sentences.en: During the Chan, Pure Land, and Esoteric Dharma Function and Light Offering Ceremony, devotees prayed together for world peace and the happiness of all beings.

sentences.zh: 這次禪淨密三修獻燈祈福法會由多位高僧主持，他們倡導智慧與慈悲的融合。
sentences.en: The Chan, Pure Land, and Esoteric Dharma Function and Light Offering Ceremony was led by several high monks who advocated the integration of wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 參加禪淨密三修獻燈祈福法會後，我感到心靈得到了巨大的安慰。
sentences.en: After attending the Chan, Pure Land, and Esoteric Dharma Function and Light Offering Ceremony, I felt a great solace in my soul.

sentences.zh: 禪淨律是佛教修行中的三大重要法門，每一個都有其深遠的意義和修習方法。
sentences.en: Chan, Pure Land, and Precepts are three major practices in Buddhism, each with profound meanings and methods of cultivation.

sentences.zh: 修習禪淨律能幫助我們達到內心的平靜並解脫煩惱，最終獲得智慧和解脫。
sentences.en: Practicing Chan, Pure Land, and Precepts can help us achieve inner peace, break free from afflictions, and ultimately attain wisdom and liberation.

sentences.zh: 在傳統寺院裡，僧侶們通常會兼修禪淨律，以綜合發展他們的精神修為。
sentences.en: In traditional monasteries, monks usually practice a combination of Chan, Pure Land, and Precepts to develop their spiritual cultivation comprehensively.

sentences.zh: 現代佛教徒也可以通過禪淨律的修行來應對快速變化的社會環境，保持內心的安定和清明。
sentences.en: Modern Buddhists can also practice Chan, Pure Land, and Precepts to cope with the rapidly changing social environment, maintaining inner stability and clarity.

phrase.en: Buddhism in Every Step: The Essence of Chan

sentences.zh: 學會理解禪的真諦，可以讓我們更好地應對生活的挑戰。
sentences.en: Understanding the essence of Chan Buddhism in every step can help us better cope with life's challenges.

sentences.zh: 禪的真諦在於生活中的每一個瞬間，而不僅僅是打坐時的體驗。
sentences.en: The essence of Chan lies in every moment of life, not just in the experience of meditation.

sentences.zh: 透過禪的真諦，我們能夠找到內心的平靜與和諧。
sentences.en: By embracing the essence of Chan Buddhism in every step, we can find inner peace and harmony.

sentences.zh: 禪的真諦教導我們要時刻保持覺醒，珍惜當下的每一刻。
sentences.en: The essence of Chan teaches us to stay awake at every step, cherishing each moment of the present.

sentences.zh: 禪的自覺教育讓他更深入地了解自己的心靈世界，並且找到內在的平靜。
sentences.en: Self-awakening through Chan allowed him to delve deeper into his inner world and find inner peace.

sentences.zh: 在禪的自覺教育過程中，她學會了如何自我反省並超越自身的煩惱。
sentences.en: During the course of self-awakening through Chan, she learned how to self-reflect and transcend her inner troubles.

sentences.zh: 老師強調禪的自覺教育能夠提升學生的心智能力和情感穩定。
sentences.en: The teacher emphasized that self-awakening through Chan could enhance students' mental capabilities and emotional stability.

sentences.zh: 禪的自覺教育為他帶來了生活的智慧，讓他能夠應對各種挑戰。
sentences.en: Self-awakening through Chan brought him wisdom for life, enabling him to tackle various challenges.

phrase.zh: 禪與人間佛教學術研討會
phrase.en: Academic Conference on Humanistic Buddhism and Chan

sentences.zh: 今年的禪與人間佛教學術研討會吸引了來自世界各地的學者和僧人。
sentences.en: This year's Academic Conference on Humanistic Buddhism and Chan attracted scholars and monks from around the globe.

sentences.zh: 在禪與人間佛教學術研討會上，與會者討論了佛教在現代社會中的應用。
sentences.en: At the Academic Conference on Humanistic Buddhism and Chan, participants discussed the application of Buddhism in modern society.

sentences.zh: 禪與人間佛教學術研討會包含多場演講和工作坊，極具啟發性。
sentences.en: The Academic Conference on Humanistic Buddhism and Chan featured multiple lectures and workshops that were highly enlightening.

sentences.zh: 他在禪與人間佛教學術研討會上發表了關於慈悲與智慧的研究報告。
sentences.en: He presented a research paper on compassion and wisdom at the Academic Conference on Humanistic Buddhism and Chan.

sentences.zh: 禪與生活密不可分，真正的修行是在日常生活中體現。
sentences.en: Ch'an and life are inseparable; true practice is reflected in daily living.

sentences.zh: 他從禪的修行中汲取智慧，運用在生活中的每一個面向。
sentences.en: He draws wisdom from Ch'an practice and applies it to every aspect of his life.

sentences.zh: 老師常教導學生如何將禪的理念融入到日常生活中，尋找內心的平靜。
sentences.en: The teacher often guides students on how to integrate the principles of Ch'an into daily life to find inner peace.

sentences.zh: 經過多年禪修，他深刻體會到禪與生活的和諧共舞，是人生的藝術。
sentences.en: After years of Ch'an meditation, he profoundly realizes the harmonious dance between Ch'an and life is an art of living.

phrase.en: Ch'an and the Art of Living

sentences.zh: 通過禪與藝術生活的修行，我們可以深刻理解內心的平靜與和諧。
sentences.en: Through the practice of Ch'an and the Art of Living, we can deeply understand inner peace and harmony.

sentences.zh: 這本書《禪與藝術生活》教導我們如何在日常生活中尋找靜謐。
sentences.en: The book 'Ch'an and the Art of Living' teaches us how to find tranquility in our daily lives.

sentences.zh: 禪與藝術生活理念認為，每一刻都可以是充滿藝術與禪意的瞬間。
sentences.en: The philosophy of Ch'an and the Art of Living believes that every moment can be a moment filled with art and Ch'an.

sentences.zh: 參加禪與藝術生活的工作坊，讓我學會了如何將禪融入日常活動中。
sentences.en: Attending the Ch'an and the Art of Living workshop taught me how to integrate Ch'an into daily activities.

sentences.zh: 經過多年的禪觀修行，他達到了內心的平靜與安寧。
sentences.en: After years of Chan contemplation practice, he achieved inner peace and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 禪觀能夠幫助我們看穿煩惱的本質，找到內心的清明。
sentences.en: Chan contemplation can help us see through the nature of our troubles and find inner clarity.

sentences.zh: 在禪觀中，專注於當下是關鍵，這樣才能達到心靈的解脫。
sentences.en: In Chan contemplation, focusing on the present moment is key to attaining spiritual liberation.

sentences.zh: 禪觀的核心是透過靜坐來培養對自我和世界的深刻理解。
sentences.en: The essence of Chan contemplation is to cultivate a deep understanding of oneself and the world through meditation.

sentences.zh: 他用禪話禪畫禪畫禪話，將複雜的哲理簡單明瞭地傳達給弟子。
sentences.en: He used Chan Heart, Chan Art to convey complex philosophies in a simple and clear manner to his disciples.

sentences.zh: 這本書集合了作者多年來的禪話禪畫禪畫禪話，讀來耐人尋味，發人深省。
sentences.en: This book compiles the author's years of Chan Heart, Chan Art, providing thought-provoking and insightful reading.

sentences.zh: 透過禪話禪畫禪畫禪話，他希望每個人都能找到靈魂的平靜和內心的智慧。
sentences.en: Through Chan Heart, Chan Art, he hopes everyone can find the peace of the soul and the wisdom within.

sentences.zh: 在這場禪話禪畫禪畫禪話的講座中，老師以繪畫和故事雙管齊下，深深吸引了所有參加者。
sentences.en: In this Chan Heart, Chan Art lecture, the teacher used both painting and storytelling, deeply engaging all the participants.

sentences.zh: 他在禪講師研究院進行的研究，對現代禪修方法有重要的貢獻。
sentences.en: His research at the Research Institute for Chan Lecturers has made significant contributions to modern meditation techniques.

sentences.zh: 禪講師研究院提供了豐富的資源和機會，幫助學生深入探討禪宗哲學。
sentences.en: The Research Institute for Chan Lecturers offers abundant resources and opportunities for students to delve deeply into Chan philosophy.

sentences.zh: 這所禪講師研究院每年吸引大量國際學者前來交流和合作。
sentences.en: This Research Institute for Chan Lecturers attracts numerous international scholars each year for exchanges and collaborations.

sentences.zh: 他決定申請禪講師研究院的博士課程，以進一步提升他的學術水平。
sentences.en: He decided to apply for the PhD program at the Research Institute for Chan Lecturers to further enhance his academic expertise.

sentences.zh: 修行禪道需要心靈的平靜和專注。
sentences.en: Practicing the Way of Chan requires mental tranquility and focus.

sentences.zh: 他從年輕時便開始探索禪道，並找到了內在的平和。
sentences.en: He began exploring the Way of Chan from a young age and found inner peace.

sentences.zh: 禪道教導我們通過冥想與靜思來了解自我。
sentences.en: The Way of Chan teaches us to understand ourselves through meditation and contemplation.

sentences.zh: 很多人對禪道感興趣，因為它能幫助他們在生活中找到平衡和意義。
sentences.en: Many people are interested in the Way of Chan because it helps them find balance and meaning in life.

sentences.zh: 他決定離開城市喧囂，前往禪門修行，尋求內心的寧靜。
sentences.en: He decided to leave the hustle and bustle of the city and retreat to a Chan Monastery to seek inner peace.

sentences.zh: 禪門內的僧人每天都進行嚴格的修行和打坐，以求證悟真理。
sentences.en: The monks inside the Chan Monastery engage in rigorous practice and meditation daily to attain enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 在禪門的靜謐環境中，訪客可以感受到一種深沉的靈性生活。
sentences.en: In the tranquil environment of the Chan Monastery, visitors can experience a profound spiritual life.

sentences.zh: 禪門的設計通常簡約樸素，追求與自然和諧共生。
sentences.en: The design of a Chan Monastery is usually simple and austere, aiming to achieve harmony with nature.

phrase.zh: 禪門深似海 佛法大如天
phrase.en: Deep as the ocean is the Way of Chan; Majestic as the sky is the Dharma of Buddha.

sentences.zh: 禪門深似海，越深入修行，越能體會其深廣無邊。
sentences.en: Deep as the ocean is the Way of Chan; the deeper one practices, the more one can appreciate its boundless depth.

sentences.zh: 佛法大如天，涵蓋宇宙萬象，無不包含在其中。
sentences.en: Majestic as the sky is the Dharma of Buddha, encompassing the entire universe and all phenomena within.

sentences.zh: 修行如同探索禪門深似海，一生也無法窮盡其奧妙。
sentences.en: Practicing is like exploring the Way of Chan, deep as the ocean; a lifetime is not enough to comprehend its mysteries.

sentences.zh: 如天般廣大的佛法，給予眾生無盡的智慧和慈悲。
sentences.en: Majestic as the sky is the Dharma of Buddha, offering boundless wisdom and compassion to all beings.

sentences.zh: 在這禪風淨月的夜晚，心靈得到了一絲寧靜。
sentences.en: On this night of Chan Breeze and Pure Moon, the mind finds a moment of tranquility.

sentences.zh: 禪風淨月的景象常常被用來形容禪修中的清明境界。
sentences.en: The imagery of Chan Breeze and Pure Moon is often used to describe the clarity attained in meditation.

sentences.zh: 他在禪風淨月的氛圍下進行了長時間的冥想。
sentences.en: He meditated for a long time in the ambiance of Chan Breeze and Pure Moon.

sentences.zh: 禪風淨月這四字不僅是佛教中的一個意境，更是一種生活態度。
sentences.en: Chan Breeze and Pure Moon is not just a concept in Buddhism, but also a way of living.

phrase.zh: 禪風淨月 佛道慈心
phrase.en: Chan Breeze and Pure Moon; Buddha's Way and Compassionate Heart

sentences.zh: 在那靜謐的夜晚，禪風淨月，讓人感受到一種無限的寧靜與祥和。
sentences.en: In that tranquil night, the Chan breeze and pure moon evoked an immense sense of peace and harmony.

sentences.zh: 佛道慈心教導我們應該以善良和無私的心去對待每一個生命。
sentences.en: The Buddha's way and compassionate heart teach us to treat every living being with kindness and selflessness.

sentences.zh: 她每天在禪堂裡靜坐，尋求禪風淨月帶來的內心平和。
sentences.en: Each day, she meditated in the Zen hall, seeking the inner peace brought by the Chan breeze and pure moon.

sentences.zh: 他以佛道慈心行事，幫助許多人從痛苦中解脫。
sentences.en: He acted with the Buddha's way and compassionate heart, helping many people find relief from their suffering.

sentences.zh: 每個早晨，他都會起床後去佛堂禮佛，開始一天的修行。
sentences.en: Every morning, he would start his day by going to the Buddha hall to prostrate to the Buddha.

sentences.zh: 在佛教節慶期間，許多信徒會聚集在寺廟中誠心禮佛。
sentences.en: During Buddhist festivals, many devotees gather at temples to sincerely prostrate to the Buddha.

sentences.zh: 她在禮佛時，感受到一種無比的安寧和內心的平靜。
sentences.en: While prostrating to the Buddha, she felt an incomparable peace and inner tranquility.

sentences.zh: 禮佛的過程不僅是對佛陀的尊敬，也是對修行人自身心靈的淨化。
sentences.en: The process of prostrating to the Buddha is not only a sign of respect for the Buddha but also a purification of the practitioner's own mind.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒在寺廟前虔誠地禮拜，祈求心靈的安寧。
sentences.en: The Buddhist devotees prostrate devoutly in front of the temple, seeking peace of mind.

sentences.zh: 每一次的禮拜都是一次心靈的修煉和提升。
sentences.en: Each prostration is a practice and elevation of the spirit.

sentences.zh: 在法會期間，信眾們一同禮拜，以示對佛陀的恭敬。
sentences.en: During the Dharma assembly, followers prostrate together to show their respect for the Buddha.

sentences.zh: 他每天清晨都會進行禮拜，作為早課的一部分。
sentences.en: He prostrates every morning as part of his daily practice.

sentences.zh: 在寺廟裡，我們首先來到禮敬大廳，向佛像行禮。
sentences.en: In the temple, we first arrived at the front hall to pay respects to the Buddha statue.

sentences.zh: 這座古老的禮敬大廳建於唐代，經歷了數百年的風雨。
sentences.en: The ancient front hall was built during the Tang Dynasty and has weathered hundreds of years.

sentences.zh: 禮敬大廳裝飾華麗，供奉著許多珍貴的佛教文物。
sentences.en: The front hall is ornately decorated and houses many precious Buddhist artifacts.

sentences.zh: 每逢佛教節日，禮敬大廳總是擠滿了前來參拜的信眾。
sentences.en: During Buddhist holidays, the front hall is always crowded with devotees coming to pay their respects.

sentences.zh: 在這場法會期間，信眾們禮請高僧開示佛法。
sentences.en: During the Dharma assembly, the devotees made a request for teachings from the esteemed monk.

sentences.zh: 禪修班開始前，學員們共同禮請老師分享他的修行經驗。
sentences.en: Before the meditation class commenced, the students collectively requested for teachings from the teacher to share his practice experiences.

sentences.zh: 當地的佛教徒禮請寺院住持每月講解一次經文。
sentences.en: The local Buddhists requested for teachings from the abbot to explain the scriptures once a month.

sentences.zh: 在法會結束後，弟子們禮請師父主持供養儀式。
sentences.en: After the Dharma assembly concluded, the disciples made a request for teachings to have the master lead the offering ceremony.

phrase.zh: 禮讚音緣─佛光山人間音緣梵樂團創團巡迴音樂會
phrase.en: Praise to the Sounds of Music - Sounds of the Human World Chinese Orchestra Debut Center Tour

sentences.zh: 禮讚音緣─佛光山人間音緣梵樂團創團巡迴音樂會在台北市立體育館盛大舉行，吸引了大量佛教信徒和音樂愛好者參與。
sentences.en: The Praise to the Sounds of Music - Sounds of the Human World Chinese Orchestra Debut Center Tour kicked off grandly at the Taipei Municipal Stadium, attracting a large number of Buddhist followers and music enthusiasts.

sentences.zh: 這場禮讚音緣─佛光山人間音緣梵樂團創團巡迴音樂會展現出佛教文化與音樂的完美結合。
sentences.en: This Praise to the Sounds of Music - Sounds of the Human World Chinese Orchestra Debut Center Tour showcased a perfect blend of Buddhist culture and music.

sentences.zh: 禮讚音緣─佛光山人間音緣梵樂團創團巡迴音樂會的每一首曲目都回響著深厚的宗教情感。
sentences.en: Each piece performed during the Praise to the Sounds of Music - Sounds of the Human World Chinese Orchestra Debut Center Tour resonated with profound religious emotions.

sentences.zh: 觀眾對禮讚音緣─佛光山人間音緣梵樂團創團巡迴音樂會給予了高度讚賞，稱其為一次心靈的淨化之旅。
sentences.en: The audience highly praised the Praise to the Sounds of Music - Sounds of the Human World Chinese Orchestra Debut Center Tour, calling it a journey of spiritual purification.

sentences.zh: 古詩中經常描寫秋月的靜謐與美麗，讓人心生向往。
sentences.en: Classical poetry often depicts the tranquility and beauty of the autumn moon, evoking a sense of longing.

sentences.zh: 每年中秋節，我們一家人會在院子裡賞秋月，感受家人團聚的溫暖。
sentences.en: Every Mid-Autumn Festival, our family gathers in the yard to admire the autumn moon, feeling the warmth of being together.

sentences.zh: 在清澈的湖面上，秋月倒映出來，如同一幅美麗的畫卷。
sentences.en: On the clear surface of the lake, the autumn moon is reflected, creating a picture-like scene.

sentences.zh: 禪師説，秋月象徵著內心的寧靜，提醒我們要追求內在的平衡。
sentences.en: The Zen master said the autumn moon symbolizes inner peace, reminding us to seek internal balance.

phrase.zh: 秋月朗清空 菩薩開覺路
phrase.en: An autumn moon in a clear sky; A bodhisattva on the path to enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 秋月朗清空，菩薩開覺路，無數修行者因此找到了安詳和智慧。
sentences.en: An autumn moon in a clear sky; a bodhisattva on the path to enlightenment, countless practitioners found peace and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 這條靜謐的小徑，如同秋月朗清空，菩薩開覺路，引領我們走向心靈的深處。
sentences.en: This quiet path, like an autumn moon in a clear sky; a bodhisattva on the path to enlightenment, leads us to the depths of the soul.

sentences.zh: 秋月朗清空，菩薩開覺路，映射出佛法的無限慈悲與智慧。
sentences.en: An autumn moon in a clear sky; a bodhisattva on the path to enlightenment, reflecting the infinite compassion and wisdom of the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 寺院的僧侶們常說，秋月朗清空，菩薩開覺路是修行的最高指導。
sentences.en: The monks of the temple often say, 'An autumn moon in a clear sky; a bodhisattva on the path to enlightenment' is the highest guidance for practice.

phrase.en: The Chan Mind Is Seen in the Autumn Moon

sentences.zh: 在寂靜的夜晚，秋月禪心使得整個世界顯得格外寧靜。
sentences.en: On a quiet night, the Chan mind is seen in the autumn moon, making the entire world appear exceptionally serene.

sentences.zh: 禪師教導弟子們，在秋月禪心中找到內心的平靜與智慧。
sentences.en: The Zen master taught his disciples to find inner peace and wisdom in the Chan mind seen in the autumn moon.

sentences.zh: 每當他遇到困難，他會在秋月禪心的默思中獲得啟發。
sentences.en: Whenever he faced difficulties, he would find inspiration in the meditative state of the Chan mind as seen in the autumn moon.

sentences.zh: 秋月禪心之美在於它提醒我們返璞歸真，發現本心。
sentences.en: The beauty of the Chan mind seen in the autumn moon lies in its reminder to return to simplicity and discover one's true nature.

sentences.zh: 公司的秘書負責整理文件和安排會議。
sentences.en: The company's secretary is responsible for organizing documents and scheduling meetings.

sentences.zh: 在佛教寺院，秘書可能需要處理來自信徒的各種詢問。
sentences.en: In a Buddhist monastery, the secretary may need to handle various inquiries from devotees.

sentences.zh: 她作為秘書，確保所有行政工作都能順利進行。
sentences.en: As a secretary, she ensures that all administrative tasks run smoothly.

sentences.zh: 他的第一份工作就是當一家小公司的秘書。
sentences.en: His first job was as a secretary for a small company.

sentences.zh: 聯合國的秘書長是一個至關重要的國際領導角色。
sentences.en: The Secretary-General of the United Nations is a crucial international leadership role.

sentences.zh: 秘書長在會議中強調了和平與合作的重要性。
sentences.en: The Secretary-General emphasized the importance of peace and cooperation during the conference.

sentences.zh: 他被任命為新的秘書長，負責管理整個組織的運營。
sentences.en: He was appointed as the new Secretary-General, responsible for managing the entire organization's operations.

sentences.zh: 秘書長的演講深深打動了在場的每一個人，喚起了大家對全球問題的關注。
sentences.en: The Secretary-General's speech deeply moved everyone present, raising awareness of global issues.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義如同一顆種子，能夠在信徒心中生根發芽。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings are like a seed, capable of taking root and growing in the hearts of believers.

sentences.zh: 他們在花園裡種下了許多花草的種子，期望來年能見到滿園的美麗景色。
sentences.en: They planted many flower seeds in the garden, hoping to see a beautiful landscape the following year.

sentences.zh: 每一個善行都像是播下了一顆慈悲的種子，最終將會收穫無盡的福報。
sentences.en: Every act of kindness is like sowing a seed of compassion, eventually reaping boundless blessings.

sentences.zh: 在修行的道路上，佛法之種必須勤勉澆灌，方能開花結果。
sentences.en: On the path of practice, the seed of Dharma must be diligently nurtured to blossom and bear fruit.

phrase.en: good begets good, evil begets evil

sentences.zh: 他相信種瓜得瓜，種豆得豆，因而總是努力行善積德。
sentences.en: He believes that good begets good, evil begets evil, so he always strives to do good and accumulate virtue.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義告訴我們，種瓜得瓜，種豆得豆，我們的每一個行為都會有相應的後果。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings tell us that good begets good, evil begets evil, and every action we take will have corresponding consequences.

sentences.zh: 在這部電影中，主人公經歷了種瓜得瓜，種豆得豆的過程，最終明白到了善惡報應的道理。
sentences.en: In this movie, the protagonist undergoes the process of good begets good, evil begets evil, ultimately understanding the principle of karma.

sentences.zh: 他的行為證明了種瓜得瓜，種豆得豆這句話的真諦，做善事終會得到回報。
sentences.en: His actions prove the true meaning of the phrase good begets good, evil begets evil, as doing good deeds will eventually be rewarded.

phrase.en: to cultivate the field of merits

sentences.zh: 他通過布施和幫助貧困的人來種福田，積累無量功德。
sentences.en: He cultivates the field of merits by making donations and helping the impoverished, accumulating boundless merit.

sentences.zh: 種福田是一種修行的方法，可以帶來內心的平靜與祥和。
sentences.en: To cultivate the field of merits is a method of practice that can bring about inner peace and harmony.

sentences.zh: 每一次善行都是在種福田，未來會收穫福報。
sentences.en: Every act of kindness is an effort to cultivate the field of merits, which will yield blessings in the future.

sentences.zh: 在寺廟裡，信眾們通過義工服務來種福田，為自己的精神修養做出貢獻。
sentences.en: In the temple, devotees cultivate the field of merits by volunteering, contributing to their spiritual cultivation.

sentences.zh: 每當她感到困惑或焦慮時，她會稱念阿彌陀佛的聖號，心靈立即變得平靜。
sentences.en: Whenever she felt confused or anxious, she would chant Buddha Amitabha's name, and her mind would instantly become calm.

sentences.zh: 僧侶們每天早晚都會稱念佛號，以求內心的清淨和智慧的增長。
sentences.en: Monks chant Buddha's name every morning and evening to seek inner purity and the growth of wisdom.

sentences.zh: 在佛教的傳統儀式中，大家齊聲稱念，這種集體的力量使人感受到無比的力量和和平。
sentences.en: In traditional Buddhist ceremonies, everyone chants together, and this collective force brings a sense of immense power and peace.

sentences.zh: 她的祖母每天都會在家中的佛壇前稱念莊嚴佛號，希冀保佑全家平安健康。
sentences.en: Her grandmother chants solemn Buddha's name in front of the home altar every day, hoping to bless the family with safety and health.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，善業的積聚能夠導致來世的美好果報。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, the accumulation of good karma can lead to positive outcomes in the next life.

sentences.zh: 長時間的修行與積聚智慧，使他成為一位受人尊敬的老師。
sentences.en: Years of practice and accumulation of wisdom made him a respected teacher.

sentences.zh: 房間的角落裡，灰塵漸漸積聚，形成了一層薄薄的灰色。
sentences.en: In the corners of the room, dust gradually accumulated, forming a thin layer of grey.

sentences.zh: 透過不斷地學習和積聚知識，她終於成為了這個領域的專家。
sentences.en: Through continuous learning and the accumulation of knowledge, she eventually became an expert in her field.

phrase.zh: 空中萬有 全在心中
phrase.en: All Existence Arise from Emptiness; Everything Is in the Mind

sentences.zh: 佛教教義中指出，空中萬有，全在心中，讓我們明白一切現象皆因心起。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings state that all existence arises from emptiness; everything is in the mind, helping us understand that all phenomena are generated by the mind.

sentences.zh: 禪修使我們體悟到空中萬有，全在心中，無一法不從心生。
sentences.en: Meditation enables us to realize that all existence arises from emptiness; everything is in the mind, and not a single dharma is not born from the mind.

sentences.zh: 在清淨的心境中，我們可以感受到空中萬有，全在心中的智慧。
sentences.en: In a state of pure mind, we can perceive the wisdom that all existence arises from emptiness; everything is in the mind.

sentences.zh: 修行過程中，我們應當時時提醒自己，空中萬有，全在心中，切勿執著於表象。
sentences.en: During the practice, we should constantly remind ourselves that all existence arises from emptiness; everything is in the mind, and not cling to appearances.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，空容萬有的概念幫助信徒理解一切萬物的本質。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, the concept of 'emptiness embraces all' helps practitioners understand the nature of all phenomena.

sentences.zh: 禪修者通過靜心冥想，體驗到空容萬有的深刻境界。
sentences.en: Through deep meditation, the Zen practitioner experiences the profound state where emptiness embraces all.

sentences.zh: 空容萬有不僅是佛教的核心理論，也是許多心靈修行之道的重要基礎。
sentences.en: 'Emptiness embraces all' is not only a core theory of Buddhism but also a fundamental principle in many spiritual practices.

sentences.zh: 當人們明白空容萬有的道理，他們能夠超越對物質世界的執著。
sentences.en: When people understand that emptiness embraces all, they can transcend their attachments to the material world.

phrase.en: The Mountain of Emptiness and Sky of Clouds

sentences.zh: 在空山雲天間冥想，能使人心境寧靜、感受自然的無限寬廣。
sentences.en: Meditating in the Mountain of Emptiness and Sky of Clouds brings a sense of peace and the boundless expanse of nature.

sentences.zh: 畫家試圖在畫布上捕捉空山雲天的壯麗景象。
sentences.en: The artist endeavored to capture the magnificent scenery of the Mountain of Emptiness and Sky of Clouds on canvas.

sentences.zh: 空山雲天的景色使人遠離世俗煩惱，領悟到生命的真諦。
sentences.en: The view of the Mountain of Emptiness and Sky of Clouds helps one to transcend worldly troubles and understand the essence of life.

sentences.zh: 遠足空山雲天的經驗教會了他平靜內心、享受當下的生活。
sentences.en: Hiking through the Mountain of Emptiness and Sky of Clouds taught him to calm his mind and enjoy the present moment.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，空性被視為一切現象最終的本質。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, empty nature is regarded as the ultimate essence of all phenomena.

sentences.zh: 禪修的目的之一是親身體驗空性的真實意義。
sentences.en: One of the goals of meditation practice is to personally experience the true meaning of empty nature.

sentences.zh: 了解空性可以幫助我們解脫煩惱，獲得內心的平靜。
sentences.en: Understanding empty nature can help us free ourselves from afflictions and attain inner peace.

sentences.zh: 大乘佛教強調空性的智慧作為通往解脫的關鍵。
sentences.en: Mahayana Buddhism emphasizes the wisdom of empty nature as the key to liberation.

sentences.zh: 理解空有之理，則能擺脫執著與煩惱。
sentences.en: Understanding the principle of emptiness and existence enables one to let go of attachment and afflictions.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義中，空有是一個至關重要的概念，意味著萬物皆有空性。
sentences.en: In Buddhist doctrine, emptiness and existence is a crucial concept, signifying that all things possess an inherent emptiness.

sentences.zh: 只有通達空有之法，方能見得真實的自性。
sentences.en: Only by comprehending the dharma of emptiness and existence can one perceive the true nature of self.

sentences.zh: 禪修的目的是體驗空有的本質，從而達到內心的平靜與智慧。
sentences.en: The goal of Zen meditation is to experience the essence of emptiness and existence, thereby achieving inner peace and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義中談到空有不二，宏觀而言，宇宙中的一切都無法完全歸化為空或有。
sentences.en: In Buddhist teachings, the concept of 'Non-Duality of Emptiness and Existence' suggests that everything in the universe cannot be fully categorized as either empty or existent.

sentences.zh: 理解空有不二的智慧能幫助我們超越二元對立的思維，達到究竟的解脫。
sentences.en: The wisdom of understanding the 'Non-Duality of Emptiness and Existence' helps us transcend dualistic thinking and achieve ultimate liberation.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中體驗到空有不二的境界，能使人達到深刻的內心平靜與和諧。
sentences.en: Experiencing the state of 'Non-Duality of Emptiness and Existence' during meditation can lead to profound inner peace and harmony.

sentences.zh: 老師講解了空有不二的觀念，強調它在日常生活中的實踐價值。
sentences.en: The teacher explained the concept of 'Non-Duality of Emptiness and Existence,' emphasizing its practical value in everyday life.

sentences.zh: 夜晚的空江月明，讓人感受到一種寧靜而祥和的氛圍。
sentences.en: The empty river, bright moon at night, provides a sense of tranquility and harmony.

sentences.zh: 我們坐在河邊，欣賞著空江月明的美景，內心得到了極大的放鬆。
sentences.en: We sat by the river, admiring the empty river, bright moon scene, and felt deeply relaxed.

sentences.zh: 古詩中常提到空江月明，用來描繪一種清幽閑靜的境界。
sentences.en: Classical poetry often mentions the empty river, bright moon to describe a serene and quiet scene.

sentences.zh: 在那個空江月明的夜晚，他頓悟了人生的真諦。
sentences.en: On that night with the empty river and bright moon, he suddenly grasped the true meaning of life.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，體驗空無是達到內心寧靜的一個重要步驟。
sentences.en: In meditation, experiencing emptiness is an important step towards achieving inner peace.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義強調空無是一切事物的本質，沒有固定的實體。
sentences.en: Buddhist doctrine emphasizes that emptiness is the essence of all things, without a fixed entity.

sentences.zh: 了解空無的真理能幫助我們放下執著，面對生活中的變化。
sentences.en: Understanding the truth of emptiness can help us let go of attachment and face life's changes.

sentences.zh: 在《金剛經》中，空無的智慧被描述為人們通往解脫的途徑。
sentences.en: In the Diamond Sutra, the wisdom of emptiness is described as a path to liberation.

phrase.zh: 空色色空空即色 有無無有有還無
phrase.en: Empty form, form of emptiness, thus emptiness is form; Being absent, absence of being, thus being is absence.

sentences.zh: 佛教經典中常提到「空色色空，空即是色」，強調萬物皆為虛幻的概念。
sentences.en: Buddhist scriptures often mention 'Empty form, form of emptiness, thus emptiness is form,' emphasizing the notion that all phenomena are illusory.

sentences.zh: 修行者需要理解「有無無有，有還無」的道理，才能擺脫對世間事物的執著。
sentences.en: Practitioners need to comprehend the principle of 'Being absent, absence of being, thus being is absence' to free themselves from attachments to worldly matters.

sentences.zh: 僧人們在禪修時，會反覆思維「空即是色，色即是空」這樣的教義，以求達到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: Monks often meditate on teachings like 'Empty form, form of emptiness, thus emptiness is form' to achieve inner peace.

sentences.zh: 理解「有無無有，有還無」的深義，有助於我們看破物質世界的本質。
sentences.en: Understanding the deeper meaning of 'Being absent, absence of being, thus being is absence' helps us see through the true nature of the material world.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義中的空見強調一切現象都是空的，沒有自性。
sentences.en: The view of emptiness in Buddhist teachings emphasizes that all phenomena are empty and lack intrinsic nature.

sentences.zh: 經由禪修，修行者可以更深刻地體會空見的重要性。
sentences.en: Through meditation, practitioners can more profoundly understand the importance of the view of emptiness.

sentences.zh: 空見並不是指什麼都不存在，而是表明我們的執著和認知都是錯誤的。
sentences.en: The view of emptiness does not imply that nothing exists but signifies that our attachments and perceptions are mistaken.

sentences.zh: 接受空見可以幫助我們脫離苦惱，實現內心的平靜。
sentences.en: Embracing the view of emptiness can help us free ourselves from suffering and attain inner peace.

phrase.zh: 空谷風吹知勁草 滿山葉落見蒼松
phrase.en: Gale in empty valley will single out a tough grass; Falling leaves in the mountains shall reveal green pines.

sentences.zh: 正如空谷風吹才能知勁草，在逆境中才能見證真正的勇士。
sentences.en: Just as the gale in an empty valley will single out a tough grass, true warriors are recognized in adversity.

sentences.zh: 當滿山的葉子落下，我們才能看到那些堅韌的蒼松，分別出真正的堅強。
sentences.en: When the leaves fall in the mountains, we can see the resilient green pines and recognize true strength.

sentences.zh: 在壓力之下，真正的品質會如空谷勁草般展現出來。
sentences.en: Under pressure, true qualities emerge just like tough grass in an empty valley.

sentences.zh: 只有經歷了風雨，我們才能像見到滿山蒼松一樣，看到人們內在的堅韌和力量。
sentences.en: Only after weathering the storms can we, much like seeing green pines on the mountain, witness people's inner resilience and strength.

sentences.zh: 他決定出家，進入空門，追尋心靈的平靜。
sentences.en: He decided to become a monk and enter the Gate of Emptiness to seek inner peace.

sentences.zh: 在空門中修行多年後，他對人生的理解更加透徹。
sentences.en: After many years of practice in the Gate of Emptiness, he gained a deeper understanding of life.

sentences.zh: 空門並非僅指寺廟，而是心靈的解脫之門。
sentences.en: The Gate of Emptiness does not merely refer to the monastery; it is the door to spiritual liberation.

sentences.zh: 她透過每日的冥想進入空門，體驗到內心的寧靜。
sentences.en: She entered the Gate of Emptiness through daily meditation, experiencing inner tranquility.

sentences.zh: 他在工作中一直致力於立功立德，受到了同事和上司的一致好評。
sentences.en: He has always been dedicated to establishing his merit and virtue at work, earning unanimous praise from colleagues and superiors.

sentences.zh: 佛教強調立功立德，認為這是修行的重要一環。
sentences.en: Buddhism emphasizes establishing one's merit and virtue, considering it an essential part of practice.

sentences.zh: 在歷史上，那些偉大的領導人都是因為立功立德而被人們永遠銘記。
sentences.en: In history, those great leaders are forever remembered for establishing their merit and virtue.

sentences.zh: 教育孩子立功立德，從小培養正確的價值觀，是每個家長的責任。
sentences.en: It's the responsibility of every parent to educate their children to establish one's merit and virtue, nurturing correct values from a young age.

phrase.zh: 立功立德 心懷天下
phrase.en: Establish One’s Merit and Virtue; A Mind That Embraces the World

sentences.zh: 修行者應該以立功立德 心懷天下為目標，這樣才能真正做到利益眾生。
sentences.en: Practitioners should aim to establish one’s merit and virtue; a mind that embraces the world, as this truly benefits all sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 立功立德 心懷天下，是古代聖賢們一再強調的修身之道。
sentences.en: Establishing one’s merit and virtue; a mind that embraces the world, is the path to self-cultivation that ancient sages often emphasized.

sentences.zh: 我們在現代社會中也應該立功立德 心懷天下，為世界的和平與發展盡一份力。
sentences.en: In modern society, we should also establish one’s merit and virtue; a mind that embraces the world, contributing to world peace and development.

sentences.zh: 他一生致力於立功立德 心懷天下，成為了很多人心中的榜樣。
sentences.en: He dedicated his life to establishing one’s merit and virtue; a mind that embraces the world, becoming a role model for many.

phrase.zh: 立功立德立言 三不朽也
phrase.en: Establish One’s Merit, Virtue, and Teachings; These Are the Three Imperishables

sentences.zh: 古代的聖賢強調立功立德立言三不朽也，以此為圭臬來修身。
sentences.en: Ancient sages emphasized establishing one's merit, virtue, and teachings; these are the three imperishables, using it as a guiding principle for self-cultivation.

sentences.zh: 他一生致力於立功立德立言三不朽也，留下了深遠的影響。
sentences.en: He devoted his life to establishing one's merit, virtue, and teachings; these are the three imperishables, leaving a lasting impact.

sentences.zh: 我們應該效法那些立功立德立言三不朽也的人，為後世樹立榜樣。
sentences.en: We should emulate those who establish one's merit, virtue, and teachings; these are the three imperishables, setting an example for future generations.

sentences.zh: 在追求人生目標的過程中，不應忽視立功立德立言三不朽也的重要性。
sentences.en: In the pursuit of life goals, one should not overlook the importance of establishing one's merit, virtue, and teachings; these are the three imperishables.

sentences.zh: 在佛前，她立大願，誓為眾生服務。
sentences.en: In front of the Buddha, she made great vows to serve all sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 菩薩道強調每個修行者都應立大願，以成就無上菩提。
sentences.en: The Bodhisattva path emphasizes that every practitioner should make great vows to achieve supreme enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 修行者通常在重要的法會上立大願，以展示他們的決心和虔誠。
sentences.en: Practitioners often make great vows during important Dharma assemblies to show their determination and devotion.

sentences.zh: 立大願是修行過程中的重要一環，能夠為修行者提供堅定的指引。
sentences.en: Making great vows is an important part of the spiritual practice, providing practitioners with steadfast guidance.

phrase.zh: 立定腳跟 心懷十方
phrase.en: Set One's Foot Firmly on the Ground; Set One's Heart on the Entire World

sentences.zh: 修行者應立定腳跟，心懷十方，不被外界的誘惑所動。
sentences.en: A practitioner should set one's foot firmly on the ground and set one's heart on the entire world, remaining impervious to external temptations.

sentences.zh: 在面對挑戰時，我決定立定腳跟，心懷十方，不讓困難擊潰我的決心。
sentences.en: When facing challenges, I decided to set my foot firmly on the ground and set my heart on the entire world, not letting difficulties break my resolve.

sentences.zh: 這位慈善家始終立定腳跟，心懷十方，以無私的精神幫助他人。
sentences.en: This philanthropist always sets his foot firmly on the ground and sets his heart on the entire world, helping others with a selfless spirit.

sentences.zh: 立定腳跟，心懷十方，是我們實現偉大目標的關鍵。
sentences.en: Setting one's foot firmly on the ground and setting one's heart on the entire world is the key to achieving great goals.

sentences.zh: 他立志成為一名醫生，以幫助那些需要幫助的人。
sentences.en: He aspires to become a doctor to help those in need.

sentences.zh: 我們應該從小立志，樹立遠大的目標。
sentences.en: We should aspire from a young age to set lofty goals.

sentences.zh: 她立志在藝術領域取得卓越成就，為此每天都在畫室裡練習。
sentences.en: She aspires to achieve excellence in the field of art and practices daily in the studio.

sentences.zh: 這位年輕的僧人立志達到內心的平靜和智慧，並每天進行冥想修行。
sentences.en: The young monk aspires to attain inner peace and wisdom, meditating daily as part of his practice.

phrase.zh: 立志如高山 培德似大地
phrase.en: Have aspirations lofty as mountains; Nurture virtue profound as the Earth.

sentences.zh: 他一直相信，立志如高山，培德似大地，從小就樹立了遠大的志向。
sentences.en: He always believed in having aspirations lofty as mountains and nurturing virtue as profound as the Earth, setting great goals from a young age.

sentences.zh: 在困境面前，她牢記著立志如高山，培德似大地，從不輕易放棄。
sentences.en: In the face of adversity, she remembered to have aspirations lofty as mountains and nurture virtue as profound as the Earth, never giving up easily.

sentences.zh: 老師常教導我們要立志如高山，培德似大地，為人要有擔當和品德。
sentences.en: The teacher often reminded us to have aspirations lofty as mountains and to nurture virtue as profound as the Earth, encouraging us to have responsibility and integrity.

sentences.zh: 他以立志如高山，培德似大地的精神來指導自己的生活，成為社會的楷模。
sentences.en: He guided his life by the principle of having aspirations lofty as mountains and nurturing virtue as profound as the Earth, becoming a role model in society.

phrase.zh: 立志如高山 培德似深海
phrase.en: Have aspirations lofty as mountains; Nurture virtue deep as the ocean.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒應該立志如高山，培德似深海，精進修行。
sentences.en: Buddhists should have aspirations lofty as mountains and nurture virtue deep as the ocean, diligently practicing their faith.

sentences.zh: 他的修行理念是立志如高山，培德似深海，讓人欽佩。
sentences.en: His philosophy of practice, to have aspirations lofty as mountains and nurture virtue deep as the ocean, is truly admirable.

sentences.zh: 寺院中的長老經常教導弟子要立志如高山，培德似深海，才能達到真正的覺悟。
sentences.en: The elder monks in the monastery often teach disciples to have aspirations lofty as mountains and nurture virtue deep as the ocean in order to attain true enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 在人生的道路上，我們也應該立志如高山，培德似深海，這樣才能成為有智慧和慈悲心的人。
sentences.en: In life's path, we too should have aspirations lofty as mountains and nurture virtue deep as the ocean to become wise and compassionate individuals.

phrase.zh: 立足當下 悟道今朝
phrase.en: Abide in the Present Moment; Awaken in the Here and Now

sentences.zh: 修行者應該立足當下，悟道今朝，避免被過去的遺憾和未來的擔憂所困擾。
sentences.en: Practitioners should abide in the present moment and awaken in the here and now, avoiding being troubled by past regrets and future worries.

sentences.zh: 他提倡立足當下，悟道今朝，認為這是實現內心平靜的關鍵。
sentences.en: He advocates for abiding in the present moment and awakening in the here and now, believing it to be the key to inner peace.

sentences.zh: 在面對挑戰時，我們要立足當下，悟道今朝，以冷靜和智慧處理問題。
sentences.en: When facing challenges, we should abide in the present moment and awaken in the here and now, handling issues with calmness and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 通過瑜伽和冥想，她學會了立足當下，悟道今朝，從而減輕了生活中的壓力。
sentences.en: Through yoga and meditation, she learned to abide in the present moment and awaken in the here and now, thereby alleviating stress in her life.

phrase.en: with a proper mind and regulated will

sentences.zh: 修行者應該端心正意，為眾生謀求福祉。
sentences.en: Practitioners should act with a proper mind and regulated will, seeking the well-being of all sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 在面對困難時，我們需要端心正意，才能找到解決方法。
sentences.en: When facing difficulties, we need to maintain a proper mind and regulated will to find solutions.

sentences.zh: 老師教導我們，要端心正意，踏實做人。
sentences.en: Our teacher instructs us to live with a proper mind and regulated will, being honest and trustworthy.

sentences.zh: 端心正意是每個修行者的基本要求，只有這樣才能接近覺悟。
sentences.en: Acting with a proper mind and regulated will is a fundamental requirement for every practitioner, as it leads them closer to enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 她的舉止總是那樣端莊，讓周圍的人倍感敬仰。
sentences.en: Her demeanor is always so graceful, earning the admiration of those around her.

sentences.zh: 他在典禮上的表現非常端莊，給大家留下了深刻的印象。
sentences.en: He was very graceful at the ceremony, leaving a deep impression on everyone.

sentences.zh: 這位舞者的每一個動作都充滿了端莊和優雅。
sentences.en: Every movement of the dancer was filled with grace and elegance.

sentences.zh: 她端莊的言談和儀態為她贏得了許多尊重。
sentences.en: Her graceful speech and manners have earned her much respect.

phrase.zh: 竹密不妨流水過 山高豈障礙白雲飛
phrase.en: No matter how dense, water always passes through the bamboos; Regardless of height, clouds always cross the mountaintops.

sentences.zh: 竹密不妨流水過，無論困難重重，終有解決之道。
sentences.en: No matter how dense, water always passes through the bamboos; no matter how challenging, there is always a solution.

sentences.zh: 山高豈障礙白雲飛，人若心志高遠，再大的困難也無法阻礙其前進。
sentences.en: Regardless of height, clouds always cross the mountaintops; if one's mind is set high, no obstacles can hinder his progress.

sentences.zh: 竹林雖密，但流水仍能順利通過，這讓我明白了堅持的重要性。
sentences.en: Though the bamboo forest is dense, water can still pass through smoothly, which taught me the importance of perseverance.

sentences.zh: 即使山再高，也無法阻止白雲飛越，這句話勉勵我們勇敢面對一切挑戰。
sentences.en: Even if the mountain is high, it cannot stop the clouds from crossing; this phrase encourages us to bravely face all challenges.

sentences.zh: 竹林佛學院從1928年到1939年培養了許多傑出的佛教學者。
sentences.en: Zhulin Buddhist College (1928-1939) nurtured many outstanding Buddhist scholars.

sentences.zh: 竹林佛學院以其嚴謹的學風和豐富的藏書聞名於世。
sentences.en: Zhulin Buddhist College (1928-1939) was renowned for its rigorous academic atmosphere and extensive library collections.

sentences.zh: 竹林佛學院在1939年因戰爭原因被迫關閉，但其影響力仍然持續。
sentences.en: Zhulin Buddhist College (1928-1939) was forced to close in 1939 due to war, but its influence continued.

sentences.zh: 竹林佛學院的畢業生在全國各地的寺院中擔任重要職位，弘揚佛法。
sentences.en: Graduates of Zhulin Buddhist College (1928-1939) held important positions in temples nationwide, promoting Buddhism.

phrase.zh: 笑面是供養 讚美出妙香
phrase.en: A smile is a form of giving, A praise emits pleasant fragrances.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，笑面是供養，帶給他人歡樂和幸福。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, a smile is a form of giving, bringing joy and happiness to others.

sentences.zh: 當你心懷善意地讚美他人時，你的話語能像妙香一般沁人心脾。
sentences.en: When you heartily praise others, your words can resemble pleasant fragrances that delight the soul.

sentences.zh: 即使在艱難時刻，保持笑容也是一種供養，能夠帶來正面的能量。
sentences.en: Even in difficult times, maintaining a smile is a form of giving that can bring positive energy.

sentences.zh: 一個真誠的讚美，不僅能提升他人的自信，也能讓你身邊充滿妙香般的和諧。
sentences.en: A sincere praise not only boosts others' confidence but also fills your surroundings with pleasant harmony like frangrances.

phrases.zh: 不私收徒弟
phrases.en: Fo Guang members do not privately accept disciples

phrases.zh: 不私蓄金錢
phrases.en: Fo Guang members do not privately save money

phrases.zh: 不私建道場
phrases.en: Fo Guang members do not privately build temples

phrases.zh: 不私交信者
phrases.en: Fo Guang members do not privately establish relationships with devotees

sentences.zh: 佛光會員遵守原則，不私收徒弟，以保護純正的教學傳承。
sentences.en: Fo Guang members adhere to the principle of not privately accepting disciples to protect the integrity of the teachings.

sentences.zh: 佛光會員強調清廉，不私蓄金錢，所有捐款都用於推動社會福利。
sentences.en: Fo Guang members emphasize transparency and do not privately save money; all donations are used to promote social welfare.

sentences.zh: 佛光會員遵循規範，不私建道場，所有建設皆需經過教團的許可和審批。
sentences.en: Fo Guang members follow regulations and do not privately build temples; all constructions must be approved by the association.

sentences.zh: 佛光會員謹守戒律，不私交信者，以維持純潔的僧團生活。
sentences.en: Fo Guang members strictly adhere to precepts and do not privately establish relationships with devotees to maintain the purity of monastic life.

en: Do not privately collect donations
Do not privately ask for favors
Do not privately purchase personal property
Do not privately prepare food and drinks

sentences.zh: 佛光成員不私自化緣，以確保所有捐款都用於共同的善業。
sentences.en: Fo Guang members do not privately collect donations to ensure all funds are used for the collective good.

sentences.zh: 佛光成員不私自請託，以保持團體內的清廉和公正。
sentences.en: Fo Guang members do not privately ask for favors to maintain integrity and fairness within the organization.

sentences.zh: 佛光成員不私置產業，所有財產都應該屬於佛光協會。
sentences.en: Fo Guang members do not privately purchase personal property; all assets should belong to the Fo Guang Association.

sentences.zh: 佛光成員不私造飲食，集體用餐以示團結和共享。
sentences.en: Fo Guang members do not privately prepare food and drinks; communal meals represent unity and sharing.

sentences.zh: 在佛光山，所有成員都遵循不私自化緣的戒律，以確保慈善工作的透明和公信力。
sentences.en: At Fo Guang Shan, all members follow the rule of not privately collecting donations to ensure transparency and credibility in charity work.

sentences.zh: 佛光成員不私自請託，避免個人利益侵蝕組織的宗旨和價值觀。
sentences.en: Fo Guang members do not privately ask for favors to prevent personal interests from undermining the organization's mission and values.
