sentences.en: The master said that life needs more rain of flowers and the serene mind of Chan, as well as the peaceful presence of pines and the chirping of birds to calm the heart.

sentences.zh: 在這個祈禱的時刻，大家閉上眼睛，感受花雨禪心寂，松風鳥語香帶來的祥和。
sentences.en: At this moment of prayer, everyone closed their eyes, feeling the peace brought by the rain of flowers, the serene mind of Chan, and the natural harmony of pines and birds chirping.

phrase.zh: 芳草春回依舊綠 梅花時到自然香
phrase.en: Fresh grass in a spring field is still verdant; Timely plum blossoms are naturally fragrant.

sentences.zh: 芳草春回依舊綠，今年的春天一如既往地充滿生機。
sentences.en: Fresh grass in a spring field is still verdant; spring this year is as vibrant as ever.

sentences.zh: 儘管時間推移，梅花時到自然香，依然散發著濃郁的香氣。
sentences.en: Despite the passage of time, timely plum blossoms are naturally fragrant, still permeating the air with their rich scent.

sentences.zh: 在這個園子裡，芳草春回依舊綠，宛若一幅生動的畫卷。
sentences.en: In this garden, fresh grass in a spring field is still verdant, resembling a lively painting.

sentences.zh: 無論寒冬多麼漫長，當春天來臨時，梅花時到自然香，帶來無限生機。
sentences.en: No matter how long the winter lasts, when spring arrives, timely plum blossoms are naturally fragrant, bringing infinite vitality.

phrase.zh: 芳草春田依然綠 梅花到時自然香
phrase.en: Fresh grass in a spring field is still verdant; Timely plum blossoms are naturally fragrant.

sentences.zh: 在佛法的熏陶下，心靈如芳草春田依然綠，無論經歷多少風雨，心中依然保持清明。
sentences.en: Under the influence of Dharma, the mind remains verdant like fresh grass in a spring field, maintaining clarity regardless of life's storms.

sentences.zh: 修行者的德行，如梅花到時自然香，隨著時間的推移，自然地散發出迷人的芬芳。
sentences.en: The virtues of a practitioner are like timely plum blossoms that are naturally fragrant, exuding an enchanting aroma as time goes by.

sentences.zh: 在寧靜的寺院小徑上，芳草春田依然綠，顯現出大自然的肅靜與祥和。
sentences.en: Along the tranquil monastery paths, the fresh grass in the spring field remains verdant, showcasing nature's serenity and harmony.

sentences.zh: 悟道的心境如梅花到時自然香，沒有刻意的追求，也不必等待，開放出純粹的美。
sentences.en: The state of enlightenment is like timely plum blossoms that are naturally fragrant; there is no forced pursuit or waiting, only the unfolding of pure beauty.

phrase.en: I vow never to rise from my seat unless I achieve Buddhahood

sentences.zh: 達摩祖師在面壁九年時發下宏願：若不成佛，誓不起座。
sentences.en: Bodhidharma made a great vow during his nine years of meditation: 'I vow never to rise from my seat unless I achieve Buddhahood.'

sentences.zh: 菩薩的決心如此堅定，他們常常說：若不成佛，誓不起座。
sentences.en: The determination of the Bodhisattvas is so firm; they often say, 'I vow never to rise from my seat unless I achieve Buddhahood.'

sentences.zh: 修行者面對困境時，可以提醒自己：若不成佛，誓不起座。
sentences.en: When practitioners face difficulties, they can remind themselves: 'I vow never to rise from my seat unless I achieve Buddhahood.'

sentences.zh: 祖師的誓言‘若不成佛，誓不起座’，激勵無數後來人。
sentences.en: The patriarch's vow, 'I vow never to rise from my seat unless I achieve Buddhahood,' has inspired countless generations.

phrase.zh: 若人滿三千大千世界七寶，以用布施
phrase.en: if a person, in an act of generosity, were to give away enough precious jewels to fill an entire great chiliocosm

sentences.zh: 《金剛經》說：若人滿三千大千世界七寶，以用布施，其福德不可計量。
sentences.en: The Diamond Sutra says: if a person, in an act of generosity, were to give away enough precious jewels to fill an entire great chiliocosm, the merit and virtue would be immeasurable.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，若人滿三千大千世界七寶，以用布施，這種無私的行為是最高尚的。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, if a person, in an act of generosity, were to give away enough precious jewels to fill an entire great chiliocosm, such selfless action is considered to be the most noble.

sentences.zh: 若人滿三千大千世界七寶，以用布施，他將獲得無盡的功德和福報。
sentences.en: If a person, in an act of generosity, were to give away enough precious jewels to fill an entire great chiliocosm, they would receive endless merit and bliss.

sentences.zh: 一個人若滿三千大千世界七寶，以用布施，那將是一種無與倫比的慈悲行動。
sentences.en: If a person were to give away enough precious jewels to fill an entire great chiliocosm, it would be an unparalleled act of compassion.

phrase.zh: 若要身體好 不要吃太飽 若要人緣佳 誠懇莫驕傲 若要家庭和 關懷最重要 若要事業興 勤勞去創造
phrase.en: To be in good health, Don't eat too much. To have good affinities, Be sincere instead of proud. To have a happy family, Show that you care. To succeed in one's career, Strive with diligence.

sentences.zh: 若要身體好，不要吃太飽，因為良好的飲食習慣是健康的基礎。
sentences.en: To be in good health, don't eat too much, as good eating habits are the foundation of health.

sentences.zh: 若要人緣佳，誠懇莫驕傲，因為誠摯的態度才能建立真誠的友誼。
sentences.en: To have good affinities, be sincere instead of proud, because only a genuine attitude can build true friendships.

sentences.zh: 若要家庭和，關懷最重要，一個互相關心的家庭才會和諧美滿。
sentences.en: To have a happy family, show that you care, as a family that cares for each other will be harmonious and joyful.

sentences.zh: 若要事業興，勤勞去創造，因為付出努力才能取得成功。
sentences.en: To succeed in one's career, strive with diligence, as hard work is the key to achieving success.

sentences.zh: 他現在承受的苦果其實是過去所做不善業的結果。
sentences.en: The effects of suffering he is enduring now are actually the result of unwholesome deeds he committed in the past.

sentences.zh: 修行者要了解如何透過智慧來消除苦果，並達到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: Practitioners need to understand how to eliminate the effects of suffering through wisdom and attain inner peace.

sentences.zh: 她透過冥想和內觀，終於超越了長期以來的精神苦果。
sentences.en: Through meditation and introspection, she finally transcended the long-term effects of suffering on her mind.

sentences.zh: 面對苦果時，保持一顆平常心是很重要的，以避免進一步的痛苦。
sentences.en: When facing the effects of suffering, it is important to maintain equanimity to avoid further pain.

sentences.zh: 眾生正在苦海中掙扎，佛法是他們的指路明燈。
sentences.en: Sentient beings are struggling in the ocean of suffering, and the Dharma is their guiding light.

sentences.zh: 他感覺自己像是在苦海中漂流，無法找到岸邊。
sentences.en: He felt as if he was drifting in an ocean of suffering, unable to find the shore.

sentences.zh: 佛祖教我們如何超越苦海，達到涅槃的境界。
sentences.en: The Buddha teaches us how to transcend the ocean of suffering and reach the state of Nirvana.

sentences.zh: 在這個充滿苦海的世界裡，慈悲和智慧是我們唯一的救贖。
sentences.en: In this world filled with an ocean of suffering, compassion and wisdom are our only salvation.

phrase.en: Ferry of Compassion in the Ocean of Suffering

sentences.zh: 佛陀被比喻為苦海慈航，他的教法就是幫助眾生渡過苦海的舟楫。
sentences.en: The Buddha is likened to a Ferry of Compassion in the Ocean of Suffering, with his teachings serving as the boat to help sentient beings cross the sea of suffering.

sentences.zh: 修行者應當發願自己也成為苦海慈航，為他人指引解脫之路。
sentences.en: Practitioners should aspire to become a Ferry of Compassion in the Ocean of Suffering themselves, guiding others towards liberation.

sentences.zh: 在困難重重的世間，我們需要更多像苦海慈航般的人來幫助受苦的眾生。
sentences.en: In a world full of difficulties, we need more people like the Ferry of Compassion in the Ocean of Suffering to assist those in agony.

sentences.zh: 透過苦海慈航的精神，我們可以學習如何以慈悲心面對別人的苦難，並願意伸出援手。
sentences.en: Through the spirit of the Ferry of Compassion in the Ocean of Suffering, we can learn to face others' suffering with compassion and be willing to extend our help.

phrase.en: the ocean of suffering is boundless; only by turning back can one reach salvation

sentences.zh: 在遭遇人生困境時，我們常常忘記苦海無邊，回頭是岸的重要道理。
sentences.en: When facing life's challenges, we often forget the important truth that the ocean of suffering is boundless; only by turning back can one reach salvation.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們，無論我們沉溺於多深的苦海，只要回頭是岸，就能找到解脫之道。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us that no matter how deeply we are immersed in the ocean of suffering, only by turning back can we find the path to liberation.

sentences.zh: 只要你願意轉變心態，就能親身體會到苦海無邊，回頭是岸的真諦。
sentences.en: As long as you are willing to change your mindset, you can personally experience the truth that the ocean of suffering is boundless; only by turning back can one reach salvation.

sentences.zh: 他明白了苦海無邊，回頭是岸這個教訓，決心改過自新，重新開始。
sentences.en: He understood the lesson that the ocean of suffering is boundless; only by turning back can one reach salvation, and decided to reform himself and start anew.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒透過苦行修行來提升自己的智慧和忍耐力。
sentences.en: Buddhists practice austerity to enhance their wisdom and endurance.

sentences.zh: 他選擇過簡樸的生活，奉行苦行，希望能夠脫離物質世界的束縛。
sentences.en: He chose to live a simple life, practicing austerity in hopes of freeing himself from material attachments.

sentences.zh: 在修行過程中，苦行能幫助修行者克服內心的貪欲和執著。
sentences.en: During the path of cultivation, austerity helps practitioners overcome inner desires and attachments.

sentences.zh: 許多修士會通過長期的苦行來檢驗自己的心志和毅力。
sentences.en: Many monks undergo long periods of austerity to test their resolve and willpower.

sentences.zh: 佛陀在四諦中講述了苦集滅道的真理，指出人生的困苦及其解脫之道。
sentences.en: The Buddha expounded the truths of Suffering, Cause, End, and Path in the Four Noble Truths, pointing out the hardships of life and the way to liberation.

sentences.zh: 通過理解苦集滅道，我們可以找到內心的平靜和終極的幸福。
sentences.en: By understanding the concepts of Suffering, Cause, End, and Path, we can find inner peace and ultimate happiness.

sentences.zh: 學習苦集滅道能幫助我們以更加平和和智慧的方式面對生活中的挑戰。
sentences.en: Learning about Suffering, Cause, End, and Path can help us face life's challenges more calmly and wisely.

sentences.zh: 在修行中，我們反覆思維苦集滅道，以此增進覺悟和智慧。
sentences.en: In our practice, we repeatedly contemplate Suffering, Cause, End, and Path to enhance our awakening and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 我最近在讀一本英文佛學小叢書，它深入淺出地解釋了佛教的基本教義。
sentences.en: I am currently reading a book from the 'Buddhist in Every Steps Series', which explains the basic doctrines of Buddhism in a simple and clear manner.

sentences.zh: 這套英文佛學小叢書對於初學佛法的人來說相當有幫助。
sentences.en: This 'Buddhist in Every Steps Series' is quite helpful for those who are new to learning about Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 寺廟圖書館收藏了許多英文佛學小叢書，供信徒們借閱。
sentences.en: The temple library holds many books from the 'Buddhist in Every Steps Series' for devotees to borrow.

sentences.zh: 老師推薦我們閱讀英文佛學小叢書，以增進我們對佛教的理解。
sentences.en: Our teacher recommended us to read the 'Buddhist in Every Steps Series' to enhance our understanding of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 今年夏天，我參加了英語寺院生活體驗營，體驗了心靈的重生。
sentences.en: This summer, I participated in the FGS Weekend Temple Retreat and experienced a spiritual rebirth.

sentences.zh: 英語寺院生活體驗營提供了打坐、禪修和法語學習的機會。
sentences.en: The FGS Weekend Temple Retreat offers opportunities for meditation, Zen practices, and Dharma study.

sentences.zh: 通過英語寺院生活體驗營，我學會了如何將平靜和智慧帶回日常生活中。
sentences.en: Through the FGS Weekend Temple Retreat, I learned how to bring peace and wisdom back into my daily life.

sentences.zh: 我們在英語寺院生活體驗營中結交了來自世界各地的新朋友，體驗了真正的佛教生活。
sentences.en: At the FGS Weekend Temple Retreat, we made new friends from around the world and experienced authentic Buddhist living.

phrase.zh: 英雄志四海 古人惜寸陰
phrase.en: The brave sets his heart on the world; The ancient sage set his mind on time.

sentences.zh: 英雄志四海，無論身在何地，都有偉大的抱負。
sentences.en: The brave sets his heart on the world, harboring great ambitions no matter where he is.

sentences.zh: 古人惜寸陰，他們深知時間的寶貴，不輕易浪費。
sentences.en: The ancient sage set his mind on time, understanding the invaluable nature of time and never wasting it lightly.

sentences.zh: 弘揚佛法需要英雄志四海的精神，與古人惜寸陰的智慧。
sentences.en: Promoting Buddhism requires the spirit of setting one's heart on the world like the brave and the wisdom of valuing time like the ancient sage.

sentences.zh: 學者應該學習英雄志四海的胸懷，並且效法古人惜寸陰的勤勉。
sentences.en: Scholars should learn to have the ambition of setting their hearts on the world like the brave and emulate the diligence of valuing every moment like the ancient sage.

phrase.zh: 英雄志四海 學士惜寸陰
phrase.en: The brave sets his heart on the world; The learned scholar sets his mind on time.

sentences.zh: 他深信英雄志四海，學士惜寸陰這句話，決心在事業與學業上都不浪費一分一秒。
sentences.en: He firmly believes in the saying, 'The brave sets his heart on the world; The learned scholar sets his mind on time,' and is determined not to waste a single second in his career and studies.

sentences.zh: 英雄志四海，學士惜寸陰，是古今許多成功人士的座右銘。
sentences.en: 'The brave sets his heart on the world; The learned scholar sets his mind on time,' is the motto of many successful people throughout history.

sentences.zh: 從小他就被教導要有英雄志四海的氣魄和學士惜寸陰的精神，所以做事總是十分專注。
sentences.en: From a young age, he was taught to have the spirit of the brave who sets his heart on the world and the diligence of the scholar who sets his mind on time, hence he always works with great focus.

sentences.zh: 英雄志四海，學士惜寸陰，不僅是一種理念，更是一種生活方式。
sentences.en: 'The brave sets his heart on the world; The learned scholar sets his mind on time' is not just a concept but a way of life.

phrase.zh: 英雄志在行天下 菩薩結緣遍十方
phrase.en: A great man aspires to travel the entire world; A bodhisattva establishes affinities across the ten directions.

sentences.zh: 英雄志在行天下，他立志走遍世界各地，追尋他的夢想。
sentences.en: A great man aspires to travel the entire world; he resolves to roam the globe in search of his dreams.

sentences.zh: 這位勇敢的探險家正是英雄志在行天下的寫照，他的足跡遍佈無數國家。
sentences.en: This brave explorer epitomizes the saying 'A great man aspires to travel the entire world,' with his footprints spanning countless countries.

sentences.zh: 菩薩結緣遍十方，她無私地在各地傳播愛與慈悲。
sentences.en: A bodhisattva establishes affinities across the ten directions; she selflessly spreads love and compassion everywhere.

sentences.zh: 他像菩薩結緣遍十方一樣，無論走到哪裡都願意幫助那些需要幫助的人。
sentences.en: He, like a bodhisattva who establishes affinities across the ten directions, is always willing to help those in need wherever he goes.

sentences.zh: 茉莉花香氣撲鼻，能讓人感到放鬆和愉悅。
sentences.en: The fragrance of jasmine flowers is delightful, bringing a sense of relaxation and happiness.

sentences.zh: 在佛教儀式中，茉莉經常被用作獻花，象徵著純淨和神聖。
sentences.en: In Buddhist rituals, jasmine is often used as an offering flower, symbolizing purity and holiness.

sentences.zh: 她把一條茉莉花編成的花環掛在佛像前，祈求平安和祝福。
sentences.en: She hung a garland made of jasmine flowers in front of the Buddha statue, praying for peace and blessings.

sentences.zh: 茉莉茶不僅味道清香，還有助於平靜心靈，增進身心健康。
sentences.en: Jasmine tea not only has a delightful aroma but also helps to calm the mind and improve overall well-being.

sentences.zh: 在茶禪的修行中，禪修者通過品茶來體驗當下的寧靜。
sentences.en: In Tea Chan practice, meditators experience the tranquility of the present moment through tea tasting.

sentences.zh: 茶禪融合了中國的禪宗與日本的茶道，形成了一種獨特的文化。
sentences.en: Tea Chan combines Chinese Zen Buddhism with the Japanese tea ceremony, forming a unique culture.

sentences.zh: 通過茶禪，我們學會了如何在日常生活中的每個動作中找到靜心。
sentences.en: Through Tea Chan, we learn how to find mindfulness in every action of our daily lives.

sentences.zh: 茶禪不僅是品味茶葉的藝術，更是修煉心靈的法門。
sentences.en: Tea Chan is not only the art of tasting tea but also a method for cultivating the mind.

sentences.zh: 在靜謐的茶室裡，他感受到茶禪一味的深刻意境。
sentences.en: In the serene tea room, he experienced the profound essence of Tea and Chan.

sentences.zh: 茶禪一味的理念強調身心合一，是追求內心平靜的一種方式。
sentences.en: The concept of Tea and Chan emphasizes the unity of body and mind, serving as a way to seek inner peace.

sentences.zh: 通過茶禪一味的修行，他找到了在日常生活中融合禪意的方法。
sentences.en: Through the practice of Tea and Chan, he found ways to integrate Zen into his daily life.

sentences.zh: 這場茶會是一種茶禪一味的體現，讓參與者從中體悟到禪意和平靜。
sentences.en: This tea gathering was an embodiment of Tea and Chan, allowing participants to experience Zen and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 在茶飯禪的修行中，即便是品茶吃飯也能找到禪的平靜與專注。
sentences.en: In the practice of Chan in tea and meals, even sipping tea and eating can bring the tranquility and focus of Chan.

sentences.zh: 茶飯禪教導我們在日常生活的點滴中也要保持覺知，不被外界所擾。
sentences.en: Chan in tea and meals teaches us to maintain awareness in the minutiae of daily life, without being disturbed by external factors.

sentences.zh: 透過茶飯禪，我們學會了在簡單的生活活動中尋找內心的平靜。
sentences.en: Through Chan in tea and meals, we learn to find inner peace in simple daily activities.

sentences.zh: 禪師強調茶飯禪的重要性，因為它可以幫助我們在平凡的日常中體驗深層次的靈修。
sentences.en: The Zen master emphasizes the importance of Chan in tea and meals, as it helps us experience profound spiritual practices in ordinary daily life.

phrase.en: Grass Hut Blown Down by the Autumn Wind

sentences.zh: 《草堂詩》是杜甫的名作之一，描述了他在草堂中生活的艱難與情懷。
sentences.en: 'Grass Hut Blown Down by the Autumn Wind' is one of Du Fu's famous works, describing his hardships and sentiments living in the grass hut.

sentences.zh: 草堂詩以其真摯的情感和細膩的筆觸，成為古典詩歌中的經典。
sentences.en: The 'Grass Hut Blown Down by the Autumn Wind' has become a classic in classical poetry with its sincere emotions and delicate touches.

sentences.zh: 讀《草堂詩》可以讓人感受到古代文人的堅韌與智慧。
sentences.en: Reading 'Grass Hut Blown Down by the Autumn Wind' allows one to feel the resilience and wisdom of ancient scholars.

sentences.zh: 草堂詩中的每一行詩句都飽含著杜甫對生命的深刻感悟。
sentences.en: Every line in 'Grass Hut Blown Down by the Autumn Wind' is filled with Du Fu's profound insights into life.

sentences.zh: 荊軻傳是一個關於忠勇和義氣的動人故事。
sentences.en: The Story of Jing Ke is a touching tale of loyalty and bravery.

sentences.zh: 歷史課上，我們學習了《荊軻傳》中的重要情節。
sentences.en: In our history class, we studied the important episodes from the Story of Jing Ke.

sentences.zh: 在《荊軻傳》中，荊軻為了刺殺秦王，不惜犧牲自己的性命。
sentences.en: In the Story of Jing Ke, Jing Ke risked his own life in an attempt to assassinate the King of Qin.

sentences.zh: 他被譽為勇士，因為《荊軻傳》中的英雄壯舉被世人傳頌。
sentences.en: He is hailed as a hero because the heroic deeds from the Story of Jing Ke are celebrated by people.

phrase.en: Solemn Pure Land - Buddhist Hymn and Dance Concert

sentences.zh: 這次莊嚴淨土─梵音樂舞的演出吸引了許多信徒前來，一同感受佛法的慈悲與智慧。
sentences.en: This Solemn Pure Land - Buddhist Hymn and Dance Concert attracted many devotees who came together to experience the compassion and wisdom of Dharma.

sentences.zh: 莊嚴淨土─梵音樂舞以其悠揚的梵唄和優美的舞蹈讓觀眾陷入深深的冥想。
sentences.en: The Solemn Pure Land - Buddhist Hymn and Dance Concert immersed the audience in deep meditation with its melodious chants and graceful dances.

sentences.zh: 主持人介紹說，莊嚴淨土─梵音樂舞的目的是讓人們更加接近淨土的境界。
sentences.en: The host explained that the purpose of the Solemn Pure Land - Buddhist Hymn and Dance Concert is to bring people closer to the realm of Pure Land.

sentences.zh: 在莊嚴淨土─梵音樂舞的結尾，所有的表演者和觀眾一起唱誦，場面充滿了虔誠的氣氛。
sentences.en: At the conclusion of the Solemn Pure Land - Buddhist Hymn and Dance Concert, all performers and the audience chanted together, creating an atmosphere filled with devotion.

sentences.zh: 在修行的過程中，我們應該時刻提醒自己莫妄想，以保持心境的平靜。
sentences.en: During the practice of meditation, we should constantly remind ourselves to think no delusive thoughts to maintain peace of mind.

sentences.zh: 老師常說，修行之道在於莫妄想，如此才能悟得真理。
sentences.en: Our teacher often says that the path to practice lies in thinking no delusive thoughts; only then can one attain enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 要達到心靈的清淨，必須學會莫妄想，這是一個漫長但值得的過程。
sentences.en: To achieve mental purity, one must learn to think no delusive thoughts; it is a long but rewarding journey.

sentences.zh: 在打坐時，我盡量讓自己莫妄想，專注於當下的每一個呼吸。
sentences.en: While meditating, I strive to think no delusive thoughts and focus on each breath I take.

phrase.zh: 莫嫌佛門茶水淡 僧情不比俗情濃
phrase.en: Say not that the monastery tea tastes bland; Monastic sentiment is lighter than worldly ones.

sentences.zh: 莫嫌佛門茶水淡，僧情不比俗情濃，這是對僧人淡泊人生的一種描寫。
sentences.en: Say not that the monastery tea tastes bland; Monastic sentiment is lighter than worldly ones. This is a portrayal of the monks' simple and tranquil way of life.

sentences.zh: 當你心中充滿煩惱時，莫嫌佛門茶水淡，僧情不比俗情濃，也許你能在清茶中找到心靈的平靜。
sentences.en: When your heart is filled with troubles, say not that the monastery tea tastes bland; monastic sentiment is lighter than worldly ones. Perhaps in that plain tea, you may find peace for your soul.

sentences.zh: 旅人來到禪寺時，僧人微笑著説：『莫嫌佛門茶水淡，僧情不比俗情濃，這裡有的是心靈的寧靜。』
sentences.en: When a traveler arrived at the Zen temple, the monk smiled and said, 'Say not that the monastery tea tastes bland; monastic sentiment is lighter than worldly ones. What we offer here is tranquility for the soul.'

sentences.zh: 禪師對弟子們說：『莫嫌佛門茶水淡，僧情不比俗情濃，我們要學會在平凡中尋找内心的潛藏智慧。』
sentences.en: The Zen master told his disciples, 'Say not that the monastery tea tastes bland; monastic sentiment is lighter than worldly ones. We must learn to find the hidden wisdom within the ordinary.'

phrase.zh: 莫學芙蓉空有面 應如梅花撲鼻香
phrase.en: Echo not the lily having naught but appearance; Pursue instead the plum blossom with a permeating fragrance.

sentences.zh: 即使我們外表再美，也莫學芙蓉空有面，應如梅花撲鼻香，內在美才是永恆的。
sentences.en: Even if we have an attractive appearance, we should not echo the lily having naught but appearance but pursue instead the plum blossom with a permeating fragrance, as inner beauty is eternal.

sentences.zh: 許多人的成功不在於外表的光鮮，而在於內在品質的提升，莫學芙蓉空有面，應如梅花撲鼻香。
sentences.en: Many people's success lies not in their outward appearance but in the improvement of their inner qualities; echo not the lily having naught but appearance, but pursue instead the plum blossom with a permeating fragrance.

sentences.zh: 做人應追求內心的豐富和智慧，莫學芙蓉空有面，應如梅花撲鼻香。
sentences.en: One should strive for inner richness and wisdom; echo not the lily having naught but appearance, but pursue instead the plum blossom with a permeating fragrance.

sentences.zh: 老師常常告誡我們莫學芙蓉空有面，應如梅花撲鼻香，這句話深深影響了我們的價值觀。
sentences.en: The teacher often admonished us to echo not the lily having naught but appearance, but pursue instead the plum blossom with a permeating fragrance; this saying profoundly influenced our values.

sentences.zh: 在修行的過程中，時刻提醒自己莫忘(妄)想，才能保持心靈的清淨。
sentences.en: During the practice, constantly reminding oneself to think no delusive thoughts helps maintain a pure heart.

sentences.zh: 禪坐時，莫忘(妄)想是避免心猿意馬的重要方法。
sentences.en: While meditating, thinking no delusive thoughts is crucial for avoiding a restless mind.

sentences.zh: 佛陀教導我們，日常生活中莫忘(妄)想，以保持內心的平和。
sentences.en: The Buddha taught us to think no delusive thoughts in daily life to maintain inner peace.

sentences.zh: 在面對挑戰時，莫忘(妄)想可以讓我們更清晰地看到事情的本質。
sentences.en: When facing challenges, thinking no delusive thoughts allows us to see the true nature of things more clearly.

sentences.zh: 釋迦牟尼佛在菩提樹下證悟了菩提，成為了覺者。
sentences.en: Under the Bodhi tree, Buddha Shakyamuni attained bodhi and became the Enlightened One.

sentences.zh: 追求菩提的過程需要無比的堅忍和智慧。
sentences.en: The pursuit of bodhi requires immense tenacity and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 每個人都有潛在的能力證得菩提，只需在正道上努力修行。
sentences.en: Everyone has the potential to attain bodhi; it just requires diligent practice on the right path.

sentences.zh: 菩提並非遙不可及，只要心存覺悟，人人皆可獲得。
sentences.en: Bodhi is not unattainable; with a heart of enlightenment, anyone can achieve it.

phrase.zh: 菩提伽耶國際三壇大戒
phrase.en: International Triple Platform Full Ordination Ceremony in Bodhgaya

sentences.zh: 菩提伽耶國際三壇大戒吸引了來自世界各地的僧人參加，共同見證這一神聖的儀式。
sentences.en: The International Triple Platform Full Ordination Ceremony in Bodhgaya attracted monks from around the globe, all coming together to witness this sacred rite.

sentences.zh: 每年，數以百計的僧侶和信徒會聚集在菩提伽耶參加這場國際三壇大戒。
sentences.en: Each year, hundreds of monks and devotees gather in Bodhgaya to participate in the International Triple Platform Full Ordination Ceremony.

sentences.zh: 菩提伽耶國際三壇大戒不僅是宗教儀式，亦是一種全球佛教徒交流的機會。
sentences.en: The International Triple Platform Full Ordination Ceremony in Bodhgaya is not only a religious ritual but also an opportunity for global Buddhist interaction.

sentences.zh: 參加菩提伽耶國際三壇大戒的人們感受到深深的靈性共鳴和佛教團結精神。
sentences.en: Participants in the International Triple Platform Full Ordination Ceremony in Bodhgaya experience a profound spiritual resonance and a sense of Buddhist unity.

sentences.zh: 每年成千上萬的人會聚在菩提廣場，共同分享智慧與慈悲。
sentences.en: Every year, thousands of people gather at the Bodhi Wisdom Concourse to share wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 菩提廣場是靈性啟蒙的重要場所，吸引了來自世界各地的修行者。
sentences.en: The Bodhi Wisdom Concourse is a significant site for spiritual enlightenment, attracting practitioners from around the world.

sentences.zh: 在菩提廣場，僧人們每天早晨進行誦經和冥想，慈悲與智慧充滿了這個地方。
sentences.en: At the Bodhi Wisdom Concourse, monks engage in chanting and meditation every morning, filling the place with compassion and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 舉辦在菩提廣場的年度法會，成為促進佛教交流與學習的重要平台。
sentences.en: The annual dharma assembly held at the Bodhi Wisdom Concourse has become an important platform for fostering Buddhist exchange and learning.

sentences.zh: 佛陀在菩提樹下得到了徹底的覺悟，因此菩提樹在佛教中具有重要的象徵意義。
sentences.en: The Buddha attained complete enlightenment under the Bodhi Tree, making it a significant symbol in Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 許多佛教徒會到菩提樹下祈禱，希望能夠獲得智慧與平靜。
sentences.en: Many Buddhists pray under the Bodhi Tree, hoping to gain wisdom and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 菩提樹的所在地被認為是一個神聖的地方，吸引了來自世界各地的朝聖者。
sentences.en: The location of the Bodhi Tree is considered a sacred site, attracting pilgrims from around the world.

sentences.zh: 在某些佛教寺廟的庭院中，你可以看到菩提樹的後代，它們被小心翼翼地照顧著。
sentences.en: In the courtyards of some Buddhist temples, you can see the descendants of the Bodhi Tree, carefully tended to.

sentences.zh: 修行者在菩提路上步步精進，追求最終的解脫。
sentences.en: The practitioner makes steady progress on the Bodhi Path, seeking ultimate liberation.

sentences.zh: 菩提路是一條充滿挑戰和啟示的道路，要求我們不斷反思和進步。
sentences.en: The Bodhi Path is a road full of challenges and insights, requiring continuous reflection and improvement.

sentences.zh: 通過修行菩提路，修行者能夠達到智慧和慈悲的圓滿狀態。
sentences.en: By practicing the Bodhi Path, the practitioner can achieve a state of complete wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 在菩提路上，修行者學習如何超越自我，達到心靈的安寧和平靜。
sentences.en: On the Bodhi Path, the practitioner learns how to transcend the self, achieving serenity and peace of mind.

phrase.en: Great Treatise on the Stages of the Path to Enlightenment

sentences.zh: 《菩提道次第廣論》是由宗喀巴大師所著，是藏傳佛教的重要經典。
sentences.en: The 'Great Treatise on the Stages of the Path to Enlightenment' was written by Master Tsongkhapa and is an important text in Tibetan Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 學習《菩提道次第廣論》能幫助修行者系統地理解佛法修行的各個階段。
sentences.en: Studying the 'Great Treatise on the Stages of the Path to Enlightenment' helps practitioners systematically understand various stages of Dharma practice.

sentences.zh: 《菩提道次第廣論》詳細闡述了成佛之道，從發心到修法，一步步指引修行者。
sentences.en: The 'Great Treatise on the Stages of the Path to Enlightenment' details the path to Buddhahood, from generating the mind to actual practice, guiding practitioners step by step.

sentences.zh: 《菩提道次第廣論》的核心思想是菩提心和智慧的完美結合。
sentences.en: The core philosophy of the 'Great Treatise on the Stages of the Path to Enlightenment' is the perfect integration of bodhicitta and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 他每天默誦菩提願，期望能夠早日證得菩提果。
sentences.en: He recites the Bodhi Vow daily, hoping to attain enlightenment soon.

sentences.zh: 菩提願是一種深刻的承諾，意味著決心不斷精進修行。
sentences.en: The Bodhi Vow is a profound commitment, signifying the determination to continually advance in practice.

sentences.zh: 修行者在菩提樹下立下菩提願，發誓利益眾生。
sentences.en: Under the Bodhi tree, the practitioner made the Bodhi Vow, swearing to benefit all sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 菩提願是大悲心的體現，旨在解脫所有眾生的苦難。
sentences.en: The Bodhi Vow embodies great compassion, aiming to liberate all beings from suffering.

sentences.zh: 觀世音菩薩是大乘佛教中受人尊敬的菩薩。
sentences.en: Guanyin Bodhisattva is a revered bodhisattva in Mahayana Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 菩提心是菩薩行為的核心，旨在救渡所有眾生。
sentences.en: Bodhicitta is the core of bodhisattva conduct, aiming to deliver all sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 許多人祈求地藏菩薩的庇佑，以求避開災難和困苦。
sentences.en: Many people pray for the protection of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva to avoid disasters and suffering.

sentences.zh: 釋迦牟尼本身在成佛之前也是一位行菩薩道的菩薩。
sentences.en: Shakyamuni himself was also a bodhisattva practicing the bodhisattva path before achieving enlightenment.

phrase.en: Sutra on the Good Precepts of the Bodhisattvas

sentences.zh: 《菩薩善戒經》是大乘佛教的重要經典之一，教導如何修持菩薩的行為準則。
sentences.en: The 'Sutra on the Good Precepts of the Bodhisattvas' is one of the important scriptures in Mahayana Buddhism, teaching how to follow the behavioral guidelines of a Bodhisattva.

sentences.zh: 讀誦《菩薩善戒經》能增進個人的智慧和慈悲心，對修行者有很大的幫助。
sentences.en: Reciting the 'Sutra on the Good Precepts of the Bodhisattvas' can enhance personal wisdom and compassion, greatly aiding the practitioner.

sentences.zh: 許多佛教徒每天都會抽時間閱讀《菩薩善戒經》，以提醒自己遵守菩薩道。
sentences.en: Many Buddhists take time each day to read the 'Sutra on the Good Precepts of the Bodhisattvas', reminding themselves to adhere to the Bodhisattva path.

sentences.zh: 《菩薩善戒經》不僅僅是修行的指南，同時也是文化和歷史的寶貴遺產。
sentences.en: The 'Sutra on the Good Precepts of the Bodhisattvas' is not only a guide for practice but also a valuable cultural and historical legacy.

sentences.zh: 《菩薩地持經》詳細闡述了菩薩修行的十地。
sentences.en: The Sutra on Bodhisattva Stages (Bodhisattva-bhumi Sutra) elaborates on the ten stages of a Bodhisattva's practice.

sentences.zh: 僧人們頻繁研讀《菩薩地持經》以指導修行。
sentences.en: Monks frequently study the Sutra on Bodhisattva Stages to guide their practice.

sentences.zh: 《菩薩地持經》是佛教經典中極為重要的一部經典。
sentences.en: The Sutra on Bodhisattva Stages is an extremely important scripture in Buddhist canon.

sentences.zh: 學習《菩薩地持經》可以幫助修行者了解如何逐步達到菩薩的境界。
sentences.en: Studying the Sutra on Bodhisattva Stages can help practitioners understand how to gradually reach the state of a Bodhisattva.

sentences.zh: 他以菩薩心對待每一個人，無論對方是敵人還是朋友。
sentences.en: He treats everyone with a Bodhi Mind, regardless of whether they are friends or foes.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該常常反省自己的內心，保持菩薩心，不被塵世所擾。
sentences.en: Practitioners should frequently reflect on their inner self, keep a Bodhi Mind, and not be disturbed by worldly matters.

sentences.zh: 她的菩薩心讓周圍的人深受感動，大家紛紛效法她的慈悲行為。
sentences.en: Her Bodhi Mind deeply touched those around her, inspiring others to emulate her compassionate actions.

sentences.zh: 菩薩心是佛教徒追求的最高理想之一，是無限慈悲與智慧的象徵。
sentences.en: The Bodhi Mind is one of the highest ideals pursued by Buddhists, symbolizing infinite compassion and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 他在寺廟裡接受了菩薩戒，決心以菩薩精神修行。
sentences.en: He received the Bodhisattva Precepts at the temple and vowed to practice with the spirit of a Bodhisattva.

sentences.zh: 菩薩戒不僅僅是表面的戒律，更是內心深處的道德承諾。
sentences.en: The Bodhisattva Precepts are not just outward disciplines but also deep inner moral commitments.

sentences.zh: 每一位受持菩薩戒的僧人都努力在日常生活中體現慈悲和智慧。
sentences.en: Every monk who upholds the Bodhisattva Precepts strives to embody compassion and wisdom in their daily life.

sentences.zh: 學習菩薩戒能夠幫助我們走向更高的精神境界，並利他助人。
sentences.en: Learning the Bodhisattva Precepts can help us reach higher spiritual realms and assist others.

phrase.en: bodhisattvas fear causes while sentient beings fear effects

sentences.zh: 菩薩畏因，眾生畏果，即指出了因果的重要性以及對善行的堅持。
sentences.en: Bodhisattvas fear causes while sentient beings fear effects, emphasizing the importance of cause and effect and the persistence in good deeds.

sentences.zh: 了解‘菩薩畏因，眾生畏果’的道理，可以幫助我們在生活中更加謹慎行事。
sentences.en: Understanding the principle that 'bodhisattvas fear causes while sentient beings fear effects' can help us act more cautiously in life.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義中，‘菩薩畏因，眾生畏果’提醒我們應該注意每一個行為的動機。
sentences.en: In Buddhist teachings, 'bodhisattvas fear causes while sentient beings fear effects' reminds us to be mindful of the intentions behind every action.

sentences.zh: 當我們理解‘菩薩畏因，眾生畏果’，便能更易於培養慈悲心和智慧。
sentences.en: When we understand that 'bodhisattvas fear causes while sentient beings fear effects,' it becomes easier to cultivate compassion and wisdom.

phrase.en: Buddhism in Every Step: On Becoming a Bodhisattva

sentences.zh: 菩薩的宗教體驗源於對眾生大慈大悲的心願。
sentences.en: The religious experience of a Bodhisattva stems from a great compassionate vow towards all beings.

sentences.zh: 學習菩薩的宗教體驗需要無數次的自我反省和修行。
sentences.en: Learning the religious experience of a Bodhisattva requires countless sessions of self-reflection and practice.

sentences.zh: 菩薩的宗教體驗讓他在面對困難時依然保持平靜和智慧。
sentences.en: The religious experience of a Bodhisattva allows him to remain calm and wise in the face of difficulties.

sentences.zh: 每一位修行者都可以通過實踐菩薩的宗教體驗來提升自己的心性。
sentences.en: Every practitioner can enhance their own temperament by practicing the religious experience of a Bodhisattva.

sentences.zh: 菩薩行者應該以慈悲為懷，幫助所有眾生脫離苦海。
sentences.en: A bodhisattva practitioner should be filled with compassion and assist all sentient beings in escaping suffering.

sentences.zh: 這位菩薩行者在生活中奉行六波羅蜜，示範了無我的精神。
sentences.en: This bodhisattva practitioner practices the Six Perfections in daily life, exemplifying the spirit of selflessness.

sentences.zh: 菩薩行者不僅修持自身解脫，更致力於眾生的救度。
sentences.en: A bodhisattva practitioner not only seeks personal liberation but also dedicates efforts to the salvation of all beings.

sentences.zh: 透過學習菩薩行者的典範，我們理解了無私奉獻的真正意義。
sentences.en: Through studying the example of a bodhisattva practitioner, we understand the true meaning of selfless dedication.

sentences.zh: 他發願行菩薩道，以救世濟人為己任。
sentences.en: He vowed to walk the Bodhisattva Path, taking on the mission of saving and helping others.

sentences.zh: 修行菩薩道的人應該具有大慈大悲的精神。
sentences.en: Those who practice the Bodhisattva Path should possess a spirit of great compassion and mercy.

sentences.zh: 菩薩道的核心是無私奉獻和犧牲自我利益。
sentences.en: The core of the Bodhisattva Path is selfless dedication and sacrificing one's own interests.

sentences.zh: 在菩薩道上，修行者需要時刻保持智慧和慈悲的兼備。
sentences.en: On the Bodhisattva Path, practitioners must constantly maintain both wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 華嚴淨土是一個充滿智慧和慈悲的境界，讓修行者能夠體驗到無上的法喜。
sentences.en: The Avatamsaka Pure Land is a realm filled with wisdom and compassion, allowing practitioners to experience supreme bliss.

sentences.zh: 學習華嚴經的教義有助於我們更好地理解華嚴淨土的深奧境界。
sentences.en: Studying the teachings of the Avatamsaka Sutra helps us better understand the profound realm of the Avatamsaka Pure Land.

sentences.zh: 很多佛教徒希望通過修行和誦經來生生世世徜徉於華嚴淨土。
sentences.en: Many Buddhists aspire to wander joyously in the Avatamsaka Pure Land through lifetimes of practice and chanting.

sentences.zh: 華嚴淨土的景象美麗莊嚴，是眾生精進修行的理想目標。
sentences.en: The vision of the Avatamsaka Pure Land is exquisitely magnificent, making it an ideal goal for sentient beings to strive towards.

sentences.zh: 《華嚴經》是大乘佛教的重要經典之一，是佛教哲學的重要資源。
sentences.en: The Avatamsaka Sutra is one of the principal texts of Mahayana Buddhism and a crucial resource in Buddhist philosophy.

sentences.zh: 《華嚴經》闡述了佛教宇宙觀中的因果關係和眾生的互相關聯性。
sentences.en: The Avatamsaka Sutra elaborates on the interconnectedness of all beings and the causal relationships in the Buddhist cosmology.

sentences.zh: 在禪宗的修行中，《華嚴經》常被視為指導思想的重要經典。
sentences.en: In Zen practice, the Avatamsaka Sutra is often regarded as an essential doctrinal text.

sentences.zh: 許多學者和修行者花費數年時間研究和默念《華嚴經》，以求得智慧和啟示。
sentences.en: Many scholars and practitioners spend years studying and chanting the Avatamsaka Sutra to gain wisdom and insight.

phrase.en: Ten Vows of Samantabhadra in the Avatamsaka Sutra

sentences.zh: 華嚴經普賢十大願是佛教徒修行道路上的重要指導原則。
sentences.en: The Ten Vows of Samantabhadra in the Avatamsaka Sutra are important guiding principles on the path of Buddhist practice.

sentences.zh: 在誦讀華嚴經普賢十大願時，可以感受到一股寧靜與力量。
sentences.en: When reciting the Ten Vows of Samantabhadra in the Avatamsaka Sutra, one can feel a sense of tranquility and strength.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒經常在禮佛時默念華嚴經普賢十大願，以增強他們的修行決心。
sentences.en: Buddhists often recite the Ten Vows of Samantabhadra in the Avatamsaka Sutra during their rituals to strengthen their resolve in practice.

sentences.zh: 華嚴經普賢十大願包括供養諸佛、稱讚如來等行為，旨在提高修行者的德行和智慧。
sentences.en: The Ten Vows of Samantabhadra in the Avatamsaka Sutra include acts like offering to all Buddhas and praising Tathagatas, aiming to enhance the virtues and wisdom of practitioners.

sentences.zh: 在佛教經典中，華藏世界是由毗盧遮那佛所創建的淨土，象徵著究竟的圓滿和智慧。
sentences.en: In Buddhist scriptures, the Pure Land of Vairocana was created by Vairocana Buddha, symbolizing ultimate perfection and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 修行者常常希望能夠往生華藏世界，以脫離輪迴的痛苦，達到涅槃。
sentences.en: Practitioners often aspire to be reborn in the Pure Land of Vairocana to escape the suffering of samsara and attain nirvana.

sentences.zh: 在華藏世界，一切眾生都能夠無憂無慮地學習佛法，獲得真正的心靈安寧。
sentences.en: In the Pure Land of Vairocana, all beings can study the Dharma without worry, achieving true peace of mind.

sentences.zh: 許多佛教徒每日誦念經文，祈求來生能夠進入華藏世界，以便獲得毗盧遮那佛的教導。
sentences.en: Many Buddhists recite scriptures daily, praying to enter the Pure Land of Vairocana in their next life to receive the teachings of Vairocana Buddha.

sentences.zh: 華藏玄門是佛教經典中的重要概念，象徵著智慧與慈悲的玄奧。
sentences.en: The Padmagarbha Gate is an important concept in Buddhist scriptures, symbolizing the profundity of wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 進入華藏玄門需要通過層層修行，領會佛法的真諦。
sentences.en: Entering the Padmagarbha Gate requires undergoing multiple stages of practice and understanding the true essence of Buddhist teachings.

sentences.zh: 在華藏玄門中，一切法界皆相通，無有障礙。
sentences.en: Within the Padmagarbha Gate, all realms of existence are interconnected and without obstruction.

sentences.zh: 華藏玄門的奧義讓修行者能夠體悟宇宙萬物的真相。
sentences.en: The mysteries of the Padmagarbha Gate allow practitioners to perceive the true nature of the universe and all phenomena.

sentences.zh: 華藏玄門是一種深奧的佛教修行方法，強調內心的純淨和智慧的開啟。
sentences.en: The Profound Approach of Lotus Store is a profound Buddhist practice that emphasizes inner purity and the awakening of wisdom.

sentences.zh: 他透過華藏玄門的學習，逐漸體會到佛法的真諦和宇宙的深奧。
sentences.en: Through studying the Profound Approach of Lotus Store, he gradually comprehended the true essence of Buddhist teachings and the profundity of the universe.

sentences.zh: 老師經常提到華藏玄門的的重要性，提醒我們要隨時保持正念和慈悲心。
sentences.en: The teacher often emphasizes the importance of the Profound Approach of Lotus Store, reminding us to always maintain mindfulness and compassion.

sentences.zh: 在華藏玄門的修行中，信徒們學會如何超越自我，達到更高的精神境界。
sentences.en: In the practice of the Profound Approach of Lotus Store, practitioners learn how to transcend the self and reach higher states of spiritual awareness.

sentences.zh: 這座古老的菴堂有著幾百年的歷史，吸引了無數遊客前來參觀。
sentences.en: This ancient nunnery has a history of several centuries and attracts numerous visitors.

sentences.zh: 在菴堂中，僧尼們每天冥想和念誦經文，保持內心的清靜。
sentences.en: In the nunnery, nuns meditate and recite scriptures daily, maintaining inner peace.

sentences.zh: 這個菴堂不僅是修行的場所，也是當地社區的文化中心。
sentences.en: The nunnery is not only a place for spiritual practice but also a cultural center for the local community.

sentences.zh: 她決定進入菴堂，追隨內心的召喚，過上簡樸的生活。
sentences.en: She decided to enter the nunnery, following the calling of her heart to live a simple life.

sentences.zh: 菴摩羅果實在佛教中常被當作供佛的供品。
sentences.en: The amra fruit is often offered as an offering to the Buddha in Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 菴摩羅樹在一些佛教聖地被視為神聖的象徵。
sentences.en: The amra tree is regarded as a sacred symbol at some Buddhist holy sites.

sentences.zh: 菴摩羅的味道甜美，營養豐富，常用於健康食品。
sentences.en: The amra fruit is deliciously sweet and rich in nutrients, often used in health foods.

sentences.zh: 在佛經中，菴摩羅被列為能解毒的草藥之一。
sentences.en: In Buddhist scriptures, the amra is listed as one of the herbs that can detoxify.

sentences.zh: 在新年的祝福卡上，大家都寫下了『萬事如意』，希望對方來年一切順利。
sentences.en: On the New Year greeting cards, everyone wrote 'All Wishes Fulfilled,' wishing each other a successful year ahead.

sentences.zh: 他的願望一一實現，他感覺自己是個萬事如意的人。
sentences.en: His wishes were being fulfilled one by one, making him feel like a person whose all wishes had been fulfilled.

sentences.zh: 如來佛祖賜福，願你前程似錦，萬事如意。
sentences.en: May the blessings of the Buddha bestow upon you a bright future and all wishes fulfilled.

sentences.zh: 在這個特別的日子裡，祝福所有人財源滾滾，萬事如意。
sentences.en: On this special day, may everyone be blessed with prosperity and all wishes fulfilled.

phrase.zh: 萬人歌頌偉大的佛陀音樂會

sentences.zh: 許多信徒期待著參加萬人歌頌偉大的佛陀音樂會，這將是一個深具意義的節日。
sentences.en: Many devotees are looking forward to attending the Praise the Buddha Grand Concert, which promises to be a deeply meaningful event.

sentences.zh: 萬人歌頌偉大的佛陀音樂會每年都吸引數千人參加，是一個向佛陀致敬的盛會。
sentences.en: The Praise the Buddha Grand Concert attracts thousands of attendees each year and serves as a grand tribute to the Buddha.

sentences.zh: 在萬人歌頌偉大的佛陀音樂會上，大家一起唱誦佛教經典，氛圍莊嚴而神聖。
sentences.en: At the Praise the Buddha Grand Concert, everyone chants Buddhist scriptures together, creating a solemn and sacred atmosphere.

sentences.zh: 慈善機構在萬人歌頌偉大的佛陀音樂會上也會設立展位，吸引信徒捐款以支持慈善事業。
sentences.en: Charity organizations also set up booths at the Praise the Buddha Grand Concert to attract donations from devotees in support of charitable causes.

sentences.zh: 在佛教大典上，信眾們聚集在萬人照相台前，拍下一張集體照片。
sentences.en: During the grand Buddhist ceremony, devotees gathered in front of the Grand Photo Terrace to take a group photo.

sentences.zh: 萬人照相台是寺廟裡的一個著名景點，許多遊客都會在這裡留影。
sentences.en: The Grand Photo Terrace is a renowned spot in the temple, where many tourists take memorable photos.

sentences.zh: 每年庙会期间，萬人照相台是一個必到之處，吸引成千上萬的參觀者。
sentences.en: During the annual temple fair, the Grand Photo Terrace is a must-visit site, attracting thousands of visitors.

sentences.zh: 從萬人照相台可以俯瞰整個寺廟的風景，這裡的風光壯麗，令人流連忘返。
sentences.en: From the Grand Photo Terrace, one can overlook the entire temple landscape, with its majestic scenery leaving a lasting impression on visitors.

phrase.zh: 萬人皈依典禮及萬人獻燈祈福弘法大會
phrase.en: Grand Triple Gem Refuge Taking and Light Offering Dharma Service

sentences.zh: 這次的萬人皈依典禮及萬人獻燈祈福弘法大會吸引了來自世界各地的信徒。
sentences.en: The Grand Triple Gem Refuge Taking and Light Offering Dharma Service attracted followers from around the world.

sentences.zh: 法師在萬人皈依典禮及萬人獻燈祈福弘法大會上講解了四聖諦的深刻含義。
sentences.en: During the Grand Triple Gem Refuge Taking and Light Offering Dharma Service, the master explained the profound meanings of the Four Noble Truths.

sentences.zh: 每年的萬人皈依典禮及萬人獻燈祈福弘法大會都是佛教界的一大盛事。
sentences.en: Every year, the Grand Triple Gem Refuge Taking and Light Offering Dharma Service is a major event in the Buddhist community.

sentences.zh: 參加萬人皈依典禮及萬人獻燈祈福弘法大會讓我感受到無比的平靜和祝福。
sentences.en: Participating in the Grand Triple Gem Refuge Taking and Light Offering Dharma Service brought me immense peace and blessings.

phrase.zh: 萬佛在家五戒菩薩戒會
phrase.en: Ten-Thousand-Buddhas Five Precepts and Bodhisattva Precepts Ceremony

sentences.zh: 萬佛在家五戒菩薩戒會是一個莊嚴的儀式，吸引了成千上萬的信徒參加。
sentences.en: The Ten-Thousand-Buddhas Five Precepts and Bodhisattva Precepts Ceremony is a solemn ritual that attracts thousands of devotees.

sentences.zh: 在萬佛在家五戒菩薩戒會上，參加者要發誓遵守佛教的基本教義。
sentences.en: During the Ten-Thousand-Buddhas Five Precepts and Bodhisattva Precepts Ceremony, participants vow to uphold the fundamental teachings of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 每年的萬佛在家五戒菩薩戒會都是一個重要的佛教活動，信徒們虔誠參與。
sentences.en: The annual Ten-Thousand-Buddhas Five Precepts and Bodhisattva Precepts Ceremony is a significant Buddhist event where devotees participate with devotion.

sentences.zh: 在萬佛在家五戒菩薩戒會上，僧眾會引導信徒進行冥想和祈禱。
sentences.en: At the Ten-Thousand-Buddhas Five Precepts and Bodhisattva Precepts Ceremony, the monks guide the followers in meditation and prayers.

sentences.zh: 萬佛殿象徵著佛教節慶的重要地點，許多信眾都會來此禮拜。
sentences.en: The Ten-Thousand-Buddhas Shrine is an important site for Buddhist festivals, where many devotees come to pay their respects.

sentences.zh: 在萬佛殿內，你可以看到各種風格的佛像，數量達到上萬尊。
sentences.en: Inside the Ten-Thousand-Buddhas Shrine, you can see various styles of Buddha statues, numbering in the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 萬佛殿的壁畫細膩生動，描述了佛陀的種種事蹟。
sentences.en: The murals in the Ten-Thousand-Buddhas Shrine are intricately detailed, depicting the various deeds of the Buddha.

sentences.zh: 每年春季，萬佛殿會舉行盛大的祈福法會，吸引來自各地的信徒。
sentences.en: Every spring, the Ten-Thousand-Buddhas Shrine hosts a grand blessing ceremony, attracting devotees from all regions.

sentences.zh: 萬壽園是一個以佛教文化和養生理念為主題的公園。
sentences.en: Longevity Park is a park themed around Buddhist culture and the concept of health preservation.

sentences.zh: 每年數千名遊客前來萬壽園，參加各種靜修和冥想活動。
sentences.en: Thousands of visitors come to Longevity Park every year to participate in various retreats and meditation activities.

sentences.zh: 萬壽園內的蓮花池是靜心冥想的理想場所。
sentences.en: The lotus pond in Longevity Park is an ideal place for peaceful meditation.

sentences.zh: 在萬壽園中散步，可以感受到一種寧靜和安詳。
sentences.en: Walking in Longevity Park, one can feel a sense of tranquility and serenity.

sentences.zh: 今天我們參加了在萬壽堂舉行的祈福儀式。
sentences.en: Today we attended the blessing ceremony held at the Longevity Hall.

sentences.zh: 萬壽堂以其宏偉的建築和歲月的沉澱而聞名。
sentences.en: The Longevity Hall is renowned for its grand architecture and timeless legacy.

sentences.zh: 在萬壽堂內禱告，可以讓人感受到無限的寧靜。
sentences.en: Praying within the Longevity Hall brings an immense sense of tranquility.

sentences.zh: 許多信徒前來萬壽堂祈求長壽與平安。
sentences.en: Many devotees visit the Longevity Hall to pray for longevity and peace.

sentences.zh: 《萬壽日記》是一本佛教修行者記錄每日修行心得的書。
sentences.en: 'The Wan Shou Diary' is a book in which Buddhist practitioners record their daily practice insights.

sentences.zh: 她在《萬壽日記》中詳細書寫了自己修行的經歷和感悟。
sentences.en: She meticulously wrote about her practice experiences and insights in 'The Wan Shou Diary'.

sentences.zh: 每晚，他都會在《萬壽日記》裡記下當天的冥想體驗。
sentences.en: Every night, he would record his meditation experiences of the day in 'The Wan Shou Diary'.

sentences.zh: 《萬壽日記》成為了他修行路上的重要指引。
sentences.en: 'The Wan Shou Diary' became an important guide on his path of practice.

sentences.zh: 在這個和諧的社區裡，人們信奉萬家生佛的理念，互助互愛，共同生活。
sentences.en: In this harmonious community, people embrace the idea that Buddha is in all families, helping and loving one another.

sentences.zh: 老師告訴我們，每個家庭都應該努力實現萬家生佛的境界，培養慈悲和智慧。
sentences.en: The teacher told us that every family should strive to realize the state where Buddha is in all families by cultivating compassion and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 這部電影的主題是萬家生佛，傳達了愛與和平的重要信息。
sentences.en: The theme of this movie is 'Buddha Is in All Families,' conveying an important message of love and peace.

sentences.zh: 她相信萬家生佛的精神，並努力在自己的家中實踐這一理念，帶來和睦與幸福。
sentences.en: She believes in the spirit of 'Buddha Is in All Families' and strives to practice this idea in her own home, bringing harmony and happiness.

sentences.zh: 佛陀是一位萬德具足的偉大人物，為世人帶來無盡的智慧和慈悲。
sentences.en: The Buddha is a great figure with boundless virtues, bringing endless wisdom and compassion to the world.

sentences.zh: 她信仰佛教多年，經常思量萬德具足的境界。
sentences.en: She has been a follower of Buddhism for many years, often contemplating the state of boundless virtues.

sentences.zh: 經典中描述了無數菩薩萬德具足，指引眾生走向覺悟之路。
sentences.en: The scriptures describe countless Bodhisattvas with boundless virtues, guiding beings on the path to enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 修行佛法的人，追求的是內心萬德具足的完美境界。
sentences.en: Practitioners of Buddhism seek the perfect state of boundless virtues within their hearts.

sentences.zh: 佛陀的形象充滿萬德莊嚴，讓人敬仰不已。
sentences.en: The image of the Buddha is filled with boundless virtues and solemnity, inspiring deep reverence.

sentences.zh: 這座寺廟在建設時，特別強調了萬德莊嚴的設計理念。
sentences.en: The construction of this temple particularly emphasized the design concept of boundless virtues and solemnity.

sentences.zh: 他修行多年，終達到萬德莊嚴的境界，成為世人的榜樣。
sentences.en: After years of practice, he finally reached the state of boundless virtues and solemnity, becoming a model for people.

sentences.zh: 參加這次法會的信眾們，都深感其中的萬德莊嚴。
sentences.en: The devotees attending this Dharma assembly deeply felt the boundless virtues and solemnity within it.

phrase.zh: 萬惡淫為首，百善孝為先
phrase.en: sexual misconducts are the worst of all unwholesome deeds; filial piety is the foremost among all wholesome deeds

sentences.zh: 在佛教教義中，萬惡淫為首，百善孝為先，意在強調對行為的約束和對父母的尊敬。
sentences.en: In Buddhist teachings, sexual misconducts are the worst of all unwholesome deeds; filial piety is the foremost among all wholesome deeds, emphasizing restraint in behavior and respect for one's parents.

sentences.zh: 老師教導學生們，萬惡淫為首，百善孝為先，這是做人最基本的道德標準。
sentences.en: The teacher instructed the students that sexual misconducts are the worst of all unwholesome deeds; filial piety is the foremost among all wholesome deeds, serving as the fundamental moral standards in life.

sentences.zh: 在家庭教育中，父母常常提醒子女，萬惡淫為首，百善孝為先，以引導他們走上正確的人生道路。
sentences.en: In family education, parents often remind their children that sexual misconducts are the worst of all unwholesome deeds; filial piety is the foremost among all wholesome deeds, guiding them toward the right path in life.

sentences.zh: 古代文學作品中常見到的格言，萬惡淫為首，百善孝為先，反映了當時社會對道德和美德的重視。
sentences.en: The maxim often found in ancient literary works, sexual misconducts are the worst of all unwholesome deeds; filial piety is the foremost among all wholesome deeds, reflects the society's emphasis on morality and virtue at that time.

phrase.zh: 萬松生千谷 一榻坐百峰
phrase.en: In all valleys can innumerous pines grow; On all peaks one cushion allows meditation.

sentences.zh: 萬松生千谷，一榻坐百峰，體現了修行者對大自然無邊無際的景仰與敬畏。
sentences.en: In all valleys can innumerous pines grow; On all peaks one cushion allows meditation, illustrating the practitioner's boundless reverence and awe for nature.

sentences.zh: 無論是萬松生於千谷，還是一榻坐於百峰，都象徵著禪修不分時間和地點，只需一顆靜心。
sentences.en: Be it innumerous pines growing in all valleys or one cushion allowing meditation on all peaks, it symbolizes that meditation knows no bounds of time and place, as long as the heart is calm.

sentences.zh: 禪修者在萬松生千谷中尋找內心的寧靜，在一榻坐百峰中體驗天地的和諧。
sentences.en: The meditator finds inner peace amidst the innumerous pines growing in all valleys and experiences the harmony of heaven and earth on all peaks with one cushion.

sentences.zh: 這句話教導我們，在自然的懷抱中，無論是萬松還是一榻，都能獲得靈性的啟發。
sentences.en: This phrase teaches us that within the embrace of nature, whether it's innumerous pines or one meditation cushion, spiritual insight can be attained.

sentences.zh: 祝您萬福金安，閤家幸福。
sentences.en: Wishing you boundless fortune and precious peace, and happiness for your entire family.

sentences.zh: 佛經中多次提到，修行能夠讓人獲得萬福金安。
sentences.en: The Buddhist scriptures often mention that practicing diligently can bring boundless fortune and precious peace.

sentences.zh: 在新年到來之際，我們希望每個人都能夠享有萬福金安。
sentences.en: As the Lunar New Year approaches, we hope everyone can enjoy boundless fortune and precious peace.

sentences.zh: 她在禪修中尋求內心的萬福金安。
sentences.en: She seeks boundless fortune and precious peace through her meditation practice.

phrase.zh: 萬籟無聲心自息 一身非我物同春
phrase.en: Peaceful minds: silence reigns supreme; Springful joy: A body lacking in self.

sentences.zh: 萬籟無聲心自息，夜晚的山谷一片寧靜。
sentences.en: Peaceful minds: silence reigns supreme; the nighttime valley is enveloped in tranquility.

sentences.zh: 一身非我物同春，感受到了大自然的無私。
sentences.en: Springful joy: A body lacking in self; felt the selfless nature of the world.

sentences.zh: 在森林中靜坐，萬籟無聲心自息，所有雜念都被洗滌。
sentences.en: Meditating in the forest, peaceful minds: silence reigns supreme; all distractions are cleansed away.

sentences.zh: 雖然旅途漫漫，但他一身非我物同春，心境平靜如湖水。
sentences.en: Though the journey is long, springful joy: a body lacking in self; his mind remains calm like a serene lake.

phrase.zh: 萬紫千紅春永在 一年四季花常開
phrase.en: A kaleidoscope of colors: lingering spring; Across all four seasons: bushels of blossoms.

sentences.zh: 庭院中萬紫千紅春永在，一年四季花常開，美景如畫。
sentences.en: In the courtyard, a kaleidoscope of colors: lingering spring; across all four seasons: bushels of blossoms, creating a picturesque scene.

sentences.zh: 這片土地一年四季花常開，彷彿萬紫千紅春永在。
sentences.en: This land, with its bushels of blossoms across all four seasons, seems to embody a lingering spring with a kaleidoscope of colors.

sentences.zh: 公園裡萬紫千紅春永在，一年四季花常開，遊客絡繹不絕。
sentences.en: In the park, a kaleidoscope of colors: lingering spring; across all four seasons: bushels of blossoms, continuously attracting visitors.

sentences.zh: 她自家花園裡萬紫千紅春永在，一年四季花常開，令人流連忘返。
sentences.en: In her home garden, a kaleidoscope of colors: lingering spring; across all four seasons: bushels of blossoms, making it hard for visitors to leave.

phrase.zh: 萬紫千紅春猶在 一年四季花常開
phrase.en: A kaleidoscope of colors: lingering spring; Across all four seasons: bushels of blossoms.

sentences.zh: 萬紫千紅春猶在，一年四季花常開，象徵著生命的不息和無盡的美麗。
sentences.en: A kaleidoscope of colors: lingering spring; Across all four seasons: bushels of blossoms symbolizes the endless beauty and perpetuity of life.

sentences.zh: 無論寒冬還是炎夏，萬紫千紅春猶在，一年四季花常開。
sentences.en: Be it in the chilling winter or the scorching summer, a kaleidoscope of colors: lingering spring; Across all four seasons: bushels of blossoms.

sentences.zh: 這座花園以萬紫千紅春猶在，一年四季花常開而聞名，每天都有遊客慕名而來。
sentences.en: This garden is famous for a kaleidoscope of colors: lingering spring; Across all four seasons: bushels of blossoms, attracting visitors every day.

sentences.zh: 畫家的作品展示了萬紫千紅春猶在，一年四季花常開的景象，引人入勝。
sentences.en: The painter's work vividly depicts a kaleidoscope of colors: lingering spring; Across all four seasons: bushels of blossoms, captivating all who see it.

sentences.zh: 在萬里晴空下，修行者感受到內心的平靜和自在。
sentences.en: Under the vast clear sky, the practitioner felt a sense of inner peace and freedom.

sentences.zh: 如同萬里晴空，這首禪詩表達了一種清明無染的境界。
sentences.en: Like a vast clear sky, this Zen poem expresses a state of unblemished clarity.

sentences.zh: 萬里晴空的景色使旅人仿佛忘卻了所有煩惱。
sentences.en: The scenery of the vast clear sky made the traveler feel as if all worries had been forgotten.

sentences.zh: 在那萬里晴空下，孩子們的歡笑聲迴盪在空氣中。
sentences.en: Under the vast clear sky, the sound of children's laughter echoed in the air.

phrase.zh: 萬里晴空開眼界 一泓淨水洗心源
phrase.en: Beneath the boundless sky, an open mind; Within a scoop of clear water, a pure mind.

sentences.zh: 萬里晴空開眼界，正如廣闊的知識能擴展我們的視野。
sentences.en: Beneath the boundless sky, an open mind; just as extensive knowledge can broaden our horizons.

sentences.zh: 一泓淨水洗心源，代表著內心的純潔和寧靜。
sentences.en: Within a scoop of clear water, a pure mind; symbolizes inner purity and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 在萬里晴空下，我們可以俯視大地，體會宇宙的浩瀚。
sentences.en: Beneath the boundless sky, we can look down upon the earth, experiencing the vastness of the universe.

sentences.zh: 心如一泓淨水，能夠反映出最真實的自己。
sentences.en: A mind like a scoop of clear water can reflect the truest self.

phrase.zh: 萬里江山觀人我 四季日月悟自心
phrase.en: Honor personal relations across the whole world; Discover one's mind beneath the sun and moon.

sentences.zh: 他總是堅信萬里江山觀人我，安於每一段人際關係。
sentences.en: He always believes in honoring personal relations across the whole world, being content with each interpersonal connection.

sentences.zh: 四季日月悟自心，讓他在大自然的變遷中找到了內心的平靜。
sentences.en: Discovering one's mind beneath the sun and moon allowed him to find inner peace amid the changes of nature.

sentences.zh: 在異國他鄉工作，他依然不忘萬里江山觀人我，珍視身邊每一個夥伴。
sentences.en: Even while working in foreign lands, he did not forget to honor personal relations across the whole world, valuing each companion around him.

sentences.zh: 她常在四季的變化中冥想，四季日月悟自心，從而達到精神上的滿足。
sentences.en: She often meditates with the changing seasons, discovering her mind beneath the sun and moon, achieving spiritual fulfillment.

phrase.zh: 落花有意隨流水 流水無情戀落花
phrase.en: Falling flowers willingly meld with the river's flow; Yet the river's flow never intends to cradle the flowers.

sentences.zh: 這句話『落花有意隨流水，流水無情戀落花』描述了世間緣分的無常與淡然。
sentences.en: The phrase 'Falling flowers willingly meld with the river's flow; Yet the river's flow never intends to cradle the flowers' describes the impermanence and indifference of worldly relationships.

sentences.zh: 許多古詩中描繪了『落花有意隨流水，流水無情戀落花』的景象，表達出無奈和遺憾的情感。
sentences.en: Many classical poems depict the scene of 'Falling flowers willingly meld with the river's flow; Yet the river's flow never intends to cradle the flowers,' expressing sentiments of helplessness and regret.

sentences.zh: 在禪修過程中，從『落花有意隨流水，流水無情戀落花』這些字裡行間，我們可以體會到心靈的無常與無執。
sentences.en: During meditation, through the phrases 'Falling flowers willingly meld with the river's flow; Yet the river's flow never intends to cradle the flowers,' we can perceive the impermanence and non-attachment of the mind.

sentences.zh: 『落花有意隨流水，流水無情戀落花』常用來比喻一方深情而另一方冷漠的感情狀態。
sentences.en: 'Falling flowers willingly meld with the river's flow; Yet the river's flow never intends to cradle the flowers' is often used to metaphorically describe a situation where one party is affectionate while the other is indifferent.

phrase.en: falling leaves return to their roots

sentences.zh: 他旅居海外多年，最終還是選擇回到故鄉，真是應了那句'葉落歸根'。
sentences.en: He lived abroad for many years but eventually chose to return to his hometown, truly embodying the saying 'falling leaves return to their roots'.

sentences.zh: 儘管她在都市裡事業有成，退休後還是希望能回到鄉間，享受'葉落歸根'的寧靜生活。
sentences.en: Although she had a successful career in the city, she wished to retire to the countryside to enjoy the tranquil life of 'falling leaves return to their roots'.

sentences.zh: 《紅樓夢》中的賈寶玉最終選擇出家，這也是一種'葉落歸根'的表現。
sentences.en: In 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Jia Baoyu eventually chose to become a monk, which is also a form of 'falling leaves return to their roots'.

sentences.zh: 許多移民在晚年選擇返回故土，這體現了'葉落歸根'的心態。
sentences.en: Many immigrants choose to return to their homeland in their old age, reflecting the mindset of 'falling leaves return to their roots'.

phrase.zh: 葉落知秋觀有相 花開見佛悟無生
phrase.en: As falling leaves hint the arrival of autumn, form is observed; When a buddha emerges from a blooming flower, no-birth is realized.

sentences.zh: 如同葉落知秋觀有相的道理，我們從生活中的變化中可以看到諸法的無常。
sentences.en: Just like how falling leaves hint the arrival of autumn, we can observe the impermanence of all phenomena through changes in life.

sentences.zh: 當一朵花開放見佛悟無生，我們可以從美麗的自然景象中體悟佛陀教義的深奧。
sentences.en: When a buddha emerges from a blooming flower, we can realize the profound teachings of the Buddha through the beauty of nature.

sentences.zh: 觀察葉落知秋，我們能理解世間一切皆無常，這是智慧的開端。
sentences.en: By observing the falling leaves signaling autumn's arrival, we come to understand the impermanence of all things, which is the beginning of wisdom.

sentences.zh: 在花開見佛的景象中，我們可以領悟無生的真理，這是一種深層的覺醒。
sentences.en: In the scene where a buddha emerges from a blooming flower, we can comprehend the truth of no-birth, which is a form of deep awakening.

sentences.zh: 他被選為公司的董事，負責監督公司的戰略方向。
sentences.en: He was elected as a board member of the company, responsible for overseeing its strategic direction.

sentences.zh: 董事會的每一位成員都在決策過程中扮演著重要的角色。
sentences.en: Every board member plays a crucial role in the decision-making process.

sentences.zh: 作為董事，她需要出席每月的會議並提出建設性的建議。
sentences.en: As a board member, she needs to attend monthly meetings and provide constructive suggestions.

sentences.zh: 這位新任董事有多年在金融領域的經驗，將對公司非常有幫助。
sentences.en: The newly appointed board member has years of experience in the financial sector, which will greatly benefit the company.

sentences.zh: 禪修時，僧人們通常會坐在蒲團上，以保持身體的穩定和平衡。
sentences.en: During meditation, monks typically sit on a cushion to maintain bodily stability and balance.

sentences.zh: 這個蒲團用優質的材質製作，非常適合長時間的靜坐。
sentences.en: This cushion is made of high-quality materials, making it ideal for prolonged sitting.

sentences.zh: 他在蒲團上打坐，很快就進入了深沉的禪定狀態。
sentences.en: He meditated on the cushion and quickly entered a deep state of meditation.

sentences.zh: 在這座寺廟裡，每個人都有自己的蒲團，用來禪修和祈禱。
sentences.en: In this temple, everyone has their own cushion for meditation and prayer.

phrase.en: Steaming sand to make cooked rice

sentences.zh: 試圖蒸沙作飯，就像期望從錯誤的方法中獲得正確的結果一樣，是徒勞無益的。
sentences.en: Trying to steam sand to make cooked rice is as futile as expecting the right result from a wrong method.

sentences.zh: 學佛要明白執迷不悟，猶如蒸沙作飯，結果只會是失望。
sentences.en: In learning Buddhism, one must realize that stubbornness is like steaming sand to make cooked rice; it will only lead to disappointment.

sentences.zh: 他不停重複同樣的錯誤，就像蒸沙作飯，永遠不會成功。
sentences.en: He keeps repeating the same mistakes, like steaming sand to make cooked rice, and will never succeed.

sentences.zh: 這個計劃若沒有合理的基礎，恐怕只是蒸沙作飯，終將無果。
sentences.en: Without a reasonable foundation, this plan is likely just steaming sand to make cooked rice and will ultimately yield no results.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒常以蓮花象徵純潔和智慧。
sentences.en: Buddhists often use the lotus flower to symbolize purity and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 蓮花在淤泥中生長，但卻保持潔白無瑕。
sentences.en: The lotus grows in muddy waters, yet remains perfectly clean and unstained.

sentences.zh: 許多佛像的基座以蓮花為裝飾，象徵佛陀的聖潔。
sentences.en: Many Buddha statues have bases adorned with lotus flowers, symbolizing the purity of the Buddha.

sentences.zh: 蓮花的綻放被視為心靈開悟的象徵。
sentences.en: The blooming of a lotus is viewed as a symbol of spiritual awakening.

sentences.zh: 觀世音菩薩通常坐在蓮台上，象徵著純潔和慈悲。
sentences.en: Guanyin Bodhisattva is usually seated on a Lotus Throne, symbolizing purity and compassion.

sentences.zh: 經典中描述佛陀在蓮台上說法，讓弟子們聽得如醉如痴。
sentences.en: In the scriptures, Buddha is described as giving teachings while seated on a Lotus Throne, mesmerizing his disciples.

sentences.zh: 蓮台是佛教藝術中的重要元素，經常出現在繪畫和雕塑中。
sentences.en: The Lotus Throne is an important element in Buddhist art, frequently appearing in paintings and sculptures.

sentences.zh: 寺廟裡的佛像通常會被安置在金色的蓮台上，顯得莊嚴而神聖。
sentences.en: Statues of the Buddha in temples are often placed on golden Lotus Thrones, appearing solemn and sacred.

sentences.zh: 在蓮池海會上，佛陀為眾生講述了許多重要的教義。
sentences.en: At the Great Lotus Pond Assembly, the Buddha imparted many important teachings to the beings.

sentences.zh: 信眾們聚集在蓮池海會，共同祈願世界和平。
sentences.en: The devotees gathered at the Great Lotus Pond Assembly to collectively pray for world peace.

sentences.zh: 這次的蓮池海會吸引了來自世界各地的佛教徒。
sentences.en: The Great Lotus Pond Assembly attracted Buddhists from all around the world.

sentences.zh: 蓮池海會的氛圍充滿了祥和和慈愛，讓人感到心靈被淨化。
sentences.en: The atmosphere of the Great Lotus Pond Assembly was filled with peace and compassion, making one feel spiritually purified.

sentences.zh: 他在冥想中尋得心靈的平靜，彷彿身處蓮界香林。
sentences.en: He found peace of mind in meditation, as if he were in the Lotus Realm, Scented Forest.

sentences.zh: 蓮界香林象徵著純淨的心靈和超越世俗的智慧。
sentences.en: The Lotus Realm, Scented Forest symbolizes a pure mind and wisdom beyond the mundane.

sentences.zh: 那些在蓮界香林中修行的人，常能感受到佛陀的慈悲和智慧。
sentences.en: Those who practice in the Lotus Realm, Scented Forest often feel the compassion and wisdom of the Buddha.

sentences.zh: 這幅畫描繪了一個祥和的蓮界香林，讓人感受到無限的寧靜和喜悅。
sentences.en: This painting depicts a serene Lotus Realm, Scented Forest, bringing a sense of infinite peace and joy.

sentences.zh: 蓮社是一個以修行淨土法門為中心的佛教團體。
sentences.en: The Lotus Society is a Buddhist group centered on the practice of the Pure Land teachings.

sentences.zh: 在蓮社，每個月都舉辦一次大型的法會，吸引了來自各地的信眾。
sentences.en: In the Lotus Society, a large Dharma assembly is held every month, attracting followers from various regions.

sentences.zh: 蓮社的成員們每日共修，互相勉勵，追求心靈的清淨。
sentences.en: Members of the Lotus Society practice together daily, encouraging each other in their pursuit of spiritual purity.

sentences.zh: 在蓮社的帶領下，許多人成為了虔誠的佛教徒，並發願往生西方極樂世界。
sentences.en: Under the guidance of the Lotus Society, many have become devout Buddhists and vowed to be reborn in the Western Pure Land.

sentences.zh: 蓮花在佛教中象徵著純淨和重生。
sentences.en: The lotus symbolizes purity and rebirth in Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 在靜謐的湖面上，盛開的蓮花宛如大自然的寶物。
sentences.en: On the tranquil lake surface, blooming lotuses resemble treasures of nature.

sentences.zh: 許多佛教徒佩戴蓮花飾品以表達他們的信仰。
sentences.en: Many Buddhists wear lotus jewelry to express their faith.

sentences.zh: 蓮花能從泥濘中綻放，象徵著能從苦難中找到解脫。
sentences.en: The lotus can bloom out of the mud, symbolizing finding liberation from suffering.

sentences.zh: 在佛教儀式中，僧侶們經常使用蓮花手印來象徵純潔和神聖。
sentences.en: In Buddhist rituals, monks often use the Lotus Mudra to symbolize purity and holiness.

sentences.zh: 瑜伽課程中，老師指導我們如何正確地做出蓮花手印，以促進心靈的平靜。
sentences.en: During the yoga class, the instructor guided us on how to properly perform the Lotus Mudra to promote mental tranquility.

sentences.zh: 蓮花手印是一種手勢，象徵心靈的開放和無垢。
sentences.en: The Lotus Mudra is a gesture that symbolizes the openness and untainted nature of the mind.

sentences.zh: 當她在冥想時，她的手自然地形成了蓮花手印，帶來了一種深深的平和感。
sentences.en: While she meditated, her hands naturally formed the Lotus Mudra, bringing a deep sense of peace.

sentences.zh: 每到夏天，蓮花池中總是開滿了美麗的蓮花，吸引了無數遊客前來欣賞。
sentences.en: Every summer, the lotus pond is filled with beautiful lotus flowers, attracting numerous tourists to admire them.

sentences.zh: 佛寺旁的蓮花池被視為一處靜心的聖地，讓人感受到無比的平和與安寧。
sentences.en: The lotus pond beside the temple is regarded as a sanctuary for meditation, providing a sense of peace and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 古詩中常常描寫蓮花池，如蘇東坡的《荷塘月色》流傳至今，廣為人知。
sentences.en: Ancient poems often describe the lotus pond, such as Su Dongpo's 'Lotus Pond Moonlight', which has been widely known and passed down through the ages.

sentences.zh: 每年春天，學生們常來蓮花池畔進行寫生活動，捕捉自然的美麗。
sentences.en: Every spring, students often come to the lotus pond for sketching activities, capturing the beauty of nature.

sentences.zh: 蓮華象徵著清淨和涅槃，是佛教的重要符號。
sentences.en: The lotus flower symbolizes purity and nirvana and is an important symbol in Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 如同蓮華從泥潭中成長，我們也應該在困境中保持清淨。
sentences.en: Just like the lotus flower grows from the mud, we should maintain purity amid adversity.

sentences.zh: 蓮華的美麗在於它不為污泥的影響，而始終盛開。
sentences.en: The beauty of the lotus flower lies in its ability to bloom, unaffected by the mud around it.

sentences.zh: 佛陀常常在教法中以蓮華為譬喻，教導弟子們超越世俗的困擾。
sentences.en: The Buddha often used the lotus flower as a metaphor in his teachings, instructing disciples to rise above worldly troubles.

sentences.zh: 在古代，薪火是家庭日常生活中不可或缺的一部分。
sentences.en: In ancient times, firewood was an indispensable part of daily family life.

sentences.zh: 冬天來臨時，人們會提前儲備足夠的薪火以御寒。
sentences.en: As winter approached, people would stockpile enough firewood to keep warm.

sentences.zh: 村民們一起砍伐森林中的樹木以製作薪火。
sentences.en: The villagers would collectively chop down trees from the forest to make firewood.

sentences.zh: 在偏遠地區，燃燒薪火仍然是主要的取暖方式之一。
sentences.en: In remote areas, burning firewood is still one of the primary means of heating.

sentences.zh: 每日的薰修使他內心逐漸平靜，遠離了煩惱。
sentences.en: The permeated cultivation each day gradually brought him inner peace, distancing him from troubles.

sentences.zh: 薰修佛法讓她的心靈變得更加柔和和沉著。
sentences.en: Permeated cultivation of Buddhist teachings made her mind softer and more composed.

sentences.zh: 通過不斷地薰修，他的智慧變得更加深厚。
sentences.en: Through continuous permeated cultivation, his wisdom became deeper.

sentences.zh: 孩子們在老師的指導下進行薰修，學會了如何更好地面對生活中的挑戰。
sentences.en: The children, under the guidance of their teacher, engaged in permeated cultivation, learning how to better face life's challenges.

sentences.zh: 孩子的成長過程中，父母的言行對其思想有著巨大的薰習作用。
sentences.en: During a child's growth, the words and actions of the parents have a significant influence on their thoughts.

sentences.zh: 這個社區的文化風氣深受歷史傳統的薰習。
sentences.en: The cultural atmosphere of this community is deeply influenced by historical traditions.

sentences.zh: 禪修的薰習讓他變得更加寧靜和專注。
sentences.en: The influence of meditation practice has made him more calm and focused.

sentences.zh: 自幼薰習佛理，使她在人生道路上充滿了智慧和慈悲。
sentences.en: Being influenced by Buddhist teachings from a young age, she is filled with wisdom and compassion in her life's journey.

sentences.zh: 藍毗尼園是佛陀的誕生地，是佛教徒朝聖的重要聖地。
sentences.en: Lumbini Garden is the birthplace of the Buddha, and an important pilgrimage site for Buddhists.

sentences.zh: 每年有成千上萬的信徒前往藍毗尼園，以表達他們的敬意和虔誠。
sentences.en: Thousands of devotees visit Lumbini Garden each year to pay their respects and show their devotion.

sentences.zh: 在藍毗尼園，佛教徒們可以參觀眾多古蹟，包括摩耶夫人的祈安寺。
sentences.en: At Lumbini Garden, Buddhists can visit numerous historical sites, including the Maya Devi Temple.

sentences.zh: 藍毗尼園被聯合國教科文組織列為世界文化遺產，象徵著其無比的重要性。
sentences.en: Lumbini Garden is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, signifying its immense importance.

sentences.zh: 藏經樓裡收藏了數千卷珍貴的佛教經典。
sentences.en: The Sutra Repository houses thousands of precious Buddhist scriptures.

sentences.zh: 在藏經樓修行的僧人每日誦讀經文，以增進智慧。
sentences.en: The monks practicing in the Sutra Repository recite scriptures daily to enhance their wisdom.

sentences.zh: 藏經樓的建築設計巧妙，內部環境極其安靜，適合靜心修行。
sentences.en: The architectural design of the Sutra Repository is ingenious, and its serene interior environment is ideal for deep meditation.

sentences.zh: 訪客們對藏經樓的龐大藏書感到驚嘆，紛紛表示由衷敬仰。
sentences.en: Visitors are amazed by the vast collection of books in the Sutra Repository, expressing their deep respect and admiration.

sentences.zh: 在佛教信仰中，藥師佛是所有疾病的治療者。
sentences.en: In Buddhist belief, the Healing Master Buddha is the healer of all ailments.

sentences.zh: 人們會祈請藥師佛來尋求身心的健康與平安。
sentences.en: People invoke the Healing Master Buddha to seek physical and mental health and peace.

sentences.zh: 藥師佛經中提到的十二大願望，都是為了眾生的福祉。
sentences.en: The twelve great vows mentioned in the Healing Master Sutra are all for the well-being of sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 在佛教儀式中，常常會誦經並供養藥師佛以祈求庇佑。
sentences.en: In Buddhist rituals, it is common to chant sutras and make offerings to the Healing Master Buddha for protection.

phrase.zh: 藥師琉璃光如來本願經

sentences.zh: 《藥師琉璃光如來本願經》是一部廣為人知的經典，主要記述了藥師佛的十二大願。
sentences.en: The Sutra of Medicine Buddha is a widely known classic that mainly records the twelve great vows of Medicine Buddha.

sentences.zh: 僧侶們每日誦讀《藥師琉璃光如來本願經》，祈求藥師佛的保佑與治癒。
sentences.en: Monks recite The Sutra of Medicine Buddha daily, praying for the blessings and healing of Medicine Buddha.

sentences.zh: 在大病面前，信眾常常依靠《藥師琉璃光如來本願經》中藥師佛的力量來尋求安慰。
sentences.en: In the face of serious illness, devotees often rely on the power of Medicine Buddha from The Sutra of Medicine Buddha for comfort.

sentences.zh: 《藥師琉璃光如來本願經》的深奧教義對修行者具有很大的啓發意義。
sentences.en: The profound teachings of The Sutra of Medicine Buddha are highly enlightening for practitioners.

phrase.en: Sutra of the Medicine Buddha with an Introduction, Comments and Prayer

sentences.zh: 學習《藥師經與其修行法門》，可以加深我們對佛法的認識與實踐。
sentences.en: Studying the 'Sutra of the Medicine Buddha with an Introduction, Comments and Prayer' can deepen our understanding and practice of the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 導師在課堂上詳細講解了《藥師經與其修行法門》的內容。
sentences.en: The teacher explained the contents of the 'Sutra of the Medicine Buddha with an Introduction, Comments and Prayer' in detail during the class.

sentences.zh: 這本《藥師經與其修行法門》不僅包括經文，還有豐富的註釋與祈禱詞。
sentences.en: This 'Sutra of the Medicine Buddha with an Introduction, Comments and Prayer' includes not only the scripture but also rich annotations and prayers.

sentences.zh: 我們誠心誦讀《藥師經與其修行法門》，希望能得到藥師佛的庇佑。
sentences.en: We sincerely recite the 'Sutra of the Medicine Buddha with an Introduction, Comments and Prayer,' hoping to receive the protection of the Medicine Buddha.

sentences.zh: 在古代，藥石常被僧人用來治療疾病並保持身體健康。
sentences.en: In ancient times, medicine meals were often used by monks to treat illnesses and maintain health.

sentences.zh: 這些藥石是由多種草藥製成的，可以有效地調理身體。
sentences.en: These medicine meals are made from a variety of herbs and can effectively regulate the body.

sentences.zh: 他每天早上必須服用一份特別配製的藥石來治療他的腰痛。
sentences.en: He has to take a specially prepared medicine meal every morning to treat his back pain.

sentences.zh: 這道藥石湯是由老僧根據古老的配方製作的，用來安神。
sentences.en: This medicine meal soup was prepared by an elder monk according to an ancient recipe, intended to calm the mind.

sentences.zh: 在古代，中醫常常會通過藥食調理病人的身體。
sentences.en: In ancient times, traditional Chinese medicine often used medicinal meals to regulate patients' health.

sentences.zh: 這道藥食不僅美味，還對消化系統有很大的好處。
sentences.en: This medicinal meal is not only delicious but also greatly benefits the digestive system.

sentences.zh: 佛教僧侶有時會通過藥食來增強體力和抵抗力。
sentences.en: Buddhist monks sometimes use medicinal meals to boost their strength and immunity.

sentences.zh: 每天吃健康的藥食，是保持身心平衡的重要方法。
sentences.en: Eating healthy medicinal meals daily is an essential way to maintain physical and mental balance.

sentences.zh: 《蘇東坡傳》是一本詳細描述蘇軾（蘇東坡）生平的書籍，記錄他在文學和政治上的成就。
sentences.en: 'The Life of Su Dongpo' is a book that details the life of Su Shi (Su Dongpo), documenting his achievements in literature and politics.

sentences.zh: 讀者可以在《蘇東坡傳》中瞭解到這位宋代文豪的幽默和智慧。
sentences.en: Readers can learn about the humor and wisdom of this great Song Dynasty literati in 'The Life of Su Dongpo.'

sentences.zh: 不少學者認為《蘇東坡傳》是研究中國古代文化的重要資料。
sentences.en: Many scholars consider 'The Life of Su Dongpo' an important resource for studying ancient Chinese culture.

sentences.zh: 《蘇東坡傳》不僅是對蘇軾的個人傳記，更是對那個時代文人風貌的生動描寫。
sentences.en: 'The Life of Su Dongpo' is not only a personal biography of Su Shi but also a vivid depiction of the literati of that era.

phrase.en: Preface to the Orchid Pavilion Collection

sentences.zh: 王羲之的《蘭亭集序》是書法史上的經典之作。
sentences.en: Wang Xizhi's 'Preface to the Orchid Pavilion Collection' is a classic work in the history of calligraphy.

sentences.zh: 《蘭亭集序》中描述了詩人們在蘭亭集會的情景。
sentences.en: The 'Preface to the Orchid Pavilion Collection' describes the scene of poets gathering at the Orchid Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 學習《蘭亭集序》能夠讓我們體會古代書法的精髓。
sentences.en: Studying the 'Preface to the Orchid Pavilion Collection' allows us to appreciate the essence of ancient calligraphy.

sentences.zh: 《蘭亭集序》被譽為中國傳統文化的瑰寶。
sentences.en: The 'Preface to the Orchid Pavilion Collection' is hailed as a treasure of Chinese traditional culture.

sentences.zh: 這座古老的蘭若位於深山之中，常年被雲霧繚繞。
sentences.en: This ancient Aranya is located deep in the mountains, shrouded in mist all year round.

sentences.zh: 僧侶們在蘭若裡修行，尋求內心的平靜與智慧。
sentences.en: Monks practice in the Aranya, seeking inner peace and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 蘭若的環境清幽，使人感受到與世隔絕的寧靜。
sentences.en: The serene environment of the Aranya gives a sense of isolation from the world.

sentences.zh: 禪修者經常到蘭若居住，以獲得更深入的精神體驗。
sentences.en: Meditators often stay in the Aranya to gain deeper spiritual experiences.

phrase.en: tiger howls with the rise of winds

sentences.zh: 在那個靜謐的夜晚，虎嘯生風，仿佛整個森林都在回應。
sentences.en: On that tranquil night, the tiger howls with the rise of winds, as if the entire forest was responding.

sentences.zh: 他的演講如虎嘯生風，震撼了在場的每一個人。
sentences.en: His speech was like a tiger howling with the rise of winds, shaking everyone present.

sentences.zh: 面對困難，他總是有如虎嘯生風，毫不退縮。
sentences.en: In the face of difficulties, he always faces them like a tiger howling with the rise of winds, never retreating.

sentences.zh: 那位武術大師的每一招每一式都如虎嘯生風，充滿力量和氣勢。
sentences.en: Every move and stance of the martial arts master was like a tiger howling with the rise of winds, full of power and momentum.

phrase.zh: 處處做好事 時時說好話 念念存好心 歡喜做好人
phrase.en: Do good deeds always. Speak good words always. Think good thoughts always. Be a good person readily and joyfully.

sentences.zh: 處處做好事，時時說好話，念念存好心，歡喜做好人，這是修行的基本原則。
sentences.en: Do good deeds always. Speak good words always. Think good thoughts always. Be a good person readily and joyfully. These are the basic principles of practice.

sentences.zh: 不論遇到什麼挑戰，我們應該處處做好事，時時說好話，念念存好心，歡喜做好人。
sentences.en: No matter what challenges we face, we should do good deeds always. Speak good words always. Think good thoughts always. Be a good person readily and joyfully.

sentences.zh: 每日提醒自己，處處做好事，時時說好話，念念存好心，歡喜做好人，可以提升我們的心靈品質。
sentences.en: Daily reminding yourself to do good deeds always. Speak good words always. Think good thoughts always. Be a good person readily and joyfully can elevate your spiritual quality.

sentences.zh: 在這個世界上，若人人都能處處做好事，時時說好話，念念存好心，歡喜做好人，世界將會變得更加和諧。
sentences.en: In this world, if everyone can do good deeds always. Speak good words always. Think good thoughts always. Be a good person readily and joyfully, the world will become more harmonious.

phrase.zh: 處處無痕跡 聲色外威儀
phrase.en: Never showing any trace; Always with comportment.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該追求處處無痕跡，聲色外威儀，保持內心的平靜和外在的莊重。
sentences.en: A practitioner should strive to never show any trace and always maintain comportment, keeping inner peace and outer dignity.

sentences.zh: 他在面對困難時，總是處處無痕跡，聲色外威儀，讓人倍感敬佩。
sentences.en: When facing difficulties, he always never shows any trace and maintains comportment, earning deep respect from others.

sentences.zh: 禪修講究處處無痕跡，聲色外威儀，這種修養需要長時間的練習。
sentences.en: Zen meditation emphasizes never showing any trace and always maintaining comportment, a discipline which requires long-term practice.

sentences.zh: 在繁忙的都市裡，他仍能保持處處無痕跡，聲色外威儀，實在令人欽佩。
sentences.en: In the bustling city, he can still maintain never showing any trace and always have comportment, which is truly admirable.

phrase.zh: 處處風光好 日日氣象新
phrase.en: Beautiful scenery everywhere; Start anew everyday

sentences.zh: 清晨的花園真是處處風光好，讓人感到日日氣象新。
sentences.en: The morning garden truly has beautiful scenery everywhere, making one feel as if starting anew everyday.

sentences.zh: 在這座城市中，你會發現處處風光好，日日氣象新。
sentences.en: In this city, you will find beautiful scenery everywhere and start anew everyday.

sentences.zh: 這條旅遊路線上，風景迷人，就像處處風光好，日日氣象新一般。
sentences.en: The travel route is charming, just like having beautiful scenery everywhere and starting anew everyday.

sentences.zh: 生活的每一天，都應該像詩句中的那樣，處處風光好，日日氣象新。
sentences.en: Every day of life should be like the verse, with beautiful scenery everywhere and starting anew everyday.

phrase.zh: 處難處之人 任難任之事 行難行之道 忍難忍之苦
phrase.en: Befriend the unfriendly, Do the undoable, Tread the untreadable, Endure the unendurable.

sentences.zh: 當我們處難處之人，便能在困境中找到真正的友誼，這是一種不可思議的力量。
sentences.en: When we befriend the unfriendly, we can find true friendship amidst adversity, which is an incredible strength.

sentences.zh: 任難任之事需要極大的勇氣和決心，這樣才能實現看似不可能的目標。
sentences.en: Doing the undoable requires immense courage and determination, enabling us to achieve seemingly impossible goals.

sentences.zh: 在追求心中的理想時，行難行之道是一種精神上的考驗，但也讓我們更加堅定。
sentences.en: Treading the untreadable path in pursuit of our ideals is a spiritual test, but it also strengthens our resolve.

sentences.zh: 忍難忍之苦會讓我們變得更加堅韌，亦能深刻體會生命的真諦。
sentences.en: Enduring the unendurable suffering makes us more resilient and allows us to deeply appreciate the essence of life.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，修行者體悟到所有現象皆是虛無。
sentences.en: In Zen meditation, practitioners realize that all phenomena are nothingness.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們看到世俗的追求其實是虛無的。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us to see that worldly pursuits are actually unreal.

sentences.zh: 行者經常反思人生的虛無，以追求更高層次的智慧。
sentences.en: Practitioners often reflect on the nothingness of life to seek a higher level of wisdom.

sentences.zh: 他深思著宇宙的本質，試圖理解一切存在的不真實。
sentences.en: He pondered the nature of the universe, trying to comprehend the unreality of all existence.

sentences.zh: 佛教中，虛空常被用來描述超越物質形態的究極實相。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, the void is often used to describe the ultimate reality beyond material forms.

sentences.zh: 他的心靈如同虛空，沒有絲毫的牽掛和煩惱。
sentences.en: His mind is like the void, free from any worries and attachments.

sentences.zh: 禪宗修行者努力排除妄念，直達虛空的境界。
sentences.en: Zen practitioners strive to eliminate delusive thoughts and reach the state of void.

sentences.zh: 在冥想中，我們試圖與虛空相合，體會生命的無限可能。
sentences.en: During meditation, we try to merge with the void and understand the infinite possibilities of life.

phrase.en: the immensity of the universe is tiny when compared with the consciousness of our own mind

sentences.zh: 佛教裡常說，虛空非大，心王最大，因為心的力量超越了空間和時間。
sentences.en: It is often said in Buddhism that the immensity of the universe is tiny when compared with the consciousness of our own mind, as the power of the mind transcends space and time.

sentences.zh: 冥想讓我們感受到心王最大的真理，虛空非大，只是外在的幻象。
sentences.en: Meditation makes us realize the truth that the immensity of the universe is tiny when compared with the consciousness of our own mind, as the vastness is merely an external illusion.

sentences.zh: 當你理解了虛空非大，心王最大，你會開始重視內心的寧靜。
sentences.en: When you understand that the immensity of the universe is tiny when compared with the consciousness of our own mind, you begin to value inner peace.

sentences.zh: 師父教導我們，真理在於內心，虛空非大，心王最大。
sentences.en: The master teaches us that the truth lies within the mind; the immensity of the universe is tiny when compared with the consciousness of our own mind.

sentences.zh: 《虛雲和尚年譜》詳細記錄了虛雲和尚一生的修行和弘法事蹟。
