sentences.en: The monks lined up in two rows to formally greet the high monk.

sentences.zh: 皇帝出巡時，百官在城門外列隊接駕，場面極其隆重。
sentences.en: When the emperor went on a tour, the officials lined up outside the city gate to give him a formal greeting, which was a very grand event.

sentences.zh: 那天寺廟裏，人人都準備好接駕先祖的靈位，進行莊嚴的儀式。
sentences.en: On that day in the temple, everyone was ready to formally greet the spirits of their ancestors, conducting a solemn ceremony.

sentences.zh: 村民們聚集在一起等候州長的到來，並準備以古老的傳統儀式接駕。
sentences.en: The villagers gathered to await the governor's arrival and prepared to formally greet him with ancient traditional rituals.

sentences.zh: 解門是理解佛教經典的一種方式，通過學習經文來擴展智慧。
sentences.en: Teaching in theory is a way to understand Buddhist scriptures, expanding wisdom through the study of the texts.

sentences.zh: 很多人通過解門來精通佛法，希望能夠更深入地理解其中的道理。
sentences.en: Many people master the Dharma through teaching in theory, hoping to gain deeper insights.

sentences.zh: 僧侶們經常參加解門課程，以提高他們的教義知識和傳教能力。
sentences.en: Monks often attend teaching in theory courses to enhance their doctrinal knowledge and preaching abilities.

sentences.zh: 解門與行門相輔相成，前者是理論上的研究，後者則是實踐中的體驗。
sentences.en: Teaching in theory complements practice, with the former focusing on theoretical study and the latter emphasizing experiential learning.

sentences.zh: 法師在禪修中與弟子們進行了接心開示，引導他們走向內心的平靜。
sentences.en: The master held a heart-to-heart connection with the disciples during the meditation, guiding them towards inner peace.

sentences.zh: 在這次法會中，師父以接心開示的方式，讓大家真切感受到佛法的力量。
sentences.en: During this Dharma assembly, the teacher used a heart-to-heart connection to let everyone truly feel the power of Buddhist teachings.

sentences.zh: 接心開示是一種能夠深入靈魂的交流方式，讓人們在精神上得到極大提升。
sentences.en: Heart-to-heart connection is a form of communication that penetrates the soul, allowing individuals to achieve significant spiritual upliftment.

sentences.zh: 通過接心開示，師父幫助徒弟們解決了內心深處的疑惑，讓他們豁然開朗。
sentences.en: Through heart-to-heart connection, the teacher helped the disciples resolve their deep-seated doubts, leading them to enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 寺院將舉行方丈的晉山陞座典禮，成為一個隆重而莊嚴的儀式。
sentences.en: The temple will hold the inaugural ceremony for the abbot, marked by a solemn and grand ritual.

sentences.zh: 在晉山陞座的儀式上，新任住持接受了眾人的祝福與支持。
sentences.en: During the inaugural ceremony, the newly appointed head monk received blessings and support from the congregation.

sentences.zh: 晉山陞座是一個重要的傳統，象徵著新的領導者開始承擔重任。
sentences.en: The inaugural ceremony is an important tradition, symbolizing the new leader's assumption of responsibilities.

sentences.zh: 各地僧侶齊聚一堂，共同參加這次意義非凡的晉山陞座儀式。
sentences.en: Monks from various regions gather together to participate in this significant inaugural ceremony.

sentences.zh: 覺世月刊為讀者提供廣泛的佛學文章與生活智慧。
sentences.en: Awakening the World Monthly provides readers with a wide range of Buddhist articles and life wisdom.

sentences.zh: 很多人喜愛閱讀覺世月刊，以獲取精神上的安慰和指導。
sentences.en: Many people enjoy reading Awakening the World Monthly for spiritual comfort and guidance.

sentences.zh: 覺世月刊自創刊以來，已經出版了數百期，累積了豐富的知識寶庫。
sentences.en: Since its inception, Awakening the World Monthly has published hundreds of issues, accumulating a rich repository of knowledge.

sentences.zh: 訂閱覺世月刊可以幫助你更深入地了解佛教的教義和實踐。
sentences.en: Subscribing to Awakening the World Monthly can help you gain a deeper understanding of Buddhist doctrines and practices.

sentences.zh: 昨天寺廟舉辦了一場開大座，吸引了許多信眾前來聆聽。
sentences.en: Yesterday, the temple hosted a Dharma lecture that attracted many devotees.

sentences.zh: 每週日早晨，師父會為弟子們進行一場開大座。
sentences.en: Every Sunday morning, the master gives a Dharma lecture to the disciples.

sentences.zh: 這次的開大座主題是《心經》的智慧，內容十分深奧。
sentences.en: The topic of this Dharma lecture was the wisdom of the Heart Sutra, and the content was very profound.

sentences.zh: 參加開大座讓我對佛法有了更深入的理解和體會。
sentences.en: Attending the Dharma lecture gave me a deeper understanding and appreciation of the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 在誦經之前，僧人們會齊聲念誦開經偈。
sentences.en: Before reciting the sutras, the monks chant the Sutra Opening Gatha together.

sentences.zh: 開經偈以其簡短而深刻的文字引導我們進入經文的智慧。
sentences.en: The Sutra Opening Gatha, with its concise yet profound verses, guides us into the wisdom of the scriptures.

sentences.zh: 每一次誦讀經文時，念誦開經偈已成為一種固定的儀式。
sentences.en: Chanting the Sutra Opening Gatha has become a fixed ritual each time the scriptures are read.

sentences.zh: 開經偈的念誦有助於集中心神，讓我們更好地理解經文的精髓。
sentences.en: Chanting the Sutra Opening Gatha helps to focus the mind, allowing us to better grasp the essence of the sutras.

sentences.zh: 老奶奶總是用慈愛的眼神看著我們，讓我們感到無比溫暖。
sentences.en: Madam Li Liu Yuying (Grandmother) always looks at us with loving eyes, making us feel incredibly warm.

sentences.zh: 我們都喜歡聽老奶奶講述她年輕時的故事，這些故事充滿了智慧和經驗。
sentences.en: We all love listening to Madam Li Liu Yuying (Grandmother) narrate stories from her youth, stories filled with wisdom and experience.

sentences.zh: 每當我們遇到困難，老奶奶總能給我們提供寶貴的建議，她是一個經驗豐富的智者。
sentences.en: Whenever we face difficulties, Madam Li Liu Yuying (Grandmother) always offers us valuable advice, being a wise and experienced counselor.

sentences.zh: 老奶奶每天都會打坐冥想，她說這能讓她保持內心的平靜與安寧。
sentences.en: Madam Li Liu Yuying (Grandmother) meditates daily, saying it helps her maintain inner peace and tranquility.

phrase.en: Madam Li Liu Yuying Memorial Hall

sentences.zh: 老奶奶紀念館是為紀念李劉玉英女士而建立的。
sentences.en: The Madam Li Liu Yuying Memorial Hall was established in honor of Madam Li Liu Yuying.

sentences.zh: 很多人前來老奶奶紀念館，緬懷她對社會的貢獻。
sentences.en: Many people visit the Madam Li Liu Yuying Memorial Hall to pay tribute to her contributions to society.

sentences.zh: 老奶奶紀念館內展示了她生前使用過的物品和照片。
sentences.en: The Madam Li Liu Yuying Memorial Hall displays items and photographs used by her during her lifetime.

sentences.zh: 每年都會舉辦特別活動在老奶奶紀念館，以紀念李劉玉英女士的生平故事。
sentences.en: Special events are held annually at the Madam Li Liu Yuying Memorial Hall to commemorate the life story of Madam Li Liu Yuying.

sentences.zh: 在佛光山的法會上，僧眾們一齊以蓮花指合掌，表示虔誠的供養和祈禱。
sentences.en: During the Dharma assembly at Fo Guang Shan, the monks collectively made the BLIA Lotus Mudra, signifying devout offering and prayer.

sentences.zh: 蓮花指出現在許多佛教藝術品中，象徵著純潔和覺悟的精神。
sentences.en: The BLIA Lotus Mudra appears in many Buddhist artworks, symbolizing purity and the spirit of enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 修行者每天早晨會以蓮花指打坐，這有助於集中精神和增進自我修養。
sentences.en: Practitioners sit in meditation with the BLIA Lotus Mudra every morning, which helps in focusing the mind and improving self-cultivation.

sentences.zh: 導師教導弟子們如何正確使用蓮花指，以提升他們的修行效果。
sentences.en: The teacher instructed the disciples on the correct usage of the BLIA Lotus Mudra to enhance their practice effectiveness.

sentences.zh: 在靈山會上，佛祖為眾弟子講解了甚深的法義。
sentences.en: At the Vulture Peak Assembly, the Buddha expounded profound Dharma teachings to his disciples.

sentences.zh: 靈山會上的開示被後世弟子視為無上妙法。
sentences.en: The teachings given at the Vulture Peak Assembly are regarded as supreme Dharma by later disciples.

sentences.zh: 許多人在靈山會上獲得了大智慧，走上了覺悟之道。
sentences.en: Many people attained great wisdom and embarked on the path of enlightenment at the Vulture Peak Assembly.

sentences.zh: 靈山會上的情景被詳細記錄在《法華經》中。
sentences.en: The events of the Vulture Peak Assembly are meticulously recorded in the Lotus Sutra.

sentences.zh: 龍樹菩薩是印度佛教的重要人物，他在佛教思想史上有著深遠的影響。
sentences.en: Nagarjuna is an important figure in Indian Buddhism, having a profound influence on the history of Buddhist thought.

sentences.zh: 龍樹菩薩被認為是中觀派的奠基人，他的作品對後世影響深遠。
sentences.en: Nagarjuna is considered the founder of the Madhyamaka school, and his works have had a lasting impact on later generations.

sentences.zh: 在《中論》中，龍樹菩薩闡述了一切現象的空性，這是一個重要的佛教概念。
sentences.en: In the 'Mūlamadhyamakakārikā', Nagarjuna expounds on the emptiness of all phenomena, which is a key concept in Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 很多學者和修行者都深受龍樹菩薩智慧的啟發，並致力於研究他的著作。
sentences.en: Many scholars and practitioners are deeply inspired by Nagarjuna's wisdom and are dedicated to studying his works.

sentences.zh: 這家的羅漢菜名不虛傳，不僅色香味俱佳，還富含營養。
sentences.en: The arhat dish at this restaurant lives up to its reputation, with excellent color, aroma, and taste, and is also rich in nutrients.

sentences.zh: 他第一次品嘗羅漢菜時，被它的清淡和獨特風味所吸引。
sentences.en: When he first tasted the arhat dish, he was attracted by its light and unique flavor.

sentences.zh: 羅漢菜是一道素食佳餚，深受信仰佛教的人們的喜愛。
sentences.en: The arhat dish is a vegetarian delicacy, much loved by those who follow Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 廚師精心調製的羅漢菜，不僅美味可口，而且寓意健康長壽。
sentences.en: The chef's meticulously prepared arhat dish is not only delicious but also symbolizes health and longevity.

phrase.en: Buddha's Light Publications (U.S.A.) f.k.a. Buddha's Light Publishing

sentences.zh: 美國佛光出版社的許多書籍都在佛教界享有盛譽。
sentences.en: Many books from Buddha's Light Publications (U.S.A.) are highly regarded in the Buddhist community.

sentences.zh: 美國佛光出版社最近出版了一本關於禪修的心得分享。
sentences.en: Buddha's Light Publications (U.S.A.) recently published a book on insights into Zen meditation.

sentences.zh: 你可以在美國佛光出版社的網站上找到最新的佛教文學作品。
sentences.en: You can find the latest Buddhist literary works on the website of Buddha's Light Publications (U.S.A.).

sentences.zh: 他們在美國佛光出版社工作多年，對出版佛教書籍非常熱情。
sentences.en: They have worked at Buddha's Light Publications (U.S.A.) for many years and are very passionate about publishing Buddhist books.

sentences.zh: 下週寺廟將舉行彌陀法會，歡迎所有信徒參加。
sentences.en: The temple will hold an Amitabha Dharma Service next week, and all devotees are welcome to attend.

sentences.zh: 在彌陀法會上，僧眾們誦念阿彌陀佛名號，祈求淨土的安寧。
sentences.en: During the Amitabha Dharma Service, the monks chant the name of Amitabha Buddha, praying for peace in the Pure Land.

sentences.zh: 參加彌陀法會讓我感受到內心的平靜和祥和。
sentences.en: Participating in the Amitabha Dharma Service brought me a sense of inner peace and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 彌陀法會結束後，大家一起分享了供養品，增進信徒間的聯繫。
sentences.en: After the Amitabha Dharma Service, everyone shared the offerings, strengthening the bonds among the devotees.

sentences.zh: 這次的彌陀佛七將在山中的寺院舉行，參加者將專注誦念阿彌陀佛聖號。
sentences.en: This Amitabha Chanting Retreat will be held at a mountain temple, where participants will focus on chanting the name of Amitabha Buddha.

sentences.zh: 在彌陀佛七期間，所有人都應該放下外界的干擾，專注於內心的寧靜。
sentences.en: During the Amitabha Chanting Retreat, everyone should let go of external distractions and focus on inner peace.

sentences.zh: 參加彌陀佛七是一個修習佛法和淨心的好機會。
sentences.en: Attending an Amitabha Chanting Retreat is a great opportunity to practice Buddhism and purify the mind.

sentences.zh: 這次彌陀佛七的開示由著名的禪師主講，內容豐富深刻。
sentences.en: The teachings at this Amitabha Chanting Retreat will be delivered by a renowned Zen master, offering profound and insightful content.

sentences.zh: 許多佛教徒希望往生彌陀淨土，以便在那裡修行並得以解脫。
sentences.en: Many Buddhists aspire to be reborn in Amitabha's Pure Land, where they can practice and attain liberation.

sentences.zh: 彌陀淨土被描述為一個無憂無虑，充滿美好和和諧的地方。
sentences.en: Amitabha's Pure Land is described as a place of worry-free existence, filled with beauty and harmony.

sentences.zh: 每日的誦經和念佛是通往彌陀淨土的重要修行方法。
sentences.en: Daily recitation of sutras and chanting of the Buddha's name are key practices to reach Amitabha's Pure Land.

sentences.zh: 佛教經典中詳細描述了彌陀淨土的美景與殊勝。
sentences.en: Buddhist scriptures provide detailed descriptions of the beauty and uniqueness of Amitabha's Pure Land.

phrase.en: A face without anger is a type of offering.

sentences.zh: 在佛教修行中，面上無瞋是供養，可以使周圍的人感到安寧。
sentences.en: In Buddhist practice, a face without anger is a type of offering, bringing peace to those around.

sentences.zh: 他每天都提醒自己，面上無瞋是供養，這樣可以提升自己的修養。
sentences.en: He reminds himself daily that a face without anger is a type of offering, thus improving his own virtues.

sentences.zh: 師父教導弟子們，面上無瞋是供養，這是一種無聲的善行。
sentences.en: The master taught his disciples that a face without anger is a type of offering, a silent act of kindness.

sentences.zh: 即使在逆境中，保持面上無瞋是供養，可以讓自己和他人受益。
sentences.en: Even in adversity, maintaining a face without anger as an offering benefits both oneself and others.

sentences.zh: 妙慧童女在佛教故事中是一位知名的女性善信，她以智慧與慈悲聞名。
sentences.en: Sumagadhi is a renowned female devotee in Buddhist stories, known for her wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 妙慧童女在經文中被描述為一位既美麗又聰慧的年輕女子。
sentences.en: In the scriptures, Sumagadhi is depicted as a young woman who is both beautiful and intelligent.

sentences.zh: 妙慧童女曾在佛陀說法時，啟發了許多聽眾增進自己的智慧。
sentences.en: Sumagadhi inspired many listeners to enhance their wisdom during Buddha's teachings.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒經常以妙慧童女作為榜樣，學習她的優秀品德和不懈精神。
sentences.en: Buddhists often look up to Sumagadhi as a role model, learning from her excellent virtues and unwavering spirit.

sentences.zh: 摩迦是佛教中的一位重要修行者。
sentences.en: Mojia is an important practitioner in Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 摩迦在山中修行多年，心無旁騖。
sentences.en: Mojia has been practicing in the mountains for many years, single-mindedly focused on his practice.

sentences.zh: 摩迦的智慧和慈悲深受弟子的尊敬。
sentences.en: Mojia's wisdom and compassion are deeply respected by his disciples.

sentences.zh: 在佛教經典中，摩迦多次出現，代表修行的典範。
sentences.en: In Buddhist scriptures, Mojia appears frequently as a model of practice.

sentences.zh: 我今年秋天要報考南華管理學院，希望能夠學習高階管理技巧。
sentences.en: I am applying to the College of Management, Nanhua University this fall, hoping to learn advanced management skills.

sentences.zh: 南華管理學院擁有一流的教學設施和經驗豐富的教授團隊。
sentences.en: The College of Management, Nanhua University boasts top-notch teaching facilities and an experienced faculty team.

sentences.zh: 在南華管理學院學習的過程中，我認識了來自世界各地的同學。
sentences.en: During my time at the College of Management, Nanhua University, I met classmates from all over the world.

sentences.zh: 南華管理學院的課程設計與時俱進，非常適合現代企業管理需求。
sentences.en: The curriculum at the College of Management, Nanhua University is up-to-date and well-suited to the needs of modern business management.

sentences.zh: 每個月的第一個週六，我們會參加當地寺廟的念佛會。
sentences.en: On the first Saturday of each month, we attend the local temple's chanting association.

sentences.zh: 念佛會旨在通過集體誦經來促進內心的平靜和專注。
sentences.en: The chanting association aims to promote inner peace and concentration through collective recitation.

sentences.zh: 在念佛會上，大家一同誦念阿彌陀佛，感受共同修行的力量。
sentences.en: At the chanting association, everyone chants Amitabha together, feeling the power of collective practice.

sentences.zh: 即使是新手也會在念佛會中找到歸屬感，因為這裡歡迎所有對佛法感興趣的人。
sentences.en: Even beginners find a sense of belonging in the chanting association, as it welcomes anyone interested in the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 在面對人生的起伏時，保持平常心是道，可以讓我們找到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: When facing the ups and downs of life, maintaining an ordinary mind is the way to finding inner peace.

sentences.zh: 禪宗大師常常教導弟子們，平常心是道，才能真正體會生活的智慧。
sentences.en: Zen masters often teach their disciples that ordinary mind is the way to truly understand the wisdom of life.

sentences.zh: 無論遇到多大的困難，記住平常心是道，有助於我們從容應對挑戰。
sentences.en: No matter how great the difficulty, remembering that an ordinary mind is the way helps us tackle challenges with composure.

sentences.zh: 在日常修行中，修士們練習將平常心是道作為一種生活方式，以求達到心靈的解脫。
sentences.en: In daily practice, monks cultivate the idea that ordinary mind is the way as a way of life, seeking spiritual liberation.

sentences.zh: 他們被稱為菩提眷屬，因為他們共同修行，共同精進佛法。
sentences.en: They are known as a bodhi couple because they practice together and advance in the Dharma together.

sentences.zh: 作為菩提眷屬，他們的婚姻不僅僅是凡俗的，而是以智慧和慈悲為基礎的精神聯繫。
sentences.en: As a bodhi couple, their marriage is not merely mundane, but a spiritual connection founded on wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 這對菩提眷屬每週參加禪修課，共同提升他們的內在覺知。
sentences.en: This bodhi couple attends meditation classes weekly, mutually enhancing their inner awareness.

sentences.zh: 他們以菩提眷屬的身份在社區中樹立了良好的榜樣，激勵他人追求內在的和平與覺悟。
sentences.en: As a bodhi couple, they set a good example in their community, inspiring others to pursue inner peace and enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該時時培養菩提心，這是成佛的根本。
sentences.en: Practitioners should constantly cultivate the bodhi mind, as it is the foundation of attaining Buddhahood.

sentences.zh: 菩提心的發起源自於對一切眾生的無限慈悲。
sentences.en: The arising of the bodhi mind stems from boundless compassion for all sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 只有發菩提心，才能走上菩薩道，最終成就無上正等正覺。
sentences.en: Only by generating the bodhi mind can one embark on the bodhisattva path and ultimately achieve supreme perfect enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 每當遇到困難時，我們應該觀察自己的動機，是否依然保持著純正的菩提心。
sentences.en: Whenever faced with difficulties, we should examine our motivations to see if we are still maintaining a pure bodhi mind.

sentences.zh: 每個眾生的心中都蘊含著菩提種子，只需因緣條件成熟，它便能開花結果。
sentences.en: Every sentient being harbors bodhi seeds in their heart; with the right conditions, they can blossom and bear fruit.

sentences.zh: 在這次的禪修課程中，我們分享了如何在日常生活中善用菩提種子，提升心靈的智慧。
sentences.en: In this meditation workshop, we shared how to effectively cultivate bodhi seeds in daily life to enhance spiritual wisdom.

sentences.zh: 導師告訴我們，承諾守護和培養內心的菩提種子，可以帶來長遠的平靜和快樂。
sentences.en: The teacher told us that committing to nurture and protect the bodhi seeds within can bring long-lasting peace and happiness.

sentences.zh: 每一次面對困境，我都記得內在有無限的菩提種子可以指引我走向解脫。
sentences.en: Every time I face difficulties, I remind myself that there are infinite bodhi seeds within me to guide me towards liberation.

phrase.zh: 普賢警眾偈 是日已過，命亦隨減， 如少水魚，斯有何樂？ 當勤精進，如救頭燃， 但念無常，慎勿放逸。
phrase.en: Samantabhadra Bodhisattva’s Verse of Admonition The day has passed, our lives thus shortened, Like fish running short of water, for what do we rejoice? Strive on diligently and vigilantly, as if putting out fire on the head. Be mindful of impermanence, and be cautious of laxity.

sentences.zh: 普賢菩薩的警眾偈提醒我們，是日已過，命亦隨減，時間是有限的。
sentences.en: Samantabhadra Bodhisattva’s Verse of Admonition reminds us that the day has passed, our lives thus shortened, and time is limited.

sentences.zh: 普賢菩薩告訴我們，如少水魚，斯有何樂？要意識到即使在快樂中也有困境存在。
sentences.en: Samantabhadra Bodhisattva tells us, like fish running short of water, for what do we rejoice? It’s important to realize that even in happiness, difficulties exist.

sentences.zh: 我們應該如救頭燃般精進努力，因為時間不等人。
sentences.en: We should strive on diligently and vigilantly, as if putting out fire on the head, because time waits for no one.

sentences.zh: 該偈提醒我們要謹記無常，並時刻保持戒慎，不要放逸。
sentences.en: The verse reminds us to be mindful of impermanence, and to always be cautious and avoid laxity.

phrase.en: place of practice for the sevenfold assembly

sentences.zh: 七眾道場為僧侶和信眾提供了一個共同修行的聖地。
sentences.en: The place of practice for the sevenfold assembly provides a sacred ground for monks and devotees to practice together.

sentences.zh: 建立一個七眾道場需要全體信徒的共同努力和奉獻。
sentences.en: Establishing a place of practice for the sevenfold assembly requires the collective effort and dedication of all the faithful.

sentences.zh: 在這個七眾道場中，人們學習經典、進行禪修並共同參與宗教儀式。
sentences.en: In this place of practice for the sevenfold assembly, people study scriptures, engage in meditation, and participate in religious ceremonies together.

sentences.zh: 七眾道場是一個融合了教義、修行和社區服務的綜合性場所。
sentences.en: The place of practice for the sevenfold assembly is a comprehensive site that integrates doctrine, practice, and community service.

phrase.en: Hsing Yun Award for Global Chinese Literature

sentences.zh: 她憑藉出色的小說榮獲全球華文文學星雲獎，這是對她寫作才華的重大肯定。
sentences.en: She won the Hsing Yun Award for Global Chinese Literature for her outstanding novel, which is a great recognition of her writing talent.

sentences.zh: 全球華文文學星雲獎每年都吸引無數作家的參與，競爭非常激烈。
sentences.en: The Hsing Yun Award for Global Chinese Literature attracts numerous writers each year, making the competition very intense.

sentences.zh: 他在頒獎典禮上感謝全球華文文學星雲獎的評審委員對他的支持和鼓勵。
sentences.en: At the award ceremony, he thanked the judges of the Hsing Yun Award for Global Chinese Literature for their support and encouragement.

sentences.zh: 全球華文文學星雲獎旨在推廣和發揚華文文學，促進文化交流。
sentences.en: The Hsing Yun Award for Global Chinese Literature aims to promote and develop Chinese literature, fostering cultural exchange.

sentences.zh: 人間大學提供多樣化的佛教課程，致力於推動全球的佛教教育。
sentences.en: Fo Guang Shan Open University offers a diverse range of Buddhist courses, dedicated to promoting Buddhist education worldwide.

sentences.zh: 在去人間大學之前，他對佛教哲學了解甚少。
sentences.en: Before attending Fo Guang Shan Open University, he had very little knowledge of Buddhist philosophy.

sentences.zh: 人間大學的線上課程讓來自世界各地的學生都能夠學習佛教。
sentences.en: The online courses at Fo Guang Shan Open University enable students from all over the world to study Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 她畢業於人間大學，現在是知名的佛學教授。
sentences.en: She graduated from Fo Guang Shan Open University and is now a renowned Buddhist scholar.

sentences.zh: 這次人間佛教論壇將探討如何在現代社會實踐佛教教義。
sentences.en: This year's Humanistic Buddhism Forum will explore how to practice Buddhist teachings in modern society.

sentences.zh: 他在參加人間佛教論壇後，對佛教的現代意義有了更深的理解。
sentences.en: After attending the Humanistic Buddhism Forum, he gained a deeper understanding of the contemporary significance of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 人間佛教論壇吸引了來自世界各地的學者和修行者。
sentences.en: The Humanistic Buddhism Forum attracted scholars and practitioners from around the world.

sentences.zh: 在這次人間佛教論壇上，許多專家分享了他們對於佛法如何改善社會的見解。
sentences.en: At this Humanistic Buddhism Forum, many experts shared their insights on how Buddhist teachings can improve society.

sentences.zh: 人間生活禪強調在日常生活中培養覺知和正念。
sentences.en: Humanistic Living Chan emphasizes cultivating awareness and mindfulness in everyday life.

sentences.zh: 通過人間生活禪的修行，他學會了如何應對壓力和焦慮。
sentences.en: Through the practice of Humanistic Living Chan, he has learned how to cope with stress and anxiety.

sentences.zh: 人間生活禪教導人們在日常行為中尋找內心的平靜和快樂。
sentences.en: Humanistic Living Chan teaches people to find inner peace and happiness within their daily actions.

sentences.zh: 她將人間生活禪融入到烹飪中，享受每一個步驟的過程。
sentences.en: She incorporates Humanistic Living Chan into her cooking, savoring every step of the process.

sentences.zh: 人間通訊社的記者對佛教的慈善活動做了深入的報導。
sentences.en: The reporters at Life News Agency (LNA) provided in-depth coverage of the Buddhist charity events.

sentences.zh: 人間通訊社最近發布了一系列有關禪修的專題文章。
sentences.en: Life News Agency (LNA) recently published a series of feature articles on meditation practices.

sentences.zh: 人間通訊社的使命是傳播愛與和平的理念。
sentences.en: The mission of Life News Agency (LNA) is to spread the message of love and peace.

sentences.zh: 透過人間通訊社的報導，更多人了解了佛教在現代社會中的影響力。
sentences.en: Through the reports of Life News Agency (LNA), more people have come to understand the influence of Buddhism in modern society.

sentences.zh: 作為一個人間行者，他每天都在社區裡推廣慈悲和智慧。
sentences.en: As a Humanistic Buddhist practitioner, he promotes compassion and wisdom in the community every day.

sentences.zh: 人間行者致力於將佛法應用於日常生活中，幫助他人解決問題。
sentences.en: The Humanistic Buddhist practitioner is dedicated to applying Buddhist teachings to daily life, helping others to solve problems.

sentences.zh: 她選擇成為一名人間行者，希望通過實踐佛教來改善社會。
sentences.en: She chose to become a Humanistic Buddhist practitioner, hoping to improve society through the practice of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 人間行者相信，佛法不僅是修行個人的解脫之道，還是服務人群的指南。
sentences.en: A Humanistic Buddhist practitioner believes that Buddhism is not only a path for personal liberation but also a guide for serving the community.

phrase.en: Fo Guang Shan Sounds of the Human World Buddhist Chinese Orchestra

sentences.zh: 人間音緣梵樂團在演出中巧妙地融合了傳統和現代的佛教音樂元素。
sentences.en: The Fo Guang Shan Sounds of the Human World Buddhist Chinese Orchestra skillfully blends traditional and contemporary elements of Buddhist music in their performances.

sentences.zh: Fo Guang Shan Sounds of the Human World Buddhist Chinese Orchestra 將舉行一場特別音樂會，紀念該團成立十週年。
sentences.en: The Fo Guang Shan Sounds of the Human World Buddhist Chinese Orchestra will hold a special concert to commemorate the orchestra's tenth anniversary.

sentences.zh: 人間音緣梵樂團的音樂每次都能讓聽眾感受到心靈的寧靜與祥和。
sentences.en: The music of the Fo Guang Shan Sounds of the Human World Buddhist Chinese Orchestra always brings a sense of peace and serenity to its listeners.

sentences.zh: Fo Guang Shan Sounds of the Human World Buddhist Chinese Orchestra 的表演經常被邀請參加國際音樂節，受到廣泛的喜愛和讚賞。
sentences.en: The performances of the Fo Guang Shan Sounds of the Human World Buddhist Chinese Orchestra are often invited to international music festivals, receiving widespread acclaim and admiration.

phrase.zh: 人能弘道 非道弘人
phrase.en: It is people who promote the Way, not the Way that promotes people.

sentences.zh: 老師常說，人能弘道 非道弘人，要靠自己的修行來傳播佛法。
sentences.en: The teacher often says, it is people who promote the Way, not the Way that promotes people, and we must rely on our own practice to spread Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 這句古訓『人能弘道 非道弘人』提醒我們，佛法的傳播需經由修持者的智慧與努力。
sentences.en: This ancient adage 'It is people who promote the Way, not the Way that promotes people' reminds us that the dissemination of the Dharma requires the wisdom and effort of practitioners.

sentences.zh: 他每天早起修行，深信人能弘道 非道弘人，認為自己的行動可以帶來善的影響。
sentences.en: He rises early every day to practice, firmly believing that it is people who promote the Way, not the Way that promotes people, and he thinks his actions can bring about positive impact.

sentences.zh: 在人能弘道 非道弘人這種信念的驅動下，他決定開辦一個免費的禪修班，幫助更多人接觸佛法。
sentences.en: Driven by the belief that it is people who promote the Way, not the Way that promotes people, he decided to start a free meditation class to help more people connect with Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 這本書列出了人生108事，幫助你在生活中找到平衡與智慧。
sentences.en: This book outlines 108 tips for life, helping you find balance and wisdom in everyday living.

sentences.zh: 跟隨人生108事的指引，你將能夠更好地應對挑戰，過上更加圓滿的生活。
sentences.en: By following the 108 tips for life, you will be better equipped to handle challenges and live a more fulfilling life.

sentences.zh: 人生108事包括了一系列的建議，從健康飲食到心靈成長，涵蓋了生活的方方面面。
sentences.en: The 108 tips for life include a range of advice, from healthy eating to spiritual growth, covering all aspects of life.

sentences.zh: 通過實踐人生108事，你將發現內在的平安與快樂。
sentences.en: By practicing the 108 tips for life, you will discover inner peace and happiness.

sentences.zh: 他決定報名參加日文佛學班，以更深入了解佛教經典。
sentences.en: He decided to enroll in a Japanese Buddhist College to gain deeper insight into Buddhist scriptures.

sentences.zh: 日文佛學班的老師們都具備豐富的教學經驗和佛學知識。
sentences.en: The teachers at the Japanese Buddhist College have extensive teaching experience and deep knowledge of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 日文佛學班每週安排一次禪修課程，幫助學生修習靜坐。
sentences.en: The Japanese Buddhist College schedules a meditation class once a week to help students practice sitting meditation.

sentences.zh: 在日文佛學班學習期間，他結識了來自世界各地的佛教學者。
sentences.en: During his time at the Japanese Buddhist College, he met Buddhist scholars from all over the world.

sentences.zh: 他決定入道出家，追求心靈的平靜和解脫。
sentences.en: He decided to enter the Way and renounce, seeking inner peace and liberation.

sentences.zh: 在找到真理之前，她選擇入道出家，過上簡樸的生活。
sentences.en: Before finding the truth, she chose to enter the Way and renounce, leading a simple life.

sentences.zh: 許多偉大的佛教僧侶都曾經歷過入道出家的過程，以實現他們的靈修目標。
sentences.en: Many great Buddhist monks have gone through the process of entering the Way and renouncing to achieve their spiritual goals.

sentences.zh: 入道出家的決定常常需要克服重重阻力和內心的掙扎。
sentences.en: The decision to enter the Way and renounce often requires overcoming numerous obstacles and inner struggles.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒自稱為如來之子，意指他們承繼佛陀的智慧和慈悲。
sentences.en: Buddhists refer to themselves as Sons of Zu Lai, implying they inherit the wisdom and compassion of the Buddha.

sentences.zh: 無論在何處，作為如來之子的人們都在努力實踐佛法。
sentences.en: Wherever they are, the Sons of Zu Lai strive to practice the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 這位僧侶教導他的弟子們要時常記住，如來之子的責任和使命。
sentences.en: The monk instructed his disciples to constantly remember the responsibilities and mission as Sons of Zu Lai.

sentences.zh: 我們要以如來之子的精神來面對生活中的挑戰，無畏無懼。
sentences.en: We should face life's challenges with the spirit of Sons of Zu Lai, fearless and unyielding.

sentences.zh: 入世佛教強調在日常生活中修行，並且在社會中實踐佛法。
sentences.en: This-Worldly Buddhism emphasizes practicing Dharma in daily life and applying it within society.

sentences.zh: 很多現代的修行者都接受入世佛教的觀念，以應對當前的社會挑戰。
sentences.en: Many modern practitioners embrace the concept of This-Worldly Buddhism to address contemporary social challenges.

sentences.zh: 入世佛教不同於傳統的修行方式，它更加注重與現實世界的連結。
sentences.en: This-Worldly Buddhism differs from traditional practices by placing greater emphasis on connections with the real world.

sentences.zh: 老師在課堂上講解了入世佛教如何幫助我們在繁忙的都市生活中找到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: The teacher explained in class how This-Worldly Buddhism helps us find inner peace amidst the hustle and bustle of urban life.

sentences.zh: 我們在法會上合唱三寶歌，心中充滿了喜悅和平靜。
sentences.en: We sang The Triple Gem Song during the dharma assembly, feeling joy and peace in our hearts.

sentences.zh: 三寶歌是對佛、法、僧的讚美和敬仰，讓人感受到佛法的力量。
sentences.en: The Triple Gem Song is a tribute and reverence to the Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha, making one feel the power of the teachings.

sentences.zh: 每當我唱起三寶歌，就像與三寶聯結，感受到無限的慈悲。
sentences.en: Whenever I sing The Triple Gem Song, it feels like connecting with the Triple Gem and experiencing boundless compassion.

sentences.zh: 在禪修靜坐之前，我們會靜靜地聆聽三寶歌，讓心靈進入寧靜的狀態。
sentences.en: Before meditation, we quietly listen to The Triple Gem Song to bring our minds into a state of tranquility.

sentences.zh: 每次法會開始前，我們都會唱頌三寶頌，以示對佛、法、僧的尊敬。
sentences.en: Before each Dharma assembly, we chant the Ode to the Triple Gem to show our respect for the Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha.

sentences.zh: 孩子們在學校的佛學課上學習了如何唱頌三寶頌。
sentences.en: The children learned how to chant the Ode to the Triple Gem in their Buddhist studies class at school.

sentences.zh: 老人院的住客在每次早課時，都會一起唱三寶頌，共祈福壽安康。
sentences.en: The residents of the elderly care home chant the Ode to the Triple Gem together during each morning session, praying for health and longevity.

sentences.zh: 三寶頌的旋律優美，讓人聽後心生安寧。
sentences.en: The melody of the Ode to the Triple Gem is beautiful and brings a sense of peace to those who hear it.

phrase.en: Three Acts of Goodness Sports Association

sentences.zh: 三好體育協會致力於推廣身心健康的體育活動，鼓勵人們在運動中實踐說好話、做好事、存好心。
sentences.en: The Three Acts of Goodness Sports Association is dedicated to promoting physical and mental well-being through sports, encouraging people to speak good words, do good deeds, and have good thoughts during their activities.

sentences.zh: 加入三好體育協會後，我們的社區變得更加團結，人人都在努力成為更好的人。
sentences.en: After joining the Three Acts of Goodness Sports Association, our community has become more united, with everyone striving to be a better person.

sentences.zh: 三好體育協會每年都舉辦各種賽事，讓孩子們在享受運動樂趣的同時學會互相尊重和幫助。
sentences.en: The Three Acts of Goodness Sports Association organizes various events annually, allowing children to enjoy the fun of sports while learning to respect and help each other.

sentences.zh: 透過三好體育協會的宣導，越來越多的人開始重視素質教育和道德提升。
sentences.en: Through the advocacy of the Three Acts of Goodness Sports Association, more and more people are beginning to value quality education and moral improvement.

sentences.zh: 這所三好校園實踐學校強調做好事、說好話、存好心的教育理念。
sentences.en: This Three Acts of Goodness School emphasizes the educational ideals of doing good deeds, speaking good words, and having a kind heart.

sentences.zh: 在三好校園實踐學校，學生們學會了如何在日常生活中實踐三好精神。
sentences.en: At the Three Acts of Goodness School, students learn how to practice the spirit of the Three Acts of Goodness in their daily lives.

sentences.zh: 三好校園實踐學校的校長致力於推廣這些重要的價值觀，希望能影響更多的學校及社區。
sentences.en: The principal of the Three Acts of Goodness School is dedicated to promoting these critical values, hoping to influence more schools and communities.

sentences.zh: 許多家長選擇將孩子送到這所三好校園實踐學校，因為他們相信這裡能為孩子的未來打下堅實的道德基礎。
sentences.en: Many parents choose to send their children to the Three Acts of Goodness School because they believe it provides a solid moral foundation for their future.

sentences.zh: 參與三好運動，是促進社會和諧的重要舉措。
sentences.en: Participating in the Three Acts of Goodness Campaign is an important step in promoting social harmony.

sentences.zh: 三好運動提倡做好事、說好話、存好心。
sentences.en: The Three Acts of Goodness Campaign advocates doing good deeds, speaking good words, and holding good thoughts.

sentences.zh: 許多學校和社區都加入了三好運動，志願者的數量不斷增加。
sentences.en: Many schools and communities have joined the Three Acts of Goodness Campaign, and the number of volunteers keeps increasing.

sentences.zh: 參加三好運動的人們認為，這是一種改善自己和周圍世界的有力方式。
sentences.en: People who participate in the Three Acts of Goodness Campaign believe it is an effective way to improve themselves and the world around them.

sentences.zh: 在地震的災後重建中，僧伽救護隊發揮了重要作用，為受災群眾提供了急需的援助。
sentences.en: In the post-earthquake reconstruction, the Monastic Rescue Team played a critical role, providing essential aid to the affected communities.

sentences.zh: 僧伽救護隊經常參與各類人道救援行動，在災難發生時迅速反應。
sentences.en: The Monastic Rescue Team frequently participates in various humanitarian missions, swiftly responding in times of disaster.

sentences.zh: 這支僧伽救護隊由一群訓練有素的僧侶組成，他們不僅具備醫療知識，還掌握心理輔導技能。
sentences.en: This Monastic Rescue Team is composed of a group of well-trained monks who not only possess medical knowledge but also are skilled in psychological counseling.

sentences.zh: 在洪水肆虐的地區，僧伽救護隊冒著生命危險，成功救出了數百名被困難民。
sentences.en: In flood-stricken areas, the Monastic Rescue Team risked their lives and successfully rescued hundreds of stranded refugees.

sentences.zh: 僧臘指的是一個僧人在寺院中修行的年資，是衡量地位和資歷的重要標準。
sentences.en: Monastic seniority refers to the number of years a monk has spent practicing in the monastery, serving as a crucial measure of status and experience.

sentences.zh: 在這個寺院中，僧臘較高的僧人通常被賦予更多的責任和領導角色。
sentences.en: In this monastery, monks with higher monastic seniority are usually given more responsibilities and leadership roles.

sentences.zh: 他的僧臘雖然尚淺，但他對佛法的理解已經非常深厚。
sentences.en: Although his monastic seniority is still low, his understanding of Dharma is already very profound.

sentences.zh: 僧臘增加不僅僅是歲月的累積，還包括智慧和修行上的成長。
sentences.en: Increasing monastic seniority is not just an accumulation of years, but also a growth in wisdom and practice.

phrase.en: monastic affairs are decided by monastics

sentences.zh: 在這座寺廟裡，所有的僧事僧決，沒有任何外界的干涉。
sentences.en: In this monastery, all monastic affairs are decided by monastics without any external interference.

sentences.zh: 僧團強調僧事僧決，以確保決策的純粹性和一致性。
sentences.en: The monastic community emphasizes that monastic affairs are decided by monastics to ensure purity and consistency in decision-making.

sentences.zh: 任何關於僧院管理的重大事項，必須遵循僧事僧決的原則。
sentences.en: Any significant issues concerning the management of the monastery must follow the principle that monastic affairs are decided by monastics.

sentences.zh: 僧事僧決的傳統源遠流長，保持了佛教教義的完整性。
sentences.en: The tradition that monastic affairs are decided by monastics has a long history and maintains the integrity of Buddhist teachings.

sentences.zh: 法會上，僧信二眾共同祈禱世界和平。
sentences.en: During the Dharma assembly, both the monastic and lay assemblies prayed together for world peace.

sentences.zh: 此寺廟規模宏大，僧信二眾經常在此舉行共修。
sentences.en: This temple is vast in scale, and the monastic and lay assemblies often conduct joint practices here.

sentences.zh: 僧信二眾和諧共處，共同護持佛法的弘揚。
sentences.en: The monastic and lay assemblies live harmoniously together, jointly supporting the propagation of the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 僧信二眾參加了這次研討會，深入討論佛教經典。
sentences.en: Both the monastic and lay assemblies participated in the seminar, engaging in deep discussions on Buddhist scriptures.

sentences.zh: 沙彌學園以其嚴謹的培訓課程著稱，吸引了來自世界各地的年輕僧侶。
sentences.en: Sramanera College is renowned for its rigorous training programs, attracting young monks from all over the world.

sentences.zh: 在沙彌學園，學生們學習經典和佛教儀式，以準備他們的未來宗教生活。
sentences.en: At Sramanera College, students study scriptures and Buddhist rituals to prepare for their future religious life.

sentences.zh: 沙彌學園的課程不僅包括宗教知識，還強調道德修養和自我紀律。
sentences.en: The curriculum at Sramanera College includes not only religious knowledge but also emphasizes moral cultivation and self-discipline.

sentences.zh: 許多畢業於沙彌學園的僧侶日後成為了受人尊敬的佛教領袖。
sentences.en: Many monks who graduated from Sramanera College later became respected Buddhist leaders.

phrase.en: attain awakening and liberate living beings; reach high and care for all

sentences.zh: 他的修行目標是上弘下化，希望能夠達到覺悟並幫助眾生解脫。
sentences.en: His practice aims to attain awakening and liberate living beings, with the hope of reaching enlightenment and assisting others to attain freedom from suffering.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒應該上弘下化，不但提升自己的智慧，還要關愛所有有情眾生。
sentences.en: Buddhists should reach high and care for all, not only enhancing their own wisdom but also showing compassion to all sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 在修行的過程中，他一直秉持上弘下化的精神，以求自利利他。
sentences.en: Throughout his spiritual practice, he has consistently upheld the principle of attaining awakening and liberating living beings, striving for self-benefit and benefiting others.

sentences.zh: 上弘下化的理念提醒我們，修行不僅是個人的成就，更是對周圍眾生的責任。
sentences.en: The concept of reaching high and caring for all reminds us that spiritual practice is not just about personal achievement, but also a responsibility towards the beings around us.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們，施比受更有福，因為施予帶來內心的喜悅和平安。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us that giving is greater than receiving because it brings inner joy and peace.

sentences.zh: 在節日期間，記住施比受更有福的精神，分享你的愛和祝福。
sentences.en: During the holiday season, remember the spirit that giving is greater than receiving by sharing your love and blessings.

sentences.zh: 經驗告訴我們，施比受更有福，因為幫助他人能夠提升自我價值。
sentences.en: Experience tells us that giving is greater than receiving as helping others enhances our sense of self-worth.

sentences.zh: 她總是堅信施比受更有福，並經常為需要幫助的人提供援助。
sentences.en: She always believes that giving is greater than receiving and often provides assistance to those in need.

en: alternation of generations
handing down of the baton

sentences.zh: 這個家族企業經歷了多次世代交替，仍然保持著它的繁榮。
sentences.en: This family business has remained prosperous despite undergoing multiple alternations of generations.

sentences.zh: 在自然界中，某些植物經歷了世代交替來完成生長週期。
sentences.en: In nature, certain plants undergo alternation of generations to complete their life cycles.

sentences.zh: 古老的文化通過世代交替傳承下來，不斷豐富和發展。
sentences.en: Ancient cultures have been handed down through generations, constantly enriching and evolving.

sentences.zh: 領導層的世代交替對公司的未來至關重要。
sentences.en: The alternation of generations in leadership is crucial to the future of the company.

sentences.zh: 十方叢林是一個歡迎世界各地僧侶來修行的地方。
sentences.en: The monastery of the ten directions is a place that welcomes monks from all over the world to practice.

sentences.zh: 在十方叢林中，僧侶們共同生活，互相學習，彼此支持。
sentences.en: In the monastery of the ten directions, monks live together, learn from each other, and provide mutual support.

sentences.zh: 這座十方叢林以其開放包容的精神，吸引著眾多修行者。
sentences.en: This monastery of the ten directions attracts many practitioners with its spirit of openness and inclusivity.

sentences.zh: 我們的禪修旅行包括參訪多座著名的十方叢林。
sentences.en: Our meditation tour includes visits to several renowned monasteries of the ten directions.

sentences.zh: 師姑室負責處理廟宇裡的所有日常事務。
sentences.en: The Lay Staff Affairs Office is responsible for handling all the daily affairs of the temple.

sentences.zh: 王先生最近在師姑室擔任義工，協助管理活動。
sentences.en: Mr. Wang recently volunteered at the Lay Staff Affairs Office to help manage activities.

sentences.zh: 師姑室的工作人員每月都會舉行一次會議，以確保流暢的運作。
sentences.en: The staff at the Lay Staff Affairs Office holds a monthly meeting to ensure smooth operations.

sentences.zh: 每當有新的義工加入，師姑室都會安排培訓和指導。
sentences.en: Whenever new volunteers join, the Lay Staff Affairs Office arranges training and guidance.

sentences.zh: 這個夏天，我將參加世界佛學會考，希望能夠通過考試增進對佛法的理解。
sentences.en: This summer, I will take the World Buddhist Exam, hoping to deepen my understanding of Dharma through the test.

sentences.zh: 世界佛學會考是世界各地佛教學者們評估學術水平的重要標準。
sentences.en: The World Buddhist Exam is an important benchmark for evaluating the academic level of Buddhist scholars around the world.

sentences.zh: 通過世界佛學會考需要長期的經典研究和實踐體驗。
sentences.en: Passing the World Buddhist Exam requires long-term study of the scriptures and practical experience.

sentences.zh: 每年，成千上萬的僧侶和居士參加世界佛學會考，測試他們在佛學方面的知識和修養。
sentences.en: Each year, tens of thousands of monks and laypeople take the World Buddhist Exam to test their knowledge and cultivation in Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 在研討會上，法師為大家唱誦了《十修歌》，帶給大家無比的平靜與啟示。
sentences.en: During the seminar, the master chanted the 'Song of the Ten Practices,' bringing immense peace and inspiration to everyone.

sentences.zh: 《十修歌》是佛教經典之一，內容深奧且充滿智慧。
sentences.en: The 'Song of the Ten Practices' is one of the Buddhist classics, rich in depth and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 每當心情煩躁時，我總會聽《十修歌》來沉澱心靈。
sentences.en: Whenever I feel agitated, I always listen to the 'Song of the Ten Practices' to calm my mind.

sentences.zh: 《十修歌》中的教誨幫助我在生活中實踐佛法，提升自我。
sentences.en: The teachings in the 'Song of the Ten Practices' help me practice Buddhism in daily life and elevate myself.

phrase.en: fragrance of books filling the world

sentences.zh: 學校圖書館新開張，書香滿人間，學生們紛紛前來借閱好書。
sentences.en: The school library has just opened, with the fragrance of books filling the world, attracting many students to borrow quality books.

sentences.zh: 書店舉辦了一場讀書會，讓書香滿人間，參與者們都陶醉在書籍的世界中。
sentences.en: The bookstore held a reading club event, letting the fragrance of books fill the world, and the participants were all immersed in the world of books.

sentences.zh: 這個城鎮以它的眾多書店聞名，宛如書香滿人間的樂園。
sentences.en: This town is famous for its numerous bookstores, resembling a paradise where the fragrance of books fills the world.

sentences.zh: 圖書館致力於推廣閱讀，書香滿人間，不斷增添更多優秀的書籍。
sentences.en: The library is dedicated to promoting reading, with the fragrance of books filling the world, continually adding more outstanding books.

sentences.zh: 老書店裡洋溢著濃厚的書香味，讓人一踏進去就感到心曠神怡。
sentences.en: The old bookstore was filled with the rich fragrance of books, instantly making anyone who steps in feel relaxed and at peace.

sentences.zh: 他在圖書館找到了心靈的歸屬，享受著每頁書本獨特的書香味。
sentences.en: He found solace in the library, enjoying the unique fragrance of books on every page.

sentences.zh: 她最愛在下雨天坐在窗邊閱讀，與書本的書香味共度安靜的午後。
sentences.en: She loved to sit by the window reading on rainy afternoons, sharing the quiet moments with the fragrance of books.

sentences.zh: 書架上的每一本書都充滿了故事和書香味，承載著讀者的夢想與希望。
sentences.en: Each book on the shelf was filled with stories and the fragrance of books, carrying the dreams and hopes of readers.

sentences.zh: 該寺廟監督條例旨在確保所有佛教寺廟的管理都符合規範。
sentences.en: The Regulation of Supervising Temples aims to ensure that all Buddhist temples are managed according to standards.

sentences.zh: 在寺廟監督條例下，每個寺廟必須每月提交財務報告。
sentences.en: Under the Regulation of Supervising Temples, each temple must submit a financial report monthly.

sentences.zh: 遵循寺廟監督條例，寺廟開放時間需提前公佈並嚴格遵守。
sentences.en: Following the Regulation of Supervising Temples, the opening hours of temples must be announced in advance and strictly observed.

sentences.zh: 寺廟監督條例還包括一套關於環境保護的指導方針，確保寺廟周圍的環境不受破壞。
sentences.en: The Regulation of Supervising Temples also includes a set of guidelines on environmental protection to ensure the surroundings of the temples are not damaged.

sentences.zh: 寺院本土化是一個重要的過程，有助於佛教在世界各地的發展。
sentences.en: The localization of temples is an important process that aids the development of Buddhism around the world.

sentences.zh: 透過寺院本土化，當地民眾能更容易接受並理解佛教教義。
sentences.en: Through the localization of temples, local populations can more easily accept and understand Buddhist teachings.

sentences.zh: 寺院本土化需要考慮到文化、語言和風俗習慣的差異。
sentences.en: The localization of temples needs to take into account differences in culture, language, and customs.

sentences.zh: 許多寺院通過本土化措施，已經成功地融入到當地社區中。
sentences.en: Many temples have successfully integrated into local communities through localization measures.

sentences.zh: 上週末，我參加了一個寺院生活體驗營，感受到了佛教修行的寧靜和莊嚴。
sentences.en: Last weekend, I participated in a weekend temple retreat and experienced the tranquility and solemnity of Buddhist practice.

sentences.zh: 在這個寺院生活體驗營中，我們學習了默觀冥想以及基本的禪修技巧。
sentences.en: During the weekend temple retreat, we learned mindfulness meditation and basic Zen techniques.

sentences.zh: 這次寺院生活體驗營幫助我放鬆心情，更深刻地理解了佛法的智慧。
sentences.en: This weekend temple retreat helped me relax and gain a deeper understanding of the wisdom of Dharma.

sentences.zh: 如果你感到生活壓力沉重，不妨參加一個寺院生活體驗營來重整身心。
sentences.en: If you feel overwhelmed by life's pressures, consider joining a weekend temple retreat to rejuvenate both body and mind.

sentences.zh: 佛教寺院學校化的努力，為無數孩子們提供了免費的教育資源。
sentences.en: The efforts towards monasteries functioning as schools have provided free educational resources to countless children.

sentences.zh: 許多偏遠地區的寺院學校化項目大大提升了當地的識字率。
sentences.en: Many monastery-school projects in remote areas have significantly improved the local literacy rates.

sentences.zh: 寺院學校化是佛教慈善事業的一部分，這些寺院不僅傳授宗教教育，也教授科學和人文學科。
sentences.en: The monasteries functioning as schools are a part of Buddhist charity work, offering not just religious education, but also teaching science and humanities.

sentences.zh: 政府支持寺院學校化計劃，旨在縮小城鄉教育差距。
sentences.en: The government supports the project of monasteries functioning as schools, aiming to bridge the educational gap between urban and rural areas.

phrase.zh: 隨緣不變 不變隨緣
phrase.en: Remain flexible yet unchanging; remain unchanging yet flexible

sentences.zh: 在修行的過程中，要學會隨緣不變，不變隨緣，這樣才能真正達到內心的安寧。
sentences.en: In the process of spiritual cultivation, one must learn to remain flexible yet unchanging; remain unchanging yet flexible to truly attain inner peace.

sentences.zh: 面對生活的變化，我們應以隨緣不變、不變隨緣的態度來應對，這樣才能穩步前行。
sentences.en: When facing life changes, we should adopt the attitude of remaining flexible yet unchanging; remain unchanging yet flexible, to progress steadily.

sentences.zh: 在處理人際關係時，隨緣不變 不變隨緣的智慧可以幫助我們保持冷靜和理性。
sentences.en: In handling interpersonal relationships, the wisdom of remaining flexible yet unchanging; remaining unchanging yet flexible can help us stay calm and rational.

sentences.zh: 他以隨緣不變 不變隨緣的心態面對困難，最終成功克服了所有挑戰。
sentences.en: He faced difficulties with a mindset of remaining flexible yet unchanging; remaining unchanging yet flexible, and ultimately overcame all challenges.

sentences.zh: 台北別院是這座城市中最著名的佛教寺廟之一，每年吸引成千上萬的信徒。
sentences.en: The Taipei Branch Temple is one of the most famous Buddhist temples in the city, attracting thousands of devotees each year.

sentences.zh: 台北別院提供多種佛教課程，讓信徒可以深入學習佛法。
sentences.en: The Taipei Branch Temple offers various Buddhist courses, allowing devotees to delve deeper into the teachings of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 每逢重大佛教節日，台北別院都會舉行盛大的法會和祈福活動。
sentences.en: On major Buddhist holidays, the Taipei Branch Temple holds grand ceremonies and blessing activities.

sentences.zh: 台北別院的住持是一位資深的佛教學者，在國際上享有很高的聲望。
sentences.en: The abbot of the Taipei Branch Temple is an experienced Buddhist scholar, highly respected internationally.

phrase.en: South African Nan Hua Performing Arts Group

sentences.zh: 天龍隊在國際佛教節上表演，展示了他們精湛的技藝。
sentences.en: The South African Nan Hua Performing Arts Group performed at the International Buddhist Festival, showcasing their exquisite skills.

sentences.zh: 天龍隊的表演融合了傳統和現代元素，深受觀眾喜愛。
sentences.en: The performances by the South African Nan Hua Performing Arts Group blend traditional and contemporary elements, greatly appreciated by the audience.

sentences.zh: 南非的天龍隊不僅僅是一個表演團隊，還是一個文化大使，推廣佛教藝術。
sentences.en: The South African Nan Hua Performing Arts Group is not just a performing team, but also a cultural ambassador promoting Buddhist arts.

sentences.zh: 每年，南非的天龍隊都會在世界各地巡演，分享佛教文化的美麗與深奧。
sentences.en: Each year, the South African Nan Hua Performing Arts Group tours around the world, sharing the beauty and profundity of Buddhist culture.

sentences.zh: 天眼網路佛學院提供多種線上佛學課程，方便人們在家中學習。
sentences.en: Tienyen Buddhist eCollege offers a variety of online Buddhist courses, making it convenient for people to study from home.

sentences.zh: 通過天眼網路佛學院的直播課程，我們可以與世界各地的佛學教授交流。
sentences.en: Through live classes at Tienyen Buddhist eCollege, we can interact with Buddhist scholars from around the world.

sentences.zh: 天眼網路佛學院的學生來自不同國家，形成一個多元文化的學習社群。
sentences.en: Students at Tienyen Buddhist eCollege come from different countries, forming a multicultural learning community.

sentences.zh: 感謝天眼網路佛學院，我能夠靈活地安排學習時間，並同時完成其他工作。
sentences.en: Thanks to Tienyen Buddhist eCollege, I can flexibly schedule my study time while managing other work.

sentences.zh: 每年的秋季祭典，人們都會聚集在文殿參拜，祈求學業有成。
sentences.en: Every autumn festival, people gather at the Scholar’s Shrine to pray for academic success.

sentences.zh: 文殿內供奉著多位著名學者的牌位，吸引了無數文人雅士前來朝拜。
sentences.en: The Scholar’s Shrine enshrines tablets of many renowned scholars, attracting countless literati to come and pay their respects.

sentences.zh: 在文殿的庭院裡，學生們常常進行讀書會，交流學術心得。
sentences.en: In the courtyard of the Scholar’s Shrine, students often hold study groups to exchange academic insights.

sentences.zh: 父母帶著孩子來到文殿，希望孩子們能感受到書香氣息，激發學習的熱情。
sentences.en: Parents bring their children to the Scholar’s Shrine in hopes that they will absorb the atmosphere of scholarship and ignite their passion for learning.

sentences.zh: 佛教文物流通處是一個展示和流通各種珍貴佛教文物的場所。
sentences.en: The Buddhist Artifacts Center is a place for showcasing and circulating various precious Buddhist artifacts.

sentences.zh: 我們訪問了深圳的一個佛教文物流通處，收集了許多有價值的資料。
sentences.en: We visited a Buddhist Artifacts Center in Shenzhen and collected a lot of valuable information.

sentences.zh: 每年都有無數的信徒來到這個佛教文物流通處，尋求心靈的安慰。
sentences.en: Every year, countless devotees come to this Buddhist Artifacts Center, seeking spiritual solace.

sentences.zh: 佛教文物流通處最近舉辦了一場特別展覽，吸引了大量的學生和研究者。
sentences.en: The Buddhist Artifacts Center recently held a special exhibition that attracted a large number of students and researchers.

sentences.zh: 在這座古老的寺院內，有一座專供祭祀將軍的武殿。
sentences.en: Within this ancient temple, there is a General's Shrine dedicated to the worship of generals.

sentences.zh: 每年都有很多人來到這裡，為在歷史戰役中犧牲的將領們在武殿祈福。
sentences.en: Every year, many people come here to pray for the generals who sacrificed their lives in historical battles at the General's Shrine.

sentences.zh: 華麗的武殿內擺放著許多古老的武器和盔甲，展示了過去將軍們的英勇事蹟。
sentences.en: The opulent General's Shrine houses numerous ancient weapons and armor, showcasing the heroic deeds of past generals.

sentences.zh: 在重大的節日時，武殿會舉行隆重的祭祀儀式，吸引大量信徒參加。
sentences.en: During major festivals, the General's Shrine holds grand worship ceremonies that attract a large number of devotees.

phrase.en: even the inanimate teaches the Dharma

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，石頭和樹木也被認為是無情說法的例子，因為它們的存在本身就是一種啟示。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, stones and trees are considered examples of even the inanimate teaching the Dharma, as their existence itself is a revelation.

sentences.zh: 無情說法提醒人們，一切萬物都在提示我們諸法實相的智慧。
sentences.en: The concept of even the inanimate teaching the Dharma reminds people that all things are hinting at the wisdom of the true nature of phenomena.

sentences.zh: 古老的寺廟和自然景觀給予遊客一種無情說法的體驗，讓他們感受到深層次的靈性聯繫。
sentences.en: Ancient temples and natural landscapes offer visitors an experience of even the inanimate teaching the Dharma, allowing them to feel a profound spiritual connection.

sentences.zh: 透過觀察大自然，我們可以領悟到無情說法的道理，從而增長我們的智慧和慈悲心。
sentences.en: By observing nature, we can understand the principle of even the inanimate teaching the Dharma, thereby increasing our wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 佛教的五院十會制度旨在完善佛教組織，促進教內各部門的協調與合作。
sentences.en: The system of Five Councils and Ten Committees in Buddhism aims to perfect the organizational structure and promote coordination and cooperation among different departments.

sentences.zh: 在五院十會管理下，寺廟的運作變得更加有序和有效。
sentences.en: Under the management of the Five Councils and Ten Committees, the temple's operations have become more orderly and efficient.

sentences.zh: 五院十會為解決僧團內部的各種問題提供了一個有力的機制。
sentences.en: The Five Councils and Ten Committees provide a robust mechanism for resolving various issues within the monastic community.

sentences.zh: 他們遵循五院十會的指導方針，確保教義的正確傳播和僧侶的生活規律。
sentences.en: They follow the guidelines of the Five Councils and Ten Committees to ensure the correct transmission of doctrines and the disciplined lives of the monks.

sentences.zh: 在送別會上，他們唱了一首感人的惜別歌。
sentences.en: At the farewell party, they sang a touching farewell song.

sentences.zh: 這首惜別歌讓大家都流下了眼淚。
sentences.en: The farewell song brought tears to everyone's eyes.

sentences.zh: 學長在畢業儀式上的惜別歌深深感動了所有人。
sentences.en: The farewell song performed by the senior at the graduation ceremony deeply moved everyone.

sentences.zh: 即使多年後，每當聽到這首惜別歌，他仍會想起與朋友們的珍貴回憶。
sentences.en: Even years later, whenever he heard the farewell song, he would recall the precious memories with his friends.

sentences.zh: 我們在西單的佛教中心見面，一起參加了晚間的禪修課程。
sentences.en: We met at the Buddhist center in the West Wing and attended the evening meditation session together.

sentences.zh: 西單圖書館有一個很大的佛教文獻收藏，對研究者來說非常有用。
sentences.en: The West Wing library has a large collection of Buddhist literature, which is extremely useful for researchers.

sentences.zh: 西單的金色佛像在陽光下閃閃發光，讓人感受到無限的平靜和安寧。
sentences.en: The golden Buddha statue in the West Wing gleams under the sunlight, providing a sense of infinite peace and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 在西單的禪房中，我們經歷了一次深刻的內觀冥想，感受到內心的安寧。
sentences.en: In the meditation room in the West Wing, we experienced a profound session of Vipassana meditation, feeling a deep sense of inner peace.

phrase.en: University of the West (formerly Hsi Lai University)

sentences.zh: 他在西來大學完成了他的碩士學位，專攻佛教研究。
sentences.en: He completed his master's degree at University of the West (formerly Hsi Lai University), specializing in Buddhist studies.

sentences.zh: 西來大學（原名西來佛學院）致力於提供高品質的佛教教育。
sentences.en: University of the West (formerly Hsi Lai University) is dedicated to providing high-quality Buddhist education.

sentences.zh: 當我訪問洛杉磯時，我參觀了西來大學的校園，並對那裡的學術氛圍留下深刻印象。
sentences.en: When I visited Los Angeles, I toured the campus of University of the West (formerly Hsi Lai University) and was deeply impressed by the academic atmosphere there.

sentences.zh: 西來大學吸引了來自世界各地的學生，形成了一個多元文化的學習環境。
sentences.en: University of the West (formerly Hsi Lai University) attracts students from all over the world, creating a multicultural learning environment.

sentences.zh: 他們的家總是充滿了笑聲和音樂，真是一個喜慶之家。
sentences.en: Their home is always filled with laughter and music, truly a home for celebration.

sentences.zh: 過節期間，他們把自己的房子裝飾得如同一個喜慶之家。
sentences.en: During the holidays, they decorated their house to make it look like a home for celebration.

sentences.zh: 每當有喜事發生，他們的家就會成為親朋好友聚集的喜慶之家。
sentences.en: Whenever there's a joyful event, their home becomes a home for celebration where friends and family gather.

sentences.zh: 這個家庭以其溫馨和諧聞名，是附近人們心中的喜慶之家。
sentences.en: This family is famous for their warmth and harmony and is considered a home for celebration by the neighbors.

sentences.zh: 香海社團每年舉辦多次靜坐修行活動，吸引了許多佛教信徒參加。
sentences.en: The Gandha Buddhist Society holds several meditation retreats every year, attracting numerous Buddhist practitioners to join.

sentences.zh: 香海社團以弘揚佛法為宗旨，致力於推廣慈悲和智慧的理念。
sentences.en: The Gandha Buddhist Society aims to spread the teachings of Buddhism, focusing on promoting the principles of compassion and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 香海社團的成員來自各行各業，他們共同努力推動社會和諧與精神成長。
sentences.en: The members of the Gandha Buddhist Society come from various walks of life, collectively working towards social harmony and spiritual growth.

sentences.zh: 香海社團提供免費的佛學課程，幫助大眾深入了解佛教教義。
sentences.en: The Gandha Buddhist Society offers free Buddhist studies courses, helping the public gain a deeper understanding of Buddhist doctrines.

sentences.zh: 昨天寺廟舉行了一場盛大的香會，吸引了上百名信徒前來參加。
sentences.en: Yesterday, the temple held a grand devotees' gathering that attracted hundreds of followers.

sentences.zh: 每年農曆新年期間，香會都是寺廟的重頭戲，信徒們前來祈福。
sentences.en: During the Lunar New Year, the devotees' gathering is a highlight at the temple, where followers come to seek blessings.

sentences.zh: 在香會上，大家一同念誦經文，氛圍莊嚴肅穆。
sentences.en: During the devotees' gathering, everyone recited scriptures together, creating a solemn and respectful atmosphere.

sentences.zh: 香會是一個增進信徒之間聯繫的重要機會，大家可以互相交流修行的心得。
sentences.en: The devotees' gathering is an important opportunity to strengthen the bond among followers, allowing them to exchange insights on their spiritual practices.

sentences.zh: 每年都有成千上萬的香客來到這座古老的寺廟祈福。
sentences.en: Every year, thousands of pilgrims come to this ancient temple to pray for blessings.

sentences.zh: 這些香客步行數日，以表達他們的虔誠之心。
sentences.en: These pilgrims walk for days to express their devout faith.

sentences.zh: 寺廟為香客提供了免費的膳食和住宿。
sentences.en: The temple provides free meals and lodging for the pilgrims.

sentences.zh: 香客在祭壇前獻上香火和鮮花，祈求家人平安。
sentences.en: Pilgrims offer incense and flowers at the altar, praying for their family's safety.

sentences.zh: 這次朝聖活動的香頭帶領著一群虔誠的信徒，每天早晨誦經。
sentences.en: The pilgrimage leader guided a group of devout followers, chanting scriptures every morning.

sentences.zh: 香頭的德行受到信眾的尊敬和愛戴，他們願意跟隨他的腳步走遍聖地。
sentences.en: The pilgrimage leader's virtues were respected and admired by the followers, who were willing to follow in his footsteps through the holy sites.

sentences.zh: 作為香頭，他肩負著組織和安排整個朝聖之旅的重任。
sentences.en: As the pilgrimage leader, he bore the responsibility of organizing and arranging the entire pilgrimage journey.

sentences.zh: 香頭親自挑選了每個停留的寺廟，確保朝聖者在旅途中獲得最好的修行體驗。
sentences.en: The pilgrimage leader personally selected each temple stop, ensuring that the pilgrims received the best spiritual experience during their journey.

sentences.zh: 寺廟裡的香油錢主要用於修繕和日常運營。
sentences.en: The donation money at the temple is mainly used for repairs and daily operations.

sentences.zh: 每一筆香油錢都代表著信徒虔誠的信仰和對佛法的支持。
sentences.en: Each donation represents the devout faith and support for the Dharma from the devotees.

sentences.zh: 他每次來寺廟參拜時都會捐出香油錢，以表達對菩薩的感恩之情。
sentences.en: He gives a donation every time he visits the temple to express his gratitude to the Bodhisattva.

sentences.zh: 寺廟管理人員每天都會統計收到的香油錢，並妥善管理。
sentences.en: The temple staff tally the donations received each day and manage them properly.

phrase.en: The Mind is Like a Painter

sentences.zh: 在禪修的靜坐中，我們可以觀察到心如工畫師般描繪出無數的念頭和景象。
sentences.en: During silent meditation, we can observe how the mind, like a painter, creates countless thoughts and images.

sentences.zh: 佛教經典常說，心如工畫師，能創造出我們的現實經驗。
sentences.en: Buddhist scriptures often state that the mind is like a painter, capable of creating our reality.

sentences.zh: 就像心如工畫師一般，我們的思想和情感會影響我們的行動和生活。
sentences.en: Just as the mind is like a painter, our thoughts and emotions influence our actions and lives.

sentences.zh: 通過修行，我們可以令心如工畫師般描繪出和平與慈悲的景象。
sentences.en: Through practice, we can let the mind, like a painter, depict scenes of peace and compassion.

sentences.zh: 每年這個時候，寺廟都會舉行盛大的信徒大會，吸引來自世界各地的信眾。
sentences.en: Every year at this time, the temple hosts a grand devotees' gathering, attracting believers from all over the world.

sentences.zh: 信徒大會是佛教徒分享心得和交流修行經驗的重要機會。
sentences.en: The devotees' gathering is an important opportunity for Buddhists to share insights and exchange experiences in practice.

sentences.zh: 今年的信徒大會將包括一系列的講座和禪修活動，旨在提高精神觉悟。
sentences.en: This year's devotees' gathering will include a series of lectures and meditation sessions aimed at enhancing spiritual awareness.

sentences.zh: 在信徒大會上，大家共同唱誦經文，感受強烈的集體力量和內心的平靜。
sentences.en: At the devotees' gathering, everyone chants the scriptures together, feeling a strong sense of collective power and inner peace.

sentences.zh: 在佛教大會上，信徒代表發表了感人的演講，分享了他的修行心得。
sentences.en: At the Buddhist conference, the devotees' representative gave a touching speech, sharing his insights on practice.

sentences.zh: 這位信徒代表經常組織寺廟活動，並帶領其他信徒參加義工服務。
sentences.en: The devotees' representative frequently organizes temple activities and leads other devotees in volunteer services.

sentences.zh: 作為信徒代表，她的責任是確保信眾的意見和需求得到寺院的重視。
sentences.en: As the devotees' representative, her responsibility is to ensure that the opinions and needs of the followers are considered by the temple.

sentences.zh: 信徒代表在年度會議中傳達了大家的願望，希望能夠更好地推廣佛教教義。
sentences.en: The devotees' representative conveyed everyone's wishes at the annual meeting, hoping to better promote Buddhist teachings.

sentences.zh: 這座寺院被稱為信徒之家，因為來自各地的信徒都聚集於此進行修行。
sentences.en: This temple is known as a Home for Devotees, as believers from all over gather here for their practice.

sentences.zh: 信徒之家提供了一個靜謐的環境，讓信仰者能夠安心禪修。
sentences.en: The Home for Devotees offers a serene environment where believers can meditate in peace.

sentences.zh: 在信徒之家，每個月都會舉辦各種佛教活動，吸引了許多虔誠的信徒。
sentences.en: Various Buddhist activities are held monthly at the Home for Devotees, attracting many devout followers.

sentences.zh: 多年來，信徒之家成為了無數人的心靈避風港，提共了安慰和心靈指引。
sentences.en: Over the years, the Home for Devotees has become a spiritual haven for countless individuals, providing comfort and guidance.

sentences.zh: 每天清晨，寺院的僧侶們會出外行腳托缽，接受信徒們的布施。
sentences.en: Every early morning, the monks from the monastery go out for an alms procession, receiving offerings from the devotees.

sentences.zh: 行腳托缽是一個讓僧侶與社會大眾互動的機會，並且提醒人們行善的重要性。
sentences.en: The alms procession is an opportunity for monks to interact with the community and remind people of the importance of charity.

sentences.zh: 在行腳托缽的過程中，僧侶們保持沉默，以表達對信徒的尊重和感謝。
sentences.en: During the alms procession, the monks remain silent to show respect and gratitude to the devotees.

sentences.zh: 有些信徒會專程早起，準備食物或其他供品，等待僧侶們行腳托缽經過他們的家門。
sentences.en: Some devotees wake up early specifically to prepare food or other offerings, waiting for the monks' alms procession to pass by their homes.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒需要在行門中實踐佛法，才能真正理解教義的深意。
sentences.en: Buddhists need to practice the teachings in practice to truly understand the profound meanings of the doctrine.

sentences.zh: 行門強調實踐的重要性，而不是僅僅停留在理論上。
sentences.en: Teaching in practice emphasizes the importance of action rather than just theoretical understanding.

sentences.zh: 透過行門，我們可以將佛法的智慧應用到日常生活中，改善自己的生活品質。
sentences.en: Through teaching in practice, we can apply Buddhist wisdom to our daily lives and improve our quality of life.

sentences.zh: 許多佛教徒在行門的過程中體驗到前所未有的心靈平靜與清明。
sentences.en: Many Buddhists experience unprecedented peace and clarity of mind during the process of teaching in practice.

phrase.en: Venerable Master Hsing Yun's One-Stroke Calligraphy

sentences.zh: 星雲大師一筆字的書法藝術極具禪意與智慧，深受各地佛教徒的推崇。
sentences.en: Venerable Master Hsing Yun's one-stroke calligraphy is imbued with Zen and wisdom, and is highly revered by Buddhists everywhere.

sentences.zh: 許多人來到佛光山，只為一睹星雲大師一筆字的風采，感受其獨特的魅力。
sentences.en: Many people visit Fo Guang Shan just to witness Venerable Master Hsing Yun's one-stroke calligraphy and experience its unique charm.

sentences.zh: 星雲大師一筆字的書法作品被認為是精神修行的一部分，它以簡潔而有力的線條傳達出深刻的佛理。
sentences.en: Venerable Master Hsing Yun's one-stroke calligraphy is considered a part of spiritual practice, conveying profound Buddhist principles through simple yet powerful strokes.

sentences.zh: 每次觀賞星雲大師一筆字的書法，我都能感受到其中的平靜與和諧，這正是佛教教義的精髓。
sentences.en: Every time I admire Venerable Master Hsing Yun's one-stroke calligraphy, I can feel the peace and harmony embodied within, which epitomizes the essence of Buddhist teachings.

sentences.zh: 每年的星雲教育獎都表彰那些對教育領域有傑出貢獻的個人。
sentences.en: The Hsing Yun Education Award honors individuals who have made outstanding contributions to the field of education each year.

sentences.zh: 她因在推廣國際佛教教育方面的努力而獲得星雲教育獎。
sentences.en: She received the Hsing Yun Education Award for her efforts in promoting international Buddhist education.

sentences.zh: 星雲教育獎旨在激勵更多人投身教育事業，提升全球教育水平。
sentences.en: The Hsing Yun Education Award aims to inspire more people to dedicate themselves to the field of education, thereby enhancing global educational standards.

sentences.zh: 星雲教育獎得主在頒獎典禮上分享了他們的教育理念和實踐經驗。
sentences.en: Recipients of the Hsing Yun Education Award shared their educational philosophies and practical experiences at the award ceremony.

sentences.zh: 星雲文學獎是為了表彰傑出的文學作品和作家而設立的。
sentences.en: The Hsing Yun Literature Award was established to honor outstanding literary works and authors.

sentences.zh: 她憑藉這本小說贏得了星雲文學獎，獲得了廣泛的認可。
sentences.en: She won The Hsing Yun Literature Award with this novel, gaining widespread recognition.

sentences.zh: 星雲文學獎的頒獎典禮每年都吸引了來自世界各地的文學愛好者。
sentences.en: The Hsing Yun Literature Award ceremony attracts literature enthusiasts from around the world every year.

sentences.zh: 參加星雲文學獎的競賽對於年輕的作家來說是一個重要的里程碑。
sentences.en: Participating in The Hsing Yun Literature Award competition is an important milestone for young authors.

sentences.zh: 這位行者每天都堅持打坐修行，以求達到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: This practitioner meditates daily in pursuit of inner peace.

sentences.zh: 行者們往往會到山中修行，以避免世俗的干擾。
sentences.en: Practitioners often retreat to the mountains to cultivate, avoiding worldly distractions.

sentences.zh: 作為一個行者，他每週都會參加佛教禪修課。
sentences.en: As a practitioner, he attends Buddhist meditation classes every week.

sentences.zh: 行者的生活方式簡樸而有紀律，並遵循佛法的教誨。
sentences.en: The practitioner's lifestyle is simple and disciplined, adhering to the teachings of the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 王先生被譽為義工的義工，因為他總是無私地為他人奉獻。
sentences.en: Mr. Wang is regarded as a volunteer's volunteer because he always selflessly dedicates himself to others.

sentences.zh: 在社區裡，李女士總是義工的義工，無論遇到什麼困難，她都毫不猶豫地幫助他人。
sentences.en: In the community, Ms. Li is always a volunteer's volunteer, never hesitating to help others no matter the difficulties.

sentences.zh: 他的無私奉獻使他成為人們心目中的義工的義工，讓大家深受感動。
sentences.en: His selfless dedication makes him a volunteer's volunteer in people's hearts, deeply moving everyone.

sentences.zh: 每次有緊急情況，她都是第一時間出現，成為真正的義工的義工。
sentences.en: Every time there's an emergency, she is the first to show up, truly becoming a volunteer's volunteer.

sentences.zh: 一九五三歌詠隊成立於那一年，成為許多青年僧侶的美好回憶。
sentences.en: The 1953 Buddhist Youth Choir was established in that year, becoming a fond memory for many young monks.

sentences.zh: 一九五三歌詠隊在寺院的慶典上首次亮相，獲得了大家的廣泛讚譽。
sentences.en: The 1953 Buddhist Youth Choir made their debut at the temple festival, earning widespread praise from everyone.

sentences.zh: 多年後，許多一九五三歌詠隊的成員仍然記得他們一起練習和演出的時光。
sentences.en: Years later, many members of the 1953 Buddhist Youth Choir still remember the times they practiced and performed together.

sentences.zh: 一九五三歌詠隊的成員們保持著深厚的友誼，儘管他們已經各奔前程。
sentences.en: The members of the 1953 Buddhist Youth Choir maintained close friendships, even though they had gone their separate ways.

sentences.zh: 在茶道中，一期一會的理念提醒我們每次茶聚都是獨一無二的經歷。
sentences.en: In the tea ceremony, the concept of 'Paths Only Cross Once' reminds us that each gathering is a unique experience.

sentences.zh: 他們在旅行中偶然相遇，深知這可能是一期一會的緣分。
sentences.en: They met by chance during their travels and understood that this might be a 'Paths Only Cross Once' encounter.

sentences.zh: 人生中的每次相會都是一期一會，要珍惜每一刻。
sentences.en: Every meeting in life is 'Paths Only Cross Once'; we must cherish each moment.

sentences.zh: 老師告訴我們，一期一會的理念應該提醒我們對每一天都心存感激。
sentences.en: Our teacher told us that the idea of 'Paths Only Cross Once' should remind us to be grateful for each day.

sentences.zh: 在因果福利社裡，顧客可以購買不同的善果作為對自己的激勵。
sentences.en: In the Cause and Effect Store, customers can purchase various good results as motivation for themselves.

sentences.zh: 這家因果福利社提倡積德行善，以期望未來有好的回報。
sentences.en: This Cause and Effect Store promotes doing good deeds with the hope of receiving good returns in the future.

sentences.zh: 因果福利社內部設有一個冥想室，讓人們反思自己的行為與其後果。
sentences.en: Inside the Cause and Effect Store, there is a meditation room for people to reflect on their actions and their consequences.

sentences.zh: 因果福利社的創立者相信每個購買都是一個善舉，將帶來正面的改變。
sentences.en: The founder of the Cause and Effect Store believes that each purchase is a good deed that will bring about positive change.

sentences.zh: 雲水護智車每日在城市各角落穿梭，提供心理健康輔導服務。
sentences.en: Mentality Protection Center Vehicles roam the city daily, providing mental health counseling services.

sentences.zh: 每當人們感到焦慮時，雲水護智車都能及時出現，給予他們所需的支持。
sentences.en: Whenever people feel anxious, the Mentality Protection Center Vehicles appear in a timely manner, offering the support they need.

sentences.zh: 雲水護智車的工作人員皆經過專業訓練，以確保他們能夠有效幫助有需要的人。
sentences.en: The staff of the Mentality Protection Center Vehicles are all professionally trained to ensure they can effectively assist those in need.

sentences.zh: 多虧了雲水護智車，許多面臨心理困境的人才能重新找到生活的希望。
sentences.en: Thanks to the Mentality Protection Center Vehicles, many individuals facing mental challenges have been able to find hope in life again.

sentences.zh: 雲水樓主是當地寺廟的住持，深受信徒們的敬仰。
sentences.en: Yunshui Louzhu is the abbot of the local temple and is deeply respected by the devotees.

sentences.zh: 在雲水樓主的指導下，許多人找到了內心的平靜與智慧。
sentences.en: Under the guidance of Yunshui Louzhu, many people have found inner peace and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 每日上午，雲水樓主都會親自帶領早課，教導大家禪修。
sentences.en: Every morning, Yunshui Louzhu personally leads the morning session, teaching everyone meditation.

sentences.zh: 許多遊客專程前來，只為能與雲水樓主面談，聽取他的開示。
sentences.en: Many tourists come from afar just to have an audience with Yunshui Louzhu and listen to his teachings.

phrase.en: Cloud and Water Mobile Library Trucks

sentences.zh: 雲水書車在鄉間來回行駛，為孩子們帶來知識和歡樂。
sentences.en: The Cloud and Water Mobile Library Trucks travel through the countryside, bringing knowledge and joy to the children.

sentences.zh: 每當雲水書車抵達村莊，村民們都會興高采烈地迎接它。
sentences.en: Whenever the Cloud and Water Mobile Library Trucks arrive in a village, the villagers greet them with great excitement.

sentences.zh: 雲水書車的志願者們不僅提供書籍，還進行教育講座和互動活動。
sentences.en: Volunteers of the Cloud and Water Mobile Library Trucks not only provide books but also conduct educational talks and interactive activities.

sentences.zh: 這些雲水書車項目旨在提升偏遠地區的閱讀水平。
sentences.en: These Cloud and Water Mobile Library Trucks projects aim to improve literacy in remote areas.

sentences.zh: 雲水書車行動圖書館正在訪問偏遠地區，為那裡的孩子們帶去閱讀的樂趣。
sentences.en: The Cloud and Water Mobile Library is visiting remote areas, bringing the joy of reading to the children there.

sentences.zh: 感谢雲水書車行動圖書館的志願者們，因為他們的努力，更多人可以接觸到優質的讀物。
sentences.en: Thanks to the volunteers of the Cloud and Water Mobile Library, more people have access to quality reading materials.

sentences.zh: 學校特別邀請了雲水書車行動圖書館，以激發學生們的閱讀興趣。
sentences.en: The school specially invited the Cloud and Water Mobile Library to inspire the students' interest in reading.

sentences.zh: 雲水書車行動圖書館提供了各種各樣的書籍，滿足了社區不同年齡層的閱讀需求。
sentences.en: The Cloud and Water Mobile Library offers a variety of books, meeting the reading needs of different age groups in the community.

sentences.zh: 雲水書坊在偏遠山區免費供應書籍，促進知識的傳播。
sentences.en: The Cloud and Water Mobile Library provides free books in remote mountainous areas, promoting the spread of knowledge.

sentences.zh: 每當雲水書坊停靠在村莊的時候，孩子們總是迫不及待地湧上去借書。
sentences.en: Whenever the Cloud and Water Mobile Library stops at a village, the children always eagerly rush to borrow books.

sentences.zh: 雲水書坊不僅是移動的圖書館，也是文化的傳遞者，讓鄉村的人們接觸到書籍的魅力。
sentences.en: The Cloud and Water Mobile Library is not just a mobile library but a cultural transmitter, bringing the charm of books to rural communities.

sentences.zh: 僧人們創建了雲水書坊，意圖通過書籍傳遞佛教智慧和平等的理念。
sentences.en: Monks established the Cloud and Water Mobile Library aiming to spread Buddhist wisdom and the concept of equality through books.

phrase.en: Travel Like the Clouds and Water

sentences.zh: 他過著雲水天下的生活，四處雲遊，隨遇而安。
sentences.en: He leads a life of traveling like the clouds and water, wandering freely and adapting to whatever comes his way.

sentences.zh: 這位僧人選擇雲水天下的修行方式，不在一處久留，追求內心的平靜與自由。
sentences.en: The monk chose to practice traveling like the clouds and water, never staying long in one place, seeking inner peace and freedom.

sentences.zh: 在繁忙的都市中，她渴望有一天能過上雲水天下的生活，探索自然的美麗。
sentences.en: In the bustling city, she yearns for the day she can live a life traveling like the clouds and water, exploring the beauty of nature.

sentences.zh: 他們兩人決定過一段雲水天下的日子，背上背包去追尋不一樣的生活體驗。
sentences.en: The two of them decided to spend some time traveling like the clouds and water, packing their bags to seek different life experiences.

phrase.en: traveling by foot like the flowing water and moving clouds

sentences.zh: 僧侶們常常雲水行腳，四處行化，以傳遞佛法。
sentences.en: Monks often travel by foot like the flowing water and moving clouds, wandering to spread the teachings of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 他決定雲水行腳，不帶任何行李，只為尋求內心的平靜與智慧。
sentences.en: He decided to travel by foot like the flowing water and moving clouds, carrying no luggage, only seeking inner peace and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 雲水行腳是一種修行的方法，讓人在旅途中領悟生命的真諦。
sentences.en: Traveling by foot like the flowing water and moving clouds is a form of practice, allowing one to realize the true essence of life during the journey.

sentences.zh: 許多人抱著雲水行腳的心態，漫遊天地，親身經歷自然的美妙。
sentences.en: Many people adopt the mindset of traveling by foot like the flowing water and moving clouds, wandering around the world to personally experience the wonders of nature.

sentences.zh: 雲水醫療車深入偏遠地區，為當地居民提供免費醫療服務。
sentences.en: The Cloud and Water Mobile Clinic travels to remote areas, offering free medical services to local residents.

sentences.zh: 志工們在雲水醫療車裡工作，為病患提供全方位的醫療照顧。
sentences.en: Volunteers work in the Cloud and Water Mobile Clinic, providing comprehensive medical care to patients.

sentences.zh: 這輛雲水醫療車配備了現代化的醫療設備，能夠處理各種常見的健康問題。
sentences.en: Equipped with modern medical facilities, the Cloud and Water Mobile Clinic can handle a variety of common health issues.

sentences.zh: 雲水醫療車的宗旨是傳播佛教慈悲精神，通過醫療幫助來減輕人們的痛苦。
sentences.en: The mission of the Cloud and Water Mobile Clinic is to spread the spirit of Buddhist compassion by alleviating people’s suffering through medical assistance.

phrase.en: Truthful, Virtuous, and Beautiful Media Awards

sentences.zh: 他因在新聞報導中展現的誠信和道德而獲得了真善美傳播貢獻獎。
sentences.en: He received the Truthful, Virtuous, and Beautiful Media Awards for his integrity and ethics in news reporting.

sentences.zh: 這部紀錄片憑藉真實的敘述和藝術的表現榮獲了真善美傳播貢獻獎。
sentences.en: The documentary won the Truthful, Virtuous, and Beautiful Media Awards for its truthful narrative and artistic execution.

sentences.zh: 該雜誌致力於倡導社會正義，最終獲得了真善美傳播貢獻獎。
sentences.en: The magazine, dedicated to promoting social justice, eventually earned the Truthful, Virtuous, and Beautiful Media Awards.

sentences.zh: 他們的廣告宣傳以誠信為基礎，贏得了真善美傳播貢獻獎。
sentences.en: Their advertising campaign, based on honesty, won the Truthful, Virtuous, and Beautiful Media Awards.

phrase.en: Truthful, Virtuous, and Beautiful Media Awards

sentences.zh: 他們因為在報導中展現出真實性、善良和美感而榮獲了真善美媒體貢獻獎。
sentences.en: They received the Truthful, Virtuous, and Beautiful Media Awards for showcasing truthfulness, kindness, and beauty in their reporting.

sentences.zh: 真善美媒體貢獻獎旨在表彰那些在媒體中推廣正面價值觀的突出貢獻者。
sentences.en: The Truthful, Virtuous, and Beautiful Media Awards aim to recognize outstanding contributors who promote positive values in the media.

sentences.zh: 新聞機構通過獲得真善美媒體貢獻獎，加強了其在公眾心中的信任度。
sentences.en: By receiving the Truthful, Virtuous, and Beautiful Media Awards, the news organization enhanced its credibility with the public.

sentences.zh: 今年的真善美媒體貢獻獎將會頒發給那些以負責任的態度報導社會問題的記者。
sentences.en: This year's Truthful, Virtuous, and Beautiful Media Awards will be given to journalists who report on social issues with a responsible attitude.

sentences.zh: 志開上人是一位備受尊敬的佛教僧侶，以其深厚的修行和智慧聞名。
sentences.en: Venerable Master Zhi Kai is a highly respected Buddhist monk, known for his profound practice and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 許多人前來聽取志開上人的教誨，尋求心靈的平靜和啟迪。
sentences.en: Many people come to hear Venerable Master Zhi Kai's teachings, seeking peace of mind and enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 在他的一生中，志開上人致力於弘揚佛法，培養無數的弟子。
sentences.en: Throughout his life, Venerable Master Zhi Kai devoted himself to spreading the Dharma, mentoring countless disciples.

sentences.zh: 志開上人的著作被翻譯成多種語言，廣泛流傳於世界各地。
sentences.en: The writings of Venerable Master Zhi Kai have been translated into many languages and are widely disseminated around the world.

sentences.zh: 知客師負責接待寺廟來訪的客人，並回答他們的問題。
sentences.en: The receptionist is responsible for greeting visitors to the temple and answering their questions.

sentences.zh: 每位新進的訪客都會由知客師安排住宿和餐飲。
sentences.en: Every new visitor will have their accommodation and meals arranged by the receptionist.

sentences.zh: 作為寺廟的知客師，他每日都忙於處理無數的拜訪和查詢。
sentences.en: As the temple's receptionist, he is busy handling numerous visits and inquiries every day.

sentences.zh: 知客師需要具備良好的溝通技巧，以便有效地輔助來訪者。
sentences.en: The receptionist needs to have excellent communication skills to effectively assist visitors.

phrase.zh: 中國佛教白話經典寶藏
phrase.en: Selected Chinese Buddhist Texts in Modern Language

sentences.zh: 這本書是中國佛教白話經典寶藏的一部分，讓現代讀者更容易理解古老的智慧。
sentences.en: This book is part of the Selected Chinese Buddhist Texts in Modern Language, making ancient wisdom more accessible to contemporary readers.

sentences.zh: 學者們花費數十年時間編纂這部中國佛教白話經典寶藏，以保存和傳承佛教文化。
sentences.en: Scholars spent decades compiling the Selected Chinese Buddhist Texts in Modern Language to preserve and transmit Buddhist culture.

sentences.zh: 通過閱讀中國佛教白話經典寶藏，人們能夠更好地理解和應用佛教的教義。
sentences.en: Through reading the Selected Chinese Buddhist Texts in Modern Language, people can better understand and apply Buddhist teachings.

sentences.zh: 這一系列中國佛教白話經典寶藏的出版對於推動佛教思想的普及具有重大意義。
sentences.en: The publication of this series of Selected Chinese Buddhist Texts in Modern Language is significant for promoting the dissemination of Buddhist thought.

phrase.en: Chunghua Federation of Traditional Religious Associations

sentences.zh: 中華傳統宗教總會致力於推廣傳統文化與宗教信仰。
sentences.en: The Chunghua Federation of Traditional Religious Associations is dedicated to promoting traditional culture and religious beliefs.

sentences.zh: 中華傳統宗教總會經常舉辦各類講座和活動，吸引了眾多信眾參與。
sentences.en: The Chunghua Federation of Traditional Religious Associations frequently organizes various lectures and events, attracting numerous followers.

sentences.zh: 中華傳統宗教總會成立於1990年，旨在保護和發揚各地的宗教文化。
sentences.en: The Chunghua Federation of Traditional Religious Associations was established in 1990 with the aim of preserving and promoting regional religious cultures.

sentences.zh: 中華傳統宗教總會與多個國際宗教組織合作，共同推動世界和平與文化交流。
sentences.en: The Chunghua Federation of Traditional Religious Associations collaborates with multiple international religious organizations to jointly promote world peace and cultural exchange.

phrase.en: Chunghua Society for Ancient and Modern Humanities

sentences.zh: 中華古今人文協會致力於推廣中國傳統文化與現代人文精神。
sentences.en: The Chunghua Society for Ancient and Modern Humanities is dedicated to promoting traditional Chinese culture and contemporary humanities.

sentences.zh: 每年，中華古今人文協會都會舉辦一系列學術講座和文化活動。
sentences.en: Every year, the Chunghua Society for Ancient and Modern Humanities organizes a series of academic lectures and cultural events.

sentences.zh: 李教授是中華古今人文協會的重要成員，他在研究古代文獻方麵作出了突出的貢獻。
sentences.en: Professor Li is an important member of the Chunghua Society for Ancient and Modern Humanities, and he has made outstanding contributions in the field of ancient document research.

sentences.zh: 該協會的成員來自世界各地，共同致力於中華文化的傳承與發展。
sentences.en: Members of the Chunghua Society for Ancient and Modern Humanities come from all over the world, united in their dedication to the preservation and development of Chinese culture.

sentences.zh: 他被譽為公司中的中流砥柱，因為他的才智和領導能力。
sentences.en: He is regarded as the foundation pillar of society within the company due to his intellect and leadership skills.

sentences.zh: 醫生和護士在這次疫情中成為社會的中流砥柱，守護著每一個病患。
